32. vibhāṣā jasi|(1.1.32)
ṭhjasaḥ kāryaṃ prati' ityādi| etacc vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādasyā
vibhāṣāyā 
labhyate| atha vā jasīti kāryāpekṣayā ādhārasaptamīyam, na tu
sarvādyapekṣayā parasaptamī; tena jasi yat kāryamu jasādhāraṃ yat
kāryaṃ jasaḥ śībhāvaḥ tatra vibhāṣā bhavati, nānyatra
| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyata ityata āha-ṭhakaj hi na bhavati' iti hi
śabdo hetau|evaṃ 
vyākhyāyamāne sati ṭhkatarakatamakāḥ' ityatrākaj na bhavati;
pūrvasūtreṇa saṃjñāpratiṣedhāt anyathā hi yadi jasi parataḥ saṃjñā
vikalpyate,tadā pakṣe'kaj bhavedeva| tathā ca tasya tanmadhyapatitvāt
tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt pākṣikaḥ śībhāvaḥ prasajyeta| kapratyaye tu sati
tena vyavadhānādevaiṣa doṣo na bhavati|

yaduktam--ṭhdambherhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāt siddham' iti
tadupapannaṃ bhavati| 

42.tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇaḥ karmadhārayaḥ (1.2.42)| 
ṭhtatpuruṣaḥ' iti samāsaviśeṣasyākhyā| sa ca eka evaśabdaḥ| anekasya ca 
śabdasya bhinnapravṛtinimitakasyaikasminnarthe vṛtiḥ
usāmānādhikāraṇyam| tataśca yatra bāhyaena padena tatpurūṣasya
sāmānadhikaraṇyamÂ, tatraiveyaṃ saṃjñā syāt--rājapuruṣaḥ śobhana
ityādau,asti hyatra tatpuruṣasya kenacit sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti;
śobhanaśabdena saha| pācakavṛndāriketyādau tu na syāt, na hyatra
tatpuruṣasya kenacit sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti; śabdāntarasya
prayogābhāvāditi codyamapākartumāha- ṭhsamānādhikaraṇapadaḥ' iti|
samānam u abhinnam, ekamadhikaraṇam u vācyaṃ yeṣāṃ padānāṃ tāni
samānādhikaraṇāni padāni, tānyāśrayabhūtāni yasya tatpuruṣasya sa
samānādhikaraṇapadastatpuruṣaḥ| etena tatpuruṣārthānāṃ padānāṃ
samānādhikaraṇatvādupacāreṇa tatpuruṣo'tra sūtre
samānādhikaraṇaśabdenokta iti darśayati| kathaṃ punarbāhyanyapadāpekṣayā
tatpuruṣasya mukhye sāmānādhikaraṇye sambhavati satyaupacārikasya
grahaṇamupapadyate ? ṭhkarmadhārayaḥ' iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇāt| iha
hi lāghavārthatvāt kasaṃjñākaraṇasya, laghīyasyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ
ṭhkarmadhārayaḥ' iti mahatīṃ saṃjñāṃ kurvatā-- ṭhanyo'pyatra kaścit
viparyayaḥ saṃjñāyāmāśritaḥ' ityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcitaḥ| tena
ṭhgauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasampratyayaḥ' (vyā.pa.4) iti mukhyasya
samānādhikaraṇasya grahaṇaṃ na vijñāyate|
ṭhsamānābhidheyaḥ' iti. tadarthānāṃ padānāṃ samānābhidheyatvāt
tatpuruṣo'pyupacāreṇa samānābhidheya ityuktaḥ| ṭhparamarājyam,
utamarājyam' iti| ṭhsanmahat' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsaḥ| karmadhāraye
sati ṭhakarmadhāraye rājyam' (6.2.130) ityutarapadādyaudātamatvaṃ na
bhavati| ṭhpācakavṛndārikā' iti| vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ' (2.1.62) iti
puṃvadbhāvaḥ| ṭhpācikābhāryaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhirayam| tenātra ṭhna
kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti pratiṣedho bhavatyeva| ṭhbrāhmaṇarājyam' iti|
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam| tenātra samāsāntodātameva na bhavati, api
tūtarapadādyaudātatvam||

43. prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam| (1.2.43)
ṭhsamāse' ityadhikaraṇanirdeaśo'yam| kaṣṭaśritādayaḥ samāsāḥ na
kiñcit prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ śabdarūpamasti| tathā hi-- samāse kṛte tata
eva samāsād vibhaktirutpadyate, na tu tatra sthāccchabdāt| na ca
vākyakāle samāsārthāt padād yā prathamotpannā tadāśrayaṃ
prathamānirdiṣṭatvaṃ samāsāvayavasya kalpayituṃ yuktam, yataḥ ṭhsamāse'
ityadhikaraṇanirdeaśo'yam| tatra samāse kṛte yasmāt prathamotpadyate,
tadeva samāse prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ bhavati; na tu yasmāt vākyakāle
vibhaktikāle vibhaktirutpadyate| taddhi vākya eva prathamānirdiṣṭam, na tu
samāse; prāgeva samāsāt tasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt| tataśca samāse
kṛte prathamānirdiṣṭasya saṃjñino'sambhavāt saṃjñā na
sambhavītyetaccodyamapākartumāha- ṭhprathamayā vibhaktyā yannirdiśyate'
iti| samāsārthaṃ yacchāstraṃ tat samāsaśāstraṃ gṛhyate| tatra
prathamānirdiṣṭasyeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, na tu kaṣṭaśritādau; samāse
prathamānirdiṣṭasyāvidyāmānatvāt vidyate ca samāsaśāstre
prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ saṃjñīti kutaḥ saṃjñāyā aprasiddhiḥ ? kathaṃ punaḥ
ṭhsamāse' ityucyamāne samāsaśāstre yat prathamayā nirdiśyate tasya
saṃjñitvaṃ labhyata ityata āha-- ṭhsamāse' iti| ṭhsamāsaśāstraṃ gṛhyate iti|
kathaṃ punaḥ ṭhsamāse' ityucyamāne samāsaśāstraṃ grahītuṃ śakyam ?
tādarthyāt tatra samāsaśabdasya pravṛteḥ| bhavati hi tādarthyāt
tāvaccchabdyam , yathā-- pradīpārthā mallikā ṭhpradīpaḥ' iti, indrārthā
sthūṇā ṭhindraḥ' iti| kaṣṭaśritādiṣūpasarjanasaṃjñayāyāḥ kāryam--
ṭhupasarjanaṃ pūrvam' (2.2.30) iti pūrvanipātaḥ|
tatredaṃ codyate-- rājñaḥ kumāraĀ paśya rājakumāraĀ paśyetyatra
rājanÂśabdaḥ ṭhṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭaḥ;
ṭhdvitīyā śritātītapatita' (2.1.24) iti dvitīyāsamāsaśāstre
kumārīśabdaśca| samasāśāstre tatrobhayorapyasyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ
pūrvanipātāniyama upasarjanahrasvasvatvañcetyetaddoṣadvayaṃ
prāpnotīti| iha ca rājñaḥ kumāryāḥ svaṃ rājakumārīsvamiti
dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhaḷntayoḥ samāsaśāstre
prathamānirdiṣṭatvādubhayorapyupasarjanasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tadeva
doṣadvayaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādusarjanamiti mahatyāḥ
saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam-- anvarthasaṃjñā yathā
vijñāyeteti| apradhanāmupasarjanam, pradhānamanupasarjamiti|
apradhānañca pradhānamapekṣate; sambandhiśabdatvāt| tatra
samnabdhādetavagantavyaṃ yat prati yadapradhānaṃ tat
pratitadupasarjanamiti| śritādaĀścāpekṣya dvitīyāntamupasarjanaṃ
bhavati, na tu dvitīyāntamātram| na ceha śritādayaḥ santi| rājñaḥ
kumāryāḥ svaṃ rājakumārīsvamityātrāpyeṣa parīhāraḥ| atrāpi
kumārīśabdamapekṣya rājanśabdasyāprādhānyam; na tu
rājanÂśabdamapekṣya kumārīśabdasya| tasmāt
rājanÂśabdasyopasarjanasaṃjñā, na tu kumārīśabdasya| yadi
hyanvarthasaṃjñeyam, pācakavṛndārikā, puruṣavyāghraḥ, ardhapippalī,
pūrvakāyaḥ-- ityeteṣu pūrvapadārtha eva pradhānamiti
pācikādīnāmiha prādhānyam| ato yadyapyete ṭhvṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ
pūjyamānam' (2.1.62), ṭhupamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge'
(2.1.56), ṭhardhaṃ napuṃsakam' (2.2.2),
ṭhpūrvāparādharotaramekadeśikanaikādhikaraṇe' (2.2.1) ityeteṣu
samāsaśāstreṣu prathamānirdiṣṭāḥ, tathāpi teṣāmupasarjanasaṃjñā na
prāpnoti; kutaḥ ? teṣāṃ prādhānyāt| evaṃ
tarhyutarasūtre'nuktasamuccayārthatvāccakārasya bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|
anyastvevaṃ manyate-- ṭhpācakavṛndāriketyevamādiṣu pūrvokteṣu
samāseṣvādyau ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam' (2.1.57), ṭhupamānāni
sāmānyavacanaiḥ' (2.1.55) ityetābhyāmeva siddhau; śeṣau tu ṭhṣaṣṭhī'
(2.2.8) ityanenaiva| tasmāt ṭhvṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ' (2.1.62)
ityādīnāṃ na tadartha ārambhaḥ; kiṃ tarhi ? upasarjana saṃjñārthaḥ;
tenāsatyapi pācikādīnāmapradhānatve teṣāmiyaṃ saṃjñā bhaviṣyati"
iti, etaccāsamyak, tathā hi -- ṭhpūjyamānam', ṭhsāmānyāprayoge',
ṭhnapuṃsakam', ṭhekādhikaraṇam'-- ityetān viśeṣān
vakṣyāmītyetadartha ārambhaḥ syāt| sati caitadartha
ārambhe'trāpradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā pradhānasya na syāt||

44. ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte| (1.2.44)
apradhamānirdiṣṭārtho'yamārambhaḥ| vibhaktiśabdaḥ supāṃ vācakaḥ,
vibhāgavacano vā| kārakaśaktirvibhāgaḥ--vibhajyate
prātipadikārtho'nayeti kṛtvā| ṭhsamāse vidhīyamāne' 
iti| samāsārthavākyakāle| tadā hi tasya samāsasya vidhīyamānatā
bhavati| etena samāsagrahaṇamanuvartamānaṃ samāsārthe vākye vartate, na
samāsaśāstra iti darśayati| samāsaśāstre hi sarvameva
śabdarūpamekavibhaktikameva bhavatītyekavibhaktigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi
bhāvaḥ| sarvameva hi prātipadikaṃ paryāyeṇaikayā vibhaktyā prayujyate|
tasmādekavibhaktigrahaṇasāmarthyādavadhāraṇamatra vijñāyata ityata āha--
ṭhyanniyatavibhaktikam' iti| tadeva spaṣṭīkurvannāha-- ṭhdvitīye
sambandhiti' ityādi| ṭhpūrvapadenānāvibhaktike'pi' iti|
niṣkrāntaśabdaḥ kartṛśaktyupasarjanībhūtaṃ dravyamāha|
taccānekasādhanaśaktyupacitamiti
kriyāntarasambandhādenekasādhanavibhaktikaṃ bhavati| ṭhutarapadaṃda tu
pañcamyantameva bhavati' iti|
niṣakramaṇakriyāpekṣayā''virbhūtāpādānaśaktikatvāt|
ṭhniṣkauśāmbiḥ'
ityatropasarjanasaṃjñākāryamṭhgāstriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti
hasvatvam| atha niso'tra kenopasarjanasaṃjñā vidhīyate, yayo'sya
pūrvanipātaḥ ? pūrvasūtreṇeti cet, naitadasti;
tenāpradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñāvidhānāt, nisaścātra prādhānyāt| evaṃ
tarhi cakārasyānuktasamuccāyārthatvāt bhaviṣyati| 
anye tvāhuḥ-- mā bhūnnisa upasarjanasaṃjñā, asatyāmapi tasyāṃ
pūrvanipāto bhaviṣyati, ṭhekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte' (1.2.44) iti
vacanāditi, etaccāyuktam; pūrvanipāte hi kartavya
ekavibhaktikasyopasarjanasaṃjñā nāstyeva| tatra yadi nisa upasarjanasaṃjñā
na syāt, tadodaharaṇe dvayorapyasatyāṃ tasyāṃ paryāyeṇāniyaḥ
pūrvanipātaḥ prasajyeta| atha kathamardhapippalyādīnāmūpasarjanasaṃjñā na
bhavati ? atra ca ṭhvibhāṣā ccchandasi' (1.2.36) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ
mamḍūakaplutanyāyenānuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenārdha
pippalyā ardhapippalītyādau viṣaye
pippalyādīnāmekavibhaktiyuktānāmapyusarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati| yadi hi
syāt, tadā hrasvatvaṃ syāt||

45. arthavadagadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam| (1.2.45)
ṭhabhidheyavacano'yamarthaśabdaḥ' iti| etena
prayojanādivacanādvayavaccchinati| arthaśabdo hi
prayojanavacano'pyasti, yathā-- anenārthanāgataḥ, anena
prayojaneneti gamyate| nivṛtivacano'pyassi, yathā-- maśakārartho
dhūma iti, maśakanivṛtyartha iti gamyate|
dhanavacano'pyasti,yathā--arthavān devadata iti, dhanavāniti gamyate|
abhidheyavacano'pyasti, yathā-- asya vacanasyāyamartha iti,
idamasyābhidheyamiti gamyate| iha tvabhidheyavacanasyaiva grahaṇam| tat
punarabhidheyaṃ jātiguṇakriyādravyabhedena caturvidham|ata eva
catuṣṭayī śabdānāṃ pravṛtirbhavati| tatra jātiśabdānāṃ
jātirabhidheyā-- gauriti| yadyarthavataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā vidhīyate
tadā'bhāvavacanaśaśaviṣāṇādiśabdānāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā nopapadyate,
arthābhāvāt, naitadasti; ṭharthaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ' (kā.1.2.45)
ityuktam, abhāvo'pyabhidheyo bhavatyeva| anyathā hyarthābhāvāditīdaṃ
vacanamanuccāraṇīyaṃ syāt, anarthakatvāt, na hyanarthakaṃ vacanaṃ
prayogarhati| tasmādabāvavacanānāmapi prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatyeva|
ṭhnāntasyādhermā bhūt' iti| nanu cādhāturiti pratiṣedho
bhaviṣyati, tathā hi ṭhvana sambhkatau' (dhā.pā.463), ṭhdhana dhānye'
(dhā.pā.1104) ityetayoḥ dharātvorete rūpe, naitadasti;
avyutpannāvapi vanadhanaśabdau staḥ, tayorevāyaṃ prayogaḥ| atra yadi
nāntasyāvadheḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā syāt tadā subutpatiḥ syāt,
tataśca padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ nalopaḥ syāt| nanu ca ṭhadhātuḥ'
ṭhapratyayaḥ'-- naitadasti; anarthakasyāpi dhātorvidyamānatvāt yathā-- ṭhiṅ
adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1046), ṭhik smaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1047) iti--
etayoradhipūrvayorevārthavatvam, na kevalayoḥ| yastu
gaṇapāṭhe'nayorarthanirdeaśaḥ, sa samudāyārthamavayave'dhyāropya kṛta
iti veditavyam| adhyāropitārthayorapi
tayorgaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāddhātusaṃjñā bhavatyeva| evaṃ
pratyayo'pyanarthako'pyasti| yathā-- ṭhyāvādibhyaḥ kan' (5.4.29), yāva
eva yāvaka iti| na hyatra pratyayasyānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śakyate'rthavatvaṃ
pratyetum| vināpi tena kanpratyayena yāvaśabdādeva tadarthaḥ
pratīyayate| tasmādarthavaditi yuktamuktam|
ṭhahan' iti| adāditvāccchapo luk, tipo halṅyādinā (6.1.68)
lopaḥ, aṭ| sa ca hantigrahaṇena gṛhyata iti kṛte'pi tasmin
hantirdātureva| atra vinā dhātugrahaṇena prāgeva pratyayotpateḥ
prātipadikasaṃjñā syāt| nalopastu pratyayotpatau padatve
satyutarakālam| atha vā-- prātipadikasaṃjñā'pi
pratyayotpaterutarakālameva syāt, tasmāddhātugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| nanu
cātra pratyayalakṣaṇena ṭhapratyayaḥ' iti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam,tat
kimadhātugrahaṇena ? naitadasti; prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ nalopaḥ kāryaḥ,
nalope ca ṭhna ṅsimbuddhayoḥ' (8.2.8) iti pratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ-
pratyayalakṣaṇena ṭhapratyayaḥ' iti pratiṣedho na pravartata iti| yadi
hyapratyaya iti pratyayalakṣaṇena he rājannityevamādiṣu
prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, ṭhna ṅsimbuddhayoḥ' (8.2.8) iti
pratiṣedho anarthakaḥ syāt; prāptyabhāvāt| atha bhid-cchid-lūḥ-
pūrityevamādīnāṃ kathaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā, yāvatā kvibantā
dhātutvaṃ na jahatīti dhātava evaita iti, atrādhāturiti pratiṣedhena
bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; mā bhūdanena, kṛdantatvādutara sūtreṇa
bhaviṣyati| na cotarasyāḥ prāpterayaṃ bādhakaḥ; vākyāntarasthatvāt|
ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante notarān' (vyā.pa.10)
iti vā|
ṭhkāṇḍe, kuḍaḷe' iti| prathamādvivacanānte ete rūpe| ṭhnapuṃsakācca'
(7.1.19) iti śībhāvaḥ| atra ca ṭhpratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa
vihitastadādestadantasya' (bhā.pa.sū.7) iti tadantasya pratiṣedho
bhaviṣyati, na pratyayamātrasya| nanu ca ṭhsuptiṅntaṃ padam' (1.4.14)
ityatrāntagrahaṇena ṭhanyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti'
iti jñāpitatvāt ṭhapratyayaḥ' iti pratyayāntasya pratiṣedho na labhyate,
naiṣa doṣaḥ; saṃjñāvidhau sa pratiṣedhaḥ, na cāyaṃ saṃjñāvidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi
? pratiṣedhavidhiḥ| atha kimarthamapratyaya ita pratiṣedha ucyate,
yāvatotarasūtre kṛtaddhitagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--
ṭhkṛtaddhitāntasyaiva prātipadikasaṃjñā, nānyapratyayāntasya--
kāṇḍe,kuḍaḷe ityevamādeḥ'iti ? naitadasti, asatyasmin
pratiṣedhe'nyatraṭhsaṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' iti
kṛtaddhitayoreva prātipadikasaṃjñā syānna tadantasya; tadantasya
caiveṣyate-- bhiccchillūḥpūrityevamādīnāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñārtham|
satyapratyaya ityetasmin pratiṣedhe prāpte yathā kṛtaddhitāntasya
prātipadikasaṃjñā labhyate tathotarasūtre pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ| nanu ca
ṭhkāṇḍe' ṭhkuḍye'-- ityetayoḥ pūrvameva prakṛteḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā
pravṛtā, vibhaktyā ca sahaikādeśe kṛte'ntādivadbhāvādastyeva
prātipadikatvamiti satyapyapratyayagrahaṇe hrasvatvaṃ prāpnotyeva,
naitadasti; apratyayagrahaṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati,anyathā
hyapratyayagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syātÂ|
ṭhadhāturapratyayaḥ' iti dviṣpratiṣedhaḥ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣāśaṅkānirāsārthaḥ
ṭhadhātupratyayaḥ' ityucyamāne ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣo'pyāśaṅkyeta--
dhātoryaḥ pratyayasya na bhavatīti||

46. kṛtaddhitasamāsāśca| (1.2.46)
atra ṭhanyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagraṇe tadantavidhirnāsti'
ityatannopatiṣṭhate, yasmādapratyaya iti pratiṣedhe prāpte vacanamidam|
ṭhapratyayaḥ' iti pratyayāntasya pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ| tena yatra saṃjñāyāḥ
pratiṣedhastatreyamārabhyamāṇā tadantasyaiva bhavatītyetaccetasi
kṛtvā''ha-- ṭhapratyaya iti pūrvasūtre paryudāsāt kṛdantasya'
ityādi|
atha samāsagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā samāsasyārthavatvāt pūrveṇaiva
saṃjñā
siddhetyata āha-- ṭharthavatsamudāyānām' ityādi|
nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhīyam-- arthavanto ye samudāyāsteṣāṃ madhye
samāsasyārthavataḥ samudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā yathā syāditi
niyamārthaṃ samāsagrahaṇam|
yadyevam, prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyārthavataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā na

yuktavadbhāvapratiṣedha iti| sa ca
vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāllabhyate|
ṭhcañcābhirūpaḥ' iti| cañceva manuṣyaścañcā-- ṭhive pratikṛtau' (5.3.96)
iti kan| tasya ṭhlum manuṣye' (5.3.98) iti lup| ṭhabhirūpaḥ' iti
viśeṣaṇasyābhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti| ṭh
vardhrikā' iti| pūrvavat kÄallupau||

53. tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt| (1.2.53)
ṭhtadaśiṣyam' iti pratijñā, ṭhsaṃjñāpramāṇatvāt' - iti hetuḥ| yasmāt
saṃjñābhūtānāṃ pañcālādiśabdānāṃ pramāṇatvam, tasmāt tadaśiṣyam|
pramāṇatvaṃ punaḥ pratyayalakṣaṇam| sarveṣāmeva śabdānāmevaṃ vidhe
svaviṣaye pramāṇatvamasti, ucyate cedam, tatra viśeṣo vijñāyate, sa
punarabhidheyagataliṅgasaṃkhyānapekṣayā bhinnaliṅgasaṃkhyānāmapi
teṣāṃ svārthe pratyāyakatvam| ata evāha-- ṭhsaṃjñāśabdā hi
nānāliṅgasaṃkhyāḥ' iti| ṭhpramāṇam'iti| pramāṇaṃ pratyāyakā vācakā
ityarthaḥ| tatraitat syāt-- saṃjñāśabdā evāmī pañcālādayo na
bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi ? yoganimitakā ityata āha-- ṭhpañcālā varaṇāḥ'
ityādi| yoganimitakāḥ śabdā yogaśabdāḥ| na hi pañcālādayaḥ
śabdāḥ kṣatriyādisambandhena janapadādau vartante; kiṃ tarhi ? saṃjñā etā
janapadādīnām| 
yadi saṃjñāśabdā ete, tataḥ kimiti ? tadaśiṣyamityata āha-- ṭhtatra
liṅgaṃ vacanañca' ityādi| kuta etat ? yat saṃjñāśabdānāṃ liṅgaṃ
vacanañca tatsvabhāvasiddhamityata āha-- ṭhyathā' ityādi| ekasyāmapi
jalakaṇikāyāṃ bahuvacanāntaḥ strīliṅgo'pśabdaḥ prayujyate,
ekasyāmapi yoṣiti dāraśabdaḥ puṃlliṅgo bahuvacanāntaḥ,
gṛhaśabdaścaikasmin veśmani bahuvacanāntaḥ puṃlliṅgaśca,
ekasyāmapi vālukāyāṃ bahuvacanāntaḥ sikatāśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ,
varṣā ita ekasmin viśiṣṭakāle'pi pravartamānaḥ strīliṅgo
bahuvacanāntaśca vartate| tasmāt yathaiveṣāmapprabhṛtiśabdānāṃ
svābhāvikaṃ liṅgaṃ vacanañca tathā pañcālādiśabdānāmapīti nārtho
yuktavadbhāvacanena| yadyevam, kasmāt pūrvaṃ taduktam ?
pratiṣedhaviṣayopadarśanārtham| na hyanirdiṣṭaviṣayasya pratiṣedhaḥ
śakyate kartu jñātuṃ vā||
54. lubyogāprakhyānāt| (1.2.54)
ṭhyogaprakhyānāt' iti|yogo janapadādeḥ kṣatriyādibhiḥ saha
sambandhaḥ, tasyāprakhyānādanupalabdherityarthaḥ| ye hi yoganimitikāḥ
śabdā yogamabhidhāya tadvati dravye vartante, tebhyo yoga upalabhyate;
yathā-- daṇḍiśabdādibhyaḥ| na ca pañcālādibhyo daṇḍaḷadiśapabdavadyoga
upalabhyate, tasmānnaite yogaśabdā ityata āha- ṭhna hi' ityādi|
prakhyāyate u kathyate, prakāśyate, buddherviṣaya āpadyata iti yāvat| yata
evaṃ pañcālā varaṇā iti sambandho na prakhyayate ata eva
naitadupalabhāmahe vṛkṣayogānnagare varaṇā iti, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃjñā etā
anapekṣitapravṛtinimitāḥ| yadi saṃjñāśbadā ete, tataḥ kimityāha--
ṭhtasmādatra' ityādi| gatārtham| nanu ca saṃjñā śabdānāmapi
vyutpatyartha taddhita utpadyata e, yathā ṭhhastājjātau' (5.2.133) hastī,
ṭhkambalācca saṃjñāyām' (5.1.3) kambalyamiti, tatkimucyate-- "
tasmādatra ṭhtasya nivāsaḥ' (4.2.69) ṭhadūrabhavaśca' (4.2.70) iti taddhito
notpadyate" iti ? satyam, saṃjñāśabdavyutpatyarthaṃ taddhita utpadyate| sa ca
kvotpadyate ? yatra śrutikṛto viśeṣo vidyate, na ceha taddhitotpatau
lupi sati
kaścidviśeṣa iti na taddhitotpatiḥ||

55. yogapramāṇe ca tadabhāve'darśanaṃ syāt| (1.2.55)
ṭhyogapramāṇe' iti| yogasya pramāṇaṃ yogapramāṇam, yena yogaḥ
pratyāyyate| tat punariha prakṛtatvāt pañcālādiśabdaḥ| sa hi
paramatena pañcālādisambandhaṃ svapravṛtinimitamabhidhāyaiva
janapadādau vartate, nānabhidhāya| tena yogasya pramāṇaṃ pratyāyako
vācaka ityarthaḥ| ṭhtadabhāve'darśanaṃ syāt' iti| yo hi
yoganimitakaḥ sa yogābhāve na prayujyate,
daṇaḍaḷadiśabdavadityabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhyogapramāṇe hi' ityādi| hiśabdaṃ
hetvarthaṃ prayuñjānaścaśabdo hetvarthavṛtiḥ sūtre upāta iti darśayati|
syādetat, bhavatyeva yogābhāve pañcālādiśabdasyādarśanamityata
āha-- ṭhdṛśyate ca' ityādi| gatārtham|

56. pradhānapratyayārthavacanamarthasyānyapramāṇatvāt| (1.2.56)
ṭhanyapramāṇatvāt' iti| anyat pramāṇam
avagatiheturyasyārthābhidhānalakṣaṇasya tadanyapramāṇam, tasya
bhāvo'nyapramāṇatvam| ṭhpradhānaṃ samāse kiñcit padam' iti| yathā
rājapuruṣaśabde puruṣa ityetat| ṭhpradhānopasarjane' ityādi|
rājapuruṣa ityatra pūrvavadupasarjanam, itarat pradhānam| te ca
pradhānārtha saha brūtaḥ| ṭhprakṛtipratyayau' ityādi| aśakyatvaṃ
tvanantaprakāratvāt| tathā hi-- citraguriti bahuvrīhau kṛte
guṇaguṇibhyāmanyapadārtha ucyate| atra guṇapadaṃ citraśabdo'pradhānam,
viśeṣaṇatvāt; guṇipadaṃ gośabdaḥ pradhānam, viśeṣyatvāt|
kvacidupasarjanābhyāmanyo'rtho'bhidhīte-- plakṣanyagrādhāviti| tathā
hi, na kevalaṃ prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ api tu, kvacit
prakṛtyarthamapi, yathā-- svārthikeṣu śuklataram, śuklatamamiti| tathā
kecidākhyāteṣu svabhāvāt pradhānamāhuḥ prakṛtyartham--
ṭhkriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti|
anye tu manyante- ākhyāteṣu pradhānabhūtaḥ pratyayārtha eva
śaktirūpeṇocyate, yathā vibhaktibhiḥ kvacit pratyaye; na tu śaktimān
padārtho dravyabhāvamāpanna ucyate| ataḥ kriyāntareṇa ca sambandhe
śaktyantaramāvirbhavati kartāraṃ paśyeti|
evamādyanantaprakāramarthābhidhānaśakyaṃ sarvamupadeṣṭuam, tasmāllokata
evārthāvagatiḥ| kathaṃ punaretadvijñāyata ityata āha-- ṭhyairapi' ityādi|
sugamam||

57. kālopasarjane ca tulyam| (1.2.57)
arthasyānyapramāṇatvādityuktam| kathaṃ punaratrāpyayaṃ heturlabhyata iti
praśnāvasara ityāha-- ṭhtulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārthaḥ' iti| kathaṃ
punastulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtho bhavati ? manyate-- tulyamiti
pratyākhyānakriyāviśeṣaṇametat| anantaroktena pratyākhyānena
tulyametat pratyākhyānam| evañc tulyaṃ bhavati yadi yastasya
hetuḥ sa evāsyāpi bhavati| tasmāt tulyagrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūrvako
hetutrānuvartate| tena tulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtho bhavatīti|
ṭhānyāyyādutthānāt' ityādi| utthānaṃ śayanādrātreḥ paścime yāme
nyāyyamuktam| saṃveśanam u śayanam tadapi rajanyāḥ prathame yāme
nyāyyam| tadevaṃ sakalo divasaḥ; pūrvasyāśca rātreḥ paścimo
yāmaḥ, āgaminyāśca prathamo yāma ityeṣo'dyatanaḥ kāla ityuktaṃ bhavati|
ṭhaharubhayato'rddharātram' ityādi| kṛtsno divasa ubhayaścārddharātram|
atikrāntāyāśca rātrerāgāminyāśca rātreradyatanaḥ kāla ityapare||

58.jātyākhyāmekasminbahuvacanamanyatarasyām| (1.2.58)
ṭhjātirnāmāyameko'rthaḥ ityādinā sūtrārambhasya prayojanamāha| nanu

sā vidyata evetyadoṣaḥ| ṭhjāterākhyā' iti| ākhyānamākhyā u
pratyāyanam| ṭhekasminnarthe' iti| jātyākhyo'rtho ṭhjātyartho

jātiviśeṣaṇebhyaḥ sampannādibhyastanna syāt|

bahuvadbhāvo labhyate ? anvarthagrahaṇāt| bahuvacanamiha na
pāribhāṣikaṃ bahuvacanaṃ gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anvartham| uktiḥ u
vacanam| bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ bahuvacam. na caikasminnarthe bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ

tadanena prakāreṇa jātyartho bahuvadbhavati| ṭhtena' ityādi| yata e

nanu cātrāvasthābhedenānekādhāraṃ devadatatvamasti, naitadasti; evaṃ
hi jātigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, sarvatra jāteḥ sambhavāt|
tasmājjātigrahaṇasāmarthyālloke ye jātiśabdāḥ, pratītāḥ, tadarthā
evātra jātiśabdena vivakṣitā iti vijñāyate, na ca devadataśabdo
loke jātiśabdaḥ pratītaḥ|
ṭhkāśyapapratikṛtiḥ kāśyapaḥ' iti| kāśyapasyāpatyam ṭhanṛṣyānantarye
vidādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.104) ityañ-- kāśyapa iti| tata ivārthe ṭheve

jātipratyāyane hi cikīrṣite bahuvadbhāvena bhavitavyam| na ceha

59. asmado dvayośca| (1.2.59)
atrāpyarthasya bahutvātideśaḥ| ṭhasmado yo'rthaḥ sa bahuvadbhavati'
iti| tena tiṅntasyāpi tatra vartamānasya bahuvacanāntatvaṃ bhavati|
ṭhvayaṃ brūmaḥ' iti| ṭhekatve dvitve ca' ityādi| yuktaṃ yadekatve bhavati,
dvitve tu katham ? na hi dvitvamasmadarthasya sambhavati;
asmaccchabdasyātmaviṣayatvāt, ātmanaścaikatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ātmatvaṃ
paratra yadopacaryate ṭhayaṃ me dvitīya ātmā' iti tadā asmaccchabdasya
tatrāpi vṛtedvaryarthaviṣayatvaṃ sambhavati| atha vā-- tyadādīnāṃ mitho
yadyat paraṃ taccchiṣyata ityasmaccchabda eva śiṣyamāṇo
yuṣmadarthamapyāheti dvayarthatopapadyata iti yujyate dvayarthatā| atha
yadyasmaccchabdo bahuvacanāntaḥ prayujyate tadaikārthaviṣayo'yam, na
dvayarthaviṣaya iti; atha dvyarthaviṣayo'yaṃ naikārthaviṣaya iti
kutasyasyaikārthadvayarthaviṣaye vṛtiravasīyate ? prakaraṇāt| yathā--
ārāccchabdasya dūrāntikārthayorvṛtiriti| ṭhaham' iti| ṭhReĀ
prathamayoram' (7.1.28) ityambhāvaḥ, ṭhtvāhau sau' (7.2.94)
ityahāradeśaḥ| ṭhvayam' iti| jasi ṭhmaparyantasya' (7.2.91) ṭhyūyavayau
jasi' (7.2.93) ita vayādeśaḥ, ṭhśeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) ṭhāvām' iti|
āṬpratyaye ṭhyuvāvau dvivacane' (7.2.92) ityāvādeśaḥ| ṭhprathamāyāśca'
(7.2.88) ityādinātvam| vaktavya iti vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānāṃ
tu-- anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ yadanuvartatate tasya
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| ṭhyuṣmadi gurāvekeṣām'

60. phalgunīproṣṭhapadānāñca nakṣatre| (1.2.60)
ṭhcakāro dvayoranukarṣanārthaḥ' iti| nanu ca phalgunyau nakṣatre dve eva,
tathā proṣṭhapade api dve; atrānayorditvādvitva eva bahuvacanaṃ
bhaviṣyati, tat kiṃ cakāreṇa dvayorityanukarṣaṇārthena ? evaṃ
tarhyetajjñāpayati-- nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa upalakṣaṇārthamiti| tenaitadapi
siddhaṃ bhavati-- uditāḥ pūrvāḥ phalguṇyaḥ, udite pūrve phalgunyāviti|
yadi nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa upalakṣaṇārthamiti na jñāpyate, tadiha tu na
syāt, yato jyotiṣāmāvasthikī nakṣatratā candramasā yoge sati
bhavati, nānyadā; anyadā tu jyotiṣṭvameva| na ca nakṣatrābhidhāyinaḥ
ṭhuditāḥ pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ' ityatra phalgunīśabdasya prayogaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ?
jyotirmātrābhidhāyina iti| atra jyotiṣṭvameksayāpyastīti
tannivṛtyarthaṃ dvayorityanukarṣaṇārthaṃ cakārakaraṇaṃ yuktam| yadi
punarjyotiṣa
upalakṣaṇārthaṃ nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ na syāt, tadā kva syāt ? tadehaiva
syāt-- adya pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ, adya pūrve phalgunyāviti| asti hyatra
phalgunyornakṣatratā, candramasā yuktatvāt| tathā ha-- ṭhnakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ
kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ bhavati| śravaṇaṃ tasya na bhavati; ṭhlubaviśeṣe'
(4.2.4) iti luptatvāt|
ṭhphalgunyau māṇavike' iti| phalgunyorjāte iti| ṭhphalgunyāṣāḍhābhyāṃ

63.tiṣyapunarvavasvornakṣatradvandve bahuvacanasya dvivacanaṃ nityam|
(1.2.63)
ṭhtiṣyapunarvasavo māṇavakāḥ' iti| tiṣyapunarvasuśabdābhyāṃ
ṭhnakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ bhavati| tasya ṭhlubaviśeṣe'
(4.2.4) iti lup| tatastiṣye jāto māṇavakaḥ punarvasvorjātau
māṇavakāviti ṭhsandhivelādi' (4.3.16) ityādinā'ṇ, tasya
ṭhśraviṣṭhāphalgunyanurādhā' (4.3.34) ityādinā lup| ṭhparyāyāṇāmapi
yathā syāt' iti| nakṣatragrahaṇe satyarthagrahaṇādetadbhavati| śabdagrahaṇe
ca ṭhsvaṃ rūpam' (1.1.68) ityaṣā paribhāṣā bhavatītyuktametat|
tadabhāve paryāyāṇāmapi bhavati| ṭhsiddhyapunarvasū' iti|
siddhyaśabdastiṣyaparyāyaḥ| ṭhyastiṣyastau punarvasū yeṣām'
ityavayavena vigrahaṃ darśayati| samudāyastu samāsārtho veditavyaḥ|
atha tiṣyapunarvasava iti ? bahuvrīhiṇā viparyastamatayaḥ puruṣā
evaivamucyante | tataśca nakṣatrasamāsa evāyaṃ na bhavati| tat
kimetannivṛtyarthena dvandvagrahaṇenetyevaṃ yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha--
ṭhtiṣyādaya eva' ityādi| svadarṇanāparādhādanyathā tiṣyādīn dṛṣṭvā
pratipatṛbhista e tiṣyādayo viparyayeṇa dṛśyamānā 
bahuvrīhiṇaivamucyante, na tu puruṣāḥ| tasmānnakṣatrasamāsa evāyam|
ṭhtiṣyapunarvasvidam' iti| kena punaratraikavadbhāvaḥ ?
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) iti cet, na; saṃjñāśabadtvāt,
devadatādiśabdavat| nāyaṃ jātiśabdaḥ,anekadhārā hi jātirbhavati,
na ca tiṣyādistathā| kiñca vakṣyati-- ṭhjātipradhānaparatve ca
jātidravyāṇāmayamekavadbhāvaḥ, na niyatadravyavivakṣāyām' iti;
niyatadravyavivakṣā cātra, tasmānna ṭhjātiraprāṇinām'
ityanenaikavadbhāva upapadyate| na cānyadekavadbhāvalakṣaṇamasti| tatra
tiṣyapunarvasvornakṣatre 
dvandvasamāse bahutvādbahuvacanena bhavitavyam| evañca
bahuvacanagrahaṇamanarthakamityata āha-- ṭhsarvo dvandvo vibhāṣā' ityādi|
yadayamekavacananivṛtyarthaṃ bahuvacanagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tato'vasīyate--
astīyamparibhāṣā ṭhsarvo dvandvo vibhāṣaikavadbhavatiṭa (vyā.pa.91)
iti| teneha bahuvacanagrahaṇamekavacananivṛtyarthaṃ kṛtimityabhiprāyaḥ|

64. sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau| (1.2.64)
ṭhsarūpāṇām' iti bahuvrīhau kṛte ṭhjyotirjanapada' (6.3.85)
ityādinā samānasyasabhāvaḥ| rūpaśabdo'tra svabhāve vartate| ṭhsarūpāṇāṃ

1.bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ| (1.3.1)
bhūrādiryeṣāṃ te bhūvādayaḥ| bhūvādayo daśagaṇīparipaṭhitā gṛhyante|
ṭhbhavati' ityādi| atra dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ satyām ṭhdhātoḥ' (3.1.91)
ityanuvartamāne ṭhvartamāne laṭ' (3.2.123) iti laṭÂpratyayaḥ| ṭhbhū
ityevamādayaḥ śabdā dhātusaṃjñakā bhavanti' ityanena gaṇapāṭhenaiveyaṃ
dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyata iti darśayati| tena aṇapayati, kaḍḍpayati
ityevamādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadyavam, yā-vā-
diva-ityevamādīnāṃ sarvanāma--vikalpa-svargābhidhāyināṃ
dhātusamānaśabdānāmakriyāvacanānāmapi dhātusaṃjñā prāpnotīti
kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākartumāha-- ṭhdhātuśabdaḥ'
ityādi| laghvarthaṃ hi saṃjñākaraṇamiccchantyācāryā ityekākṣarāyāṃ
saṃjñāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ mahatyāḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñāyā yadāśrayaṇaṃ
tasyaitatprayojanam--yathāvidhānāṃ te dhātusaṃjñāṃ kṛtavantaḥ,

14. kartari karmavyatīhāre| (1.3.14)

pratiṣedhe kartavye hasādīnāmapyātmanepadapratiṣadhasya pratipādanaṃ
kartavyamiti| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- neti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate,
tena hasādīnāmapi bhaviṣyatīti| tataḥ ṭhgatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ' iti
dvitīyo yogaḥ, tatra ṭhna' iti vartate|kimarthaṃ punarayam ?
pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārtham, tena ṭhna' iti
yogavibhāgena hasādīnāmeva pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, nānyeṣyamiti|

16.itaretarānyo'nyopapadācca| (1.3.16)
upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam| itaretarānyo'nyaśabdāvupapade yasya sa
tathoktaḥ| athopapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, ṭhnetaretarānyo'nyābhyām'
ityucyatām ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; evaṃ hyucyamāne pañcamīnirdeaśāt
ṭhtasmādityutarasya' (1.1.67) ityutarasyaiva syāt-- itaretarasya
vyatilunantīti, iha tu na syāt-- vyatilunantītaretarasyeti|
ṭhparasparopapadācceti vaktavyam' iti| parasparaśabda upapadaṃ yasya
tasmāt pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānamÂ- cakāro'tra kriyate| sa cānuktasamaccayārthaḥ| tena
parasparopapadādapi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti|

17.nerviśaḥ| (1.3.17)
ṭhniviśate' iti| ṭhviśa praveśane' (1424) tudāditvāccchaḥ|
ṭhnyaviśata' iti| aḍāgamena vyavadhānamityātmanepadena na bhavivyamiti
kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākartumāha--
ṭhpyadāgamāstadÂgrahaṇena' iti-- kāśikā.padamañjarī ca. aḍāgamaḥ'
ityādi| ṭhmadhuni viśanti' iti| atra neḥ parasya viśaterātmanepadaṃ
prāpnoti, tatkasmānna bhavatītyāha-- ṭhnerupasargasya' ityādi|
madhuśabdasya saptameyakavacane ṭhiko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) iti numi
madhunīti rūpaṃ bhavati, tasya cāvayavo niśabdo'narthakaḥ||

18. parivyavebhyaḥ kriyaḥ| (1.3.18)

ṭhparikrīṇīte' iti| ṭhī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itītvam| ṭhparyādaya
upasargā gṛhyante' iti| katham ? kriya iti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī, na
pañcamī-- kriyo ye sambandhinaḥ paryādaya iti| arthadvāraśca teṣāṃ
sambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| sa copasargaireva paryādibhiḥ
sambhavati; nānyairiti sāmarthyādupasargagrahaṇaṃ bhavati| ṭhbahuvi
krīṇāti' iti| bahavo vayo yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| viśabdo'tra
pakṣiṇi vartate||

19. viparābhyāṃ jeḥ| (1.3.19)
ṭhsāhacaryāt' iti| upasargagrahaṇae hetuḥ ṭhnerviśaḥ' (1.3.17) ityatra
nerupasargasya grahaṇam| anantarasūtre'pi (1.3.18)
paryādīnāmupasargāṇāmeva grahaṇam| ataḥ
prakaraṇasāhacaryādadviparāśabdāvupasargau gṛhyaeteta-- ityeke|
apare tu varṇanti-- sāhacarya partyāsatyupalakṣaṇam| yeṣāṃ sāhacaryaṃ
teṣāṃ niyogataḥ pratyāsatyā bhavitavyamiti| ataḥ sāhacaryasya
pratyāsatyā'vinābhāvitvāt tena pratyāsatirlabhyate| tadetaduktaṃ
bhavati-- pratyāsaterviparāśabdāvupapasargau gṛhyaete iti| pratyāsatiśca
jayaterviparāśabdābhyāmupasargābhyāmeva, nānupasargābhyām| tathā
hi-- tābhyāmeva jayatyartho jayatyartho viśiṣyate,netarabhyāmiti||

20. āṅe do'nāsyaviharaṇe| (1.3.20)
dadāterevāsyaviharaṇe vṛtiḥ sambhavati, nānyeṣāṃ dārūpāṇāṃ
dhatūnāmiti| atastatpratiṣedhena tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha--
ṭhāṅpūrvāddāñaḥ' iti| ṭhādate' iti| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ, ṭhkhari ca'
(8.4.55) iti cartvam|
ṭhāsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapi pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ'
ityupasaṃkhyānadhyājenāsyaviharaṇaviṣayaṃ darśayati| katham ?
viharaṇagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, iha ṭhāṅe do'nāsye' ityetadvaktavyam,
tatrāsye dāño vṛtirna sambhavatīti sāmarthyādāsyasamavāyinyāṃ
kriyāyāṃ vṛtirvijñāsyate, tatraiva pratiṣedhaḥ,tat kiṃ viharaṇagrahaṇena
? nanu ca ṭhāṅe do'nāsye' ityetāvatyucyamāne, svaṃ mukhamādate
devadata ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ, vā hyāsyaviṣayaiva
kriyā tasyāṃ vartamāno dadātirāsyavṛtirbhavati,
viharaṇamevāsyaviṣayam, grahaṇaṃ tvāsyaviṣayaṃ grahītṛviṣayañca|
tadevaṃ viharaṇamanteraṇāpi siddhe yadviharaṇagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tasyaitat
prayojanam-- āsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapi pratiṣedho'yaṃ yathā
syādityevamityeke| ṭhitaretarānyo'nyopapadācca' (1.3.16)
ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ|
tenāsyaviharaṇasānakriyādapi pratiṣedho bhavatītyapare|
ṭhsvāṅgakarmakācca' iti| vaktavyamiti śeṣaḥ| na
cātrādravamūrtimallakṣamaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ svāṅgaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi
? svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgamiti| tat karma yasya sa svāṅgakarmakaḥ,tasmāt
svāṅgakarmāt pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ|
tena parasambandhinā mukhena yadā sakarmako bhavati tadā
bhavatyevātmanepadam-- ṭhvyādadate pipīlikāḥ pataṅgasya mukham'
iti| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
kartarīti vartate, āsyamiti ca sambandhiśabdaḥ, tatraivaṃ vijñāyate--
ṭhyasmin kartaryaivātmanepadaṃ bhavati tasya cedāsyamÂ' iti| ṭhāṅ'
iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate-- āgamayasva tāvanmāṇavakam, ānute
śṛgālaḥ, āpṛccchate gurūnityevamarthaḥ| tena ṭhāgameḥ kṣamāyām'
(vā.35) iti ṭhāṅ nuprisaccchayoḥ' (vā.40) iti ca nopasaṃkhyeyaṃ
bhavati||

21. krīḍo'nusaṃparibhyaśca| (1.3.21)
ṭhsamā sāhacaryāt' iti| yadyapyanvādirupasargatvaṃ vyabhicarati,

loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanam, ṭhthāsaḥ se' (3.4.80) ṭhsavābhyāṃ vāmau'
(3.4.91) iti vādeśaḥ| ṭhśikṣeḥ' iti| śakiḥ sannanto gṛhyate|ṭhvidyāsu

(7.4.58) ityabhyāsasya lopaḥ| ṭhskoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca ' (8.2.29)
iti sakāralopaḥ, śikṣa iti sthite laṭ| yastu ṭhśikṣa vidyopādāne'
(dhā.pā.605) iti paṭhaḷte, tato'nadātetvādātmanepadaṃ siddhameva|
ṭhāśiṣi nāthaḥ' iti| gatestācchīlyaṃ gatitācchīlyam| tācchīlyam u
tatsvabhāvatā| ṭhpaitṛkamaśvā anuharante, mātṛkaṃ gāvo'nuharante'
iti| pitṛvanmātṛvadÂgamanameṣāṃ svabhāva ityarthaḥ|
ṭhmāturanuharati, pituranuharati' iti| māturākāraṃ
piturākāramanukarotītyarthaḥ| mātṛsadṛśaḥ,pitṛsadṛśaḥ ityarthaḥ|
paitṛkamiti piturāgatamiti ṭhṛtaṣṭhañ' (4.3.78), ṭhisusuktāntāt
kaḥ' (7.3.51)| māturanuharatītyatra gatitācchīlyaṃ na vivakṣitam|

suṭ|

samprasāraṇam|
ṭhvācā śarīrasparśanamupalambhanam' iti| śapathaviśeṣaḥ| tathā hi--
devadatasya śarīraṃ spṛśāmīti śapathaṃ kurvāṇo devadatāya śapata

22. samavapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ| (1.3.22)
ṭhsantiṣṭhate' iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) tiṣṭhādeśaḥ|
ṭhastiṃ sakāramātiṣṭhate' iti sakāramātramastiṃ dhātum
āpiśalirācāryaḥ pratijānīte| tathā hi -- na tasya pāṇineriva ṭhasa
bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065) iti gaṇapāṭhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? 
ṭhsa bhuvi' iti sa paṭhati| ṭhāgamau guṇavṛddhī ātiṣṭhate' iti| sa
tvāgamau guṇavṛddhī ātiṣṭhate| evaṃ hi sa pratijanīta ityarthaḥ||

23. prakāśanastheyākhyayośca| (1.3.23)
ṭhtiṣṭhantyasminnati stheyaḥ' iti| ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'(3.3.113)
ityadhikaraṇe ṭhaco yat' (3.1.97)| ṭhīdyati' (6.4.65) itītvam| guṇaḥ|
ṭhvivāda' iti| sandehaviṣaye| ṭhnirṇetā' iti| niścetā, pramāṇabhūta
ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ stheyaśabdāt tasya pratītirbhavati, yāvatā
stheyaśabdo bhāvasādhanopyasti gatinivṛtivacana ityāha-- ṭhtasya'
ityādi| yasya ṭhstheya' ityākhyā, loke tasya pratītiryathā
syādityevamarthamākhyāgrahaṇam| tenākhyāgrahaṇena tasya
pratītirbhavatīti darśayitumākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| ṭhtiṣṭhate kanyā
chātrebhyaḥ' iti| pūrvavat sampradānasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ chātrebhya iti
caturthī| ṭhprakāśayatyātmānamityarthaḥ ' iti| anekārthaddhātūnāṃ
tiṣṭhatiratra prakāśane vartate| ṭhsaṃśayya' iti|
jahātu nainaṃ kathamarthasiddhaḥ
saṃśayya kaṇādiṣu tiṣṭhate yaḥ|
asādhuyogā hi jayāntarāyāḥ
pramāthinīnāṃ vipadāṃ padāni|| (kirā-3.14) 
ityasya ślokasyāyamekadeśa ihopanyastaḥ| saṃśayyeti vivādapadabhūte
vastuni saṃśayitvo bhūtvā karṇādiṣu tiṣṭhata iti|
karṇaśakuniprabhṛtiṣu nirṣetṛtvenābhimateṣu tatsu pakṣāntaraṃ
parityajya tiṣṭhate; tadupadarśitasyaiva pakṣasyāśrayaṇāt||

24. udo'nūrdhvakarmaṇi| (1.3.24)
anurdhvakarmaṇi vartamānādityukte, yaścodayati--- ṭhnanu ca
tiṣṭhaterakarmakakriyāvacanatvānna karmaṇi vṛtirupapadyate|
tatkimucyate-- ṭhanūrdhvakarmaṇi vartamānāt' iti, taṃ pratyāha--
ṭhkriyāvācī' iti| yaduktam-- anūrdhvakarmaṇi vartamānāditi, tasyārthaṃ
vispaṣṭīkartumāha-- ṭhanūrdhvakarmaviśiṣṭāt kriyāvacanāt' iti| 
ṭhuda īhāyāmiti vaktavyam'iti| utpūrvāt tiṣṭhaterīhāyāṃ
parispandane
vartamānādātmepadaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- antareṇāpi karmagrahaṇaṃ kriyāmātravṛtitve tiṣṭhateḥ
siddhe yat karmagrahaṇaṃ talloke yā kriyā karmatvena prasiddhā tasyāḥ
pratipatayarthaṃ kṛtam, sā tu parispandanātmakaiva parispandanātmikaiva
ghaṭanabhramaṇādikā, tathā hi--tāṃ kurvāṇaḥ ṭhsakriyaḥ' ityucyate|
sthānāsanādikāṃ tvaparisampandanātmikāṃ kurvāṇo'pi ṭhniṣkriyaḥ'
iti| tasmādātmanepadamidaṃ karmagrahaṇādīhāyāmeva
vartamānādbhaviṣyati| uda īhāyāmityukte,
īhāgrahaṇamanūrdhvakarmaṇo'pavāda iti kasyacidÂbhrāntiḥ syāt,
atastannirākartumāha-- ṭhīhāgrahaṇam' ityādi| viśeṣaṇaṃ
vyaktīkaraṇamihābhipretam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadidamuktam ṭhuda
īhāyāmiti vaktavyam' iti, tatra yadīhāgrahaṇaṃ tadanūrdhvakarmaṇa eva
viśeṣaṇaṃ sūtropātasya vyaktīkaraṇārtham| īhātmakamihānūrdhvakarma
vivakṣitamiti pratipādanārthamityarthaḥ||

25. upānmantrakaraṇe| (1.3.25)
ṭhmantrakaraṇe'iti| mantraḥ karaṇaṃ sādhakatamaṃ yasya dhātvarthasya sa
tathoktaḥ| ṭhupāt' ityādi| atra vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ|
tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- utarasūtre cakāro'nuvartate, sa
cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena
upapūrvātiṣṭhaterdeavapūjādiṣvapyātmanepadaṃ bhavati|
ṭhvā lipsāyām' iti| labdhumicchā lipsā| lipsāyāṃ
gamyamānāyāmityeṣo'rthoveditavyaḥ,na tu tatra vartamānāt
tiṣṭhateriti, na lipsā tiṣṭharerarthaḥ| tathā hi-- ṭhbhikṣuko
brāhmaṇakulamupatiṣṭhate'ityatra tiṣṭhatirupasaṃkramaṇe vartate| lipsā
tūpasaṃkramaṇasya hetubhūtā gamyate| lipsāyāṃ hetubhūtānāṃ
brāhmaṇakulamupasaṃkrāmatītyarthaḥ||

26. akarmakācca| (1.3.26)
ṭhakarmakāt' iti| nāsya karmāstīti bahuvrīhiḥ| ṭhḍukṛñ
karaṇe'(dhā.pā.1472), ṭhanyabhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti manin,
dhātorguṇaḥ, ṭhśeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap| nanu dhātoḥ
kriyāvacanādakarmakatvaṃ na sambhavatīti tasmādayuktamakarmakāditi
viśeṣaṇam, vyavacchedyābhāvādityata āha-- ṭhakarmakakriyāvacanāt'iti|
akarmikā cāsau kriyā cetyakarmakakriyā, tasyā vacano yaḥ, tāṃ vakti
so'karmakakriyāvacanaḥ| etenārthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇamidaṃ darśayati--
akarmako yo dhātvarthastasatsāhacaryādabhidheyadharmasyābhidhāna
upacārāt dhāturakarmaka iti| arthasya ca yuktametadviśeṣaṇam,tasya
sakarmakatvākarmakatvasambhavāt| ṭhyāvadbhuktam' iti| yāvaccchabdo
nipāto'vyayam, tasya yathārthe vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ,
saptamyantañcaitat|ata evāha-- ṭhbhojane bhojane sannidhīyate' iti|
ṭhbhāve ktaḥ' iti|
ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) ityanena||

27. udvibhyāṃ tapaḥ| (1.3.27)
ṭhsvāṅgakarmakācceti vaktavyam' iti| svāṅgaṃ karma yasya tasmāt

tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt svāṅgakarmakādapi bhaviṣyati|

ātmīyamaṅgamityarthaḥ|
ṭhniṣṭapati' iti| ṭhnisastapatāvanāsevane' (8.3.100) iti mūrdhanyaḥ||

28. āṅe yamahanaḥ| (1.3.28)

29. samo gamyṛccchipraccchisvaratyartiśruvidibhyaḥ| (1.3.29)

ṭhartyādeśasyatvartītyevam' ityādi|
atha vā-- yadyanādeśasya grahamaṃ syāt, ādeśasyātmanepadaṃ na
sidhyatītyata āha--
artyādeśasya tvartītyevam' ityādi| sthānivadbhāvenetyabhiprāyaḥ|
ṭhna lābhārthasya' iti| ṭhvidlṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432) ityasya| atha ṭhna tu
satārthasya, nāpi vicāraṇārthasya' ityevamapi kasmānnoktam ? evaṃ
manyate-- nityātmanepaditvādanayorātmanepadārthagrahaṇaṃ
nāśaṅkyetaiveti|
ṭhdṛśeśceti vaktavyam' iti| ṭhdṛśir prekṣaṇe'(dhā.pā.988) ityasmāt
saṃpūrvādātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ|
vyākhānaṃ tu pūrvapadeva| ṭhsampaśyate iti| pādhrādinā(7.3.72)
paśyādeśaḥ|| 

30. nisamupavibhyo hvaḥ| (1.34.30)
ṭhhvaḥ' iti ṭhhveñ sparddhāyāṃ śabdena ca' (dhā.pā.1008) ityasya
kṛtātvasya ṭhāto dhātoḥ' (6.4.140) ityakāralopaṃ kṛtvā nirdeaśaḥ|
ṭhnihvayate' iti| nanu ca kṛtātvasya nirdeaśādatrātmanepadena na
bhavitavyam, na hi vikṛtiḥ prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇāti; anyatvāt, naiṣa
doṣaḥ; kvacidvikṛtirapi prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇātyeva| kathaṃ jñāyate ? yadayaṃ
ṭhna vyo liṭi' (6.1.46) iti kṛtātvasya vyeño
nirdeaśonātvapratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tato jñāyate-- vikṛtirapi prakṛtiṃ
gṛhṇātīti; anyathā ṭhvyaḥ' iti nirdeaśena vyeño grahaṇābhāvāt
kasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt !
ṭhupasargādasyatyūhyaervā vacanamÂ' iti| vaktavyamityarthaḥ| ṭhasu kṣepaṇe
' (dhā.pā.1209), ṭhūha vitarkea' (dhā.pā.648) asyatīti śyanā
nirdeaśāddaivādikasya grahaṇam, na tvādādikasya-- ṭhasa bhuvi'
(dhā.pā.1065) ityasya||

31. sparddhāyāmāṅḥ| (1.3.31)
ṭhsparddhāyāṃ viṣaye' iti| spardheha dhātvarthasya viṣayo'bhimataḥ, na
dhātoḥ| ata evāha-- ṭhspardhā saṅgharṣaḥ| ṭhparābhibhavecchā' iti|
spardhāyāḥ svarūpaṃ darśayitvā dhātvarthasya viṣayaṃ darśayitumāha- ṭhsa
viṣayo dhātvarthasya' iti| kaḥ punardhātorartho nāma yasyaivaṃ viṣayaḥ
? ityāha-- ṭhdhātustu śabdakriyaḥ' ityādi| śabdanaṃ śabdaḥ| sā kriyā
yasya sa tathoktaḥ| śabdanakriyāvācīti yāvat| yadyapi hvayatiḥ
sparddhāyāmapi paṭhaḷte, tathāpyāṅpūrvastatra na vartate, yathā--
tiṣṭhatirgatinivṛtau paṭhaḷte, atha ca prapūrvo gatāveva vartate, na
gatinivṛtau; tathā hi pratiṣṭhita ityukte gaccchatītyarthaḥ|
tasmādāṅpūrvasya hvayateḥ sparddhāyāṃ vṛtyabhāvāt sparddhā dhātvarthasya
viṣayaḥ| dhātvarthaviṣayatvaṃ tu taddhetubhāvena veditavyam||

32. gandhanāvakṣepaṇasevanasāhasikyapratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu kṛñaḥ|
(1.3.32)
ṭhapakāraprayuktam' iti| tṛtīyāsamāso'yam| apakāramuddiśya
yatpravartate tadapakāraprayuktaṃ veditavyam| ṭhhiṃsātmakam' iti|
hinastīti hiṃsaḥ, pacādyac, hiṃsa ātmā yasya tat tathoktam|
pīḍākaraṇamityarthaḥ| ṭhsūcanam' iti doṣāviṣkaraṇam|
kathametadvijñāyata eṃvidhaṃ sūcanaṃ gandhanamityāha-- ṭhtathā ha' ityādi|
ṭhvasta' ityādinanā gandhayatidhāturardayaterarthe vartate iti darśayati|
ṭharda hiṃsāyām' ityādinā ardayaterhisātmakatvam| evañca
hiṃsārthenārdayatinā gandhayateḥ samānārthatāṃ darśayatā
gandhanaśabdavācyasyārthasya hiṃsātmakatvaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati| bhartsanaṃ
tiraskaraṇam| anuvṛtiḥ paracitāvadhāraṇam| ṭhsāhasikyaṃ sāhasaṃ
karma' iti| ṭhojaḥ saho'mbhasā vartate' (4.4.27) iti ṭhak, sāhasikaḥ|
tasya karmeti tasmādguṇavacanabrāhmaṇāditvāt (5.1.124) ṣyañ,
sāhasikyam| ṭhupayogo dharmādiprayojano viniyogaḥ' iti|
dharmādiṣu prayojanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| ādiśabdaḥ kāmāparigrahāya|
ṭhedho dakasyopaskurute' iti| ṭhupāt
pratiyatnavaikṛtavākyādhyāhāreṣu' (6.1.139) iti suṭ| ṭhkṛñaḥ
pratiyatne' (2.3.53) iti ṣaṣṭhī||

33. adheḥ prahasane| (1.3.33)
ṭhtamadhitakre' iti| kṛño liṭ, tasya caiśādeśaḥ| ṭhdvirvacane'ci
(1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvādÂdvirvacanam, ṭhurata'(7.4.66) ityatvam,
raparatvañca, ṭhhalādiḥ śeṣaḥ' (7.4.60) ṭhkuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti
cutvam||

34.veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ| (1.3.34)
ṭhkartari karma' (1.3 .14) ityevamādau kvacit karmaśabdasya
kriyāvācinā dṛṣṭā| ihāpi tasya kriyāvācitā mā vijñāyītyāha-
ṭhkarmaśabda iha kārakābhidhāyi'iti| atha
kriyābhidhāyī kasmānna bhavati ? vipūrvasya karoteḥ śabdanakriyāyāṃ
vṛtyasambhavāt| ṭhśabdakarmaṇaḥ' iti| dhātorarthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ
viśeṣaṇam-- śabdaḥ karmāsyeti; śabdakarmā dhātvarthaḥ| tadarthasya
śabdakarmatvātaddvāreṇa dhāturapi śabdakarmeti; anyathā hi
kriyāvācitvāddhātoḥ kataṃ śabdaḥ karmāsyeti sambandha upapadyate||

35. akarmakācca| (1.3.35)
ṭhodanasya ppūrṇāḥ' ityeva-- kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|} paripūrṇāḥ'
iti| suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhī| ṭhpūraṇaguṇasuhitārtha'(2.2.11)
ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhena jñāpitametat-- suhitārthayoge
ṣaṣṭhī bhavatīti| suhitārthāḥ u tṛptyarthāḥ| pūrṇāstṛptā ityarthaḥ||

36. sammānanotsañjanācāryakaraṇajñānabhṛtivigaṇanavyayeṣu niyaḥ|
(1.3.36)
ṭhsammānanādiṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu' iti| kiṃsvidatra viśiṣyate
nayatyartho'neneti viśeṣaṇam ? kiṃsvinnayatyartha eva viśeṣaṇam ?
viśiṣyate vyāvartyate'rthāntarāditi kṛtvā| tatra
sammānanamācāryakaraṇaṃ bhṛtiśceti pūrveṇaivārthenaitāni
viśeṣaṇāni, pariśiṣṭāni tu nayatyarthasvabhāvāni dvitīyena
viśeṣaṇāni| ṭhnayate cārvī lokāyate' iti| atra nayateḥ prāpaṇamartho
viśeṣyaḥ, śiṣyasammānanantu tasya phalabhāvena viśeṣamam|
tatsambandhādācāryo'pi cārvītyucyata iti| yathā kuntānna
praveśayetyukte kuntaśabdaḥ kuntasambandhāt puruṣeṣvapi vartate,
tathehāpi cārvīśabdaścārvīsamnabdhādācārye'pi| ṭhsthirīkṛtya' iti|
niśaclīkṛtyetyarthaḥ| niścalatvantu teṣāmananyārthabhāvaḥ|
ṭhsthāpyamānāḥ' iti| lokāyate śāstre padārthānāṃ samyagavabodhaḥ|
ṭhpūjitā bhavanti' iti| abhilaṣitārthasampādanameva teṣāṃ pūjā|
abhilaṣito'rthastu lokāyate śāstre padārthānāṃ samyavabodhaḥ|
ṭhutkṣipatītyarthaḥ' iti| etenopatsañjanaṃ nayaterarthaḥ, na tu tasya
viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| evaṃ ṭhniścinotītyarthaḥ' ityādibhirapi
jñānādīnāṃ yathāsambhavaṃ nayatyarthatāṃ darśayatīti veditavyam|
ṭhīdṛśena' iti| yādṛśaḥ śāstrokto vidhiḥ, tādṛśenetyarthaḥ|
atrāpyācāryakaraṇaṃ nayatyarthasya phalabhāvenaiva viśeṣaṇam|
ṭhkarmakarānupanayate' iti| atra hi bhṛtirhetubhāvena nayatyarthasya
samīpakaraṇasya viśeṣaṇam| ṭhṛṇādeḥ' iti| ādiśabdena
karaśulkadaṇḍādīnāṃ grahaṇam| karo nāma rājagrāhyae bhāgaḥ karṣakaiḥ
rakṣārthaṃ parikalpitaḥ| ṭhdharmādiṣu' iti| ādiśabdena kāmādiṣvapi||

37. kartṛsthe cāśarīre karmaṇi| (1.3.37)
ṭhnayateḥ kartā' iti| arthadvārakaḥ sambandho veditavyaḥ|
ṭhtadekadeśo'pi śarīram' iti| samudāyeṣu hi pravṛtāḥ śabdāḥ
kvacidavayaveṣvapi vartanta iti bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punarmukhye sati
gauṇasyāpi grahaṇaṃ labhyate ? śarīragrahaṇāt| iha laghutvāt
kāyagrahaṇaṃ kartavye yacccharīragrahaṇaṃ kartavye yacccharīragrahaṇaṃ karoti
tacccharīraikadeśo'pi śarīraśrutyā nāma gṛhyaetetyevamartham| ṭhkrodhaṃ
vinayate' iti| atra nayateryaḥ kartā sa hi
buddhīndriyadehasamudāyasvabhāvo devadatādiḥ| tatraiva karma krodho
vartata iti kartṛsthaṃ karmāśarīraṃ bhavati| evaṃ gaḍuaṃ
vinayatītyādau gaḍvādaiḥ śarīraikadeśasya karmaṇaḥ kartṛsthābhāvo
veditavyaḥ| atra ca krodhādyapagamaḥ kriyāphalaṃ kartrabhiprāya eveti ṭh
svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye' (1.3.72) ityanenaiva siddhe
niyamārthametadvacanaṃ veditavyam-- kartṛsthe karmaṇyaśarīra eva,
nānyatreti||

38. vṛtisargatāyaneṣu kramaḥ| (1.3.38)
śeṣalakṣaṇena krameḥ parasmepade prāpta ātmepadaṃ vidhīyate|
vṛtyādayo'rthā apratibandhotsāhasphītatāsu prasiddhāḥ||

39. upaparābhyām| (1.3.39)
ṭhsaṃkramati' iti| ṭhkramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.3.76) iti dīrghaḥ|

40. āṅ udgamane| (1.3.40)
ṭhākrāmati māṇavakaḥ kutapam' iti|avaṣṭabhnātītyarthaḥ|
ṭhjyotirudgamana iti 
vaktavyam' iti| jyotiṣāṃ grahanakṣatrādīnāmudgamana evātmanepadaṃ
bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
ṭhanupasargādvā' (1.3.43) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate
siṃhāvalokitanyāyena, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tena
jyotirudgaman eva bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti| yadi tarhi ṭhvā'
grahaṇamanuvartate, ubhayorapi yogayoranuvarteta ?
maṇḍūakaplutinyāyena nānuvartiṣyata ityadoṣaḥ|

44. apahvave jñaḥ| (1.3.44)

45. akarmakācca| (1.3.45)
ṭhkathañcāyamakarmakaḥ' iti| evaṃ manyate-- sarpirādi jñeyatvena
vivakṣitaṃ karma, atastena karmaṇā sakarmaka evāyamityabhiprāyaḥ|
ṭhkatham' iti| na kathañcidityarthaḥ| tathā cetyādinā ṭhnātra sarpirādi
karmatvena, api tu karaṇatvena vivakṣitam ityatra yuktimāha--
ṭhsarpiṣopāyena' ityādi| yasya sarpiḥṣvabhiṣvaṅgo vinā tena
bhujikriyāyāmabhilāṣo na bhavati tasya bhojane pravṛtiṃ prati
sarpirupāyabhāvaṃ pratipadyata iti tenopāyena sa pravartata iti| 
ṭhakarmakāditi kim' iti| ṭhnātra sarpirādi jñeyatvena vivakṣitam|
kiṃ tarhi? karaṇatvena' iti bruvatā vṛtikṛtā sākṣāccchabdopātena
karaṇena sakaraṇādātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| evañca
sakaraṇādityevaṃ vācyam, kimakarmakagrahaṇeneti bhāvaḥ|
evamucyamāne karaṇayuktāt sakarmakādapi syāditi darśayitumāha---
ṭhsvareṇa putraṃ jānāti' iti||

46. saṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne| (1.3.46)
ṭhutkaṇṭhāsmaraṇam' iti| utkaṇṭhāpūrvakasmaraṇamiti| ṭhmātuḥ' iti|
ṭhadhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi' (2.3.52) iti ṣaṣṭhī||

47. bhāsanopasaṃbhāṣājñānayatnavimatyupamantrameṣu vadaḥ| (1.3.47)
ṭhpbhāsanādiṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu' ityeva-kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|}
bhāsanādiṣvartheṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu' iti| atrāpi kiṃsvidviśiṣyate
vadatyartho'neneti viśeṣaṇam ? kiṃsvidvadatyartha eva, viśeṣaṇaṃ
hyarthāntarādviśiṣyate vyavaccchidyata iti kṛtvā ?
tatropasambhāṣopalasāntvanamupamantraṇañca dvitīyenārthena vadatyartha eva
viśeṣaṇam| pariśiṣṭāni tu bhāsanādīni prathamenārthena
viśeṣaṇāni| ṭhbhāsanamāna' ityādinā bhāsanaṃ vadatyarthasya
lakṣaṇabhāvena hetubhāvena vā viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| tathā hyatra
bhāsamāna iti ṭhlakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' (3.2.126) ityanena
śānajādeśo vihitaḥ| ṭhjānāti' ityādinā jñānaṃ vadatyarthasya
viṣayibhāvena viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| jñānena hyasau vadituṃ
jānāti| atra yena jñānena vadanaṃ 
vadatyarthasya hetubhāvena tatra tenaiva viṣayeṇa paricchedyena
viṣayībhavati| ṭhtadviṣayam' ityādinā yatra āviṣkaraṇasya vadatyarthasya
hetubhāvena viśeṣaṇamityācaṣṭe| utsāho hyāviṣkriyamāṇa
ādiṣkaraṇakriyāyāḥ karmākhyaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavati, sādhanaṃ ca hetuḥ;
kārakāṇāṃ kriyānimitatvāt| ṭhvimatipatitāḥ' ityādinā
vimatirbhāṣaṇasya vadatyarthasya hetubhāvena viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati|
satyāṃ vimatau vicitraṃ nānāprakāraṃ bhāṣante| yadi hyabhinnā matiḥ
syādabhinnameva bhāṣeran| ṭhupaccchandayati' iti| ṭhbhadre bhajasya māmidaṃ
te dāsyāmi' ityevamādibhirabhiṣṭe'rthe pravartayatītyarthaḥ||

48. vyaktavācāṃ samuccāraṇe| (1.3.48)
ṭhprasiddhyupasaṃgrahārtham' iti| yadi tadarthaṃ vyaktavācāmiti
nocyeta,ṭhvaratanu sampravadanti kukkuḍā payi vijahīhi
dṛḍhopagūhanaṃ tyaja navasaṅgamabhīru vallabham|
aruṇakarodgama eṣa vartate varatanu sampravadanti kukkuṭāḥ|ityevaṃ
sayagraḥ ślokaḥ|}| kukkuṭāḥ api vyaktavāca eva| tathā hi --
kukkuṭenāpi lapite viśeṣaparicchedāducyate- kukkuṭā
lapantīti| varatanviti tanūśabdasya ṭhambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti
hrasvaḥ| hrasvakavacanasāmarthyāt ṭhhrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) iti guṇo na
bhavati| nṛṇāmiti na kṛtaṃ vaicitryārtham||

50. vibhāṣā vipralāpe| (1.3.50)

53. udaścaraḥ sakarmakāt| (1.3.53)
ṭhgehemucvarate' iti| carirgatyarthaḥ| ṭhguruvacanamuccarate' iti|
atrotkramaṇātmikāyāṃ gatau vartamānaścaratirguruvacanena karmaṇā
sakarmakaḥ| ṭhbāṣpamuccarati' iti| upariṣṭādÂgaccchatītyarthaḥ| nātra

54. samastṛtīyāyuktāt| (1.3.54)
yadyatra tṛtīyeti gṛhyate, tadehāpi syāt-- ubhau lokau sañcarati
imāñcāmutra devaleti| atrāpi tṛtīyārtho gamyata eva| tapasā śrutena
vā vidyata evetyetaccetasi kṛtvāha-- ṭhtṛtīyā' iti| ṭh
tṛtīyāvibhaktirgṛhyate' iti| yadyevaṃ tayā saha dhātoḥ sambandho
nopapadyate| na hi tṛtīya dhātuvācyetyāha-- ṭhtayā' ityādi| artho
dvāraṃ mukhamupāyo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| tṛtīyārthena dhātvarthasya
yuktavādaupacāriko dhātostṛtīyīrthena yoga iti darśayati|
ṭhyatrapyatra tadarthena yogaḥ sambhavati' iti| vinā karaṇena
kriyāniṣpaterabhāvāt, tathāpi na bhavati| ṭhtṛtīya tu' ityādi|
tṛtīyāyapuktagrahaṇaṃ hyaevamarthaṃ kriyate-- śrūyamāṇatṛtīyayuktādyathā
syāditi, anyathā sama ityevaṃ vaktavyaṃ syāt ? anukte'pi
siddhvatāt tṛtīyāprayogasya| na hi tena vinā
kriyāniṣpatirupapadyate| tasmādyatra tṛtīyā śrūyate tanmūlodāharaṇam,
yatra tu na śrūyate tatpratyudāharaṇam||

55. dāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe| (1.3.55)
kathaṃ punastṛtīyā caturthyarthe syāditi ? na kathañcidityarthaḥ|
tadvidhāyinaḥ śāstrasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| ṭhvaktavayamevaitat' iti|
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- tadeva sampradānaṃ yadā
sādhakatamatvena vivakṣyate tadā sādhakatamatvena vivakṣyate tadā
caturthye'pi tadā caturthye'pi tṛtīyā bhavati, vivakṣātaḥ
kārakāṇi bhavantīti kṛtvā; na tu svabhāvavataḥ| sā ca vivakṣā
laukikī samāśrīte, na tu proyogikīti| loke cāśiṣṭavyavahāre
eva sā sambhavati, nānyatra| laukikavivakṣātra samāśrīyata iti
asyaivārthasya dyotanāya ceccchabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| ṭhdāsyā mālāṃ sampraccchate'
iti| yo hi dharmaśāstraviruddhāṃ dāsīṃ kāmayituṃ tasyai mālāṃ dadāti
tasyāsāvaśiṣṭavyavahāro bhavatītyastyatrāśiṣṭavyavahāraḥ| samprayaccchata
iti pādhrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) dāṇo yacchādeśaḥ| kathamātmanepadaṃ
bhavatīti| na kathañcidityarthaḥ| ṭhtasmādityutarasya' (1.1.67) ityatra
nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāditi| evaṃ manyate-- ṭhsama iti
viśeṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhī' ityādi| yadi ṭhsamaḥ' iti pañcamī syānna ṣaṣṭhī, tadā
praśabdena vyavadhānādātmananepadaṃ na syāt; tasmānneyaṃ pañcamī, kiṃ
tarhi ? ṣaṣṭhī-- samo viśeṣaṇasya sambandhī yo viśeṣyo dāṇiti|
tataśca vyavahito'pi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavatīti tena
vyavadhāne'pi bhavatyātmanepadam||

56. upādyamaḥ svakaraṇe| (1.3.56)
yadi svakaraṇamātra ātmanepadaṃ bhavati śākaṭakādisvīkāre'pi
syāditi codyamapākartumāha-- ṭhpāṇigrahaṇam' ityādi| evaṃ
manyate-- pratiniyataviṣayā hi śabdaśaktayo bhavanti, yasmādupapūrvo
yamirātmanepadānta evaṃvidha eva svīkāre vartate; na tu sarvasmin|
tasmāt pāṇigrahaṇātmakameva svīkaraṇaṃ gṛhyate| upayaccchata iti
pūrvavadyacchādeśaḥ||

57. jñāśrusmṛdṛśāṃ sanaḥ| (1.3.57)
ṭhtribhiḥ sūtreḥ' iti| ṭhapahnave jñaḥ' (1.3.44) ityādibhiḥ| ṭhdharmaṃ
jijñāsate' iti| ṭhjñā avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1507), san, dvirvacanam,
abhyāsasya hrasvatvam, ṭhsanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itītvam| ṭhśuśrūṣaśate' iti |
śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942), ṭhiko jhal' (1.2.9) iti sanaḥ kitam,
ṭhśrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, ṭhajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16)
iti dīrghaḥ| ṭhsusmūrṣate' iti|ṭhsmṛ ādhyāne' (dhā.pā.807) ;
pūrvavat kitvāt ṭhudoṣṭhaḷpūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityutvam,
raparatvam| ṭhdidṛkṣate' iti| ṭhhalantācca' (1.2.10) iti kitvam, tataśca
vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam, ṭhṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam||

58. nānorjñaḥ| (1.3.58)
ṭhpūrveṇa' iti| anantarasūtraprāptaṃ yatatpratiṣidhyate-- ṭhanantarasya
vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā ' (vyā.pa.19) iti kṛtvā| ṭhtathā ca'
ityādi| yasmādanantarasūtreṇaātmanepadaṃ #eyatprāpnoti, tasyāyaṃ
pratiṣedhaḥ sampadyate| evaṃsati sakarmakasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ;
anantarasūtreṇa sakarmakādātmanepadavidhānāt| akarmakāddhi
ṭhakarmakācca' (1.3.45) ityanena prāgevātmanepadaṃ
vihitamityanantarātīto yogaḥ sakarmakārtho vijñāyate;
yataścaivam, tenākarmakāt ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadaṃ
bhavatyeva-- āṬṣadhasyānujijñāsata iti||

59. pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ| (1.3.59) 
ṭhupasargagrahaṇañcedam' iti| kathaṃ śruva iti ?
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| tenāyaṃ sambandho bhavati--
śṛṇoteryau viśeṣaṇabhūtau pratyāṅai tatpūrvācccharuvaḥ sambandhāt
sannantādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| upasargādevārthaṃ dvāreṇa
śṛṇoterviśeṣaṇabhūtāviti sāmarthyādupasargayorgrahaṇam|
ṭhdevadataṃ prati śuśrūṣate' iti| pratiśabdasya ṭhlakṣaṇe tyambhūtākhyāna'
(1.4.90) ityādinā lakṣaṇe karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tena pratinā devadat
eva sambadhyate; na dhātvartha iti|| 

60. śadeḥ śitaḥ| (1.3.60)
yadi ṭhśadeḥ śitaḥ' iti vyadhikaraṇe ete pañcamyāvityabhyupagamyaivaṃ
vyākhyāyate-- śadeḥ paro yaḥ śit tasmādātmepadaṃ bhavatīti, tadā
sārvadhātukāśrayatvāccchitaḥ prāgeva tadutpaterdhātoḥ śeṣatvādasya
lāvasthāyāṃ parasmaipadaṃ syāt, tatastannimitakaḥ vyācikhyāsurāha--
śadiryaḥ śiditi| etena ṭhśadeḥ śitaḥ' iti samānādhikaraṇe ete
pañcamyāviti darśayati| kathaṃ punaḥ śadiḥ śidbhavati, yāvatā
vikaraṇasya śakāra itsaṃjñaka itsaṃjñāsambandhī, na tu śadeḥ ? ityata āha--
ṭhśadbhāvī' iti| bhāviśabdo'yam ṭhbhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ'(3.3.3) iti
bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaḥ| śidbhāvīti yataḥ śidbhaviṣyati sa
śidbhāvī|etaduktaṃ bhavati-- śinnimitatvādupacāreṇa śadiḥ
śidityuktamiti| bhavati hi kāraṇe kāryopacārāt tathā vyapadeśaḥ,
yathā-- naḍvalodakaṃ pakādaroga iti| śito vā sambandhī' iti|
etena ṭhśitaḥ' ityasya ṣaṣṭhaḷntatāṃ darśayati| kaḥ śadeḥ śitsambnadhī ?
yastasya prakṛtiḥ| prāgapi śitaḥ śadestatprakṛtitvamastyeveti
śitprakṛteḥ śaderātmanepadaṃ bhavati| ṭhśīyate' iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa
(7.3.78) śīyādeśaḥ||

61. mriyaterluṅliṅeśca | (1.3.61)

na bhavitavyamiti ? ucyate; svarārthamupadiśyate-- mā hi mṛteti

62. pūrvavatsanaḥ| (1.3.62)
ṭhpūrvavat' iti| ṭhtena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ' (5.1.115) iti vatiḥ|.
pūrvaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdatvādavadhimapekṣate| sa cāvadhiḥ
śrutatvātsanneva vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhsanaḥ pūrvo yo dhātuḥ' iti|
yadyevam, avadhibhāvopagama eva sangrahaṇasyopayuktatvāta
sannantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti, na tatraitallabhyate; kutastarhi syāt ?
dhātumātrāt, naitadasti; evaṃ hyātmanepadaṃ
parasmaipadānukramaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| atha pratyayāntāt syāt ?
evamapi sangrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, pūrvavat pratyayāditi vācyaṃ
syāt| tasmāt partyāsannaṃ sanaṃ tyaktvā na yuktvā na
yuktā'nyanyasyāśrutasya parikalpaneti sanntādeva bhavatīti
vijñāyate| ṭhyena' ityādinā vatyarthamācaṣṭe| ṭhtadeva nimitam' iti|
anudātetvaṃ ṅtviñca dhātvantarāvasthāyāmapi
sannantādvacanasāmarthyānnimitaṃ bhavati| ṭhasisiṣate' iti| iṭi kṛte
ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti siśabdasya dvirvacanam| ṭhnivivikṣate'
iti| ṭhviśa praveśane' (dhā.pā.1424), pūrvavat kitvaṣatvakatvāni|
ṭhācikraṃsate' iti| ātmanepadanimitatvāt
ṭhsnukramoranātmanepadanimite' (7.2.36) itīṇ na bhavati| 
ṭhśiśatsati', mumūrṣati'iti| atra sano yaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ,
tasyātmanepadanimitatvamasti; śīyate, mriyata ityātmanapadadarśanāt|
tata ātmanepadena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ
nirākartumāha-- ṭhiha na bhavati' ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha-- ṭhna hi'
ityādi| kiṃ tarhi ? ṭhśidādyapi'iti| śiccchabdenātra śidbhāvitvaṃ
śitsambandhitvañcoktam| ādiśabdena luṅliṅergrahaṇam, tacceha
nāstīti na hyatra sanaḥ pūrvabhāgasya śidbhāvitvaṃ śitsambandhitvaṃ
vāsti; śitpratyayasyāsmin viṣaye'tyantāsambhavāt, nāpi mriyateḥ
parau luṅliṅai staḥ; tasmānneha
śadimriyatyorātmanepadanimitatvamastīti na bhavatyātmanepadam|
iha tarhi kasmānna bhavati-- anucikīrṣati, parācikīrṣatīti ?
karoterhi gandhanādiṣvartheṣvātmanepadaṃ vihitam,
atastdavivakṣāyāṃ sanantādapi tena bhavitavyamityāha-- ṭhyasya ca'
ityādi| gandhanādiṣvartheṣu pūrvatrāsanantāvasthāyām ṭhanuparābhyāṃ
kṛñaḥ' (1.3.79) ityanena parasmaipadavidhānāt
karoterātmanepadābhāvaḥ kriyate| tasmādābhyāṃ
sanantādapyātmanepadanimitābhāvānna bhavati|
ṭhatha jugupsate, mīmāṃsata ityatra kathamātmanepadam, yāvatā
ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityucyate, na ca gupādiṣu sanaḥ
prāgevātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti; ataḥ pūrvavadityatideśābhāvānna
bhavitavyamātmanegadenetyata āha-- ṭhiha' ityādi| ṭhjugupsate'iti|
ṭhguptijkidbhyaḥ san' (3.1.5) iti san| ṭhmīmāṃsate' iti| ṭhmānabadha'
(3.1.6) ityādinā san, abhyāsasya ṭhsanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itītve dīrghaḥ|
kathaṃ punariha ṭhanudātaṅti ātmanepadam' (1.3.12), yāvatā
gupādāvavayave'nudātetvaṃ liṅgam, na jugupsādau samudāya
ityata āha -- ṭhavayave kṛtam' ityādi| yathā goḥ karṇādāvavayave
kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, tathā gupādāvavayave
kṛtamanudātetvaṃ samudāyasya jugupsa ityevamāderviśeṣakraṃ bhavati|
yadyevam, gopayati, tejayati, saṅketayatītyevamādāvapi
prāpnoti, satyam; syādetat-- avayavekṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ tasya
samudāyasya gorviśeṣakaṃ bhavati, yaṃ samudāyaṃ so'vayavo na
vyabhicarati; sanantaṃ punarna vyabhicarati; ṇijantantu
vyabhicaratītyato'trātmanepadena na bhavitavyam; vārtametat,
sanantamapi vyabhicaratīti vināpi tena gopayatītyādau sambhavāt|
tasmāt samudāyaṃ yaṃ gupādirna vyabhicarati, tasyāsambhavāt
sarvasya gupādāvayave kṛtamanudātetvaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya
viśeṣakaṃ bhaviṣyati| tataśca gopayatiprabhṛtibhyo'pyātmanepadaṃ
prāpnotītyeva| evaṃ tarhi ṭhnigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca' (1.3.87) ityatra
cakāro'nuktasamudhcayārthaḥ kriyate| tena gupādibhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ
parasmaipadātmanepadāpavādo bhaviṣyati||

67. ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartānādhyāne| (1.3.67)
ṭhārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ' iti| aṇau
karmapradarsanārthametaduktam| idaṃ tvatrodāharaṇam-- ṭhārohayate
hastī svayameva' ita| ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatrāṅpūrvasya
tu ṭhruha bījajanmani prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.859) ityasya dve kriye
vācye-- nyagambhavanam, nyagbhāvanañca| tatra nyagbhavanasya hastī kartā,
nyagambhāvanasya hastipakā iti| nyagbhavantaṃ hastinaṃ
nyagbhāvayantītyarthaḥ| sa yadā tu suśikṣitatvāt suvidheyatvācca
nyagbhāvanakriyāyāmatyantamānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate hastī svayameva;
tadāsau hastī hastipakān prati prayojanakatvena vivakṣyate,
hastipakāstu prayojyatvena| hastī hastipakān prayuṅkte--
māmārohateti, tataśca prayojyaprayojakabhāve vivakṣite
hetumaṇṇic| evamutaratrāpi karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvasya vivakṣitatvāt

72. svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale| (1.3.72)

punarviprakṛṣṭatvādanumeyatvāt sambhavavyabhicārāccotpatiṃ prati
vyabhicāraḥ| yadyapi taduddiśya kriyārambhāt tadapi pradhānam,
tathāpyaviprakṛṣṭaphalāpekṣayā tasyāprādhānyamastyeva| tatra yadyabhipragrahaṇaṃ
na kriyeta, tadā lunīta punīta ityādāveva syāt-- yatrāviprakṛṣṭaṃ
kriyāphalam| yajate ityādau tu na syāt-- yatra viprakṛṣṭaṃ
svargādikaṃ kriyāphalam, pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt| abhigrahaṇe tu na
doṣaḥ; yasmādabhirābhimukhye vartate, praśabdasatvārambhe| tena
prārambhamātrasyābhimukhye phalaniṣpatau buddhāvāśrīyamāṇāyāṃ sarvatra
siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu cāsatyabhipragrahaṇe prakṛtīnāṃ
yajiprabhṛtīnāmanubandhaviśeṣāsañjanādeva viprakṛṣṭe'pi phale
bhaviṣyatica anyathā hi tasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, na; abhicārādau
yatrāviprakṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ dṛṣṭamasti tatra tasya sārthakatvāt|
tasmādviprakṛṣṭe'pyapradhāne phale syādityevamarthamipragrahaṇaṃ
kartavyameva||

77. vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne| (1.3.77)
tatra ṭhsvaritañitaḥ'(1.3.72) ityādīni pañca sūtrāṇyanuvartante|
ṭhkartrabhiprāye kriyāphale dyogye' iti| kena dyotye ?
prakṛtatvādātmanepadeneti vijñeyam| ṭhtadupapadena dyotite na
prāpnoti' iti| uktārthānāmaprayogāt| etenāprāptavibhāṣeyamiti
darśayati| nanu casvaṃ yajñaṃ yajate ityatra
svaśabdasyopapadatvānnopapadyate ? yataḥ ṭhtatropapadaṃ saptamīstham'
(3.1.92) iti dvitīyadhātvadhikāre yat saptamīnirdiṣṭaṃ
tadupapadasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, na ca svaśabda evaṃvidha ityāha-- ṭhsamīpe
śrūyamāṇam' ityādi| etenopoccāritaṃ
padamupapadamityanvarthasyopapadasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti
darśayati| etacca pāribhāṣikasyāsambhavāllabhyate| ṭhsvaṃ yajñam'
ityādinā pañcasūtryāṃ yadādyaṃ sūtraṃ tatrodāharati| ṭhsvaṃ putram'
ityādinā yadÂdvitīyaṃ tatra| ṭhevaṃ pañcasūtryāmudāharāryam' iti|
anyatrāpīti seṣaḥ| pañcasūtryantargate sūtre yadudāhṛtaṃ
tato'nyatrāpyudāhāryamityarthaḥ | svaṃ kaṭṃa kārayate, kārayati vā|
svaṃ vrīhiṃ saṃyacacchate, saṃyaccchati vā| svaṃ bhāramudyaccchate, udyaccchati vā|
svaṃ vastramāyaccchate, āyaccchati vā| svaṃ gāṃ jānīte, jānāti veti|
etāni ṭhṇicaśca' (1.3.74) ityādiṣu sūtreṣu yathāyogamudāharaṇāni||

78. śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam| (1.3.78)
ṭhpūrveṇa' iti| ṭhanudātahitaḥ' (1.3.12) ityādinā| ṭhsarvatra prāpnoti'
iti| aśeṣebhyo'pi| ṭhtadarthamidamucyate' iti| sarvatra parasmaipade
prasakte tannivṛtyartham; arthaśabdasya nivṛtivacanatvāt|
tathā-maśakārtho dhūma iti| tadenaitat niyamārthamityuktaṃ bhavati|
ṭhyebhyo dhātubhyaḥ' ityādinā śeṣatvaṃ darśayati| ṭhyena viśeṣaṇena'
iti| anubandhādinā| ṭhyāti, vāti' ityanubandhaśeṣasyodāharaṇam|
ṭhāviśati, praviśati' ityupasargaśeṣasyārthaśeṣasyāpi. evaṃ
gandhanādibhyo'nyatra karotītyevamādikamudāharaṇaṃ veditavyam|
nanu ca śeṣādityanena pañcamyantena dhātusamānādhikaraṇena
dhātureva viśiṣyate, nārthaḥ, tataścāśeṣeṣu gandhanādiṣvartheṣu
parasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti, naitadasti; gandhanādayo hi prakṛterevārthāḥ,
tatrāsau śeṣagrahaṇānnivartamānastānapi nivartayati| 
ṭhpacyate, gamyate' iti| nanu ca yadyatra parasmaipadaṃ syāt, tadā
ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt, anavakāśatvāt,
naitadasti; asti hi tasyāvakāśaḥ| kaḥ punarasau ? yo na śeṣaḥ--
āsyate, śayyate, kriyata iti| anudātetvaṃ ṅtviñcāśeṣaḥ| ṭhśeṣāt
kartari' (1.3.78) ityatra kartṛgrahaṇaṃ sāmānyamupātamiti yo
deśayet taṃ pratyāha--ṭhkarmakartari' ityādi| ṭhkartari
karmavyatīhāre' (1.3.14) ityādinā pariharati| ṭhkartaiva yaḥ kartā'
iti| śuddho yaḥ kartā, kartṛvadbhāvarahito yaḥ kartaityarthaḥ||

84. upācca| (1.3.84)

devadatam' iti| nanu copapūrvo ramirakarmaka eva bhavati| tathā

sakarmakasyodāharaṇaṃ yujyata ityāha-- ṭhuparamayatīti yāvat' iti|
etena ṇyarthavṛtitāmuparamaterdarśayan sakarmakatāmupapādayatīti|
akarmako hi dhāturṇyarthe vartamānaḥ sakarmako bhavati| atha
punaraṇyantasya ṇyarthavṛtitopapadyate katham ? sa tathoktaḥ| evaṃvidhasya
tasya prayojyena sakarmatvamupapadyata eva|
atha kimarthaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ kriyate ? ṭhna vyāṅparyupebhyo ramaḥ' ityeka
eva yogaḥ

tasyānarthakyaṃ prasajyeta ? naitadasti; arṅthatvāt| nanu ca
syasanoriti svaritatvamiṣyate, tena tasya bādhā na bhaviṣyatīti,
satyametat; sūtrakārastu cakāraṃ vaicitryārthaṃ cakāra, na
svaritatvārtham| ṭhkalptā' iti| pūrvavadadhikāradvayānuvṛtau satyāṃ
ṭhtāsi ca klṛpaḥ' (7.2.60) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| ṭhluṭaḥ prathamasya
ḍāraurasaḥ' (2.4.85) iti ḍādeśaḥ| ṭhkṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) iti
latvam ṭhciklṛpsati' iti| pūrvavat kitvādÂguṇābhāvaḥ||
iti śrobodhisatvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ

1.ā kaḍārādekā saṃjñā| (1.4.1)
‘yā parā' iti| yatra vipratiṣedhastatra ṭhvipratiṣedhe param' (1.4.2) iti
vacanāt parā bhavati| ‘anavakāśā ca yā' iti| yasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ
kvacidavakāśo nāsti, sā'pyapavādabhūtvāt saṃjñāntaraṃ bādhitvā
pravartate| yadyevam, ata eva saṃjñāsamāveśo na bhaviṣyati, tat
kimekasaṃjñādhikāreṇa ? naitadasti, virodhe hi satyapavādabhūtatvaṃ
bhavati| vipratiṣedhastu virodha eva, sa ca virodha ekasaṃjñādhikāre
sati bhavati, nāsati; tathā hi yatraikasaṃjñādhikāro nāsti, tatra
vipratiṣedho nāstyeva, yathā-- pratyayādīnāṃ saṃjñāyām;
tasmādasminnadhikāre sati virodho bhavati| tasmiṃśca sati ṭhvirodhe
param' iti vacanāt parā bhavati, Âpavādabhūtatvādanavakāśā ca|
tasmāt kartavyo'yamadhikāraḥ|
yadyevam, aṅsaṃjñāyāṃ bhapadasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo vaktavyaḥ-- bābhravyaḥ,
dhānuṣka iti| babhruśabdāt ṭhmadhubrabhvrorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ' (4.1.106)
iti yañ| tatra bhatvāt ṭhorguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) aṅgatvādādivṛddhiḥ, tatra
‘vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ; dhanuḥśabdācca dhanuḥ
praharaṇamasya ṭhtadasya praharaṇam' (4.4.57) iti ṭhak; ṭhisusuktāntātkaḥ'
(7.3.51) iti kādeśaḥ, atra padatvāt ṭhiṇaḥ ṣaḥ' (8.3.39) iti ṣatvam|
aṅgatvādādivṛddhirna vaktavyā| ‘vā kyaṣaḥ' (1.3.90) itato
vāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena kvacit
saṃjñāsamāveśo bhaviṣyatīti| ‘anyatra ' iti| loke ca, śāstre ca|
loke tāvat-- indraḥ, śukraḥ, purandara iti saṃjñāyāḥ samāveśo
dṛṣṭaḥ| śāstre'pi pratyayaḥ,kṛt, kṛtyapratyayaḥ| evamanyatra
saṃjñāsamāveśādihāpi syāt, ataevaikā saṃjñā yathā syāditi
niyamārthametat| ‘bhidiścchidiḥ' iti| laghusaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ|
prayojanaṃ tu—‘bhetā, chetā' iti| ‘pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti
guṇaḥ| ‘śikṣirbhikṣiḥ' iti| gurusaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ| prayojanaṃ--
‘śikṣā, bhikṣā' ita| ‘gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) ityakārapratyayaḥ|
laghusaṃjñā tvatra prayojanābhāvānna bhavati| ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--
‘atatakṣat, ararakṣat' iti| paratvādgurusaṃjñaiva bhavati| ṭhtakṣūtvakṣū
tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.655, 656), ṭhrakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.65ra8),
hetumaṇṇic, luṅ, cleścaṅ, ṇilopaḥ, ṭhcaṅ' (6.1.11) iiti
dvarvacanam| yadyatra laghusaṃjñā syāt, ṭhsanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) ityādinā
sanvadbhāvāditvaṃ syāt| tadabhāvānna bhavatītyāha—‘sanvallaghuni'
ityādi| ‘eṣa vidhiḥ ' iti| sanvadbhāvavidhiḥ| parasyā
idamudāharaṇamuktam| anavakāśāyāstūcyate-- ayante yonirṛtviya
iti| ṛtuḥ prāpto'steti ṭhṛtoraṇ' (5.1.105) ṭhcchandasi ghas'
(5.1.106) iti ghas; tasyeyādeśe kṛte ṭhsiti ca' (1.4.16) iti
padasaṃjñā prāpnoti, ṭhyaci bham' (1.4.18) iti bhasaṃjñā ca,
anavakāśatvāt padasaṃjñaiva bhavati| yadi bhasaṃjñā syāt tadā
‘orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) iti guṇaḥ syāt|
bhasaṃjñāyāstvaupagavādiṣvavakāśaḥ| ā kaḍārāditīyato'vadhergrahaṇaṃ
vaicitryārtham; anyathā hi ṭhā dvandvāta ityevaṃ brūyāt| na hi
dvandvasaṃśabdānāt pareṇākaḍārādekasaṃjñāvidhānasya prayojanamasti;
yata etāvato'vadhergrahaṇamarthavadbhavati||

2. vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam| (1.4.2)
‘virodho vipratiṣedhaḥ ' ita| vipratiṣedhaśabdasya loke
virodhavācitvena prasiddhatvāt| tathā hi-- viruddhe'bhihite vaktāro
vadanti—‘vipratiṣiddhamidamucyate' iti, viruddhamiti gamyate| tasya
vipratiṣedhasya viṣayaṃ darśayitumāha—‘yatra' ityādi| prasajyete
vidhīyete iti prasaṅgau u vidhī| ‘anyārthau' iti| anyatra viṣaye'rthaḥ
prayojanaṃ yayostau tathoktau| anyatra viṣayāntare kṛtārthāvityarthaḥ|
‘ekasmin' iti| abhinne| yugapat u ekakalām| sa ityasya vipratiṣedha
ityane sambandhaḥ| sa vipratiṣedho vipratiṣiddhaḥ, vipratiṣedhasya viṣaya
ityarthaḥ| vipratiṣedhaviṣayatvādvipratiṣedaviṣayo hyatra
vipratiṣedhaśabdenokto viṣayiṇā viṣayaṃ darśayitum| yasmānna

iti| tulyabalayorvirodho'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| idaṃ

anyaḥu bhinno'rthaḥ u prayojanaṃ yatostāvanyārthāviti| śeṣaṃ
samānam| ‘vipratiṣedhe' iti ca satī saptamīyam|
‘utsargāpavāda' ityādi| vipratiṣedho yatrāsti, so'ya
yogasyāvakāśaḥ| vipratiṣedhañca tulyabalayoreva bhavatīti
nātulyabalayoḥ| etatu ṭhyatra hi prasaṅgāvanyārthau'ityādigranthena
tasya viṣayaṃ darśayatā vyākhyātam| na cotsargāpavādādiṣu
tulyabalatāstīti, tato nāsāvutsargāpavādādirasya yogasya
viṣayaḥ| tena balavāneva tatra bhavati; tatra sāmānyenotsargaḥ
pravartate; yathā--ṭhārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) iti,
valādisāmānyasyeḍvidhānāt| viśeṣo'pavādaḥ, yathā-- neḍa vaśi
kṛti' (7.2.8) itīṭpratiṣedhasya valādiviśeṣe vaśādau kṛti

brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatām, takraṃ kauṇÃḍinyāyeti viśeṣavihitaṃ

tasmādvaśādau kṛti pare'pīḍāgamo na bhavati, pratiṣedha eva bhavati--
‘stheśabhāsapisakaso varaca' (3.2.175) īśvara iti| 
nityānityayornityaṃ balavat yathā- ṭhbhisa ais' (7.1.9) ityaitvam|
taddhi ṭhbahuvacane jhalyet' (7.3.103) ityetve kṛte prāpnoti|
akṛte'pi-- bhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇādakārāntādaṅgadbhisa ais
vihita iti kṛtvā| yaśca kṛtākṛtapraśaṅgī vidhiḥ sa nitya iti|
tathā ca tatra (7.1.9) vakṣyati-- 
etvaṃ bhisi paratvāccedata ais kva bhaviṣyati|
kṛte'pyetve bhautapūrvyādaistu nityastathā sati||
iti sa nityaḥ| aistve etvaṃ na prāpnoti; nimitasya
jhalādervihitatvāt| vṛkṣeṣvtayādādetvasyāvakāśaḥ, asmiṃśca sati

brāhmaṇakṣatriyādīnāmasahabhujāmekasmin bhājane bhujakriyāyāṃ paryāyaḥ
syāt| tatra jātau padārthe kṛtārthatvādÂvṛtau prāptayāṃ

‘sakṛdÂgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva' (vyā.pa.40)

3. yū stryākhyau nadī| (1.4.3)

na; cakṣiṅe'tra sopasaragtvādityata āha--

6. ṅiti hrasvaśca| (1.4.6)
yadyatra hrasvaviśeṣaṇārtha ṭhyū' iti nānuvartate iti nānuvartate,
tadehāpi syāt-- mātre duhitra iti; tasmāt tadihānuvartate|

tasmāt tadihārthāt ṣaṣṭhaḷntamupajāyata ityata āha—‘hrasvaśca yvoḥ
sambandhī' iti| kaḥ punastayoḥ sambandhī hrasvaḥ ? yastayorhrasvaḥ savarṇaḥ;
tena sāmarthyādikārokārayorgrahaṇam, na hi tābhyāmanyo hrasva
īdutoḥ savarṇaḥ sambhavati| ‘kṛtyai, kṛtaye' iti| yadā nadīsaṃjñā

7.śeṣo ghyasakhi| (1.4.7)

8.patiḥ samasā eva| (1.4.8)

dṛḍhamuṣṭinetyādau na syāt, evakāre tu sati bhavatīti| tathā hyatar

nirastāyāṃ ṭhyasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityākāralopo na bhavati|
‘ṛtviyaḥ' iti| ṛtuḥ prāpto'styeti ṭhṛtoraṇ' (5.1.148) ṭhcchandasi
ghas' (5.1.106) ṛtviyaḥ, padatvāt bhatvābhāve tadāśrayaḥ ṭhorguṇaḥ'
(6.4.146) na bhavati| 
17.svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne| (1.4.17) 
atra yadi saptamībahuvacanādārabhya ā kapaḥ pratyayā gṛhyaeran, tadā
‘asarvanāmasthāne' iti pratiṣedaṃ na kuryāt; prāptyabhāvāt|
kṛtaścāsāvato'vasīyate prathamaikavacanādārabhyā kapaḥ pratyayāḥ
svādayo gṛhyanta ityata āha—‘svādiṣviti suśabdādekavacanādārabhya'
iti| ‘rājatvam, rājatā' iti| ṭhtasya bhāvastvatalau' (5.1.119)|
‘rājataraḥ' iti| ‘dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau' (5.3.57) iti
tarap| ‘rājatamaḥ' iti| ṭhatiśāyane' (5.3.55) ityādinā tamap|
‘rājānau,rājānaḥ' iti| atra padasaṃjñāyā abhāvānnalopo na bhavati|
yadyevam, rājatyatrāpi na syāt, pratyayalakṣaṇenāsarvanāmasthāna iti
padasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt,naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛtirjñāpayati-- bhavati
sau parataḥ padasaṃjñeti, yadayam ṭhnaṅsimbuddhayoḥ' (8.2.8) iti
pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| atra sambuddhiśabdo'narthakaḥ syāt, padatvābhāvādeva
nalopasyāprāpteḥ| atha vā —‘asarvanāmasthāne' iti paryudāso'yam,
na prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ,tena sarvanāmasthānādanyatra padasaṃjñā vidhīyate; na
tu sarvanāmasthānaṃ pratiṣidhyate| tena tatra pūrvasūtreṇa sau pare
padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| atha vā- prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi na doṣaḥ, yasmāt
‘anantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā'(vyā.pa.12) ityanantarā yā prāptiḥ
sā pratiṣidhyate; na vyavahitā| tena ṭhsuptiṅntaṃ padam' (1.4.14)
ityakāralopaḥ||

18. yaci bham| (1.4.18)
‘yaci' iti varṇagrahaṇaṃ saptamīnirdiṣṭam| ataḥ ṭhyasmin
vidhistaddāvalgrahaṇe' (vā.14) iti tadādividhinātra bhavitavyamityata
āha—‘yakārādau' ityādi| gārgya ityādau bhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ
‘yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ|
‘nabho'ṅrominuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam' iti|
bhasaṃjñāyāstvatra padasaṃjñābādhaḥ phalam| ‘nabha iva' iti
tulyārthatopadarśanametat; na tu prathamāsamarthādvatiḥ| sa tu nabhasā
tulyaṃ vartata iti ṭhtena tulyam' (5.1.115) ṭhāṅgirasvat' iti|
pūrveṇa tulyam| ‘manuṣvata' iti| ṭhjanerusiḥ'(da.u.9.37) ityatra
bahulagrahaṇānuvṛteḥ ṭhmana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176)
ityetasmādusipratyayaḥ| ‘ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam|
manuṣ iti sthite pūrvavadvatiḥ-- manuṣvaditi| yadyatra padasaṃjñā syāt
tadā ṣatvasyāsiddhatvādiha rutvaṃ syāt, tataśca manurvadityaniṣṭaṃ
rūpaṃ syāt| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya ceha pratipādanam—‘siti ca'
(1.4.16) ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena
nabho'ṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatau bhasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati|
‘vṛṣaṇvasvaśvayoḥ' iti| antarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñāyāṃ
prāptāyāṃ bhasaṃjñā vidhīyate,tasyāśca vidhiścakārānuvṛtereva
labhyate| vṛṣṇo'śvaḥ, atra bhatve sati yadyapi ṇatvasyāsiddhatvam, tathāpi
nalopaḥ padanibandhano na bhavati, ṭhpadāntasya' (8.4.37) iti
ṇatvapratiṣedhaśca||

19.tasau matvarthe| (1.4.19) 
‘tasau' iti varṇagrahaṇam| na ca varṇamātrānmatvarthīya sambhati, ataḥ
sāmarthyāt tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha—‘takārāntam' ityādi|
‘matvarthe pratyaye' iti vyadhikaraṇe pade; ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| matorartho
matvartha iti, tatra yo vartate pratyayastasminnityarthaḥ| atha vā-
samānādhikaraṇe pade, matuśabdena sāhacaryānmatupsahacaritārtha
ucyate-- ṇatubartho yasya tasmin, na tu yasminniti matvarthe pratyaya
iti| 
arthagrahaṇaṃ kamatupo'nyatrāpi yathā syāt; itarathā hi
matāvityucyamāne matāveva syāt; nānyeṣu| matvarthagrahaṇe
kriyamāṇe matupi na syāt; tasyārthaviśeṣaṇatvāt| viśeṣaṇasya ca
kāryeṇa sambandhānupapateḥ| na hi citragurānīyatāmityukte
viśeṣaṇabhūtā gāvo'ḍapyānīyante, naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣamapi
kvacit kārye viśiṣyate, yathā hi-- devadataśālāyā brāhmaṇā
ānīyantāmityukte devadataḥ śālāyāṃ viśeṣaṇabhūto yadi brāhmaṇo
bhavati tadā so'pyānīyata eva| ‘udaśvitvāna' iti| bhatvāt
padasaṃjñābhāve jaśtvaṃ sidhyati| ‘jhayaḥ' (8.2.10) iti vatvam,
‘ugidacām' (7.1.70) iti num, ṭhatvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti
dīrghaḥ| ‘payasvī, yaśasvī' iti| ṭhasmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121)
bhatvādrutvaṃ na bhavati| ‘indaranpūṣāryamṇāṃ sau' (6.4.12)
ityanuvartamāne ṭhsau ca' (6.4.13) ityanena dīrghaḥ||

20. ayasmayādīni ccchandasi| (1.4.20) 
yadyatra bhasaṃjñā vidhīyeta tadā padasaṃjñā na syāt, atha yadi padasaṃjñā
vidhīyeta tadā'tra bhasaṃjñā na syāt, tadā bhapadasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo
na syāt; ekasaṃjñādhikārāt| sādhutvavidhāne tveṣa doṣo na
bhavati, taddhi keṣāñcidbhasaṃjñā vidhīyate padasaṃjñakānām,
keṣāñcidubhayasaṃjñākānām; tasmāt sādhutvameva vidhātuṃ
yuktamityata āha—‘ayasmayādīni' ityādi| kathaṃ punareṣāṃ sādhutvaṃ
vidhīyata ityāha—‘bhapadasaṃjñādhikāre' ityādi| dvāram, mukham,
upāya tatra bhāṣāgrahaṇamasti, tathāpyayasmayaśabdasyāsmādeva
sādhutvavidhānāccchandasyapi mayaḍ bhavatīti bhatvādrutvaṃ na bhavati|
‘saṛkvatā' iti| ṛco'sya santīti matup| padatvāt ṭhcoḥ kuḥ'
8.3.30) iti kutvam| bhatvāt ṭhjhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvaṃ
na bhavati| ‘ākṛtigaṇo'yam' iti| ādiśabdasya prakāravācitvāt||

21. bahuṣu bahuvacanam| (1.4.21)
‘tasyānena bahutvasaṃkhyā vācyatvena vidhīyate' iti| etena
vidhyarthatāmasya yogasya darśayati| 
iha keṣāñcit ṭhsvārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyākarmādyātmakaḥ pañcakaḥ
prātipadikārthaḥ' iti darsanam| keṣāñcit
‘svārthadravyaliṅgātmakastrikaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ' iti| tatra svārtho
viśeṣaṇam; svarūpajātiguṇadravyāṇi| dravyastu viśeṣyam,
tatpunarjātiguṇadravyāṇi| tatra yadā śabdasvarūpeṇa viśiṣṭā

svārtho bhavati; jātistu viśeṣyatvādÂdravyam| yadā tu jātyā
viśiṣṭo guṇo'bhidhīte-- paṭasya śuklo guṇa iti, tadā
jātirviśeṣaṇatvāt svārtho bhavati; guṇastu viśeṣyatvādÂdravyam|

dravyameva| yadā punardravyamapi dravyāntarasya viśeṣaṇabhūtaṃ bhavati--
yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya, kuntān praveśayetyādau, tadā yaṣṭaḷadikaṃ dravyaṃ
viśeṣaṇabhāvāpannaṃ svārthaḥ; dravyāntaraṃ viśeṣyabhāvāpannaṃ
puruṣādikaṃ dravyameva| kvacitsambandho'pi svārtho bhavati-- yatra
sambandhanimitakaḥ pratyaya utpadyate, yathā-- daṇḍī, viṣāṇīti| atra
daṇḍapuruṣasambandho viśeṣaṇam, daṇḍīti dravyam| kvacit kra#yāipi
svārtho bhavati, yatra kriyānimitakaḥ pratyayaḥ utpadyate, yathā--pācakaḥ,
pāṭhaka iti| kriyākārakasambandho'tra svārtha ityapare| liṅgaṃ
strītvādi, saṃkhyaikatvādi, karmādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ kārakaviśeṣāḥ|
tatra pūrvoktayordarśanayordvitīyaṃ yaddarśanaṃ tadiha
vṛtikāreṇāśritam|
dhātostu kriyaiva vācyetyatrācāryāṇāmavivāda eva| tatra
prātipadikasya pūrvokte trike'rthe sati dhātośca kriyātmakatve
yadīdaṃ sūtraṃ nocyeta, tataḥ ṭhanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti'
(sī.vṛ.125) iti prātipadikājjasādibahuvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ trika
evārthe syāt, na bahutvasaṃkhyāyām| dhātorapi jhiprabhṛti
bahuvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kriyāyāmeva syāt; na tu
bahutvasaṃkhyāyām| tasmādanenaiva tasya bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena
vidhīyata iti vidhyarthametadbhavati| yathā cānena yogena
bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate, tathā ṭhkarmaṇi
dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādibhiryogairdvitīyādīnāṃ karmādi ca| ṭhlaḥ
karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) ityanenāpi lakārāṇāṃ
karmādyeva| tasmādete'pi yogā vidhyarthā eva veditavyāḥ|
yeṣāñca pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti matam, teṣāṃ prātipadikasyaiva
pañcāpyarthā vācyāḥ| vibhaktayaśca taddayotikā bhavanti| tatra
‘anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (sī.vṛ.125) iti vināpi
vacanenānena prātipadikādbahuvacanaṃ jasādi bahutve siddhameva|
tatra tvaniyamenānyatrāpyekatvādau prāptamanena niyamyata iti
niyamārthametadbhavati|
kasmāt punarvṛtikāreṇa trikaṃ prātipadikārtha iti darśanamāśritam
? yuktatvāt| tathā hi-- vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau na hi vinā vibhaktibhiḥ
saṃkhyākarmādayaścārthāḥ pratīyante| yadyapi payaḥ payo jarayatītyādau
vināpi vibhaktyā saṃkhyākarmāderarthasya pratītirbhavatīti, tathāpi
payasī payāṃsi payasetyevamādau saṃkhyākarmādipratītyarthaṃ
niyogato vibhaktirapekṣyata eva| na hi yathā gargā ityatra bahuvacanena
yañpratyayamantareṇāpatyārthaḥ pratīyate, tathā gārgya ityatra
prakṛtirevāpatyārthamabhidhata iti śakyate vaktuma| api ca -- payaḥ payo
jarayatītyevamādau vibhaktiviśeṣaotpatisāmarthyādeva
saṃkhyākarmādyarthsya pratītirbhavati| tathā hi, yataḥ sa vibhaktiviśeṣa
utpannasta evāsāvarthaviśeṣaḥ pratīyate, nānyasmāditi trika eva
prātipadikārtho yuktaḥ|
yadi tarhi bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate tadā
sūtre bhāvapratyayena bahutvanirdeaśaḥ kartavyaḥ, anyathā bahutvasaṃkhyā na
pratīyeta ? na kartavyaḥ; antareṇāpi bhāvapratyayaṃ bhāvapradhāno
nirdeaśo bhaviṣyatīti, yathā -- paṭasya śukla iti| nanvevamapi
bhādasyaikatvādbahuṣviti bahuvacanaṃ nopapadyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
yasmādbahutavasaṃkhyādhārasya dravyasya yo bhedastaṃ bahutve
guṇe'dhyāropya bahuṣviti bahuvacanena nirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ ,
saṃkhyāvācyayaṃ bahuśabdo na vaipulyavācīti jñāpanārthaśca| tena
vaipulyaṃ bahuvacanasya vācyaṃ na bhavatīti bahurodanaḥ,bahuḥ sūpa
iti vaipulyavācino bahuśabdādekavacanameva bhavati, na
bahuvacanam|
yadi bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate, iha vṛkṣaṃ
paśyetyatra bahuvacanaṃ prāpnoti, dve hyatra saṃkhye-- samudāyasaṃkhyā
caikatvam, avayavasaṃkhyā ca phalamūlaśākhādyavayavasamavetā bahutvam|
asyāpi prātipadikārthenaikārthasamavāyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'styeva| tathā
hi-- yeṣvayavaveṣu samaveta| bahutvasaṃkhyā prātipadikārtho'pi
samudāyastatraiva samavetaḥ, tataśca tasmādbahuvacanaṃ prāpnotītyata
āha—‘karmādayaḥ' ityādi| karmādayo hyaekavibhaktiśabdavācyatvāt
pratyāsannā bahutvasaṃkhyāyāḥ; tataḥ pratyāsatestadīya eva bahutve
bahuvacanaṃ bhavati| samudāya eva hi vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyatra dṛśikriyayā
vyāptamiṣṭatama iti sa eva karmabhāvamāpadyate, nāvayavāḥ, tatkuto
bahuvacanasya prasaṅga ? ṭhkarmādiṣu' ityādi| karmādayo bahuvacanasya
vācyāḥ| tadīyaṃ bahutvaṃ bahuṣveva karmadiṣu sambhavati, ataḥ
sāmarthyāt karmādiṣu bahuṣvityeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyate|
yadi tarhi vibhaktīnāṃ bahuvacanasya bahutvasaṃkhyā vācyatvena
vidhīyate, tadā niḥsaṃkhyebhyo'vyayebhyaḥ svādayo na syuḥ; tataśca
padasaṃjñā teṣāṃ na syādityāha—‘yatra ca' ityādi| nanu

vihitāḥ, tena sahāsyaikavākyateti vakṣyati| tatkutaḥ svādīnāṃ
sāmānyavihitatvam ? na hi ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanama' (1.4.21), ṭhkarmaṇi
dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa svaujasādeḥ
sūtrasyaikavākyatāyāṃ svādīnāṃ sāmānyavihitatvamupapadyate| evaṃ
tarhi jñāpakena avyayebhyaḥ sāmānyena svādyautpaterjñāpi tatvāt
sāmānyavihitā ityuktamityadoṣaḥ; kiṃ punastajjñāpakam ?
‘avyayādāpsupaḥ' (2.4.82) ityavyayādutpannānāṃ supāṃ lṛgvavacam, na

22. dvayekayordvivacanaikavacane| (1.4.22) 
‘dvyekayoḥ' iti| ayamapi bhāvapradhāno nirdeaśaḥ; anyathā hi
bahutvādbahuvacanaṃ syāt| bhāvapradhāne tu nirdeaśe,dvitvamekatvañca

23.kārake| (1.4.23)
‘kāraka iti viśeṣaṇamapādānādisaṃjñāviṣayam' iti| apādānadayaḥ
saṃjñā viṣayo yasya tatathoktam| ādiśabdena sampradānādīnāṃ
grahaṇam| atha vakṣyamāṇānāṃ dhruvādīnābhiyaṃ saṃjñā kasmānna bhavati ?
evaṃ manyate-- yadīyaṃ saṃjñāśabdā nirdiśyante; ayaṃ tu saptamyā
nirdiṣṭaḥ, tasmānneyaṃ dhruvādīnāṃ saṃjñeti| ‘kārake' iti nirdhāraṇe
saptamī, nirdhāraṇaṃ tu bahunāṃ sambhavati, tatkathamekavacanena
nirdeaśaḥ ? sāmānyapekṣayā tvekavacanam| atha vā—‘cchandovat
sūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.1.1.1) tato ṭhvyatayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti
bahuvacane prāpta ekavacam kārakeṣu madhye yad dhruvaṃ kārakaṃ
tadapādānasaṃjñaṃ bhavati| evamanyatrāpi veditavyamiti|
kārakaśabdo'yamastyeva vyutpannaḥ-- ṇvulantaḥ kartṛparyyāya iti, asti
ca saṃjñāśabdaḥ-- avyutpanno paryyāya iti| tatreha yadi pūrvoktasya
grahaṇaṃ syāta tadāpādānādiṣu kārakaśabdo na vartate, yathā--
kartṛśabdaḥ ṭhṇvultṛcau' (3.1.133) iti kartari vyutpāditaḥ, tathā
kārakaśabdo'pi; kartā ca svatantraḥ, apādānādayaścāsvatantrāḥ, tatkathaṃ
teṣu kārakavyapadeśaḥ syāt ? asati hi kārakavyapadeśe
kārakasaṃśabdeṣu teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt| atha teṣāmapi kathañcit
svatantratābhyupeyeta, evañca tatra kartṛsaṃjñā prasajyeta, tataśca
grāmādāgaccchati, upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadātītyādau grāmādibhyastṛtīyā
prasajyeta, itaretarāśrayaścāpi doṣaḥ syāt| tathā hi--
kartṛsaṃjñotarakālaṃ kārakaśabdasya vyutpatiḥ, tasyāṃ satyāṃ
kārakaśabdopakrameṇa kartṛsaṃjñā syāt bahvevaṃ pratividheyaṃ
syāt, pratividhāne ca pratipatigauravaṃ syāt| nimitaparyāyasya tu
kārakaśabdasya grahaṇe na doṣaḥ syāt, tataḥ sa eva gṛhyata iti
matvāha--ṭhkārakaśabdo'yaṃ nimitaparyāyaḥ' iti| ‘grāmādāgaccchati'
iti| grāmasya dhrusyāgamanakriyāṃ prati nimitabhāvo'sti| yadīha
grāmo'vadhibhāvena nāvatiṣṭhetatata āgamanaṃ na
niṣpadyeta,tasmādÂgrāmaḥ kārakam|
‘vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati' iti| vṛkṣaḥ sambandhitvenātra vivakṣitaḥ na tu
nimitatvena| apāyasya
kārakagrahaṇānnimitatvenāvivakṣitasyāpādānasaṃjñā na bhavati| naitat
kārakagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ yuktam;
dhrugrahaṇenaivātrāpādānasaṃjñāyā nivartitatvā#at, dhruvaṃ hi
tadyadavadhibhūtamapāye sādhye| tathā hi vṛtikāro vakṣyati—‘apāye
sādhye yadavadhibhūtam' (kā.1.4.24) iti| na ceha vṛkṣo'vadhitvena
vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sambandhatvena, naitadasti;

sambandhitvena| 
yadi viśeṣaṇamidaṃ dhruvādīnām; na saṃjñā, tataśca
‘kārakādataśrutayorevāśiṣi' (6.2.148) ityevamādiṣu pradeśeṣu yatra

24. dhruvamapāye'pādānam| (1.4.24)

26. parājerasoḍhaḥ| (1.4.26)

kimetannivṛtyarthenāsoḍhagrahaṇena ? satyametat; prapañce gurulāghavaṃ
na hi cintyate, prapañcaścāyam| asti hyatrādhyayanād buddhisaṃsarga

prāpya ca tato nivartate; tasmāt pūrveṇaiva siddham||

27. vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ| (1.4.27)

(8.3.22) iti yalopaḥ| ‘vārayati' iti| ṭhvṛñ āvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1813),
curādiṇic| ‘nivartayati' iti| ṭhvṛtu vartane' (dhā.pā. 758),
hetumaṇṇic| 
‘yavebhyo gā vārayati kṣetre' iti| atra kṣetrasyānīpsitasya na bhavati

28.antarddhau yenādarśanamiccchati| (1.4.28)

iti saptamī, yathā-- carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hantīti| etadeva jñāpakam--
