kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhaḷa bhavitavyamiti ? naitadasti; ṭhubhayaprāptau
karmaṇi' (2.3.66) iti niyamāt karmaṇyeva, na kartari| karma
tvatrādarśanasyātmā, tasyāntaraṅtvāt sa eva karma vijñāyate| ṭhtat
kārakam' iti| yadyapyatra sūtre taccchabdo nopātaḥ, tathāpi sa
yatadornityābhisambandhāllabhyate| ‘upādhyāyādantardhate'
ityatropādhyāyena kartā śiṣya ātmanaḥ karmabhūtasyādarśanamiccchati|
antarddhinimitam| antarddhate iti dadhāter laṭ, ‘svaritañitaḥ' (1.3.72)
ityātmanepadam, śapaḥ śluḥ, kaṭhślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam,
‘śnābhyasatyorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ, abhyāsasya jaśtvam,
‘dadhastathośca' (8.2.38) iti dakārasya dhakāraḥ, parasya dhakārasya ṭhkhari
ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam u takāraḥ| ‘nilīyate' iti| ṭhlīṅ śleṣaṇe'
(dhā.pā.1139) vaivādikaḥ|
‘caurānna didṛkṣate' iti| atra yaścaurān na didṛśata iti sa
tairātmano'darśanamiccchati, na tvantarddhinimitam;
kintūpaghātanivṛtyartham| vispaṣṭārthañcāntārddhigrahaṇ| paratvāt
karmasaṃjñaiva bādhitatvāccaurāṇāmihāpādānasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati|
prapañcārtho'yaṃ yogaḥ, na ca prapañce gurulāghavaṃ cintyata ityuktam|
upādhyāyādantardhate śiṣya iti śiṣyasyāntarddhāturmā bhūt,
naitadasti; dhruvamityanuvartate, dhruvañcāvadhibhūtamityuktam; na
cāntarddhātāvadhibhūtaḥ| evaṃ tarhyasati yenetyetasmin vacane,
satyāmapi dhruvamityasyānuvṛtau sūtrasyāvācakatvaṃ syāt|
atastanmābhūditi yenetyuktam||

29. ākhyātopayoge| (1.4.29)

30. janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ| (1.4.30)
janiśabdo'tra sāhacaryājjanyartha vartate| ata evāha—‘janyarthasya' iti|
‘janmanaḥ' iti| etena janyarthaṃ darśayati| tathā hi—‘janī prādurbhāve'
(dhā.pā.1149) iti paṭhaḷte| prādurbhāvo janma eva| kaḥ punastasya
kartetyata āha—‘jāyamānaḥ' iti| ‘jñājanorjā' (7.3.79) iti jādeśaḥ|
atha prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā dhruvamityanuvartate,
dhruvañcāvadhibhutamityuktam| janikartṛścāvadhiḥ kāraṇameva bhavati;
tatrāntareṇāpi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ prakṛtereva bhaviṣyati, naitadasti;
putrāt pramādo jāyata ityādau putrāderapyapādānāsaṃjñā yathā
syādityevamarthaṃ prakṛtigrahaṇam| dvividhaṃ hi kāraṇam--
upādānakāraṇam, sahakārikāraṇañca| tatra yat kāryeṇābhinnadeśaṃ
tadupādānakāraṇam, yathā- ghaṭasya mṛtpiṇḍaḥ| sahakārikāraṇaṃ yat
kāryeṇa bhinnadeśam, yathā-- tasyaiva daṇḍacakrādi| tatrāsati
prakṛtigrahaṇe pratyāsaterupādānakāraṇasyaiva syāt, netarasya|
prakṛtigrahaṇe tu sati sarvasyaiva kāraṇamātrasya bhavati||

31.bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ| (1.4.31)

punaretadavasitam-- kriyayā yamabhipraitisa sampradāvamityayamartho'tra
pratipādayitumiṣṭatam iti ? abhipragrahaṇāt| asti hyatrācāryasya
kaścidartho'dhiko'bhimataḥ, yasyāvabhāsanāyādhikaṃ śabdāntaraṃ
prayuktamiti gamyate, na tvarthaviśeṣaḥ| na hi tat tasya vācakam|
yadyapyavācakaṃ syāt, tathāpi
lakṣyadarśanavaśādaviccchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśācca
viśeṣāvagatirbhaviṣyatītyadveṣyametat| 
‘kriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavyam' iti| kriyayā grahaṇaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam| yena
kriyā gṛhyate, tadvayākhyānaṃ kartavyam| kiṃ punastadvyākhyānam ?
taccāsmābhirabhigrahaṇsaya prayojanaṃ varṇayadbhiḥ kṛtameva| kā
punariha kriyā, yayābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānasaṃjñeṣyate ? sā
vivakṣitā| ata āha—‘kriyayāpi yamabhipraiti' ityādi| ‘nigalhate'
iti| ‘garha galha kutsāyām' (dhā.pā.636,637) anudātet| ṭhyuddhāya
sannahyate' iti| ‘naha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1166) divādau svaritet| sa
ceha niścaye vartate, yuddhe niścayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| ‘patye śete'
iti| śīṅtropasarpaṇapūrvake śayana vartate| patimupasṛtya śete
ityarthaḥ| ‘karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñā' ityādi| etat ṭhpaśunā rudraṃ yajate'
ityetadviṣayameva veditavyam| yajiḥ svaritet| etacca ṭhvyatyayo
bahulam' (3.1.85) iti suvyatyayena siddhameveti na vaktavyam||

33. rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ| (1.4.33)

bhavati ? rucyarthābhāvāt ṭhanyakartṛko hyabhilāṣo ruciḥ, (kā.
1.4.33) ityuktam. na cehānyakartṛko'bhilāṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ?

40. pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā| (1.4.40)
‘pareṇa' ityādi| anyena kenacididaṃ me kriyatāmiti prayukto
vyāpāritaḥ san pratijānīte| ataḥ pratijñāturanyena
prayuktsayābhyupagamo bhavati| prayokteti vyāpārayitā| sūtre
pūrvasyetyarthāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ|sa tvartho vicāryamāṇaḥ
kriyaiva bhavati| yasmāt karteti kriyāyā eva bhavati
nānyasyārthasyetyāha—‘pūrvasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ' iti| yaścāsau pūrvasyāḥ
kriyāyāḥ kartā bhavati, sa pratijñātuḥ prayojako bhavatīti
hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāmidaṃ vanacam| ṭhdevadatāya gāṃ
pratiśṛṇoti' iti| atra pūrvasyā yānacakriyāyā devadataḥ kartā|
devadatena hi mahyaṃ gāṃ dehīti yācita sa yadā dadāmīti
pratijānīte, tadaivaṃ prayujyate-- devadatāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇotīti |
pūrvasya karteti kim ? vinā tena gavāderabhyupayemānasya karmaṇa
eva syāt| nanu ca paratvāt karmasaṃjñā tasya bādhikā bhaviṣyati,
naitadasti; nāprāpte hi saṃjñāntara idamārabhyata iti| ihāpi ca
devadatāya gāmāśṛṇotīti devadatasya hetusaṃjñā prāpnoti| tatra
pūrvasya kartetyasminnasati yathā devadatasya hetusaṃjñāṃ bādhate, tadā
karmasaṃjñāmapi bādheta| atha vā—‘purastādapavādā anantarān
vidhīn bādhante notarān' (vyā.pa.9) iti karmasaṃjñāmeva bādheta|
pūrvasya kartetyasmiṃstu sati hetusaṃjñāmeva bādhate, na
karmasaṃjñām||

42. sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam| (1.4.42)
nanu ca sāmagryadhīnā hi kriyāsiddharekasyāpyabhāvena na bhavati| tat
kasyātra prakarṣo yatparigrahāya sādhakatamaśabdasya grahamamita

atyantamupakārakam| atha vā -- prakarṣaḥ prakṛṣṭam ṭhnupaṃsake bhāve
ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| prakṛṣṭena prakarṣeṇopakārakaṃ prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ yat
kriyāyasiddhiviṣaye prakarṣeṇopakārakaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tat sādhakatamam|
vivakṣitagrahaṇaṃ yadā prakṛṣṭopakārakatvena vivakṣyate, tadā
sādhakatamavyavahāro vijñāyate, nānyedita jñāpanārtham| tathāhi--
vivakṣāvaśād yadeva kadācit karaṇambhavati-- dhanuṣā vidhyatīti,
tadeva kadācit svātantryavivakṣāyāṃ kartṛtvamanubhavati--
ṭadhanurvidhyatīti| ‘lunāti' iti| ṭhpvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ' (7.3.80)|
‘tamabgrahaṇaṃ kim ? gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' iti| yadi tamabgrahaṇaṃ na
kriyeta, tato'trādhikaraṇasaṃjñā na syāt| iha hi dvivadha ādhāraḥ-
gauṇaḥ,mukhyaśca| tatra mukhyo ya ādheyena vyāpyate, yathā-- tileṣu
tailamasti;atra tailenādheyenādhārabhūtāstilā vyāptāḥ| avyāpto
gauṇo yathā-- gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| atra hi sāmīpyād gaṅgāyāṃ
ādhāratvamupacaritam, na mukhyam; vyāptyabhāvāt| tatrāsati
tamabgrahaṇe ṭhgauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃmpratyayaḥ' (vyā.pa.4) iti
mukhyasyaivādhikaraṇasaṃjñā syāt, netarasya; tamabgrahaṇāt tasyāpi
bhavati; tathapīha tamabgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam,katham ? vināpi tena
prakarṣāvagateḥ| yathaiva hyanabhirūpāya kanyādānasya
pravṛtirnāstītyabhirūpāya kanyā deyetyukte vināpi
prakarṣapratyayenābhirūpatamāyeti gamyate; tathehāpi
kārakādhikārādasādhake saṃjñāyāḥ pravṛtirnastīti ṭhsādhakaṃ karaṇam'
ityukte'ntareṇāpi tamabgrahaṇaṃ sādhakatamamiti gamyate, tatkiṃ
tamabgrahaṇena ? tadetat tamabgrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārthaṃ kṛtam| etadanena
jñāpyate—‘iha kārakādhikāre itaḥ sūtrādanyatra vinā tamabgrahaṇena
prakarṣo nāśrīyate' iti| tena ṭhādhāro'dhikaraṇam' (1.4.45) ityanena
‘gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādāvamukhyasyāpi

45. ādhāro'dhikaraṇam| (1.4.45)
‘ādhriyante kriyāguṇā asminnityādhāraḥ' iti| ṭhadhyāyanyāyodyāvaṭa

bhavatīti cet, na; paratvādanavakāśatvācca kartṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāṃ
bādhyamānatvāt| adhikaraṇasaṃjñā hi pūrvo gauṇa ādhāre sāvakāśā,

vikledanakriyāyā karmasthatvāt|

48. upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ|(1.1.48)
lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.50) ṭhvasa nivāse'
(dhā.pā.1005) ityasya bhauvādikasya grahaṇam, na ṭhvasa ācchādane'
(dhā.pā.1023) ityasyādādikasya|
‘vaseraśyarthasya' ityādi| ‘upoṣya rajanīmekām' iti,
trirātramupavasatītyatra ca ṭhkālādhvanoḥ' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā| atha vā
‘kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ' (vā; ma.bhā.1.336) iti karmatve| atrārthaśabdo
nivṛtivacana iti bhojananivṛtivācina ityartha-| ‘vaktavyam' iti|
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
ihāpyanyatarasyāgrahaṇanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate;
tena vaseraśyarthasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati||

49. karturīpsitatamaṃ karma| (1.4.49)
‘kartuḥ kriyayā' iti| etena karturiti nepsitatamāpekṣayā ṭhktasya
ca vartamāne' (2.3.67) ityaneneyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī, api tu kriyāpekṣayā
śeṣalakṣaṇaiveti darśayati| nanu ca neha kriyopātā, tatkathaṃ
tadapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī prayujyate ? yadyapi nopātā, tathāpi kartuḥ
kriyāpekṣatvāt kartṛśabdo'yaṃ sambandhiśabda iti kartṛsambandhinīṃ
kriyāmupasthāpayatītyadoṣaḥ| īpsitaśabdo hyasti rūḍhiśabdaḥ--
īpsito'bhipreta iti, asti ca kriyāśabdaḥ-āptamiṣṭa īpsita iti ;
tatraha kriyāśabdo gṛhyate, netaraḥ; na hi rūḍhiśabdasya kriyayā
kartṛsādhyayā sambandha upapadyate| ‘īpsita' iti| ṭhāplṛ vyāptau'
(dhā.pā.1260) san, dvirvanacam, ṭhāpjñapyṛdhāmīt' (7.4.55)
itītvam| ‘atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ| īpsa iti
sthite, ktapratyaye kṛte, iṭi ca ṭhato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralope
cepsitaśabdaḥ sampadyate| tenārthadvayamihopātam-- prakṛtyarthaḥ,
pratyayārthaśca| tatrāptumityanena prakṛtyarthaṃ darśayati,iṣṭatamamityanena
pratyayārtham|
‘karmaṇaḥ' ita| aśvasya| atra bandhakriyayā āptamiṣṭatamatvāt karmatvam|
sa hi bhakṣaṇakriyayā māṣānāptumiccchati| ‘payasaudanaṃ bhaṅkte' iti|
asati hi tamabgrahaṇe payaso'pi syāt| tadapi kartṛrbhujikriyayā
vyāptumiṣṭaṃ bhavati| tamabgrahaṇe tu sati na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ;
prādhānyādaudanasyaivepsitatamatvāt| prādhānyaṃ tvodanasya
saṃskāryatvāt, payasastvaprādhānyaṃ saṃskārakatvāt| 
‘karmetyanuvartamāne' iti| ‘adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma' (1.4.46) ityataḥ|
‘punaḥ'ityādi| pūrva karmagrahaṇamādhāreṇa sambaddham; atastadanuvṛtau
tasyānuvṛtiḥ syādata ādhāranivṛtyarthaṃ punaḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|
yadi punarādhāro'nuvartate, tataḥ kiṃ syādityatrāha—‘ādhārasyaiva
hi syāt' iti| ‘hi' śabdo yasmādarthe| yasmāsyādityāha—‘geham'
ityādi| ādhārānuvṛtau tu yatra na bhavati taddarśanayitumāha--
‘odanaṃ pacati' ityādi| ādiśabdenaudanaṃ bhaṅktaṃ
ityevamādergrahaṇam| atha nadī kūlaṃ karṣatītyādau kathaṃ karmasaṃjñā ?
kathañca na syāt ? nadyāderacetanatvāt, acetanānāmīpsāyā
asambhavāt, naitadasti; atra nadīti padāntarasambandādīpsāyā
abhāvo'cetanasyāpi bhāvaḥ pratīyate| na ca padasaṃskāre
padānatarasambandhagamyo'rtha upayujyate, tena kūlaṃ
karṣatītyādāvicchāmātramāśritā vyāptiḥ, karma ca saṃskriyate| yadyapi
paścānnadyā saha sambandhādacetanatvamicchāyā abhāvaśca pratīyate, tathāpi
ca tadbahiraṅgatvādantaraṅgasaṃjñākārya na śaknoti
nivartayitum| anenaiva nyāyena yatra vyāptirnāsti,icchāmātraṃ ca
kevalam, tatrāpi karmasaṃjñā bhavati, yathā- grāmaṃ ganatumicchāmi na ca
me gamanaśaktirastīti| 
tacca karma trividham-- nirvartyam, vikāryam, prāpyañca| tatra
nirvartyaṃ yadasakadevotpādyate, yasya janma kriyate, tannirvartyam
, yathā-- kaṭṃa karoti, kaṭo hyasanneva kriyate| vikāryaṃ
yallabdhasatākamavasthāntaramāpādyate kevalaṃ bhasmākhyāmavasthāmāpādyante|
prāpyaṃ yatra vyāptivyitarekeṇa kriyākṛtā viśeṣā na vibhāvyante,
yathā-- ādityaṃ paśyatīti| na hi dṛśikriyayā vyāpyamānasya savituḥ
kriyākṛtaviśeṣa upalabhyata iti prāpyametat karma||

50.tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam|(1.4.50)
cakāro'vadhāraṇe| ata eva vṛtāvāha—‘tenaiva' iti| ‘anīpsitam'
iti| yadyapyayaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tadā grāmaṃ gaccchan
vṛkṣamūlānyupasarpatītyādau vṛkṣamūlādīnāṃ karmasaṃjñā na syāt|
tathā hi-- prasajyapratiṣedhe satyanena yogenānīpsitasyaiva karmasaṃjñā
vidhīyate; vṛkṣamūlāni ca na tāvadīptitāni, pūrvamanabhisandhāya
pravṛteḥ; nāpyanīpsitāni, apratikūlatvāt; tataścānīpsitasya
karmasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā teṣamīpsitādanyatvenānīpsitānna syāt|
paryudāse tu satyanena yonenepsitādanyasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyate|
bhavanti ca yathoktaprakaraṇāni vṛkṣamūlānīpsitādanyāni;
atasteṣāmapi karmasaṃjñā sidhyatītyetadālocya paryudāso'yamiti
darśayitumāha—‘īpsitādanyat' ityādi| kiṃ punastadityāha--
‘dveṣyam' ityādi| dveṣyam u pratikūlam, yathā-- viṣacaurādi|
itaradapratikūlam, yathā -- uktaprakārāṇi vṛkṣamūlāni| ‘bhakṣayati' iti|
‘bhakṣa adane' (dhā.pā. 1557) caurādikaḥ||

51.akathitañca| (1.4.51)
‘pmudrita ṭhkāśikāvṛtau' tu ṭhapādānādiviśeṣakathābhiḥ'
ityevāsti|}apādānādhibhirviśeṣakathābhiḥ' iti| kārakasāmānyakathāyā
vyavacchedārtametat| yadi hi kenāpyakathitasya karmasaṃjñā syāt,
tadā māṇavakasya pitaraṃ panthānaṃ pṛccchatītyatrākārakasyāpi
māṇavakasya karmasaṃjñā syāt| ‘parigaṇanam' iti|

‘upayajyate' iti| iṣṭārthasiddhau vyāpāryata ityartha-| ‘payaḥprabhṛti'

ātrāpyādiśabdena pauravādergrahaṇam| ṭhtasyoparyujyamānapayaḥ
prabhṛtanimitasya' iti| upayujyamānañca tat payaḥ prabhṛti ceti
viśeṣaṇasamāsaṃ kṛtvanā upayujyamānapayaḥ prabhṛternimitamiti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ‘gavādeḥ' iti| ādiśabdena pauravādergrahaṇam| nanu
ca pāṇyādikamapyupayoganimitamiti, tena vinopayogasya
payaso'sambhavāt| ādiśabdena kāṃsyapātrādergrahaṇam| ṭhvihitā hi

pūrvagrahaṇamatrānyavidherupalakṣaṇārtham| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yasyānyo
vidhirnoktasya karmasaṃjñeti| tena yatrāpi vakṣyamāṇe hetukartṛsaṃjñe
iti tatrāpyeṣā saṃjñā na
bhavatīti dogdhāpyupayogasya nimitaṃ tasya karmasaṃjñā na bhavati|
sūtre'pi ṭhakathitam' iti kathamanivṛtaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ

bruviśāsiguṇena' iti| kaḥ punarguṇa ityāha—‘sādhanam' iti|
sādhanaṃ hi kriyayā upakārakam | yaccopakārakaṃ tadupakāryam

52.gatibuddhikapratyavasānāthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa
ṇau|(1.4.52)
‘yāpayati' iti| ‘artihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk|
‘vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- utarasūtre
(1.4.53) anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūto vijñāyate, sā
ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tena nīvahyaerna bhaviṣyati|
‘vaheḥ' ityādi| niyaccchati u viśiṣṭe viṣaye'vasthāpayatīti niyantā
sārathiḥ, avidyamāno niyantā kartā yasya sa tathoktaḥ, tasya|
‘nīvahyoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (vā.62) iti yo'nantaroktaḥ sa
vaheraniyantṛkartṛkasya bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ|
tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- tasyaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣā
tvānniyantṛkartṛkasya vaheḥ karmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti|
‘ādikhādyoḥ' ityādi| atrāpi vaktavyaśabdasya pūrvavadevārthaḥ|
vyākhyānamapi pūrvavadeva kartavyam| ‘bhakṣyati piṇḍī devadataḥ' iti|
curādiṇic| ‘bhakṣayati' piṇḍaĀ devadatena' iti| hetumaṇṇic|
‘bhakṣayati balīvarddān śasyam' iti| bhakṣiratra hiṃsārthaḥ| ṭhsarve
sacetanā bhāvāḥ' ityasmin darśe hiṃsitaṃ śasyamiti śasyasya bhakṣaṇena
devadato hiṃsito bhavati| yasya hi taccchasyaṃ tasya hiṃsā gamyate|
‘śabdakarmaṇām' iti| śabdagrahaṇeneha pāribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhya.te, na
tu kriyā| kriyā grahaṇe hi karma grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|
kārakādhikārādeva kārakasya kriyāpekṣatvāccchabdātmikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ
vartamānā dhātavo grahīṣyanta iti, tat kiṃ karmagrahaṇena ? yadi tarhi
pāribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhyate, jalpati devadato jalpayati devadatam,
vilapati devadataṃ kārṣāpaṇamityatra na prāpnoti, śabdādanyasya
pāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo vivakṣitatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ;
buddhyarthatvāt bhaviṣyati| atra hi jalpatiprabhṛtayastāvaccchabdasādhane
bodhane vartante| jalpati devadata iti| vacanena bodhayatītyarthaḥ|
evamanyatrāpi| paśyati kārṣāpaṇamityatra dṛśiścakṣuḥ sādhane jñāne
vartate| cakṣuṣā jānīta ityarthaḥ| tasmādbuddharthatvāt siddham|
‘adhyāpayati' iti| ‘krīṅjīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1..48) ityātvam| ṭhartihrī'
(7.3.36) ityādinā puk| kimarthaṃ punaridaṃ sūtram, yāvatā ṇyante
dhātau prayojanakavyāpāreṇa preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇākhyena
vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt prayojyasya ṭhkarturīpsitatamaṃ karma' (1.4.49)
ityanenaiva karmasaṃjñā siddhā ? satyam, niyamārthaṃ vacanam--
prayojakavyāpāreṇa vyāpyamānasya yadā karmasaṃjñā tadā
gatyarthādīnāmeva,nānyeṣāmiti||

53. hṛkrorantayatarasyām|(1.4.53)
gatyarthādayo nivṛtāḥ| tenobhayatra vibhāṣeyam| yadā haratirgatau
vartate, abhyavahāre vā, karotiścākarmaṇo bhavati tadā prāpte| yadā
tu haratiḥ steyādau vartate, karotiśca sakarmako bhavati
tavā'prāpte| ‘upasaṃkhyānam' iti| pratipādanamityarthaḥ| etacca
prakṛtatvāt tatredaṃ pratipādanam—‘akathitañca' (1.4.51)
ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ|
tenābhivādidṛśorapyātmanepade karmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti|
‘abhivādayate' iti. ṭhṇitaśca'(1.3.ka74) ityātmanepadam| ‘darśayate'
iti| atrāpi ṭhṇeraṇau' (1.3.67) ityādinā|

54.svatantraḥ kartā| (1.4.54)
astyayaṃ svatantaraśabdo bahuvrīhiḥ| svaṃ tantraṃ yasya sa svatantraḥ| asti
ca samāsapratirūpako rūḍhiśabdaḥ, pradhānārthavṛtiḥ, yathā--
svatantro'yamiha devadata iti, pradhānabhūta iti gamyate| tatra yadi
pūrvo gṛhyaeta tadā tantuvāyasyaiva syāt; vistṛtā hi
tantavastantram, tacca tantuvāyasyaivāsti| devadataḥ pacatītyādau na
syāt| itarasya tu grahaṇe sarvatra bhavati| tasmāt vyāpternyāyāt sa
eva gṛhyata iti matvāha—‘svatantra iti pradhānabhūtaḥ' iti|
yadyevamapradhānamapekṣya pradhānamucyata iti
yatrādhikaraṇādīnyaparāṇyapradhānāni kārakāṇi santi, devadataḥ
kāṣṭhṬaragninodanaṃ sthālyāṃ pacatītyādau tatraiva syāt| yatra tu
teṣāmavivakṣā-- āste devadataḥ, śete devadata ityādau, tatra na
syāditi yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha—‘aguṇabhūtaḥ' iti| evaṃ manyate--
pradhānenāguṇabhāva upalakṣyate| guṇabhāvo yatra nāsti sa karteti|
kārakāntarāvivakṣāyāmapyaguṇabhāvo'styeveti sarvatra bhavati| nanu
ca sāmagryadhīnā hi kriyāsiddhiḥ, ekasyāpyabhāve na sidhyati, tat
kasyātra prādhānyaṃ yatparigrahāya svatantragrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityāha —‘yaḥ
kriyāsiddhau' ityādi| yadyapi kriya#asiddhau sarveṣāṃ vyāpāraḥ, tathāpi
svātantryaṃ yasya vivakṣyate sa eva svatantra ityutyate, nānya iti|
devadataḥ pacatītyatra devadataḥ kartṛsaṃjñakatvāt
kartṛpratyayenocyate lakāreṇa||

55. tatprayojako hetuśca|((1.4.55) 
‘tasya prayojakastatprayojakaḥ' iti. nanu ca ṭhkartari ca' (2.2.16)
ityanena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhe nātra bhavitavyamityāha--
‘nipātanātsamāsaḥ' iti| ‘prayojakaḥ' iti prerakaḥ u upadeśakaḥ,
vyāpāraka ityarthaḥ| na cānyena prayujyamānasya svavyāpāre svātantrayaṃ
hīyate; anyathā hyakurvatyapi kārayīti syāt| prayojakatvaṃ
dvividham-- mukhyam, itaracva| devadataḥ kaṭṃa kārayītyatra devadatasya
mukhyam| bhikṣā vāsayatītyatra bhikṣāṇāṃ vāsahetutvāt
prayojanatvamupacaritam, na mukhyam. na hi bhikṣā yūyaṃ vasathetyevaṃ
prayuñjate| iha ca kārakādhikāre tamabgrahaṇavyatirekeṇātiśayo na
vivakṣita iti ṭhsādhakatamaṃ karaṇa m' (1.4.42) ityatra tamabgrahaṇena
jñāpitametat| tena yasyāpi prayojagatvamupacaritam, na mukhyam,
tasyāpi hetusaṃjñā bhavatyeva|
‘saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ' iti| asati tasminnekasaṃjñādhikārādatra
kartṛsaṃjñā na syāt| ataḥ saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ kriyate|
‘hetutvāt' ityādinā saṃjñādvayasya prayojanaṃ darśayati|
prayojakavyāpāre hi ṭhhetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic vidhīyate|
tasya hetutvaṃ prayojakasya hetutve satyupapadyate|
hetutvātprayojako ṇico nimitaṃ bhavati| kartṛpratyena na
lakāreṇābhidhānaṃ kartṛsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ bhavatīti kartṛtvat
kartṛpratyayena lakāreṇocyata iti||

56. prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ| (1.4.56)

60. gatiśca| (1.4.60)
‘prakṛtya' iti| gatisaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti

80. te prāgdhātoḥ|(1.4.80)

gatyupasargasaṃjñayoranabhinirvṛtatvāt te gatyupasargasaṃjñā iti
pratyavamarśo na yujyate| nipātasaṃjñāyāścābhinirvṛtatvāt ta
ityanena nipātā eva pratyavamṛśyeran; tataśca nipātasaṃjñāyā niyamaḥ
syāt| itaratra tu niyamenāyaṃ yogo
gatyupasargasaṃjñāvākyānāmekadeśabhūto bhavatīti na bhavatyeva
doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| saṃjñāniyamasya cāprākprayujyamānānāṃ saṃjñānivṛtiḥ
phalaṃ syāt, taccāyuktam; na hyaprākprayujyamānānāṃ satyāmapi
saṃjñāyāṃ kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| itarasya tu
niyamasyāprākprayogābhāvaḥ phalam, tacca yuktam; na hi
gatyupasargasaṃjñakānāmaprākprayoga iṣyate| tasmāt prayoganiyama eva
nyāyya iti tamāśrityāha—‘te gatyupasargasaṃjñakāḥ' iti| ‘tathā ca'
ityādi| yādṛśo niyamaḥ kṛtastadanurūpaṃ tatsadṛśamevetyarthaḥ| nanu
ca naiva kaścit prapaṭhatīti prayoktavye ṭhpaṭhati pra' iti prayuṅkte,
tato'niṣṭādarśanādapārthakametat, naitadasti; yadyapi bhāṣāyāṃ
dhātoḥ pareṇa prayujyamānāste gatyupasargasaṃjñakā na dṛśyante,
cchandasi tu dṛśyante| tatra ya eva mandabuddhiḥ pratipatā teṣāṃ cchandasi
dhātoḥ pare prayogaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathaiva te cchandasi viṣaye dhātoḥ
pareṇa prayujyante, tathā bhāṣāyamapi prayoktavyā iti manyate, taṃ prati
vyutpādanārthatvānnāsti vaiyarthyaprasaṅgaḥ|
atha kimarthaṃ tegrahaṇam ? yāvatā prakṛtatvādeva gatyupasargasaṃjñakānāṃ
prākprayogeṇa sambandho vijñasyata ityāha—‘tegrahaṇam' ityādi| asati
tegrahaṇe gatisaṃjñakānāmanantaratvāt ta eva prākprayogeṇa
sambadhyeran| tegrahaṇe tūpasargasaṃjñā api nirdiśyanta iti taṣāmapi
sambandha upapadyate| tasmādupasargāṇāmapi prākprayoganiyamo yathā
syādityevamartha tegrahaṇam| nanu cayaṃ prati kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ
prati gatyupasargasaṃjñakā bhavantītyantareṇāpi dhātugrahaṇaṃ dhātoreva
prāk prayogo vijñāsyate, na hi dhātoranyatra kriyā'sti, tatkathaṃ
dhātorityucyate ? naitadasti ; prakartṛmiccchati
pracikīrṣatītyatrāpi dhātośca prāk prayogo yathā syāt| atra sanaḥ
sambandhinyaṣaṇakriyayā yuktaḥ praśabda iti sanaṃ gatyupasargasaṃjñā yathā
syāt| tataścāsati dhātugrahaṇe tata eva prāk prayujyeta |dhātugrahaṇe
tu cikīrṣaterdhātoḥ prākprayujyate, na sanaḥ||

81. cchandasi pare'pi|(1.4.81)

82.vyavahitāśca| (1.4.82)
cchandasi vyavahitānāṃ prayogavacanāt bhāṣayāṃ vyavahitānāṃ
prayogo na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadyevam, gativyavadhāne'pi
prākprayogo na prāpnoti-- samāharatītyādau naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi
tulyajātīyako vyavadhāyako bhavati| gatyupasargajāterāśrayaṇānnāsti
vyavadhānam| ‘ā mandraiḥ' ityādi| atrāṅe mandrairityādibhiḥ
padairvyadhāne'pi yāterdhātoḥ prākprayogaḥ| ‘āyāhi' iti| etenāṅe
yāhītyanena sambandhaṃ darśayati||

83. karmapravacanīyāḥ| (1.4.83)
‘karmapravacīyāḥ' iti vakṣyamāṇānāṃ saṃjñināṃ bahutvādbahuvacanena
nirdeaśaḥ| mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitatprayojanamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā
vijñāyeta-- karma proktavantaḥ karmapravacīyā iti| bhūte ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo
bahulam' (3.3.113) iti kartaryanīyar| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ| ke ca
karma proktavantaḥ ? ye samprati kriyāṃ na tvāhuḥ|
tadevamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇadvāreṇa ye kriyāṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na tu
proktavantaḥ ? yeta samprati kriyāṃ na tvāhuḥ|
tadevamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇadvāreṇa ye kriyāṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na tu samprati
dyotayanti, te karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā bhavantītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadi
sampratati na kriyāṃ dyotayanti, kintarhi ? sambandhaviśeṣam| yathā
śākalyasya saṃhitāmanuprāvarṣakhadityatra hi niśamanakriyayā
saṃhitāpravarṣaṇayoryaḥ sambandha upajanito hetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇaḥ,
tamanuśabdo dyotayati| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām
‘karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' (2.3.8) iti dvitīyā bhavati||

84. anurlakṣaṇe| (1.4.84)
‘lakṣaṇāśabdo'tra cihne vartate' iti matvā kaściccodayati--
‘kimartham' ityādi| itarastu ṭhlakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsāsu'
(1.4.90) ityādau sūtre| tatra cihne jñāpake vartamānasya lakṣaṇaśabdasya
grahaṇam, iha tu kārake hetau, atastena na sidhyatītyenābhiprāyeṇa
taṃ pratyāha—‘hetvarthantu vacanam' ityādi| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe--
hetvamarthameveti| hetuśabdo'tar kārakahetuvacanaḥ, na
jñāpakahetuvacanaḥ; anyathā hyaparihāra evāyaṃ syāt| heturartho yasya
tatathoktam| hetau vartamānasyānoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā yathā
syādityevamarthamidaṃ vacanamityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ punahatau vartamānasya
tasyeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyata ityāha—‘hetau tṛtīyāyām' ityādi|
saṃhitā hi varṣaṇasya hetuḥ, anuhudÂdyajñaḥ sekasya, tathā hi--
saṃhitāmanuniśamya śrutvā prāvarṣat|
avuḍudyajñañcānuniśamyāsiñcat| tatra yadi hetāvanoreṣā saṃjñā
nocyeta śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu raprāvarraṣadityādau ṭhhetau'
(2.3.23) iti tṛtīyā syāt| tasmātāṃ bādhitvā dvitīyaiva yathā
syādityevamartha hetāviyaṃ saṃjñā'norvidhīyate|| 

85. tṛtīyārthe|(1.4.85)
‘nadīmanvavasitā' iti| sahārtho'tra tṛtīyārthaḥ| ‘sahayukte'pradhāne'

86. hīne|(1.4.86)
‘anuśākaṭāyanaṃ vaiyākaraṇāḥ' iti| śākaṭāyanamapekṣyānye

sambandhivibhaktirna bhavati||

87. upo'dhike ca| (1.4.87)

88. apaparī varjane|(1.4.88)

89. āṅ maryādāvacane|(1.4.89)
yatrāṅe maryādāyāmabhividhau ca kāryamiccchati tatrobhayorapi grahaṇaṃ
karoti, yathā—‘āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityādi| iha tu
maryādāgrahameva kṛtam, nābhividhigrahaṇam, ato'bhividhāvanayā
saṃjñayā na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ
nirākartumāha—‘vacanagrahaṇāt' ityādi| vacanagrahaṇe hi sati
bahuvrīhirlabhyate| ‘maryādā' ityetadvacanaṃ yatra sūtre
tanmaryādāvacanam| tatrāyamartho bhavati-- yatra maryādāgrahaṇamasta
sūtre, tatra ya āṅ sa karmapravacanīyasaṃjño bhavati| tatpunaḥ sūtram--
‘āha maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityetat-- tatra cāṅ
maryādābhividhyorvartamāna upāta ityubhayatrāpi bhavati|
kaḥ punarvarjanasya maryādāśca viśeṣaḥ, yena pūrvasūtre
varjanamabhidhāyeha maryādāgrahaṇaṃ karoti ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ--
varjane hi tatparityāgenānyatra sāmānyena varṣaṇādinā sambandho
gamyate, yathā-- ā trigartebhyo vṛṣṭo deva iti, atra hi yasyāṃ diśi
vyavasthito vaktedaṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅkte tasyāṃ diśi yo deśo
yastathānyāsu dikṣu tatra sarvatraiva trigartānÂ varjayitvā vṛṣṭa iti
gamyate| maryādāyāṃ tvidaṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅkte-- ā
pāṭaliputrādÂvṛṣṭo deva iti, tatsambandhinyāmeva diśi yo
vyavasthito deśastasya deśasya varṣaṇena sambandharaḥ pratīyata ityeṣa
viśeṣaḥ|
‘īṣadarthe kriyāyoge mā bhūt' iti| īṣadartha ākaḍāra iti|
kriyāyoge samāharatīti| pūrvatra saṃjñāyā abhāvātpañcamī na bhavati|
itaratra ṭhgatirgatau' (8.1.70) iti nighāto bhavati| yastu
vākyasmaraṇayorākāro vartate, tasyāṅtvāidiha
ṅkāroccāraṇādeva saṃjñāyā aprasaktiḥ||

90. lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsāsu pratiparyanavaḥ|(1.4.90)
lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpako hetuścihnamihābhipretam| lakṣyate cihnyate yena
tallakṣaṇam| kañcitprakāramāpannamitthambhūtam,
tasyākhyānamitthambhūtākhyānam| ‘bhī prāptau' (dhā.pā.1844)
ātmanepadī| tasmāt ṭhā dhṛṣādvā' (dhā.pā.1805 taḥ paścāt) iti
vibhāṣitaṇico yadā curādiṇij nāsti, tadā ktāntasya bhūta iti
rūpaṃ bhavati| svīkriyamāṇāā'śo bhāgaḥ| yastvasvīkriyamāṇe'śe
bhāgaśabdaḥ prayujyate-- priyaṅgorbhāgo nagarasya bhāga iti, sa
svīkriyamāṇāṃśasādṛśyāt| padārthān vyāptumicchā vīpsā| ete ca
lakṣaṇādayaḥ pratyādīnāṃ na dyotyāḥ| kiṃ tarhi ? viṣayabhūtāḥ, ata
evāha—‘viṣayabhūtāyam' iti| etacca ṭhabhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni
bhavanti' (vyā.pa.73) iti liṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇādibhiḥ
sambadhyate| etacca ṭhabhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti' (vyā.pa.73) iti
liṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇādibhiḥ sambadhyate| yadi lakṣamādayaḥ
pratyādīnāṃ na dyotyāḥ, tarhi kiṃ te dyotayanti ? sambandhaviśeṣam|
‘vṛkṣaṃ prati vidyotate vidyaut' iti| atra vṛkṣo lakṣaṇam, vidyotamānā
vidyaullakṣyā; sā hi vṛkṣaṃ prāpya vidyotata iti tayoḥ
prāptikriyājanito'tra lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ pratiśabdena dyotyate|
‘sādhurdeavadato mātaraṃ prati' iti| pratinā devadatasya mātṛviṣayā
sādhubhāvāpatirākhyāyate| atrāpi mātaraṃ prāpya sādhubhāvāpatiriti
prāptikriyājanita eva mātuḥ sādhubhāvāpateśca
viṣayaviṣayibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ pratinā''khyāyate| ṭhyadatra
mām'ityādi| yo bhāgo māmabhibhajate sa dīyatāmityarthaḥ| atrāpi
vibhajanakriyājanitaḥ svīkārakriyājanito vā svasvāmibhāvaḥ
sambandhaḥ| ‘mām' iti| asmaccchabdasya ṭhtvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) iti
mādeśaḥ| ‘dvitīyāyāñca' (7.2.87) ityātvam| ṭhvṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati
siñcati' iti| atra vīpsā dvirvacanenaiva dyotyate| pratiśabdasya tu
sekakriyājanito vṛkṣāyāṃ yaḥ sambandhaḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sa eva
dyotyaḥ| vṛkṣādinimitaṃ sādhanam, sekaḥ sādhyaḥ| dvitīyā ceha
sakarmakatvāt siceḥ sekena vyāptumiṣṭatamānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ karmatve
sati ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityanenaiva siddhā|
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasarjanasaṃjñayā nivartitatvāt ṭhupasargāt
sunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā dhatvaṃ na bhavati| 
‘pariṣiñcati' iti| sarvataḥ siñcatītyarthaḥ| athetyādi codyam|
varjanetyādi parīhāraḥ| apaśabdasāhacaryādityatartraivopapatiḥ| tatra
hi karmapravacanīyādhikārādvarjanārthasyāpaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ varjana eva|
tasya ṭhapaparī varjane' (1.4.88) iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā|
tasmātena sāhacaryādvarjanārthasya parorgrahaṇam| atastenāpi yoge
varjana eva viṣaya iyaṃ pañcamī vidhīyate, na lakṣaṇādiṣu||

91. abhirabhāge|(1.4.91)
‘yadatra māmābhiṣyāt' iti| ‘śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ|

93. adhiparī anarthakau|(1.4.93)
‘anarthāntaravācinau' iti|
#etenānarthāntaravācitvādanarthakādavityuktam, na tvarthābhāvāditi
darśayati| yadi hyavidyamānārthatvādanarthakau syātām, nirarthakamidaṃ

94.suḥ pujāyām|(1.4.94)

96. apiḥ padārthasambhāvanānvavasargagarhāsamuccayeṣu|(1.4.96)
‘padārthe' iti| anyasya padasyārtho lakṣyate| na svārthaḥ, nāpi
svasambandhinaḥ; padasyārthaḥ padārthaḥ. svapadārthagrahaṇaṃ,
svasambandhipadārthagrahaṇaṃ vā padārthagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| apiśabdasya
hi yo'rthaḥ yaścāpiśabdasambandhinaḥ syādityādeḥ padasya , sa padārtha
eveti kiṃ padārthagrahaṇena ? tasmāt
padārthagrahaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭapadasyārtho vijñāyata ityāha--
‘padāntarasya' ityādi| ‘sarpiṣo'pi syāt' iti|
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā nivartitatvāt
‘upasargaprādurbhyāmastiryacparaḥ' (8.3.ka87) iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati| atha
sarpiḥśabdādÂdvitīyā kathaṃ na bhavati ? apiśabdena tasya
yogāsambhavāt| sarpiṣo hi yā mātrā sā'piśabdena yuktā, na sarpiḥ|
mātrāśabdāt tarhi kasmānna bhavati ? tasya prayogābhāvāt| yadā tu
prayujyate, tadā karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaiva nāsti; aprayujyamānasya
padāntarasyārthe tadvidhānāt| ‘adhikārthavacanena' iti| adhikartho
mūlakasahasrasekādiḥ, tasya vacanena sekādāvarthe kriyāyāṃ

ca sāmarthyaṃ na vihanyata ityarthaḥ| ‘sambhāvane'lamiti cet
siddhāpyoge' (3.3.154) iti liṅ| ‘kāmacārābhyanujñānam' iti|
kamacāraḥ u iccchayā pravṛtiḥ, tasyābhaayanujñānaṃ kāmacārābhyanujñānam|
‘api siñca, api stuhi' iti| siñca vā stuhi vā

ubhayasarvatasoḥ kāryā dhiguparyādiṣu triṣu|
dvitīyāmreḍitānteṣu tato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate||(vā.118) 
ityupasaṃkhyānādÂdvitīyā| ‘api siñcetpalāṇḍum' iti| ṭharhe

97.adhirīśvare|(1.4.97)
‘tadayaṃ svasvāmisambandhe' iti| parilapālanādikriyājanito'tra
sambandhaḥ| ‘tatra' ityādi| sarvatra hi sambandhe kiñcidanūdyate,
kiñcidākhyāyate| yatprasiddhaṃ tadanūdyate, yadaprasiddhaṃ tadākhyāyate u
vidhīyate; jñāpyate; yathā-- yaḥ kuṇÃḍalī sa devadata iti|
kuṇḍalitvānuvādena devadatanuvādena devadatatvaṃ vidhīyate| yacca
vidhīyate tatpradhānam, itaradapradhānaṃ viśeṣamam| tatra yadā
svamaprasiddhatvādvidhīyate tadā svāmī pradhānatvādvayatirekamāpadyata iti
tata iva karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyuktatvādvyatirekanibandhanavibhakto
ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyāṃ tadapavādaḥ ṭhyasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra
saptamī' (2.3.9) iti saptamī bhavati| tayaiva sambandhasya dyotitatvāt
svāt prathamaiva bhavati, na saptamī| yadā tu svāmyaprasiddhatvāt
vidhīyate, tadā viparyayo veditavyaḥ||

98. vibhāṣā kṛñi| (1.4.98)
adhirīśvara iti vartate| tena prāpte vibhāṣeyam| adhipūrvaḥ
karotirviniyoge vartate| viniyuktasyaivaśvaryaṃ sampadyate| ṭhyadatra
māmadhikariṣyati' iti| māmiti karmaṇi dvitīyā| adhikariṣyatīti;
atra ṭhnipātairyadyadi' (8.1.30) ityādinā nighāte pratiṣiddhe'sya
prakṛtisvareṇādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati||

99. laḥ parasmaipadam| (1.4.99)
la iti prathamā vā syāt ? ṣaṣṭhī vā ? tatra yadi prathamā
syāllakārasyaiva parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāt, na tadādeśānāṃ
tibādīnām| kāmam, teṣamamapi sthānivadbhāvena syāt|
‘taṅanāvātmanepadam' (1.4.100)ityatra tu ṭhlaḥ' ityanena taṅanayoḥ
sambandho nopapadyeta, na hi taṅanau lau bhavataḥ| atra taṅanabhāvo
lakāra eva taṅanāvityevamabhihitaḥ| sāhacaryādvā lādeśau
taṅanāvava ṭhla' ityuktāviti vyākhyeyam| tathā ca
vyākhyānadvāreṇeṣṭārthapratiptau sādhyāyāṃ pratipatigauravaṃ syāt|
ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe tveṣa doṣo nāsti, atastamāśrityāha—‘laḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī'
ityādi| nanvayamapi pakṣo doṣavāneva, lādeśasya hi
parasmaipadasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā tiṅaṃ na syāt, teṣāṃ paratvāt
‘tiṅstrīṇi trīṇi' (1.4.101) ityādinā prathamapuruṣādisaṃjñayā
bhavitavyam| parasmaipadasaṃjñāyāstu śatṛkvasvoścāvakāsaḥ ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ ṭhsici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.2.1.) ityāha
tajjñāpayati-- bhavati ca tiṅaṃ parasmepadasaṃjñeti| sa hi parasmaipade
pare sici vidhīyate, na hi sijviṣaye śatṛkvasū sambhavataḥ|
‘tiptasjhi' ityādi rūpodāharaṇamātram||

100. taṅanāvatmanepadam|
‘katīha nighnānāḥ' iti| nipūrvoddhanteḥ ṭhtācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu

101. tiṅstrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamotamāḥ|
tiṅ iti prathamābahuvacanam| tiṅḥ saṃjñinaḥ kiṃbhutāḥ ? trīṇi
trīṇityevambhūtā ityarthaḥ| vacanāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ|
vīpsāyāñcaitadÂdvirjanam| yadi tiṅstrīṇi trīṇi vacanāni
prathamamadhyamotamapuruṣasaṃjñakāni bhavanti, evaṃ sati ṣaṭÂtrikāḥ
saṃjñinaḥ saṃjñāstitra iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti; vaiṣamyāt| tatra
yadyekasyānekasaṃjñāvidhānavaiyarthyādekā saṃjñā bhavet, na tvekaikasya
tisraḥ, tathāpi saivaikaikā bhavantītyavyavasthā vā syāt; naiṣa
doṣaḥ;iha hi parasmaipadagrahaṇamātmanepadagarhaṇañcānuvartate|
tadanuvṛtau ca dvau rāśī bhavataḥ- navānāṃ tiṅaṃ
parasmaipadasaṃjñakānāmeko rāśiḥ, tathā
nāvānāmātmanepadasaṃjñakānāṃ dvitīyaḥ| tatra prathame rāśau ye
trayastrikāḥ, ye ca dvitīye rāśau trayastrikāstairidaṃ sūtraṃ
pratyekamabhisambadhyate-- parasmaipadeṣu tiṅstrīṇi trīṇi
pthamamadhyamotamāḥ, tathātmanepadeṣu tiṅstrīṇi trīṇi
prathamamadhyamotamā iti| evaṃ hi sati na bhavati
saṃkhyātānudeśābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| tamevārthaṃ darśayitumāha--
‘tiṅe'ṣṭādaśa pratyayāḥ' iti| ‘nava' ityādinā rāśidvayaṃ darśayati|
‘tatra' ityādinā prathame rāśau ye trayastrikāstairasya sūtrasya sambandha#ṃ
karoti| ‘ātmanepadeṣu' ityādināpi dvitīye rāśau ye
trayastrikāstaiśca||

102. tānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ|
‘tāni' iti bahuvacanaṃ saṃjñāsamāveśārtham; anyathā hyaekasaṃjñādhikāre
sati vacanparāmāṇyāt puruṣavacanasaṃjñāḥ paryāyeṇa pravarteran|

vidhīyamānamāḍādikāryaṃ pākṣikaṃ syāt| asmiṃstu sati bhavati
saṃjñāsamāveśaḥ| taccchabdena hi trīṇi trīṇi labdhapuruṣasaṃjñakāni
tānyekavacanādisaṃjñakāni bhavantīti pratyavamṛśyante, tena yāni
labdhaprathamapuruṣādisaṃjñakāni tānyevaikavacanādisaṃjñakāni bhavanti|
nanu ca trikāṇāṃ prathamādisaṃjñaikaikasya caikavacanādisaṃjñā, tatra
viṣayabedādekasaṃjñādhikāre'pi virodho nāstyeveti; naiṣa

nāmānyastrikebhyo'sti; tasmāt tibādayastrakā eva saṃjñinaḥ|
trigrahaṇantu maryādārtham| tratvasaṃkhyāpariccchinnāstiṅḥ pratyekaṃ

103. supaḥ| (1.4.103) 
suviti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| prathamaikavacanāt suśabdādārabhya
saptamībahucanasya supaḥ pakāreṇa| atha kapaḥ pakāreṇāyaṃ pratyāhāra
kasmānna vijñāyate ? saptamībahuvacanasya pakārasya
vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| sa hyanudātārthaḥ syāt ? pratyāhārārtho vā ?
tatrānudātārtho na bhavati; anudātasya supatvādeva siddhatvāt| tatra
yadi pratyāhārārtho'pi na syāt tadāsyāpārthakatvameva syāt|
tasmāt tenaivāyaṃ pratyāhāro vijñāyate, na tu kapaḥ pakāreṇa;
svaravidhau tasya caritārthatvāt||

105.yuṣmadyaupapade samānādhikaraṇe sthāninyapi madhyamaḥ| (1.4.105) 
niyatārthametaditi darśayitumāha—‘lasyetyadhikṛtya' ityādi| etacca
niyamārthatve kāraṇam| satyārambho niyamārtho bhavati, nāsiddhe| sa
punarayaṃ niyama upapadārthaniyamo vā syāt-- tiṅe yuṣmadyaupapade
madhyama eva ? puruṣaniyamo vā syāt-- yuṣmadyevopapade madhyam iti
vā ? tatra yadi prathamo niyama āśrīyate, tvayā kurvatā tvayā
kurvāṇeneti yuṣmadyaupade lasya śatṛśānajādeśau na bhavataḥ| tasmāt
tadarthaṃ yatnāntaramāstheyam| itaratra tu na kiñcidyatnasādhyam, ato
dvitīyapakṣamāśrityāha—‘teṣāmayam' ityādi| vyavahite ca,
avyavahite ceti| nanu ca parasparaṃ sannikṛṣṭaṃ yatpadaṃ
tadupapadamucyate-- upoccāritaṃ padamiti kṛtvā;yacca vyavahitaṃ
tadavyavahitāpekṣayā viprakṛṣṭam, ato vyavahitena bhavitavyam,
naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāt sannikṛṣṭaṃ
viprakṛṣṭamityavyavasthitametadubhayagrahaṇam; sāpekṣatvāt
parāparavat| tatra yadyavyavahitamapekṣya vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ bhavati,
tathāpyanyadviprakṛṣṭataramapekṣya sannikṛṣṭaṃ bhavatītītaratra
vyavahitenāpi bhavitavyam| yadyevam, upapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ?
pūrvabhūte'pi yathā syādityevamartha kṛtam| anyathā ṭhyuṣmadi'
ityetāvatyucyamāne' tasminniti nirdiṣṭa#e pūrvasya' (1.1.66)iti
parabhūta eva yuṣmadi pūrvasya madhyamaḥ syāt, na tu pūrvabhūte
parasya| upapadagrahaṇādatrāpi bhavati| pūrveṇa pareṇāpi
prayujyamānamupapadaṃ bhavatyeva|
‘samānādhikaraṇe' ityanena samānābhidheya iti
vyācakṣāṇo'yamadhikaraṇaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ sūtra upāta iti
darśayati| tatpunarabhidheyaṃ yatra lakāra utpadyate kartari karmaṇi vā
kārake pratyāsatestadeva vijñāyate ityāha—‘tulyakārake' ityādi|
tulyaṃ kārakaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| tulyaśabdena samānaśabdasyārtho
darśitaḥ| ‘prayujyamāne'prayujyamāne'pi' iti| anena
sthāninyapītyasyārthamācaṣṭe| sthānaśabdaḥ prasaṅgavācī--
sthānamasyāstīti sthānī| kasya ca sthānam ? tasyaiva sthānamasti
yasyārtho gamyate, śabdo na prayujyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--
aprayujyamāne'pi yuṣmadi, apiśabdāt prayujyamāne'pi|
samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇaṃ kim ? ṭhtvayā pacyate' ityatra mā bhūt, bhinnaṃ
hyadhikaraṇam| tathā hi—‘tvayā' ityetat kartṛvāci; kartari
tṛtīyāvidhānāt| ‘pacyate' iti karmavāci; karmaṇi
lakāravidhānāt||

106. prahāse ca manyopapade manyaterutama ekavacca|(1.4.106) 
‘prahāse gamyamāne' iti| yatra bhūtārthābhāvādvañcanaiva kevalaṃ tatra
vakturabhiprayāviṣkaraṇena prahāso gamyate| ‘manyopapade'
iti|manyatirupapadamupoccāritaṃ padaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| madhyamasya
dhātorvidhānāt dhāturanyapādratho vijñāyata ityāha—‘dhātoḥṭa iti|
‘sa caikavat' iti| yatra dvau mantārau bahavo vā
tatrāyamekavadbhāvo vidhīyate| anyatra tu manturekatvādevaikavacanaṃ
siddham| ‘madhyamotamayoḥ' iti| yathākramaṃ yuṣmadasmadorupapadayoḥ
samānādhikaraṇayoraprayujyamānayorapyarthasya vidyamānatvāt| yathā
pratyudāharaṇe pūrvakamupapadagrahaṇaṃ
yuṣmaccchabdenābhisambaddhamihānuvarteteti
tanmanyatinā'śakyamabhisambandhṛmiti punarupapadagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|
manyateriti śyanā nirdeaśaḥ, ityasya tānādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā
bhūdatyevamarthaḥ| tenenaha na bhavati-- ehi manuṣe rathena yāsyāmi na
hi yāsyasi yātastena te piteti| evaṃ hi manoterbhavati||

107. asmadyautamaḥ| (1.4.107)
yadā yuṣdasmadī dve apyete upapade staḥ, tadā kathaṃ bhavitavyam ?

109. paraḥ sannikarṣaḥ saṃhitā| (1.4.109)
‘paraśabdo'tiśaye vartate' iti| yathā paraṃ duḥkhamiti| etana
paraśabdola digādiṣvapyartheṣu vartate, tathāpīhātiśaye vartamānasya
tasya grahaṇamita darśayati| sannikarṣaḥ u pratyāsatiḥ, saṃśleṣaśca| tatreha
pratyāsatirgṛhyata iti darśayannāha—‘sannikarṣaḥ pratyāsatiḥ' iti|
saṃśleṣastu na gṛhyate, tasya varṇeṣvasambhavāt| saṃśleṣo hyaekakālānāṃ
bhavati, na ca varṇāmāmekakālatāpatiḥ;
krameṇoccāritvāduccaritapradhvaṃsitatvāt| saṃśleṣo hyaekakālānāṃ
bhavati, na ca varṇānāmekakālatāpatiḥ;
krameṇoccāritvāduccaritapradhvaṃsatatvāt| satyāmapi caikakālatāyāṃ
na sambhavatyeva varṇānāṃ saśleṣaḥ| tathā hi-- saṃśleṣaḥ saṃyogato vā
syāt, samavāyato vā; tatra pūrvako dravyasyaiva syāt, na tu
śabdasya-- nirguṇā guṇā iti kṛtvā| itaro'pi naiva śabdasya
sambhavati, na hi varṇo varṇe samavaiti; śabdasyākāśasamavāyitvāt| na
ca saṃyogasamavāyayoratiśayaḥ sambhavati; sarvatraikarupakatvāt| tathā
ca ṭhparaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate| pratyāsatistvapekṣākṛtabhedāt
prakarṣāprakarṣābhyāṃ prayujyamānāparagrahaṇena viśiṣyata iti yuktaṃ tasya
viśeṣaṇatvam | kaḥ punarasau paraḥ sannikṛṣṭān varṇānuccārayati
vaktari pūrvasya varṇasya ye niṣpādakāstālvādayasteṣāṃ
vyāpāroparatau varṇāntarasya ca ye niṣpādakāstālvādayasteṣāṃ
vyāpāropadeśanamarddhamātrākālamāhuḥ| sa varṇānāṃ vyavadhānaḥ u
vyavadhāyako yasmin so'rddhamātrākālavyavadhānaḥ sannikarṣaḥ| yadi
varṇānāmarddhamātrākālavyavadhānaḥ sannikarṣaḥ,kathaṃ tarhi dadhyatretyādau
vayavadhāyakakālo nopalakṣyate,varṇāḥ saṃśliṣṭā evopalabhyante ?
naitat; kimarthaṃ punaretadārabhyate, yāvatā parameva sannikarṣaṃ
saṃhiteti vadantyācāryāḥ, tathā hi saṃhitāmadhīṣvetyukte paraṃ
sannikarṣamevādhīte śiṣyaḥ ? naitadevam; padasya padāntareṇa
yadānantaryaṃ sā saṃhiteti loke'bhidhīyate | tathā ca vaktāro
vadanti-- saṃhitāmadhīte na padāni, padānyadhīte na saṃhitāmiti|
tathā caikapade hi saṃhitākāryaṃ na syāt, ṭhiko yaṇaci'(6.1.77) iti--
kumāryau, kurmārya iti| sati hyasmin varṇānāṃ
sannikarṣaviśeṣasyānena saṃhitāsaṃjñā vidhīyata ita sarvatraiva
bhavati|||

110. virāmo'vasānam| (1.4.110)
‘viratirvirāmaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ| virāmo
vaṇoccāraṇābhāvo'vasānasaṃjño bhavati| ‘viramyate'neneti
virāmaḥ' iti virāmaśabdasya dvitīyamarthaṃ darśayati| ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo
bahulam' (3.3.13) iti bahulavacanādasaṃjñāyāmapi ṭhhalaśca' (3.3.121)
iti ghañ| atra pakṣe yenāntyena varṇena viramyate so'vasānasaṃjño
bhavati| tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe'bhāve paurvāparyābhāvāt
‘kharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15) ityatrāvasānāpekṣayā viṣayasaptamīyaṃ
vijñāyate; na parasamaptamī| kharapekṣayā tu saptamīyam|
anye tu-- yadyabhāve paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavatītyavasanāpekṣayā
‘kharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15) iti parasaptamī nopapadyate, tadā ṭhiko
yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityādāvapi parasaptamī nopapadyate| katham ? varṇānāṃ
kramabhāvitvāt, uccaritapradhvaṃsitatvācca| yadegasti tadāñ nāsti,
yadā tvajasti tadeg nāsti| athātra buddhiprakalpitaṃ
paurvāparyamāśritya parasaptamīṣyate, tadā ṭhkharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15)
ityatrāpitathaivaiṣṭavyeti manyamānā avasānāpekṣayāpi
parasaptamīmiccchanti|
apare tu--antyasya tu varṇasyāvasānasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṭhkharavasānayoḥ'
(8.3.15) iti ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate| atrāvasānāpakṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī|
rephasyāvasānasya visarjanīya iti kharapekṣayā tavānantaryalakṣaṇā
ṣaṣṭhīti vadanti| tanmate sthānaṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ hi ṭhro ri' (8.3.14) ityato
rephasyānuvṛtasya yat sthānitvaṃ tadavirudhyate tadevamekāpi
vibhaktiryathāyogaṃ vibhajyate| nanu cābhāvapakṣe'pi pūrvasminnapi
bhāge'nuccāramamasti, tatrāpi visarjanīyaḥ prāpnoti-- ratha iti,
asti hyatrāpi rephāt prāguccāraṇam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ tatra hi prakṛtaṃ
padagrahaṇaṃ repheṇa viśiṣyate-- rephāntasya padasyeti| na ca pūrveṇa
repheṇa padaṃ bhavati| nanvevapyarthasyaiṣā saṃjñā syāditi
‘kharavasanāyoḥ' (8.3.15) ityatra ṭhtasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66)
iti paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| śabde hi saptamīnirdiṣṭe
satīyamupatiṣṭhate, nārthe| tadanupasthāne ca pareṇa repheṇa
rephāntasya ratha ityetasya padasya pūrvo yo rephastasya vyavahitasyāpi
visarjanīyaḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; jñāpakānna bhaviṣyati, yadayaṃ ṭhuraṇ
raparaḥ' (1.1.51) iti vyavahitasya rephasya visarjanīyamakṛtvā nirdeaśaṃ
karoti, tajjñāpayati- vyavahitasya rephasya visarjanīyo na
bhavatīti| 
‘nanvatra loke prasiddherevāyantye varṇe'vasānaśabdasya sampratyayo
bhaviṣyati| prasiddho hi loke--antye varṇe'vasyateḥ prayogaḥ| tathā hi
kenāvasyatītyukte vaktāro vadanti-- ikāreṇokāreṇa veti|
ikārādivarṇenāvasānaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| tataḥ pradeśa evāvasānagrahaṇaṃ
kartavyamiti nārthaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñipraṇanena, naitadasti; apūrvo hi syatiḥ
parisamāptāvapi vartate-- avasito vāda iti, avagame'pi vartate--
avasito'rtha iti, parābhave'pi vartate--dvayorvivāde'vasito
davadata iti| tatra yadīyaṃ nārabhyate, tadāvasānagraṇe sandehaḥ syāt--
kimabhidhānāvasānaśabdasya grahaṇamiti ? ṭhvirāmo'vasānam' (1.4.110)
iti tu hyantagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam-- kharantyayoriti ? etadapi nāsti; evaṃ
hi sandehaḥ syāt-- kimantyasya varṇasya ? uta padasya?
āhosvadvākyasyeti ? tatrāntyasya viśeṣaṇārthaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ
syāt| tasmāt saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaḥ kartavyaḥ|
‘vṛkṣaḥ, plakṣaḥ' iti| ‘kharavasanāyorvisarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.15)| ṭhdadhiṃ madhuÄ'
iti| ‘aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsika' (8.4.57) iti| atra hi
‘vā'vasāne'(8.4.56) ityato'vasānagrahaṇamanuvartate||
iti śrībodhisatvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ 
kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ
prathamādhyāyasya
caturthaḥ pādaḥ 
samāptaścāyaṃ prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||

dvitīyādhyāyasya

1.samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ| (2.1.1)
ṭhparibhāṣeyam' iti| parito vyāpṛtā bhāṣā u paribhāṣā| tathā
coktam-- ṭhparibhāṣā punarekasthā sarva śāstramabhijvalayati, yathā--
vaśmapradīpaḥ'| kutaḥ punaretadvijñāyate-- paribhāṣeyam, nādhikāra
iti ? padavidhigraṇālliṅgāt | utaratra hi sarvaḥ
parāṅgavadbhāvādiranukarasyamānaḥ padavidhireva| tatra yadyamadhikāraḥ
syāt, padavidhigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; vayāvartyābhāvāt|
paribhāṣāyāṃ tvasyām, paribhāṣā hyaekadeśasyāpi sarvatra śāstre
vyāpriyata ityasati padavidhigrahaṇe varṇavidhāyavapyupatiṣṭheta| tato
varṇavidhinirāsārtha kriyamāṇaṃ padavidhigrahaṇamarthavadbhavati|
tasmāt padividhagrahaṇālliṅgāt paribhāṣeyaṃ nādhikāra
ityavasīyate| yadyavam, ṭhisusoḥ sāmarthye' (8.3.44) , ṭhna
cavāhāhaivayukte' (8.1.24) ityevamādiṣu yogeṣu sāmarthyagrahaṇaṃ
yuktagrahaṇañca kimarthaṃ kriyate, yāvatā ṭhpadasya' iti tatrānuvartate,
tatra padavidhitvādevāsāmarthye na bhaviṣyati ? satyametat; yadarthaṃ
tu kriyate tat tatraiva pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ|
vidhiśabdo'yamastyeva bhāvasādhanaḥ-- vidhānaṃ vidhiriti| asti ca
karmasādhanaḥ-- vidhīyata iti vidhiḥ| tatra bhāvasādhane vidhiśabda
āśrīyamāṇe padānāmapariniṣpannānāṃ pariniṣpādanaṃ padavidhiriti
padeṣu karmaṇi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī; teṣāṃ vidhinā sambandhāt|
karmasādhane tu pariniṣpannānāṃ vyavasthitānāmeva padānāṃ
yatsamāsādi kāryaṃ vidhīyate sa padividhiḥ| tatra padeṣu ca
śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati; vidhīyamānasya kāryasya
padasambandhitvenopādānāt| tatra yadīha bhāvasādhano vidhiśabda
āśrīyeta tadā vibhaktividhānameva saṅgṛhītaṃ syāt,samāsa--
parāṅgavadbhāva--taddhitavṛtyādikaṃ na saṅgṛhyaetaca na hi tatra
padānāmasatāṃ vidhānam; kiṃ tarhi ? vyavasthitānāmeva padānāṃ
samāsādi kāryaṃ vidhīyate| itaratra tu vidhiśabda āśrīyamāṇe te'pi
saṅgṛhītā bhavantīti manyamānaḥ karmasādhanaṃ vidhiśabdamāśrityāha--
ṭhvidhīyata iti vidhiḥ' iti| nanu cātrāpi pakṣe vibhaktividhānaṃ na
saṅgṛhyaeta, na hi ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādiśāstreṇa
vyavasthitānāṃ padānāṃ kiñcit kāryaṃ vidhīyate, api tu padānyeva
vidhīyante ? yadi na saṅgṛhītaṃ syānna nāma| na ca tadasaṅgrahe
kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata ityutaratra pratipādayiṣya#amaḥ| ṭhsamāsādiḥ' iti|
ādiśabdena taddhitavṛtyādīnāṃ grahaṇam|
ṭhsamarthaḥ śaktaḥ' iti| svakāryanirvartanakṣama ityarthaḥ| sa hi loke
samartha ityucyate| svārthapratipādanameva śabdānāṃ svakāryam| ye
ceha laukikā vaidikāśca śabdā adhikṛtāste sarve eva
svakāryapratipādanaṃ prati samarthāḥ| tasmāt ṭhsamarthaḥ' ita
viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādviśeṣaḥ kaścidāśrīyate| sa ca viśeṣaḥ--
vṛtyarthaṃ yadvākyamupādīyate, pratyāsatestadarthapratipādane yā śaktatā
tallakṣamo vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhvigrahavākyarthābhidhāne' ityādi|
viśeṣeṇa gṛhyate vijñāyate'neneti vigrahaḥ, vigrahaśca tadvākyam| atha
vā-- viśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ vigrahaḥ, vigrahārthaṃ yadvākyaṃ tadvigrahavākyam|
śākapārthivāditvānmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ| vigrahavākyasyārtho
vigrahavākyārthaḥ, tadabhidhāne tatpratyāyane yaḥ śaktaḥ sa samartho
veditavyaḥ, yathā-- rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ samasāḥ, etadarthaṃ yadvākyaṃ rājñaḥ
puruṣa iti tasya yo'rthastadabhidhāne rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ śabdaṃ śaktaḥ;
tato'pi tadarthasya pratīteḥ| sa punararthaḥ-- saṃsargaḥ,
bhedaśca;bhedasaṃsargau vā|tatra svaviśeṣasya svāmiviśesya
svāmiviśeṣeṇa yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa ṭhsaṃsargaḥ' ākhyāyate| svāntarasya
svāmyantarebhyaḥ, svāmyatarasya svātantarebhyaśca vyāvṛtiḥ ṭhbhedaḥ'
ākhyāyate|

tatra saṃsargavādino mate saṃsarga eva śabdārthaḥ,
vyāvṛtistvarthasaṃgṛhītā| na hyavyāvartyasaṃgṛhītā| na
hyavyāvartyamānayoḥ svasvāminoḥ sambandhyantarebhyaḥ saṃsarga upapadyate|
bhedavādinastu vyāvṛtirava śabdārthaḥ, saṃsargo'rthasaṅgṛhītaḥ; na
hi vyāvartyamānasya sambandhyantareṇāsambaddhasya
svāmyāderavasthānamasti| ubhayavādinastu ubhaya eva śabdārthaḥ| yadi
vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne yaḥ śaktaḥ sa samartho vijñāyeta, evaṃ sati
samāsataddhitaviṣayameva sāmarthyāmiti
parāṅgavadbhāvavibhaktividhānayoriyaṃ paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭheta; na
hi tatra vigrahavākyārthābhidhānamasti ? yadi nopatiṣṭheta, na nāma; na
ca tadanupasthāne kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyeta| tathā hi-- parāṅgavadbhāve
tāvannimitagrahaṇaṃ deśayiṣyati bhāṣyakāraḥ| tatra ca nimitasya
nimitinā sāmarthyamastyeva-- madrāṇāṃ rājan, paraśunā vṛścanniti|
vibhaktividhāne'pi yāstāvat kārakavibhaktayastā yeṣveva kārakeṣu
karmādiṣu vidhīyante teṣāṃ kriyayā sambandho'styeva|
upapadavibhaktiṣvapi ṭhsahayukte'pradhāne' (2.3.19) ityevamādiṣu
yuktagrahaṇādīni santi, tatrāpi sāmarthyamastyeva| tatraivaṃ sambandhe
sati vibhaktaya iṣyante, na tu va#grihavākyārthābhidhānalakṣaṇasāmarthye|
evaṃ tāvanmukhyārthavṛtiḥ samarthaśabdo darśitaḥ|
idānīmupacaritavṛtiṃ darśayitumāha-- ṭhatha vā' ityādi| samarthāni
padānyāśrayo yasya sa samarthapadāśrāyaḥ; tadbhāvaḥ
samarthapadāśrayatvam| tato hetoḥ samāsādiḥ samartha ucyate| āśrayasya
samarthatvādupacāreṇāśrito'pi tatheti vyapadiśyate; kāraṇadharmasya
kārya upacārāt, yathā-- naḍÂvalodakaṃ pādarogaḥ| ṭhsamarthānām'
ityanena vākye vyapadeśalakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyamāha| tathā hi ṭhrājñaḥ puruṣaḥ'
ityatra vākye rājā puruṣamapekṣate -- mamāyamiti, puruṣo'pi
rājānamapekṣate-- ahamasyeti| ṭhsaṃsṛṣṭārthānām' ityanena samāse
padānāmekārthībhāvanalakṣamaṃ sāmarthyaṃ darśayati| ekārthībhāvaśca
pṛthagavasthitānāṃ bhinnārthānāṃ padānāṃ samāse sādhāraṇārthatā
nāmāvasthāviśeṣaḥ| vākye hi sādhāraṇārthatā nāsti; bhinnārthatvāt|
ata eva tatra bhedanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhÂayupajāyate-- rājñaḥ puruṣa iti|
vṛtau tūbhayapadavyavaccchinārthābhidhānat sādhāraṇārthatā bhavati|
etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati-- samāse hi viśeṣaṇaṃ
viśeṣyamanupraviśatyekārthī bhavati viśeṣyeṇa saraha, vākye hi
viśeṣamaṃ viśeṣyāt pṛthagavatiṣṭhata iti| yasminnasati, vākye
rājño gauścāśvaśca puruṣaśceti bhedanibandhanasamuccayapratipādanāya
caśapabda prayujyate| samāse tu yasmin sati sa nivartate rājño
gavāśvapuruṣā ityayamekārthībhāvo veditavyaḥ| ṭhpaśya devadata kaṣṭam,
śrito viṣṇumitro gurukulam' iti| atra kaṣṭaśabdasya paśyetyanena
sambandhaḥ; na tu śritaśabdana; tena sāmarthyābhāvātsamāso na bhavati|
nanu ca śritādīnāṃ śrutatvātaireva dvitīyāṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ--
śritādīnāṃ sambandhinī yā dvitīyeti śakyate vyapadeṣṭam ḥ asati
tu tasmin, dvitīyāmātraṃ śritādibhiḥ samasyata iti vijñāyate| evaṃ
sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ syādeva-- mahat kaṣṭaṃ śrita iti, bhavati hyatra
śritādinimitā dvitīyā| tasmāt samarthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| ṭhkiṃ tvaṃ
kariṣyasi saṅkulayā, khaṇḍo devadata upalena' iti| atropalena
tṛtīyāntena kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanam| atastatkṛtatvamastīti prāpnoti
samāsaḥ; samarthagrahamānna bhavati| samarthagrahaṇe tu satyayamartho bhavati--
yasyaiva tṛtīyāntasya samāsastenaiva yadi kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamiti| na ceha
tatkṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamato na bhavati samāsaḥ|
evamanyatrāpyasāmarthyādasamāso veditavyaḥ|
2.subāmantrite parāṅgavatsvare| (2.1.2)
ṭhparasyāṅgavat' iti| atrāṅgavaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| parsayāṅgavat
paraikadeśavadbhavati| tadÂgrahaṇena gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| evaṃ
tādātmyātideśo'yaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhtādātmyātideśo'yam'
iti| tādātmyam u tatsabhāvatvam| ṭhsubantam' ityādinā tameva
tādātmyātideśaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| ṭhsubantamāmantritamanupraviśati'
iti| tatrāntarbhavatītyarthaḥ| ṭhkuṇḍenāṭan' iti| atra kuṇḍaśabdokāra
āmantritasvaraḥ| evamanyatrāpi sasupkasyāmantritasya svaro veditavyaḥ|
ṭhpīḍaḷe pīḍaḷmāna' iti| he pīḍaḷmāna tvadīyayā pīḍayā'haṃ pīḍaḷe,
bādhye'hamityarthaḥ| ṭhpīḍa avagāhane' (dhā.pā.1544), curādiṇic,

śānac, sārvadhātuke yak, ṇilopaḥ,
ṭhtāsyanudātenṅdidupadeśāllasārvadhātumanudātamahanviṅeḥ'
(6.1.186) itīṭo'nudātatvam, yakaḥ pratyayasvareṇādyaudātatvam, yakaḥ
pratyayasarveṇādyaudātatvam, ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' (ra8.2.5)
ityekāra udātaḥ| pīḍaḷmānetyasya tu ṭhpīḍaḷ' ityasyāt padādutarasya
ṭhāmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) iti nighātaḥ| ṭhgehe gārgyaḥ' iti|
gehaśabda uñchādipāṭhādantodātaḥ, saptamyekādeśaḥ pūrvavadudātaḥ,
gārgya iti ñtsareṇādyaudātaḥ| pṛthaksvara evātra bhavati| ṭhdevadata
kuṇḍenāṭan' iti| yadi paragrahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā devadataśabdaṃ
pūrvamapyāmantritaṃ prati subantasyānupraveśaḥ syāt, tataśca
devadataśabdāt padātparasyāṭannityetasya ṭhāmantritasya ca'(8.1.19) iti

devadatetyāmantritasvareṇādyaudātaḥ| evaṃ kuṇeḍanāṭannityapi|
āmantritanighāto'tra na bhavati; pādāditvāt| ṭhyathā mṛtpiṇḍībhūtaḥ

śāstarātideśa-vyapadeśātideśānāmanyatamaḥ syāt| tathā ca sati
yathā parasya kāryamādyaudātatvamāmantritavyadeśa ādyaudātaśāstraṃ ca; tathā
subantasya pūrvasyāpi syāditi,tataścobhayorapyādyaudātatvaṃ syāt|

na bhavatyubhayorādyaudātatvaprasaṅgaḥ| ṭhsvāśrayamapi kāryaṃ yathā syāt'
(iti)| ṭhāma kuṇḍenāṭan' ityatra aṭannityetasya padātparasya
ṭhāmantritasya' (8..19) iti nighāte prāpte ṭhna luṭ' (8.1.29) ityato
netyanuvartamāne ṭhāma ekāntaratāyā abhāvāt| parameva hi syāt
subantamasata#vitkaraṇe, na ca tathābhūtenaikāntaratā yuktā| vatkaraṇe
tu sati, bhavati kadācit svāśrayamapyanaṅgatvamityupapadyata
ekāntaratā, tena nighātapratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| tatrāyaṃ svaravibhāgaḥ--
āmityasya nipātasvareṇādyaudātatvam| kuṇḍaśabdasyāpi

bhavitavyam| ṭhkūpe siñcan' iti| atra parāṅgavadbhāvo nāstīti

ṣatvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt| ṭhcarma naman' iti| atrāpi

prāpnotitayupasaṃkhyāyate| ṭhtīkṣṇayā sūcyā sīvyan' ityatra

parāṅgavādādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati| ṭhuccairadhīyāna' iti| uccaiḥ śabdasya

3. prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ| (2.1.3)
ṭhyathāvṛddham' iti| atra samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām ṭhkṛtaddhitasamāsāśca '
(1.2.46) ityevamādi kāryaṃ bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ prāgvacanam ? yāvatā
pañcamīnidçaśādeva prāgityasyādhyāhāro bhaviṣyati; na ca
parāgityayamapi dikcchabdo'sti, atastasyāpyadhyāhāraḥ
syādityaśaṅkanīyam, tadadhyāhāre kaḍārasaṃśabdanāt pare
ye'nukraṃsyante teṣāṃ samāsasaṃjñā syāt; tathā ca
kaḍārasaṃśabdanādanantarameva samāsādhikāraṃ kuryāt, iha tu kṛtaḥ,
tasmādiha karaṇasāmarthyāt samāsādhikārasya prāgityasyādhyāhāro
bhaviṣyati, tato nārthaḥ prāgvacanenetyāha-- ṭh prāgvacanam' ityādi|
utaratrāvyayībhāvādisaṃjñābhiḥ saha samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ samāveśo yathā
syādityevamartha prāgvacamanam| asati tu tasmin,
tābhiranavakāśābhiriyaṃ saṃjñāla bādhyeta| asyāstu samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ
ṭhsaha supā' (2.1.4) ityatra saheti yogavibhāgena yaḥ samāsaḥ krite
so'vakāśaḥ syāt-- anuprāvarṣat, anuvyacaladiti, tiṅntenātra
samāsaḥ; asatyapi sāvakāśatva ekasaṃjñādhikāre vacanapramāṇyāt
paryāyeṇa vṛtiḥ syāt, na tu samāveśaḥ| sākṣāt sūtreṇopāte tu
prāgvacane sati bhavati samāveśaḥ, katham? evaṃ hi sambandhaḥ kriyate--
kaḍārāt prāgyāvanto vyavasthitaḥ sarve te samāsasaṃjñakā bhavanti,
samāsasaṃjñakāḥ santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñāṃ labhanta ita| tena
nimitameva samāsasaṃjñā'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñānām| naca nimitinā
nimitaṃ vihanyate; anyathā tasya nimitatvameva na syāditi yuktaḥ
sūtropātena prāgvacanena samāveśaḥ| adhyāhṛte tu tasmin
ṭhkaḍārasaṃśabdanātprāgyāvanto vyavasthitāḥ sarve te samāsasaṃjñakā
bhavanti' ityeṣo'rtho labhyate, na tu ṭhsamāsasaṃjñakāḥ
santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñakāḥ' ityeṣo'pi| sākṣāt sūtropāte tu
tasminneṣo'pi labhyate; anyathā tasya sūtre sākṣādupādānamanarthakaṃ
syāt||

4. saha supā| (2.1.4)
ṭhsahagrahaṇaṃ yogavibhāgārtham' iti; nanu cāsati tasminnekaikasya
saṃjñā syāt, tataśca ṛkpāda ityatra ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ pathāmānakṣe'
(5.4.74) ityatrākāraḥ samāsāntaḥ syāt; iha ca ṭhrājāśvaḥ' ityatra
ṭhsamāsasya' (6.1.223) iti dvau svarau syātām, sahabhūtayoreva
samāsasaṃjñā yathā syādekaikasya mā bhūdityevamartha sahagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna
vijñāyate ? evaṃ manyate-- supeti tṛtīyaiva sahārtha gamayati, yathā
ṭhvṛddho yūnā' (1.2.65) iti| samāsaṭa iti ca mahatī saṃjñā kriyate--
anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeteti| kathaṃ nāmānvarthasaṃjñā kriyate ?
samasanam u samāsaḥ, saṃkṣepa ityarthaḥ| saṃkṣepaścānekavastuviṣayaḥ|
tenāsatyapi sahetasmin sahabhūtayoreva samāsasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| ṭhna
pratyekam' iti| ṭhanuvyacalat' iti| tiṅntenātra samāsaḥ| atra
ṭhtiṅṅtiṅḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāte kṛte samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ
tannibandhanamantodātatvaṃ bhavati||

5. avyayībhāvaḥ| (2.1.5)
ṭhyathāvṛddham' ityatrāvyayībhāvatve sati ṭhavyayībhāvaśca' (2.4.18) iti
napuṃsakatve ṭhnāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) ityeṣa
vidhirbhavati| ṭhanvarthasaṃjñā ceyam' iti| anavyayamavyayaṃ
bhavatītyavyayībhāvaḥ| ṭhpūrvapadārthaprādhānyam' ityādinā
anvarthasaṃjñāyāḥ phalamāha| prāyeṇa hyavyayībhāve pūrvapadamavyayam,
parapadamanyavyayam; samudāyo nāvyayamÂ| sa yadi pūrvapadavaśena
tasya pūrvapadasya yo dharmo'vyayatvaṃ tatpratipadyate
tato|ñanavyayasvabhāvaḥ sannavyayasvabhāvo bhavati| evañca pūrvapadavaśena
taddharmaṃ pratipadyate yadi pūrvapadaṃ pradhānaṃ bhavati, nānyathā|
pradhānavaśena hi vastunaḥ svadharmaparityāgena dharmāntarāpatiryuktā|
tadevamanvarthasaṃjñeyaṃ bhavantī pūrvapadārthaprādhānyamavyayībhāvasya
darśayati| tena yadā pūrvapadārthasya prādhānyaṃ bhavati tadāvyayībhāvo
bhavati, nānyathetyuktaṃ bhavati||

7. yathā'sādṛśye| (2.1.7)
ṭhye ya vṛddhāḥ' ityanena ṭhyathāvṛddham' ityatra yathāśabdo vīpsāyāṃ
vartata ityācaṣṭe| ṭhyathā devadatastathā yajñadataḥ' iti| devadatasadṛśo
yajñadata ityarthaḥ| nanu ca yathāśabdo'yamupamānaṃ ṭhyajñadata'
ityupameyamapekṣate| tatra ṭhsāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavati' ityasāmarthyādeva
samāso na bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthamasādṛśya iti pratiṣedhena ?
naitadasti; na hyatra yathāśabda upamānam, kiṃ tarhi ? ṭhyathā devadataḥ'
ityeṣa samudāyaḥ| tasmāt tasyaivopameyāpekṣayā'sāmarthyam, na tu
yathāśabdasya||

8. yāvadavadhāraṇe| (2.1.8)
ṭhiyatāparicchedaḥ'iti| iyato bhāva iyatā u parimāṇam, tasyāḥ
paricchedo niścayaḥ| ṭhyāvanti pātrāṇi' ityādinā
tameveyatāparicchedaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| ṭhnāvadhārayāmi' ityādinā
iyatāparicchedābhāvaṃ darśayati||

9. suppratinā mātrārthe| (2.1.9)
ṭhvṛkṣaṃ prati' ityatra lakṣaṇe pratiśabdo vartate, na mātrārthe| nanu paraṃ
subgrahaṇaṃ kamarthaṃm ? yāvatā ṭhsubāmantrite' (2.1.2) ityataḥ
subgrahaṇamatuvartiṣyata ityata āha-- ṭhsubgrahaṇam' ityādi|
subgrahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ hyavyayena sambaddham; atastadanuvṛtau
tasyāpyanuvṛtiḥ syāt| tasmādavyayanivṛtyarthamidamanyata
subgrahaṇaṃ kriyate||

10. akṣaśalākāsaṃkhyāḥ pariṇā| (2.1.10)
ṭhkitavyavahāre' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ kitavavyavahāra iṣyamāṇe'pi tatra
labhyate ? svabhāvata eva; samāsasya tatra vṛteḥ|na hyarthā atidiśyante,
laukikatvāt teṣām| ṭhtasya' ityādi| tasya pātayitustasya ca
vipāta ityanena sambandhaḥ| vipātaḥ u parājayaḥ| ṭhetasya' iti|
akṣādereva pratyavamarśaḥ| abhedavivakṣāyāmekavacanam| etasyānayathā
pāta ityanena sambandhaḥ| ṭhanyathā' iti| jaye ya uktaḥ
pātaprakārastadapekṣayā'nyathātvaṃ vivakṣitam| ṭhpañcasu tvekarūpāsu
jaya eva bhavati' iti| pañcaparīti samaso na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| jaye hi
yadakṣādīnāṃ vṛtaṃ tadapekṣayānyapātatve sati samāsena bhavitavyam|
na ca pañcasvekarūpāsvanyathātvaṃ sambhavati| ata eva jayastadā bhavati
yadā pañcāpyekarūpā bhavanti-- utānā avāñco vā| etena prakāreṇa
ṭhpareṇa catuṣpari' ityatropapatirdarśitā| ṭhpareṇa' iti|
atiśayenetyarthaḥ|
ṭhakṣādayastṛtīyāntāḥ' ityādi| anyathā vṛtāvayaṃ samāsa iṣyate| tatra
cākṣādināmanyathāvṛtau kartṛtvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ vā bhavati,
atastṛtīyayā bhavitavyamiti tadantā eva samasyante | ṭhpūrvoktasya'
iti| akṣāderityarthaḥ| kuta etat ? akṣādayastṛtīyāntā iti
pūrvamakṣāderevoktatvāt| abhedavivakṣāyāmekavacanam| ṣaṣṭhī ceyaṃ
śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ vṛtaśabdāpekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇā,
vṛtaśabdastvadhyāhartavyaḥ| ṭhyathā na tat' iti| akṣādeḥ pūrvoktasya yathā
vṛtamabhūt pūrvaṃ jaye tathā vṛtaṃ yadi samprati na bhavatyevaṃ samāso
bhavati , nānyathā| pūrvavṛtasyānyathātvadyotane samāso'yam,
taccaikenāpi kriyate, tato dvivacanādyapekṣayā niṣprayojanamityāha--
ṭhekatve'kṣaśalākayoḥ' iti| akṣaśalākayorekavacanāntayorityarthaḥ|
tato'yaṃ nyāyasiddha evārthaḥ ślokena saṃgṛhītaḥ|
atha vā-- utaraṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇamihāpi siṃhāvalokitanyāyena
sambadhyate| sā ca vyavasthivibhāṣā| tena vacanasiddha evāyamartho
veditavyaḥ| akṣādaya iti kim ? pāśakenedaṃ na tathāvṛtaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ
jaye| pariṇeti kimÂ ? subantamātreṇa saha samāso mā bhūt|
kitavavyavahāra iti kim ? akṣābhyāmakṣairvā na tathā vṛtaṃ yatā pūrvaṃ
jaye||

11.vibhāṣā| (2.1.11)

12. apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā| (2.1.12)
ṭhnanu bahiḥ śabdayoge na kenacitpañcamī vidhīyate, tatkathaṃ
tadantena samāsa ityāha-- ṭhbahiḥ śabdayoge' ityādi| yadetat
pañcamyantena saha bahiḥ śabdasya samāsavidhānam, tajjñāpayati- bhavati
hi bahiḥ śabdayoge pañcamīti| athopādānasāmarthyāt bahiḥ
śabdayoge pañcamī na sambhavatītyapañcamyantenaiva subantamātreṇa
samāsa ityevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? aśakyametadvijñātum;
pañcamīgrahaṇasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| tathā hi ṭhapapari varjane'
(1.4.88) ityevamapaparyoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tābhyāṃ
yoge ṭhpañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' (2.310) iti pañcamyaiva bhavitavyam;
nānyathā vibhaktyā| ṭhañcuśabdenāpi yoge' ṭhanyārāt' (2.3.29)
ityādinā pañcamyaiva bhavitavyamityapārthakaṃ pañcamīgrahaṇaṃ syāt.
nanu cākarmapravacanīyau yāvaparī tayorapañcamyantena samāso mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ pañcamīgrahaṇaṃ syāt-- parigataḥ, apagata iti ?
naitadasti; paratvāddhi tayoḥ ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' (ra2.2.18)
ititatpuruṣeṣa bhavitavyam| nanu ca nāprāpte
hyaetasminnayamārabhyamāṇo bādhako bhavati ? naitadasti; karmapravacanīyo
yāvapaparī tatrāvakāśaḥ syāt| tatra hi karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedhaṃ
vakṣyatati| tasmādbahiḥ śabdasya pañcamyantenaiva samasāvidhānam,
nānyena; anyathā pañcamīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmātsādhūktam--
ṭhbahiḥśabdayoge pañcamībhāvasyaitadeva jñāpakam' iti||

13. āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ| (2.1.13)
atha maryādābhividhigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā pañcamītyanuvartate,
āṅa ca karmapravacanīyenaiva yoge pañcamī vidhīyate--
etayorevārthayoḥ ṭhāṅ maryādāvacane' (1.4.89) ityāṅḥ
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā4, nānyatra; tatrāntareṇāpi maryādāvidhigrahaṇaṃ
tayorevārthayo samāso bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti ? satyametat;
tathāpi mandadhiyāṃ sukhāvabodhanārthaṃ maryādābhividhigrahaṇam||

14. lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye| (2.1.14)
ṭhabhyagni, pratyagni' iti| ṭhagnimabhi, agniṃ prati' iti vigrahaḥ|

pratigaccchatitadā tadapratītaṃ kathaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati-- ṭhsrughnamiti !
ṭhtathāyuktañcānīpsitam' (1.4.50) iti karmasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ karmaṇi

pratyaṅkā gāvaḥ' iti| abhinavaḥ pratinavo'ṅka āsāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ|
abhiśabdo'trābhinavārthe vartate, pratiśabdaśca pratinavārthe| aṅko'tra
bhavati gavāṃ lakṣaṇam, ābhimukhyantu nāsti| nanu cātra
paratvādbahuvrīhiṇā bhavitavyam, ataḥ sa bādhako bhaviṣyati,
kimābhimukhyagrahaṇena ? naivam; asatyābhimukhyagrahaṇe'śeṣatvāt
kuto bahuvrīhirbhavati ! atha vaitajrajñāpayati--
bahuvrīhiravyayībhāvena bādhyata iti| tena dvau munī vyākaraṇamisi
siddhaṃ bhavati; anyathā hi svapadārthe caritārtho'vyayībhāvo dvimuni
vyākaraṇamityatrānyapadārthe paratvādbahuvrīhiṇā bādhyeta||

15. anuryatsamayā| (1.4.15)
yasya samayā yatsamayeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| nanu ca samayāśabdayoge
ṭhabhitaḥ paritaḥ samayānikaṣā' (vā. 119)
ityādagyupasaṃkhyānāddvitīyayā bhavitavyam, ataḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷeva tāvanna na
sambhavati, kutaḥ punastasyāḥ samāsaḥ ? athāpi kathañcit ṣaṣṭhī syāt,
tathāpi samayāśabdasyāvyayatvat ṭhpūraṇaguṇa' (2.2.11) ityādinā
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yogagrahaṇādiha
samayāśabdārthena yoge dvitīyā vijñāyate| sa cārtho mukhya eva
gṛhyate, na gauṇaḥ| sa punarmukhyo'rthaḥ samīpam| na ceha
samayāśabdasya mukhyo'rtho'sti, kiṃ tarhi ? gauṇo'rthaḥ| anureva
samayāśabdenocyate, tasmāccheṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhaḷeva nyāyyā| ata eva
dravyavācitvādavyayasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt ṭhpūraṇaguṇa' (2.2.11) iti
pratiṣedho nopapadyate| ṭhanuryatsamayā' iti| etenānuśabdārthe
samayāśabdo vartata iti darśayati| nanu ca samayāśabdasya samīpamarthaḥ,
tatkathamanuśabdaḥ samayāśabdenocyeta ityāha-- ṭhyasya samīpavācī'iti|
etena samayāśabdārthābhidhāyitvādanuśabdaḥ
samayāśabdenopacārādvyapadiṣṭa ityācaṣṭe| bhavatyupacāreṇa hi
tadarthābhidhāyini tadvyapadeśaḥ, yathā-- sītāharaṇaṃ kāvyamiti|
tenetyanena yasyānuśabdaḥ samayavācī sa parāmṛśyate| nanu ca
sa#e'rthaḥ, tatkutastena samāsaḥ ? arthe kāryāsambhavāt tadvācini
śabde kāryaṃ vijñāyate, tathā ca tenetyasya tadvācinā
śabdenetyayamartho'tra gamyate| ṭhanuvanam' iti| tenetyanena yat
ṣaṣṭhaḷntaṃ tena vanaśabdena samāsaḥ| vanasyānviti
samīpasamīpisambandhe ṣaṣṭhaḷeva yuktā| 
ṭhvanaṃ samayā' iti; pūrvoktenopasaṃkhyānena vanaśabdāddvitīyā|
ṭhvṛkṣamanu vidyotate vidyaut' iti| atra karpravacanīyalakṣaṇā dvitīyā|
anuśabdo'tra lakṣaṇe vartate, na sāmīpye||

16. yasya cāyāmaḥ| (2.1.16) 
atrāpyupacāreṇāyāmavācitvādanurevāyāmaśabdanoktaḥ| ṭhanugaṅgaṃ
vārāṇasī' iti. yadyapi gaṅgāvārāṇasyāvubhe apyāyamavatyau,
tathāpyāyāmavatayā gaṅgāyāḥ prasiddhatvādÂ gaṅgaivātra lakṣaṇam, na
vārāṇasī| prasiddhaṃ hi lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, nāprasiddham|
tasmādgṅgayaivātra samāso bhavati, na vārāṇasyā| ṭhyamunāyāmena
gathurāyāmaḥ lakṣyate' iti| yamunayā tadvatyā lakṣaṇabhūtayeti
veditavyam| yasmādyasyāyāmavācyanuśabdastena lakṣaṇabhūtena subantena
samasyate| yumanāyāścāyāmavācyanuśabdaḥ, na yamunāyāmasya| na
hyāyāmasyāpara āyāmo'sti, tasmādyamunāyāmeti hetāviyaṃ tṛtīyā|
yamunāyāmena hetunā tadvatyā yamunayā lakṣaṇayabhūtayā
karaṇabhāvamāpannayā vā mathurāyāmo lakṣyata ityayamartho veditavyaḥ||

17. tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīni ca|(2.1.17)
tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīnāṃ gaṇapāṭhādeva kṛtasādhutvānāmiha prakaraṇe
saṅkīrtanamavyayībhāvasaṃjñārtham; na tu subantena samāsārtham| ata
evāha-- ṭhsamudāyā eva nipātyante' iti| tathābhūtānāṃ pāṭha evaiṣāṃ
nipātanam| ṭhavyayībhāvasaṃjñakāni bhavanti' iti| anena saṃjñāmātar#ṃ
vidhīyate, na tveṣāṃ subantena samāsa iti darśayati|
ṭhtiṣṭhadgu, bahadgu'iti| pūrvapadasya śatrādeśo nipātyate|
ṭhgostariyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaḥ| tiṣṭhanti gāvo yasminna
kāle sa tiṣṭhadgu kālaḥ| vahanti gāvo yasmin kāle sa bahadgu
kālaḥ| ṭhcakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ' asati tasmin paramatiṣṭhadgviti
ṭhsanmahat' (2.1.61) ityādinā paramaśabdena samāsaḥ syāt|
avadhāraṇārthe tu tasmin
tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīnītyevambhūtānyevāvatiṣṭhate| ṭhāyatīgavam' iti|
puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ samāsāntaśca bhavati| āyatyo gavo yasmin kāle
sa āyatīgavam| ṭhkhaleyavam; khalebusam' iti| saptamyā alag
nipātyate| ṭhlūyamānayavam' iti| śānaj nipātyate| tathā
ṭhpūyamānayavam' ityatrāpi| ṭhete kālaśabdāḥ' iti|
tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtayaḥ saṃskriyamāṇabusaparyantāḥ|
ṭhsamabhūmi, samapadāti' iti| samatvaṃ bhūmeḥ, samatvaṃ padāteriti
pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ| utarapadārthaprādhānyavivakṣāyāntu
samapadātiḥ samabhūmiriti viśeṣaṇasamāsastatpuruṣo bhavati| anye
makārāntaṃ samaśabdaṃ paṭhanti-- samambhūmi, samampadāti' iti| ṭh
suṣamam, viṣamam, duḥṣamam,aparasamam' iti| samaśabdeneti|
suṣamādayaścaite| suṣamādayaścaite pūrvapadārthaprādhānye samāsāḥ|
atra śobhanatvaṃ samasyetyevamādi vākyaṃ draṣṭavyam|
utarapadārthaprādhānye tu prādisamāso viśeṣaṇasamāsaśca yathathāyogaṃ
kartavyaḥ| ṭhāyatīsamam' iti| samāśabdaḥ saṃvatsaravācī, tena samāsaḥ-
āyatī samaṃ āyatīsamam| evaṃ pāpā samā pāpasamam| puṇyā samā
puṣyasamam| anye tu tṛtīyāsamāsaṃ varṇayanti-- āyatyā samaṃ
āyatīsamamiti; evamanyatrāpi| pragatatvamahnaḥ prāhṇam| ayamapi
pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ| utarapadārthaprādhānye tu tatpuruṣa eva bhavati--
prāhṇe kalyāṇanāmānāvetau tiṣyapunarvasū iti| evaṃ ṭhpraratham'
ṭhpradakṣiṇam' ṭhpramṛgam' , ṭhaparadakṣiṇam' , ṭhsamprati', ṭhasamprati'|
ṭhic karmavyatīhāre' (5.4.127) itīco'vyayībhāvatve
prayojanamavyayasaṃjñā, napuṃsakatvañca| daṇḍṬaśca daṇḍṬaśca prahṛtyedaṃ
yuddhaṃ vṛtimita#| ṭhtitra tenedamiti sarūpe'(2.2.ka27) iti samāsaḥ,
ṭhic karmavyatīhāre' (5.4.127) itīc samāsāntaḥ-- ṭhanyeṣāmapi
dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti dīrghaḥ, ṭhdaṇḍādaṇḍi' iti||

18. pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhaḷa vā| (2.1.18) 
nanu ca prakṛtaiva mahāvibhāṣā tayaiva vikalpo bhaviṣyati, tatkiṃ
vāgrahaṇenetyāha-- ṭhvāvacanāt' ityādi| gatārtham| yadi tarhi
vāvacanāt pakṣe ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhavati, māhavibhāṣayā kiṃ kriyata
ityāha-- ṭhmahāvibhāṣayā' ityādi||

19. saṃkhyā vaṃśyena| (2.1.19)
ṭhekalakṣaṇa' iti| ekasvabhāvaḥ| santānaḥ u prabandhaḥ|
santānināmekalakṣaṇatvāt, santāno'pyekalakṣamo bhavati| tatar
vidyayaikalakṣaṇaḥ-- vaiyākaraṇavaṃśaḥ, upādhyāyavaṃśa iti| janmanā--
brāhmaṇavaṃśaḥ, kṣatriyavaṃśa iti| ṭhtatra bhavo vaṃśyaḥ' iti| digāditvādyat|
ṭhdvau munī' iti| pāṇinikātyāyanau| ṭhvyākaraṇasya' iti|
sambandhalakṣamā ṣaṣṭhī| ṭhtrimunivyākaraṇasya' iti| pūrvau dvau,
bhāṣyakārastṛtīyaḥ| ṭhvidyayā' iti| vyākaraṇākhyayā| ṭhtadvatām' iti|
pāṇiniprabhṛtanīnām| ṭhabhedavivakṣā' iti| yau tau dvau munī
tāveva vyākaraṇamityatiśayena vidyayā yogaṃ
tayorākhyātumabhedavivakṣā yadā kriyate tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
bhavati-- dvimuni vyākaraṇamiti||

20. nadībhiśca| (2.1.20) 
cakāreṇa ṭhsaṃkhyā' ityanukṛṣyate| bahuvacananirdeaśenārthasyedaṃ
grahaṇam, na svarūpasya, nāpi saṃjñāyāḥ, tena sarvairnadīvācibhiḥ
samāso vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhnadīvacanaiḥ' ityādi| ṭhsamāhāre
cāyamiṣyate' iti| cakāro'vadhāraṇe -- samāhāra eva nānyatreti|
yadyevam, samāhāragrahaṇamaṃ kartavyam ? na kartavyam, yata eva
hetorakṣādīnāṃ pariṇā saha kitavavyavahāra eva samāso bhavati,
tataeva hetorayamapi samāhāra eva bhaviṣyati- sapta gaṅgāḥ
samāhṛtāḥ saptagagṅmiti| pūrvavad hrasvaḥ| anyapadārthe tu na bhavati--
dvīrāvatīko deśa iti| ṭhpañcanavam, saptagodāvaram'iti|
kṛṣṇodakapāṇÃḍupūrvāyā bhūmeracpratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ|
godāvaryāśca nadyāśca saṃkhyāyā utare yadi||
iti vacanādac samāsāntaḥ||

21. anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām| (2.1.21) 
ṭhkṛṣṇaveṇṇā' iti| kṛṣṇā cāsau veṇṇā ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ|
ṭhśīghragaṅgaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| 

22. tatpuruṣaḥ| (2.1.22)
ṭhkaṣṭaśritaḥ' iti| tatpuruṣasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṭhtatpuruṣe
tulyārtha'(6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam| atha
kimarthamiyaṃ mahatī saṃjñā vidhīyata ityāha-- ṭhpūrvācāryasaṃjñā
ceyam' iti| tadaṅgīkaraṇaṃ kimarthamityāha-- ṭhtadaṅgīkaraṇam'
ityādi| upādhiḥ u viśeṣaṇam| kaḥ punarasau tadīya upādhirityāha--
utarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ' iti||

23. dviguśca| (2.1.23)
ṭhsamāsāntāḥ prayojanam' iti| ṭhtatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ

ṭhsaṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñā, ṭac, ṭhnastaddhite'
(6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ ṭhakārāntotarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate'
(vā.156) iti strīliṅgatā, ṭhdvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp| ṭhdvahyahaḥ,
tryahaḥ' iti| ṭhahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti ṭilopa), ṭhrātrahnāhāḥ
puṃsi'(2.4.29) iti puṃstvam| ṭhpañcagavam' iti| ṭhsa napuṃsakam'
(2.4.17) iti napuṃsakatvam| satyapyakārāntatve strītvaṃ na bhavati;
ṭhpātrādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (vā.1.5.9) iti vacanāt||

24. dvitīyā śritātītapatitagatyāstaprāptāpannaiḥ| (2.1.24)
ṭhśritādiṣu' ityādi| śritādiṣu samāsakāraṇatvenopāteṣu satsu
gamigāmyādīnāṃ samāsasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ|

bhavati| na caivaṃ śritādigrahaṇanarthakam;
pūrvaviṣayasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthatvāt| ādiśabdaḥ prakāravācī|
gamigāmiśabdayorekataropādānenaiva siddhe

grahaṇaṃ kartavyam| ṭhgrāmaṃ gamī'iti| ṭhgamerini' (da.u.6.57)
itīnipratyayaḥ| sa ca bhaviṣyatkāle; ṭhbhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' (3.3.3) iti
vacanāt| ṭhgrāmaṃ gamī' iti| ṭhāvaśyakādhamarṇyayoḥ' (3.3.170)
ityāvaśyame ṇiniḥ| ṭhakenorbhaviṣaayadādharmarṇyayoḥ' (2.3.70) iti

26. khaṭvā kṣepe| (2.1.26)

28. kālāḥ| (2.1.28)
ṭhcarācarāḥ' iti| anatyantasaṃyogapratipādanārtham| caranti bhramantīti

ṭhkramu pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pā.473),pūrvapadiṭpratiṣedhaḥ|

29. atyantasaṃyoge ca| (2.1.29)
ṭhkṛtsnasaṃyogaḥ' iti| kṛtsnasya saṃyogaḥ kṛtsnasaṃyogaḥ, kṛtsnasya
kālasya muhūrtādeḥ svena sambandhinā u sukhādinā saṃyoga u
sambandho'tyantasaṃyogaḥ| etadeva spaṣṭīkartumāha-- ṭhkālasya'
ityādi| ṭhmuhūrta sukham' iti| ṭhkālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5)
