vyāptiḥ|

30. tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena guṇavacanena| (2.1.30)
ṭhtatkṛta' iti| etadarthaśabdenāsamastameva, avibhaktiñca|
tṛtīyāvibhakteḥ ṭhsupāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) iti luptatvāt| etacca
guṇavacanenetyasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam| ata eva kīdṛśeneti
pṛṣṭaḥ sannāha-- ṭhtatkṛtena' iti| taditi sarvanāmnā prakṛtasya
tṛtīyāntasya pratyavamarśa iti tṛtīyāntakṛteneti darśayati|
tṛtīyāntena guṇavacanasya karaṇatvaṃ na sambhavatītyataḥ sāmarthyāt
tadarthakṛteneti vijñāyata ityata āha-- ṭhtṛtīyāntārthakṛteneti
yāvat' iti| arthadvāreṇa cedaṃ guṇavacanasya viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam-
tṛtīyāntārthakṛto guṇavacanārtha iti| so'pi tathocyate| etaduktaṃ
bhavati-- tṛtīyāntārthakṛtena guṇavacanārtheneti| artha eva hi
tṛtīyāntārthena kriyate, na ca guṇavacanaśabdaḥ| guṇamuktavān u
guṇavacanaḥ| ṭh kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.13) iti kartari lyuṭ| atha
vā-- karaṇe, guṇa ukto'neneti guṇavacanaḥ| yaśca pūrva guṇe
vartitvā paścāt tadvati dravye vartate sa guṇavacanaḥ|
guṇenetyucyamāne ghṛtena pāṭavamityādau prasaṅgaḥ,
atastannivṛtyarthaṃ vacanagrahaṇam| tasmiṃśca sati guṇe vartitvā tadvati
dravye yo vartate tenaiva samāso bhavati, na tu guṇa eva yo vartate
tena saha| na ca pāṭavādayaḥ śabdāḥ pūrvaṃ guṇe vartitvā paścāt
tadvati dravye vartante, api tu guṇa eva| vacanagrahaṇāt taiḥ saha
samāso na bhavati| ṭhśaṅkulākhaṇḍaḥ, girikāṇaḥ' iti|
khaṇḍakāṇaśabdāvatra khaṇḍanena nimīlane ca kriyārūpāpanne guṇe
vartitvā paścānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tadvati dravye vartate iti
guṇavacanau bhavataḥ| ṭhdhānyārthaḥ' iti| bhavutyayamarthaśabdastatkṛtaḥ,
tathā hi sa gobhirvapāvān kṛtaḥ| na tu vapāvānityayaṃ śabdo
guṇamuktavāmiti na guṇavacanaḥ, tatastena saha samāso na bhavati||

31. pūrvasadṛśasamonārthakalahanipuṇamiśraślakṣṇaiḥ| (2.1.31)
yuktaḥ samasadṛśaśabdābhyāṃ samāsaḥ, yāvātā tābhyāṃ yoge
ṭhtulyārtheratulopamābhyām' (2.3.72) iti tṛtīyāvidhānam,
itaraistu pūrvādibhiḥ kathaṃ tṛtīyāsamāsa upapadyate ? na hi tadyoge
kenacitṛtīyā vihitā ityāha ṭhasmādeva' ityādi| subodham|
ṭhpūrvādiṣvavarasyopasaṃkhyānam' iti| pūrvādiṣu
samāsakāraṇatvenopāteṣu satsvavaraśabdasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ
kartavyamityarthaḥ| avaraśabdenāpi tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ pratipadyata ityarthaḥ|
tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- utarasūtre bahulagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|
tenāvaraśabdenāpi samāso bhavati||

32. kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam| (2.1.32)
ṭhbhikṣābhiruṣitaḥṭa iti| hetau (2.3.23) tṛtīyā vihitā|
vaservacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam, ṭhśāsivasighasīnāñca'
(8.3.60) iti ṣatvam, ṭhvasatikṣudhoḥ' (7.2.ka52) itīṭ| ṭhdātreṇa dhānyaṃ
lūnavān' iti| ṭhlvādibhyaśca' (8.2.44) iti niṣṭhānatavam|
ṭhpādahārakaḥ' iti| pādābhyāṃ hriyata iti pādāhārakaḥ| pādābhyāmiti
pañcamī caturthī vā| hāraka iti ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti
karmaṇi ṇvul| ṭhgalecopakaḥ' iti| gale cupyata iti| ṭhcupa mandāyāṃ
gatau' (dhā.pā. 403) ityasmāt pūrvavadeva ṇvul| ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti
bahulam' (6.3.14) ityulak||

33. kṛtyairadhikārthavacane| (2.1.33)
ṭhstutinindāprayuktam' iti| stutyā nindayā vā yat prayuktaṃ
pravartitaṃ tat stutinindāprayuktam| tadarthamuccāritamityarthaḥ|
ṭhadhyāropitārthavacanam' iti| adhyāropito'rtho'sanneva buddhyā
samāropitastasya vacanamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṭhkṛrtṛkaraṇayoḥṭa iti|
arthe kāryāsambhavāt tadabhidhāyini subante kāryaṃ vijñāyate|
ṭhkākapeyā' iti| ṭhpā pāne' (dhā.pā.925) iti ṭhaco yat' (3.1.97)
ṭhīdyati' (6.4.65) ītvam| atra sampūrṇatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nadyāḥ stutiḥ,
adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ kākapeyatvam-- evaṃ nāma sampūrṇatoyā
nadī yataṭasthairapi kākaiḥ śakyā pātum| ṭhśvalehyaḥ kūpaḥ' iti|
ṭhṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) atrāpyāsannodakatvodbhāvanaṃ kūpasya
stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ śvalehyatvam-- evaṃ nāmāsannodakaḥ
kūpo yataḥ śnabhirapi lihyate| ṭhbāṣpacchedyāni tṛṇāni' iti| atra
māradvātiśayodbhāvanaṃ tṛṇānāṃ stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ
punaratrārtho bāṣpacchedyatā-- evaṃ nāma mṛdūni tṛṇāni
yadbāṣpeṇāpi śakyāni chetum| ṭhkaṇṭakasañceya odanaḥ' iti|
atrāpi vaiṣadyātiśayodbhāvanaṃ viklinnatodbhāvanañcaudanasya
stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ kaṇṭakasañceyatvam-- evaṃ
nāmaudanasya viśadatātiśayo vikledaśca yatkaṇṭakenāpi śakyaḥ
sañcetum| evaṃ tāvat stutiprayukte'dhikāryavacana udāharaṇāni|
nindāprayukte'dhikārthavacana etāvantyeva draṣṭavyāni| tathā hi--
kākeyā nadītyatrālpatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nadyā nindā| adhyāropitaḥ
punaratrārthastadeva pūrvoktaṃ kākapeyatvam, evaṃ śvalehyādāvapi
pūrvokta evādhyāropito'rtho draṣṭavyaḥ-- evaṃ nāmālpatoyā nadī
yatkākairapi śakyaṃ pātumiti| śvalehyaḥ kūpa
ityatrāpyaśuddhatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nindā- evaṃ nāmālpa odano
yatkaṇṭakairapi cīyata iti| nanu ca bahulavacanādadhikārtho'pi
pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ samāsaḥ, tatkimarthamidamityāha-- ṭhpūrvasya' ityādi|
te vai vidhayaḥ susaṃgṛhītā yeṣāṃ prapañcaśceti| susaṃgṛhītaṃ yathā
syāditi pūrvasyāyaṃ prapañca kriyate||

34. annena vyañcanam|
ṭhdadhyodanaḥ' iti| nanu ca kriyākṛtaḥ kārakāṇāṃ sambandha-, na tu
svataḥ| na ca vṛtāviha kācana kriyā śrūyata iti sāmarthyābhāvaḥ| asati
ca sāmarthye samāsābhāvaḥ| athāsatyapi sāmarthye vacanasāmarthyāt
samāso bhavatīti cedāsyatāṃ dadhnā, odano bhujyatāṃ
devadatenetyatrāpi syādityata āha-- ṭhvṛtau' ityādi| na
hyasatyāmupasecanakriyāyāṃ saṃskāryaṃ saṃskārakaṃ sambhavati| asti ceha
tadubhayamityatastadbhāvādeva samāsāntarbhūtā kriyā gamyate|
taddvārakaścānnavyañjanayoḥ sambandha iti vidyata eva sāmarthyam||

35. bhakṣyeṇa miśrīkaraṇam| (2.1.35) ṭhmiśrīkaraṇam' iti| amiśraṃ miśraṃ
kriyate'neneti miśrīkaraṇam| ṭhkharaviśadamabhyavahārya bhakṣyam' iti|
tatraiva bhakṣyaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt||

36. caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣitaiḥ| (2.1.36)
ṭhtadarthena' ityādi| yadi tādarthyamātre samāsaḥ syāt,
balirakṣitagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tathā hi--
kuberabaliḥ,gorakṣitamityatrāpi tādarthyaṃ gamyatata eva|
tasamādbalirakṣitagrahaṇālliṅgāt ṭhtādarthye prakṛtivikārabhāve
samāso bhavati' iti vijñāyate| nanu ca sampradāne caturthyarthaṃ
balirakṣitagrahaṇaṃ syāt, naitadasti; dadātikarmaṇā hi
abhipreyamāṇasya kriyayā vā sampradānasaṃjñeṣyate, na ceha
dadātikarmaṇā kriyayā vā'bhipreyamāṇatā'sti, tatkutaḥ sampradāne
caturthī ? kena punastādarthye caturthī bhavatītyāha-- ṭhasmādeva'
ityādi| yadi tādarthye caturthī na syāt, tadā tadarthagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt| tasmādyadetat, tadarthena caturthyantasya samāsavidhānaṃ tadeva
jñāpakam-- tādarthye caturthī bhavatīti|
ṭharthena' ityādi| kartavyamiti śeṣaḥ| nityasamāsa ucyate u kathyate,
yena tannityasamāsavacanaṃ vyākhyātavyam| etaduktaṃ bhavati--
yenārthaśabdena nityasamāsaḥ pratyāyyate tadvayākhyānaṃ kartavyamiti|
tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca
vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenārthaśabdena nityasamāso
bhaviṣyati, sarvaliṅgatā ceti| ṭhparavallaliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ'
(2.4.26) iti paravalliṅgatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ sarvaliṅgatā vidhīyate|
eṣā tu lokāśrayatvālliṅgasyeti siddhā| atha vā --
bahulagrahaṇānuvṛteḥ sarvametat siddham| gohitam, gosukhamiti
ṭhcaturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣya' (2.3.73) ityādinā caturthī| hitayoge
tvanāśiṣyapi caturthī bhavati| tathā hi vakṣyati-- ṭhhitayoge caturthī
vaktavyā' (vā. 123) iti| 

37. pañcamī bhayena| (2.1.37)
ṭhbhayabhītabhītibhībhiriti vaktavyam' iti| evaṃ hi tribhirapi
bhītādibhiḥ samāso bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ|
svayameva vyākhyātumāha-- ṭhpūrvasya' ityādi| yathaiva hi
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) iti tṛtīyāntasya samāso
vidhīyamāno bahulagrahaṇasya
sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvādanyavibhaktyantasyāpi samāso bhavati--
pādahārakaḥ, galecopaka iti, tathā vṛkabhīta ityādāvapi samāso
bhaviṣyati| tasmāt pūrvakasya
bahulagrahaṇassayaivodāharaṇapradarśanārtho'yaṃ yogaḥ prapañcārtho
veditavyaḥ| ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| yasmāt pūrvakeṇaiva bahulagrahaṇena
siddhaṃ tasyaivāyamprapañcaḥ; tasmātata eva bahulagrahaṇāt ṭhgrāmanirgataḥ'
ityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena vṛkabhītādergrahaṇam||

38.apetāpoḍhamuktapatitāpatrastairalpaśaḥ| (2.1.38)
ṭhalpaśaḥ' iti| ṭhbahvalpārthāccchas kārakādanyatarasyām' (5.4.42) iti
śas| ṭhalpā pañcamī samasyate' iti|| alpebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ utpannā
yā pañcamī sā samasyate, na tu sarvebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ ityarthaḥ||

39. stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena| (2.1.39)
ṭhstokānmuktaḥ; kṛcchrānmuktaḥ' iti| ṭhkaraṇe stokālpakṛcchra' (2.3.33)
ityādinā pañcamī| ṭhantikādāgataḥ, dūrādāgataḥ' iti|
dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca' (2.3.35) ityanena||

40. saptamī śauṇḍṬaḥ| (2.1.40)
śauṇḍṬariti bahuvacananirdeaśādādyartho gamyata ityāha-- ṭhśauṇḍādibhiḥ'
ita| kena punarvihitāyāṃ saptamyāṃ tadantasya śauṇḍādibhiḥ samāso
vidhīyate ? ṭhsaptamyadhikaraṇe ca' (2.3.36) ityaneneti cet,
vārtametat| tathā hyadhikaraṇaṃ kārakam, tacca kriyāpekṣam| na
cākṣaśauṇḍa ityādau vṛtau kācana kriyā śrūyate|
tatkuto'dhikaraṇasyeha sambhavaḥ ? na ca śakyate vaktumÂ-- asmādeva
vacanācchāṬṇḍādibhiryoge saptamī bhaviṣyatīti, devadataḥ śauṇḍa
ityatrāpi prasaṅghaḥ syādityata āha-- ṭhvṛtau' ityādi. astyevātra
prasaktikriyā| sā tu samāsārtha evāntarbhūtetigamyamānatvāddvṛtau
kriyāpadaṃ na prayujyate| tasyā yatsādhanamadhikaraṇaṃ tatra
saptamītyadoṣaḥ| antaḥ śabdastvatrādhikaraṇapradhāna eva paṭhaḷte| tasya
prayoge tatsāmānādhikaraṇyameva saptamyāḥ kāraṇam|
vane'ntarvanāntarvasatīti pūrvapadārthapradhānye tu ṭhvibhaktyarthe
yadavyayam' (2.1.6) ityavyayībhāva eva bhavatiḥ- antarvaṇamiti|
adhiśabdo'tra paṭhaḷte-- tasyādhikaraṇaprādhānye satyavyayībhāvaḥ-
adhistri| ādheyaprādhānye tu tatpuruṣaḥ-- brāhmaṇeṣvapi brāhmaṇādhīna iti|
brāhmaṇādhiśabdaḥ kevalo na prayujyate| ṭhaṣaÃḍakṣāśita' (5.4.7)
ityādinā'dhyutarapadāt svārthikasya nityasya khasya vidhānāt||

41. siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca| (2.1.41)

42. dhvāṅkṣeṇa kṣepe| (2.1.42)
ṭhdhvāṅkṣeṇetyarthagrahaṇam' iti| arthapradhānatvānnirdeaśasya| yatra hi
śabdapradhāno nirdeaśastatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, anyatra
tvarthagrahaṇameveti pratipāditametat prāk| arthapradhānatvantu
nirdeaśasyāviccchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśādvijñāyate|
bahulagrahaṇānuvṛterarthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā| api ca ṭhkṣepe' ityucyate,
kṣepaścārthakārita evetyarthagrahaṇameva yuktam| arthagrahaṇe ca sati
dhvāṅkṣaparyāyairapi samāso bhavati, ata āha-- ṭhdhvāṅkṣavācinā'
ityādi| ṭhtīrthe dhvāṅkṣa iva' iti| upamānabhāve sati dhvāṅkṣasya kṣepo
gamyate,nānyatheti darśayitumivaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| samāse tu samāsa
evopamānārthasyāntarbhūtatvādivaśabdo gatārtho na prayujyate| yathaiva
hi tīrtha dhvāṅkṣaściraṃ sthātāro na bhavanti, tadvadanyo'pi yaḥ kāryaṃ
pratyanavasthitaḥ sa ṭhtīrthadhvāṅkṣaḥ' ityucyate, yadāha-- ṭhanavasthita
ityarthaḥ' iti| kāryaṃ pratyanavasthitatvameva kṣepaḥ||

43. kṛtyairṛṇe| (2.1.43)
ṭhyapratyayāntenaiva samāsa iṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punaryatpratyayenaiva
labhyate ? alpaśa ityanuvṛteḥ, ṭhmāsadeyam' iti| pūrvavadyat, ītvañca|
saptamī hyatraupaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe veditavyā| māse hyatīte yo'ntaro
divasaḥ sa māsaṃ pratyupaśliṣṭo bhavati, ṭhyasya ca bhāvena
bhāvalakṣamam' (2.3.37) ityanena vā| māsātikramaṇabhāvena hi
ṛṇadānabhāvo lakṣyate| atha ṛṇa ityucyate, tatredaṃ na sidhyati--
pūrvohṇegeyaṃ sāma, prātaradhyeyo'nuvākaḥ, ityata āha-- ṭhṛṇam'
ityādi| ṛṇaṃ hi niyogato niryātayitavyamiti
niyogasahacaritam| ataḥ sāhacaryāt tena niyogo'vaśyambhāva
upalakṣyate| etacca ṭhkṛtyaiḥ' iti
bahuvacananrideśālliṅgādgamyate| katham ? ṭhkṛtyaiḥ' iti
bahuvacanamatra vivakṣitam, tacca ṛṇagrahaṇasya niyogopalakṣaṇārthatve
prakṛtibhedena| bhidyamāne kṛtye sati prasajyate, na tvanyathā|
yatpratyayasyaikatvāt tenaiva samāsasyeṣṭatvāt||

44. saṃjñāyām| (2.1.44)
ṭhsamudāyopādhiḥ' iti| ṭhsaṃjñāyām' iti nedaṃ
pūrvapadasyotarapadasya vā viśeṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? samudāyasya--
samudāyena cetsaṃjñā gamyata iti| kimevaṃ sati sidhyatītyata āha--
ṭhtena' ityādi| atraivopapatimāha-- ṭhna hi' ityādi||

45. ktenāhorātrāvayavāḥ| (2.1.45)
ṭhetatu te divāvṛtaṃ rātrau vṛtañca drakṣyasi' ityādi.
nātrāharavayavāḥ rātryavayavāśca santi, kiṃ tarhi ? kṛtsnamevāhaḥ,
kṛtsnā ca rātririti, teneha samāso na bhavati ||

46. tatra| (2.1.46)
ṭhtatretyetat saptamyantam' iti| saptamīsādharmyāt| tralÂpratyaya
evātra saptamīśabdenoktaḥ| bhavati hi tāddharmyāt tāccchabdyam| yathā--
gaurvāhīka iti| saptamīsādharmyaṃ punastralo'dhikaraṇārthatvāt.
yathaiva hyadhikaraṇapratyāyanāya saptamī prayujyate,tathā tralapi| atha
mukhyaiva saptamīvibhaktiḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ?
tasyāstatraśabde'sambhavāt| asambhavastu tralaiva tadarthasya dyotitavāt|
anyastvāha-- yadā vibhaktyādaśāstralādayastadā
sthānivadbhāvenaivaitat saptamyantaṃ bhavati| ādeśapakṣasat#u tatra
vṛtikṛtā nāśrita ityasamyagetat| antaśabdaścātrāvayavavacanaḥ|
saptamītralpratyayo'nto'vayavo yasya tatathoktam||

47. kṣepe| (2.1.47)
ṭhavataptenakulasthitam' iti| ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) iti
saptamyā aluk| kaḥ punaratra kṣepaḥ ? kāryeṣvanavasthitatā| yadāha--
ṭhetaccāpalam' ityādi| yathā avatapte deśe nakulā na ciraṃ
sthātāro bhavanti, tadvadanyo'pi yo'rthānārabhya na ciraṃ
teṣvavatiṣṭhate taṃ pratīdamucyate-- avataptenakulasthitamiti| ṭhudakaṃ
viśīrṇam' ityādāvapyārambhasya niṣphalatā kṣepaḥ| ata evāha--
ṭhniṣphalaṃ yatkriyate tadevamucyate' iti| ṭhpravāhe mūtritam' iti|
ṭhmūtra prasravaṇe' (dhā.pā.1909) curādiḥ||

48. pātresamitādayaśca| (2.1.48) 
ṭhyuktārohyāviparigrahārthaḥ' iti| yuktārohyādiṣu yuktārohyādibhirvā
parigarho'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya pāṭhasya sa tathokkataḥ| kimarthaṃ
punaryuktārohyādiṣu parigrahasteṣāmiṣyata ityāha--

āmravṛkṣa iti ? viśeṣaṇasamāsena bhavitavyam, yadā
śiṃśapādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣe vṛtirnāvadhāryate| tathā hi--
śiṃśapādiśabdāḥ phalasya vṛkṣasya mūlasya ca vācakāḥ sāmānyaśabda iti
tadarthānāṃ vṛkṣatvavyabhicārādadviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, vṛkṣaśca viśeṣaṇaṃ
bhavati| yadā tu kutaścit prakaraṇādarthādvā vṛkṣādyarthā
evāvasitavṛtayo bhavanti tadā na bhavitavyam| nanu ca
vṛkṣārthāvasitavṛtitvādÂvṛkṣaśabdasya tadā prayoga eva nopapadyate,
uktārthatvāt, ṭhuktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' (vyā.pa.60) iti vacanāt| tataśca
samāsasyāprasaṅga eva| tatkiṃ tannivṛtyarthenobhayagrahaṇena?
naitadevam; kvaciduktārthānāmapi loke prayogo dṛśyate, yathā--
apūpau dvāvānayeti|
yadi tarhi yatrobhayoḥ pratyekaṃ viśeṣamaviśeṣyabhāvastatra samāsena
bhavitavyam, evaṃ sati pratyekamupasarjanatvaṃ syāt, ubhayorapi
viśeṣaṇatvāt, viśeṣaṇasyeha sūtre prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt,
tataścotpalanīlaramityapi syāt, nīlotpalamiti tu
sarvadaiveṣyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādekataraṃ pradhānam,
itaradapradhānam| dvayoḥ prādhānye
parasparānupakāritvādasambandhayorekatra prayogo na syāt|
aprādhānye'pi dvayoḥ pradhānāpekṣāvatornāsti
parasparopakāritvamiti na syādevaikatra prayogaḥ| tasmādekatra
pradhānam, aparaṃ tvapradhānam| yaccāpradhānaṃ tedavopasarjanasaṃjñāṃ
bhavati, netarat; anvarthatvādupasarjanasaṃjñāyāḥ-- upa u samīpe
viśeṣye svārtha sṛjati u kṣipatīti| nīlaśabdaścāpradhānam, tadarthasya
guṇasyāprādhānyāt; utpalaśabdastu pradhānam, tadarthasya dravyasya
prādhānyāt| tasmānnīlaśabda evopasarjanam, notpalaśabda iti na
bhavati pūrvoktadoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ| yatrobhāvapi tatra
paryāyeṇopasarjanabhāvaḥ, yathā-- kubjakhañja, khañjakubja iti|
atha kuto'tra dravyasya prādhānyamavasitam ? ucyate;yathā-- śvetaṃ
chāgamālabhetetyasyāṃ deśanāyāṃ deśanāyāṃ
śvetaguṇasyābhāve'nyavarṇasyāpi cchāgasyālambhanācchāgābāve
śvetaguṇasyānyadravyasyānālambhanācca| na hi cchāgābhāve
piṣṭakapiṇḍīlamālabhya yājñikaḥ kṛtī bhavati| yadi ca pradhānaṃ guṇaḥ
syātadā yathā chāgābhāve piṣṭakapiṇḍī nālabhyate, tathā
śvetaguṇābhāve'nyaguṇo'pi cchāgo nālabhyate| na ca sa nālabhyate,
tasmāt dravyameva pradhānam, na guṇa iti| nanu cotpalaśabdo'pi
naiva dravyaśabdo'yamiti vyavasthāpyate| evaṃ nīlaśabde'pyatiprasaṅgaḥ,
prabhṛtyā vināśāt svādhāraṃ dravyaṃ naiva jahāti| ato
dravyātmabhūtatvājjātestannimitakaḥ śabdo dravyasyotpate| guṇāḥ
punarapāyino'napāyino vā satyetasmin dravye vartante
nivartante ca| tasmānnaite dravyātmabhūtā iti na tannimitaśabdo
dravyaśabdo vyavasthāpyata ityalamatiprasaṅgena|
ṭhtakṣakaḥ sarpaḥ' iti| nanu ca takṣakaḥ sarpasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva, tathā
hi-- sarpa tyukte sarpasāmānyaṃ pratīyate, na sarpaviśeṣaḥ| takṣaka-
sarpa ityukte sarpaviśeṣo'takṣakādvyāvṛto'vasīyate, tadayuktaṃ
pratyudāharaṇametat; naitadasti;uktaṃ hyaetat- yatraikaisyobhayatra
bhāvastatra samāsa iti| na tu kadācit sarpārthasya takṣako viśeṣyo
bhavati| kathaṃ na bhavati ? takṣakasya sarpatvāvyabhicārāt| nanu ca
takṣakaśabdasyānekaprakāratvena prakārāntaranivṛtaye yujyata eva
sarpasya takṣako'pi viśeṣyaḥ ? naitadasti; na nāmadheyasya kriyāśabdena
tulyamarthābhidhānasāmarthyam| avayavārthānusāreṇa hi kriyāśabdo'rthaṃ
bodhayati, samudāyarūpeṇa tu nāmadheyam| ṭhavayavaprasiddheḥ
samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī' (vyā.pa.108) iti tasyāṃ satyāṃ
kriyāśabdārthaviṣayāpekṣā nopajāyata eva| ṭhlohitastakṣakaḥ' iti|
bhavati lohito viśeṣaṇam, na tu takṣako viśeṣyam| tasya
lohitatvāvyabhicārāt| yadi tarhi takṣako na viśeṣyaḥ,
lohito'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt; viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyāpekṣatvāt|
na ca śakyaṃ takṣakādyarthāntaraṃ paṭādikaṃ viśeṣyaṃ tadapekṣayā
lohitasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ parikalpayitum| evaṃ hi
lohitādyadarthāntaraṃ tīvraviṣādikaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ tadapekṣaṃ takṣakasyāpi
viśeṣyatvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādvispaṣṭārthamubhayorgrahaṇamityapare||

58. pūrvāparaprathamacaramajaghanyasamānamadhyamadhyamavīrāśca| (2.1.58)
ṭhpūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ' iti| tenaiva siddhatvāt| asti hyatrāpi
pratyekaṃ pūrvotarapadayarviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyabhāvaḥ||

59. śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ| (2.1.59) 
ṭhśreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanam' iti| abhūtatadbhāve vartamānānāṃ
samāso yathā syāt| yadā hi śreṇyādiśabdānāmarthā apariniṣpannā
eva niṣpādyante tadā samāsa iṣṭe| yadā tu niṣpannā eva te
rūpāntareṇa kriyate tadā śreṇayaḥ kṛtā daṇḍitāḥ satkṛtā
vetyevamādyarthavivakṣāyāṃ neṣyate| kṛtaśabdasya
daṇḍitādiśabdānāmartheṣu vṛtirna sambhavatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam|
karoteḥ kriyāsāmānyavācitvāt| anekārthatvādvā dhātūnām|
śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanamityasyāyamarthaḥ-- cvyartha ucyate u
pratyāyyate yena taccvyarthavacanam| ṭhkartavyam' iti| yena
śreṇyādiṣu samāsakarāṇatvenopāteṣu cvyarthatā pratipadyate
tadvayākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
bahulagrahaṇamihānuvartate, tena cvyarthānāmeva samāso bhavatīti
nācvyarthānām| ṭhcvyantānām' ityādi| cvervikalpena
vidhānāddvividhāścvyarthāḥ-- cvyantāḥ, acvyantāśca| tatra ye
śreṇyādayo'cvyantāsteṣāmanena samāsaḥ| cvyantānāntu
ṭhūryyādicviḍācaśca' (1.4.61) iti gatisaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ paratvāt
ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāso bhaviṣyatīti||

60. ktena nañviśiṣṭenānañ| (2.1.60)
ayaṃ viśiṣṭaśabdo'styeva sāvadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamānaḥ| yathā--
devadatayajñadatāvāḍhyavabhirūpau prekṣāvantau| devadatastu yajñadatāt
svādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ; svādhyāyenaivādhika iti gamyate| anye tu
guṇāḥ samānā eva bhavanti| asti ca niravadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamānaḥ,
yathā-- devadatayajñadatāvāḍhyavibhirūpau prekṣāvantau| devadatastu
yajñadatāt svādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ, svādhyāyenādhika iti gamyate| anye
tu guṇāḥ samānā bhūyāṃso vā, te na vivakṣitā bhavanti| yadyapi
cābhinnarūpameva vākyadvayametat, tathāpi prakaraṇādeḥ
kutaścidarthabhedo gamyate, yathā-- ārāccchabde dūrāntikārthabhedaḥ|

tadā siddhaṃ ca tadabhuktañcetyatrāpi syāt, astyatra nañādhikaṃ ktāntam|
tasmāt sāvadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamānaṃ viśiṣṭaśabdaṃ parigṛhyāha--
ṭhnañaiva viśeṣo yasya' ityādi| ṭhprakṛtyādikam' iti| ādiśabdena
pratyayopasargayoḥ parigrahaḥ| ṭhanañ' iti| avidyāmāno nañ yasmin
ktānte tadanañ| ṭhkṛtañca tadakṛtañca' iti| kathaṃ punarekameva vastu
kṛtaṃ syādakṛtañca ? avayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya tathā
vyapadeśādadoṣaḥ| kṛtabhāgasambandhāt kṛtam, akṛtabhāgasambandhāt
tadevākṛtamityuÂcyate| atha vā- yadarthaṃ kṛtaṃ tatrāsāmarthyādakṛtam,
yathā-- putrakāryāsāmarthyāt putro'pyaputra iti| yadi nañeva

bahulagrahaṇamihānuvartate, tena kṛtāpakṛtādīnāmapi samāsī

61. sanmahatparamotamotkṛṣṭāḥ pūjyamānaiḥ| 
ṭhpūjyacamānavacanairiti vacanāt' ityādi| pūjyamanatvaṃ
hyavamutarapadasya bhavati yadi pūjāvacanā bhavanti, nānyathā; tasmāt
pūjyamānagrahaṇāt sadādayaḥ pūjāvacanā vijñāyante| ata eva
saccchabdena śatṛśānacorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, na hi tau pūjāmāhatuḥ|
ṭhutkṛṣṭā gauḥ karddamāt' iti| uddhṛtetyarthaḥ| atha kathaṃ mahādrumaḥ,
mahodadhiriti samāsaḥ, na hyatra pūjā gamyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
pramāṇātireka utarapadārthasya ? yadyapyevam, tathāpi
bahulagrahaṇānuvṛterbhaviṣyati||

62. vandārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam| (2.1.62)
vandārakādayo jātiśabdāḥ| te copamānatve sati pūjāvacanā
bhavanti| tatra vyāghrāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ṭhupamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ'
(2.1.56) ityevaṃ siddhe samānyaprayogage'pi yathā
syādityevamartho'yamārambhaḥ| "ṭhpūjyamānam' iti
vacanādvṛndārakādayaḥ pūjāvanacanā gṛhyante" iti| na hyanyathā
pūjyamānatvamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ|
ṭhsuṣīmo nāgaḥ' iti| nanu ca viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti vartate| na ca
nāgādanyaḥ suṣīmo'sti, saṃjñā hyaeṣā nāgasyaiva ? evaṃ tarhi
pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ vṛtikṛtā darśitā|idantvatra
pratyudāharaṇam--devadato nāgo yasmānmūrkha iti||

63. kataratamau jātiparipraśne| (2.1.63)
ṭhjātiparipraśna eva vyutpādyete'iti| ṭhkiṃyatadaurnirdhāraṇe'(5.3.92)
ityanuvartamāne ṭhvā bahūnām' (5.3.93) ityādinā| syādetat--
kataraśabdaviśeṣaṇārtha jātiparipraśnagrahaṇamityāha-- ṭhkataraśabdo'pi'
ityādi| ṭhtadeva jñāpayati' iti| yadi tarhi katamaśabdo jātiparipraśna
eva vartamāno gṛhyate, jātiparipraśnagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāta, vinā'pi
tena yathoktayā nītyā kataratamaśabdau jātiparipraśna eva vartamāno
grahīṣyete| ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| yata eva takamaśabdasya
jātiparipraśnādanyatrāpi vṛtiḥ, evañca kṛtvā bhavatāṃ devadataḥ katama
iti pratyudāharaṇamupapadyate| anyathā tannopapadyet; tasya
jātiparipraśnādanyatrāpravṛteḥ||

64. kiṃ kṣepe| (2.1.64)
ṭhkiṃsakhā' iti| ṭhanaṅ sau' (7.1.93) ityanaṅadeśaḥ| atha kiṃrājetyādau
ṭhrājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) ṭhgorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac
samāsāntaḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- ṭhkimaḥ kṣepe' ityādi| atra ṭhna
pūjanāt' (5.4.69) ityataḥ ṭhna' ityanuvartate||

65.
poṭāyuvatistokakatipayagṛṣṭidhenuvaśāvehadbaṣkayaṇīpravaktṛśrotriyādhyāpakadhūrtairjātiḥ| (2.1.65)
viśeṣaṇamityādinā samāse prāpte vacanamidaṃ paranipātārtham|
guṇaśabdā hyaete| tatra yadi tena samāsaḥ syāta tadaiṣāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ
prasajyeta| atha dhūrtagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā kutsanaśabdo'yam,
ṭhkutsitāni kutsanaiḥ' (2.1.53) ityevaṃ samāsaḥ siddha ? ityāha--
ṭhdhūrtagrahaṇamakutsārtham' iti| śabdapravṛtinimitakutsāyāṃ samāso
vijñāyate, na kutsāyām||

66. praśaṃsāvacanaiśca| (2.1.66)
ṭhrūḍhiśabdāḥ praśaṃsāvacanā gṛhyante' iti| triprakārā hi praśaṃsāśabdāḥ-
ke#jjāitiśabdāḥ parārthe prayujyamānāḥ praśaṃsāmācakṣate yathā-- siṃho
devadata iti| kecidguṇaśabdā guṇaguṇisambandhena praśaṃsāvacanā
bhavanti, yathā-- ramaṇīyo grāmaḥ, śobhanaḥ pācaka iti|
kecidrūḍhiśabdā matallikādayaḥ; teṣāṃ praśaṃsaiva śabdārthaḥ| tadiha
vacanagrahaṇāt praśaṃsāyāmeva ye vartante te gṛhyante rūḍhiśabdāḥ|
ṭhgoprakāṇḍam' iti| śobhanaḥ praśasto gaurityarthaḥ|
yogavibhāgo'sandehārthaḥ| yadi pūrvayoga eva praśaṃsāvacanā
gṛhyaeran, tadā sandehaḥ syāt-- kiṃ poṭādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ
vacanamabhisambadhyate ? atha praśaṃsayeti ? poṭādibhiḥ sambandhe
tatparyāyairapi samāsaḥ syāt||

67. yuvā khalatipalitavalinajaratībhiḥ| (2.1.67)
ṭhkhalatyādibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇaiḥ' ityādi| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ
jaratībhiriti strīliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ, jaradbhirityevaṃ nāma
nirdeaśaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt, na hi jaratīśabdena strīliṅgena
yuvaśabdasya puṃliṅgasya sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyata ityāha--
ṭhjaratībhiriti strīliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punaranena
nirdeaśenaiṣā paribhāṣā śakyate jñāpayitum ? yadyeṣā na syāt tadā
jaratībhirityevaṃ nirdeaśo'narthakaḥ syāt. tathā ca
samānādhikaraṇādhikārāt samānādhikaraṇena jaratīśabdenāyaṃ
samāso vijñāyate| na ca tena strīliṅgena puṃsi vartamānasya
yuvaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, tadeṣa nirdeaśaḥ kathamarthavān
bhavati ? yadyeṣā paribhāṣā'vatiṣṭhate ! tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ yuvaśabdasya
grahaṇe yuvatiśabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyupapadyate| yuvatijaratīśabdayoḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tasmiṃśca sati tayoḥ samāsaḥ| tedavaṃ
jaratībhiriti nirdeaśo jñāpayati-- eṣā paribhāṣā'stīti|
nanvevamapi jaratyā samāsa ucyamāne jaratā na prāpnoti--
yuvajaranniti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vṛtyantare hi jaradbhiriti paṭhaḷte|
ubhayathā'pyācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratipāditā ityubhayaṃ sidhyati||

68. kṛtyatulyākhyā ajātyā| (2.1.68)
ṭhtulyaparyāyāśca' iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? evaṃ
manyate--kṛtya ityarthagrahaṇam| atastatsāhacaryāt tulya ityarthasyaiva
grahaṇaṃ yuktam, tatrārthe kāryāsambhavāt tadvācināṃ samāso vijñāyata
ityākhyāgrahaṇaṃ tulyanāmadheyaparigrahārtham| anyathā gaurvāhīka
ityatrāpi syāt ; gośabdasyeha sādṛśyārthatvāt| sarva eva hi śabdāḥ
parapadārthe prayujyamānāḥ sādṛśyaṃ gamayanti| ākhyāgrahaṇe tu
kriyamāṇe gośabdo'tra tulyanāmadheyaṃ na bhavatīti samāsābhāvaḥ|
bhojyoṣṇamityādāvuṣṇādayaḥ śabdā guṇavacanāḥ| tatrāsatyasmin
yoge viśeṣaṇasamāse sati teṣāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| ataḥ
paranipātārtha ārambhaḥ| ṭhtulyamahān' iti| yadyapyatra ṭhsanmahat'
(2.1.561) ityādinā samāsaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpi paratvādanenaiva
bhavati| tulyākhyāyāmasyāvakāśaḥ-- tulyaśveta iti| tasya
cātulyākhyāyāmavakāśaḥ-- mahāpuruṣa iti| ṭhbhojya odanaḥ' iti|
odana śabdo'tra jātivacanaḥ||

69. varṇo varṇena | (2.1.69)
ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' (2.1.57) iti vartate| tatra yadi dvayorapi
varṇaśabdayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇamiha syāt, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo
nopapadyeta; abhinnārthatvāt| na hi tadeva devadatasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ
viśeṣyatvaṃ copapadyate| athāpyekasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt,
aparasyārthagrahaṇam ? evapyekaḥ sāmānyavācī syādvarṇaśabdaḥ,
dvitīyastu viśeṣavācī kṛṣṇādiśabdaḥ| tataśca pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ
viśeṣyatvaṃ ca na syāt| yatra ca tadubhayamasti tatra samāsa iti
prāgubhayagrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam| tasmādubhayatrāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ
vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhvarṇaviśeṣavāci' ityādi| ṭhkṛṣṇasāraṅgaḥ,
lohitasāraṅgaḥ' iti| nanu ca kṛṣṇaśabdo lohitaśabdaścāvayave
vartate sāraṅgaśabdastu samudāye; yathā-- śabalaśabdaḥ,
tatkathamavayavavṛteḥ kṛṣṇādiśabdasya samudāyavṛtinā
sāraṅgādiśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyamityāha-- ṭhavayavadvāreṇa'
ityādi| kṛṣṇa ityucyate, lohitāvayavasambandhāllohita iti| ata eva
gauṇatvādatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' (2.1.57)
ityādinā samāso na prāpnotītīdamārabhyate mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ
karaṇamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeteti| tenāpradhānamupasarjanamiti| na
cātra samudāyo'pradhānam, kiṃ tarhi ? pradhānameva| avayavānāntu
tadarthatvādaprādhānyam| ato'vayavavacanasyaiva
kṛṣṇaśabdāderupasarjanatvam| na samudāyavacanasya
sāraṅgādiśabdasya||

70. kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ| (2.1.70)
ṭhtaiḥ saha strīliṅga eva kumārīśabdaḥ samasyate' iti| na tu
puṃlliṅga ityavadhāraṇena darśayati| na hi puṃlliṅgasya
strīliṅgena sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| ṭhtairupabhayathā'
iti| strīliṅgaḥ, puṃlliṅśca| kathaṃ punaḥ puṃlliṅgaiḥ samāsa
ucyamānaḥ strīliṅgaiḥ syādityata āha-- ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe' iti|
gatārtham||

71. catuṣpādo garbhiṇyā| (2.1.71)
ṭhcatuṣpādaḥ' iti| catvāraḥ pādā yāsāṃ tāścatuṣpādaḥ| ṭhpādasya
lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ' (5.4.138) ityantasya lopaḥ| ṭhcatuṣpājjātiriti
vaktavyam' iti| catuṣpādo jātivacanā eva garbhiṇyā samasyanta
ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
poṭādi(2.1.65) sūtrādiha jātigrahaṇamanurtate| tena
catuṣpajjātivācyeva garbhiṇyā samasyate, nānyaditi||

72. mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca| (2.1.72) 
ṭhmayūravyaṃsakaḥ' iti| mayūraścāsau vyaṃsakaśceti mayūravyaṃsakaḥ|
vyaṃsakaśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipātārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| evaṃ cātra
mayūravyaṃsakādīnāṃ yavanamuṇḍaparyantānām| ṭhcchandasi hstegṛhya'
ityādi| samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap' (7.1.37)| bhāṣāyāntu --
hastegṛhītvā, punardatvetyevaṃ bhavati| ṭhehīḍādayo'nyapadārthe'
iti| ehi īḍa yatra karmaṇi vartate taducyate-- ṭhehīḍam' iti| evam--
ṭhehiyavam' iti| ehivāṇijeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā ṭhehivāṇijā'|
evam-- ṭhapehivāṇijā, prehivāṇijā'| ehi savāgatamiti yasyāṃ
kriyāyāṃ sā ṭhehisvāgatā'| evam-- ṭhapehisvāgatā'| prauha kaṭamiti
yasyāṃ sā ṭhprohakaṭā'| eṃ prohakardamādaya āharavasanāntāḥ| kṛndhi
vicakṣaṇeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā ṭhkṛndhivicakṣaṇā' | ṭhuddharotsṛja'
iti| tiṅntayoḥ samāsaḥ| ṭhākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātye' (ga.sū.20)
ityevaṃ siddhe'sātatyārthaṃ vacanam| uddharotsṛjati yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā
uddharotsṛjā| kriyāpradhānaścāyaṃ samāsaḥ| ṭhutpatanipatā'|
ṭhutamavidhamā'| evamuddharotsṛjetyādikamasātatyaviṣayameva|
ṭhuccāvacanam' iti nipātyate| udak cāvāk citi vigṛhya| uccaiśca
nīcaiśceti vigṛhyaeccanīcamiti nipātyate|
ācitañcopacitañceti vigṛhya ṭhācopacam'| ācitañca
parācitañceti ṭhācaparācam'| niścitañca pracitañceti
ṭhniścapracam'| na kiñcana ṭhakiñcanam'| ṭhsnatvākālakaḥ'|
ṭhpītvāsthirakaḥ'| ṭhbhuktvāsuhitaḥ' ityeṣāmantodātārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ|
lyabbhāvaśca nipātyate| ṭhproṣyapāpīyān' iti| aikapadyamaikasvaryañca
samāsādbhavati| evam-- utpatyapākalādīnām| ṭhnityarohiṇī|
niṣaṇṇaśyāmā| apehiprasavā| ihapañcamī| ihadvitīyā' iti|
aikapadyamaikasvaryañca samāse bhavati|
ṭhjahi karmaṇā bahulamābhīkṣṇye kartārañcādhidadhāti' iti| jahīti
loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanam| tadantaṃ karmaṇā ca bahulaṃ samasyata
ābhīkṣṇye gamyamāne samāsena cetkartā cābhidhīyate|
jahijoḍamityābhīkṣṇyaṃ ya āha sa ucyate ṭhjahijoḍaḥ' iti|
jahistamba iti, loṭ; sip, ṭhhanterjaḥ' (6.4.36) iti jādeśaḥ|
joḍāderatra karmabhāvaḥ| 
ṭhākhyātam' ityādi| tiṅntaṃ tiṅntena saha samasyate kriyāsātatye
gamyamāne| aśnīta pibatetyasakṛdyatrocyate tatra ṭhaśnītapibata' iti
prayujyate| kriyāpradhānaścāyaṃ samāsaḥ| evaṃ pacatabhṛjjatetyevamādayo
veditavyāḥ| bhindhi lavaṇamiti yatrībhidhīyate sā ṭhbhindhilakṣaṇā'| evaṃ
ṭhpacalavaṇā' iti|| 
iti śrībodhasatvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ 
kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ
dvitīyādhyāyasya
prathamaḥ pādaḥ

 atha dvitīyādhyāyasya
dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ
1. pūrvāparādharotaramekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe| (2.2.1)
ṭhsāmarthyādekadeśavacanāḥ' iti| yadi hi pūrvādayaḥ śabdā
ekadeśavacanā na syusatadotarapadasyaikadeśitvaṃ na gamyeta;ekadeśina
ekadeśāpekṣatvāt| tasmāt sāmānyoktā api pūrvādayaḥ śabdā
sāmarthyādekadeśavacanāḥ samasyanta iti vijñāyate|
ekādhikaraṇagrahaṇamekadeśino viśeṣaṇamityasyārthaṃ
vispaṣṭīkartumāha-- ṭhekaṃ ca' ityādi| ekamityekasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaṃ
dravyamityarthaḥ| ṭhekadravyam' ityanenādhikaramaśabdo'tra dravye vartamāna
upāta ti darśayati| nanu ṭhekadeśinā' iti tṛtīyāntametat,
ṭhekādhikaraṇe ityetat saptamyantam, tat kathaṃ
tayorbhinnavibhaktikayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva
upapadyate, kathañca na syāt; bhinnārthatvāt ? naitadasti; ṭhcchandovat
sūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.1.1.1) ityato ṭhvyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85)
iti bahulavacanāt| ṭhekādhikaraṇe' ityatra tṛtīyārtha evaiṣā saptamī|
na ṭhsaptamyadhikaraṇe ca' (2.3.36) ityanena| ato nāsti
bhinnārthatvamityadoṣaḥ| ṭhṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ' iti|
ṭhekadeśinā' iti vacanāt pūrvādayaḥ śabdā ekadeśavacanā āśrīyante|
sambandhiśabdā hi niyatameva pratiyoginamupasthāpayanti|
tatrāvayavāvayavisambandhe steyakadeśinaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷamupajanitāyāṃ
ṭhṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti samāsaḥ prāpnoti, atastadapavādo'yaṃ yoga iti|
ṭhpūrvakāyaḥ' ityatra kāya ekadeśī, ekadravyañca; ekasaṃkhyāyuktatvāt|
ṭhpūrvaṃ nābheḥ kāyasya' iti| nābheriti digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī|
nābherupariṣṭāt yat pūrvaṃ tat kāyasyetyeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ|
tenātra nābhirekadeśinī na bhavati| kiṃ tarhi ? avadhibhūtā, tadvācī
nābhiśabdaḥ pañcamyanto na samasyante| yastvekadeśī kāyastadvācinaḥ
kāyaśabdasya bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| satyapi pūrvaśabdasya sāpekṣatve
kāyasya prādhānyāt pradhānasyaca sāpekṣasyāpi samāso bhavatīti
jñāpitametat ṭhupamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge' (2.1.56)
ityatra| ṭhpūrvaṃ pchātrāṇāmāmantraya ita mūlapāṭhaḥ, padamañjarīsammataśca|}
chātrāṇāmāmantrayasva'iti| atra bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaikadeśinaśchātrā
iti na bhavati samāsaḥ| nanu cātra paratvāt ṭhna nirddhāraṇe' (2.2.10)
iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedho bhaviṣyati| tat pkimevādhikaraṇe- iti
mudrita pāṭhaḥ|} kimekādhikaraṇagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; yadi
tarhyāmantrayasvetyetannāpekṣyate tadā pūrvaṃ chātrāṇāmityetāvadvākyaṃ
parisamāpyate,tadā nirddhāraṇābhāvānnāyaṃ tasya pratiṣedhasya viṣaya
ityasatyekādhikaraṇe'nekasaṃkhyenāpyekadeśinā samāsaḥ syāt| atha
sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ kriyayā parisamāpyata iti pūrvaṃ chātrāṇāmityatra yāṃ
kāñcit kriyāmadhyāhṛtya nirddhāraṇaṃ parikalpyeta, evaṃ ṭhpūrvaṃ
kāyasya' ityatrāpi nirddhāraṇaṃ syāt| asti hyatrāpyakarṣaṇakriyā
nirddhāraṇahetuḥ| tathā ca tasyaiva yogasya viṣaye kilārabhyamāṇo'yaṃ
yogastadapavādaḥ syāt. na cotsargāpavādayorvipratiṣedha upapadyate,
tatkathaṃ paratvāt ṭhna nirddhāraṇe' (2.2.10) iti pratiṣedhaḥ pravartate--
saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyetyādi ? yadayaṃ ṭhsaṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhnasya'
(6.3.110) ityāha, tato jñāpakādavasīyate-- sarveṇaikadeśinā'hnaḥ
samāso bhavatīti| anyathā hi sāyapūrvatvamahnaśabdasya nopapadyata
ityayuktametadvacanaṃ syāt||

2.arddhaṃ nupaṃsakam| (2.2.2) 
ṭhsamapravibhāge tvarddhaśabdo napuṃsakamāviṣṭaliṅgastasyedaṃ grahaṇam'
iti| yadyevam, samagrahaṇameva kartavyam ? naivaṃ śakyam,
anekārthatvāt samaśabdasya| tathā hi--sa nimnonnatādirahite'pi
deśe vartate-- yathā--same yajeteti, nimnonnatādirahite deśe
yajetetyarthaḥ| athāpi samapravibhāga icyucyate, evamapi gurutvaṃ
syāt, tasmānnapuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam; arddhamiti
napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeaśādeva hi napuṃsakasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati,
naitadasti; asati hi napuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakanirdeaśa
iti vijñāyeta, yathā-- ṭhsvamajñātidhanākhyāyām' (1.1.35), ṭhbanthuni
bahuvrīhau' (6.1.14) iti ca; tataścārddhaśabdasya
napuṃsakaliṅgatvatā'nāśritā syāt| evamanupaṃsakaliṅgo'pi
samasyeta| tasmādarddhaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvamāśrayituṃ
napuṃsakamiti vaktavyam| ṭharddhapiptalī' iti| ṭhparavaliṅgam' (2.4.26)
iti strīliṅgatā| athātra ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti
hrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? anupasarjanatvāt| upasarjanatvaṃ tu
ṭhekavibhakti ca' (1.2.44) iti| atra ṭhvibhāṣā cchandasi' (1.2.36) ityato
vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā pratipāditā|
ṭhgrāmārddhaḥ' iti| grāmasyaikadeśa ityarthaḥ|
ṭharddha paśodêavadatasya' iti| devadataśabdena saha samāso na bhavati|
anekadeśitvāddevadatasya| na hyasāvekadeśaḥ, kintarhi ? svāmī|
yastvekadeśī paśuśabdaḥ, tena saha bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| satyapi
paśuśabdasya sāpekṣatve paśoḥ prādhānyāt samāso bhavatyeva--
arddhapaśurdeavadatasyeti||

3. dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇyantarasyām| (2.2.3)
ṭhanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇāt so'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhavati' iti| nanu ca
pūraṇapratyayāntā ete dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ| tatra pūraṇetyādinā
samāsaniṣedhena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ so'pi bhavatītyāha-- ṭhpūraṇa'
ityādi| yadyatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt tadā'nyatarasyāṃ
grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| vākyasya tu mahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhatvāditi
bhāvaḥ| ṭhdvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyāḥ' iti| bhikṣāyā dvitīyo bhāga ityarthaḥ|
ṭhdvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyā bhikṣakasya' iti| bhikṣukeṇa sahātra samāso na
bhavati| na hyasāvekadeśī, kiṃ tarhi ? svāmī| turyaśabdaḥ
ṭhcaturaścchayatāvādyakṣaralopaśca' (vā.571) iti yatpratyayāntaḥ
pūraṇārthasya pratipādakaḥ||

4. prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā| (2.2.4)
ṭhdvitiyāsamāse prāpte' iti| ṭhdvitīyā śrita' (2.1.24) ityādinā|
ṭhsamāsavidhānātso'pi bhavati' iti| apiśabdādayamapi bhavati|
ṭhprāptajīvikaḥ'iti| ṭhekavibhakti ca' (1.2.44) ityādinopasarjanatvam|
hrasvatvaṃ tu ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti| atra ca
ṭhparavalliṅgam' (2.4.26) ityādinā jīvikāyā yalliṅgaṃ tat
samudāyasya kasmānna bhavati ? ṭhdviguprāptāpannalaṃpūravagatisamāseṣu
pratiṣedo vaktavyaḥ'(vā.163) iti vacanāt| tena
prāptāpanyoryalliṅgaṃ tat samudāyasya bhavati| atha yadā
prāptājīvikāmiti vigṛhya samāsaḥ kriyate tadā kimudāharaṇam ?
prāptajīvika iti| ṭāpaḥ śravaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat'
(6.3.34) iti yogavibhāgāt puṃvadbhāvena ṭāpo nivartitatvāt|| 

5. kālāḥ parimaṇinā| (2.2.5)
ṭhsāmarthyāt parimāṇavacanāḥ' ita| evaṃ hyutarapadasya parimaṇivācitvaṃ
gamyate yadi kālaśabdāḥ parimāṇavacanā bhavanti, nānyathā| tasmāt
kālā ityeviśeṣābhidhāne'pi sāmarthyāt ṭhparimāṇavacanaḥ
kālaśabdāḥ samasyante' iti vijñāyate| nanu cakālaḥ parimāṇeva
bhavati; anavadhitvāt, tat kathaṃ tadabhidhāyinaḥ śabdāḥ
parimāṇavacanā bhavanti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi mukhyasya parimāṇasya
vācakā na bhavanti, gauṇasya tu bhavatyeva| iha hi mukhyaṃ parimāṇatvaṃ
kālasya māsaderna bhavatīti sāmarthyāt
paricchedahetumātraparimāṇasādharmyamupādāyopacāreṇa kālāḥ
parimāṇtavenābhimatāḥ| māsādayo'pi hi jātādeḥ
sambandhinīrādityagatīrgamayanti, ato bhavanti paricchedahetavaḥ|
ṭhṣaṣṭhīsamāsaviṣaye yogārambhaḥ' iti| parimāṇaparimāṇisambandhe hi
parimāṇavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷa bhavitavyam| yatra ca ṣaṣṭhī bhavati sa
ṣaṣṭīsamāsasya viṣayaḥ,tenāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya viṣayo yoga
ārabhyate| ṭhmāsajātaḥ' ityatra jātaḥ parimāṇī| tasya parimāÄ māsaḥ|
ṭhdvayahajātaḥ' iti| dvayorahnoḥ samāhāra iti dvyahaḥ|
ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91)| ṭhahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti
ṭilopaḥ| ṭhna saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' (5.4.89) ityahnādeśapratiṣedhaḥ|
dvyaho jātasya dvyahajātaḥ| atha ṭhkālāḥ' iti bahuvacananirdeaśaḥ
kimarthaḥ ? svarūpavidhinirāsārtha iti cet; naitadasti; na hi
svarūpagrahaṇe satyutarapadasya parimāṇivācitvaṃ gamyate,
kālaśabdasyāparimāṇavācitvāt| tasmāt parimāṇigrahaṇādeva
kālaviśeṣavācināṃ māsādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhi
bahuvacananirdeaśo'yaṃ mātrādhikyena
sūtraprabandhasyārthādhikyasūcanārthaḥ| tathā coktam--
ṭhiṅgitenonmiṣitena mahatā sūtraprabandhenācāryāṇāmabiprāyā
lakṣyante' iti| tena saṃkhyāpūrvapadastripado'pyayaṃ parimāṇinā
tatpuruṣasamāso bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyate| tena dvyahnajāta
ityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| dve ahanī jātamasyeti vigṛhya tripade
tatpuruṣe kṛte jātaśabda utarapade pūrvayoḥ padayoḥ
ṭhtaddhitārthotarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti dvyavayavastatpuruṣo
bhavati, pūrvaṣaṭṭac, ṭhahnohna etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ|| 

6. nañ| (2.2.6) 
naño ñakāraḥ ṭhnalopo nañaḥ' (6.3.73) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ,
pāmanaputrādiṣu mā bhūt| ṭhlomādipāmādipicchādibhyaḥ śanelacaḥ'
(5.2.100)| athābrāhmaṇa iti kiṃpradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ ?
utarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ, yathā-- rājapuruṣa iti|
pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ, yathā-- amakṣikamiti|
anyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiḥ, yathā--abrāhmaṇako deśa iti| yadyevam,
abrāhmaṇamānayetyukte brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti ? atha
nivṛtipadārthako'yaṃ brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, sā ca nivṛtiḥ svābhāvikī nañā
dyotyata iti matam, evaṃ ca satyabhāva evāsyārtha ityabrāhmaṇamānayetyukte
na kasyacidānayanaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;sarvaṃ hi padaṃ svārthe
prayujyamānaṃ prayogapratijñānamapekṣate| tathā coktam--
"ātmā buddhyā sametyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā" iti|
tacca dvividhaṃ jñānam-- samyak, mithyā ceti| ubhayamapyetat
brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ pravartayati| yatra samyagjñānapūrvake brāhmaṇaśabdaprayoge
nāsti naño vyāpāraḥ, na hi tatra nañā kiñcita kriyate|
mikhyājñānapūrvake tu vidyata eva tasya vyāpāraḥ| tatra hi tena
mithyājñānaprabhāvatā parasyākhyāyate| mithyājñānaṃ ca
duṣṭendriyahetukam| taccasādṛśyādṛte na sambhavatīti pratiṣedhe
satyatarapadārthasadṛśaḥ samāsārtho jāyate| tathā coktam-- ṭhnañiva
yuktamanyasadṛśādhikaraṇe tathā hyarthagatiḥ' (vyā.pa.65) iti|
tasmādabrāhmaṇamānayetyukte brāhmaṇasadṛśe kṣatriyādau pratītirbhavatīti na
bhavati pūrvokatdoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ||

7. īṣadakṛtā| (2.2.7)
ṭhīṣadguṇavacanenati vaktavyam' iti| īṣadityetadavyayaṃ samasyate,
na sarveṇākṛdan#etanetyetadrūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| taredaṃ

vijñāyate| tena guṇavacanenaiva samāso bhaviṣyati, nānyena|
ṭhīṣadgārgyaḥ' iti| gārgyaśabda'yaṃ jātivacanaḥ, na guṇavacanaḥ|
nanvakṛtetyucyate, tara īṣatpītaḥ, īṣadunna ta ityādi na sidhyati;
pītādiśabdasya kṛdantatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avyutpannā hyaete
pītādiśabdā veditavyāḥ; na tu kṛdantāḥ||

9.yājakādibhiśca| (2.2.9) 
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena ṭhtatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭī samasyata
iti vaktavyam' (iti) iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati;anenaiva siddhatvāt|
tasmin sthitāḥ u tatsthāḥ| prakṛtasyānyasyābhāvāt tadityanena
guṇā eva pratyavamṛśyante| tena guṇātmanyeva ye guṇā vartante , na
kadāciddravyātmani, taiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate| yadyapi nāstyeva hi sa
guṇo yo dravye na vartate, sarvanasya guṇasya dravyāśritatvāt;
tathāpi guṇaśapabdāstu kecit matublopādabedopacārādvā tadvati
dravye vartamānā guṇamādhārānugataṃ gamayanti, yathā-- śuklaḥ paṭaḥ,
lohitaḥ kambala iti| apare tvāśrayādvibhaktaṃ dravyaṃ
pratyanupasarjanībhūtaṃ guṇamāhuḥ, yathā-- candranasya gandhaḥ, kapisthasya
rasa iti| tasmādabhidhānaśaktavyāpārāpekṣayā tatsthairiti viśeṣaṇaṃ
yuktam. tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- ye guṇāḥ svaśabdairdravyaṃ
pratyanupasarjanabhāvāpannā eva pratyāyyante, taiḥ saha ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti
candanasya gandhaśabdanagandhaḥ, kapitthasya rasaḥ kapittharasaḥ| gandhādayo
hi svaśabdairādhāravibhaktā eva pratyāyyante, na tu
kadācidāśrayānugatā dravyaṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtāḥ||

10. na nirddhāraṇe| (2.2.10)
ṭhmanuṣyāṇāṃ kṣatriyaḥ śūratamaḥ' iti. ṭhyataśca nirddharāṇam' (2.3.41)
iti ṣaṣṭhī| ṭhpratipadavidhānā ca' ityādi| ṭhṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' (2.3.50) iti
sāmānyalakṣaṇavihitāṃ ṣaṣṭhaĀ tyaktvā yā'nyā viśeṣalakṣaṇāvihitā
ṣaṣṭhī sā pratipadavidhānā,ka sā ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyata ityetadrūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- neti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate,
tena pratipadavidānā ṣaṣṭhī na samasyata iti|yadyevam, kathaṃ
gṛhasvāmī, vidyādāyādaḥ, pṛthvīśvara iti, pratipadavidhānā hyaeṣā ṣaṣṭhī
bādhiṣyata iti cakāreṇa punaḥ ṣaṣṭhīpratiprasavaḥ kriyate| na hyaevaṃvidā
ṣaṣṭhī pratipadavidhānā bhavati| ata va ṭhna nirddhāraṇe' iti niṣedho
vidhīyate| ṭhyataśca nirddhāraṇam' (2.3.41) ityatrāpi cakāreṇa saiva
śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī pratiprasūyate, anyathā hīyamapi pratipadavidhānaiva
ṣaṣṭhīti samāso na syāt| tataśca ṭhna nirddhāraṇe'iti

ṭhppūrvanipātasyāniyamaḥ--kāśikā}pūrvanipātāniyaḥ' ityādinā

14. karmaṇi ca| (2.2.14)

20.amaivāvyayena| (2.2.20) 
ṭhsvāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte' iti| ṭhsvādubhi' (3.4.26) iti ṇamul|
svādumītyatasmādeva māntanirdeaśādupapadasya makārāntatvaṃ
nipātyate| yadi pūrveṇaiva samāse siddhe niyamārtham vacanam;
evañca sati saddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo'nteraṇāpyevakārakaraṇaṃ
niyamārtho bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthamevakārakaraṇamityāha--
ṭhevakārakakaraṇam' ityādi kimarthaṃ punastadupapadaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ kriyata
ityata āha-- ṭhamaiva tulyavidhānam' ityādi| yena vākyenāyameva
pratyayo vidhīyate na tu pratyayāntaram; tena yadupapadaṃ nirdiśyate
tadamaiva tulyavidhānam, tasyaiva samāso yathā
syādityevamarthamevakārakaraṇamupapadaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ kriyate| sa ca
samāsaḥ pratyāsateramaiva bhavati, na pratyayāntareṇeti vijñāyate| ṭhagre
bhuktvā, agre bhojam' iti| atrāgreśabda upapadam
ṭhvibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu' (2.4.24) ityamā ktvāpratyayena ca
tulyavidhānamiti na samasyate| avyayagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| na
hyanavyavamamantamasti yannivṛtyarthamavyayagrahaṇamarthavadbhavati||

23. śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ| (2.2.23)
ṭhupayuktādyo'nyaḥ' iti| abhihitādanya ityarthaḥ| ṭhyadyānyaḥ samāso
noktaḥ' iti| yatrānyā samāsasaṃjñā na vihitetyarthaḥ| ṭhcitraguḥ' iti|
atra bahuvrīhitve sati ṭhbahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam' (6.2.1)
ityeṣa vidhirbhavati| ṭhunmatagaṅgam' iti| ṭhanyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām'
(2.1.21) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| asati hi śeṣagrahaṇa ihāpi bahuvrīhiḥ syāt|
nanu ca bahuvrīhau prāpte'vyayībhāvastvārabhyamāṇastasyaiva bādhako
bhaviṣyati, tatkuto bahuvrīhiprasaṅgaḥ ? ṭhprākkaḍārāt paraṃ
kāryam' ityasmin pakṣa idaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam| tatra hi pakṣe
kayadi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tataḥ anyapadārtheca saṃjñāyām' (2.1.21)
iti vacanaprāmāṇyadavyayībhāvaḥ syāt| paratvādbahuvrīhirityeke|
ayantu pakṣo vṛtikāreṇa nāśrita ityayuktametat| tasmāt
ṭhākaḍārādekā saṃjñā' (1.4.1) ityasmin pakṣe ṭhvyaktiḥ padārthaḥ'
ityeddarśamāśrityedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam| vyaktau hi padārthe
pratilakṣye lakṣaṇaṃ pravartate| atrāsati śeṣagrahaṇe yadesadviṣayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ
tadakṛtārthamityavaśyaṃ tena pravartitavyam| ekasaṃjñādhikārācca
yogapadyaṃ na sambhavatīti vacanaprāmāṇyādubhayaprasaṅgaḥ, ubhe api
paryāyeṇa syātāmityapare||

24. anekamanyapadārthe| (2.2.243)

25. saṃkhyayā'vyayāsannādūrādhikasaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye| (2.2.25)

26. diṅnāmānyantarāle| (2.2.26)

27. tatra tenedamiti sarūpe|(2.2.27)
ṭhitikaraṇaḥ' ityādi| samāsādabhimate'rthe itikaraṇo yamarthaṃ

anugamayati prabodhayatīti yāvat| sa punarlaukiko'rtho
grahaṇādiriti darśayannāha ṭhtataḥ' ityādi| yasmāditikaraṇo
laukikamarthamanusārayati tato hetorgarhaṇādiriti sarvaṃ labhyate|
ṭhyatatretyādinā' karmavyatīhāra iti parasparagrahaṇam,
parasparagrahaṇañcetikaraṇādeva labhyata iti veditavyam|
svarūpavidhiratretikaraṇādeva na bhavatīti veditavyam| daṇḍṬaśceti
karaṇe tṛtīyā| ṭhsa cāvyayam' iti| tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣu
pāṭhādavyayībhāvaḥ; ṭhavyayībhāvaśca' (1.1.41) ityavyayasaṃjñāvidhānāt|

29. cārthe dvandvaḥ| (2.2.29)
kaḥ punarayaṃ cārtho nāmetyāha-- ṭhsamuccayā'nvācaya' ityādi|
samuccitiḥ u samuccayaḥ| sādhanamekaṃ kriyāṃ vā prati

punastulyabalānāmaniyatakramayogapadyānāmeva bhavati, yathā-- gāmaśvaṃ
puruṣaṃ paśuñcāharaharnayamāno vaivasvatastṛptiṃ nopayātīti|
anvācayo'pi yatraikasya prādhānyam, itaradapradhānam,
tadanurodhenānvācīyamānatā, yathā-- bho vaṭo bhikṣāmaṭa
gāñcānayeti| itaretarayogaḥ samāhāraśca samuccayasyaiva prabhedaḥ| sa
eva hi parasparāpekṣāṇāmavayavabhedānugata itaretarayogaḥ, yathā--
devadatayajñadatābhyāmidaṃ kāryaṃ kartavyam| ubhāvapi tatkāryaṃ prati
parasparāpekṣau| tathā hi tadekasyāpyabhāve na kriyate|
avayavapradhānaścāyamiti dvitvāddvicavacanaṃ bhavati|
parasparāpekṣāṇāmeva tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ saṃhatipradhānaḥ
samāhāraḥ; yathā-- cchatropānahamatiti| atrāpi kasyāñcit kriyāyāṃ
cchatrādeḥ parasparāpekṣatvam| saṃhatipradhānatvāccaikavacanam| yadi
tarhi samuccayānvācayāvapi cārthau tadā tayorapi samāsaḥ
prāpnotītayata āha-- ṭhtatra' ityādi| samuccaye tāvat
parasparānabhisambandhā eva gavādayo nayanādibhiḥ sambadhyamānāḥ
samucīyanta ityāsāmarthyāt satyapi cārthe tasmin na bhavati
samāsaḥ| anvācaye'pyekaṃ sāpekṣaṃ netarat, yathā-- pūrvokta
udāharaṇe| tara hi gavānayanaṃ bhikṣāṭanamapekṣate, na tu bhikṣāṭanaṃ
gavānayanam,; vināpi tena tadanuṣṭhānāt| sa yadi gāṃ paśyati
tadā tāmapyānayati, na cet bhikṣāmevāṭatītyanyatarāpekṣārahite
cārthe na bhavati samāsaḥ| ṭhitaretarayoge samāhāre ca vidhīyate'
iti| tatra sarveṣāṃ sāmarthyasya vidyāmānatvāt| ṭhvāktvacam,
vāgdṛṣadam' iti. ṭhdvandÂvāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre' (5.4.106)
iti ṭac| samāsāntaḥ| ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityekavadbhāvaḥ||

30. upasarjanaṃ pūrvam| (2.2.30)
ṭhpūrvavacanaṃ paraprayoganivṛtyartham' iti| nanu ca
paraprayogaviparyayo loke na dṛṣṭa eva; tatkathaṃ
paraprayoganivṛtyarthena pūrvagrahaṇenetyata āha-- ṭhaniyamo hi
syāt' iti| sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ| evaṃ manyate-- yadyapi
paraprayogaviparyayo na dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpyasati niyāmake vākye
puruṣāparādhādviparītaprayogo'pi sambhāvyeta| yeṣāñca vākyameva
samāsībhavatīti darśanam, teṣāṃ vākyasyānitayatakramatvāt
tadvikāro'pi samāso'niyatakramaḥ s#aditi sūtrārambhaḥ||

31. rājadantādiṣu param| (2.2.31)ṭa
ṭhpūrvasya paranipāta' iti| liptavāsitādyauptagāḍhaparyanteṣu|
udūkhalamasalādayo ye dvandvāḥ, tatra kvacidalpāctaratvāt
pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti, kvacid dhyantatvāt pūrvanipātaḥ,
kvacidajādyantatvāt; kvacitulyādaniyamaḥ| ṭhdṛṣdupalam' iti
pramādāccāyaṃ pāṭho lakṣyate| alpāctaratvādaddṛṣaccchabdasya
pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ| ṭhakṣibhruvam, dāragavam' iti|
acaturādisūtreṇāc (5.4.79) samāsāntaḥ| ṭhsthūlapūlāsam' iti|
pramadapāṭho'yaṃ lakṣyate;pūrvoktādeva kāraṇāt||

32. dvandve ghi| (2.2.32) 
ṭhupasarjanam' ityanvarthasaṃjñāvidhānādapradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñā
vihitā| dvandve ca sarveṣāṃ padānāṃ prādhānyam| na
kasyacidaprādhānyamityupasarjanasaṃjñāyā abhāvādaniyame prāpte
vacanamidam| atra yatra bahūnāṃ pūrvanipātaprasaṅgastatra
kimekasyāniyamo bhaviṣyati, uta sarveṣāmityāha--
ṭhanekaprāptāvekasya' ityādi| eva cārtho
jātipadārthasyāśrayaṇāllabhyate vyaktau tu padārthe prativyakti
śāstrapravṛtyā bhavitavyam, tataḥ sarveṣāṃ niyamaḥ syāt| ākṛtau tu
padārthe lakṣya ekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sakṛdeva pravartate| tena caikasya
pūrvanipāte jātiḥ kṛtārtheti śeṣāṇāmaniyamo bhavati|
evamutaratrāpyekasya niyamaḥ, śeṣāṇāntvaniyama iti veditavyam|
ṭhvispaṣṭapaṭuaḥ' iti| vispaṣṭaḥ paṭuaḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ||

33. ajādyadantam| (2.2.33)
ṭhdvandve ghyantādajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedhena' iti| ṭhdvandve ghi' (2.2.32) iti
tasmādajādyadantamityetatadbhavati vipratiṣedhena| ṭhdvandve
ghi'ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- paṭuaśuklau,paṭuaguptau| ṭhajādyadantam'
ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- uṣṭraśaśau, uṣṭrakharau| indrāgnī ityatrobhayaṃ
prāpnoti, ajādyadantaṃ bhavati vipratiṣedhena||

34. alpāctaram| (2.2.34)
ṭhṛtunakṣatrāṇām' ityādi| ṛtūnāmānupūrvya prādurbhāvakṛtam,
nakṣatrāṇāmudayakṛtam| ṛtunakṣatrāṇāmityatraiva varṇagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna
kṛtamiti paryanuyogadoṣamāśaṅkyāha-- ṭhsamānākṣarāṇām'
ityādi| asamānākṣarāṇāmapi varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa pūrvanipāta iṣyata
iti pṛthagvacanam. ānupūrvyañca varṇānāṃ janmakṛtamiti
lokavyavahāre prasiddham| prasiddhiśca śrutikṛtā| śrutau hi paṭhaḷte
ṭhmukhate brāhmaṇamasṛjat, bāhubhyāṃ rājanayam, ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyam,
padbhyāṃ śūdram' iti| ṭhsaṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ' iti dvandve ceti
vaktavyam| ṭhdvitrāḥ,tricaturāḥ' iti bahuvrīhiḥ| ṭhnavatiśatam' iti
dvandvaḥ||

35. saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau| (2.2.35)
ṭhsarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ' iti| yatra guṇavacanena saha samāsaḥ so'sya
viṣayaḥ| yatra tu dravyavācinā tatra sarvanāmaṃkhyayorviśeṣaṇatvādeva
pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ|
ṭhsaptamyāḥ pūrvanipāte' ityādi| saptamyantasya pūrvanipāte prāpte
gaḍvādibhyaḥ paravacanaṃ kartavyamiti| saptamynataṃ paramucyate u
kathyate yena vyākhyānena tat paravacanam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvād gaḍukakaṇṭhaprabhṛtayastatraiva draṣṭavyāḥ,tena
gaḍvādibhyaḥ paraṃ saptamyantaṃ bhaviṣyati| ṭhkathaṃ vahegaḍuḥ' iti| yadi
gaḍvādibhyaḥ saptamyāḥ paravacanamiti bhāvaḥ| ṭhprāptasya ca bādhā
vyākhyeyā' iti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ṭhvāhitāgnyādiṣu' (2.2.37)
ityato vāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena
prāptasya paranipātasya bādhanaṃ bhaviṣyati||

36. niṣṭhā| (2.2.36)
ṭhnanu viśeṣaṇamevātra niṣṭhā' iti| kṛtaśabdaḥ kriyāśabdaḥ| kaṭaśabdo
dravyavacanaḥ| tatra yathā guṇo dravyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ tathā kriyā'pi| tathā
sati niṣṭhāntasya viśeṣaṇatvāt pūrveṇaiva pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ|
kaṭekṛtamanenetyādinā vigrahabhedena niṣṭhāyā viśeṣaṇatvābhāvaṃ
darśayati| atra vigrahe saptamyantameva viśeṣaṇam, niṣṭhāntaṃ
viśeṣyam, sāmānādhikaraṇye hi kriyāguṇau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvau
niyamenānubhavataḥ, na hi vaiyadhikaraṇye| tathā hi-- paṭasya śuklaḥ,
kākasya gatirityatra guṇāderviśiṣyetvam, vyavacchedyatvāt; dravyasya
tu viśeṣaṇatvam, vyavacchedakatvāt| ṭhniṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte'
ityādi| jātyādibhyo niṣṭhāntaṃ paramucyate, tena tadvyākhyānaṃ
kartavyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
sāraṅgajagdhī-māsajātā-sukhajātādayaḥ śabdāḥ
āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvāt tadantaḥpātinaḥ, tena
jātikālasukhādibhyo niṣṭhāntaṃ paraṃ bhavatīti| ṭhsāraṅgajagdhī'
iti| sāraṅgaśabdo jātivacanaḥ| tataḥ ṭhktādalpākhyāyām' (4.1.51)
ityanuvartamāne ṭhasvāṅgapūrvapadādvā' (4.1.53) iti ṅīṣ| ṭhkathaṃ
kṛtakaṭaḥ' iti| kaṭaśabdasya jātivācitvāditi praśnaḥ| ṭhprāptasya
cābādhā vyākhyeyā' iti| tena kṛtakaṭa ityatra#api bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ|
sā punaraprāptasya cābādhā pūrvavadeva vyākhyeyā| evamutaratrāpi
vyākhyeyā| ṭhpraharaṇārthebhyaḥ' ityādi| praharaṇamartho yeṣāṃ te
tathoktāḥ| tebhya pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- asyudyataḥ,
daṇḍapāṇirityevamādināṃ śabdānāmāhitāgnyādiṣu pāṭhāt pare
niṣṭhāsaptamyau bhavata iti||

1. anabhihite| (2.3.1)
dadhāterhinotervā'nabhihita ityasya rūpam; samānatvāt,
anekārthatvācca dhātūnām| na jñāyate kimarthasyānabhihitaśabdasya
grahaṇamiti sandehaḥ syāt, atastaṃ nirākartumāha--
ṭhanabhihite'nukte' ityādi| yadyanabhihite karmādau dvitīyādayo
vibhaktayo bhavantīti sāmānyenocyeta; tato yathā ṭhkṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ'
ityatra ktapratyayena karmaṇo'bhihitatvāt kaṭaśabdādÂdvitīyā na
bhavati, tathā ṭhkaṭṃa karoti', ṭhbhīṣmamūdāraṃ śobhanaṃ darśanīyam'
ityatra kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānayā dvitīyayā bhīṣmādigatasya
karmaṇo'bhihitatvādbhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā na prāpnoti| tasmāt
kaścidviśeṣo'trābhimata iti matvā taṃ viśeṣaṃ pṛccchati--
ṭhkenānabhihitate'? iti| itaro viditābhiprāya āha--
ṭhtiṅkṛtaddhitasamāsaiḥ' ityādi| kriyata iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ|
ṭhsārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67)| ṭhriṅ śayagliṅśu' (7.4.28) iti
riṅadeśaḥ| ṭhśatyaḥ, śatikaḥ' iti| ṭhśatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21) iti
ṭhanyatau bhavataḥ|
ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityevamādi| tatredamuktam- karmādayo'vyapare
vibhaktīnāṃ vācyāḥ, ata stadīye bahutve bahuvacanaṃ bhavatīti| evañca
bruvatā vṛtikṛtā karmādyāśritāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ dvitīyādayo
vibhaktayo bhavantītyetaduktaṃ bhavati| na ca tatra kaścidviśeṣa upātaḥ|
santi ca karmādayo'bhihitāḥ, anabhihitāśca| tatra viśeṣānupādānta,
yathā anabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣvekatvādiṣu dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo
bhavanti, tathā'bhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣvapi syuḥ| ato'nabhihitā ye
karmādayastadāśrayeṣvekatvādiṣu yathā vibhaktayaḥ syuranyatra mā
bhūvannityanabhihita ityetadviśeṣaṇamārabhyate|
ṭhanabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣu' iti| anabhihitāḥ karmādaya āśrayā
yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| etena ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityādeḥ
śāstrasya, anabhihita ityetasya ca ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2)
ityevanamādibhiḥ sahaikavākyatāṃ darśayati-- anabhihite karmaṇi
dvitīyā bahuṣu bahuvacanamiti| evamanyatrāpyekavākyatā veditavyā|
ekavākyatā ca guṇapradhānabhāvamantareṇa na sambhavatītyekasya
guṇabhāvena bhavitavyam, aparasya pradhānabhāvena| tatra
viśeṣaṇatvādanabhihita ityasya karmādyepekṣayā guṇabāvaḥ, karmādīnāṃ
tu viśeṣyatvāt prādhānyam, ekatvādyapekṣayā karmādīnāntu
viśeṣaṇatvādaprādhānyam| ekatvādīnāṃ viśeṣyatvāt pradhānabhāvaḥ|
atha kathaṃ kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyā mīṣmādipadānugataṃ
karmābhidadhāti, yathā-- niṣṭheti cet ? syādadat-- ṭhyathā kaṭaḥ
kṛto bhīṣma udāraḥ śobhano darśanīya ityatra karoteḥ
karmaṇyutpadyamānā niṣṭhā sarva bhīṣmādikamapi karmābhidadhāti,tathā
kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyā' iti, vārtametat; kṛta iti
kriyākārakasambandhanimitakabhidhānam| kriyā cotpadyamānā sāmarthyāt
sarvāṇi kārakadravyāṇyākṣipati| tataḥ kṛña utpadyamānaḥ ktaḥ
sādhāraṇatayā yāvat karoteruyāti karmatāṃ tāvat
sarvamevābhidadhātīti yuktam| bhīṣmādigatāyā api karmatāyāḥ
ktapratyayenābhidhānam| kaṭastu viśiṣṭadravyavacanaḥ, tata utpadyamānā
dvitīyā tadgatameva karma śaknotyabhidhātum, nānyagataṃ kiñcit,
tatkathaṃ tayā bhīṣmādigatamapi karmābhidhīyate ? tathā ca nirarthakaṃ
parigaṇanam| tasmāt tiṅkṛtaddhitasamāsairevābhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti
sambhavadudāharaṇapradarśanamaparametat parisaṃkhyānaṃ veditavyam, na
parigaṇanam||

2. karmaṇi dvitīyā| (2.3.2)
dvitīyā tiṅvibhaktir apyastīti tasyā apy atra grahaṇam iti
kasyacidāṅkā syāt, atas tannirākartum āha-- dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ'
ityādi| karmaśabdeneha sādhanaṃ karma gṛhyate, na tu kriyākarma| tathā
hi - ye vibhaktyarthā ekatvādayasteṣāṃ viśeṣaṇatvenaiva
karmādayo'nukraṃsyante| na ca kriyākarmaṇi dvitvabahutve staḥ;
sādhanakarmaṇi tu vidyete, tasmāt tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, netarasya|
ṭhubhasarvatasoḥ'ityādi| ubhasarvaśabdayostasipratyayāntayoḥ prayoge
dvitīyāvibhaktiḥ kāryāḥ| śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyāmayamārambhaḥ|
ubhasarvatasorityatra yadyaupyabhaśabdaḥ paṭhitastathāpi
sāmarthyādubhayaśabdo gṛhyate; sādharmyāt| na
hyubhaśabdastasipratyayānto'sti; tasya
nitydavivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt| tathā coktam-- ṭhanyabhāvo
ni#eÂtyadvivucanaṭābviṣayatvādubhayo'nyatra' (1.1.27-vā.8,9) iti|
ṭhubhayataḥ, sarvataḥ' iti| ṭhpañcamyāstasil' (5.3.7)| dhikśabdayoge'pi
dvitīyā kāryā| tathoparyādiṣu triṣu yoge dvitīyā kāryā|
ṭhāmreḍitānteṣu'iti| kṛtadvirvacaneṣvityarthaḥ| ṭhuparyuyari grāmam'
ityādau ṭhuparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye' (8.1.7) iti dvirvacanam|
ṭhtato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate' iti| yathoktādanyatrāpi dṛśyate dvitīyeti
sambandhaḥ| 
kva cānyatra dṛśyata ityata āha-- ṭhabhitaḥ' ityādi| ṭhprayabhibhyāñca' (5.3.9)
iti tasiḥ| apiśabdo vikalpārthaḥ| api dṛśyate'pi na dṛśyateca| tena
hā tāta hā mātarityādi sidhyati||

3. tṛtīyā ca hoścchandasi| (2.3.3) 
ṭhyavāgvā'gnahotraṃ juhoti' iti| yadyapyatra ṭhsupāṃ supo bhavanti'
(vā.818) iti dvitīyāsthāne tṛtīyādeśavidhāne'pyetat sidhyati;
