luk prāpnoti| aparasya ṭhato'm' (7.1.24) ityambhāvaḥ||

4.antarāntareṇa yukte| (2.3.4)
ṭhantarāntareṇaśabdau nipātau sāhacaryādgṛhyaete' iti|
ayamantarāśabdo yadyapi strīpratyayānto'sti,
tathā'strīpratyayānto'pi;antareṇaśabdastvastrīpratyayānto gṛhyate|
yaścāstrīpratyayānto'ntarāśabdaḥ sa nipāta evetyantarāśabdasya
tāvannipātasya grahaṇam| atastena nipātena
sāhacaryādantareṇaśabdasyāpi tasyaiva grahaṇam| tenānipāto
yastṛtīyānto'ntareṇaśabdaḥ, yaśca ṭābanto'ntarāśabdastābhyāṃ yoge
dvitīyā na bhavati| kiṃ te bābhrāvāṇāṃ śālaṅkāyamānāñcāntareṇa
gatena ? grāmayorantarāyāṃ puri vasatītyantaraśabdo'tra
viśeṣavacanaḥ| gamirapi jñānavacanaḥ| kiṃ te viśeṣaṇa jñānenetyarthaḥ|
ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ' iti|ra śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣaṭhaḷaṃ
prāptāyāmasyārambhāt| ṣaṣṭhaḷapavādatvamasya
yogasyāntarāntareṇaśabdārthapradarśanadvāreṇa vispaṣṭīkartumāha--
ṭhtatra' ityādi| madhyaṃ hi sambandhiśabdatvādamadhyabhūtaṃ dvitīyaṃ
sambandhinamapekṣya bhavati| tatra yadapekṣaṃ madhyatvaṃ tato madhyena
vyatireke samupajanite ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti| vinārtho'pi śeṣa eva|
atrāpi ṣaṣṭhaḷeva prāpnoti| ṭhantarā tvāñca māñca kamaṇḍaluḥ' iti| tava
mama madhye kamaṇḍalurityarthaḥ| atha kamaṇḍaluśabdāddvitītā kasmānna
bhavati ? satyapyantarāntareṇayoge tasya prādhānyāt| tathā hi--
kamaṇḍaloḥ svārthā pravṛtiḥ , yuṣmadasmadostu parārthā;
kamaṇḍaluviśeṣaṇatvena tayoḥ pravṛtatvāt| tatra kamaṇḍaloḥ svārthe
vartamānāt prādhānyenāvasthitvāt prātipadikārthādapracyutatvāt
paratvāt prathamaiva bhavati| dvitīyāyāstvapradhāne
yuṣmadasmaccchabde'vakāśa iti tābhyāṃ teneva prathamāntena
kamaṇḍalunopajanite vyatireke ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyāṃ dvitīyā
vidhīyate| ṭhantareṇa puruṣakāram' iti| vinā puruṣakāreṇetyarthaḥ| 
ṭhantarā takṣaśilāṃ pāṭaliputrañca srughÂnasya prākāraḥ' iti| atra srughnaḥ
prākāraviśeṣaṇatvenopakṣīṇasāmarthya iti na bhavati tsayāntarāśabdena
yogaḥ||

5. kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge| (2.3.5)
kālādhvanorityarthagrahaṇam| ata āha-- ṭhkālaśabdebhyo'dhvaśabdebhyaśca'
ityādi| ṭhmāsasya dviradhīte| krośasyaikadeśe parvataḥ|
yojanasyaikadeśe parvataḥ' iti| nātra ṭhkālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge'
iti dvitīyā bhavati||

6. apavarge tṛtīyā| (2.3.6)
ṭhapavargaḥ'iti| atyantasaṃyogasya phalarūpametadviśeṣaṇamupātam| tacca
kriyātyantasaṃyogasyaiva sambhavati, nānyasyati sāmarthyādatra
kriyātyantasaṃyoga eva gṛhyate| sarvasyāśca kriyāyāḥ
parisamāptirasti; tasmādviśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt phalaprāptau
satyāṃ kriyāyāḥ parisamāptirihāpavargo vijñāyata ityata āha--
ṭhphalaprāptau' ityādi| ṭhkartṛvyāvṛtau' iti| na hi
māsamadhīto'nuvāko na cānena gṛhīta ityukte'pavargo gamyate, kiṃ
tarhi ? karturaśaktimātram| na ca tatrāpavargavyapadeśaḥ||

7. saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye| (2.3.7)
ṭhadya bhuktvā devadato dvyahe bhoktā, dvyahādbhoktā' iti| nanu
cātra eka eva kartā, kārakabhede sati tannibandhano madhyavyayapadeśo
bhavati, tat kathamasati kārakabhede kārakayormadhye kālo
bhavatītyata āha-- ṭhkartṛśaktyoḥ'ityādi| na hi dravyaṃ kārakam,
kiṃ tarhi ? śaktiḥ, sā ceha bhidyate| tathā hi-- devadate dve śaktī
vyavasthite; ekādya bhujeḥ sādhanam, aparā dvyahe'tīti iti
kartṛśaktibhede sati yukto madhyavyapadeśaḥ| ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ'
ityādi| iṣvāsaḥ kartā, lakṣyaṃ karma| ṭhkarmāpādānayoḥ' iti. karma
tadeva| apādānaṃ yataḥ paro niryāti| ṭhkarmādhikaraṇayorvā' iti|
ihetyanena yannirdiśyatetadadhikaram| karma ca tadeva| ṭhtayormadhye
krośaḥ' iti| krośasyehāpādānādhikaramatvābhāvāt saptamīpañcamyau
na bhavatiḥ| na hi krośācccharo'paiti, kiṃ tarhi ? tadekadeśāt| nāpi
krośe vyavasthitaṃ lakṣyam, kiṃ tarhi ? tadekadeśa eva| tasmāt
krośasya śeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyāṃ saptamīpañcamyau vidhīyete|
athātra saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? yāvatā kālādhvanau hi dvau,
saptamīpañcamyāvapi dva, ata eva sāmāt saṃkhyātanudeśena
bhavitavyam- kālāt saptamī, adhvanaḥ pañcamītyata āha--
ṭhsaṃkhyātānudeśaḥ' ityādi| ṭhsvaritenādhikāraḥ' (1.3.11) ityatra
svariteneti yogavibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ, tata pūrveṇāpi sambadhyate. yatra
svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate tatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yathā syāt| iha tu
svaritatvaṃ nāsti, ato na bhavati saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ||

8. karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā| (2.3.8)
ṭhśākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣat' iti| ṭhanurlakṣaṇe' (1.4.84) iti
karmapravacanayīsaṃjñā|

9. yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī| (2.3.9)
ṭhupakhāryāṃ droṇaḥ' iti| khāryā adhiko droṇa ityarthaḥ| ṭhupo'dhike ca'
(1.4.87) ityupaśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā| ṭhyasya ceśvaravacanam' iti|
yasya ceśvaravyapadeśa ityarthaḥ| īśvaravyadeśastu svāmina eva sambhavati|
tatraiva saptamyā bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrānti syāt,
atastānnirākartumāha-- ṭhyasya ceśvaravacanam' ityādi| yasya
ceśvaravacanamityanena dvayorapi u svasvāminoḥ paryāyeṇa saptamī
bhavatīti| katham, yāvatā ṭhadhirīśvare' (1.4.97) ityanenādhikaśabdasya
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā, īśvarastu svamī, sa ca svamapekṣya bhavati
? svasvāmisambandhe'dhiśabdaḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjño bhavati| tatra
kadācit svāmī karmapravacanīyavibhaktayā yujyate, kadācit
svamityetat pratipāditaṃ prāgeva| kathaṃ punaryasya
ceśvaravacanamityucyamāne svamapi karmapravacanīyavibhaktyā yujyate, na
hi tasyeśvaravyapadeśo'sti ? evaṃ tarhi anuktasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ
kriyate, tena yasyeśvaravyapadeśo nāsti tatrāpi saptamī vijñāyata
ityadoṣaḥ||

10. pañcamyāpāṅpirabhiḥ| (2.3.10)
apapariśabdayoḥ ṭhapaparī varjane' (1.4.88) ityanena
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā, āṅśca ṭhāṅmaryādāvacane' (1.4.89)
ityanena| ṭhvṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate' iti| pariḥ
ṭhlakṣaṇetyambhūtakhyāna'(1.4.90) ityādinā||

11. pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt| (2.3.11)
ṭhmukhyasadṛśaḥ pratinidhiḥ' iti| mukhyo yaḥ kaścit kārye rūḍhaḥ u
samarthaḥ, prasiddhaḥ u pradhānabhūtastena sadṛśo yastadabhāve tasya kāryasya
siddhyarthamupādīyate sa pratinidhiḥ| ṭhabhimanyurarjunataḥ prati' iti|
mukhyādarjunādabhimanyuḥ pratinidhistataḥ pañcamīvibhaktirbhavati|
pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ| ṭhmāṣānasmai tilebhyaḥ pratiyaccchati' iti|
ye tilāḥ pūrvaṃ datāstebhyo māṣāṇāṃ pratidānam| tilebhya iti
pañcamī bhavati| tilān gṛhītvā māṣān dadātītyarthaḥ|
nanu ca ṭhpratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ' (1.4.92) iti prateḥ
pratinidhipratidānarorevārthayoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tayoreva
pratinā yoga upapadyate, na tu yataste tasyeti manyamāna āha-- ṭhnanu
ca' ityādi| ṭhsambandhasambandhāt' iti| sambadhyata iti
sambandhaḥupratinidhiḥ, pratidānañca, tadubhayamayi karmapravacanīyena
pratinā yujyate| tena sambandhena yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa sambandhasambandhaḥ|
kasyapunastena sambandhaḥ ? yataḥ pratinidhiḥ pratipādanañca tasya|
sambandhiśabdau hi pratinidhipratidānaśabdau| tau ca nāsati
pūrvavijñāte mukhye pūrvadate ca bhavati iti pratinidhipratidānābhyāṃ
yasya sambandhastasya tābhyāṃ sambandho'stīti te api
karmapravacanīyairyukte bhavata iti| kvacit ṭhsambandhisambandhāt' iti
pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpi pratinidhiḥ hūtidānañca sambandhiśabdenocyate;
tadubhayasyāpi karmapravacanīyena sambandhāt| tena sambandhinā yaḥ
sambandhaḥ sa sambandhisambandha iti sa evārthaḥ||

12. gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani| (2.3.12)
yadi kriyāmātramiha ceṣṭāśabdenocyate tadā
ceṣṭāgrahaṇamapārthakam| sarvo hi dhātuḥ kriyāvacanaḥ| tasmādviśeṣaṇaṃ
pādānasāmarthyāt parispandavacano'yaṃ ceṣṭāśabdo vijñāyate,
ityāha-- ṭhparispandakriyāṇām' iti| parispandaḥ u śarīravyāpāraḥ, sā
kriyā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| 
ṭhadhvanītyarthagrahaṇam' iti| arthapradhānatvannirdeaśasya, saptamīnirdeaśācca|
yadīha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt ṭhanadhvanaḥ' iti kuryāt|
ṭhāsthitapratiṣedhaścāyaṃ pvijñeyaḥ- kāśikā|} vijñāyate iti| yena
deśaviśeṣeṇa prāpyaṃ grāmādikaṃ prāpyate sa deśaviśeṣo
loke'dhveti rūḍhaḥ| kena ca prāpyaṃ prāpyate ? yaḥ panthā ākrāntastena|
tasmāt tasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| yadā tu sa evotpathena prāpyate tadā
tasya patho'dhvavyapadeśo na bhavatīti bhavatyeva tatra caturthī|
ṭhdvitīyāgrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| karmaṇi kārake caturthyāṃ
vikalpitāyāṃ pakṣe nyāyaprāptaiva dvitīyeti bhāvaḥ| tat kriyate
bādhakabādhanārtham| ṭhapavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syāt' iti|
athārthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na gatikarmaṇītyevocyeta, yāvatā gatirartha
eva ? naitadasti; yā gatirgaminaiva
śabdāntarasannidhānādyanapekṣatayocyate tatra yathā syāt|
pādaviharaṇātmikā ca yā gatiḥ pradhānabhūtā tasyā evagrahaṇaṃ yathā
syādityevamartham| teneha na bhavati-- striyaṃ gaccchati, ajāṃ grāmaṃ
nayati| atra hi gamemaÄthunamathaḥ strīśabdasannidhānādgamyate, na tu
gameḥ kevalāt| nayateśca prāpaṇamevārthaḥ pradānabhūtaḥ,
tadviśeṣaṇantu prādavihaṇamapradhānam| yadyevam,grāmaṃ gamayati grāmāya
gamayatīti ṇante guṇabhūtatvādgamarna sidhyati, gameratra
preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādiko hyarthaḥ prādhānyamanugaccchati, naiṣa doṣaḥ ; na hyatra
grāmo ṇyantasya karma, kiṃ tarhi ? gamereva||

13. caturthī sampradāne| (2.3.13)
ṭhdevadatāya rocate' iti| ṭhrucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ' (1.4.33) iti
saṃpradānasaṃjñā| ṭhpuṣpebhyaḥ spṛhyati' iti| atra ṭhspṛherīpsitaḥ' (1.4.36)
ityanena|
ṭhtādarthye upasaṃkhyānam' iti| taccchabdena caturthyantasyārtho
nirdiśyate| tasmā idaṃ tadartham, tasya bhāvastādarthyam| tatra caturthyā
upasaṃkhyānam u pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam--
ṭhcaturthī' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena tādarthye caturthī
bhavatīti| athavā ṭhcaturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣitaiḥ'(2.1.36) iti
tādarthye caturthyāḥ samāsavacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhavati-- tādarthye'pi
caturthīti|
ṭhklṛpi sampadyamāne' ityādi| klṛptyarthānāṃ dhānūnāṃ prayoge
sampadyamāne kartari saṃpādanakriyāviśiṣṭe caturthī vaktavyā,
vyākhyeyetyarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tameva yogavibhāgamāśritya| tathā
ṭhutpātena jñāpyamāne' ityādāvapi| ṭhmūtrāya kalpate yavāgūḥ' iti|
yavāgūrmūtravikārarūpeṇa bhavatītyarthaḥ| vikārarūpāpatau caturtī
vijñeyā| teneha na bhavati-- devadatasya śālayaḥ saṃpadyanta iti| yadā
cābhedavivakṣā tadā paratvāt prathamaiva bhavati, na caturthī-- mūtramidaṃ
saṃpadyate yavāgūriti, uccāro'yaṃ sampadyate yavaudana iti| yadā tu
ṭhjanikarttṛḥ prakṛtiḥ' (1.4.30) iti prakṛterapādānātvaṃ vivakṣyate
tadā yavāgvā iti pañcamyeva syāt-- mūtraṃ sampadyate yavāgvā iti| 
ṭhvātāya kapilā vidyaut' iti| atra kapilāvidyaudutpāto vātasya
lakṣaṇam| tena jñāpyamāne vāte caturthī bhavati| ṭharocakine' iti|
ṭhata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) itīniḥ||

14. kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ| (2.3.14)
ṭhkriyārthā kriyopapadaṃ yasya' ityādi| kathaṃ punarayamartho labhyate,
yāvatā neha sūtre dvitīyaṃ kriyāgrahaṇamupātamastītyāha--
ṭhtumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' (3.3.10) ityasmin viṣaye
kriyārthopapadaṃ sambhavatīti yadatra kriyārthopapadaṃ tat kriyaiveti
gamyate| ṭhsthāninaḥ'iti| śabdāstiṣṭhantyasminniti sthānam|
tadasyāstīti sthāni| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yasyārthaḥ pratīyate, na tu
prayogo'sti, sa sthānītyucyata iti|
ṭhedhebhyo vrajati'iti| āṅpūrvo haratiratra sthānī, tatkarma tvedhāḥ|
edhānāhartu vrajatītyarthaḥ| nanu cātra tādarthyamasti, atastādarthyaṃ
ityevaṃ siddhā caturthī, tatkimarthaṃmidaṃ vananam ? niyamārtham-
sthānino'prayujyamānasyaiva karmaṇi yathā syāt, prayujyamānas mā
bhūt| ṭhbhakṣiratra sthānī' iti| praviśa gṛhaṃ piṇḍaĀ bhakṣayeti
gamyamānatvāt| praviśa tarpaṇamityatrāpi pibatiḥ sthānī| ṭhna tu
kriyārthopapadaḥ' iti| tumunnādiviśiṣṭapratyayānto hi
kriyārthopapado bhavati| ayantu loḍantaḥ| na ca loṭ kriyārthopapade
vidhīyata iti na bhavati bhakṣiratra kriyārthopapadaḥ||

15. tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt| (2.3.15)
ṭhtumunā samānārthaḥ' iti| vṛtau gamyamānatvāt samānaśabdo na
prayuktaḥ| ṭhtumarthabhāvavacanapratyayāntāt' iti| tumartho
bhāvavacanapratyayo'nto yasya sa tathoktaḥ| ṭhbhāvavacanāśceti vakṣyati,
tasyedaṃ grahaṇam' iti| sa eva hi tumartho bhāvavacanaḥ sambhavati,
nānyaḥ| ṭhpākāya vrajati' iti| yadyapyatra tādarthyaṃ gamyate tathāpi caturthī
na bhavati; tasminneva tādarthyaṃ vihitena bhāvapratyayena
tasyoktatvāt,yathā-- pācako vrajatītyatra na bhavati| tena
caturthīvidhānārthamidamārabdham| atha vā-- bhāvavacanādeva yathā
syāt, iha mā bhūt-- pācako vrajatīti niyamārthaṃmetat| ṭhpākaḥ,
tyāgaḥ, rāgaḥ' iti bhāve ghañ| nanu ca
kriyārthopapadagrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, tadarthādvibhaktervipariṇāmaṃ
kṛtvaivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate-- kriyārthopapadādbhāvavacanāditi|
yastu kriyārthopapado bhāvavacanaḥ sa tumartha eveti kiṃ
tumarthagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; na hi kriyārthopapadagrahaṇaṃ bhāvavacanasya
viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati| kiṃ tarhi ? dhātoreva| tasmāt tumarthagrahaṇaṃ
kartavyameva| ṭhkārako vrajati'iti-- ṭhtumunṇvulau' (3.3.10) iti
ṇvul| bhavatyayaṃ tumartho na tu bhāvavacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? kartṛvacanaḥ,
tena tadantānna bhavati||

16. namaḥsvastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍaḷagācca| (2.3.16)
ṭhalamiti paryāptyarthasya grahaṇam' iti. ṭhtasmai prabhavati
santāpādibhyaḥ' (5.1.101) ityalaṃśabdasamānārthena prabhavatiśabdena yoge
caturthīnirdeaśālliṅgāt| nanu cāsmālliṅgādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇam,
na tu śabdasyetyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate; na tu
paryāptyarthasyetyeṣo'rthaḥ| tathā ca bhūṣaṇapratiṣedayorapi grahaṇaṃ
syāt| evañca kanyāmalaṃkurute, alaṃ bāle rodanenetyādāvapi
caturthī syāt; naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
bhaviṣyati, katham ? kanyāmalaṅkurute ityatra ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ
kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' (cāṃ.pa.69) iti ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) iti
dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyam| ṭhalaṃ bāle rodanena' ityatrāpyata eva
hetoḥ karaṇe tṛtīyayaiva| atra hi rodanaṃ karaṇabhāvamāpannameva
pratiṣedhena sambadhyata iti sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasya grahaṇaṃ sampadyate|
ṭhcakāraḥ punarasyaiva samuccayārthaḥ' iti| yadetannamaḥprabhṛtiyoge
caturthīvidhānaṃ tatsamuccayārthaścakāraḥ| tena punarvidhnāt ṭhcaturthī
cāśiṣyāyuṣya' (2.3.73) ityādināśīrvivakṣāyāṃ pakṣe yā ṣaṣṭhī
vidhīyate tāmapi bādhitvā caturthyeva bhavati| yadyavam,
kārakavibhaktimapi bādhitvā ṭhkanyāmalaṅkurute' ityādau
caturthyeva syāt, tataśca yaduktam- sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasyaiva
grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, tannopapadyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
kārakavibhakterbalīyastvāt, punarvidhānasya cānyatra caritārthatvāt|
atha vā-- vakṣyamāṇā vibhāṣā siṃhāvalokitanyāyenehāpyupatiṣṭhate|
tena ṭhkanyāmalaṅkurute ityādau caturtī na bhavati||

17.manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu| (2.3.17)
ṭhanādarastiraskāraḥ' iti| atraivānādaraśabdasya rūḍhatvāt| tiraskāraḥ
u paribhavaḥ, avajñānamityarthaḥ| ṭh na tvā tṛṇāya manye' iti| tṛṇādapi
nikṛṣṭataraṃ tvāmahaṃ ityarthaḥ| ṭh vikaraṇanirdeaśaḥ kimarthaḥ' iti|
ṭhmanikarmaṇi' iti kasmānnoktam ? eva hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti ? ṭhmana
jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176) ityasya daivādikasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, ṭhmanu
bodhane' (dhā.pā.1471) ityasya tānādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartho
vikaraṇanirdeaśa iti darśayitumāha- ṭhna tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manve' iti|
ṭhaśmānaṃ dṛṣadaṃ manye' ityādau yathāvyavasthitasya vastunaḥ
svarūpamāviṣkriyata ityatrānādaro na gamyate| 
ṭhyedatadaprāṇiṣviti tadanāvādiṣviti vaktavyam' iti|
aprāṇigrahaṇapanīyanāvādigrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| yathānyāse hi na
tvā nāvaṃ manya ityatra caturthī syāt| na tvā śune manya ityatra caturthī
na syādityabhiprāyaḥ||

18. kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā| (2.3.18)
ṭhtṛtīyāvidhāne pprakṛtayādīnām'itivṛtau pāṭhaḥ} prakṛtyādibhya
upasaṃkhyānam' iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ? na siddhyati,
kartṛkaraṇayorabhāvāt| tayostvabhāvaḥ prakṛtyā'bhirūpa ityādau
kriyāyā avidyamānatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| prātipadikenātra sambandamātraṃ
pratīyate, na tu kācana kriyā| na ca tayā vinā kartṛkaraṇe
sambhavataḥ; tayoḥ kriyāpekṣatvāt| tataśca sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī
syāt-- prakṛterabhirūpaḥ, prāyasya yājñikaḥ, gotrasya gārgya iti|
ṭhsamena dhāvati, viṣameṇa dhāvati' iti| yadyapyatra kriyā'pyasti,
tathā'pi nātra samaviṣamaśabdau karaṇatvena vivakṣitau, kiṃ tarhi ?
karmatvena, tataśca dvitīyā syāt| ṭhdvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti'
ityādāvapi dvidroṇātyeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ| ṭhpañcakena paśūn
krīṇāti' iti| pañca parimāṇamasya paśusaṃghasya pañcakaḥ saṅghaḥ|
pañcakaṃ saṅghaṃ kṛtvā paśūn krīṇātītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ṭhsāhasreṇāśvān
krīṇāti'iti sāhasraṃ saṅghaṃ kṛtvā| sahasraṃ sahasraṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ|
upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanārthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam--
pratīyamānā'pi kriyā kārakāṇāṃ nimitaṃ bhavatyeva| iha ca
prakṛtyā'bhirūpa ityatrāpi karotyartho bhavatyartho vā gamyate|
gārgyo'smi gotreṇetyatrāpi jñāne bhavane vā gamyamāne gotrasya
karaṇatvaṃ pratīyate| samena dhāvatītyadau samena viṣameṇa vā pathā
karaṇeneti gamyate| dvidroṇenetyatrāpi tṛtīyā na karmatvaṃ
bodhayati| kiṃ tarhi ? karaṇatvam| atra hi dvidroṇādyarthaṃ hiraṇyādikaṃ
mūlyabhūtaṃ tādarthyāddvidroṇādiśabdenoktam| tasyāpi
karaṇatvamastyeveti karaṇa ityevaṃ sarvatra tṛtīyā siddhyati|| 

19. sahayukte'pradhāne| (2.3.19)
kriyāguṇadravyasambandhe hi sati sahayogo bhavati| ataḥ ṭhputreṇa
sahāgataḥ' ityādīni kriyādisambandhe yathākramudāharaṇāni
vṛtikṛtopanyastāni| sarvatra ca putrasyātrāpradhānyamiti tatastṛtīyā
bhavati| nanu cobhayorapi pitāputrayoḥ kriyādisambandhaḥ pratīyate,
tatkutaḥ putrasyāprādhānyamitarasya pradhānabhāva ityāha-- ṭhpituratra'
ityādi| ṭhyadypyubhayagataḥ kriyādisambandhaḥ pratīyate,
tathā'pyupātaśabdavyāpārāpakṣayā pradhānāpradhānavyavasthāḥ-- śabdena
yasya kriyādisambandhaḥ pratyāyyate tat pradhānamitaradapradhānamiti| iha
tu piturava kriyādisaṃbandhaḥ pratyāyyate śabdena, na tu putrasya |
kuta etat ? śabdaśaktasvābhāvyāt| tathāvidhā hi śabdaśaktiryataḥ
piturevātra kriyādisambandhaṃ śnoti pratipādayitum, na
putrasyeti; evañcāgata ityādavekavacanamupapadyate; anyathā hi
dvitvāddvivacanaṃ syāt, yathā-- pitatāputrāvāgatāviti| ṭhputrasya
tu pratīyamānatvādaprādhānyam' iti| arthātsa punararthaḥ sahārthayogaḥ|
sa ca bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt putrasya kriyādisambandhamantareṇa na
sambhavatīti sambandhasya nāntarīyakatvāt putrasyāpi kriyādisambandhaṃ
pratyāyayati| ṭhsahārthena yoge tṛtīyāvidhānāt' iti| kutaḥ
punaretadavagataṃ sahārthena yoge tṛtīyāvidhānamiti ?
yuktagrahaṇāt| tasya caitadeva prayojanam-- sahārthena yoge tṛtīyā
yathā syāt, nānyat| ṭhśiṣyeṇa sahopādhyāyasya gauḥ' iti| atra
dravyasambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷṬvopādhyāyasyocyata ityasya prādhānyāt|
tatrāsatyapradhānagrahaṇe pradhāne'pyupādhyāye syāt| nanu ca paratvāt
ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati? na bhaviṣyati; aśeṣatvāt| sati tvapradhānagrahaṇe
śeṣo'yaṃ sampadyata iti ṣaṣṭhī||

20. yenāṅgavikāraḥ| (2.3.20)
ayamaṅgaśabdo'vayave prasiddhaḥ| sa yadi tatraiva vartamāna iha gṛhyate
tadā'traiva syāt-- akṣi kāṇamasyeti; atra hyakṣṇaḥ śarīrāvayavasya
vikāraḥ kāṇena guṇena dyotyata iti| iha tu na syāt-- akṣṇā kāṇa
iti| na hyatrāvayavasyākṣṇo vikāro lakṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? aṅganaḥ
samudāyasyetyata āha-- ṭhaṅgaśabdo'tra'ityādi|
aṅgamasyāstītyaṅgaḥ, arśa āditvādacpratyayānto'ṅgaśabda upāta
iti darśayati; aṅgino'ṅgāpekṣatvāt|
yadapekṣayā'ṅgino'ṅgitvaṃ tadeva yenetyanena nirdiśyata iti
darśayitumāha-- ṭhyena' ityādi| vikṛteneti sāmarthyāllabdhamarthaṃ
darśayati| na hyavikṛtenāṅganino'ṅgena vikāro lakṣyate|
ṭhlakṣyate' iti| dyotyata ityarthaḥ| ṭhakṣṇā kāṇaḥ' iti| atrākṣṇā'vayavena
vikṛtenāṅgino devadatasya vikāro lakṣyata iti tatsatṛtīyā|
vibhaktirbhavati| kathaṃ punaravayavena vikṛtena samudāyastathā
vyapadiśyata ityāha-- ṭhavayavadharmeṇa' ityādi| yāthā'ḍhaḷmidaṃ
nagaramityavayavadharmeṇāḍhaḷtvenātra samudāyo vyapadiśyate,
tathehāpyavayavena vikṛtana samudāyo vyapadiśyata iti| kathaṃ
punaratrākṣiśabdasya prayogaḥ kriyate, yāvatā vinā'pi tena kāṇatvaṃ
guṇaḥ samudāyasya pratīyata eva ? satyametat; laukike śabdaprayoge
gurulāghanaṃ pratyanādarāt| yastu tadādriyate so'kṣiśabdaṃ na
prayuṅkta eva|
ṭhakṣi kāṇamasya' iti| atrāsatyaṅgagrahaṇe kāṇaśabdāt tṛtīyā syāt|
lakṣyate hi kāṇatvena guṇenākṣṇo vikāraḥ samudāyasyāvayavasya||

21. itthambhūtalakṣaṇe| (2.3.21)
kañcit prakāramityanena ityamityasyārthamācaṣṭe| tathā hi
prakāravacane ṭhidamasthamuḥ' (5.3.24) iti thamupratyaye vihite
itthamityedrūpaṃ bhavati| sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāra ucyate|
āpanna ityanena bhūtaśabdsayārthamācaṣṭe| tathā hi-- ṭhbhū
prāptāvātmanepadī' (dhā.pā.1844) ityasya caurādikasya ṭhā dhṛṣādvā'
(dhā.pā.805) ityasyānantaram) iti yadā ṇij nāsti tadā ktapratyaye
ṭhbhūta' iti rūpaṃ bhavati| tasyetītvambhūtasya | ṭhlakṣaṇam' iti| lakṣyate
cihnyate'neneti lakṣaṇam u cihnam| ṭhapi bhavān kamaṇḍalunā
chātramādrākṣīt' iti| atra manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, tasya cchātratvaṃ
prakāraḥca; taṃ prāptasya cchātrasya kamaṇḍalurlakṣaṇam|
ṭhchātreṇopādhyāyam' iti| manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, tasyopādhyāyatvaṃ
prakāraḥ; taṃ prāptasyopādhyāyasya lakṣaṇaṃ chātraḥ| ṭhśikhayā
parivrājakam' iti| manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, parivrājakatvaṃ prakāraḥ|
taṃ prāptasya parivrājakasya lakṣaṇaṃ śikhā|
ṭhlakṣaṇasya samāse'ntarbhūtatvāt' iti| ekārthībhāvad bahuvrīhyarthena
lakṣaṇārthasyāpṛthagbhāvādityarthaḥ| bahuvrīhāveva vācyatvenāntarbhāvo
lakṣaṇasyeti gatārthatvāt tṛtīyā na bhavati| itthambhūtalakṣaṇa iti
kim ? vṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate vidyaut| nātra vidyotanatvaprāptasya
kasyacidvṛkṣeṇa lakṣaṇam| kiṃ tarhi ? vidyotanasyaiva||

22. saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi| (2.3.22)
ṭhmātrā sañjānīte' iti| ṭhjñānanorjā' (7.3.79) iti jādeśaḥka, ṭhī
halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itītvam, ṭhsaṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne' (1.3.46)
ityātmanepadam| ādhyāne tu ṭhadhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi' (2.3.52) iti
paratvāt ṣaṣṭhī bhavati-- mātuḥ sañjānātīti| kṛtprayoge
cānādhyāne'pi ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti paratvāt
ṣaṣṭhaḷeva bhavati-- saṃjñāteti||

23. hetau| (2.3.23)
heturdvividhaḥ-- śāstrīyaḥ,laukikaśca| tatra śāstrīyaḥ ṭh tatprayojako
hetuśca' (1.4.55)| laukikaḥ phalasādhanayogyaḥ padārthaḥ| tatra śāstrīye
hetau ṭhkartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' (2.3.18) ityevaṃ siddhā tṛtīyā|
tasmāllaukikasya hetoridaṃ grahaṇamityata āha-- ṭhphalasādhanayogyaḥ'
ityādi| aniṣpādayannapi phalaṃ tāsāśanayogyaḥ padārtho loke
heturityucyata iti yogyagrahaṇam| ṭhdhanena kulam' ityādau
kulādīnyakurvantyapi dhanādīni tatkaraṇayogyatayā loke
hetuvaypabadeśamāsādayantīti tebhyastṛtīyā| iha yūpāya dārviti
sadapi dāruṇo hetutvaṃ na vivakṣitam| kiṃ tarhi ?
kāraṇasyānyathātvam| tena tādarthye caturthī bhavati|| 

24. akartaryṛṇe pañcamī| (2.3.24)
ṭhśatena bandhitaḥ'iti| bandherṇyantasya niṣṭhāyāmetadrūpam|
ṭhśatamṛṇañca bhavati'iti| utamarṇāya deyatvāt| prayojakatvāt
kartṛsaṃjñeti, ṭhtatprayojako hetuśca' (1.4.55) iti cakārāt
kartṛsaṃjñāvidhānāt| nanu laukiko hetuḥ pūrvasūtre gṛhītaḥ,
sa cehānuvartata iti tata eva pañcamī vidhīyate, na cātra laukiko
hetuḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pāribhāṣika iti prāptyabhāvādakartarīti
pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ ? naitadasti;tatra hi śāstrīye hetau tṛtīyā
siddheveti laukikasya hetaurgrahaṇam, iha tu pañcamī vidhīyate| na
cātar#asau śāstrīye hetau kenacit sidhyati| dvāvapīha hetū
gṛhyaete| atha vā śāstrīyasyāpi hetorlaukikaṃ
hetutvamaviruddhameva| yo hi bandhane prayuṅkte sa tatsādhanayogyo
bhavatyeva||

25. vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām| (2.3.25)
ṭhdhanena kulam' iti| dhanaṃ dravyam, na guṇaḥ| dravyāśrito hi guṇo
bhavati, na dravyameva ! guṇaśabdena cātra sambandhimātraṃ
parārtharūpāpannamucyate, tenāgniratra dhūmādityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati|
nanu cāstriyāmityucyate, tena nāstīha ghaṭo'nupalabdherityādi na
sidhyati ? naitadasti;ṭhvibhāṣā guṇe' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ|tena
yatreṣyate tatraya yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddhiriti striyāmapi bhavatyeva||

26. ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge| (2.3.26)
prayogasya śabdadharmatvāt heturityanena hetuśabda eva vijñāyata
ityata āha--ṭhphetuśabdasya prayoge--kāśikā} hetuśabdaprayoge' iti|
evañca hetuśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇe sati tatparyāṇāṃ
nimitakāraṇādīnāṃ prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatīti kimarthaṃ
punaridamucyate, yāvatā śeṣavivakṣayaivātrādhyayanādibhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhī
bhaviṣyati, tatsamānādhikaraṇyācca hetuśabdādapi ? evaṃ tarhi saiva
śeṣavivakṣā'smin viṣaye vacanenākhyāyate mandadhiyāmanugrahāya||

27. sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca| (2.3.27)
ṭhnimitÂtakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ vibhaktīnāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti|
etaccakārasyānukkatasamuccayārthatvallabhyata iti veditavyam|
yadarthagrahaṇametata kasmāt paryāyopādānaṃ kṛtamitmāha--
ṭhparyāyopādānam' ityādi| asati paryāyagrahaṇa etat
svarūpagrahaṇamiti kasyacidbhrānti syāt| atastannirākartu
paryāyagrahaṇam||

28. apādāne pañcamī| (2.3.28)
ṭhvṛkebhyo bibheti' iti| ṭhbhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ' (1.4.25)
ityapādānatvam| adhyayanāt parājayata ityatra ṭhparājerasoḍhaḥ'
(1.4.26) ityapādānatvam| ṭhviparābhyāñjeḥ' (1.3.19) ityātmanepadam|
ṭhpañcamīvidhāne ityādi| yadetat pañcamīvidhānamatra lyablope
pañcamo syādityupasaṃkhyānam u vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- iha pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvartate| sa
cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī bhaviṣyati|
ṭhadhikaraṇe copasaṃkhyānam' ityādi| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya
pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu
pūrvavaccakārānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya kartavyam|
ṭhpraśnākhyānayośca' ityādi| vaktavyeti vyākhyātavyetyarthaḥ|
vyākhyānantu tāmeva cakārānuvṛtimāśritya kartavyam| atha vā--
atrāpādāna ityevaṃ siddhā pañcamī| tathā hi kuto
bhavānitytarāgaccchatīti pratīyate, pāṭaliputrādityatrāpyagacchāmīti;
ataḥ sphuṭamevāpādānatvam|
ṭhyataścāṣvakāla' ityādi| yataḥ prabhṛtyadhvanaḥ kālasay
nirmāṇamiyatāparicchedastatra pañcamī vaktavyā| etaduktaṃ bhavati--
adhvani kāle ca nirmīyamāṇe yadavaśribhūtatvena vivakṣyate tatra pañcamī
vaktavyā u vyākhyeyā| vyākhyānantu pūrvavaccākārānuvṛtimāśritya
kartavyam| atha vā- adhvani nirmīyamāṇe apādāna ityevaṃ siddhā
pañcamī| tathā hi-- gavīdhumataḥ sāṅkāśyaṃ catvāri yojanānītyatra
niḥsṛtyeti kriyā gamyate| ato yuktamevāpādānatvam| kārtikyā
āgrahāyaṇī māsa ityatrāpi pareṇeti śabdo gamyate| tatrotarasūtreṇa
digyolakṣaṇā pañcamī bhaviṣyati|
ṭhtadyauktātkāle' ityādau tadityanena pañcamī sambadhyate|
pañcamīyuktāt paro yaḥ kālastatra saptamī vaktavyā u vyākhyeyā|
vyākhyānaṃ tu kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇī māsa ityatra ṭhyasya ca bhāvena
bhāvalakṣaṇam'(2.3.37) ityanena saptamī siddhā| kārtikyāḥ paro yo
māsastatsatayā''grahāyaṇyā bhāvo lakṣyate|
ṭhadhvanaḥ prathamā' ityādi| tadyauktāditi vartate| tatra yadā sāṅkāśyasya
yojanādabhedo vivakṣyate tadā prathamā| ṭhgavīṣumataḥ sāṅkāśyaṃ
catvāri yojanāni' iti. bhedavivakṣāyāntu ṭhyasya ca bhāvena
bhāvalakṣaṇam' (2.3.37) iti saptamī| tathā hi gavīdhumataḥ sāṃkāśyaṃ
caturṣu yojaneṣu gateṣu satsu bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate| tatra
yojanasya sambandhi sambandhi gamanaṃ sāṅkāśyabhāvasya lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati|| 

29. anyārāditarartedikśabdāñcūtarapadājāhiyukte| (2.3.29)
ṭhanya ityarthagrahaṇam' iti| arthadvāraka eva hi śabdasya śabdāntaraṇe
yogo bhavati| tasmādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate|
tenetyādinā'rthagrahaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati| athānyo devadatādyajñadata
iti yajñadataśabdādapi pañcamī kasmānna bhavati ? devadatādutpannayā
pañcamyobhayagatasyāpyanyatvasya pratipāditvāt
tadviśiṣṭamanyatvamekata evotpādyamānayā pañcamyā śakyaṃ
pratipādayitumiti dvitīyasambandhinaḥ pañcamī na bhavati|
ṭhitara iti nirdiśyamānasya pratiyogī padārtha ucyate' iti|yathā
kvacitprakaraṇe dvau prakṛtau -- devadataḥ, anyaśca kaścit|
tatraikastāvannirdiśyate-- devadataḥ śūra iti| tasya nirdiśyamānasya
yo'sau dvitīyaḥ sambandhī pratiyogī sa itaraśabdenocyate,
yathā--itaraḥ kātara iti| 
ṭhśabdagrahaṇam'ityādi| śabdagrahaṇe sati diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda
iteṣo'rtho labhyate | tena yo'pi samprati dikśabdo deśe kāle ca
vartate, so'pi diśi duṣṭa iti tadyoge pañcamī bhavati| tatra
deśavṛtinā pañcamī-- pūrvo grāmāt parvata iti | kālavṛtinā'pi--
pūrvo grīṣmādvasanta iti| ṭhitarathā hi digvṛtinaiva yoge syāt'
iti| tatraiva dikśabdasya mukhyatvāt|
ṭhprāggrāmāt' iti| prapūrvādañcaterṛtvigādisūtreṇa (3.2.59)
kvinpratyayaḥ| tadantādyadādiśabdebhyaḥ ṭhsaptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo
digdeśakāla' (5.3.27) ityādinā vihitasya stāteḥ ṭhañcerluk'
(5.3.30) iti luk; luki kṛte tadedamudāharaṇam| ṭhdakṣiṇā
grāmādutarā grāmāt| ṭhdakṣiṇāhi grāmādutarāhi grāmāt' iti|
ṭhdakṣiṇādāca' ṭhāhi ca dūre' (5.3.37) ṭhutarācca' (5.3.38) ityājāhī
pratyayau||

30. ṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthapratyayena| (2.3.30) atasarthāḥ pratyayā dikśabdebhyaḥ
svārtha eva bhavantīti tadantasya dikśabdatvāt pūrveṇa pañcamyāṃ
vacanamidam. ṭhpuro grāmasya' iti|
ṭhpūrvādharāvaṇāmasipuradhavaścaiṣām' (5.3.39) ityādinā'sipratyayaḥ,
pūrśabdasya purādeśaśca| purastādityatrāpi ṭhdikśabdebhyaḥ saptamī'
(5.3.27) ityādinā'stātipratyayaḥ|ṭhastāti ca' (5.3.40) iti purādeśaḥ|
ṭhupari grāmasya, upariṣṭādgrāmasya' iti| ṭhuparyupariṣṭāt' (5.3.31)
ityūrdhvaśabdasyopi ityādeśo rilariṣṭātilau ca pratyayau bhavataḥ|.

31. enapā dvitīyā| (2.3.31) 
ṭhpūrveṇa ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanamidam'iti| enapo'tasarthatvāt|
ṭhtadartho yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ' iti. enapeti pṛthayogaḥ
kartavyaḥ,enapā ṣaṣṭhī yathā syāt| anyathā hi dvitayīyāsau bādhyeta|
tato dvitīyeti dvitīyo yogaḥ, atra cainapeti vartate|| 

32. pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyā'nyatarasyām| (2.3.31)
ṭhpañcamīgrahaṇamanuvartate' iti| svaritatvāt| ime sarve
pṛthagādayo'sahāye'rthe vartante| bhedenopādānantu
paryāyāntaranivṛtyartham| iha tṛtīyāpañcamyau mā bhūtām-- hirug
devadatasya| viṣvag devadatasyeti| tatrāsatyāṃ
pañcamīgrahaṇānuvṛtau yathā hirugityādinā paryāyāntareṇa yoge
ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, tathā pṛthagādibhiryoge pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt, na pañcamī|
tasmāt pañcamīgrahaṇamanuvartanīyam, anuvṛtereva pakṣe bhaviṣyati,
tat kimarthamanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇam ? satyam; tat kṛtañca tasyā
evānuvṛteḥ sūcanārthamutarārthañca||

33.karaṇe ca stokālpakṛchÂarakatipayasyāsatvavacanasya| (2.3.333)
ṭhyadā tu dharmamātram' ityādi| yadyogāddravyaṃ
stokādivyapadeśamāsādayati te guṇā dharmaśabdenocyante| tanmātraṃ
stotādibhiḥ śabdairabhidhīyamānaṃ karaṇatvena yadā vivakṣyate na tu
dravyam, tadā stokādiśabdānāmasatvavacanatā| yadā tu
so'yamityabhedāt tadvati dravye vartante, tadā teṣāṃ satvavanatā
bhavati|
ṭhkriyāviśeṣaṇe mā bhūt' iti| kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvāt karmatvam|
tadviśeṣaṇamapi karma bhavati, taccāsatvaṃ bhavati| kriyaiva hi
tāvaddravyaṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ pustadviśeṣaṇaṃ dravyaṃ bhaviṣyati ?
ekārthatve'pi stokādīnāṃ bhedenopādānāṃ
paryāyāntaranivṛtyartham| iha mā bhūt-- mātrayā mukta iti||

34. dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷntarasyām| (2.3.34)
vikalpena pañcamyāṃ vihitāyāṃ pakṣe śeṣatvādeva yadyapi sidhyati,
tathā'pi tadiha ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat ṭhcaturthī cāśiṣya' (2.3.73)
ityādinā''śiṣi yā caturthī vidhīyate tāmapi bādhitvā ṣaṣṭhaḷeva
yathā syādityevamartham-- dūraṃ hitaṃ grāmasya, antikaṃ hitaṃ
grāmasyeti| nanu cānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ prakṛte punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ
kimarthamityāha-- ṭhanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam' ityādi|
yadīhānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā pakṣe tṛtīyā syāt; tasyā
evānantarasūtre śrutatvāt| punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ
pañcamīvidhānārthaṃ vijñāyate; prayojanāntarābhāvāt| tathā hi--
tṛtīyāvikalpārthaṃ tāvadetanna bhavati| tṛtīyāvikalpo hi
pūrvakeṇānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sidhyati| na cānyā kācidvabhaktiḥ
prakṛtā, kiṃ tarhi ? pañcamī| tasmāt
pañcamīvikalpārthametadvijñāyate||

35. dūradāntikārthabhyo dvitīyā ca| (2.3.35)
ṭhpevamprakārakaṃ vākyaṃ vṛtau nāsti}pañcamī ca' iti|
tadanuvṛtisāmarthyāt| ṭhtṛtīyā'pi samuccīyate' iti| cakāreṇa|
ṭhyathāyatham' iti| yathāsvaṃ yo yasyātmīyo viṣayastatrāsau bhavati,
na vibhaktyantaramityarthaḥ||

36. saptamyadhikaraṇe ca| (2.3.36)
ṭhdūrāntikārthebhyaścatasro vibhaktayo bhavanti' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa
dvitīyādayastisraḥ, anena saptamī|
ṭhsaptamīvidhāne ktasyenviṣayasya' ityādi| inviṣayo yaḥ ktastadīye
karmaṇi saptamī| vidheyā| kaścenviṣaḥ ktaḥ ? yastadantastenaiva saha
prayujyata ityarthaḥ| ananyatrabhāvārthatvādatra viṣayaśabdasya| ṭhadhītī
vyākaraṇe' iti| adhītaṃ vyākaraṇamaneneti| ṭhśrāddhamanena bhuktam'
(5.2.85) ityato'nenetyanuvartamāne ṭhpūrvādīniḥ' (5.2.86) ityata
inirityanuvartamāne ca ṭhiṣṭādibhyaśca' (5.2.88) itīnipratyayaḥ| atra
yadyapi karmaṇyeva kto vihitastathāpi taddhita
utpanne'dhītavyākaraṇorabhisambandho nivartate| asti ca dhātvarthasya
vyākaraṇena sambandha iti karmaiva vyākaraṇaṃ bhavatītyato dvitīyā
syāt, yathā-- kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti| tasmāt saptamyā upasaṃkhyānam u
pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanamÂ-- yo'sāvadhītī
kartā tasya vyākaraṇaṃ viṣamatvena vivakṣyate| tasmādadhikaraṇa ityevaṃ
siddhā saptamī||
ṭhsādhvasādhuprayoge' ityādi| anarcārthamiha sādhuśabdasya grahaṇam|
arcāyāṃ hi ṭhsādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyām' (2.3.43) ityanenaiva siddhā
saptamī| ṭhsādhurdeavadato mātari' ityādi| atrāpyadhikaraṇa eva saptamī|
tathā hyatra mātṛsthāsu kriyāsu mātṛśabdo vartate, pitṛsthāsu
kriyāsu pitṛśabdaḥ; tāsāñca kriyāṇāṃ sādhvasādhutāṃ prati
viṣayabhāvo'stīti vaiṣayikādhikaraṇa eva saptamī| vaktavyaśabdastu
vyākhyeya ityarthe vartate| evamutaratrāpi| 
ṭhkārakārhāṇāñca' ityādi| bhāvapradhāno'tra kārakaśabdaḥ| kriyāṃ prati
yeṣāṃ kārakatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ nyāyyaṃ te kārakārhāḥ, teṣāṃ
kārakārhatve saptamī vaktavyā| ṭhṛddheṣu' ityādi| ṛddhā hi bhujikriyāṃ
prati sādhanabhāvamarhinti| teṣāmeva ceha kārakatvaṃ vivakṣitam|
etadanusāreṇa kārakārhāṇāñcākārakatva ityevamāderartho
veditavyaḥ| atrāpi sarvatra ṭhyasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' (2.3.37)
ityenaiva siddhā saptamī| tathā hi-- ṛddhādisambandhinā
bhujikriyādilakṣaṇenātra bhāvena daridrādisambandhyāsanādibhāvo
lakṣyate|
ṭhcarmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti' ityatra dvīpinanasya nimitaṃ carma, tasya
dvīpinā karmaṇā saha saṃyogaḥ| atrāpi
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt siddhā saptamī| nanu ca
dūrāntikārthānukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥca nārthastadanukarṣaṇārthena
cakāreṇa, saptamīti yogavibhagādeva dūrāntikārthebhyaḥ saptamamī
bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- utarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt
saptamī veditavyā||

37. yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam| (2.3.37)
kīdṛśī punaḥ kriyā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣayatītya ta āha-- ṭhprasiddhā ca'
ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, prasiddhaivetyarthaḥ| na hi svayamaprasiddhaṃ
parasya lakṣaṇamupapadyate| atha kathaṃ phalāyāmāneṣvāmreṣu gataḥ,
paktevaṣvāgata ityatra saptamī, na hīha bhāvaḥ śrūyate ? yadyapi na śrūyate
? tathā'pi gamyate| phalāyamāneṣu jāteṣvityarthaḥ||

38. ṣaṣṭhī cānādare| (2.3.38)
anādaraḥ tiraskāraḥ, paribhava ityarthaḥ| ṭhrudataḥ' iti| ṭhrudir
aśruvimocane' (dhā.pā.1067) śatṛpratyayaḥ||

39. svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca| (2.3.39)
svāmīśvarādhipatīnāmekārthatve'pi bhedenopādānaṃ

40. āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām| (2.3.40)
āyuktatā nipuṇatā ca kaṭādikaraṇaviṣayaiveti saptamyāmeva

41. yataśca nirdhāraṇam| (2.3.41)
kimarthaṃ punaridam ? yāvatā nirdhāryamāṇo'vayavaḥ
samudāyāntarbhūtaḥ; tatra yadā samudāyāsyādhikaraṇatvaṃ vivakṣyate
tadā saptamī siddhaiveti, yathā-- vṛkṣe śākheti; yadā
tvavayavāvayavisambandhastadā ṣaṣṭhī, yathā-- vṛkṣasya śākheti ?
satyametat; prapañcārtha vacanam||

42. pañcamī vibhakte| (2.3.42)
ṭhvibhāgo vibhaktam' iti| ṭhnapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| ṭh
yasminnirdhāraṇāśraye' iti| yato nirdhārayate sa iha nirdhāraṇāśraya
iti sarvasminneva nirdhāraṇāśraye vibhāgostīti
viśeṣaṇopādānasārthyādvibhāga eva yatra sa nirdhāraṇāśrayo
vijñāyate; tena kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratametyatra na bhavati| tathā
hi-- goṣu nirdhāryamāṇa ekadeśo yasmāt gotvenāntarbhūtaḥ
pratīyate tasmānnāsti vibhāga iti| yadā tu kṛṣṇena guṇena
pathagbhūtaḥ pratīyate tadāsti vibhāga iti| nātra nirdhāraṇāśrayo
vibhāga eva| iha punarmāthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhaḷtarā iti
māthuratvena nāpyāḍhaḷtaratvena māthurāṇāmantarbhāvaḥ| tas #adatra
vibhāga evetyayamasya yogasya viṣayaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ-- yatra rāśīkṛtya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ sa pūrvasya yogasya
viṣayaḥ; yatra tu pṛthagbhūtasyaiva guṇāntarāviṣkaraṇaṃ so'sya; tatra
dvayorapyavasthayorvibhāga eveti kṛtvā ayamapi yogaḥ prapañcārtha eva|
vibhāgo hi samnabdhātpracyutiḥ| pāṭaliputrakāśca sambandhāt
pracyavamānānāṃ māthurāṇāṃ sambandhe
pracyuteravadhibhāvamupavāntītyapādāna ityevaṃ pañcamī siddhā||

43. sādhunipuṇābhyamarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ| (2.3.43)
ṭhpapratyādibhirahita vaktavyam' iti vṛtau pāṭhaḥ|} apratyāderiti
vaktavyam' iti| ke punaḥ pratyādayaḥ ? yeṣāṃ ṭhlakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyāna'
(1.4.90) ityādinā karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā te pratiparyanavaḥ
ityādayaḥ||

44. prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca|
prasitaśabdo'yaṃ guṇavacano'pyasti-- prakṛṣṭaḥ sitaḥ prasitaḥ,
kriyāśabdo'pyasti-- ṭhṣiñ bandhane' (dhā.pā.1477) ityasya prapūrvasay
niṣṭhāyāṃ vyutpādyate, tatrehotsukaśabdena kriyāśabdena sāhacaryāt
kriyāśabdo vijñāyata ityata āha-- ṭhprasitaḥ prasaktaḥ' iti| ṭhyastatra
nityamevābaddhaḥ sa prasitaśabdenocyate' iti| ābaddha ivābaddhaḥ, yo hi
yatra prasaktaḥ sa tatrābaddha iva bhavati| ṭhkeśaiḥ prasitaḥ, keśeṣu prasitaḥ'
ityādi| prasitatvamutsukatvañca keśaviṣayamiti ṭhsaptamyadhikaraṇe'
(2.3.36) ityeva siddhā saptamī pakṣe tṛtīyāvidhānārtha vacanam||

45.nakṣatre ca lupi| (2.3.45)
nakṣatre ca lupīti subvyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamīvidhānam| ata
evāha-- ṭhlabantānnakṣatraśabdāt' ityādi. ṭhpuṣyeṇa' ityādi| ṭhnakṣatreṇa
yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) iti vihitasyāṇaḥ ṭhlubaviśeṣe' (4.2.4) iti
lup| pañcāleṣu vasatītyatrāpi ṭhtasya nivāsaḥ' (2.3.36) iti
vihitasyāṇaḥ ṭhjanapade lup' (4.2.81) iti lupÂ|
ṭhmaghāsu grahaḥ' iti| sāmīpye'dhikaraṇa eva saptamī| atra ṭhnakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ
kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityasyārthasyāvivakṣitatvādaṇ na bhavati| ṭhadya puṣyaḥ'
iti| pūrvavadaṇ, lup| ṭhadhikaraṇe' (2.3.36) ityanuvartate| na
cehādhikaraṇatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ||

46. prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā| (2.3.46)
ṭhprātipadikārthaḥ satā'iti| yadi jātistadā devadatādau na syāt|
atha sato bhāvaḥ satā, tadākāśakusumādau na syādityāha--
prādipadikārthaḥ sateti| yatrārthāntaranirapekṣā śabdasya pravṛtiḥ sa
sarvaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ| satāgrahaṇantūpalakṣaṇārtham| uccairnīcaiḥ' iti|
atroccaiḥ śabdasya svārthe jātyādyarthāntanirapekṣaḥ vṛtiḥ| atra ca
prathamāyāḥ prayojanam-- ṭhsapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā' (8.1.26) iti
vikalpena temayādividhiryathā syāt-- grāma uccaiste svam, grāma
uccaistava svamiti| padasaṃjñā tu ṣaṣṭhaḷa'pi syādeva| 
ṭhkumārī, vṛkṣaḥ, kuṇḍam' iti| nanu cātrāpi prātipadikārtha
ityevaṃsiddhā prathamā; liṅgamapi prātipadikārtha eva bhavati| tathā ca
vakṣyata ṭhstriyām' (4.1.3) ityatra ṭhsiddhāstu striyāḥ
prātipadikaviśeṣaṇatvāt svārthe ṭābādayaḥ' (vā.4.13) iti ?
naitadasti; idamapi hi tatra vakṣyati-- ṭhatha vā punaridamastu|
striyāmabhidheyāyām' (ma.bhā.4.1.3) iti| kiñca-- strītavaṃ pratyeṣā
gatiḥ syāt, puṃnapuṃsake tu niyogato vibhaktivācye eva| tathā
hi-- vinā vibhaktyā taṭaśabdāḥ pratyujyamānaḥ kiṃ puṃstvamācaṣṭe ? uta
napuṃsakatvam ? iti sandehaḥ syāt| tatra yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityatra
prātipadikārthenānupāte svasvāmikasambandhe tasya cābhidhāne
vibhaktyapakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, tathā puṃnapuṃsakayorapi ṣaṣṭhī syāt|
tasmālliṅgagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|
ṭhdroṇaḥ, khārī, āḍhakam' iti| nanu cātrāpi prātipadikārthatvādeva
sidhyati prathamā, tathā hi -- droṇādayaḥ śabdāḥ parimāṇe lauhe
dārumaye vā arthāntaranipekṣā eva vartante ? satyam; sidhyati tadā
yadā parimāṇa eva vartante, yadā tu punaḥ parimeye vartante tadā na
sidhyati| tathā hi-- droṇādayaḥ śabdā droṇādikaṃ parimāṇamarthāntaraṃ
pravṛtinimitamupādāya vrīhyādau parimeyaṃ vartante| kathaṃ punaste
tatra vartante ? so'yamityabedasambandhāt- droṇaparimito
vrīhirdroṇa iti | yadyevam, nimitarūpeṇa
nimitano'bhidhānādavyatirikta eva prātipadikārtha iti
prātipadikārtha ityeva siddhā prathamā ? na sidhyati, na hi mukhye sati
gauṇasyāśrayaṇaṃ yuktam| nanvevamapi liṅgagrahaṇādevātra prathamā
bhaviṣyati, tatkiṃ parimāṇagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; tasya hi yatra
parimāṇaṃ nāsti so'vakāśa iti| atra parimāṇādhikye ṣaṣṭhaḷeva
syāt| tasmāt parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|
parimāṇagrahaṇañca yatra nimitādarthāntare
so'yamityabhedasambandhāccchabdaḥ pravartate, tadupalakṣaṇārtha
veditavyam| tena parimāṇavadarthāntarabhūteṣvapyunmānādiṣu prathamā
bhavati| ghṛtam, palam, dīrgha kāṣṭham, śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, hasto
muṣṭirvitastirityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| kuta etat ? mātraśabdāt|
sa hyatra vyāptivacano gṛhyate, yathā-- kanyāmātraṃ varayati, brāhmaṇamātraṃ
bhojayatīti| tena parimāṇagrahaṇasyaivopalakṣaṇārthatā vijñāyate yadi
tu yathā ṭhpayomātraṃ bhuṅkte' ityatra mātraśabdo niyamārthaḥ,
tathehāpi niyamārtha eva syāt; tataśconmānādiṣu prathamā na syāt;
tasya parimāṇādanyatvāt-- ukteṣvapyekatvādiṣu prathamā yathā
syāditi|
vacanagrahaṇe tvasatyukteṣvekatvādiṣu prathamā na syāt| ṭhanabhihite'
(2.3.1) ityadhikārāt| nanu ca parigaṇanaṃ tatra kṛtam, tat
kuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ ? naitadasti; pratyākhyātaṃ hi tatra parigaṇanam|
tathā hi--rūḍhaḥ karma, bhīṣmādayo'pi karmaṇi, tatra karmāṇi, tatra
karmaṇītyeva dvitīyā siddhā| kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyayā
sāmānyakarmoktam, na viśeṣakarma| tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣo vaktavya iti
bhīṣmādibhyo'pi viśeṣābhidhānārtha dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- kaṭa
eva karma, tatsāmānādhakaraṇyāt bhīṣmādibhyo'pi dvitīyā bhaviṣyati;
nārthaḥ parigaṇanena| 
yatpunaridaṃ ṭhtiṅkṛtaddhitasamāsaiḥ parisaṃkhyānam' (2.3.1) iti
vṛtāvupanyasatm, tadebhirevābhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti
sambhavapradarśanārthaparaṃ veditavyam| yadyapyekādibhirapi
saṃkhyāśabdairektavādīnāmabhidhānaṃ sambhavati, tathā'pyabhihite'pi
tairetkatvādāvarthe vacanagrahaṇāt yatnāt vibhaktyeti|
tairapyabhidhānasya sambhavapradarśanārtha yatnaḥ kṛtaḥ|
ṭhnipātarasyānarthakasya' ityādi| athārthaviśeṣaṇārtha prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ
kasmānna vijñāyate ? asati hi tasmin na jñāyate-- kasyārtha iti, tathā
cārthamātre prathamā syāt ? naitadasti;prātipadikāddhi prathamā
vidhīyate| tatrāsati prātipadikagrahaṇe prātipadikārtha eva bhavatīti
vijñāyate| tasyādvṛtikāroktameva prātipadikagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ
nyāyyam||

47. sambodhane ca| (2.3.47)
sambodhanam u abhimukhīkaraṇam, "tadadhike prātipadikrathā" iti|
abhimukhīkaraṇasya kriyāparatvāt prātipadikārthe tasyāntarbhāvo
nāsti, tsayātadātmakatvāt, tasmāta tenādhikaḥ prātipadikārtho
bhavati| atha kathamiha prathamā-he-pacanam, he pacamāneti ? kathañca na
syāt ? śatṛśānajbhyāmuktatvāt sambodhanasya| etāvapi ṭhsambodhane
ca' iti sambodhana eva vakṣyate| mā bhūdanena, pūrvasūtreṇa bhaviṣyati ?
sambodhanārthasyeha ṭhkṛtaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) ityanena
prātipadikārthatvāt| yogavibhāga utarārthaḥ||

48. sā''mantritam| (2.3.48)
ṭhtadantaṃ śabdarūpam' iti| nanu ca ṭhsaṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe
tadantavidhirnāsti' (pu.pa.vṛ.81) iti jñāpitametat ṭhsuptiṅntaṃ
padam' (1.4.14) ityatrāntagrahaṇena| iha ca saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇam,
tat kathaṃ tadantasya saṃjñā vidhīyate ? naitadasti; yadyapi saṃjñāvidhau
pratyayagrahaṇamiha, tathā'pi tadantasyaiveyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate| yadīha
pratyayamātrasya saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ syāt tadā pradeśeṣu tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
syāt, tathā ca saṃjñākaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| pradeśeṣu sambodhana
ityevaṃ brūyāt| evamapi pratyayamātrasya grahaṇaṃ labhyata eva| tasyaiva
sambodhane vihitatvāt| tasmāt saṃjñākaraṇādeva tadantasya saṃjñā
labhyate| seti vacanaṃ pūrvasūtreṇāpi sambodhane yā vihitā tasyā
apīyaṃ saṃjñā yathā syāt-- he pacan, he pacamānetyatra| asati
tvasmin ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti
pūrvasūtreṇaiva yā vihitā tasyā eva syāt; setyetaducyamānaṃ
sarvanāmapadaṃ sāmānyena pravartata iti kṛtvā| ataḥ sambodhanamātre yā
prathamā tāṃ pratipādayati, tena sarvatra saṃjñā siddhā bhavati|
āmantritasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ he devadata ityādau ṭhāmantritasya' (6.1.198)
ityādyaudātatvaṃ bhavati| ṭhāmantritam' iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇaṃ
vaicitryārtham||

49. ekavacanaṃ sambuddhiḥ| (2.3.49)
ṭhhe paṭo, he devadata' iti| atra sambuddhisaṃjñāyāṃ satyām,
ṭhsambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) ityadhikṛtya ṭhhrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) iti guṇe
ṭheṅ hrasvāt sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sorlopo yathāyogaṃ bhavati| atha
sugrahaṇameva kasmānna kṛtam, na ca saptamībahuvacanasya prasaṅgaḥ,
sambodhanaprathamādhikārāt ? satyam; kintu naitadasti; pratyayamātrasya
saṃjñāvidhānārthamekavacanagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam-- he pacanam,
hepacamāneti; anyathā hi pūrveṇa yathā tadantasya saṃjñā vihitā
tathehāpi syāt| na cehāsaṃjñinaḥ kaścidviśeṣo'ṅgīkriyata iti
suśabdena tadantameva lakṣyate, tataśca tadantakasyaiva saṃjñā syāt|
tathā ṭheṅ hrasvāt sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sorlopo vidhīyamānaḥ
ṭhādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityādereva syāt; pratyayamātrasya na syāt|
tasmāt pratyayamātrasya saṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthamekavacanagrahaṇam||

50. śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī| (2.3.50)
karmādīnāṃ prakṛtatvāt tadapekṣayā śeṣatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--
ṭhkarmādibhyo yo'nyaḥ' iti| karmādayaḥ kārakaviśeṣāstasya sambandhasya
hetubhūtāḥ, sa tu phalabhūtaḥ| hetuphalayośca prasiddhamanyatvamiti
tebhyo'nyo bhavati| prātipadikārthapvyatiriktaḥ-kāśikā.padamañjarī
ca} vyatirekaḥ| vyatirekaḥ u ādhikyam| atha vā-- yena
prātipadikārtho vyatiricyate u vyatirekīkriyate sa vyatirekaḥ|
prātipadikārthasya vyatirekaḥ u prātipadikārthavyatirekaḥ| sa śeṣaḥ|
kaḥ punarasavityāha-- ṭhsvasvāmikasambandhādiḥ' iti|
ādiśabdenovayavāvayaviprabhṛteḥ sambandhasya grahaṇam| sambandhaśca
yadyapi dviṣṭhastathāpi tasyaikatvādekata eva sambandhina utpadyamānayā
ṣaṣṭhaḷa vibhaktyā'bhihitatvāt dvitīyāsambandhinaḥṣaṣṭhī na bhavati|
ekasmādutpadyamānā'pi ṣaṣṭhī viśeṣaṇādeva bhavati ; na viśeṣyāt|
viśeṣyātu prathamaiva bhavati; yasmāccheṣaśabdo'yaṃyathā
prakṛtādanyaviśeṣaṇamācaṣṭe tathā parārthamapi| evaṃ hyabhiyuktāḥ puruṣā
upadiśanti-- śeṣaḥ parārtha iti| rājñā puruṣa iti
svasvāmikasambandasyodāharaṇam | atra puruṣasya prādānyam,
viśeṣyatvāt| rājño'prādhānyam, viśeṣaṇatvāt| viśeṣaṇasya
parārthatvāt śeṣabhāva iti tataḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| yadā tu dvāvapi
viśeṣaṇabhūtau tṛtīye sambandhinyapekṣitau bhavataḥ, tadā dvābhyāmapi
ṣaṣṭhī bhavati ṭhrājñaḥ puruṣasya gṛham' iti|
ṭhpaśoḥ pādaḥ' iti| atrāvayavāvayisambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| ṭhpituḥ putraḥ'
ityatra janyajanakasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| atha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā
ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādau pratyaniyamo'rthaniyamaśceti
dvāvapi pakṣau| tatra pratyayaniyamapakṣe yadi śeṣagrahamaṃ na kriyeta tadā
karmaṇyeva dvitīyeti karmāniyatam, dvitīyā tu niyatā; atastatrāpi
ṣaṣṭhī syāditi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| śeṣa eva yathā syādanyatra
mābhūditi arthaniyamapakṣe tu śeṣagrahamaṃ śakyamakartum| yāvatā
karmaṇi dvitīyaivaiti karma niyatam, dvitīyā tvaniyatā;
tasyāmanyatrāpi prāptāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhītyucyamānaṃ sūtramidaṃ niyamārthaṃ
bhaviṣyati-- yatra ṣaṣṭhī cānyā ca prāpnoti tatra ṣaṣṭhaḷeva bhavati|
evamanyatrāpi veditavyam||

51. jño'vidarthasya karaṇe| (2.3.51)
yadyapi bahavo vidayaḥ santi, tathāpi yasyārthe jānātarvṛtiḥ sambhavati
tasyaiva videḥ pratiṣedhakaraṇaṃ yuktam, ṭhvida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064)
ityasyaivārthe jānātervṛtiḥ sambhavati, tasmādavidarthasyetyanena
jñānārthasyaiva pratiṣedho vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhajñānārthasya' ityādi|
ṭhsarpiṣo jānīte, madhuno jānīte' iti| ṭhapahnave jñaḥ' (1.3.44)
ityanuvartamāne, ṭhakarmakācca' (1.3.45) ityātmanepadam| dhuna iti-- ṭh
iko'ci vibhaktau' (ra7.1.73) iti num| sarpiṣā karaṇabhūte pravartata
ityarthaḥ| yasya priyatamaṃ sarpistasya pravṛtiṃ prati sarpiṣaḥ
karaṇabhūtatvāt| dhātūnāmanekārthatvājjānātiriha pravṛtyarthaḥ|
ṭhsarpiṣiraktaḥ pratihato vā' iti| sarpiṣi raktatvaṃ pratihatatvaṃ ca
citabhrānteḥ kāraṇamāha| yadi sarvameva grāhyaṃ tadātmanā
sarpiḥsvabhāvatayā pratipadyate| evaṃ satyavidarthatā nopapadyate,
jñānārthatvādityata āha-- ṭhmithyājñānamajñānameva' iti|
jñānakāryākaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ| aviparītaviṣayaparicchedo hi
jñānakāryam, katacca mithyājñānena na kriyata iti
mithyājñānamajñānamucyate, yathā-- putrakāryākaraṇāt putro'putra
iti||

52. adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi| (2.3.52)
ṭhadhīka' iti| ṭhik smaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1047) ityasyādhipūrvasya grahaṇam|
adhīgityanena samānārthā adhīgarthāḥ| kakārānubandhakaraṇamasya
dhātoratraiva sūtre viśeṣaṇārtham| adhyayanārthānāmityucyamāne
sandehaḥ syāt-- ko'yaṃ dhāturiti|
adhipūrvasyoccāraṇenādhipūrvasyaivāsya prayoga iti darśayati|
ṭhkarmaṇi kārake' ityādi| yadā tadeva karma śeṣakāryatvāccheṣatvena
vivakṣyate na karmatvena, tadā tatra ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| ṭhadhyeti' iti|
adāditvāccchapo luk| evam ṭhīṣṭe' iti| vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36)
ṣatvam|
ṭhmāturguṇaiḥ smarati' iti| atra karmagrahaṇādguṇānāṃ karaṇabhūtānāṃ
śeṣavivakṣāyāmapi ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati|| 

53. kṛñaḥ pratiyatne| (2.3.53)

54. rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvareḥ| (2.3.54)
rujeti kecidbhidādiṣu paṭhanti| ye na paṭhanti te'pi
ṭhcintipūjikathikumbacarccaśca' (3.3.105) iti
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādasmādeva nipātanādvā rujāśabdasya
sādhutvaṃ varṇayanti| rujā artho yeṣāṃ te rujārthāḥ|
ṭhbhāvavacanānām' iti| yadi bhāvārthābhidhāyināṃ
rujārthānāmityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ syāt, tadā'narthakamidaṃ vacanaṃ
syāt| sarva eva hi rujārthā bhāvavacanāḥ| tasmānnātar dhātuvācyo
bhāvo vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pratayayavācyaḥ, yatra ṭhbhāve' (3.3.18) iti
dhañ vidhīyate| vacanaśabdo'yaṃ kartṛsādhanaḥ, vaktīti vacanaḥ,
ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti kartari lyuṭ| na ca
rujārthānāṃ yo bhāvastasya vacanakriyāṃ prati kartṛtvaṃ sambhavatīti
sāmarthyādavacanaśabdena prakṛtyarthaṃ parityajya pratyayārtho vivakṣita iti
pratīyate| sa punaḥ kartṛśaktiḥ| bhāvavacanānāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ--
bhāvo vacanaḥ kartā yeṣāṃ te bhāvavacanāḥ| bhāvakartṛkā ityarthaḥ|
etatsarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā''ha-- ṭhbhāvakartṛkāṇām' iti|
bhāvakartṛkāṇāmityevaṃ noktaṃ vaicitryārtham| ṭhcaurasya rujati'
iti| ṭhrujo bhaṅge' (dhā.pā.1416), taudīdikaḥ| atra rogo bhāvaḥ
kartā| ṭhcaurasyāmayati' ityatrāpyāmayaḥ| ṭhama roge' (dhā.pā.1720),
caurādikaḥ|
ṭheti jīvantamanando naraṃ varṣaśatādapi' iti| astyatrānando bhāvaḥ
kartā| na tvetirdhātū rujārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? gatyarthaḥ| ṭhnadī kūlāni
rujati' iti| rujiratra dravyakartṛkaḥ, na bhāvakartṛkaḥ, nadyā
dravyatvāt| naitadyauktaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, rujāśabdo hi ruḍhiśabdatvāt
vyādhimevācaṣṭe; na cātra vyādhivacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? bhaṅgavacano
rujiḥ| evaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā vṛtikṛtā| idantvatra
pratyudāharaṇam-- śleṣmā puruṣaṃ rujatīti| vyādhinā
grāhayatītyarthaḥ| jvarayatīti| ṭhjvara yoge' (dhā.pā.776),
hetumaṇṇic| ghaṭāditvānmitvam| ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvaḥ|
ṭhsantāpayati' iti| ṭhtapa santāpe' (dhā.pā.985), hetumaṇṇic|
santāpo'tra bhāvaḥ kartā||

55. āśiṣi nāthaḥ|
ṭhsarpiṣo nāthate' iti| sarpiryasya nāstyato'rthitvādāśāste saḥ--

56. jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām| (2.3.56)
ṭhna daivādikasya' iti| hiṃsāyāmiti vacanāt| asya ca tatrāpravṛteḥ|
ata eva hi ṇyantasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatkimartho ṇyantasya nirdeaśa
iti ? kaḥ punarāha cyantasya nirdeaśa iti ? atra hīkāro'yaṃ
dhātunirdeaśārthaḥ kṛtaḥ, ṭhikśtipau dhātunirdeaśe' (vā.319) iti|
yadyevam, jāsītyākāraḥ kathaṃ śrūyate? ucyate-- ākāramuccārya
vikṛtanirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ, vikṛtanirdeaśastū yatrāsyaitadrūpaṃ bhavati
tatraiva yathā syādiha mā bhūt,-- dasyumajījasaditi| luṅ,
ṭhṇiśri'(3.1.48) ityādinā cleścaṅ, ṭhṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ' (7.4.1),
ṭhcaṅ' (6.1.11) iiti dvirvacanam, ṭhsanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) ityādinā
sanvadbhāvaḥ, ṭhsanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itītvam, ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.93) iti
dīrghaḥ| nāṭakrāthayorapi vakṛtānirdeaśasyaitadeva prayojanam| iha mā
bhūta-- dasyumanīnaṭaditi, dasyumacikrathaditi| krathervṛddhiśca
prayojanam, etacca ṭhnipātanādvṛddhiḥ' iti bruvatā vṛtikāreṇa
darśitam| ṭhpniprahanti'iti vṛtau pāṭhaḥ} niprahan' iti|
dhātūpasargānirdeaśamātramiha tantram| na tūpasargasayoḥ saṃghātaḥ,
nāṣyānupūrvī; tayoravivakṣitatvāt| tena
nipraśabdayorvyastasamastayorviparītānupūrvīkayośca grahaṇaṃ
vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhsaṃghātavigṛhītaviparyastasya grahaṇam' iti.
ṭhcaurasya praṇihanti' iti| nergadanada' (8.4.17) ityādinā ṇatvam.
ṭhcaurasyonnāṭayati' iti| ṭhnaṭa avaspandane' (dhā.pā.(7.2.116) iti
vṛddhi siddhā; tatkimarthamucyate-- nipātanādvṛddhiriti ? ata āha--
ṭhayaṃ hi' ityādi| ṭhhrasvasya syāt' iti| ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92)
ityanena| ṭhcaurasya pinaṣṭi' iti| ṭh piṣlṛ sañcūrṇane' (dhā.pā.1452)
rudhāditvāt śnam| ṭhdhānāḥ pinaṣṭi' iti| atra hiṃsā nāsti; tasyā
prāṇidharmatvāt| idañcābhāvakartṛkāṇāmapi yathā

57. vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ| (2.3.57)

vetyarthaḥ| ṭhśatasya paṇate' ityatrāpi sa evārthaḥ|

ityādi| yadyapi ṭhpaṇa vyavahāre stutau ca'(dhā.pā.439) iti
stutivyavahārayoḥ paṇiḥ paṭhaḷte; tathāpi stutyarthasyaiva
paṇaterāyapratyaya iṣyate, na vyavahārārthasya| tatra vṛtikāraḥ svayameva
yuktiṃ vakṣyati| stutyarthyena paṇinā sāhacaryāt tadartha eva
paṇirāyamutpādayati,na vyavahārārtha iti| ṭhśalākāṃ vyavaharati' iti|
parigaṇayatītyarthaḥ| atra vyavahārārthe vartata ityasamānārthatvam|
