61. preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsampradāne| (2.3.61)
ṭhiṣyatedêavādikasya' iti| ṭhiṣa gatau' (dhā.pā. 1127) ityasya śyanā
nirdeaśa iṣyantarāṇāṃ nivṛtyarthaḥ| loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanena
nirdeaśastu lakārāntarasya puruṣāntarasya vacanāntarasya ca
nivṛtyarthaḥ| ṭhtadviṣaya eva' iti| loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaviṣaya eva|
ṭhagnaye chāgasya' ityādi| chāgasya vikāraścachāgaḥ| tatrāgnirdeavatā
sampradānam| kachāgavikāro vapādi sampradeyaṃ haviḥ karma|
ṭhpnāsti-kāśikā, padamañjarī ca} nanu preṣya' iti| ṭhato heḥ'
(6.4.105) iti harluk| ṭh anubrūhi' iti| ṭhserhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti
hirādeśaḥ| adāditvāccchapo luk| bhāṣāviṣaye'pyayaṃ yogaḥ;
utarasūtre cchandograhaṇāt| ṭhjuhudhi' iti| ṭhhujhalbhyo herdhiḥ'
(6.4.101) iti dhibhāvaḥ| ṭhagnaye gomayāni preṣya' iti| nanu ca
gomayāni harvīṣi bhavantyeva, tatkathaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? naivam;
devatāsampradānagrahaṇādeva sambandhiśabdātvāddhavirgrahaṇe siddhe
punarhavirgrahaṇādabhyavahāryasya haviṣo grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| na ca
gomayānyabhyavahāryāṇi bhavantīti yuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇam|
ṭhhaviṣaḥ prasthitasya' ityādi| prasthitaśabdena yadviśiṣyate havistat
prasthitam| tasya ṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ|
tatredaṃ vyākhyānam --ṭhvibhāṣopasarge' (2.3.59) ityato
vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena haviṣaḥ
prasthitasya na bhavati||

62. caturthyarthe bahulaṃ cchandasi| (2.3.62)
ṭhbahulagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtereva sidhyatīti
manyamānasya praśnaḥ| ṭhkṛṣṇo rātryai, himavato hastī' iti| atra
bahulagrahaṇāt saptamyarthe'pi caturthī bhavati| ṭhvaktavyā' iti|
vyākhyātavyetyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- bahulagrahaṇamiha kriyate|
tena kvacit ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe'pi caturthī bhavati| kvacidanyadevetyeṣo'pi
bahulagarhaṇasyārtho'bhimata eva||

63. yajeśca karaṇe| (2.3.63)
ṭhdhṛtasya yajate' iti| yajiratra devapūjāyāṃ vartate, tatra ca ghṛtasya
karaṇabhāvaḥ||

64. kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe| (2.3.64)
ṭhpañcakṛtvaḥ' iti| ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛtigaṇane kṛtvasuc'
(5.4.17) ṭh dvirahnaḥ' iti| ṭhdvtricaturthyaḥ suc' (5.4.18)|
ṭhgamyate hi dvistriścaturvā' iti| prakaraṇāderiti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca
bahiraṅgaḥ prakaraṇādyartha iti pañcakṛtva ityamatra ca vacanasya
caritārthatvādiha na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--
prakaraṇādyartho'pi vibhaktīnāṃ nimitamiti| tena ṭhvṛddho yūnā' (1.2.65)
iti ṭh sahayukte'pradhāne' (2.3.19) iti sahārthe gamyamāne tṛtīyā
bhavatīti||

65. kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti| (2.3.65)
ṭhāsikā' iti| bhāve ṭhparyāyārhaṇotpatiṣu ṇvuc' (3.3.111)| ṭhsraṣṭā'
iti| sṛjestṛc'| ṭhsṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) ityam,
ṭhvraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam|
ṭhtaddhitaprayoge mā bhūt' iti| atha tiṅprayoge mā
bhūdityevamarthamapi kṛdgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? tatra ṭhna
lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' (2.3.69) ityanena ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhāt| ṭh kṛtapūrvī
kaṭam' iti| ṭhpūrvādiniḥ' (5.2.86) ityatra inirityanuvartamāne
ṭhsapūrvācca' (5.2.87) itīnipratyayaḥ| atra kartā taddhitenaivokta ityatra
vākyamevaitannopaprasaṅgo nāsti, karma tu tenānabhihitamityasati
kṛdgrahaṇe kaṭādeḥ karmaṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhī syāt| nanu cātra
vākyamevaitannopapadyate, tathā hi-- karmaṇo niṣṭhayā'bhihitatvāt
dvitīyayā'tra na bhavitavyam, nāpi taddhitena, asamārthyāt|
tatpunarasāmarthya sāpekṣatvāt| tathā hi-- kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamaneneti
kṛtaśabdaḥ kaṭamapekṣate, naivam; dhātorutpadyamānā niṣṭhā kathaṃ
kaṭaśabdasya karmatāmabhidadhyāt| tasyā hi karmasāmānyamevābhidhātuṃ
sāmarthyam, na karmaviśeṣam| vākye tarhi kathaṃ tayā kaṭaśabdasya
karmatvamabhidhīyate ? tatra yuktamabhidhānam; kṛta ityanena
sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| taddhite tūtpanna ekārthībhāvātsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
nivṛtamiti kena kaṭādeḥ karmabhāvo'bhidhīyate ? kriyā tu
prakṛtyarthatvādyathā vākye guṇībhūtā sādhanasambandhamanubhavati, tathā
vṛtāvapīti karotyarthāpekṣaṃ kaṭaśabdasya karmatvamupapadyate|
tasmāddhavitavyameva dvitīyayā|
kiñca vṛtisamānārthena vākyana bhavitavyam| na ca vṛtau bāhyaṃ
kaṭādikaṃ karma gamyate yena pratyaya utpādayiṣyate| vākye
kaṭādikarmāpekṣā niṣprayojaneti gamyate| tasmādevaṃ vigrahaḥ
kartavyaḥ-- kṛtaṃ pūrvamaneneti| tataśca nāsti sāpekṣatvamiti
bhavatyeva taddhitaḥ|
ṭhitarathā hi' iti| yadi śeṣagarhaṇamanuvartata ityarthaḥ| ṭhkartari ca
kṛtītyevaṃ brūyāt' iti| evamapi hyucyamāne śeṣa ityanuvṛtau
cakārakaraṇāt karmaṇītyetallabhyata eva, kiṃ karmagrahaṇena ? tasmāt
punaḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ śeṣādhikarānivṛtyartham| punaḥ karmagrahaṇena hi
pūrvasya karmagrahaṇasya nivṛtirākhyāyate| tannivṛtau
tatsambaddhamanuvṛtamapi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ nivartate||

66.ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi| (2.3.66)
ṭhubhayaprāptāviti bahuvrīhiḥ' iti| tena tatpuruṣaśaṅkāṃ nirasyati|
bahuvrīherāśrayaṇasya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati| ubhayagrahaṇamena prakṛtatvāt
kartṛkarmaṇī sambadhyete| ṭhubhayoḥ prāptiryasmin
kṛti'ityanenaikasminnevetyabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhkarmaṇyeva' iti niyamasya
svarūpaṃ darśayati| ubhayaprāptāveva karmaṇītyeṣa tu viparītaniyamo
na bhavati| mā bhūt pūrvasūtreṇa karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīvidhānasya
vaiyarthyamiti| ṭhāścaryo gavāṃ doho'gopālakena' iti| duherbhāve
ghañ| tatrobhayoprāptau karmaṇyeva goṣu ṣaṣṭhī bhavati;
nā'gopālake kartari| atra ca ṭhkṛtvo'rthaprayoge' (2.3.64) ityataḥ
prayogagrahaṇaṃ nānuvartate| tena gamyamāne'pi karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati,
yathā-- ṭhantardhau yenādarśanamiccchati' (1.4.28) ityatra
hyaprayujyamānasyātmanaḥ karmatvaṃ gamyate| ṭhpānam' iti| ṭhlyuṭ ca'
(3.3.115) iti bhāve lyuṭ| iha tu na bhavati-- āścaryamidamodanasya ca
pāko brāhmaṇānāñca pādurbhāva iti| na hyatraikasmin kṛtyubhayoḥ
prāptiḥ| tathā hyaedanasya pāka ityatra karmaṇyevaudane prāptiḥ, na tu
brāhmaṇeṣu kartuṣu| na hi pākasya kartṛtvena vivakṣitā brāhmaṇāḥ,
kiṃ tarhi ? prādurbhāvasya karttṛtvena | brāhmaṇānāṃ naca prādurbhāva
ityatrāpi prādurbhāva ityetasmin kṛti kartṛṣveva brāhmaṇeṣu
prāptiḥ, na karmaṇyodane| na hi prādurbhāvasyodanaḥ karma;
bhavaterakarmakatvāt| pākasyaiva tvodanaḥ karmatvena vivakṣitaḥ|
ṭhakākārayoḥ'ityādi| niyamasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| akākārayoḥ prayoge
niyamo na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- ṭhcaturthyarthe bahulaṃ cchandasi' (2.3.62) ityato
bahulagrahaṇamanuvartate, tenākākārayoḥ prayoge niyamo na
bhaviṣyatīti|
ṭhśeṣe vibhāṣā' iti| asyāpyartho bahulagrahaṇasamāśrayaṇena
vyākhyātavyaḥ| ṭhbhedikā' iti| pūrvavadbhāve ṇvuc| ṭhcikīrṣā' iti|
ṭha pratyayāt' (3.3.102) ityakārapratyayaḥ||

67. ktasya ca vartamāne| (2.3.67) 
ṭhrājñāṃ mataḥ' iti| ṭhmatibuddhi' (3.2.188) ityādinā ktaḥ| rājñāmiti
kartari ṣaṣṭhī| karma tu niṣṭhayābhihitam| atheha kasmānna bhavati--
śīlito devadatena, rakṣito devadatenetyādi, śīlitādiṣvapi
ṭhmatibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' (3.2.188) iti
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvanādvartamāna eva kto vidhīyate ?
yadyapyevam, tathāpi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛteriha na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|
atha vā-- prakaraṇādevātra vartamānakālatā gamyate| padārthastu
bhūtatvameva pratipādayati, na vartamānatām| yasya tu padārtho
vartamānastatprayoge bhavatyeva ṣaṣṭhī, yathā-- ṭhkānto hariścandra iva
prajānām' iti|
ṭhśeṣavijñānāt siddham' iti| upasaṃkhyānaṃ ptyācaṣṭe-- ṭhtathā ca'
ityādinā| yastūpasaṃkhyānamārabhate, tasya kartṛtvāvivakṣāyāmapi
ṣaṣṭhaḷeva bhavati, na tṛtīyeti darśayati||

68. adhikaraṇavācinaśca| (2.3.68)
ṭhtasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī vibhaktirbhavati' iti| yathāsambhavaṃ yatra kartaiva
saṃbhavati tatra kartari bhavati; yathā-- idameṣāmāsitamiti|
atrāserakarmakatvāt kartaiva sambhavati, na karma| yatra tu karma kartāpi
sambhavati tatrobhayatrāpi, yathā-- idameṣāṃ bhuktamodanasyeti| bhujeḥ
sakarmakatvāt karmāpyastyevaudanaḥ| ṭhubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (2.3.66)
iti niyamaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ṭhkartṛkarmaṇo kṛtiḥ' (2.3.65) ityasyāḥ
ṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ prāptereva niyamo vijñāyate| ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā
bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti, ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān
vidhīn bādhante notarān' (vyā.pa.10) iti vā| adhikaraṇe ceti
vaktavye vācigrahaṇamidhakaraṇaktopalakṣaṇaṃ mā vijñāyītyevamartham|
upalakṣaṇārthatve hi tasyārthāntaravṛterapi
dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhya utpannasya ktasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt|
vācigrahaṇe tu yadā bhāve ktapratyayo bhavati tadā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati|
tadā kartari tṛtīyaiva bhavati -- hahānenāsitamiti| na
hyatrādhikaraṇavācī ktaḥ; ṭhpkto'dhikaraṇe ca
dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthe'bhyaḥ' iti sūtram|} kto'dhikaraṇe
dhrauvyagatipratyavasānāthabhyaśca' (3.4.76) iti cakārāt
yathāprāptañceti bhāve kartari ca vidhānāt| yadā tu kartari kto
bhavati tadā tenaivābhihatatvāt tatra ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| ihema āsitā
iti cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ||

69. na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām| (2.3.69)
ṭhkikinau ca gṛhyaete' iti| yadyapi kikinoralādeśatvāt
sthānivadbhāvena lagrahaṇena tayorgrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi ṭhliṭ ca'
(3.2.171) ityatideśena bhavitavyam| viśeṣātideśe hi nāntarīyakaḥ
sāmānyātideśa iti; viśeṣasya sāmānyenāvinābhāvāditi| tena
sāmānyanibandhanaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kikinorapi sidhyatīti yuktaṃ
tayorapi grahaṇam| ṭhpacamānaḥ' iti śānac|
svaritetvādātmanepadam| ṭhpecānaḥ' iti| ṭhliṭaḥ kānajvā' (3.2.106)
iti vacanāt, kānac| dvirvacanam| ṭhata eka' (6.4.120)
ityādinaitvābhyāsalopau| ṭhpecivān' iti| ṭhkvuśca' (3.2.107) iti
kvasuḥ| etvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ ṭhvasvekājāddhasām' (7.2.67)
itīṭ| ṭhugidacām' (7.1.70)iti num| ṭhsāntamahasaḥ' (6.4.10)
ityādinā dīrghaḥ| ṭhdadiḥ| papiḥ' iti| ṭhādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau
liṭ ca' (3.2.171) iti kikinoranyataraḥ| liṭ
cetyatideśāddvivanam| ṭhāto lopa iṭi ca' (6.3.64)
ityākāralopaḥ| ṭhcikīrṣuḥ' iti| ṭhsanāsaṃsabhikṣa uḥ' (3.2.168)|
ṭhalaṅkariṣṇuḥ'iti| ṭhalaṃkṛñ' (3.2.136) ityādineṣṇuc|
ṭhpāgāmukam- kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|} āgāmukaḥ' iti|
ṭhlaṣapatapada'(3.2.154) ityādinokañ|
ṭhukapratiṣedhe' ityādi| pratipādyata iti śeṣaḥ| pratipādanantu
bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtimāśritya kartavyam| ṭhkṛtvā' iti|
ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) iti ktvā|
ṭhavyayapratiṣedhe' ityādi| atrāpi pūrvavadvākyaśeṣo veditavyaḥ|
pratipādanañca pūrvavadeva| atha vā -- ṭhavyayībhāvaśca' (1.1.41) ityatra
ṭhsarvamidaṃ kāṇḍaṃ svarādiṣu paṭhaḷte' (1.1.41 kāśikā) ityādinā
vṛtikāreṇa pratipādanaṃ kṛtam| ṭhsaṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ'
(vyā.pa.64) iti vā| ṭhudetoḥ' iti| utpūrvādiṇo ṭhbhāvalakṣaṇe
stheṇkṛñvadicari' (3.4.16) ityādinā tosun| ṭhvisṛpaḥ' iti|
ṭhsṛpitṛdoḥ kasun' (3.4.17) | ṭh īṣatkaraḥ' iti| ṭhīṣad' (3.3.126)
ityādinā khal| ṭhīṣatpānaḥ' iti| ṭhāto yuc' (3.3.128)| ṭhātṛno
nakārāt' iti| tācchīlikasya tṛnaḥ sambandhino nakārādityarthaḥ| ṭh
pavamānaḥ' iti| ṭhpūṅ pavane' (dhā.pā.966), ṭhpūṅyajoḥ śānan'
(3.2.128)| ṭhnaḍamaghnānaḥ' iti| ṭhtācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś
(3.2.129)| ṭhgamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ| ṭhho
hanteḥ'(7.3.54) ityādinā kutvam| ṭhadhīyan' iti| ṭhiṅ dhāryoḥ
śatrakṛcchriṇi' (3.2.130) iti śatrādeśaḥ| iyaṅadeśaḥ| upasargeṇa saha
dīrghaḥ| ṭhkartā' iti| ṭhā kvestacchīla' (3.2.134) ityādinā tṛn|
ṭhdviṣaḥ śaturvāvacanam' iti| dviṣaḥ paro yaḥ śatṛpratyayasya prayoge
vāvacanaṃ kartavyam; abhidhānābhidheyayorabhedopacārāt| vetyanena
vārtha uktaḥ| vārtho'pi vikalpaḥ| vikalpa ucyate u pratyāyyate yena
tadvāvacanam| tasya vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānaṃ --
bahulagrahaṇamihānuvartate, tena dviṣaḥ śaturvikalpena pratiṣedho
bhaviṣyati| ṭhdviṣan' iti| ṭhdviṣo'mitre' (3.2.131) iti śatṛpratyayaḥ||

70. akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ| (2.3.70)
ṭhakasya bhaviṣyati kāle' iti| nādhamarṇye, tasya tatrāsambhavāt| ṭhinastu
bhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti| tasyobhayorapi sambhavāt| nanu ca
sāmyādiha saṃkhyātānudeśena bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; svaritena hi
saṃkhyātānudeśo bhavati, na ceha tadarthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate|
ṭhkaṭṃa kārako vrajati' iti| ṭhtumunṇvulau' (3.3.10) ityādinā
ṇvul| ṭhgrāmaṃ gamī' iti| gameriniḥ| sa ca ṭhbhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ'
(3.3.3) iti vacanādbhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaḥ| ṭhśataṃ dāyī' iti|
ṭhāvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ' (3.3.170)| ṭhyavānāṃ lāvakaḥ' iti|
ṭhṇvulatṛcau' (3.1.133) iti ṇvul| ṭhavaśyaṃ kārī' iti| āvaśyake
ṇiniḥ| ṭhvarṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ' iti| ṭhpūrī āpyāyane' (dhā.pā.1151)
caurādikaḥ| tasmāt ṭhṇvultṛcajau' (3.1.133) iti bhaviṣyatkāle
ṇvul| sa hi triṣu kāleṣu bhavati|
ṭhbhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasyedaṃ grahaṇam' iti| iha hi
bhaviṣyaditi svaryate| svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavati| tena
bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyedamakasya grahaṇam, na sarvasya||

71. kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā| (2.3.71)
ṭhgeyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnām'iti| ṭhbhavyageya' (3.4.68) ityādinā kartari
geyaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ| gāyatīti geyaḥ sāmnāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī
nityameva bhavati| ṭhvaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- ṭhna lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' (2.3.69) ityatra neti yogavibhāgaḥ
kartavyaḥ, tenobhayaprāptau kṛtye ṣaṣṭhaḷapratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| tena
kraṣṭavyā śākhā grāmaṃ devadateneti| kṛṣeḥ ṭhanudātasya
cardupadhasyāntarasyām' (6.1.59) ityamāgamo bhavati| devadate kartari
ṣaṣṭhī mā bhūditi| evamubhayaprāptau kṛtye ṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ pratiṣedho
vaktavya ityuktam| karmaṇi tu śākhāyāṃ kṛtyenābhihitvādeva ṣaṣṭhī na
bhaviṣyati| grāmyasyāpradhānatvādeva yathaiva hi kṛtyāḥ pradhāne karmaṇi
bhavanti nāpradhāne tathā ṣaṣṭhaḷpi| na ceha grāmaḥ pradhānaṃ karma, kiṃ tarhi
? śākheti||

72.tulyārthairatulopamābhmāṃ tṛtīyā'nyatarasyām| (2.3.72)
tulyārthaiḥ sadṛśārthairityarthaḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ padāntaranirapekṣayā ye
tulyārthatāmāhustatparigrahārtham| tena padāntarasānnidhyena dyotakā
ivādayo nivartitā bhavanti-- gauriva gavaya iti, yathā gaustathā
gavaya iti| svarūpanivṛtyarthatvarthagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati;
bahuvacananirdeaśādeva svarūpavidhernirastatvāt| ihāpi pitustulyaḥ
prajñayeti prajñāśabdāt ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati hetutvana karaṇatvena vā
prajñāyā vivakṣitatvāt ṭhitarathā hi tṛkatīyānukṛṣyeta' iti| tasyā
anantarasūtre śrutatvāt| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya tvetadeva
prayojanamiti| tadeva cakāreṇānukṛṣyata iti||

73. caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ|
ṭhtṛtīyānirdeaśādevārthagrahaṇe siddhe'rthagrahaṇādarthaśabdaḥ pṛthageva
nimitaṃ vijñāyate| kathaṃ punastṛtīyāgrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ sidhyati ?
aparisamāptatvādasya yoga ityadhyāhriyate| sa cārthaireva sambhavati, na
śabdairiti sāmarthyādarthagrahaṇaṃ sidhyati||
iti śrībodhisatvadeśīyācāryajinedandrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ
kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ
dvitīyādhyāyasya
tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
-----------------


 atha dvitīyādhyāyasya 
caturthaḥ pādaḥ
1. dvigurekavacanam| (2.4.1)
atra yadi pāribhāṣikamekavacanaṃ gṛhyaeta tadānuprayoga ekavacanaṃ na
syāt-- pañcapūlīyaṃ śobhaneti, anuprayogasyādvigutvāt| yadi
pāribhāṣikamekavacanamihābhipretaṃ syāt tadā
dvigorekavacanamityevaṃ brūyāt, tasmādanvarthasyaikavacanasyedaṃ
grahaṇaṃ na pāribhāṣikasyeti manasi kṛtvāha-- ṭhekasya
vacanamekavacanam' iti| etenaikavacanaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsatāṃ
darśayannanvarthatāṃ darśayati| ekasya vacanaṃ vācakamekavacanamiti|
vaktīti vacanam, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti kartari
lyuṭ| ekavacanasyaivārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇa spaṣṭīkartumāha--
ṭhekārthasya' ityādi| nanu caikavacanamiti puṃlliṅgena bhavitavyam;
katham ? dvigoḥ puṃlliṅgatvāt; na; liṅgasāmānyasya
vivakṣitatvānnapuṃsakaliṅgenaiva sāmānyena nirdeaśaḥ kṛta
ityadoṣaḥ| ṭhtadanena prakāreṇa' iti|
anvarthasyaikavacanaśabdagrahaṇātmakenetyarthaḥ| nacānekārthābhidhāyinaḥ
śabdasya vacanaśatairapyekārmathābhidhāyitvaṃ śakyate kartum;
śabdānāmarthābhidhāyitvasya svābhāvikatvāt; ucyate cedaṃ vacanam,
tataḥ sāmarthyādatideśo'yaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha--
ṭhdvigvarthasyaikavadbhāvo vidhīyate' iti| asyaivārthaṃ spaṣṭīkartamāha--
ṭhdvigvartha ekavadbhavati' iti| yadyevam, taddhitārtho yo
dvigustasyāpyakavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti-- pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtau
saṃskṛtā vā pañcakapālau pañcakapālā vetyata āha--
ṭhsamāhāradvigośca' ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇe|
samāhāradvigoreveti yāvat| kathaṃ punaḥ samāhāradvigoreva
grahaṇaṃ labhyate ? evaṃ manyate-- ṭhdvandvaśca' (2.4.2) ityatra cakāreṇa
dviguranukṛṣyate| yasminnarthe dvandva ekārthībhavati tasminnevārthe
dvigorapyekavadbhāvo yathā syāditi| dvandvaśca samāhāra
evaikārthībhavati, nānyatra| tasmāt dvigorapyekavadbhāvastatraiva
bhavati; ataḥ samāhāradvigorevedaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhi
samāhāradvigorevedaṃ grahaṇaṃ tadā niṣprayojano'tideśaḥ, tathā
hi-- samāhāro dvigorarthaḥ, samāhāraśca bhāvasādhanaḥ, samāharaṇaṃ
samāhāraḥ u samudāyaḥ, sa caika eva| tatra nyāyaprāptamevaikavacanamiti
niṣphalaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ ? naitadasti; yataḥ ṭhsamudāyibhyo'nanyaḥ
samudāyaḥ' ityasmin darśane'nekadravyātmakatvāt
samudāyasyaikavacanaṃ na siddhyatītīdamārabdham| tathā coktaṃ
bhāṣye-- ṭhpratyadhikaraṇaṃ vacanotpateḥ saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyācca
dvigorekavacane vidhānam' iti| pratyadhikaraṇam u pratidravyam|
vacanasyotpatau pratyabhidheyadravyasamavāyinī saṃkhyāvibhaktiḥ
prayojikotpadyate| dvigośca yo'rthaḥ so'nekadravyātmakaḥ| tathā hi--
pañca samāhṛtāḥ| samāhriyamāṇānāṃ pūlānāṃ pañcasaṃkhyāvaccchinnatvāt
saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyācca pañcaitāni dravyāṇīti kṛtvā
samudāyasyaikavacanaṃ na siddhyati| tatrāsatyasmin vacane bahutvāt
bahuvacanaṃ syāt| ata evadbhāvo vidhīyata iti vākyārthaḥ|
ṭhsamudāyibhyo'nyaḥ samudāyaḥ' ityasmin darśane sūtramidaṃ
pratyākhyātavyameva| tathā coktaṃ bhāṣye-- ṭhna vā samāhāraikatvāt'
iti| na vā yogārambheṇaivārthaḥ| yasmādeko'yamarthaḥ samāhāro
nāma| tatraikatvādekavacanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti vākyārthaḥ| ṭhpañcapūlī' iti|
ṭhakārāntotarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā.156) iti strītve
sati dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp| ṭharthasyaikatvāt'
ityādinā'rthātideśasya phalaṃ darśayati||

2. dvandvaśca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām| (2.4.2)
atrāṅgaśabdaḥ samudāye parisamāpyate ? pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate vā ?
tatra yadi samudāye parisamāpyeta tadaikamevedaṃ vākyaṃ syāt, tathā
ca vyatikaraḥ prasajyeta| prāṇitūryasenāṅgānāṃ parasparasahitānāṃ
yo dvandvo vyatikīrṇāvayavastasyaikavadbhāvaḥ syāt| pratyekaṃ
parisamāptau tveṣa doṣo na bhavati| tatra hi prāṇyaṅgānāṃ dvandva
ekavadbhavatītyevamādīni trīṇi vākyāni sampadyante| svaviṣaye yatra
bahuvacanāntaṃ vākyaṃ kriyate tatra prathamena vākyena prāṇyaṅgānāṃ
prāṇyaṅgaireva yaḥ samāsastasyaikavadbhāvo vidhīyate| dvitīyena
vākyena tūryāṅgānāṃ tūryāṅgaiḥ| tṛtīyena senāṅgānāṃ
senāṅgairiti na bhavati saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ| na hi caturtha vākyamasti
yena vyatikīrṇāvayavasya dvandvasyaikārthatā syāditi manyamānaḥ
pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptipakṣamāśrityāha-- ṭhaṅgaśabdasya' ityādi|
tathā tūryāṅgānāmiti dvandva ekavadbhavatītyepekṣate| evaṃ
senāṅaganāñcetyatrāpi| ṭhpāṇipādam' iti| atra yadi prāṇyaṅgamapi
prāṇigrahaṇena gṛhyate tadā ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityevaṃ siddham|
yathā-- paṇavamṛdaṅgamiti| ṭhrathikāśvāroham' iti|
rathikāścāśvārohāśceti vṛtipadārthasya bahutvaṃ darśayitavyam|
yasmādbahutvameva senāṅgatve kāraṇam| bahutvābhāve
senāṅgatvannāstīti rathikāśvārohāviti bhavitavyam|
ṭhhastyaśvādiṣu paratvāt paśudvandvavibhāṣayaiva bhavitavyam' iti|
ṭhvibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛga' (2.4.12) ityādinā| ṭhitaretarayoge' ityādinā
dvandvaprakaraṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| ṭhprāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eva'
ityādinā viṣayavibhāṣāgārthatāṃ spaṣṭīkaroti||

3. anuvāde caraṇānām| (2.4.3)
ṭhcaraṇaśabda' ityādinā sūtrasya viṣayaṃ darśayati| tathā hi-- yo hi
kaṭhādiproktādhyayanaviśeṣaḥ śākhā, tatra yadā caraṇaśabdo vartate tadā
ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityeva siddham| yadā tu śākhānimitakaḥ'
iti| śākhā nimitamsayeti bahuvrīhiḥ| ṭhpramāṇāntarāvagatasya' iti|
śabdāt pramāṇādyadanyat pramāṇaṃ tat pramāṇāntaram,
tatpunaḥpratyakṣādi| tenāvagatasya pariccchinnasya śabdena
rasaṅkīrtanamātramiti mātraśabdo'rthāvagativyudāsārthaḥ|
ṭhudagāt,pratyaṣṭhāt' iti| utpūrvādiṇaḥ pratipūrvātiṣṭhaterluṅ,
ṭhiṣo gā luṅ' (2.4 .45) iiti gādeśaḥ, ṭhgātisthā' (2.4.77) iti sico
luk| ṭhkaṭhakālāpam' iti| kaṭhena proktamadhīyata iti kaṭhāḥ|
kaṭhaśabdāt proktārthe ṭhkalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaśca' (4.3.104)
iti ṇiniḥ, tasya ṭhkaṭhacarakālluk' (4.3.107) , tataḥ ṭh tadadhīte
tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya ṭhproktālluk' (4.2.64) , ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni
ca tadviṣayāṇi' (4.2.66) iti tadviṣayatā| kalāpinā proktamadhīyata iti
kalāpāḥ| proktārthe kalāpino'ṇ, ṭhinaṇyanapatye' (6.4.164) iti
prakṛtibhāve prāpte
ṭhsabrahmacāripīṭhasarpikalāpikuthumitairatilijājalilāṅgaliśilāliśikhaṣṭiśūkarasadmasuparvaṇāmupasaṃkhyānam' (vā. 798) iti ṭilopaḥ| tataḥ ṭhtadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ| tasya ṭhproktālluk' (4.2.64) iti luk| pūrvavat tadviṣatā ca| kaṭhāśca kālāpāśca kaṭhakālāpam| ṭh yadā tu prathamata evopadeśaḥ' iti| anavagatasyaiva prāk pramāṇāntareṇa śabdenādyaṃ pratyāyanamarthasya praśne prativacane vopadeśaḥ, sa yadā bhavati tadātra pratyudāharaṇam| ṭh udaguḥ' iti| ṭhātaḥ' (3.4.110) iti jharjus| ṭhusyapadāntāt' (6.1.96) iti pararūpatvam| ṭhstheṇoradyatanyāñceti vaktavyam' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ṭhtulyārthairatulopamābhyām' (2.3.72) ityataḥ sūtrādanyatarasyāmityanuvartate| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena stheṇoradyatanyāmanuvāde caraṇānāmekavadbhāvo bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti| ṭhadyatanī' iti luṅḥ pūrvācāryapraṇītaiṣā saṃjñā| ṭhanandiṣuḥ' iti| ṭhṭuanadi samṛddhau' (dhā.pā.67), ṭhsijabyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus| ṭhudyanti' iti| ṭhiko yaṇ' (6.4.81) iti yaṇādeśaḥ||

4. adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam| (2.4.4)
ṭhadhvaryuvede' iti| aitenādhvaryuśabdanātra yajurvedo lakṣyata iti
darśayati| athāṣvaryorṛtvigviśeṣasya yaḥ kraturiti
kratuviśeṣaṇamevādhvaryugrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? asambhavāt; ko
hi tasya kraturbhavati ! api tu ghanavyayaśīlasya| yadyapi tasya kratau
kartṛtvamasti tadapi ṛtvigantareṇa sādhāraṇamityadhvaryuṇaikena
tasya viśeṣaṇamayuktam| nanu cātharvavedavihito yaḥ
kratustannivṛtyarthamadhvaryuṇaikena kathaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt; na hi
tarādhvaryavaḥ santi ? naitadasti; yadi hyaetāvat prayojanamabhihitaṃ
syāt tadā'natharvaṇa iti pratiṣedhameva kuryāt| laghīyasī hi
sākṣāt pratiṣedhe pratītirbhavati| trayīgrahaṇaṃ vā kuryāt| yadi
cādhvaryuṇā kraturviśeṣyeta tadeṣuvajrāvityatrāpi syāt ?
iṣuvajrāvapi hyadhvaryoḥ kratū bhavataḥ; tayorapi tatkartṛkatvāt|
tasmādadhvaryūṇāṃ yajurvedavidāṃ yo vedaḥ
so'dhvaryuśabdenopalakṣyate| sa punaryajurvedaḥ| tatrādhvaryuvede
yasya kratorvidhānaṃ so'dhvaryukraturiti| itikartavyatopadeśaḥ
prayogaścānuṣṭhānātmako vidhānaśabdenoktaḥ| yadi
tarhyadhvaryukratuvācināmanapuṃsakaliṅgānāṃ dvandva ekavadbhavatīti
sūtrārthastadā sūtre'dhvaryukratuśabdasyānapuṃsakamityasya ca dvandva
iÂtayanena prakṛtena sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeaśo nopapadyate|
ato'dhvaryukratuvācināmanapuṃsakaliṅgānāmiti vaktavyaṃ syādityata
āha-- ṭhadhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam' iti| ṭhgauṇo'yaṃ nirdeaśaḥ' iti|
gauṇa ityamukhya āṬpacārika ityarthaḥ| adhvaryukratvavayavo dvandva
upacāreṇādhvaryukraturityuktaḥ| sa
evānapuṃsakaliṅgāvayavo'napuṃlakamiti| gauṇarndeiśastu
lāghavārtho veditavyaḥ| yadi punaranapuṃsakamityanena mukhyayā vṛtyā
dvandva evocyeta tadā ṭhsa napusaṃkam' (2.4.17) ityasyāpavādo'yaṃ
vijñāyeta| ṭharkāśvamedham' ityādi| arkaścāśvamedhaścetyarkāśvamedham|
sāyāhnaścātirātraśceti ṭhsāyāhnātirātram'|
ṭhiṣuvajrau' ityādi| iṣuvajraprabhṛtayo'dhvaryukratavo na sambhavati, na
hi teṣāmadhvaryuvede vidhānam| kiṃ tarhi ? sāmavede|
ṭhrājasūyavājapeye' iti. etau rājasūyavājapeyaśabdau
puṃlliṅgāvapi staḥ| tatra yadā napuṃsakaliṅgau prayujyete tatredaṃ
pratyudāharaṇam| ṭhsomayāgeṣu' iti| yatra yatra somapānaṃ vihitaṃ
te somayāgāḥ| teṣveva kratuśabdo rūḍhaḥ| na ca darśapaurṇamāsau
somayāgau| ṭhanapuṃsakam' (2.4.4) ityupādānāt svarūpagrahaṇamiha na
bhavati| na hi kratusāmānyo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati||

5. adhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām| (2.4.5)
adhītiradhyayanamiti bhāvasādhano'dhyayanaśabdaḥ, karmasādhano vā --
adhīyata ityadhyayanamiti| ṭhadhyayanataḥ' iti|
ṭhādyādibhyastasyupasaṃkhyānam' (vā. 634) iti hetutṛtīyāntāt
tasiḥ| ata āha-- ṭhadhyayanena nimitena' iti| ṭhaviprakṛṣṭā' iti|
aviprakṛṣṭā''khyā yeṣāṃ te'viprakṛṣṭākhyāḥ| nimitasya
sādhāraṇatvādiviprakṛṣṭatā| tatpunarnimitaṃ
sūtropātamevādhyayanamākhyānāmadheyam| ṭhpadakakramakam' iti|
padamadhīte, kramamadhīte iti ṭhkramādibhyo vun' (4.2.61)|
ṭhkramakavārtikam' iti. vṛtimadhīta iti vārtikaḥ|
kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak (4.2.60)| kathaṃ punaḥ padasyādhyetuḥ kramasya
cādhyayanena nimitenāviprakṛṣṭatā bhavatītyāha-- ṭhsampāṭhaḥ' ityādi|
yasmāt padānāṃ kramasya ca yaḥ pāṭhaḥ sa nātibhinnaḥ| grantho'pi tādṛśa
eva, ataḥ pratyāsannaḥ| yataśca padānyadhītya kramo'dhyetavyaḥ, tato'pi
sampāṭhastayo| pratyāsannaḥ, tataśca tena sampāṭhenādhyayanena nimitena
padaka iti kramaka iti ca yā'dhyeturākhyā sā'pi pratyāsannā
bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhpitāputrau' iti| ṭhānaṅ ṛto dvandve' (6.3.25)
ityānaṅadeśaḥ| tatra hi ṭhputre'nyatarasyām' (6.3.22) ityataḥ putra
ityanuvartate| atrāpi piteti putra iti cākhye pratyāsanne
sādhāraṇatvānnimitasya| tathā hi-- janyajanakabhāvo dvayorapi
tayornimitam| ṭhyājñikavaiyākaraṇam' iti| yajñamadhīte yājñikaḥ|
kratūkthādinā (4.2.60) ik| vyākaramamadhīte vaiyākaraṇaḥ| ṭhtadadhīte
tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ| astyatrādhyayananimitatvamanayorākhyayoḥ, na
tu pratyāsatiḥ| na hi yajñādhyayanena vyākaraṇādhyayanena vā tayoḥ
kriyāpratyāsatirnāpi granthapratyāsatiḥ||

6. jātiraprāṇinām| (2.4.6)
ayamapi gauṇyā vṛtyā jātirdvandva iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeaśaḥ
kṛtaḥ| jātivācyavayavo dvandvo jātirityuktaḥ| jāteśca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ
na bhavati, aprāṇināmiti pratiṣedhāt| ṭhārāśastri' iti| ṭhhrasvo
napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvaḥ|
ṭhnandakapāñcajanyau' iti| saṃjñāśabdayoreva dvandvo'yam, na
jātiśabdayoḥ| anenāprāṇināmityasya paryudāsatāṃ darśayati|
tenāyamartho bhavatītyāha-- ṭhnañivayukta' ityādi| ṭhrūparasagandhasparśāḥ'
ityādi guṇajātiḥ| ṭhgamanākuñcanaprasāraṇāni' iti kriyājātiḥ|
ṭhjātiparatve ca' iti| yadā jāteḥ prādhānyena vivakṣā tadā
jāteḥparatve pradhānatve sati jātiśabdānāmamekavadbhāvo bhavati|
ṭhna niyatadravyavivakṣāyām' iti| yadā kvaciddeśādau niyatānāṃ
dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ vivakṣā bhavati tadā jātiśabdasya
prayoge'pyekavadbhāvo na bhavati| kuta etat ?
jātirityabhidhānānmukhyā jātirāśrīyate; na gauṇī| etacca pradhāne
kāryasampratyayāllabhyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadā jātireva
vyaktiviśeṣamāśritya prayujyate tadā naikavadbhāvaḥ| yadā tu
vyaktiviśeṣamanāśritya prayujyate tadaivaikavadbhāva iti|
ṭhbadarāmalakāni' iti| atra badarāmalakānāñca vyaktiprayuktānāṃ
pratītiḥ; na jātiśabdānām| ata eva vyaktyāśrayaṃ bahuvacanam; anyathā
jāterdvitvāddavivacanameva syāt, na bahuvacanam| aprāṇināmiti
paryudāso'yam| tenāyamartho labhyate-- nañivayuktanyāyena
(vyā.pa.65) rūparasasparśādīnānnaikavadbhāva iti| aprāṇa#nāimiti
pratiṣedhe bahutvaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ vidhāvapi bahutvaṃ gamayati| tena
bahuprakṛtereva dvandva ekadavadbhavati, na dviprakṛteḥ--
ārāśastryāviti||

7. viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ| (2.4.7)
viśiṣṭaśabdo'yaṃ bhedavacanaḥ| yoña'pi ṭhktena nañviśiṣṭenānañ'
(2.1.ka60) ityatra sāvadhāraṇādhikye viśiṣṭaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ; so'pi
bheddavāreṇaiva pratipatayaḥ| teneha vṛtikāro'pi
ṭhbhinnaliṅgānāpapi nāsti--kāśikā}mapi' ityāha| ṭhagrāmāḥ' iti|
pratiṣedhādanayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatītyāha-- ṭhnadīvācinām'
ityādi| yadi nadīvācināṃ dvandvo
deśavācināñcaikavadbhavatītyayamatra sūtrārtho'bhimataḥ, tatkathaṃ
nadīdeśa ityayaṃ dvandva ityanena prakṛtena sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeaśa
ityāha-- ṭhnadyavayavo dvandvonadītyucyate' ityādi| etena gauṇaḥ sūtre
nirdeaśa iti darśayati| nadīdeśa ityayaṃ yadi dvandvasamāsastadā
vyatikīrṇāvayavo dvandvo yasya kaścidavayavo nadī
kaściddeśastasyaikavadbhāvaḥ syāt| kiñca, dvandvo bhavanneṣa samāhāre
vā syāt ? itareratarayoge vā ? tra pūrvasmin pakṣe ṭhsa
napuṃsakam' (2.4.17) iti napuṃsakatvaṃ syāt, itaratra tu
dvivacanamitīmaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha-- ṭhnadīdeśa' iti| ṭhasamāsa evāyaṃ
nirdeaśaḥ' iti|
ṭhmadrakekayāḥ' iti| madrāśca kekayāśca madrakekayāḥ| atha nadīgrahaṇaṃ
kasmāt kriyate ? na deśagrahaṇādeva nadīgrahaṇaṃ siddhamityata āha--
ṭhnadīgrahaṇamadeśatvāt' iti| kasmāt pūnarnadī deśo na
bhavatītyāha-- ṭhjanapado hi deśaḥ' iti| tatraiva deśaśabdasya
rūḍhatvāt| yat punarnadī deśa ityucyate tat tātsthyāt| bhavati
hi tātsthyāt tāccchabdyam, yathā- mañcāḥ krośantīti| ṭhtathā ca'
ityādi| tasmājjanapada eva deśo nānyaḥ parvatādiḥ| evañca kṛtvā
deśagrahaṇena parvatādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati|
ṭhagrāmā ityatra ' ityādi| loke hi grāmagrahaṇena nagaragrahaṇaṃ bhavati,
tathā hyabhakṣyo grāmyaśūkara ityukte nāgaro'pi na bhakṣyate|
tataścehāgrāmā iti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyamāṇo nagarāṇāmapi prāpnoti,
tasmādagrāmā iti pratiṣedhe nagarapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, agrāmā ityanena
nagarāṇāṃ yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti tasya pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedho
vaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tena nagarāṇāṃ vidhireva bhavati| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- yadayam ṭhprācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām' (7.3.14) ityatra
grāmanagarayorbhedenopadānaṃ karoti kajjñāpayati-- iha śastre
grāmagrahaṇena nagarāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti| tenāgrāmā iti
pratiṣedho nagarāṇāṃ na bhavati|
ṭhubhayatacca' ityādi| ubhayasminnityarthaḥ ubhayataḥ| yatra kaścidavayavo
grāmaḥ kaścinnagaraṃ tatra grāmāṇāṃ yaḥ pratiṣedha ucyate sa eva vaktavyaḥ,
vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- agrāmā iti prasajya
pratiṣedho'yaṃ vijñeyaḥ, nacet dvandve grāmā vidyanta iti| tena yatra
grāmagandho'pyasti tatrāpyekavadbhāvo na bhavatīti||

8. kṣudrajantavaḥ| (2.4.8) 
kṣudraśabdo'yamastyeva yaḥ kārpaṇyavati puruṣe vartate; yathā-- kṣudro
devadata iti, kṛpaṇa iti gamyate| asti ca śīlahīne'ṅgahīne ca,
yathā --kṣudrābhyo veti| atra hyaniyatapuṃskā vikalāṅgāśca striyaḥ
kṣudrāgrahaṇena gṛhyante| asti ca parimāṇāpacaye, yathā-- kṣudrāstaṇḍulā
iti| iha tu jantuśabdasannidhānāt prāṇiśarīrasyālpatāmācaṣṭe| tena
parimāṇāpacaye vartamānasya kṣudraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--
ṭhapacitaparimāṇaḥ kṣudraḥ' iti| alpaśarīra ityarthaḥ| apacitaparimāṇatā
cāpekṣābhedādanavasthiteti| asthiretyarthaḥ|
kṣudrajantuśabdasyābhidheyaṃ prati sma-tīrupanyasyati--
ṭhkṣudrajanturanasthiḥ syāt' iti| ṭhkṣudir sampevaṇe' (dhā.pā.1443)
kṣudyata iti kṣudraḥ| āṬṇādikaḥ ṭhsphāyītañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādinā rak|
kṣudraścāsau jantuśceti kṣudrajantuḥ| ṭhanasthiḥ' iti| yasyāsthīni na
vidyante| kavalaṃ yasya carmaśoṇitamāṃsamasti sa kṣudraścāsau
jantuśceti kṣudrajantuḥ| ṭhatha vā kṣudra eva yaḥ' iti smṛtyantaramāha|
kṣodayituṃ yaḥ śakyate sa kṣudrajantuḥ| śabdārthavaśāt prasiddha eva
loke kṣudrajanturgrāhyaḥ| sa punarmaśakādiraṅge yasyātmīyaṃ śoṇitaṃ
nāsti| yeṣāṃ vā gocarmamātraṃ rāśihatvāpi naraḥ patito na bhavati
te prasiddhāḥ kṣudrajantava ucyante| ṭhśataṃ vā prasṛtau yeṣām' aparā
smṛtiḥ| psṛtau añjalau baddhaṃ yeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ śataṃ prasṛtirbhavati
śatena vā prasṛtiḥ pūryate te kṣudrajantavaḥ| ṭhkecidānakulādapi'
iti. kakecidvarṇayanti-- nakulaparyantāḥ kṣudrajantava iti| ṭhiyameva
smṛtiḥ pramāṇam' iti| asyāḥ sarvasmṛtyanugrāhiṇītvāt| tathā
hyaetadupalakṣiteṣu kṣudrajantuṣu smṛtyantaradarśitā api
kṣudrajantavo'ntarbhavati| itarā api smṛtayaḥ pramāṇaṃ kasmānna
bhavantītyāha-- ṭhitarāsām' ityādi| anasthyādīnāṃ smṛtīnāmā
nakulādapīti smṛtyā virodhaḥ| tasmānnaitāḥ
prāmāṇyenābhyupagamyante, tena sarvatredaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| ṭhkṣudrajantavaḥ'
iti bahuvacananirdeaśāt bahuvacananirdeaśāt
bahuprakṛterevaikavadbhāvo yathā syāt| taneha na bhavati--
yūkālikṣe, daṃśamaśakāviti| ayañca prāṇijātyartha ārambhaḥ|
ṭhkṣudrajantava iti kim' iti ? nanu ca sūtrāsyābhāve kiṃ
pratyudāharaṇaṃ syāt ? evaṃ manyate-- anyathā hi jantava iti sūtraṃ
kartavyam, tataścātiprasaṅga syāditi||

9. yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ| (2.4.9)
pratipakṣabhāvamātraṃ loke virodhaśabdenocyate| tasyeha grahaṇe sati
chāyātapau, agnijale ityatrāpi syāditi matvā vairamiha
virodho'bhimata iti darśayitumāha-- ṭhvirodho vairam' iti| evaṃ
manyate-- ṭhkṣudrajantavaḥ' (2.4.8) ityato jantugrahaṇamanuvartate| tena
jantūnāṃ yo virodhastasyeha grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| sa ca vairasvabhāva
eveti| ṭhśāśvatiko nityaḥ' iti| śasvaditi traikalyamucyate| tatra bhavaḥ
śāśvatikaḥ| ṭhkālāṭaṭhañ'(4.3.11)| asmādeva nipātanāt tāntādapi
ko na bhavati| yaśca traikalye bhavati sa nityaḥ|
ṭhgopāliśālaṅkāyanāḥ' iti| gopālayaśca śālaṅkāyanāśca
gopāliśālaṅkāyanāḥ| nātra śāśvatiko virodha ityekavadbhāvo
na bhavati| ṭhcakāraḥ punarasyaiva samuccayārthaḥ' iti| prakṛtasyānyasya
samuccetavyasyābhāvādasyaikavadbhāvasya samuccayārthaścakāro
vijñāyate| tena kiṃ bhavatītyāha-- ṭhtena paśuśakuni' ityādi|
paśuśakunivibhāṣāyā avakāśaḥ--mahājorabhram, mahājorabhrāḥ,
haṃsacakravākam, haṃsacakravākā iti|
nityavirodhināmekavadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ-- brāhmaṇanāstikamiti,
śvaśṛgālam, aśvamahiṣam| kākolūkamityatrobhayaprāptau paratvāt
paśuśakunivibhāṣā syāt| cakārasya punarasyaiva
samuccayārthatvādanena nityamekavadbhavati||

10.śūdrāṇāmaniravasitānām| (2.4.10) 
yadyapi ṭhṣiñ bandhane' (dhā.pā. 1248) iti sinotirbandhane vartate;
tathāpi niravapūrvo bahiṣkaraṇe vartata ityāha-- ṭhniravasānaṃ
bahiṣkaraṇam'| yairbhukte pātraṃ saṃskāreṇāpi na śuddhyati tasmāt
te tato bahiṣkṛtāḥ u pṛthakkṛtāḥ| na labhante tatra bhoktumityarthaḥ||

11. gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca| (2.4.11)
gavāścādīni kṛtaikavadbhāvāni gaṇe paṭhaḷnte| teṣāmamanena
sādhutvamātraṃ vidhīyate| na tvekavadbhāva iti darśayannāha--
ṭhgavāśvādīni' iti| gvāśvamityevamādīnāmajaiḍakaparyantānāṃ
paśudvandvavikalpe vacanamidam| kubjavāmanaprabhṛtīnāṃ
trayāṇāmaprāpte| śvacāṇḍālasyāvirodhaḥ ? yadā virodhaṃ dvandvo
nācaṣṭe kevalañcārthamātre vartate tadā śvacāṇḍālamihāstīti|
ṭhstrīkumāraṃ dāsīmāṇavakam' ityaprāpte vacanam| ṭhśāṭīpiccchakam'
iti ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) iti siddhe, abahuprakṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ|
ṭhuṣṭrakharamuṣṭraśaśam' iti| paśudvandvavibhāṣāprāptau nityārtham|
mūtraśakṛdādīnāṃ
māṃsaśoṇitaparyantānāmaprāṇijātīnāmabahuprakṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ|
darbhaśaraprabhṛtīnāṃ tṛṇavibhāṣāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam|
dāsīdāsādīnāṃ trayāṇāmaprāpte| ṭhpumān striyā' (1.2.67)
ityekaśeṣo na bhavatyasmādeva nipātanāt|
ṭhgavāśvaprabhṛtiṣu yathoccāritaṃ dvandvavṛtam' iti| katham ? tathā
rūpsayāśrayaṇāt| gaṇapāṭhe hi yadeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ rūpaṃ tadāśritam|
yena yathoccāritānāmekavadbhāvalakṣaṇaṃ dvandvavṛtaṃ bhavati|
ṭhrūpāntare tu nāyaṃ vidhiḥ' iti| yadā ṭhavaṅ sphoṭāyanasya ' (6.1.123)
ityavaṅ nāsti tadā rūpāntare jāte'nena sūtreṇa yo vidhiḥ kriyate
sa na bhavati| paśudvandvavibhāṣaiva pravartate||

12. vibhāṣā
vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharotarāṇām| (2.4.12)
vṛkṣādigrahayaṇeneha vakṣādiviśeṣavācināṃ grahaṇam| katham ?
yasmādatra hi vṛkṣādibhirdvandvaḥ pratyekaṃ viśiṣyate, tenaiṣā
vibhāṣā tulyajātīyeṣvevāvatiṣṭhate| virūpeṣu tulyajātīyeṣvapi,
na svarūpeṣu| teṣāṃ dvandvo nāsti; ekaśeṣavidhānāt| virūpeṣvapi
na paryāyeṣu| teṣāṃ dvandvābhāvāt| dvandvābhāvaśca
yugapatprayogābhāvāt, yuktārthābhāvācca|
cārthābhāvastvarthabhedābhāvāt| bhinnādhiṣṭhānā hi cārthatā| na ca
paryāyāṇāṃ bhinnārthatā sambhavati; tasmādvarūpeṣveva
vṛkṣādiviśeṣavāciṣvasyā vibhāṣāyā upasthānam| tena viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ
vṛkṣādiṣu vijñāyate, na svarūpagrahaṇam, nāpi paryāyagrahaṇam| atha
sāmānyaviśeṣavācināṃ grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate, sambhavati hi
sāmānyaviśeṣavācināṃ dvandvaḥ, yathā-- govalīvardamiti ? na;
anabhidhānāt| na hi vṛkṣadhavamityevaṃ loke'bhidhānamasti;
dhavaśabdādeva tadarthābhidhāyino vṛkṣaśabdasyārthasyāvagatvāt,
dhavādiśabdaprayoge vṛkṣādiśabdasya prayogānarhatvāt|
govalīvardamityatra tu balīvardasannidhāne gośabdasya strīgavīṣveva
vṛterdvāvapi viśeṣavācināviti yukto dvandvaḥ|
ye'trāprāṇivācinasteṣāṃ ṭhjātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityekavadbhāve
nitye prāpte vacanamidaṃ vibhāṣārtham| pariśiṣṭānāmaprāpte|
paśugrahaṇenaiva mṛgādigrahaṇe satyapi paśvantareṇeṣāṃ kimartham ?
tulyajātīyānāṃ dvandvo'yamekavadbhavatītyuktam, atra paśugrahaṇenaiva
siddhe mṛgādigrahaṇe satyapi paśvantareṇeṣāṃ paraspareṇa vā dvandvo mā
bhūdityevamartham| ṭhpaśudvandva' ityevaṃ siddhe'śvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ
niyamārtham| yo'nya etayoḥ paryāyastatra mā bhūt-- hayavaḍave iti|
ṭhbahuprakṛtiḥ' iti| bahvarthā bahuvacanāntā vā prakṛtiryasya sa
bahuprakṛtiḥ| bahvarthānāṃ phalādīnāmeṣāṃ bahuvacanāntānāṃ vā dvandva
ekavadbhavatītyarthaḥ||

13. vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci| (2.4.13)
ṭhadravyavācinām' iti| etenādhikaraṇaśabdo'tra dravye vartate nādhāra
iti darśayati| na hi vipratiṣiddhavācināṃ śabdānāmādhāre
vṛtirastiḥ; vibhaktyarthatvādādhāraśakteḥ| ṭhśītoṣṇe' iti|
śītoṣṇayoḥ sahānavasthānalakṣaṇenaiva virodhena
viruddhatvādvipratiṣiddhavācitvam| tathā sukhaduḥkhayorapi||
ṭhkāmakrodhau' iti| kruddho'pi kāmamācaratīti
nānayorvipratiṣiddhatvam||

14. na dadhipayaādīni| (2.4.14)
ṭhyathāyatham' iti| yathāsvaṃ yasya yadātmīyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tenetyarthaḥ| tatra
dadhipayasī ityādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ
vyañjanavācitvādvibhāṣaikavadbhāvaprāptiḥ| nanu ca sarpirmadhunī,
madhusarpiṣī iti rājadantādiṣvanayornipātanādevaikavadbhāvo na
bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; pākṣiko hi vyañjanaikavadbhāvaḥ| tatra
yasmin pakṣe sa nāsti tasminnipātanaṃ pūrvanipātvyabhicārārthaṃ
syāt| itarasminnapi pakṣa ekavadbhāvaniṣedhārtho'tra pāṭhaḥ| yadyevam,
anenaiva siddhatvādrājadantādiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt ? nānarthakaḥ;
bahuvacanārthatvāt| ṭhsarpirmadhunī, madhusarpiṣī' iti| nanu tatrāpi
dvavacanāntāveva paṭhaḷete ? yadyapyevam, tathāpi śabdāśrayatvāt
paranipātasyārthadharmatvāddvitvaṃ nāpekṣyate| arthāśrayastvekavadbhāva
iti tatpraṣedhe yujyate saṃkhyāṃ vivakṣitum| ṭhbrahmaprajāpatī'
ityādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ samāhāraikatvāt prāptiḥ| ṭhśuklakṛṣṇau' iti|
ṭhvipratiṣiddham' (2.3.13) ityādinā| ṭhidhmābārhiṣī' ityādīnāṃ
samāhāraikatvāt prāptiḥ||

15.adhikaraṇaitāvatve ca| (2.4.15)
adhikaraṇaṃ vartipadārthaḥ' iti| vartana vartaḥ u samāsaḥ| bhāve ghañ|
varto'syāstīti varti u samāsāvayavabhutama| vartiśca tat padañceti
vartipadaṃ tasya padasyārtho'dhikaraṇamityucyate| kathaṃ
punastasyādhikaraṇatvāmityata āha-- ṭhsa hi' ityādi| ādhāro
hyadhikaraṇam| vartipadārthaśca samāsārthasyādhāro bhavati; tatra tasya
samavāyāt| vartipadārthairhyavayavairavayavī samāsārtha ārabhyate, avayavī
cāvayaveṣu kasamavaiti| ṭhtasya ' iti| vartipadārthasya| ṭhdaśa pime
nāsti--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca} ime dantauṣṭhāḥ}' iti| ṭhdvandvaśca'
(2.4.2) ityādinā prāptiḥ||

16. vibhāṣā samīpe| (2.4.16)
adhikaraṇaitāvatvasya prakṛtatvāt tadapekṣayaiva samīpatvaṃ vijñāyata
ityata āha-- ṭhadhikaraṇaitāvatvasya samīpe' iti| ṭhupadaśaṃ
dantauṣṭham'iti| atrādhikaraṇaitāvatvaṃ daśasaṃkhyā, tatsamīpaṃ
navaikādaśa vā| tatra daśaśabda etāvatvamācaṣṭe| upaśabdaḥ sāmīpyam|
kathaṃ punardvandvaikavadbhāvo vikalpyamāno'nuprayogasya labhyata ityata
āha-- ṭhavyayasya' ityādi| yadyapyarthātideśādanuprayogasyāpi vikalpo
labhyate, tathāpi parīhārāntaramapyastīti darśanārthamasyopanyāsaḥ|
tatrāvyayasya saṃkhyāyā avyayībhāvo vihitaḥ--ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6)
ityādinā| bahuvrīhirapi vihitaḥ-- ṭhsaṃkhyāyāvyayāsanna' (2.2.25)
ityādinā| atraikavadbhāvapakṣa ekārthasya dvandvasyaikārtha
evāvyayībhāvo'nuprayujyate| ekārthatvaṃ punastasya
sāmīpyapradhānasatvāt| yadyapyavyayībhāvo'vyayam, tathāpyabhedaikatvaṃ
bhedābhāvalakṣaṇaṃ tasyāstyeva sāmānādhikaraṇyam| itaratra tu
bahvarthasya dvandvasya bahvartha eva bahuvrīhiranuprayujyate| bahvarthaṃ
punarbahuvrīheḥ samīpinaḥ prādhānyāt| bahuvrīhirhi samīpī
pradhānatvādbhedasaṃkhyāmupādata iti bahvartho bhavati| ṭhupadaśam' iti|
ṭhavyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' (5.4.7) ityanuvartamāne ṭhanaśca' (5.4.108)
iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ| ṭhnastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopoḥ| ṭhupadaśāḥ'
iti| bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt' (5.4.73) iti ḍac||

17. sa napuṃsakam| (2.4.17)
ṭhpañcagavam' iti| ṭhgorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac| sagrahaṇaṃ
dvigorapi yathā syādityevamartham. itarathā hi ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā
bhavati pratiṣedo vā' (vyā.pa.19) ityanantarasyaiva dvandvasya syānna
vyavahitasya dvigoḥ, naitadasti; ekavacanamityanuvartate, tasya
ṭhnapuṃsakam' ityanena sambandhe sati kuto vyavadhānam ! na
hyatraikaravacanena viśeṣo dvandvo'nenāpekṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
ekavacanamātram| prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ tarhi sagrahaṇam| sa
ityetadanuvādo bhaviṣyati, anuvādaśca prasiddhasyaiva bhavati| tathā ca
yathādarśanamiyaṃ liṅgavyavasthā''khyāyata iti| tena dvandvaikavadbhāve
nityaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ vijñāyate| dvigoścāniyatā| tena
ṭhakārāntotrapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā.156) ityetadupapannaṃ
bhavati| ṭhpañcapūlī' iti| ṭhdvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp| etadeva dvigoḥ
strīprakaraṇe ṅībvidhānaṃ jñāpakam-- ṭhkvacit striyāṃ dvigurbhāṣyate'
iti|
ṭhpañcakhaṭvam, pañcakhaṭvī' iti| upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte pakṣe ṅīp|
ṭhpañcatakṣam, pañcatakṣī' iti| nalope kṛte pakṣe ṅīp||

18. avyayībhāvaśca| (2.4.18)
ṭhadhistri' iti| ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ| ṭhhrasvo
napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvatvam| ṭhunmatagaṅgam,
lohitagaṅgam' iti| ṭhanyapadārthe ca sañjñāyām' (2.1.21) iti
samāsaḥ| pūrvavaddhrasvatvam| ṭhpūrvapadārthapradhānasyāliṅgataiva
prāptā' iti. adhistrītyādau pūrvapadasyāliṅgatvāt|
ṭhanyapadārthapradhānasyābhidheyaliṅtā' iti| unmatagaṅmityādau
deśo'bhidheyaḥ, sa ca puṃlliṅga iti puṃlliṅgatvaṃ prāptam|
ṭhpuṇyāham' iti| karmadhārayaḥ| ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) iti
ṭac samāsāntaḥ| ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi' (2.4.29) iti pulliṅgatāyāṃ
vacanam|
ṭhvipatham' iti| ṭhpathaḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' (vā. 161) iti
paravalliṅgatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18)
itaki samāsaḥ| ṭhcatuṣpatham' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| samāhāradvigau tu
pūrveṇaiva siddham| ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ
samāsāntaḥ||

19. tatpuruṣo|ñanañkarmadhārayaḥ|
nañmātrasya tatpuruṣasyābhāvannañātra nañsamāso lakṣyata ityāha--
ṭhnañsamāsam' iti| ṭhvakṣyati-vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyā' iti|
anantarayogeyvasyādhikārasya prayojanaṃ nāstītyastānullaṅghya
vyavahitasya ṭhvibhāṣā senāsurā' (2.4.25) ityādiyogasyopanyāsaḥ|
ita utareṣvanantareṣu yogeṣvasya prayojananābhāvaḥ ṭhna hi saṃjñāyāṃ
kanthośīnareṣu tatpuruṣa nañsamāsaḥ, karmadhārayo vā'sti'
ityādinā bhāṣye pratipāditaḥ| ṭhdṛḍhasenaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ|
athānañkarmadhāraya iti ko'yannirdeaśaḥ ? yadi hyatra
nañkarmadhārayayorvadandvaḥ, tadā samāhāre vā syāditaretarayoge
vā ? tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe napuṃsakatvaṃ prasajyeta; itaratra tu
dvivacanam| nirdeaśasya sautratvādubhayathāpyadoṣaḥ| tathā hi--
ccchandovat sūtrāṇi bhavantīti| cchandasi ca liṅgavacanavyatyayaṃ
tṛtīye'dhyāye vakṣyati ||

20. saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu| (2.4.20)
prakṛte na tadantavidhiriti prakṛtasya tatpuruṣasya kanyayā
tadantavidhirvajñāyata ityāha-- ṭhkanthāntastatpuruṣaḥ' iti|
ṭhsauśamikantham' iti| sauśamīnāṃ kanthā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
ṭhdākṣikanthā' iti| astīyaṃ grāmasya saṃjñā; na tūśīnareṣu kiṃ tarhi ?
tato'nyatreti||

21. upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām| (2.4.21)
ṭhupajñāyata ityupajñā' iti| ṭhātaścapasarge' (3.3.106) iti karmaṇyaṅ|
ṭhupakramyata ityupakramaḥ'| atra ṭhakartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19)
iti karmaṇi ghañ| ṭhnodātopadeśasya' (7.3.34) ityādinā
vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ| ṭhyadyapyupajñeyasyopakramyasya ca' ityādi| upajñeyaḥ u
parijñeyaḥ| upakramaḥ u upakramitavyaḥ| ādiḥ u prāthamyam|
ṭhpāṇinyupajñam' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tena tatprathamataḥ praṇītam|
ṭhakālam' iti| sa svasmin vyākaraṇe kālādhikāraṃ na kṛtavān|
ṭhvyāḍaḷupajñaṃ daśahuṣkaraṇam' iti| vyaḍirapyatra yugapatkālabhāvināṃ
vidhīnāṃ madhye daśa huṣkaraṇāni kṛtvā paribhāṣitavān pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ
kālamiti| vālmīkeḥ ślokā vālmīkiślokā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ||

22. chāyā bāhulye| (2.4.22)
ṭhpūrvapadārthadharmo bāhulyam' iti| atra hetumāha--
ṭhśalabhādīnām'ityādi| śalbhādīnāṃ bahutvaṃ śalabhacchāyamityādau
hi gamyate, na hi tena vinā chāyā sambhavati| ataḥ pūrvapadārthasya
śalabhāderbāhulyaṃ dharmaḥ||

23. sabhā rājā'manuṣyapūrvā| (2.4.23)
ṭhiha kasmānna bhavati-- rājasabhā' iti| ṭhsvaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā'
(1.1.68) iti vacanadihaiva yuktaṃ bhavitumityabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhtadayuktam'
ityādi| etena ṭhparyāyavacanasyaiveṣyate' (kā.vṛ.2.4.23)
ityetadāptavacanena draḍhayati| yataḥ paryāyavacanasyaiveṣyate tasmādeva
hetoridamuktam| ṭhpjitparyāyavacanasyaiva-kāśikā|
jaditparyāyavanasyaiva' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ paryāyavacanasyaiva
bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ, yāvatā neha sūtre tathāvidhaṃ vacanamasti ? evaṃ
manyate-- nanu ca pūrvagrahaṇamasti, ataḥ pūrvagrahaṇādeṣo'rtho
labhyate, katham ? yadi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt ṭhrājā'manuṣyāt' ityevaṃ
brūyāt, pañcamyeva hi dikśabdamadhyāharayiṣyati, na ca sabhāntasya
tatpuruṣasya pūrvaśabdādanyo dikśabdo'dhyāhartuṃ śakyata iti kiṃ
pūrvagrahaṇena ? tat kriyate'rthagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| arthagrahaṇe ca
satyarājā'manuṣyapūrvā iti dviṣpratiṣedho varṇyate-- arājapūrvā,
amanuṣyapūrveti| tadanena nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) tatsadṛśā
rājaparyāyā gṛhyante, na tu tadviśeṣāścandraguptādayaḥ, na hi te
rājārthasya vācakā iti| atha vā-- arthagrahaṇe'smin ṭhvibhāṣā samīpe'
(2.4.16) ityato vibhāṣāgarhaṇamanuvartate maṇḍūakaplutinyāyena, sā
ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| teneha
prayāyavacanasyaiveśvarādergrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, nānyasya|
ṭhamanuṣyaśabdo phi-- vṛtau nāsti} hi rūḍhirūpeṇa rakṣaḥ
piśācādiṣu vartate' iti| yadyevam, ṭhanuṣyakartṛke ca' (3.2.53)
ityatra yadudāhariṣyati-- jāyāghnastilakālakaḥ, patighnī pāṇirekhā,
śleṣmadhnaṃ madhu, pitaghnaṃ ghṛtamiti,tadvyāhanyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
atra hi cakāra kriyate, tasyaiva vidheḥ samuccayārthaḥ| tena
punarvidhānāt, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.ka113) iti vacanādvā
rakṣaḥ piśācādibhyo'nyatrāpi bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- amanuṣyaśabdo'yaṃ
dvividhaḥ-- astyevāyamavyutpanno yo rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu vartate, asti
ca vyutpanno nañsamāsaḥ; tatrehāvyutpannasya rūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam|
ṭhamanuṣyakartṛke ca'(3.2.53) ityatra vyutpannasyārūḍhiśabdasya
grahaṇamityavirodhaḥ| ṭhdevadatasabhā' iti| devadataśabdo na
rājaparyāyaḥ; nāpyamanuṣyavacanaḥ||

24. aśālā ca| (2.4.24)
sabhāśabdo'yamastyeva kuṭīvacanaḥ-- kadīrghā sabhā,hrasvā sabheti| asti
ca saṅghātavacanaḥ, yathā-- brāhmaṇānāṃ sabhā, strīṇāṃ sabheti; iha
cāśāleti kuṭīvacanapratiṣedhāditaro gṛhyata ityata āha--
ṭhsaṅghātavacanaḥ' ityādi||

25. vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām| (2.4.25)
ṭhśvaniśam' iti| yasyāṃ niśāyāṃ śvāno matā viharanti sā śvaniśam;
śvaniśeti cocyata iti||

26. kaparavalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ| (2.4.26)
kimarthamidam ? ihāyaṃ dvandvaḥ sravapadārthapradhānaḥ, sa yadā
bhinnaliṅgavayavo bhavati tadā pūrvotarayoḥ
padayorbhinnaliṅgayoranugrāhakamekaṃ liṅgaṃ nāsti yena
samudāyo vyapadiśyate| ubhābhyāñca yugapadasambhavādaśakyo vyapadeśaḥ
kartṛm| ataḥ paryāyaḥ syāditi dvandve niyamārthaṃ vacanam|
tatpuruṣo'pi dvividhaḥ-- pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ,
utarapadārthapradhānaśceti| tato ya utarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣastasya
pradhānatvādeva parasya yalliṅgaṃ tatsamudāyasya bhaviṣyatīti taṃ
pratyanarthakaṃ vacanam| yastu pūrvapadārthapradhānastasya pūrvapadasya
yalliṅgaṃ tasmin prasakta utarapadasya yalliṅgaṃ tadvidhīyata iti tatra
vidhyarthametadbhavati| ṭhdvandvasya tatpuruṣasya ca' iti|
dvandvatatpuruṣayoriti ṣaṣṭhīyaparaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvāt| tathā ca
mayūrīkukkuṭāvityatra pūrvapadasya strīpratyayo nivarteta,
tatpuruṣe'pyarthapippalītyatra pūrvapadasyāpi strīpratyayaḥ syāt;
tasmāta ṣaṣṭhīyam| tathā ca sati samāsārthasyāyamatideśo vijñāyate|
pūrvapadsaya na pratiṣidhyate; nāpi vidhīyata iti na bhavati
pūrvoktadoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ| samāsārthasya
liṅgātideśādanuprayogo'pi samāsārthasyaiva viśeṣaṇamiti
talliṅgameva bhavati| kaṭhkukkuṭamayūryāvime' iti|
upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ na bhavati, upasarjanasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| uktaṃ hyaetat
prāk-- ṭhupasarjanamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā
vijñāyeta-- apradhānamupasarjanam' iti| dvandvaśca sarvapadārthapradhāna iti
nāstyupasarjanasaṃjñā| ardhapippalītyādāvapi satyekavibhaktiyoge
yathā pippalyāderupasarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati,
tathopasarjanasaṃjñāvidhāveva tatpratipāditam| 
ṭhvaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ṭhtatpuruṣaḥ'
(2.4.19) ityanuvartamāne punastatpuruṣagrahaṇasyaitat prayojanam--
tatpuruṣaviśeṣasya paravalliṅgatā yathā syāditi. tena
dviguprāptāpannalampūrvagatisamāseṣu paravalliṅgatā na bhavati;
anyathā yadi sarvastheyaṃ tatpuruṣasya paravalliṅgatā syāt tadā
ṭhparakavalliṅgaṃ dvandvasya ca' ityevaṃ brūyāt| cakārāddhi prakṛtasya
tatpuruṣasyeti vijñāsyata eveti| ṭhpañcakapālaḥ' iti| taddhitārthe
dviguḥ| saṃskṛtārtha utpannasyāṇaḥ ṭhdvigorluganapatye'(4.1.88) iti
luk| ṭhprāptajīvikaḥ' iti| prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā' (2.2.4) iti
samāsaḥ| ṭhalañjīvikaḥ' iti| ṭhparyādayo glānādyarthe caturthyā' (vā. 93)
iti samāsaḥ| niṣkauśāmbiḥ' iti| ṭhnirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā'
(vā.94) iti||

27. pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau| (2.4.27)
ṭhaśvavaḍavayorvibhāṣaikavadbhāvo vihitaḥ'iti| ṭhvibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛga'
(2.4.12) ityādinā| ṭharthātideśaścāyam, na nipātanam' iti|
nipātane hi pūrvavaditi vacanamarthakaṃ syāt, aśvavaḍavāvityevaṃ
brūyāt| tena ṭhdvivacanamatantram' ityādinā'rthātideśasya phalaṃ
darśayati| nipātane hi vacanāntare pūrvavalliṅgatā na syāt||

28. hemantaśiśirāvahorātre ca ccchandasi| (2.4.28)
paravalliṅgatāpavādo'yaṃ yoga iti hemantaśiśirāvityatra
napuṃsakatvāpavādaḥ, parasya śiśiraśabdasya napuṃsakatvāt|
ṭhahorātre' iti| puṃlliṅgatvāpavādo'yam| ṭhrātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi'
(2.4.29) iti puṃlliṅgatve prāpte cchandasi liṅgavyatyaya ukta iti--
ṭhvyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) ityanena||

29. rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi| (2.4.29)
ṭhparavalliṅgatayā strīnapuṃsakayoḥ prāptayoḥ' iti| rātriśabdasya
strīliṅgatvādahaḥ śabdasya ca napuṃsakatvāt| ṭhdvirātraḥ' iti| dvayo
rātryoḥ samāhāraḥ| ṭhtaddhitārtha' (2.1.51) ityādinā samāhāre
dviguḥ| ṭhahaḥ sarvaikadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācca rātreḥ' (5.4.87) ityac
samāsāntaḥ| atra hi ṭhac pratyanvavapūrvāt sāmalomnaḥ' (5.4.75)
ityato'jityanuvartate| ṭhpūrvāhṇaḥ' iti|ra ahnaḥ pūrvamiti vigṛhya
ṭhpūrvāpara' (2.2.1) ityādinā samāsaḥ, ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91)
iti ṭac, ṭhahno'hna etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ; ṭhahno'dantāt'
(8.4.7) iti ṇatvam| ṭhdvayahaḥ' iti| pūrvavat samāhāre dviguḥ|
pūrvavat ṭac| ṭhna saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' (5.4.89) iti
pratiṣedhāvahnadeśo na bhavati| ṭhahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti
ṭilopaḥ| ṭhanuvākādayaḥ' iti| kecidāhaḥ-- bahuvrīhirayam,
anukrānto vāko'nayānena vā'nuvākaḥ| strīliṅge
napuṃsakaliṅge ca prāpte vacanam| anye ca manyante-- yo'yaṃ ghañ
sa sāmarthyāt puṃlliṅgaḥ| tasya hi napuṃsake bhāve kto'pavādaḥ,
striyāñca ktin| tenāsau sāmarthyāt puṃsyavāvatiṣṭhate|
yastvakartari kārake vidhīyate sa puṃsi napuṃsake ca vartate;
bādhakābhāvāt| striyāntu na bhavati; yataḥ ṭhstriyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94)
ityakartari ca kārake vidīyate, sa viśeṣavihito ghañaṃ bādhate| iha
ca vaceḥ ṭhakartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti ghañ vihitaḥ|
anūcyate yat padaṃ tadanuvākaḥ| ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti
samāsaḥ| asmin pakṣe napuṃsake prāpte vacanam||

30. apathaṃ napuṃsakam| (2.4.30)
ṭhapadham' iti| ṭhpatho vibhāṣā' (5.4.72) iti yadā samāsāntapratiṣedho
nāsti tadā ṭhṛkpūrabdhūpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ|
samāsāntanirdaśādyadā samāsānto nāsti tadā puṃlliṅgataiva
bhavati-- apanthā iti||

31. arddharcāḥ puṃsi ca| (2.4.31)
arddharcā iti bahuvacananirdeaśādādyartho gamyata ityāha-- ṭharddharcādayaḥ'
ityādi|
ṭhśabdarūpāśrayā ceyam' iti| śabdarūpamāśrayo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā|
śabdarūpamāśrityārthamanapekṣyadviliṅgateyaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ|
kriyāśabdasyābhidheyavalliṅgamiti bhūtaṃ kuṇḍam, bhūtā śāṭī,
bhūto ghaṭa iti| yaugikasyābhidheyavalliṅgamiti lavaṇaṃ śākam,
lavaṇā yavagūḥ, lavaṇaḥ sūpaḥ iti| lavaṇena saṃsṛṣṭamiti ṭhsaṃsṛṣṭe'
(4.4.ka22) iti ṭhak| tasya ṭhlavaṇālluk' (4.4.24) iti luk| ata eva
taddhitārthayoge bhūtatvāt apūrvaśabdo'yaṃ dharmādharmayorvartate|
ṭhtatsādhane' iti| adṛṣṭopārjanaṃ prati yasyāṅgabhāvaḥ sa
tatsādhanamityarthaḥ, sa punaryāgādiḥ| karmaśabdo nakārānta
evobhayaliṅga iti krama karmā ceti||

32. idamo'nvādeśe'śanudātastṛtīyādau| (2.4.32)
ṭhādeśaḥ kathanam' iti| prathamataḥ pratipādanam, śabdena|
ṭhanavādeśo'nukatham' iti| paścātpratipādanam| tacca
yādṛśamihābhipretaṃ tādṛśaṃ paścādvakṣyati| ṭhābhyāṃ chātrābhyām'
ityādi| ādeśa eṣaḥ| ṭhatho ābhyām' ityādyanvādeśaḥ eṣaḥ|
athośabdenātrānvādeśa ucyate|
nanu ca tyādādyatve kṛte hali lope (7.2.113) cātho
ābhyāmityādirūpaṃ sidhyatyeva, tasmādanudātameva kevalaṃ vidheyam,
ādeśavacanaṃ tvanarthakamityata āha-- ṭhādeśavacanam' ityādi|
ṭhavyayasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ' (5.3.71) ityakaracpratyaye kṛte
satyapi ṭhanāpyakaḥ' (7.2.112) ityadhikārādidrūpasya lopo
nāstītyastayādeśavacane rūpaṃ na sidhyati| nanu ca ṭhhali lopaḥ'
(7.2.113) ityanena halādāvidrūpasya lope'nenājādau yathā
syādityavevamarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? naitadasti; sāmarthyāddhi
halādāveva bhavitavyam, tatra smaibhāvādiṣu kṛteṣu| tasmāt
sākackārthamādeśavacanam| sākackārthe cāsminnārabdhe śitkaraṇaṃ
sarvādaśārtham; anyathā hyalo'ntsya syāt| prayojanābhāvānna
bhaviṣyatīti cet, na; akārasya tvakāravacanaṃ
dīrghādeśanivṛtt«athaṃ vijñāyate| athānudātavacanaṃ kimartham,
yāvatā ṭhūḍidampadādyappumraidyaubhyaḥ' (6.1.171) iti vibhakterudātatve
kṛte ṭhānudātaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.158) iti prakṛteranudātatvaṃ
bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; savibhaktyarthamanudātavacanam,
savibhaktikasyānudātatvaṃ yathā syāt| tena
sarvānudātamevābhyāmiti padamanvādeśe bhavati| yadi
paścāduccāraṇamātramanvādeśastadeha kasmānna bhavati-- devadataṃ
bhojaya, imañca yajñadatamiti ? asti hyatrāpyanvādeśaḥ, tataśca
ṭhdvitīyāṭaussvenaḥ' (2.4.34) ityenādeśaḥ prāpnotītyata āha-- ṭhneha
paścāduccāraṇamātram' ityādi| ṭhteneha na bhavati' iti| na
hyatraikasyābhidheyasya pūrvaṃ śabdena pratipāditasya dvitīyaṃ
pratipādanam, kiṃ tarhi ? abhidheyāntarasya| tathāhi pūrvaṃ devadatasya
pratipādanam, utarakālaṃ yajñadatasya| kathaṃ punarayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate,
yāvatāpaścāduccāraṇamātre'nvādeśaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, na ca sāmānyaśabdaḥ
śabdāntasannidhānādikaramanteraṇa viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
yasmāt ṭhvibhāṣā senā' (2.4.25) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvartate,
sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenaivaṃvidhaviṣaya
evānvādeśo'tra grahītavyaḥ, nānvādeśamātram|
tasamādviśiṣṭasyānvādeśasya grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| yadapi ca
vakṣyati tatra-- ṭhyatra kiñcidvidhāya' ityādi, tadapīmameva nyāyaṃ hṛdi
kṛtveti boddhavyam||

33. etadastratasostratasau cānudātau| (2.4.33)
ṭhatho atra' iti| ṭhsaptamyāstral' (5.3.10)| ṭhatho ataḥ'

69. upakādibhyo'nyatarasyāmadvandve| (2.4.68)

vināpi tenārthasya pratīteḥ| katham ? tikakitavādayo'pīha trayaḥ
paṭhaḷnte-- upakalamakāḥ, bhraṣṭakakapiṣṭalāḥ, kṛṣṇājinakṛṣṇasundarā

niṣphalamevādvandvagrahaṇaṃ syāt| tasmād
dvandvādhikāranivṛtyarthametadyauktamiti| ṭhteṣāṃ pūrveṇa nityameva

syāt| ṭhadvandve tvanena vikalpaḥ' iti| prakṛtatvālluko vijñeyaḥ|
tatropakalamaśabdābhyāṃ naḍādiphagvidhānāt tasya lugvikalpaḥ, tataḥ
parebhyaḥ prāk kapiṣṭhalaśabdāt iñaḥ| kapiṣṭhalamayūrakarṇa--

kaṭheraṇiśabdādata iñaḥ| kaṭheraṇiśabdādautsargikasyāṇaḥ|

1. pratyayaḥ| (3.1.1)

saṃjñā syāt| tatra prakṛtiḥ-- ṭhguptijkidbhyaḥ san' (3.1.5),
upapadam-- ṭhstambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ' (3.2.13), upādhiḥ--

2. paraśca| (3.1.2)
ṭhayamapyadhikāraḥ' iti| na kevalaṃ pratyaya ityapiśabdārthaḥ| ṭhyoge
yoge upatiṣṭhate' iti| paribhāṣāyā adhikārasya bhedaṃ darśayati|
paribhāṣā hyaekadeśasthaiva sarvatra śāstre vyāpriyate, na tu
pratiyogamupatiṣṭhate| ṭhparibhāṣā vā' iti| pakṣāntaraṃ darśayati|
ekadeśasyaiva sarvatra śāstre vyāpriyata ityeṣa paribhāṣādharmo vṛtau na
darśitaḥ; adhikāradharmapradarśanadvāreṇāvagamyamānatvāt| yadi hi
prayogamupatiṣṭhamānā paribhāṣā kāryasiddhau vyāpriyeta
tadā'dhikāraparibhāṣayorbhedo na syāt, tathā ca tayoriha
bhedenopanyaso niṣphalaḥ syāt| liṅgavatī ceyaṃ paribhāṣā,
liṅgañcāsyāḥ pratyayasaṃjñaiva| dhātorveti kriyāvācinyā
prakṛteridamupalakṣaṇam, tena tiṅntamapi gṛhyate| tadapi
kriyāpradhānatvāt kriyāvācīti śakyate vyapadeṣṭuam| pradhānena hi
vyapadeśā bhavanti, yathā--- rājadhānīti| ṭhprātipadikādvā' iti|
akriyābhidhāyinyāḥ prakṛteridamupakṣaṇam, tena ṅyāpāvapi gṛhyaete|
ṭhtaitirīyam' iti| proktārthe ṭhtitiravaratantukhaṇḍikokhāccchaṇ'
(4.3.102) iti cchaṇ| tadantāt ṭhtadadhīte tadveda' (2.4.59) ityaṇ| tasya
ṭhproktālluk' (4.2.64) iti luk| atha cakāraḥ kimarthaḥ; yāvatā nātra
kiñcit prakṛtamasti yaccakāreṇa samuccīyate ? ityāha-- ṭhcakāraḥ
punaḥ' ityādi| anyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvādasyaiva
samuccayārthaścakāro vijñāyate, tena bahulādhikāre'pi ye pratyayā
vidhīyante teṣvapyṛṇādiṣu paratvaṃ na vikalpyate|
kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate ? paro yathā syāt, pūrvo mā bhūditi|
naitadasti prayojanam, tathā hi-- yamiccchati pūrvaṃ tamāha---
ṭhavyayasarvanāmnāmakac prākṭeḥ' (5.3.71) iti| ya idānīmato'nyaḥ
pratyayaḥ so'ntareṇāpi vacanaṃ para eva bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti;
yeṣāmeva hi pratyayānāṃ deśo niyamyate ta eva niyatadeśāḥ syuḥ|
ya idānīmato'nyo'niyatadeśaḥ sa kadācit pare, kadācit pūrve,
kadācinmadhye syāt, tasmāt paraśceti vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam;
yasmāt dhātoḥ pratipadikāditi ca digyogalakṣameyaṃ pañcamī;
anyasyāpādānādeḥ pañcamīnimitasyābhāvāt| tasmādeṣaiva
paradikśabdādhyāhāraṃ kariṣyati ? naitadasti; pūrvadikśabdādhyāhāraḥ
syāt, tathā ca pūrve'pi kadācit sannādayaḥ syuḥ|
ṭhtasmādityutarasya' (1.1.67) ityanayā paribhāṣayā tarhi vyavasthā
bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; yatra pañcamīnirdiṣṭāt parasya ṣaṣṭhīnirdeaśasya
kāryaṃ vidhīyate so'sya viṣayaḥ, na ca sannādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷa nirdiśyante,
tanāpi teṣāṃ sambandhikāryaṃ vidhīyate, teṣāmeva bhāvyamānatvāt|
nanu ca pratyayasaṃjñākāryaṃ vidhīyate ? naivam, kathaṃ punarasatāṃ
teṣāṃ śakyaṃ saṃjñākāryaṃ vidhātum ? kiñca yeṣāṃ pratyayasaṃjñaiva na
vidhīyate-- ṭhkaṇeṣṭhaḥ' (da.u. 5.6) ṭhśamerḍhaḥ' (5.11),
ityevamādīnām, tatra kā gatiḥ syāt ? na hyaeṣāṃ pratyayasaṃjñeṣyate,
tathā hi-- kaṇṭhaḥ, śaṇḍha ityatra pratyayasyocyamānamikādeśādikāryaṃ na
bhavati| yadyevam, pratyayasyocyamānaṃ paratvamapi na syāt?
paraścetyadhikārasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati| asati hyaetasmin vacane
satyapi tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasthāne bahulādhikāre
vidhīyamānatvāduṇādiṣu paratvaṃ vikalpyeta| tasmāt
kartavyametat||

3. ādyaudātaśca| (3.1.3)
ṭhaniyatasvarapratyayaprasaṅge' ityādinā sūtrārambhasya prayojanaṃ
darśayati| aniyato'vyavasthitaḥ svaro yasya sa tathā, sa cāsau
pratyayaśceti karmadhārayaḥ, tasya prasaṅgaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
aniyatasvaro yaḥ pratyayastasya prasaṅge sati
vacanamidamāderudātārtham| ṭhaniyatasvaraprasaṅge' iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ|
tatrāniyataśabdasya svaraśabdena viśeṣamasamāsaṃ kṛtvā prasaṅgaśabdena
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| aniyatānāmudātādīnāṃ svarāṇāṃ prasaṅge
satyāderudātārtha vacanam| ṭhanekākṣu ca' ityādi| aneke'co yeṣāṃ
te'nekācaḥ| teṣvanekākṣu pratyayeṣu deśasyāniyame sati
vacanamāderudātārtham-- āderevodātatvaṃ yathā syāt, madhye'nte
ca mā bhūditi| ye hyaekācaḥ pratyayāstatra
deśasyābhāvādasatyapyādigrahaṇe deśyāniyamo na sambhavati,
ato'nekākṣu cetyuktam|
anekācāṃ hyasatyādigraha ādimadhyāntānāmaniyamena svaraḥ
prasajyetanekācaḥ pratyayāderyadyādyaudātārthavacanaṃ nārthaṃ etena;
yasmādāderanudātādīnāṃ madhyāntayoścodātasya prasaṅga eva
nāsti| tathā hi-- yamanudātamiccchati, karoti tatra
pakāramanubandham, āha ca-- ṭhanudātau suppitau' (3.1.4) iti;
svaritamapi yamiccchati, karoti tatra takāramanubandham, āha ca--
ṭhtit svaritam' (6.1.185) iti; ekaśrutiṃ yamiccchati tatraikaśrutigrahaṇaṃ
karoti, āha ca-- ṭhekaśruti dūrātsambuddhau' (1.2.33) iti;
antodātamapi yamiccchati karoti tatra cakāramanubandham, āha ca--
ṭhcitonta udāto rita' (kā.6.1.163) iti; madhyodātamapi yamiccchati,
karoti tatra rephamanubandham, āha-- ṭhupotamaṃ riti' (6.1.217) iti;
ya idānīmato'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ so'ntareṇāpi vacanamādyaudāta eva
bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; yeṣāmeva hi svaro niyamyate ta eva
niyatasvarāḥ syuḥ, yastvaniyatasvaraḥ pratyayastasyāniyamenaiva svaraḥ
prasajyeta-- kadācidudātaḥ kadācit svarāntaram| udāto'pi bhavan
kadācidādau, kadācinmadhye, kadācidante syāt| tasmāt
kartavyametat||

4. anudātau suppitau| (3.1.4)
ṭhpūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ' iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt| subiti
pratyāhārasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya; tasya
pitvādevānudātasya siddhatvāt| ata eva vṛtau ṭhsupaḥ' iti
bahuvacanena nirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ| pratyāhāragrahaṇañcedaṃ supa eva pakāreṇa
nānyena; tasyānanyārthatvāt| ṭhpacati, paṭhati' iti|
śabatrodāharaṇam, na tipa; tasya ṭhtāsyanudāta' (6.1.186) ityādinaiva
siddhatvāt||

5. guptijkidbhyaḥ san| (3.1.5)
ṭhpratyayasaṃjñā cādhikṛtaiva' iti| vispaṣṭārthametat| pratyayaśabdaḥ
saṃjñātvenādhikriyate; ṭhā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ' (kā.3.1.1)
ityato vacanādeva pratipādyasyāvagatatvāt| nanu ca satyapi
pratyayasaṃjñāyā ihopasthāne naiva tayā sano bhavitavyam; yataḥ pratyaya
ityanvarthasaṃjñeyam-- pratiyantyanenārthāniti pratyayaḥ, na ca sanā
kañcanārthaṃ pratiyanti; tasyānarthakatvāt, na hīha sanaḥ kaścanārtho
nirdiśyate| na ca ṭhanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhaviṣyati'
(pu.pa.pā.90) itisvārtha eva san bhaviṣyatīti yuktaṃ
parikalpayitum; gopanādeḥ svārthasya sannantādapratīteḥ|
athānarthakasyāpi pratyayādhikāre vidhānasāmarthyāt saṃjñā
bhaviṣyatīti cet ? na; evañca ṭhhanasta ca' (3.1.108) ṭhtrapujatunoḥ
ṣuk' (4.3.138) iti vikārāgamayorapi syāt| naiṣa doṣaḥ; astyeva
sano'rthaḥ, kaḥ punaraso ? nindādiḥ| yadāha--
ṭhnindākṣamāvyādhipratīkāreṣu saniṣyate' (vā. 178) iti| kutaḥ
punaretadavasitam-- sano'rthā nindādaya iti ?
anvayavyatirekābhyām| sati hi sani jugupsata ityādau te'rthāḥ
pratīyante, asati tu sani satsvapi gupādiṣu gopayatītyādau te na
pratīyante| tasmādarthavāneva sanniti bhavatyeva pratyayasaṃjñā|
ṭhjugupsate' ityārdhadhātukatvābhāvādiṇ na bhavati|
ārdhadhātukatvābhāvastu sano dhātorityavidhānāt| ṭhkuhoścu'
(7.4.62) iti cutvam-- jakāraḥ| ṭhtitikṣate' iti| jakārasya ṭhcoḥ kuḥ'
(8.2.30) kutvam-- gakāraḥ| tasya ṭhkhari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam--
kakāraḥ|
ṭhnindākṣamā' ityādi| kathaṃ punarnindādiṣviṣyamāṇo labhyate ?
vakṣyamāṇaṃ vāgrahaṇaṃ sarvasya śeṣo vijñāyate, sā ca
vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena nindādiṣu nityaṃ san bhavati, anyatra na
bhavati| prāyikañcaitat vyādhipratīkārasyārthamanyathā vyākhyāsyati| atha
vā-- kṣetriyāṇi ca tṛṇāni śasyārthe kṣetre jātāni cikitsyāni
vināśayitavyāni| atha vā-- kṣetriyaḥ pāradārikaḥ| paradārāḥ
parakṣetram,tatra cikitsyo nigrahītavya ityarthaḥ| saṃśaye'pi dṛśyate--
ṭhvicikitsati me manaḥ' iti| yadyapyatropasargasambandhāt saṃśayaḥ
pratīyate, tathāpi dhātoreva vācya iṣyate, upasargasya tu dyotyaḥ|
tasmāt prāyikaṃ vyādhipratīkāragrahaṇam| prāyeṇa hi loke
vyādhipratīkāre cikitsatīti prayujyate| ṭhanyatra' iti| gopanādau|
ṭhgopayati' iti| hetumaṇṇic| tejayati, ṭhsaṅketayati'iti|
hetumaṇṇic, curādiṇjvāḥ; bhvādau curādau cānayoḥ
pāṭhāt|
atha jugupsata ityādau kathamātmanepadaṃ sannantādvidhīyate, na ca
gupādibhya prāk sana ātmanepadaṃ paśyāmaḥ ? ityāha--
ṭhgupādiṣvanubandhakaraṇam' ityādi| ātmanepadaṃ yathā syāditi|
gupādiṣvanubandho'nudātārthaḥ kṛtaḥ tasmāt ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ'
(1.3.12) ityātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca kṛte'pyanubandhe na
bhavitavyameva tebhya ātmanepadena; sanā vyavahitatvāt ? naitadasti;
anubandhakaraṇasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati| atha vā-- ṭhavayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ
samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati' (hai.ga.pa.107) iti jugupsādaya eva
samudāyā anudātetaḥ, tenāvayavadhānenaiva tebhya ātmanepadaṃ
bhaviṣyati| evaṃ sthite yadatra dveṣyamāpadyate tat ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ'
(1.3.62) ityatropanyastamapāstañca| atha kimarthaṃ sano'kāra upadiśyate,
yāvatā tasyārdhadhātuke ṭhato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) iti lopena
bhavitavyam, sārvadhātuke'pi śapā sahaikādeśena, tatra satyasati
vā'kāropadeśe nāsti kaścidviśeṣaḥ ? naitadasti; iha pratīṣiṣatīti
prapūrvādiṇaḥ sani vihite yadyakāropadeśo na syāt
ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti dvitīyasyaikāco dvarvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ
sa ityasya na syāt, anackatvāt sanaḥ| akāropadeśe sati sa ityasya
dvitīyasyaikāco bhavati| tadartho'pakāropadeśaḥ||

6. mānbadhadānśānbhyo dīrghaścābhyāsasya| (3.1.6)
mānbandhī anudātetau, śeṣau svaritetau| iha dīrghagrahamāt ṭhacaśca'
((1.2.28) iti paribhāṣopasthānādacā'bhyāso viśiṣyata
ityajantasyābhyāsasya dīrgho vidhīyamāno niyataṃ
halādiśeṣamapekṣate; vinā tenājantatvābhāvāt| tasmiṃstu sati na
kiñcit pratīkṣaṇīyamiti tatsamanantarameva dīrgheṇa bhavitavyam,
tataścābhyāsasyāvarṇasya sthāne bhavan bdheritvasya bādhakaḥ syāt,
śeṣāṇāntu hrasvasya, tataścāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāditi yo manyeta taṃ
pratyāha-- ṭhabhyāsasya cekārasya dīrgho bhavati' iti|kathaṃ punarikārasya
dīrgho labhyate, yāvatā viśeṣavidhiḥ sāmānyavidherbādhako bhavati,
viśeṣavihitaśca dīrghaḥ, tato'yaṃ sāmānyavihitamitvaṃ
bādhitvā'kārasyaiva prāpnoti ? ata evaṃ manyate-- ṭhdīrgho'kitaḥ
(7.4.83) ityatra jñāpitametat syāt--
ṭhabhyāsavikāreṣvapavādānotsargān vidhīnbādhante' (vyā.pa.23) iti|
akidgrahaṇasyaitat prayojanam, iha mā bhūt-- yaṃyamyate, raṃramyate
iti| yadi cābhyāsavikāreṣvapavādairutsargā bādhyerannevaṃ
satyapavādatvānnuki kṛte'najantatvādeva dīrgho na bhaviṣyati,
kimakita ityanena| kṛtañca; atastato jñāpayati-- nābhyāsavikāreṣu
bādhyabādhakabhāva iti| ṭhbībhatsate' iti| ṭhekāco baśo bhaṣ' (8.2.37)
iti bakārasya bhakāraḥ, dhakārasya ṭhkhari ca' (8.4.55) iti takāraḥ|
ṭhutarasūtre' ityādi| atra hi sano vidhimātramapekṣyate vāvacanena, na
tvanantara eva vidhiḥ| tena trayāṇāmapi yogānāṃ śeṣo vijñāyate|
sarvagrahaṇaṃ gupādisūtrasyāpi (3.1.5) śeṣo vijñāyata iti
jñāpanārtham, anyathā hyanantarasyaiva sūtrasya śeṣo vijñāyeta|
ṭhmānayati' iti| hetumaṇṇic, curādiṇijvā, curādāvapyasya
pāṭhāt| ṭhpniśānayati-- kāśikā} niśānam' iti| pacādyac||

7. dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā| (3.1.7)
karttṛḥ kriyayā vyāptumiṣṭatamasya karmabhāva upapadyate|
nānyathetyavaśyaṃ yā kācit kriyā'pekṣitavyeti| iha cānyā na
śrūyate, pratyayārthatvena cecchā sannidhāpitā, ataḥ saivāpekṣituṃ
yuktā; pratyāsaternyāyāt,tasmāt, tayaiva vyāpyamānasya karmabhāvo
vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhiṣikarma' ityādi| iṣeḥ karmeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
pratiyogyapekṣatvāt samānatvasya niyogataḥ pratiyogyapekṣitavyaḥ,
na ca sūtre pratiyogī śrūyate, tatra pūrvoktanyāyeneṣereva
pratiyogitvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--- ṭhiṣiṇaiva' ityādi| samāna ekaḥ
kartāsyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, ekakartṛka ityarthaḥ| nanu caṭa dhātoḥ
karmatvaṃ nopapadyate, tasyārthadharmatvāt, dhātośca śabdātmakatvāt|
atha karoti dhātumiccchatītyādau prayoge dhātorapi karmatā dṛṣṭeti
cet ? na brūmaḥ-- sarvathā dhātoḥ karmatvaṃ na bhavatīti, kiṃ tarhi ? ya
iha sannutpatinimitabhāvanopātaḥ samānakartṛkaḥ, tasya na
sambhavatīti brūmaḥ; yasmāt samānakartṛkatvaṃ sādhyamānasyārthasya
bhavati, karmatvaṃ tu siddhasvabhāvasya| aṅgīkṛtya ca samānakartṛkatvaṃ
dhātoḥ karmatve doṣa uktaḥ idānīṃ tadapi na sambhavatyeva| tathā hi--
dhātuḥ śabdaḥ kriya#ayāśca kartā bhavati, na śabdasyetat āha--
ṭhkarmatvam' ityādi| ṭharthadvārakam' iti| artho dvāramupāyo yasya
tadarthadvārakamiti| arthasya karmatvāt samānakartṛkatvācca
tadvacano'pi dhāturarthadharmeṇopacārāt
karmasamānakartṛkaścocyate, yathā--- ṭhdvandvaśca prāṇitūrya' (2.4.2)
ityatrārthasya prāṇyaṅgatvāt tadvacano'pi prāmaayaṅgamityucyata iti
bhāvaḥ| ṭhcikīrṣati' ityatra karoterartha iccchayā vyāpyamānatvāt
samānatvāt karmasamānakartṛkaśceṣiṇā; yasmāt ya eveṣeḥ kartā
sa eva tasyāpi| atastaddvāreṇa karotirapi
karmasamānakartṛkaśceti bhāvaḥ| tataḥ san, ṭhiko jhal' (1.2.9) iti
sanaḥ kitvāt guṇabhāvaḥ, ṭhajjhanagamāṃ sani' ((6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ,
ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itītvam, raparatvam, ṭhhali ca' (8.2.77) iti
dīrghaḥ, ṭhiṇkoḥ' (8.3.57) ityanuvartamāne ṭhādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59)
iti ṣatvam, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam|
dhātugrahaṇaṃ kimiti| dhātugrahaṇaṃ hyaevamarthaṃ kriyate-- gamanamiccchatīti
subanthānmā bhūditi| nanu cāsatyapi dhātugrahaṇe tataḥ san bhavituṃ
notsahate; ṭhsupa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8) itpapavādena bādhitatvāt,
tasmāt pāriśeṣyādvināpi dhātugrahaṇena dhātoreva
bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha-- ṭhsopasargādutpatirmā bhūt' iti|
yadopasargaviśiṣṭo dhātvartha iṣiṇā vyāpyate
tadāsāvupasargaviśiṣṭa eva karmatvamanubhavatīti tadadvāreṇāsau
sopasarga eva dhātuḥ| karmeti sopasargādutpatiḥ syāt,tataśca
prācikīrṣadityatra dvirvacanaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ sannantasyaikācaḥ prathamasya
dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti ṭhsanyaṅeḥ' (6.1.9) iti samudāyādeḥ praśabdasya
syāt| laṅ ci sopasargasyāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ tataḥ prāgaḍāgamaḥ syāt|
yadi tarhi sopasargaḥ, karmadhātorutpatirna syāt, tasyākarmakatvāt
? naitadasti, samudāyasya hi karmatve'vayavā
apikmatvamanubhavanti;avayavātmakatvāt samudāyasya| abhyupāya eva
hyavayavakarmatā samudāyakarmatāyāḥ; anyathā yadi samudāye
karmaṇyavayavāḥ karmabhāvāpannā na bhaveyuḥ, tadā mahāntaṃ
putramiccchatītyatra karmalakṣaṇāvayavā dvitīyā na syāt| ṭh
gameneneccchati' iti| karaṇatvapradarśanārthaṃ lyuhantopanyāsaḥ|
dhātoreva hi sano'nutpatiḥ pratyudāharaṇam| astyatra
samānakartṛkatvam| tathā hi--- ya eveṣeḥ kartā sa eva gamanasya, sa
hyātmīyena gamanena karaṇabhāvamāpannena kimapi vastviccchati| kmatvaṃ tu
gamerarthadvārakaṃ nāstīti na bhavatyataḥ san| ṭhdevadatasya
bhojanamiccchati' iti| devadatasyeti ṭhkartakarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65)
iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī| atra hi bhojanasya devadataḥ kartā, iṣestu yajñadata
iti samānakartṛkatvaṃ nāsti| ṭhkartuṃ jānāti' iti| icchāgrahaṇādiha
jñāne'rthe sanna bhavati| nanu ceṣikarmā yo dhātu riṣiṇaiva
samānakartṛkastata icchāyā vā san bhavatītyuktam| iha ca yathecchā
pratyayārtho nāsti tathā dhātoriṣikarmatvamapi, iṣiṇā
samānakartṛkatvañca, tadayuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, aṅgatrayavaikalyāt
? naitadasti, sati hīcchāgrahaṇe tadviśeṣaṇadvayaṃ pratyāsaterlabhyate|
asati tu tasmin yāṃ kāñcit kriyāṃ prati dhātoḥ karmatvaṃ

kaiścinmanasprabhṛtayaḥ sopasargāḥ paṭhaḷnte, tebhyaḥ sopasargebhya eva

13. lohitādiḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣ| (3.1.13)

syāt| nanu ca yadā bhavatiyoge ḍājbhavati tadā tadantāt kyaṣ

14. kaṣṭāya kramaṇe| (3.1.14)
ṭhkyaṅnuvartate, na kyaṣ' iti| kyaṅ eva svaritatvāt| ṭhcaturthī
samarthāt' iti kaṣṭāyeti nirdeaśādeva caturthī
samarthavibhaktirlabhyate, atastatsamarthyāt pratyayo vijñāyate|
kramaṇaśabdo'yamasti pādaviharaṇe, asati cānārjave; tatra kramaṇa
ityaviśeṣābhidhāne pādaviharaṇe pratyayo mā vijñāyīti
viśeṣaṇamupātam| jihmam, pāpam, anārjavamityanarthāntaram|
tato'nārjava ityanena krameṇa viśeṣite satyānārjavalakṣaṇaṃ yatkramaṇaṃ
tatraiva pratyayo vijñāyate, na kramaṇamātre| etacca ṭhdhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ'
(3.1.7) ityādeḥ sūtrādvāgrahaṇasyānuvartamānasya
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāllabhyate| ṭhkaṣṭāya kramaṇe' iti tādarthye
caturthī| ṭhkaṣṭāyate' iti| kaṣṭāya kramaṇamanārjavaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| 
ṭhatyalpamidamucyate' iti| sarvalakṣyāsaṃgrahāt| kathaṃ tarhi
vaktavyamityāha- ṭhpsatrakakṣa' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} satrakaṣṭa' ityādi|
asmin nyasāntare yadyapi samarthavibhaktinirdaśo nāsti, tathāpi
subadhikārāt tatsamarthayogyā vibhaktiradhyāhartavyā| satraṃ
cikīrṣatīti satrāyate, pāpaṃ kartumicchītyarthaḥ|
ṭhajaḥ kaṣṭaṃ krāmati' iti| kramiratra pādaviharaṇe| kaṣṭamiti
karmapadametat| kaṣṭaṃ deśaṃ gahanaṃ krāmatītyarthaḥ| atha vā-- kaṣṭamiti
kriyāviśeṣaṇametat| ajaḥ kaṣṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā sañcaratītyarthaḥ|
kriyāviśeṣamapakṣe'pi kaṣṭamiti dvitīyāntametat| prasipāditaṃ hi
ṭhkaraṇe ca stokālpa' (2.3.33) ityādau sūtre-- kriyā viśeṣāṇānāṃ
karmateti| tenātra sūtre pratyudāharaṇe dvitīyāntasya kaṣṭaśabdasya
nirdeaśaḥ| mūlodāharaṇeṣvapi dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiradhyāhartavyeti
vijñāyate||

15. karmaṇo romanthatapobhyāṃ varticaroḥ| (3.1.15)
karmaṇa iti pañcamī; romanthatapobhyāṃ pañcamyantābhyāṃ
sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| satyapi tābhyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇye dvivacanaṃ na
bhavati, pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāpteḥ| ṭh varticaroḥ' iti| vartanaṃ
vartiḥ, ṇyantāt striyāṃ ktin| nanu ca ktinā na bhavitavyam,
ṭhṇyāsaśrantho yuc' (3.3.107) iti yucā bādhitatvāt| asmādeva
nipātanāt ktin bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| caraṇaṃ cariti
sampadāditvāt kvip|
ṭhhanucalane' ityādi| abhyavahṛtasya yat punarudgīrya carvaṇaṃ
hanucalanam| atrārthe romanthaśabdāt kyaṅ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ
vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu vāgrahaṇamanuvartya
tadvyavasthitarakavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| vāgrahaṇaṃ
tvavaśyamanuvartayitavyam, romanthaṃ vartayatīti vākyaṃ yathā syāt|
ṭhkīṭo romanthaṃ vartayati' iti| udgīrṇaṃ vahirnirastamavagīrṇaṃ vā
pṛṣṭhāntena nirgataṃ romanthākhyaṃ dravyaṃ vartayati, guṭikāṃ
karotītyarthaḥ| tenātra hanucalanaṃ na vidyate| mūlodāharaṇe tu
vidyata eva, tathā hi romanthāyata iti| abhyavahṛtaṃ punarākṛṣya
carvayītyarthaḥ| taccarvaṇaṃ hanucalanātmakameva|
anye tu hanucalane pratyayamanyathā pratipādayanti| asti cāyaṃ
romanthaśabdaḥ kriyāpadārthako yo romanthaśabdāt
prātipadikāddhātvartha ityādinā ṇicamutpādya ghañanto vyutpādyate, sa
hyabhyavahṛtasya dravyasya punarākṛṣya yaccarvaṇaṃ tatra vartate| asti ca
dravyavacano'yaṃ ya udgīrṇamavagīrṇaṃ vā romanthakriyāviśiṣṭaṃ
dravyamāha| tatra yaḥ kriyāvacanastasyedaṃ grahaṇam, yato dravye'pyayaṃ
vartamānaḥ kriyādvāreṇaiva vartate| ato dravye gauṇaḥ, kriyāyāṃ
mukhyaḥ; gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasampratyayaḥ (vyā.pa.4)| tena
kriyāvacanādeva bhavati, na dravyavacanāditi|
ṭhtapasaḥ parasmaipadaṃ ca' iti| vaktavyamityapekṣate| ṅtvādātminepade
prāpte parasmaipadaṃ vaktavyam u vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu
ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ' (1.3.12) iti sūtre ṭhnapuṃsakamanapuṃsakena' (1.2.69)
ityādeḥ
sūtrānmaṇḍūakaplutinyāyenānuvartamānasyānthatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| tena tapasaḥ
kyaṅntādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| tadabhāvāt ṭhśeṣāt kartari
parasmaipadam' (1.3.78) iti parasmaipadameva bhavati|

16. bāṣpoṣmabhyāmudvavane| (3.1.16)
