17. śabdavairakalahābhrakaṇvameghebhyaḥ karaṇe| 
karaṇaśabdenātra kriyocyate, na sādhakatamam| yasmāt ṭhkarmaṇaḥ'
(3.1.15) ityadhikārāccchabdādibhyaḥ karmabhya eva pratyayena bhavitavyam|
tatra yadi sādhakatame pratyayaḥ syāt prakṛtipratyayāvasambaddhau
syātām, kriyāpekṣatvācca karmatvasya kriyāyā abhāve karmatvaṃ na
syāt| tasmāt kriyāvacana eva karaṇaśabdaṃ niścityāha-- ṭhkaraṇe
karotyarthe'iti|
ṭhsudina' ityādi| sudinādibhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ karamae karotyarthe
kyaṅpratyayo bhavati#ītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu--
ihāpi tamevānuktasamuccayārtha cakāramanuvartya kartavyam| ata
evānuktasamuccayārthāccākārādaṭādīnāmapi grahaṇam| tenaṭāyata
ityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati|
ṭhaṭāṭṭa' ityādi| aṭādīnāṃ grahaṇamupādānamityarthaḥ| ayañca
ṭhtatkaroti' (vā.200) iti ṇici prāpta ārambhaḥ; so'pīṣyate--
śabdayati, vairayatīti| tasmādetadarthāpi cakārānuvṛtirveditavyā||

18. sukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedānāyām| (3.1.18)
ṭhvedanāyāmarthe'nubhave' iti| pratyakṣeṇa vastuna upalabdhiḥ u anubhavaḥ|
nanu ca vedanāśabda upalabdhimātarvacano loke dṛṣṭaḥ, tatkathameṣa
viśeṣo labhyate ? yathā labhyate tathotarasūtre pratipadāyiṣyāmaḥ|
kartā kārakam, kārakañca kriyāpekṣaṃ kriyāyā eva bhavati| vedanā
ceha kriyā śrūyate, nānyā| tasmāt tasyā eva kartā vijñāyate|
tasyāśca so vedayitā sa eva vijñāyate| tasmādaviśeṣābhidhāne'pi
vedayitari kartari vartamānaḥ kartṛśabdaḥ gṛhyata iti--
ṭhvedayituścet kartuḥ' ityādi| etena kartṛgrahaṇena sukhādayo
viśiṣyante, na tu vedaneti darśayati| yadi kartṛgrahaṇena vedanā
viśiṣyeta-- kartuḥ sambandhinī cedvedanā bhavatīti, tadehāpi
syāt--- devadatasya sukhaṃ vedayati prasādhaka iti| prasādhakasyāpi
sambandhinī vedanā bhavatyeva, tathā hi so'pi tasyāḥ kartā| yathaiva
hi prasādhyaḥ sukhaṃ vedayate tathā prasādhako'pi| etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ--
ekaḥ pratyakṣeṇa vedayate, aparaścānumānena; sarvathā hi
tadakartṛkatve vedayata ityetanna syāta, na hyakartā vedayata
ityucyate| tasmāt sukhādīnāmeva kartṛgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ
yuktimiti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca sukhādiviśeṣaṇatve'pi sa eva doṣaḥ,
yasmāt prasādhakasyāpi janyajanakabhāvalakṣaṇena sambandhena sukhādayaḥ
sambandhino bhavanti ? naitat; sarvatraiva hi kartṛsambandhinaḥ
sukhādayaḥ, kriyate cedaṃ kartṛgrahaṇam| ataḥ
kartṛgrahaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭo yaḥ kartā sukhādīnāmāśrayaḥ
samavāyikāraṇaṃ sa eva gṛhyate| tenāśrayāśrayibhāvena sambandhena
kartṛsambandhibhyaḥ sukhādibhyaḥ pratyayo vijñāyate| na ca prasādhakaḥ
sukhādīnāṃ samavāyikāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? nimitakāraṇam|
sukhādisamavāyikāraṇasya karturye sukhādaya āśrayāśrayibhāvena
sambandhinaste pratyakṣeṇopalabhyante| tena tadupalabdhiranubhavasvabhāvā
bhavatīti yuktamuktam-- vedanāyāmarthe'nubhava iti| yadi tarhi
kartṛgrahaṇena sukhādayo viśiṣyante, na vedanā, tataśca
kartṛvedanāyāmiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na prāpnoti, asāmarthyāt ?
sautratvānnirdeaśasya satyapyasāmarthye samāso bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atha
vā-- asamāsa eva, ṣaṣṭhaḷastvaśravaṇam; ṭhsupāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) iti
luptatvāt||

19. namovarivaścitraṅḥ kyac| (3.1.19)
ṭhkaraṇaviśeṣe pūjādvau' iti| ādiśabdena
paricaryāścaryayorgrahaṇam| ṭhnamasaḥ' ityādinā'nantarasyoktārthasya
viṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati| eṣa cārtho yadyapi karaṇa iti
karaṇasāmānyamanuvartate, tathāpyabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyallabhyate
vināpi vacanena, yathā--- pacādīnāṃ vikledādiṣu vṛtiḥ,
bahuvrīheśca matvarthe| ṭhnamasyati devān' iti| nanu ca namasyatiśabde
namaḥśabdo'sti, atastadyoge ṭhnamaḥ svasti' (2.3.16) ityādinā caturthyā
bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; ṭharthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya' (vyā.pa.1)
ityarthavato namaḥśabdasya kartumaśakyatvāt| atha vā-- ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ
kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' (cāṃ.pa.69) iti dvitīyaiva bhavati|
upapadasambandhanirapekṣatvāt kārakavibhakterbalīyastvam|
upapadavibhaktestu padāntarasāpekṣatvāddurbalatvam| ṭhnamasyati' iti|
namaskāraṃ karotītyarthaḥ| ṭhvarivasyati'| paricarītyarthaḥ| ṭhcitrīyate'
iti| vismāpayata ityarthaḥ||

20. puccchabhāṇḍacīvarāṇṇiṅ| (3.1.20)
ṭhpucchāt' ityādi| udasanam u ūrdhvakṣepaṇam, paryasanam u paritaḥ
kṣepaṇam| yadodasane pratyayastadā tasya dyotanārtha uccchabdaḥ
prayujyate--- ṭhutpuccchayate' iti| yadā paryasane pratyayastadā
pariśabdaḥ-- ṭhparipuccchayate' iti| ṭhṇāviṣṭhavat kāryam
prātipadikasya' (vā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvavāṭṭilopaḥ| samācayanam--
rāśīkaraṇam| arjanam u alabdhasya lābhaḥ| paridhānam u ācchādanam||

21. muṇḍamiśraślakṣṇalavaṇavratavastrahalakalakṛtatūstebhyo ṇic| (3.1.21)
ṭhprātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca' (dhā.pā.ga.sū.186) ityanena
muṇḍādibhyaḥ siddho ṇic| ayañca tasyaiva prapañcaḥ| yadyapi tasya
tatkarotītyādiḥ prapañca uktaḥ, tathāpīha mandabuddhīnāmanugrahāya
punarucyate| ṭhtannivṛtau vā' iti| bhojananivṛtau| ṭhpayo vratayati'
ita| payo bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ| ṭhvṛṣalānnaṃ vratayati' iti vṛvalānnaṃ na
bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ| ṭhhaliṃ gṛhṇāti halayati, kaliṃ gṛhṇāti kalayati'
iti| nanu ceha halakalaśabdayoḥ etenaitaddarśayati-- sūtre'pi
halikalyoreva grahaṇam, tayostvatvanipātanaṃ kṛtam,
ṭhsanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) ityādinā sanvadbhāvo mā bhūditi| ato
yuktaṃ halikalyorgrahaṇam| tathā hi-- nātra ṇij durlabhaḥ,
gaṇasutreṇaiva siddhatvāt| kevalaṃ prapañcārthamidamucyate| sa ca
prapañco halikalyorapi grahaṇa upapadyata eva| ayantu viśeṣaḥ--
akārāntayorgrahaṇe satīkārāntābhyāmapi gaṇasūtreṇaiva ṇic
prāpnoti, tatra kṛte satīṣṭhavadbhāvena ṭilopaḥ prāpnoti, ṭhaco
ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiśca,ubhayorapi tayoranityatvam| tathā
hi, ṭilopasya satyapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitve
śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityatvam| tathā hi, kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhāvaikārasya
prāpnoti, akṛtāya#antvikārasya; vṛddhestu ṭilope
satyaprāptyā'nityam| aprāptistvanajantatvāt| ubhayoranityayoḥ
paratvādÂvṛddhiḥ, tasyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ ṭilopaḥ, tatrāpyaglopyaṅgaṃ na
bhavati| tathā ca sati ṭhsanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) iti
sanvadbhāve'bhyāsasyetve ṭhdīrgho laghoḥ' (7.1.94) iti dīrghatve ca
acīkalat, ajīhaladityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta| halikaliśabdayostu
kṛtātvayorgrahaṇe sati yadyapi paratvādÂvṛddhirbhavati, tathāpi
satyāmapi tasyāmageva lupyata ityaglopyaṅgaṃ bhavati| tataśca
sanvadbhāvāt acakalat, ajahaladitīṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyati| tatra
yayorgrahaṇe satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati tayoreva grahaṇam, na tu
yayorgrahaṇe'niṣṭaṃ prāpnoti| nahyaniṣṭārthā śāstre
praklṛptiryuktā||

22. dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamābhihāre yaṅ| (3.1.22)
ṭhekāc' iti| bahuvrīhirayaṃ na tatpuruṣaḥ; ṭhhalādeḥ' iti
viśeṣaṇāt| ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre vartate' iti| etena
kriyāsamabhihārasya prakṛtiviśeṣaṇatvaṃ darśayati| ṭhtasmādyaṅpratyayo
bhavati' iti| kva ? ṭhanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe
bhavanti'(pu.pa.pā.90) iti tatraiva kriyāsamabhihāre|
viprakīrṇānāmaketra rāśīkaraṇaṃ samudāyabhāvāpatirmukhyaḥ
samabhihāraḥ| sa ca kriyāgāmutpannāpavargiṇīnāṃ sahānavasthānādekena
ca dhātunā'nakasyāḥ kriyāyā yugapadanabhidhānānna sambhavatīti gauṇaṃ
samabhihāraṃ darśayatumāha--ṭhpaunaḥ punyam' ityādi| ubhayamapi hyaetat
samabhihārasādṛśyādupacāreṇa samabhihāre vyapadeśamāsādayati| yathā
dravyāṇāṃ samāhṛtānāṃ dravyāntarairavyapetānāṃ samāhāro bhavati,
tathā kriyāṇāmapi kriyāntarairavyapetānāmetadubhayaṃ bhavatīti
sādṛśyam| kriyā ca dviprakārā--- pradhānā,apradhānā ca | tatra
pradhānakriyā vikledanādiḥ, guṇakriyā cādhiśrayaṇādiḥ| tatra yaḥ
phalāntaṃ pākamavasāyya kriyāntaramanārabhya punaḥ pākamevārabhate sa
pradhānakriyāṃ samabhiharati, tāsāṃ paunaḥpunyaṃ samabhihāraḥ|
yastvadhiśrayaṇādīreva kriyāḥ kriyāntarairavyapetāḥ sākalyena karoti
sa guṇakriyāḥ samabhiharati, tāsāṃ bhṛśārthatā samabhihāraḥ|
phalātireko vā bhṛśārthatā| tathā hi--- yo jvalanaphalamavāpya
jvalati, dīpyate vā, sa jājvalyate dedīpyate iti cocyate|
ṭhpāpacyate' iti| ṭhsanyaṅeḥ' (6.1.9) iti dvirvacanam, ṭhdīgho'kitaḥ'
(7.4.83) iti dīrghaḥ| atra ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre dve bhavataḥ' (vā.886) iti
dvitvaṃ na bhavati; kriyāsamabhihāre vidhīyamānasya yaṅḥ svayameva
tadabhivyaktau sāmarthyāt| yastu ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre loḍ loṭo
hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ' (3.4.2) iti loḍ vakṣyate sa
kriyāsamabhihāravyaktau svayamaśakta ityapekṣate dvirvacanam| na hyasau
kriyāsamabhihāre vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? karmādiṣu; ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca
bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) iti vacanāt| tena tasya prayoge
dvirvacanaṃ bhavatyeva-- ṭhlunīhi lunīhītyevāyaṃ lunāti|
ṭhdedīpyate' iti| ṭhguṇo yaṅ lukoḥ' (7.4.82) iti guṇaḥ|
ṭhbhṛśaṃ prāṭati' iti| asati dhātugrahaṇe, ekāj yaḥ śabdo halādiḥ
kriyāsamabhihāre vartate tasmādyaṅ pratyayo bhavatītye| sūtrārthaḥ
syāt| tataśca prapūrvādaṭateryaṅ prasajyeta; prapūrvasyāṭateryaḥ
samudāyastasya yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvāt| dhātugrahaṇe satyeṣa
prasaṅgo na bhavati| na hyayaṃ dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ|
ṭhjāgarti' iti| ādāditvāccchapo luk| atha kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na
samabhihāra ityevocyeta ? naivam| sādhanasamabhihāre'pi syāt|
naitadasti, prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ hyaetat| na ca prakṛteḥ sādhanasamabhihāre
vṛtiḥ sambhavati| api ca ṭhkaraṇe' (3.1.17) iti vartate, tena
samabhihāro viśeṣayiṣyate-- karaṇasambandhī cet samabhihāraḥ, tat
kutaḥ sādhanasamabhihāre prasaṅgaḥ ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---
kriyāmātrasamabhihāre yathā syāt; anyathā pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt
pradhānakriyāsamabhihāra eva syāt, na guṇakriyāsamabhihāre| 
ṭhsūci' ityādi| ṭhsūca paiśūnye' (dhā.pā.1873), ṭhsūtra pveṣṭane'
dhā.pā.} avamocane' (dhā.pā.1908), ṭhmūtra prasravaṇe' (dhā.pā.1909) ṭhaṭa
gatau' (dhā.pā.295), ṭhṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098), ṭhaśa bhojane'
(dhā.pā.1523) ṭhūrṇūñ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1039),-- āsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ
yaṅvidhau grahaṇaṃ kartavyam, tacca pūrvasyaiva
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāllabhyate, kimarthaṃ punarāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ
grahaṇamityāha--- ṭhanekājahalādyartham' iti| anekāj ahalādirarthaḥ
prayojanaṃ yasya tatathoktam| sūcyadīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ
curādiṇijantānāmanekārthaṃ grahaṇam,
ūrṇotestvanekājarthamahalādyarthañca, śeṣāṇāṃ tu ahalādyarthameva|
ṭhsosūyate' iti| ṭhṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ,
pūrvavadabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| ṭhaṭāṭayate' iti| ṭhajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2)
iti ṭaḷkārasya dvirvacanam, halādiḥ śeṣaḥ, dīrghaśca| ṭharāryate' iti|
ṭhyaṅ ci' (7.4.30) iti guṇaḥ| dvitīyasyaikāco ryaśabdasya dvarvacanam|
ṭhna ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti tu nāsti, ṭhyakāraparasya rephasya
pratiṣedhaḥ' (vā. 651) iti vacanāt| ṭhaśāśyate' iti| dvitīyasyaikācaḥ
ṭhśya' ityasya dvirvacanam| ṭhprorṇunūyate' iti| atrāpi nuśabdasya
dvirvacanam| rephastu na dvirucyate, tathaiva pratiṣedhāt| ṭhbhṛśaṃ
rocate, bhṛśaṃ śobhata ityatra neṣyate' iti| tadarthaṃ vetyanuvṛtasya
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ vyākhyeyam||

23. nityaṃ kauṭitye gatau| (3.1.23)
dhātorityeva| ṭhgatau' iti| prakṛtiviśeṣaṇametat| gatau
vartamānāddhātorityarthaḥ| amumevārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇācaṣṭe---
ṭhgativacanāddhātoḥ' iti| ṭhcaṃkrakamyate, daṃdramyate' iti| ṭhkramu
pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pa.473), drama hamma mīmṛ gatau (dhā.pā.466, 467, 468)
ṭhnugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti numāgamaḥ| yo'lpīyasyadhvani
gatāgatāni karoti sa kuṭilāṃ gatiṃ sampādayan caṃkrabhyate
dedramyata iti cocyate| atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham,
yāvatā'nabhidānādevātra vākyaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? na hi caṅkramyata iti
vṛterarthaṃ kuṭilaṃ krāmatīti vākyaṃ śaknoti gamayitum| tathā hi
kuṭilaṃ krāmatīti vākyāt saṃśayo bhavati-- kiṃ gatikauṭilyam ?
uta manaḥ-- kauṭilyamiti ? caṃkramyata iti vṛtau tvasaṃśayaṃ
gatikauṭilyameva gamyate, ityāha-- ṭhnityagrahaṇam' ityādi|
gatikauṭilyaṃ viṣayaḥ| tatra yaṅe niyamo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat
tathoktam| ṭhgativacanāt' ityādinā niyamasya prayojanaṃ darśayati|
ṭhna tu' ityādinā tadvyavacchedyam| nityam u sarvakālaṃ
gativacanāt kauṭilya eva bhavati, na tu kadācit kriyāsamabhihāre|
tena ṭhbhṛśaṃ krāmati' iti kriyāsamabhihāre pūrveṇa prāpto yaṅ na
bhavati|

25.satyāpapāśarūpavīṇātūlaślokasenālomatvacavarmavarṇacūrṇacurādibhyo ṇic| (3.1.25)
curādibhyo'nyaāṣāmiha grahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham| ṭhprātipadikāddhātvarthe
bahulamiṣṭhavacca' (vā.813) iti siddhatvāt|

ṇicsanniyogenāpugbhavatīti| satyaśabdasya tu ṭhsatyāpa' ityata eva
nipātanādāpugbhavatīti veditavyam| ṭhvipāśayati' iti| pāśaṃ
vimocayatītyarthaḥ| ṭhnirūpayati' iti| rūpaṃ paśyatītyarthaḥ|
ṭhabhiṣeṇayati' iti| ṭhupasargāt' (8.3.65) ityādinā ṣatvam|
ṭhtvacayati' iti| nanu ca tvacśabdo halantaḥ, tasmāt ṇici
ṭhṇāviṣṭhavat' (vā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvāṭṭilope prāpte tatra

(7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, tat kathaṃ tvacayatīti hi
bhavitavyamityāha-- ṭhakārānto'yaṃ tvacaśabdaḥ' iti|

26. hetumiti ca| (3.1.26)
phalasādhanayogyaḥ padārtho loke heturityucyata iti tasya yadīha
grahaṇaṃ syādihāpi ṇic syāt-- adhyayanena vasatīti| tasmāt
pāribhāṣikasya hetorgrahaṇamiti darśayitumāhau ṭhhetuḥ svatantrasya
prayojakaḥ' iti| sa punaryasya ṭhtatprayojako hetuśca' (1.4.55) iti
hetusaṃjñā vihitā| kutaḥ punaretadavagamyate ? hetumadÂgrahaṇāt,
pūrvasūtre curādigrahaṇācca| iha hi ṭhkaraṇe' (3.1.17) iti vartate,
dhātvadhikārācca dhātoḥ karaṇe kriyāyāṃ ṇicpratyayena bhavitavyam|
yadi ca laukikasya hetorgrahaṇaṃ syāt ṭhhetumati' iti
karaṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ na kuryāt; vyāvartyābhāvāt-- sarveva hi kriyā
hetumatīti| pūrvasūtre ca curādigarhamaṃ na kuryāt,
curādayo'pi dhātava eva| tadarthaśca kriyālakṣaṇa eva|
ṭhsatyāpapāśarūpavīṇātūlaślokasenālomatvacavarmavarṇacūrṇebhyaśca
ṇic' ityekayogaṃ kuryāt| evaṃ hi cakārāddhātoḥ prakṛtatvāt
karaṇe pratyayo bhaviṣyatīti vijñāsyate| so'yamekayogenaiva siddhe
yat pṛthagyogamārabhate, pūrvasūtre ca curādigrahaṇaṃ karoti,
tato'vasīyate pāribhāṣikasya hetorgrahaṇamiti| ṭhtadīyaḥ' iti|
tatsambandhī kriyātmako vyāpāraḥ| kaḥ punarasāvityata āha-- ṭhpreṣaṇa'
ityādi| bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasya kvacidarthe niyojanam u ādeśaḥ,
preṣaṇam| gurvāderārādhyasya satkārapūrvavyāpāraṇamadhyeṣaṇam|
ādiśabdena tatsamarthācaraṇasya| etat preṣaṇādikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ svabhāvo
yasya sa tathoktaḥ| nanu ca catvāro'tra hetumantaḥ sambhavanati--
prayojyaḥ, prayojyavyāpāro'dhiśrayaṇādiḥ, sarvasādhanasādhyaśca
pradhānakriyā vikledādiḥ, prayojanakavyāpāraśca preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādiḥ|
caturṇāmapi hyaeṣāṃ hetunā saha sambandho'sti| tatra prathamasya
tadadhiṣṭhitasya pravartanāt, tadabhiprāyasampādanācca| dvitīyasya
sambandhāya hetoḥ pravṛteḥ| tṛtīyasya tatpravartitena
prayojyenādhiśrayaṇādikriyāṃ kurvāṇena sādhanāt| caturthasya tu
tannirvartitatvāt tatra ca samavāyāt| tatra ṭhkaraṇe'
ityadhikārādayuktaṃ prayojyasya grahaṇam, itareṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ
kriyātmakatvāt sarveṣāṃ nyāyyam, tat kasmāt prayojanakavyāpāra
eva gṛhyate ? satyapi sarveṣāṃ kriyātmakatve tadagrahaṇasyaiva
nyāyyatvāt| tathā hi-- heturiti kārakaviśeṣasyaiṣā saṃjñā,
kārakañca kriyānimitam, tacca tasya nimitaṃ bhavati yad yasmin
satyeva bhavati, asati tu tasmin na bhavatyeva| na ca prayojyavyāpāraḥ
prayojake satyeva bhavati; va#nāipi tenārthitvādeva
prayojyasyādhiśrayaṇādivyāpārasya sambhavāt| satyapi ca tasmin
prayuktasyāpi svārthamapaśyataḥ prayojyasyāpravṛteḥ| tasmāt pyojyasya
vyāpāraṃ prati prayojakasya kārakatvābhāvāddhetutvaṃ nāstīti na sa
hetumān| etena vikledanādirapi pradhānakriyāviśeṣo hetumānna
bhavatīti veditavyam| bhavatu nāma tau prati kathañcit tasya
hetutvam, tathāpi na tayorhetumatvaṃ yuktam; yasmāt---
bhūmanindāpraśaṃsāsu nityayoge'tiśāyane|
saṃsarge'sti vivakṣāyāṃ bhavanti matubādayaḥ||
iti vacanāt bhūmādiviśiṣṭasyārthasya satāyāṃ matubādayaḥ pratyayā
vidhīyante, iha ca nityayogādanye bhūmādayo'rthā na sambhavanti;
apratīteḥ| na hi yathā gomānityatra bahutvaṃ pratīyate, yathā ca
kakudāvartītyatra ca nindā, yathā ca rūpavānityatra praśaṃsā, yathā
codariṇī kanyetyatrātiśayaḥ, tathā ṭhhetumati' ityatra| saṃsargā'pīha
na sambhāvyate--- saṃsargo hi saṃyogaḥ,sa ca dravyayoreva parasparaṃ
sambhavati, yathā-- daṇḍītyatra daṇḍapuruṣayoḥ| na ca vyāpāro dravyam,
ato nāsti kenacit saṃsargaḥ|tasmānnityayoge evāyaṃ matvarthīyaḥ,
yathā-- kṣīriṇo vṛkṣā iti| na ca
prayojyavyāpārasyādhiśrayaṇādervikledādeśca hetunā
nityayogo'sti; uparate'pi tasmin prayoktari tayoḥ sambhavāt|
satyapi tasmin virodhisannidhānāt, asambhavācca| na
cānyatarāsannidhāne sambandho yujyate; tasya dviṣṭhatvāditi| na tau
hetumantau| preṣaṇādestu prayojako bhavati nimitamca tena vinā
tadasambhavāt, sati ca tasmiṃstat sambhavāt; atastaṃ prati kārakatvaṃ
tasyopadyate| tena tasya hetusaṃjñā| nityoge'pi matupo
nimitamastyeva; utpateḥ prabhṛtyāvināśāt, preṣaṇādervyāpārasya
hetau samavāyāt| tasmāt sa eva hetumāniti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ
nyāyyam| ṭhtasminnabhidheye' iti| pratyayena vācye| etena
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ hetumadÂgrahaṇaṃ na prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti
darśayati| tena prakatyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe ye doṣāste
tatpakṣānaṅgīkāreṇaiva nirastāḥ| ye'pi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe
doṣāḥ sambhāvyante,te bhāṣye evodbhāvitāḥ, parihṛtāśca| iha
tvatigranthavistarabhayānna likhitāḥ|
atheha kathaṃ ṇijbhavati-- bhikṣā vāsayati,

prakṛte rājā kartāsīt, tatra ṭhprakṛtivacca kārakam' (2.3.65) iti

27. kaṇḍvādibhyo yak| (3.1.27)
kiṃ punarime kaṇḍvādayo dhātavaḥ ? uta prātipadikāni ? tatra yadi
dhātavaḥ, yaki kṛte kaṇḍūariti na sidhyati| kaṇḍūayeti prāpnoti|
nanu ca vetyanuvartiṣyate, tatar yadā yaṅ nāsti tadā kaṇḍūariti
bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; na hi dhātoḥ subvibhaktirutpatumutsahate;
tasyāḥ prātipadikādvidhānāt| syādetat-- yagantāt ṭhanyabhyo'pi'
(3.2.178) iti kvipi kṛte ato lope (6.4.48) vali yakāralope
(6.1.66) ca kaṇḍūariti bhaviṣyati ? asadetat; kartari kvib
vidhīyate, kaṇḍūariti ca vedanāmātramucyate, na kartā; tathāpi
sampadāderākṛtigaṇatvāt bhāve kvipaṃ vidhāya kaṇḍūariti
vyutpādyate| evamapi mantuḥ, valguriti na sidhyet| yadi
tāvadvetyanuvṛtyā manuvalguśabdābhyāṃ pakṣe yagna bhavati tadā
vibhaktistābhyāṃ nopapadyeta, tathā ca mantu, valgu ityavibhaktikaṃ rūpaṃ
syāt| athāpi tābhyāṃ yakaṃ vidhāya kvip kriyate ? evamapi
mantūrvalgurityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| avaśyaṃ yaki kṛte
ṭhakṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghatvena bhavitavyam| atha
prātipadikāni kaṇḍavādayastadā yakaḥ karāro'narthakaḥ syāt, sa hi
ṭhsārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti prāptasya guṇasya ṭhkṅiti
ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate|
prātipadikatve teṣāmetatprayojanaṃ nopapadyate, na hi
prātipadikādvihitaḥ pratyaya ardhadhātukasaṃjñāṃ labhata iti yo
deśayet, taṃ pratyāha-- ṭhdvividhāḥ' ityādi| tatreti nirdhāraṇe
saptamī| teṣu dhātuprātipadikeṣu madhye ye dhātavaḥ
kaṇḍvādayastebhyo yak| ṭhdhātvadhikārāt' ityatravopapatiḥ|
evamevārthaṃ draḍhayitumāha-- ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| yata evaṃ dhātubhyaḥ
pratyayo vidhīyate; dhātvadhikārāt , prātipadikebhyaḥ| evañca kṛtvā
yakaḥ kakāro'nubadhyate guṇapratiṣedhāt| yadi tu pratipadikebhyo
yak syāt tasyānārdhadhātukatvādÂguṇasya prāptireva nāsti,
tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ kakārānubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|
ṭhdhātuprakaraṇāddhātuḥ' iti| pratyayamutpādayatīti śeṣaḥ|
ṭhdhātorekācaḥ' (3.1.22) ityota dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate| tena
dhātureva kaṇḍvādiśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, na prātipadikam|
ṭhkasya' ityādi| yaccedaṃ kakārānubandhāsañjanamato'pi hetoreva
dhātuḥ pratyayamutpādayati| anyathā kakārānubandhakaraṇaṃ pūrvoktayā
rītyā nirarthakameva syāt| ataeva dhātubhūtebhyaḥ kaṇḍavādibhyo
yagvidhānāt kakārānubandhāsañjanācca teṣāṃ dhātutvaṃ vijñāyate| na
hyadhātubhūtebhyo yagvidhānamupapadyate, nāpi kakārānubandhakaraṇam;
prayojanābhāvāt. atha prātipadikatvaṃ kaṇḍvādīnāṃ kathamavasīyate
? ityāha-- ṭhāha cāyam' ityādi| cakāro hetau| yadyete dhātava eva
syustato yaki kṛte ṭhakṛta' (7.4.25) iti dīrghatvasya siddhatvāt
kaṇḍūañ, hṛṇīṅ, mahīṅiti dīrghaṃ noccārayet, uccārayati ca
dīrgham, ato'vasīyate-- ṭhdhāturvibhāṣitaḥ' iti| dhātutvameṣāṃ
vikalpitamityarthaḥ| nanu ca pakṣe yatra yaṅ nāsti tatrāyagantebhyaḥ
kvibādau pratyaya utpanne kaṇḍūaḥ, kaṇḍūatiḥ, kaṇḍūatavāniti dīrghasya
śravaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇaṃ syāt| tat
kutastasyānarthakyam! kathaṃ punarayagantebhyaḥ kvibādayo bhavanti,
yakaḥ pākṣikatvāt, tadapi kutaḥ ? vetyanuvṛteḥ, naitat;
nityatvādasya vidheḥ| nityatvantu vāgrahaṇasya nivartitatvāt| kutaḥ
punastannivṛtiravīsayate ? ṭhāyādayaḥ' (3.1.31) ityādeḥ
sūtrārambhāt| yadyatra vetyanuvṛtistadotaratrāpyanuvartanādāyādayo
vā bhaviṣyantītyetannārabheta| na ca tadanārambhe
sārvadhātuke'pyāyādayo vikalpena prāpnuvanti; vāgrahaṇasya
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt| tasmādāyādaya
ityāderārambhādvāgrahaṇanivṛtiravasīyata iti nityaṃ yakā
bhavitavyam| tataśca yadyeṣāṃ pakṣe prātipadikatvaṃ na
syāddīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāddīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāt
prātipadikatvameṣāmastītyekānta eṣa pakṣaḥ| tatra dhātupakṣe kaṇḍūayata
ityādayaḥ sidhyanti, prātipadikapakṣe tvasati yaki
kaṇḍūarmanturvalgurityādayaḥ| magadha ityādayo ye'kārāntāḥ
kaṇḍvādiṣu paṭhaḷnte teṣāṃ ṭhato lopaḥ' (6.4.48)
ityakāralopaḥ--- magadhyati, sukhyati, duḥkhyati| leṭÂloṭau śabdau
paṭhaḷete, tayoḥ lvarūpeṇaiva grahaṇam, na tu pratyayatvena,
kaṇḍvādibhiḥ svarūpaśabdaiḥ sāhacaryāt||

28. gupūdhūpaviccchipaṇipanibhya āyaḥ| (3.1.28)
ṭhstutyarthena' ityādi| ṭhpaṇa vyavahāre stutau ca' (dhā.pā. 439) ṭhpana
ca' (dhā.pā.440) ityanayā'nupūrvyā gaṇe pāṭhaḥ| tatra ṭhpana ca'
(dhā.pā.440) ityatra stutāvityanuvartate, na vyavahārārthaḥ tena
paṇirvyavahārārthaḥ, stutyarthaśca,paniḥ stutyartha eva| tadiha
stutyarthena paṇinā sāhacaryāt panerapi stutyartha eva gṛhyate|
tenāsau stutāveva vartamānaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, na tu vyavahāre|
ṭhśatasya' iti| ṭhvyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ' (2.3.57) iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī|
atra paṇāyatītyatrātmanepadaṃ kasmānna bhavati, yāvatā
paṇirayamanudātet paṭhaḷte ? tatra ṭhanudātaṅtiḥ' (1.3.12) iti yathā
kevalādātmanepadaṃ bhavati tathāyapatpratyayāntādapi tena
bhavitavyamityata āha-- ṭhanubandhaḥ' ityādi| yo hi tasyānubandhaḥ sa
āyapratyayarahite paṇatau caritārthaḥ u kṛtātmanepadakāryaḥ,
tenāyapratyayāntādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati; tasya dhātvantaratvāt||

29. ṛterīyaṅ| (3.1.29)
ṭhsautraḥ' iti| sūtre paripaṭhitatvāt| sūtre bhavaḥ sautraḥ| ṭhghṛṇāyāṃ
vartate' iti| ghṛṇā u jugupsā| tasyāmayaṃ svabhāvata eva vartate| atha
kasmādīyaRucyate, na ccchaṅtyevocyeti, tasyeyādeśe ṛtīyata iti
sidhyati ? na sidhyati; paratvādiḍāgame kṛte
satyapratyayāditvādīyādeśo na syāt| nanu
cāntaraṅgatvādīyādeśa eva bhaviṣyati, antaraṅgatvantu
tasyāyannādiṣu ṭhupadeśivadvacanamiṣṭasvarasiddhyartham' (7.1.2.vā.1)
iti vacanāt; evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati-- ṭhdhātupratyayānāmāyannādayo na
bhavanti' iti| tena śamerḍhapratyaye kṛte śaṇḍhaḥ ityevamādayaḥ siddhā
bhavanti| atha vā-- svaravidhāvupadeśivadbhāvaḥ svarasidhyarthamiti
vacanāt| tena nāstyantaraṅgateti paratvādiḍāgamaḥ syāt,
tasmādīyaṅ vidhīyate||

30. karmarṇiṅ| (3.1.30)
ṭhṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ' iti ṭhaca upadhāyāḥ'(7.2.116) iti vṛddhiryathā
syāt| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ ṭhna kampamicamām' (dhā.pā.817) iti

31. āyādaya ārdhadhātuke vā| (3.1.31)

syāt-- midāna iti| punaḥ śitkaraṇe tu ṭhsārvadhātukamapit'
(1.2.4) iti ṅtvimapi punaḥ pravartate| tena mideḥ prataṣedhaviṣaye'pi
guṇa ārabhyamāṇa iha na bhavati||

87. karmatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ| (3.1.87)
ṭhkarmavat' iti| ṭhtena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ' (5.1.115) iti; na tu
ṭhtatra tasyeva' (5.1.116) iti; tulyakriya iti prathamānirdeaśāt| anyathā
tulyakriye, tulyakriyasyati saptamyā ṣaṣṭhaḷa vā nirdeaśaṃ kuryāt|
tulyākriyā'syeti tulyakriyaḥ| kena tulyakriyaḥ ? karmaṇā|
sāpekṣatve'pi gamakatvāt samāsaḥ| tulyaśabdo'yaṃ sadṛśavacanaḥ| na ca
sādhanasya karmaṇaḥ kriyayā sādṛśyamupapadyate; atyantabhedāt| tathā hi--
karma dravyaṃ pariniṣpannam| tdaviparītasvabhāvā kriyā| tasmāt
karmaṇeti karmaśabdo'yaṃ gauṇastātsthyādupacāreṇa karmasthāyāṃ
kriyāyāṃ vartate, yathā-- mañcāḥ krośantīti, atra mañcaśabdaḥ
puruṣeṣu| upacārastu karmasthabāvakānāṃ karmasthakriyāñca
karmavadbhāvo yathā syāt, kartṛsthabhāvakānāṃ kartṛsthakriyāṇāṃ ca
mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| etatsarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvāha-- ṭhkarmaṇi kriyā karma'
iti| etena karmaśabdo'yaṃ karsthakriyāvācītyācaṣṭe|
karmasthakriyāvācini ca karmaśabde yaḥ sūtrārthaḥ sampadyate taṃ
darśayitumāha-- ṭhkarmasthayā' ityādi| evaṃ sthite sūtrārthe
tulyaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇavacana iti manyamāno yo deśayet-- ṭhyadi
karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakra#yiḥ sādhāraṇakriyaḥ kartā karmavadbhavati
tadā pacatyodanaṃ devadata ityatrāpi syāt; yasmādihāpi yāsau
pradhānakriyā tāmuddiśya sarvāṇi kārakadravyāṇi pravartante,
tayākarmasthayā pravartante, tayākarmasthayā sādhāraṇakriyaḥ kartā bhavati,
yathaiva hyasāvanyeṣāṃ kārakāṇāṃ sambandhinī tathā karturapi' iti, taṃ
pratyāha-- ṭhyasmin karmaṇi' ityādi| tadvadyathāśabdau sādṛśyārthau
prayuñjānaḥ ṭhsadṛśavacano'yaṃ tulyaśabda-,na sādhāraṇavacanaḥ'
ityācaṣṭe| yasmin karmaṇi kartṛbhūte'pi kartravasthāṃ pratapanne'pi
tādṛśī kriyā lakṣyate yādṛśī karmāvasthāyāṃ sa kartā karmavadbhavati|
sādṛśyañca kañcidbhedādhiṣṭānamityasādhāraṇa evādhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇaḥ
kartṛvyāpāro gṛhyate, na tu sādhāraṇo vikledādilakṣaṇaḥ| sa
cāsādhāraṇaḥ pacacyodanaṃ devadata ityatra
kārakāntaravyāpāravisadṛśo devadatasya karturvyāpāra iti na
bhavati karmavadbhāvaḥ| atha vā-- karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā
karmavadbhavatītyukte sadṛśavacanastulyaśabda iti manyamāno yo
deśayet-- ṭhyadyevam, bhidyamānaḥ kusūlaḥ pātrāṇi bhinatītyatrāpi
prāpnoti, tathā hi yādṛśī pātreṣvavayavavibhāgātmikā kriyā
tādṛśyeva kusūle kartari lakṣyate' ityasmin pūrvapakṣa idamāha--
ṭhyasmin karmaṇi' ityādi| sa ityanena yasminnityanena yo'rtho
nirdiṣṭaḥ sa eva pratyavamṛśyate| etenaikadravyādhārayaiva
karmasthayākriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavadbhavatīti darśayan
pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati| evacca pratyāsaternyāyāllabhyate|
ekadravyasamavāyino hi kriyā pratyāsannā, dravyāntarasamavetā tu
viprakṛṣṭā|
nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakamiti darśanam, na ca karmaśaktiḥ kadāpi
kartṛbhāvamāpadyate, tadayuktamuktam-- yasmin karmaṇi
kartṛbhūte'pīti ? śaktiśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣāyāṃ śaktyādhāraṃ
dravyamevaitaduktamityadoṣaḥ| idaṃ tarhyayuktamuktam-- ṭhtadvat kriyā
lakṣyate yathā karmaṇi' iti| yasmādya eva karmāvasthāyāṃ vyāpāraḥ sa eva

sarvāṇyevaitānyadāharaṇāni|

dhātoriti yeyamekā saṃkhyā sā vivakṣitā, tenaikasminneva dhātau

ṭhkarmasthabhāvakānām' ityādinā nyāyaprāptamevārthaṃ darśayati|tathā
hi-- karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyasya kartuḥ karmavadbhāvo bhavati|
na ca kartṛsthabhāvakānāṃ kartṛsthakriyāṇāṃ kartā tathāvidho'sti|
yadyapi kriyāpyupādīyate, ṭhlakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' (3.2.126) ityatra
ca bhāvo'pi parigṛhyate; tathāpīha dvayorupādānasāmarthyādarthabhedo
draṣṭavyaḥ|
sā parispandanasādhanasādhyā kriyā kriyāśabdenocyate,
aparispandanasādhyā tu bhāvaśabdena| yeṣāṃ karmasthobhāvaḥ karmasthā ca
kriyā; yeṣāṃ kartṛstho bhāvaḥ kartasthā ca kriyā, teṣāmudāharaṇaṃ
darśayitumāha-- ṭhkarmasthaḥ pacaterbhāvaḥ' iti| pacyate ghaṭaḥ
svayamevetyatra yadā taddeśasthaghaṭakarmakapāko niṣpadyate
tadā'parispandanasādhanasādhyasvabhāvaḥ pākaḥ kartastho bhavati, yadā tu
deśāntaraṃ gaccchataḥ pākadravyasya pākābhinirvṛtirbhavati tadā
karmasthaiva paceḥ kriyā, yathā -- pacyata odana ityatrodāharaṇe|
ṭhkarmasthā ṭaca bhideḥ kriyā' iti| bhidyate kusūlaḥ-- svayameveti|
avayavavibhāgalakṣaṇā hi bhideḥ kriyā,sā ca daśāntaraprāptau satyāṃ
bhavatīti bhidyate parispandaḥ,tena karmasthā kriyā bhavati|
ṭhmāsāsibhāvaḥ kartasthaḥ' iti| āserdhātorbhāva asibhāvaḥ| āsanaṃ hi
bhāvaḥ; tasyāḥ parispandanasādhanasādhyatvāt| tathā hi--
vyāpāroparatāvāsta iti prayujyate| māsasahacarita āsibhāvaḥ|
śākapārthivāditvāt samāsaḥ-- māsāsibhāvaḥ| kadā sa māsasahacarita
āsibhāvo bhavati ? yadā māsamāsta iti prayujyate| māsamiti karmaṇi
dvitīyā| karmasaṃjñā tu ṭhkālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ kramasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām'
(vā.1.4.51) iti vacanāt| māsāsibhāvaḥ kartastho bhavati, āsitari
samavāyāt| tenāsyate māsaḥ svayameveti na bhavati| ṭhkartṛsthā ca
gameḥ kriyā' #iti| gamanaṃ pāda viharaṇātmakam| tacca parispandanasā
nasādhyatvācca kriyā, sā ca gantari devadatādau samavetā, na karmaṇi
grāmādau| tena karmasthakriyābhāvādgamyate grāmaḥ svayameveti na
bhavati||

88. tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva| (3.1.88)
ṭhtapaḥ karmakasyaiva' iti| evakāro vispaṣṭārthaḥ; vyavacchedaphalatvāt,

karmasthayā kriyayā tulyatvaṃ na sambhavatīti ṭhkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ'

ṭhduḥkhayantītyarthaḥ' ityanena tāpasasya karmāvasthāyāṃ taperduḥkhanamartha
iti darśayati| ṭhsvargāya tapastapyate' iti| tapaḥśabdo'tra jñānaviṣeya

92. tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham| (3.1.ka92)

94. vā'sarūpo'striyām| (3.1.94)
apavādaviṣayamutsargo nābiniviśata ityeṣa utsargadharmaḥ, kṛtāñca

avaśyastutya iti, paratvādbādhako ṇyat syāt| punaḥ
kyabgrahaṇāt tamapi bādhitvā kyabbhavati| ṭhvṛgrahaṇena vṛño
grahaṇamiṣyate, na vṛṅḥ' iti| tatkatham ? ṭhkṛṣirajoḥ' (3.1.90)
ityādeḥ sūtrādiha parasmaipadagrahaṇamanuvartate, tena vṛśabdo
viśiṣyate-- parasamaipadaṃsya yo vṛśabda iti| kaśca parasmaipadasya
vṛśabdaḥ ? yasya parasmaipadaṃ prati nimittbhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ| vṛña
evobhayapadinaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ, na vṛṅḥ; tasya nityātmanepaditvāt| tena
vṛña eva grahaṇaṃ bhavati, na vṛṅḥ|
ṭhśaṃsiduhi' ityādi| ebhyaḥ śaṃsiprabhṛtibhyo vā
kyabbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tadeva
bahulagrahaṇamāśritya kartavyam| ṭhśasyam' iti| ṭhśansu stutau'
(dhā.pā.728), ṭhaniditām' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ| ṭhguhyama' iti| ṭhguhū
saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896)|
ṭhaḥṅpūrvādañjeḥ' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tacca
pūrvavat| ṭhañjū vyaktibhramaṇakāntigatiṣu' (dhā.pā.1458)|
pūrvavannalopaḥ| iyaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ saṃjñā|
ṭhkathamupeyam' iti| iṇa etadrūpamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| ṭhīṅ
etadrūpam' iti. ṭhīṅ gatau' (dhā.pā.1143) ityasya ṭhaco yat' (3.1.97)

111. ī ca khanaḥ| (3.1.111)
ṭhkheyam' iti| ṭhkhanu avadāraṇe' (dhā.pā.878), nakārasya īkāraḥ,
ṭhādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| atha kimarthaṃ dīrgha ādiśyate, yāvatā hrasve'pi
kṛte ādguṇena bhavitavyam| na ca hrasvasyādguṇe kṛte
kaścidviśeṣaḥ ? syādetat-- ekādeśastu tugvidhāvasiddho vaktavyaḥ,
tatra yadi hrasva ādiśyate tadā hrasvsayādguṇe kṛte
tugvidhāvasiddhatvād hrasvāśrayastuk syāt; dīrghādeśe tu na
bhavati, ato dīrghādeśo vaktavya iti ? etacca nāsti; yasmāt
padāntapadādyoyaṃ evādeśaḥ sa tugvidhāvasiddho vaktavyaḥ, na
sarvatretyāha-- ṭhdīrghanirdeaśaḥ| kimarthaṃ punardvitīya savarṇadīrghatvena
(6.1.101) dvyorivarṇayoḥ praśleṣo yathā syādityevamartho
dīrghanirdeaśaḥ| kimarthaṃ punirdvitīya ivarṇaḥ, yāvataikenaiva kheyamiti
rūpaṃ sidhyatītyata āha--ṭh tatra ' ityādi| dvayorikārayoḥ
praśleṣanirdeaśaḥ| tatra yo dvitīya ivarṇaḥ saḥ ṭhye ca' (6.4.109)
ityātvabādhā yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| ṭhye vibhāṣā' (6.4.43)
ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- khāyate, khanyate, isi, asyādeśasyāvakāśo yasmin
pakṣa ātvaṃ nāsti; ātavapakṣe tūbhayaṃ prāpnoti|
ubhayaprāptāvasatīkāre partavādantaraṅgatvāccātvaṃ syāt, asmiṃśca
satyātvaṃ bādhitvekāra eva bhavati| antaraṅgatvaṃ punarātvasya
yakārasāmānyamāśritya vidhānāt| itvasya bahiraṅgatvam;
kyabviśeṣamāśritya vidhānāt||

112. bhṛño'saṃjñāyām| (3.1.112)

śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt| tatra kyabÂvidhīyamāno bhāva eva bhavati, na

striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'sti| bhāva eva vācyatvena vyāpriyate, na
karma,tena karmaṇi bhāryāśabdaḥ prasidhyati| striyāṃ bhāvādhikāre hi

bhavataḥ| ṭhṇyadvidhiścutaḥ' iti| caturo vārān ṇyadbhavatītyarthaḥ| sa
punaḥ pariśiṣṭeṣu brahmavādyādiṣu|
atha vā-- ṭhṇyadekasmāt' ityekasmāddhātorityarthaḥ| ṭhcaturbhyaḥ kyap'

128. praṇāyyo'sammatau| (3.1.128)

1. karmaṇyaṇ| (3.2.1)

vikāryam-- yasya sata eva kaścidadvikāro vidhīyate, tadyathā-- kāṇḍaṃ
lunāti, nagaraṃ lunātīti| sata eva kāṇḍāderlavanena vikāro
vidhīyata iti vikāryaṃ karma| prāpyam-- nāsata evotpādanaṃ kriyate,
nāpi sata eva vikārādhānam, kevalaṃ kriyāsambandhamātraṃ pratīyate,
tadyathā-- vedamadhīte, carccāṃ parayatīti| atrahyavyayanādinā vedādeḥ
sambandhamātraṃ pratīyate, na tvasata evotpādanam| nāpi sata
evānyathālakṣaṇo vikāra iti prāpyametat karma| ṭhsarvatra' ityādi|

20. kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu| (3.2.20)

hetvādiṣu ṭapratiṣedhārthaṃ kṛtam| yadyeṣāmupapadatvaṃ

syāt|ato naivāmupapadatvam, nāpi pratyayārthatvam; ṭhkartari
kṛt' (3.4.67) iti kartuḥ pratyayārthatvāt| na ca tairbādhā yuktā,
virodhābhāvāt| tasmāt pratyayārthaviśeṣamatvameṣāṃ yuktam| tatra
kartari pratyayo bhavati yasminnabhidhīyamāne tadviśeṣo hetvādayo
gamyante| ata evāha-- ṭhhetau tācchīlye ānulomye ca gamyamāne'
iti| ṭhheturaikāntikaṃ kāraṇam' iti| etena laukikahetorgrahaṇam,
na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| pāribhāṣiko hetuḥ svatantrasya
kartuḥ prayojakaḥ, yadi tasyeha grahaṇaṃ syāta kṛña iti nopapadyate;
na hyaṇyantāt prayojakakartari prayojaka itpadyate, api tu
ṇyantādantarbhāvitaṇyarthāt pratyaya utpadyata iti cet ? naitadasti;
ṭapratyayāntaṇṇyarthasyāpratīteḥ| nanu ca laukikasya hetorgrahaṇe
sati nimitatayā kartā viśiṣyate, taccāyuktam; na hi
karturanimitvamasti yadviśeṣaṇena vyāvartyeta ? naiṣa doṣaḥ
siddhe karturhi nimitatve punarhetuśabda upādīyamāna aikāntikatvaṃ
bodhayatīti--yaḥ kartā yasyāḥ aikāntiko heturiti| ata evoktam--
ṭhheturaikāntikaṃ kāraṇam' iti| ānulomyam u
anukūlayāmītyārādhyacitānupravartanam| ṭhyaśaskarī'iti| ṭhataḥ
kṛkamikaṃsa' (8.3.46) ityādinā visarjanīyasya satvam||

ṭhkaraṇādhikaraṇayośca' (3.3.117) ityanena lyuḍÂvidhānāt| yadi
lyuṭā bhavitavyaṃ tataḥ kimityāha-- ṭhna ca' ityādi| ubhayatrāpi tadeva
rūpam, sa eva svaraḥ| rūpaṃ tāvadabhinnam, ubhayatrāpi samāsasya
nityārthatvāt; tathā hi khyunyupapadasamāsena bhavitavyam, lyuṭaḷpi
gatisamāsena ? ṭhanavyayasya' (6.3.66) iti ca pratiṣedhānmumā ni
bhavitavyamiti rūpabhedo nāsti| svaro'pi na bhavati bhedakaḥ; khyuni
sati yatraiva nitsvaro bhaviṣyati, lyuṭaḷpi litsvarastatraiva|
ṭhpratiṣedhasāmarthyāt' iti| āḍhÂayīkaraṇamityasya rūpasya nirāsāya
ṭhacvau' (3.2.56) iti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| evaṃ tasya nirāsaḥ kṛto
bhavati yadi khyunā mukte lyuḍapi bhavati, anyathā hi syādeva| tadeva
rūpamiti pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi vaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ| ṭharthataḥ' iti| na
śabdataḥ| arthastu pratiṣedhasāmarthyameva| ṭhutarārthaśca' iti|
utarasūtrasyopayogaṃ darśayati| tatra khiṣṇuckhukañbhyāṃ mukte
tṛjādibhirbhavitavyamityasti viśeṣaḥ|khyunaḥ khakāro mumarthaḥ,
nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ||

57. kartari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhukañau| (3.2.57)
ṭhkartari kārake' iti| kartṛgrahaṇaṃ karaṇanivṛtyartham| nanu
cāsvasitatvādevānuvṛtirna syāt ? satyametat; dveṣyamapi
kaścidavijānīyāt-- yathaivāḍhyadayo'nuvartante tathā
tatsambandhakaraṇamapīti| utarārthañca kartṛgrahaṇam|
ṭhudātatvāt' ityādi| udātāditaro'nudātaḥ, tena
bhavatervihitasyārddhadhātukasya ṭhekāca upadeśe'nudātāt' (7.2.10)
itīṭÂpratiṣedho na bhavati| balādilakṣaṇeṭā (7.2.35) bhavitavyam,
tataśca tenaivekārāditvaṃ siddham,tato na kartavyaṃ khiṣṇuca
ikārāditvamiti bhāvaḥ| ikārāditvakaraṇasya prayojanamāha-- ṭhnañastu'
ityādi| yadi| khiṣṇu ca ikārāditvaṃ na kriyate tato yadyapīṭi kṛte
satīkāraditvaṃ tasya bhavati, tathāpi tasya lākṣaṇikatvāt
ṭhkṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca' (6.2.60) ityatreṣṇujgrahaṇena na grahaṇaṃ
syāt| tataścānāḍhaḷmbhaviṣṇuriti naña
utarasyotarapadasyāntodātatvaṃ na syāt,iṣyate ca| ato naña
utarasyotarapadāntodātatvaṃm, tenekārāditvamiṣṇucaḥ kriyate|
nanu ca satyapīkārāditve alaṃkṛñādisūtre (3.2.136)
vihitasyaiveṣṇuco grahaṇena bhavitavyamÂ, netarasya ,
tasyaikānubandhakatvāt, asya dvayanubandhakatvāt ?
ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| khakāro
mumarthaḥ; cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, ñakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ||

58. spṛśo'nudake kvin| (3.2.58)
ṭhsupi sthaḥ' (3.2.4) ityatroktam-- ṭhkarmaṇi' ṭhsupi'iti
dvayamanuvartate, tatra sakarmakeṣu karmaṇītyupatiṣṭhate, anyatra
supīti| spṛśirayaṃ sakarmakaḥ, ataḥ spṛśerdhātoranudake subanta
upapada ityukte pūrvāparavyāhati manyamāna āha-- ṭhnanu ca'
ityādi|ṭhnaiṣaḥ' ityādinā parihāraḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ kartṛgrahaṇe
kartuśca pracayārthe vijñāyamāne subanta upapade pratyayo labhyata
ityāha-- ṭhsubantamātre' ityādi| subantamātra upapade satyekaḥ
pracayārthaḥ kartā karmaṇyupapade sati bhavati, aparaḥ karaṇādāvupapade;
tatra bhede sati tatsambandhabhedena bhidyamānasya kartuḥ pracayo labhyate|
ṭhghṛtaspṛk' iti| ṭhkvinpratyayasya kuḥ' ityādi| ṭhkvipratyayasya kuḥ'
ityucyamāne kvipo'pi grahaṇaṃ syāt,ato nakāro'nubadhyate|
prakṛterādyaudātārtho nakāro na bhavita;
spṛśerekāctvāt,tatsvareṇaiva siddhatvāt| kakāro
guṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ, vakāraḥ ṭhverapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ||

59. ṛtvigdadhṛksragdiguṣṇigañcuyujikruñcāṃ ca| (3.2.59)
ṭhṛtau yajati' iti| vasantādika ṛtau yajati, yasmin ṛturdeavatā sa
yāga ṛtustaṃ yajatīti| ṭhṛtuprayukto vā yajati' iti| yasmin yāga
ṛtuḥ prayojakastamṛtuprayukto yajatīti| asmin pakṣe prayuktamātrasya
lopo nipātyate| ṭhṛtvik'iti| yajāditvāt (6.1.15)
samprasāraṇam| ṭhyathākathañcidanugantavyā' iti| yena kenacit
prakāreṇa vyutpādayitavyam, na tvavayavārthastantramiti darśayati|
ṭhantodātatvaṃ nipātyate' iti| niyatasvarabādhanārtham| ṭhdadhṛk'
iti| abhyāsasya ṭhurat' (7.4.66) ityatvam, halādiḥśeṣaḥ, (7.4.60)
jaśtvam| ṭhṣatvañca nipātyate' iti| ṭhsātpadādyoḥ' (8.3.109) iti
pratiṣedhānna prāpnotīti kṛtvā| ṭhṣṇiha prītau' (dhā.pā.1200),
utsnihyatītyuṣṇik| ṭhnipātanaiḥ' saha nirdeaśāt' ityādinā
nipātanaiḥ sahaiṣāṃ yo nirdeaśaḥ sa eṣāmapi kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ
yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| tenaiṣu kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati| idaṃ
tvalākṣaṇikam-- yaḥ sakarmakasyāpi subantamātra upapade bhavati| ṭhprāṅ'
iti| ṭhugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātoḥ' (7.1.70) iti num,
halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogādi (8.2.23) lopau,nakārasya pūrvavat
kutvam| ṭhkevalāt' iti| satyapi karmaṇi supītyadhikāre
nirupapadādeva bhavati; nipātanaiḥ saheti nirdeaśāt|
kvinvidhānasāmarthyādvā| upapade hi sadādisūtreṇa (3.2.61) kvipā
bhavitavyam| ṭhsopapadāt' ityādi| na ca sopapadādyaujeḥ kvipi
kvinā vā viśeṣo'sti; ṭhcoḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvasya siddhatvāt|
anupapadatve ṭhyujerasamāse' (7.1.71) iti numi kṛte nakārasya
kutvārthaṃ kvino vidhānaṃ sārthakaṃ bhavati||

60. tyadādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañca| (3.2.60)
anālocanamiha cakṣurjñānamātramabhipretam| yadi tatra dṛśirna vartata
evaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathā| ṭhtyādṛk, tyādṛśaḥ' iti|

ityātvam| ṭhkaño ñakāraḥ ṭhṭiḍḍhāmaña' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ iti| yadi
kaño ñakāro na kartavyasatdodātārtho nakāraḥ kartavyaḥ| evañca
kañkannityevaṃ (4.1.15) kartavyam| tataścaivamucyamāne ṭhyāvādibhyaḥ
kan' (5.4.29) yādiketyatrāpi ṅīp prasajyate, atastadviśeṣaṇārtho
ñakāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti| nanu ca dṛśerdarśanakriyatvāt tādṛk tādṛśa
ityādiṣu darśanakriyā'styeva, tathā hyaeṣāṃ vyutpatau taṃ
paśyatyevaṃprakāraṃ vākyamupadiśyācāryāḥ pratyayaṃ kurvanti|
vākyasamānārthā vṛtirbhavati, sā ca darśanakriyā jñānārthikā|
tatkathamatra dṛśiranālocane vartata ityāha-- tādṛgādayo hi
rūḍhiśabdaprakārāḥ'ityādi| rūḍhiśabdeṣu nāvayavārthena bhavitavyam,kiṃ
tarhi ? samudāyārthena| ata evātrāvayavārtho nopadīyate|
vyutpatyarthastu vidyamāno'pyavayavārtha nopādate, yathā--
vyājighratīti vyāghra ityādau| tasmādiha yadyapi vyutpatyarthaṃ vākyasya
darśanakriyopādīyate, tathāpyasau vṛtau nāstyeva| tathā hi--
tādṛk tādṛśa ityādibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ sadṛśavastuviṣaye pratyaya
upajāyate, na tu darśanakriyāviṣaya iti yuktaiva dṛśeranālocane
vṛtiḥ|
ṭhsamānānyayośceti vaktavyam' iti| samānānyayośca
śabdayorupapadayordṛśeḥ kvinkañau pratyayau bhavava ityetadartharūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--- pūÂravasūtrādiha
cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuvatasamuccayārthaḥ| tena
samānānyayorupapadayordṛśeḥ pratyayau bhaviṣyataḥ| ṭhsadṛśaḥ' iti|
ṭhsamānasya' (6.3.84) ityanuvartamāne ṭh dṛgdṛśavatuṣu' (6.3.89) iti

69. kravye ca| (34.2.69)
ṭhpūrveṇaiva siddhe' iti| kravyaśabdasyānarthakatvāt|

kravyaśabda iti darśayati| yadi tarhi kṛtavikṛtaśabda upapade'ṇ, kathaṃ
kravyādaśabdaḥ sidhyati; kṛtavikṛtāda iti bhavitavyamityāha-- ṭhtasya
ca' ityādi| nanu ca kṛtavikṛtaśabde upapade'ṇi kṛte tatra
copapadasya kravyabhāva iti rūpaṃ bhavati, kravyaśabda upapade'ṇi kṛte
tadeva, kvātra viśeṣaḥ; yataḥ kravyaśabda upapade|ñaṇ pratiṣidhyate ?
ityata āha-- ṭhkṛtavikṛta' ityādi| etenārthabhedaṃ darśayati-- yo hi
kṛtavikṛtaśabdena pakvamāṃsabhakṣaḥ sa eva kravyāda

71. mantre śvetavakthaśaspuroḍāśo ṇvin| (3.2.71)

tarhi ? parābhāvam| paro yo na bhavati sa ātmeti,

85. karaṇe yajaḥ| (3.2.85)
ṭhṇiniranuvartate, na khaś'iti| ṇinereva svaritatvāt| kva
punaryāgaḥ karaṇamityāha-- ṭhagniṣṭomaḥ phalabhāvanāyām' ityādi|
phalaṃ svargaḥ, tasya yā bhāvanotpādanā u yajamānasambandhī vyāpāraḥ,
tatrāgniṣṭomayāgaḥ karaṇaṃ bhavati| nanu cāgniṣṭomavyatirekeṇa
yajamānasay vyāpāro bhāvanākhyo nāstyeva, yatra yāgaḥ
karaṇamiṣyate, tathāhyagniṣṭomākhyenaiva hyasau yāgena svargākhyaṃ
phalamutpādayati ? naitadevam; viśeṣavyāpāre hi
sāmānyavyāpāro'sti, vikṣeṣasya sāmānyavyabhicārāt|
sāmānyavyāpāra eva hyādau phalārthino buddhau sanniviśate| tathā hi--
pratipatā phalaṃ samīhamānaḥ svayameva phalakāmaḥ san ṭhsvargo manasi
kartavyaḥ'iti sāmānyavyāpāraṃ buddhāvāropayati, tataḥ ṭh
agniṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta'iti śāstrasyāgniṣṭomena karaṇena
svarga bhāvayeditīmamartha pratipādya, svargabhāvanāṃ prati
karaṇatvenāgniṣṭomamāśrayati| tasmāt sāmānyavyāpāre
svargasyotpādo viśeṣavyāpāro'gniṣṭomākhyo yāgaḥ
svargābhāvanāyāṃ karaṇaṃ bhavati| nanu cānuṣṭhīyamānaḥ
karmatvamanubhavati, tathāpi tasya śaktibhedāt karaṇatvaṃ na virudhyate,
yathā -- ṭhnipīyamānena madhunā mataḥ' ityatra karmabhāvamanubhavato'pi
madhunaḥ karaṇabhāvo bhavati| tadevamagniṣṭomayājītyasyāyamarthaḥ--
agniṣṭomena karaṇena svarga bhāvitavāniti| svargaśabdastu
vṛtādantarhitatvānna prayujyate||

87. brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip| (3.2.87)
ṭhbrahmahaḥ'iti| pūrvavaddīrghatvam|
ṭhsarvadhātubhyaḥ kvibvihita eva' iti| ṭhkvip ca' (3.2.76) ityanena|
ṭhcaturvidhaścātra niyamaḥ' iti| dhātuniyaḥ, upapadaniyamaḥ,
pratyayaniyamaḥ, kālaniyamaḥ| cakāro'vadhāraṇe -- caturvidha eva|
ṭhbrahmādiṣveva hanternānyasminnupapade'iti dhātuniyamaṃ darśayati| ata
eva yataevakārakaraṇaṃ tato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti| upapadebhyaḥ para
evakāraḥ prayujyamāno hantiṃ niyamayati| prāyikaścāyaṃ niyamaḥ,
kvacidanyasminnupapade dṛśyate-- madhuhetu| prāyikatvañca tasya
vakṣyamāṇabahulagrahaṇasya purastādapakarṣāllabhyate| ṭhbrahmādiṣu
hantereva nānyasmāt' iti upapadaniyamaḥ| atra hi hanteḥ ekāraḥ
śrūyamāṇa upapadaṃ niyamayati-- brahmādiṣu hanterbhūte kvibeva| ṭhnānyaḥ
pratyayaḥ' iti kālaniyamaḥ| brahmādyaupapade hanteḥ kvipi vihite
bhūtakālasya niyamitatvāt| yadi brahmādiṣu kvibeva nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ
iti, tadā niṣṭhāpi na prāpnoti-- brahmāṇaṃ hatavāniti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante, notarān'(vyā.pa.10)
ityaṇādaya eva bādhyante, na niṣṭhā| evamapīha vṛtrasyāhanturiti tṛj
na prāpnoti ? prāyikatvānniyamasya na doṣaḥ| ṭhtathā bhūtakāla eva
nānyasmin' iti pratyayaniyamaḥ, bhūtakāle pratyayo niyamyata iti
kṛtvā| kathaṃ punarekadā catvāro niyamā labhyanta ityāha--
ṭhtadetat'ityādi| ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' (3.2.88) iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ
bahulagrahaṇaṃ purastādapakṛvyānena yogena sambadhyate--
brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvibÂbahulamiti, tenāyaṃ caturvidho niyamo
labhyate||

89. sukarmapāpamantrapuṇyeṣu kṛñaḥ| (3.2.89)

ṭhsvādiṣu karmasu' iti| bāhulyamāśrityoktam, yathā-- ṭhbrāhmaṇagrāmaḥ,
bhaṭṭagrāmaḥ' iti| kuta etat ? suśabdaṃ
varjayitvetyanantarāṇāmevābhidhānāt| 
ṭhtrividhaścātra niyamaḥ' iti| etadapi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛterlabhyate|
ṭhkālopapadapratyayapniyamaḥ-kāśikā}viṣayaḥ' iti| kālopapadapratyayā
viṣayā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa punaḥ kālaniyamaḥ, upapadaniyamaḥ,
pratyayaniyamaśceti| tatra kālaniyamaḥ--svādiṣu kṛño bhūta eva
kvibeva bavati, nānyaḥ pratyaya iti; na bhavati-- karma kṛtavān
karmakāra iti| upapadaniyamaḥ--svādiṣu kṛña eva,
nānyasmāddhātoriti; na hi bhavati kvip-- mantramadhītavāniti, aṇeva
bhavati mantrādhyāya iti| pratyayaniyamaḥ-- svādiṣu kṛño bhūta eva
kvip, na vartamāne, bhaviṣyat vā, teni mantraṃ karoti, mantraṃ
kariṣyatīti vetyarthavivakṣāyāṃ mantrakṛditi na bhavati| ṭhśāstrakṛt'

90. some suñaḥ| (3.2.90)

kvibeva bhūte, nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ; na hi-- somaṃ sutavān somasāva
iti| dhātuniyamaḥ--soma eva sunoteḥ kvip, nānyasminnupapada
iti;iha na bhavati--surāṃ sutavān surāsuditi|

91. agnau ceḥ| (3.2.91)

92. karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām| (3.2.92)
ṭhkarmaṇi hanaḥ' (3.2.86) ityata upapadaviśeṣame karmagrahaṇe'nuvartamāne
yat punariha karmagrahaṇaṃ tasya pratyayārthatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--
ṭhkarmaṇyeva kārake' iti| ṭhdhātūpapada' ityādinā
samudāyopādhitkmetadagnyākhyāgrahaṇasya darśayati|
ṭhākhyāgrahaṇaṃ rūḍhisampratyayārtham' ityādi|
agniśabdo'yamagnisāmānyavācī, atrāsatyākhyāgrahaṇe viśeṣo na
vijñāyate-- kasyeha grahaṇamiti, rūḍhisampratyayārthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ
kriyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tadarthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityāha--
ṭhagnyartho hi' ityādi| agnyartho ya iṣṭakānāṃ racanāviśeṣaḥ sa
śyenacidityucyate, tatraivāyaṃ pratyaya iṣyate| sa kathaṃ tatraiva labhyate
? yasya grahaṇaṃ kriyate, tasmiṃśca sati prasiddho gṛhyamāṇo'gnyartho ya
iṣṭakānāṃ racanāviśeṣaḥ sa eva pratyayārtho vācyatayā vijñāyate,
nānyaḥ||

94. karmaṇīnirvikriyaḥ| (3.2.93)

iti| aparijñātatvāt; na tu lakṣaṇam| parijñātaṃ lakṣaṇamiti bhavati,
yathā-- agnerdhuma iti||

115. parokṣe liṭ| (3.2.115)
ṭhnanu ca' ityādi| dhātvartho hi pūrvāparībhūtāvayavā sādhyamānā
kriyā| yacca sādhyamānaṃ tadasat| taccāsadindriyāṇāmaviṣayaḥ, teṣāṃ
sadviṣayatvāt| yaccendriyāṇāmaviṣayaḥ tat parokṣamiti sa eva hi
dhātvarthaḥ parokṣaḥ, tataḥ parokṣagrahaṇamanarthakam, vyavacchedyābhāvāditi
bhāvaḥ|
ṭhsatyametat' iti| yadanantaramuktam| yadi satyametat tadā kasya
vyavacchedārthaṃ parokṣagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityāha-- ṭhasti tu' ityādi| yatra
sādhyāni pratyakṣāṇi tatrāniṣpanne kriyātmani dhātvarthe pratyakṣābhimāno
lokasya bhavati| nanu ca sāvadhānānyapi naiva
pratyakṣāṇi;śaktisvabhāvatvāt, śakteśca kāryānumeyatvāt, na hyaśaktau
kāryaṃ karotīti kāryakaraṇe śaktiranumīyate; tat kimucyate
sādhanāni pratyakṣāṇi ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;ṭhdravyāśritā hi śaktayaḥ'iti dravyasya
pratyakṣṭavādāśrayadhamamāśriteṣu śaktyātmakeṣūpacāryāṇyetānyapi
pratyakṣāṇītyucyante| atha vā-- tadapi sādhanāśrayaṃ
dravyaśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt sādhanaśabdenocyate; tadanena
parokṣagrahaṇena pratyakṣābhimāno'sti, sa eva parokṣa icyucyate--
tadāha-- ṭhsa yatra nāsta' iti| ātmaviṣaya utamasya ca dhātvarthasya
parokṣatvaṃ nopapadyate; tatsādhanānāṃ pratyakṣatvāt| tatra lokasya
pratyakṣatvāt, tataścotamena sidhyatīti codyamāśaṅkyāha--
ṭhutamaviṣaye' ityādi| ātmasādhyā hi kriyā, yatra
citavikṣepānnopapadyate, tadāsau parokṣā bhavati,
tenotamaviṣaye'pi parokṣabhāvaḥ| tadbhavatyeva| ṭhvilalāpa' iti|
lapervipūrvasyotame ṇali rūpam|
ṭhatyantāpahnave' iti| pratyakṣametat| apahnavaḥ u apalāpaḥ| sa
kcidatyanto bhavati yaḥ sarvāpahnavaḥ, kvacidanatyanto ya
ekadeśāpahnavaḥ| tatra yo'tyantaḥ sa sarvāpahnavaḥ, tatra liḍÂvaktavya,
vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi bahulagrahaṇamāśrit kartavyam|
kaścit kenacit pṛṣṭaḥ-- ṭhkaliṅgeṣu prasthito'si'ityādi| sa
evamāha-- ṭhnāhaṃ kaliṅgān jagām' iti| atra kevalaṃ na
kaliṅgaviṣayasyāpahnavo'pi tu gamanasyāpīti
vidyate'tyantāpahnavaḥ| yastu sthānamātrasyāpahnavo na gamanasyāpi ,
tadānatyantāpahnave laReĀva bhavati-- na hi kaliṅgeṣu pratyatiṣṭha
iti| tathā kaścit kenacit pṛṣṭaḥ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviśya tvayedaṃ
kāryaṃ kṛtamiti| sa evamāha-- ṭhnāhaṃ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviveśa' iti|
atrāpi vidyate'tyantāpahnavaḥ| tathā hi-- na kevalaṃ dakṣiṇāpathapiṣayaṃ
kāryaṃ pratiṣidhyate, api tu praveśamapi||

120. nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane| (3.2.120) 
ṭhpṛṣṭaprativacane' iti| praśnaḥ u pṛṣṭam, bhāve niṣṭhā|
pṛṣṭapūrvakaprativacanaṃ pṛṣṭaprativacanam,
śākapārthivāditvanmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ| ṭhanadyatane parokṣa iti
nivṛtam' iti| asvaritatvāt| ṭhakārṣīḥ kaṭṃa devadata' ityeṣa praśnaḥ|
ṭhnanu karomi bhoḥ'ityetat praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanam| ṭhavocastatra
kiñciddevadata'ityeṣa praśnaḥ| ṭhnanu karomi bhoḥ'ityetat
praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanam|
ṭhnanvakārṣīt' iti| praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanaṃ na bhavatīti luReĀva
bhavati| nanu ca prativacanaṃ sarvaṃ praśnapūrvakamevu, tadanarthakaṃ
pṛṣṭagrahaṇam, vyavacchedyābhāvāt ? naitadiṣṭam
;prativacanaśabdo'yamastyeva pṛṣṭānvākhyāne-- yaḥ praśnamantareṇa na
bhavati; astyavyayībhāve-- vacanaṃ vacanaṃ prativacanam, yathārthe

tadevamanekārthe prativacanaśabda-, yadi pṛṣṭagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate

124. laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe| (3.2.124)
śatṛśānacoḥ śakārau sārvadhātukārthau| ṛkāra ugitkāryārthaḥ|

yathā-- devadatayajñadatau samānadhanāvita|
adhikaraṇaśabdo'yamabhidheyavacanaḥ samānañca tadadhikaraṇañceti

126. lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ| (3.2.126)
ṭhdhātvartha viśeṣaṇañcaitat' iti| dhātvadhikārāt| athopapade kasmānna
bhavataḥ ? kriyāyā iti vacanāt| yadyaupapade syātāṃ tadā
kriyāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| upapadaṃ hi dhātorbhavati, sa ca
kriyāvacana ityentareṇāpi kriyāgrahaṇaṃ lakṣamahetū kriyāviṣayau
vijñāsyete| tat kriyāgrahaṇena dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatve hi tayoḥ
kvaciddhātvartho dravyasya heturbhavati, lakṣaṇaṃ vā ; kvacidguṇasya ,
kvacitkriyāyāḥ| ato dravyādinivṛtyarthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ yuktam; ataḥ
ṭhkriyāyāḥ' iti vacanam| ṭhkriyāviṣayau' iti| kriyāyā
ityetadvivaraṇam| kriyā viṣayo yathostau tathoktau| etena

127. tau sat|

tau vidhīyete, tato vacanasāmarthyāt tu bhaviṣyataḥ ? na brūmaḥ--
vidhānaṃ tayorna sidhyatīti, kiṃ tarhi ? vihitayorutarakālasaṃjñā na
sidhyati| tataśca brāhmaṇasya kariṣyan, brāhmaṇasya kariṣyamāṇa ityatra
ṭhpūraṇaguṇa' (2.2.11) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedho na syāt|
sadÂgrahaṇaṃ tu saccchabdenaiva vartamānaśatṛśānajante

178. anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate| (3.2.178)

179. bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ| 3.2.179)
ṭhdhanikādhamarṇayoḥ' ityādi| dhaniko yasmai ṛṇaṃ dhāryate| adhamarṇo
yo dhārayati| tadantare madhye yastiṣṭhatyātmapakṣapatitaḥ
sampratyayahetuḥ sapratibhūśabdenocyate, na sarvaḥ| tena
grāmayorantare yastiṣṭhati tatra pratyayo na vati| etacca
śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāllabhyate, ṭhdṛśyate' (3.2.178) ityasyānuvartervā| asya
hyanuvṛtau pratibhūriti saṃjñeyam, tat kimantaragrahaṇena,
saṃjñāyāmityeva vaktavyam ? naitadasti; dravyatāvighātā hi saṃjñāśabdā
bhavanti, na caivaṃ pratibhūśabdaḥ| tathāpi satyapi devadate kadācidasau
na pravartata eva||

181.dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran| (3.2.181)
ṭhdhayateḥ' iti| ṭhdheṭ pāne' (dhā.pā.902)| ṭhdadhāteḥ' iti| ṭhḍudhāñ

upapadatvaṃ syāt ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ'(3.2.1) ityasminneva prakaraṇe vidadhyāt|
evaṃ hi dviḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati| nanu ca yadyapi dviḥ
karmagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati| nanu ca yadyapi dviḥ karmaghaṇaṃ na
kartavyaṃ bhavati, tadāpyutarasūtreṇa ṣṭrangrahamaṃ kartavyaṃ jāyate ?

naitallabhyate ? naitadasti;ihāpi kriyamāṇe naiva vartamāne pratyayo

nopapadam||

tasyaivordhvamauhūrtikagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--
ṭhbhaviṣyataścaitat' ityādi| ūrdhvamauhūrtikaśabdaścāyaṃ vartamānasya
pratyāsanne vartate| ūrdhvamauhūrtike vartamānasamīpa ityarthaḥ|
ṭhāgacchet' iti| yāsuṭ, ṭhato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) itīyādeśaḥ,
ṭhādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)ṭhlopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakārasya
lopaḥ,salopo'nantyasya' (7.2.79) iti sakārasya||

10. tumunÂṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām| (3.3.10)
ṭhbhikṣiṣya ityasya jaṭāḥ' iti| lṛṭ,
anudātetvādātmanepadam,utamapuruṣaikavacanam, iṭ, ṭeretvam,
ṭhato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam| atrāsti bhikṣikriyārthamupapadaṃ
jaṭāśabdaḥ, na tu jaṭāśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ; jaṭānāṃ dravyatvāt|
ṭhdhāvataste patiṣyati daṇḍaḥ'iti| ṭhdhāv gatiśuddhayoḥ'(dhā.pā.601),
laṭ, tasya śatrādeśaḥ, ṣaṣṭhaḷekavacanam| atha vā ṭhsṛ gatau'
(dhā.pā.935)ityasya prāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) dhāvādeśaḥ| astyatra
dhāvatikriyopapadam, na tu kriyārthaḥ| arthaśabdo hyayaṃ
prayojanavacanaḥ, yacca yaduddiśya pravartate tatasya prayojanaṃ bhavati, na
cāsau daṇḍapatanamuddiśya dhāvati, kiṃ tarhi ? kāryāntarārtham|
ṭhatha' ityādi codyam| ṭhsāmānyena vihita eva'iti| bhaviṣyatyanyatra ca
kāle kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade'nyatra cāviśeṣeṇa vidhānāt|
ṭhlṛṭā' ityādi parihāraḥ| ṭhlṛṭa śeṣe ca' (3.3.13) iti lṛṭṃa vakṣyati,
tena viśeṣavihitena lṛṭā bādhyate, tanmā bhūtatasya bādheti
punariha vidhīyate| atha tumun kriyārthopapadena bādhyata ityetat
ksamānnoktam ? bhinnārthatvāt| na hi bhinnārthayorbādhyabādhakabhāvo
bhavati, bhinnārtho ca ṇvultumunau| tathā hi-- kartari ṇvul, tumun
punarbhāve| kathaṃ jñāyate ? ṭhtumarthe sesen' (3.4.9) ityatra
tumarthagrahaṇāt| yadi tumun ṭhkartari kṛt' (3.4.67) ityato
vacanāt kartari syāt,tataḥ sesenprabhṛtayo'pi tatraiva
bhaviṣyantīti tumarthagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtavāṃśca,
tatastumarthagrahaṇādavasīyate-- tumun kartari na bhavati| na
cānyārtho nirddiśyate, tatra ṭhanirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe
bhavanti' (pu.pa.90) iti bhāva eva tumun bhavatīti vijñāyate|
yaduktam-- lṛṭā kriyārthopapadena bādhyata iti,tadvighaṭayitumāha--
ṭhvāsarūpavidhinā'ityādi| ṭhevaṃ tarhi' ityādi| etena jñāpakārthatāṃ
ṇvulvidhānasyācaṣṭe| yadi hi kriyāyāmupapade kriyārthāyāṃ
vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayaḥ syurṇvulapi
tṛjarthābhidhāyitvādvāsarūpavidhinā bhaviṣyantīti punariha tanna
vidadhyāt, vihitavāṃśca;tatastena ṇvulvidhānenāsmin viṣaye
vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayo na bhavantītyeṣo'rtho vijñāpyate| ṭhtena'
ityādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| ṭhkartā' iti| tṛc|
ṭhvikṣipaḥ' iti| ṭhigupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ'(3.1.135)| tumuno nakāra
ādyaudātārthaḥ, ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| ṇvulo lakāro liti pratyayāt
pūrvasyodātārthaḥ, ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ||

11. bhāvavacanāśca| (3.3.11)
ṭhbhāvavacanāḥ' iti| bruvantīti vacanāḥ, bahulacanāt kartari lyuṭ|
bhāvasya vacanā bhāvavacanāḥ| bhāvavacanatvaṃ punasteṣāṃ bhāvādhikāre
vidhānāditi darśayitumāha--ṭhbhāve iti prakṛtya'ityādi| prakṛtya
adhikṛtyetyarthaḥ| ṭhghañādayaḥ'iti| ādiśabdenājabādīnāṃ grahaṇam|
ṭhkimartham' ityādi codyam| ṭhkriyārthopapade vihitena' ityādi
parihāraḥ| syādetat-- vāsarūpavidhinā te bhaviṣyanti| ata āha--
ṭhvāsarūpavidhiśca nāstītyuktam' iti| etacca pūrvasūtra uktam|
ṭhatha ' ityādi| bhāva ityetāvadvaktavyam; evaṃ hyucyamāne satīdameva
ghañādīnāṃ vidhāyakaṃ syāt,tataśca te dhātumātrādaviśedhema
prasajyeran; viśedhānupādānāt| vacanagrahaṇādayamartho labhyate--
bhāve ye vihitāḥ pratyayāste tathā bhavanti yathā bhāvasya vācakā
bhavantīti| yathā ca te bhāvasya vācakā bhavanti tathā praśnapūrvakaṃ
darśayitumāha--ṭhkathañca' ityādinā| ṭhnāmasāmañjasyena' iti| na
vyatirekeṇa,nāniyamenetyarthaḥ|
tatra kecidāhuḥ- vacanagrahaṇādyaireva vidhivākyairbhāva eṣāṃ vidhānaṃ
taireva kriyāyāmupapade kriyārthāyāṃ bhavanti, evañcate vācakā
bhavanti, nānyatheti| anye tvāhuḥ-- etadeva sūtraṃ vidhāyakam;
vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyāt| anenāpi tathaiṣāṃ vidhānaṃ bhavati yathā
svairvidhivākyaiḥ| yadi bhāve hi tadvidhiḥ, nānyasminnapi viṣaye
bhaviṣyati| tat tasmāt punarvidhīyata iti||

12. aṇ karmaṇi ca| (3.3.12)
ṭhkarmaṇyaṇ' ityādi| ṭhtumunṇvulau' (3.3.10) ityādisūtre
jñāpitametat-- vāsarūpavidhiriha nāstīti| tena yadyapi
viśeṣaṇeṇāṇ vihitaḥ, tathāpi vāsarūpavidherabhāvāt
kriyārthopapada na ṇvulā bādhitaḥ,tasmāt punarvidhīyate|
ṭhsopa'pavādatvāṇṇavulaṃ bādhate' iti| nāprāpte
ṇvulītarasyārabdhatvāt, viśeṣavihitatvācca| ṭhkādīn' iti| bādhata
iti sambandhaḥ| ādiśabdena ṭagādīnāṃ grahaṇam|
ṭhtenāpavādaviṣaye'pi bhavati' iti| apavādāḥ sāmānyavihitasyāṇaḥ
kādayaḥ, tadviṣaye'pi bhavati| ṭhaṇ karmaṇi ca' (3.2.12)
ityasyā'nākārāntakriyopapado'vakāśa--- kāṇṭalāvo vrajatīti,
ṭhāto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) ityasyākārāntaḥ kriyopapado'vakāśaḥ
--goda iti; iha hyubhayaṃ prāpnoti-- godāyo vrajatīti, paratvādaṇ
bhavati| tathā ṭhgapoṣṭak'(3.2.8) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--surāpaḥ,śīdhupaḥ,aṇaḥ
sa eva;ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--surāpāyo vrajati, śīdhupāyo
vrajatīti||

13. lṛṭ śeṣe ca| (3.3.13)
ṭhcakārāt' ityādi| etena kriyāyāṃ
kriyārthāyāmityasyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāra iti darśayati| ṭhkariṣyāmi'
iti| ṭhṛddhanoḥ sye' (7.2.70) itīṭ||

14. lṛṭaḥ sadvā| (3.3.14)
ṭhsatsaṃjñau' iti| ṭhtau sat' (3.2.127) itisaṃjñāvihitatvāccchatṛśānacau
satsaṃjñakau| kathaṃ punarlṛṭaḥ śatṛśānacau bhavata ityāha--
ṭhaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe' ityādi| prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe vikalpena
yathā laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau,tathā lṛṭo'pi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā
satsaṃjñakau bhavataḥ| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇādiṣu nityaṃ bhavataḥ--
kariṣyantaṃ paśya, kariṣyamāṇaṃ paśya, he kariṣyan, he kariṣyamāṇa,
arjayiṣyan vasati, kariṣyadbhaktiḥ, kariṣyamāṇabhaktiḥ,
kariṣyadrūpaḥ,kariṣyamāṇarūpa ityaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe|
prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe tu vikalpaḥ-- kariṣyati devadataḥ kariṣyan
devadataḥ; kariṣyate devadataḥ, kariṣyamāṇo devadata iti| lṛḍiti
vartamāne punarlṛḍÂgrahaṇaṃ sthāninirdeaśārtham; itarathā hi
pratyayāntaratvaṃ satsaṃjñakayorvijñāyeta| lṛṇmātrasya yathā
syādityevamarthaṃ vā| tena yo'nadyatane lṛṭ tasyāpi bhavataḥ--
śvo'gnīnādhāsyamāneneti| ṭhabhijñāvacane lṛṭ' (3.2.112) ityasya na
bhavataḥ; bhaviṣyatītyadhikārāt, asya ca bhaviṣyatkālavihitatvāt|
anadyatane punarlṛḍutarasūtre'nadyatana itiyogavibhāgādbhavatīti
veditavyam| lṛṭaṣṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ, ṛkāraḥ ṭhsyatāsī lṛluṭoḥ'
(3.1.33) ityatra viśeṣārthaḥ||

15. anadyatane luṭ| (3.3.15)
ṭhanadyatana iti bahuvrīhinirdeaśaḥ' iti| adya bhāvo
nāsyāsminnityanadyatanaḥ| ṭhtena' ityādinā bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayaṇasya
phalaṃ darśayati| etacca ṭhanadyatane laṅ'(3.2.111) ityatra
vyākhyātaprāyamiti tata evādavagantavyam| ṭhadya śvo vā gamiṣyati' iti|
adya śvaśca gamiṣyatītyarthaḥ|
ṭhparidevane' ityādi| bhaviṣyadanadyatane luḍukto bhaviṣyatsāmānye na
prāpnoti, iṣyate ca, etadarthamidamucyate| paridevanam u
anuśocanam| ṭhśvastanī' iti. luṭa iyamanyācāryasaṃjñā| ṭhvaktavyā' iti|
vyākhyeyā| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ṭhlṛṭ śeṣe ca' (3.3.13)
ityataścakāro'nuvanartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tataḥ paridevane
śvastanī bhaviṣyatyarthe bhaviṣyatīti| anyastvayaṃ nu kadā
gantetyādāvanadyatana eva kāle luḍiti darśayannāha-- padamanvākhyāne
vyākaraṇe ca, tacca padaṃ gantetyādikamanadyatana eva vartate| tasya
yadā'nadyatane bhaviṣyatsāmānye vā vṛtiḥ sārthāt prakaraṇādvā
bhavatīti vākyārmatho'vatiṣṭhate| na ca vākyārthaḥ padasaṃskārasya
nimitam, kiṃ tarhi ? padārthaḥ| tasmādanadyatane luḍityeṣa siddhamiti|
anena tu nyāyena paridevane śvastanītyādi samyagetat| luṭo'pi
ṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ; ukāraḥ ṭhluṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ' (2.4.85) iti
viśeṣaṇārthaḥ||

16. padarujaviśaspṛśo ghañ| (3.3.16)
paderṇvṛltṛcorapavādo ghañ vidhīyate,
rujiviśibhyāmigupadhalakṣaṇasya kasya, spṛśeśca pacādyacaḥ| ṭhpādaḥ' iti|
ṭhata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| yadyevam, padamiti na siddhyati
? na tu khalu na siddhyati, ṭhanudātaṃ padamekavarjam (6.1.158)iti
nipātanāt|
ṭhspṛśa upatāpe iti vaktavyam'iti| upatāpaḥ u rogaḥ, tatra
spṛśerghañbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- ṭhlṛṭaḥ sadvā' (3.3.14) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca
vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena spṛśerupāta eva kartari bhavati, nānyatreti|
ṭhsvare viśeṣaḥ' iti| aci hi satyantodātatvaṃ bhavati, ghañi tu
padasyādyaudātatvaṃ syāt| ghaño ñakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ, ādyaudātārthaśca|
ghakāraḥ ṭhcajoḥ kughiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvārthaḥ||

17. sṛ sthire| (3.3.17)
ṭhsarterdhātoḥ' iti| ṭhsṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935) ityasmāddhātoḥ| ṭhsthire
kartari' iti| etena sthiragrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya karturviśeṣaṇaṃ na
tūpapadamiti darśayati|ṭhghañpratyayo bhavati' iti| tṛjādyapavādaḥ| kaḥ
punarayaṃ sthiro nāmetyāha-- ṭhsthira iti kālāntarasthāyī' ityādi|
tatraivopapatimāha-- ṭhsa ciram' ityādi| sarterdhātorgatirarthaḥ| sa
ca kālāntarasthāyina eva kartuḥ sambhavati,
nātmalābhasamanantaranāśinaḥ| tasmāt kālāntarasthāyyeva
gaterdhātvarthasya kartā yujyata ityeveha sthiraśabdenocyate| yadi
kālāntarasthāyina eva gatiḥ sambhavati sthiragrahaṇamanarthakam, na
hyasthiraḥ sartyarthas kartopapadyate ? nānarthakam; prakarṣeṇa yaḥ sarati
tatra kartari pratyayo yathā syādityevamarthatvāt| ata eva sa ciraṃ
tiṣṭhan kālāntaraṃ saratīti vṛtau ciragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| ṭhcandasāraḥ'
iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
ṭhvyādhimatsyabaleṣviti vaktavyam' iti| asthirārtho'yamārambhaḥ| eṣu
vyādhyādiṣu triṣvipi ghañ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ|
vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi cakārānuvṛtimāśritya kartavyam| ṭhatīsāraḥ'
iti| ṭhupasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam' (6.3.122) iti dīrghatvam||

18. bhāve| (3.3.18)
ṭhrāgaḥ' iti| ṭhrañjeśca' (6.4.26) ṭhghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ'
(6.4.27)ityanunāsikalopaḥ| nanu ca ṭhbhāve' iti bhavatināyaṃ ghañantena
nirdeaśaḥ kriyata iti bhavativiṣaya eva pratyayārthanirddeśaḥ kṛto
bhavati, tataśca bhavateryo bhāvastasminneva vācye pratyayaḥ syāt, sa ca
bhavaterevotpadyamānena pratyayena śakyo'bhidhātum, atastata eva
pratyayena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ pākastyāgo rāga iti pacyādibhyo
bhavati ? ata āha-- ṭhkriyāsāmānyavācī' ityādi| kriyāsāmānyaṃ hi
sarva dhātvarthānugataṃ bhavaterarthaḥ| tena
kriyāsāmānyavācinā'rthanirdeaśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ sarvadhātuviṣayaḥ kṛto
bhavati, ataḥ pacyādibhyo'pi pratyayo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu
dhātvarthaḥ pūrvāparībhūto'pariniṣpannaḥ, tato yadi tatra vācye
pratyayo bhavati tasyāsatvabhūtatvālliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ pratyayārthasya
sambandho na siddhyati, tata āha-- ṭhdhātvarthaśca' ityādi| evakāraḥ
pratyayavyavacchedārthaḥ| dhātunaivocyate dhātvarthaḥ, na tu pratyayena|
kathaṃ tarhi ghañādayo vidhīyanta ityata āha-- ṭhyastasya' ityādi| tasya
dhātvarthasya siddhatā niṣpanntā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādayaḥ pratyayā
vidhīyante, tato yuktaḥ pratyayārthasya liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ| tasya yo
dharmastasya satvabhūtatvādityarthaḥ| bhāva iti-- ihi puṃlliṅgenāyaṃ
nirddeśa ekavacanenana ca| tena puṃlliṅga eva bāve ekavacana eva
pratyayāḥ syuḥ| na liṅgāntarayukte nāpi vacanāntare| evañca sati
ṭhstriyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) ityatra ṭhbhāve' ṭhstriyām'iti caitayoḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate, vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ hi syāt| tataḥ striyāṃ
bhāve ktinpratyayo na syāt, arthāntara eva karmādau syāt| bhāve ca
puṃlliṅge pākau pākā ityatraikavacanaṃ syāt|
yathājātīyakaṃ hyarthamupādātuṃ samartho bhāvaśabdastathājātīyake'rthe
pratyayena yuktaṃ bhavituṃ nānyatretyata āha-- ṭhpuṃlliṅgamekavacanaṃ
cātra na tantram' iti| sarvaliṅgasaṃkhyāsambandhayogyaṃ
pratātipadikārthasāmānyanimitaṃ pratyayanimitatvenopādīyate,
tadeva pradhānam, na liṅgaṃ nāpi vacanam| tatra
prātipadikārthasāmānyaṃ vinā liṅgavacanābhyāṃ na śakyaṃ
nirddeṣṭuamiti nāntarīyakatvāt tayorupādānam| pratīte tu
tasmin prātipadikārthasāmānyacaritārthatvālliṅgavacane
liṅgāntare ca pratyayā bhavantyeva| ṭhpaktiḥ' iti| bhāve ṭhstriyāṃ
ktin' (3.3.94) | ṭhpakvam' iti| ṭhnupaṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)|
ṭhpacanam' iti| ṭhlyuṭ ca' (3.3.115) iti lyuṭ| atrāpi yadi bhāve
pulliṅgastantraṃ syāt, tato bhāvanapuṃsakaśabdayoḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatervaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ syāt, tataśca bhāve
napuṃsake lyuṇna syāt, arthāntara eva tu syāt| bhāve ca
puṃlliṅge pacanamityasya tulyatvāccodyaparihārasyopanyāsaḥ,
anyathā hyanyadeva bhāvagrahaṇamadhikṛtya lyuṭo
vidhānādadamihānupanyasanīyameva syāt| ṭhpākau' ityādikaṃ
vacanāntare bhāvapratyayasyodāharaṇam||

19. akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām| (3.3.19)
ṭhprāsaḥ'iti| ṭhasu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209), ṭhprasevaḥ' iti| ṭhṣivṛ
tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1108), ubhayatrāpyatra karmaṇi ghañ| ṭhāhāraḥ' iti|
ṭhhṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899)| ṭhmadhurāhāraḥ' iti| karmadhārayaḥ,
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo vā|
ṭhmeṣaḥ' iti| ṭhmiṣa sparddhāyām' (dhā.pā.1352), pacādyac| ṭhkartavyaḥ'
iti| karmaṇi tavyaḥ|
ṭhcakāraḥ saṃjñāvyabhicārārthaḥ' iti| cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ
saṃjñāyāmityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, tadanena cārtha dyotyate|
ṭhsaṃjñāyāñca'iti cārthaṃ dyotayannasau saṃjñāvyabhicārāya bhavati,
tenāsaṃjñāyāmapi ca bhavati yadyevam, saṃjñāgrahaṇamakṛtvā
sāmānyenaiva pratyayo vidheyaḥ; tatrāpyayamarthaḥ--
saṃjñāvyabhicārārthaścakāro na kartavyo bhavati ? satyametat ;
tathāpi bāhulyena saṃjñāyāṃ bhavati; asaṃjñāyāṃ tu
kvacidevetyamumarthaṃ sūcayituṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| dīyata iti
ṭhdāyaḥ' karmaṇi ghañ, pūrvavad yuk| ṭhlābhaḥ' iti karmaṇyeva ghañ|
ṭhkārakagrahaṇam' ityādi| paryudāse hi ṭhakartari' ityukte
kārakagrahaṇamanteraṇāpi nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) karturanyatra
tādṛśe kāraka eva karmādau pratītirbhavati, yathā-- abrāhmaṇa iti
brāhmaṇasadṛśe kṣatriyādau| tasmāt paryudāse vināpi kārakagrahaṇena
kārakaeva pratyayo labhyataita kārakagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam|
prasajyapratiṣedhe tu kartavyam, tatra hi kriyāpratiṣedhamātraṃ pratīyate,
na sadṛśaṃ vastvantaram| tatra yadi ṭhakartari saṃjñāyām'
ityetāvaducyeta, kartari na bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyeta| evañca
vidhāyakasya vākyāntarasyābha#avāt karmādiṣu pratyayo na syāt| kva
tarhi syāt ? ṭhanirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti (puṃ.pa.90)
iti svārthe| nanu ca vihitaḥ svārthe pūrveṇeva ?
naitadasti;ṭhdhātvarthasya hi siddhatā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādayo
vidhīyante' ityuktam| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedhe kārakagrahaṇaṃ kriyate
? ityata āha-- paryudāse kārakagrahaṇamantareṇāpi sidhyati, sa
evāśrayiṣyate, tatkimarthamaṃ kārakagrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityata āha--
ṭhtatkriyate' ityādi| yadi tarhi paryudāsa evaiṣa nañsamāsaḥ syāt,
kārakagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, vināpi hi tena kāraka eva pratyayo
labhyate; prasajyapratiṣedhe tu sati kārakagrahaṇamarthavadbhavati, na hi
tatra vināpi tena kārake pratyayo labhyate| ivañcānantarameva
pratipādanam| tasmāt kārakagrahaṇena prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi
samāso'stīti jñāpyate| tena ṭhādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityatra
prasajyapratiṣedhe samāso labhyate, tataśca yaduktam--ṭhanaimitikamātvaṃ
śiti pratiṣedhaḥ' iti, tadupapannaṃ bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra
prasajyapratiṣedha āśrīyate ? prāgeva pratyayotpateranimitaka ātve
kṛte suglaḥ sumla iti ṭhātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti ko yathā
syāt| paryudāse tu tatrāśrīyamāṇe śito'nyatra tṛjādau pratyaye
parabhūta ātvena bhavitavyam, tataśca glāyatiprabhṛtibhya
ākārāntalakṣamaḥ pratyayo na syāt| nanu cācāryapravṛtirjñāpayati--
bhavantyejantebhya ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyaya iti, yadayaṃ kabādhanārthaṃ
ṭhhvāvāmaśca' (3.2.2) ityaṇaṃ śāsti, tasmādaśitīti
paryudāse'pyāśrīyamāṇe jñāpakādejantasyākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyayaḥ
sidhyatyeva ? naitadasti; karmopapadaviṣayamevaitajjñāpakaṃ vijñāyate|
tasmādaśitītyatra prasajyapratiṣedha evāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ| tasya
cāstitvamiha kārakagrahaṇena jñāpyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
prasajyapratiṣedho na sidhyati, yatastadastitvajñāpanaṃ pratipannaṃ kriyate
? asāmarthyaṃ kāraṇam; sāmarthye hi sati samāsena bhavitavyam,na ca
tat prasajyapratiṣedhe| tathā hi tatar nañ kriyayā sambaddhaḥ,
notarapadena||

20. parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ| (3.3.20)

prāpte dhañ| ṭhdvau śūrpaniṣpāvau' iti| atrāpi ṭhṛdorap' (3.3.57)

kriyamāṇe parimāṇākhyāyāṃ vā'nyatraiva siddham, niṣpūrvādapi

ṭhsarvagrahaṇam' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati sarvagrahaṇe'po bādhā
na sidhyatītyāha-- ṭhpurastāt' ityādi| ṭhpurastādapavādā anantarān

na ca parimāṇaśabdo'yaṃ prasthādiṣu rūḍho na saṃkhyāyām, tatkathaṃ
parimāṇākhyāyaṃ pratyayo vidhāyamāna ekastaṇḍulaniścāya ityādau
gamyamānāyāṃ bhavatītyata āha-- ṭhākhyāgrahaṇam' ityādi|
ākhyāgrahaṇamiha rūḍhearnirāsastyāgo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kṛtam|

parimāṇam, ato yuktaṃ tasyāpi grahaṇam| yadi sarvagrahaṇāt
paramapyayaṃ ghañ bādhate, sthīpratyayānapi bādhetetyata ityabhiprāyaḥ|
ata evāha--ṭhstrīpratyayāstu na bādhyante' iti| kṛtaḥ punarayamartho
labhyate ? ṭhsarvebhyaḥ'iti pañcamyantena nirddaśāt| pañcamyantanirddeśe
hi sarvaśabdo dhātusamānādhikaraṇo vijñāyate| tena
prakṛtyāśrayasyāpavādasya sarvagrahaṇādbādhā bhavati, nārthāśrayasya|
yadi tvarthāśrayo'pyapavādo bādhitumiṣṭaḥ syāt, tadā
sarvasminniti sarvaśabdaṃ saptamyantamuccārayet| ṭhekā
tilocchritiḥ'iti| śriña utpūrvāt ṭhstriyāṃ ktinÂ' (3.3.94),
ṭhstoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti cutvam, ṭhśaśchāe'ṭi' (8.4.63)
iti ccchatvam| 
ṭhdārajārau' ityādi| dārajāraśabdau nipātyete| kimatra nipātyate
? ṭhdṛ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1493) ṭhjṛṣ vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1130) ābhyāṃ
hetumaṇṇyantābhyāṃ kartari tṛjādiṣu ghañi ṇiluk| nanu ca
ṭhṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilope hi sati

30. kṛ dhānye| (3.3.30)

ṣaṣṭhī nopapadyate-- utkāro dhānyasyeti| sāmānādhikaraṇyameva
pratyayāntena syāt, evaṃ hi pratyayartho bhavati yadi pratyayāntena
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, yathā-- dṛtihariḥ paśuriti| tasmānnedaṃ

hiṃsārthasya' iti| ṭhkṛ hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1496) ityasya grahaṇaṃ na
bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha-- ṭhanabhidhānāt' iti|
śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādutkāraśabdābhyāṃ dhānyaviṣayo vikṣepa

matyā| pūrvavadanunāsikalopaḥ, hrasvasya tuk| vidanti tayā vidyā|
sunvanti tasyāṃ sutyā| śerate tasyāṃ śayyā| ṭhayaṅ yi
kṅiti'(7.4.22) ityayaṅadeśaḥ| bharaṇaṃ bhṛtyā| eti tayetyā u
ayanamiti|
ṭhbhṛño'saṃjñāyām' (3.1.112) ityatra---
ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ puṃsi dṛṣṭatvānna te bhāryā prasidhyati|"
striyāṃ bhāvādhikaro'sti tena bhāryā prasidhyati||
ityuktam, iha ṭhbhāva iti na svaryate' (kā.3.3.98) ityabhihitam, ataḥ
pūrvotataravacanaṃ vyāhatamiti manyamāna āha-- ṭhkatham' ityādi|
yadīha ṭhbhāve' (3.3.18) iti na svaryate tatkathaṃ ṭhstriyāṃ
bhāvādhikāro'sti' ityuktam, na hi ṭhbhāve' ityasvaryamāṇe
bhāvādhikārasyehāstitvamupapadyate ? ṭhbhāvādhikāro
bhāvyavyāpāraḥ'ityādi parihāraḥ| bhāvādhikāraśabdena tatra vyāpāro
vācyatvena vivakṣitaḥ| sa punarbhṛtyāśabdābhidheyabhāvopagamanalakṣamaḥ|
ata evaitaduktaṃ bhavati-- ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣada' ityādinā
vyutpāditasya bhṛtyāśabdasya bhāva evābhidheyamupayāti, na tu
kartṛvarjitaṃ kārakam| tena karmaṇi kārake bhāryeti sidhyīti| na
tu śāstrīyo'dhikāro'yaṃ svaritatvāsaṅgāt priyogamupatiṣṭhate,
sa tatra bhāvaśabdena vivakṣito mā bhūt| samajanti tasyāṃ samajyā,
niṣīdanti tasyāṃ niṣadyā, vidantyanayā vidyetyevamādīnāṃ kārake
karaṇādike karaṇādasādhutvamiti na|
kathaṃ punaḥ ṭhbhāve'kartari ca kārake' (3.3.18,19)
sarvasminnanuvartamāne kvacidbhāvaḥ kyabantasyābhidheyabhāvamupayāti
? kvacidakartṛkārakamevetyeṣa niyamo labhyate ? saṃjñāvaśāt|
yatrotpadyamānena pratyayena saṃjñā gamyate tatra bhāva evābhidheyatvaṃ
pratipadyate, itaradudāste| yatra tvakartari kārake pratyayenotpannena
saṃjñā gamyate tatra tadabhidheyatāmupayāti,
bhāvastvaudāsīnyamavalambate| ṭhakartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām'(3.3.19)
iti saṃjñāgrahaṇe'nuvartamāne punaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ bhāvārtham, pūrvakaṃ
hi saṃjñāgrahaṇamakartṛkārakeṇa sambaddhamiti| tataḥ kartṛvarjita eva
kārake saṃjñāyāṃ syāt, na bhāve| tasmādbhāve'pi saṃjñāyāmeva
yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇam| atha kathaṃ bhṛtiḥ, matiḥ,
āsutiriti ? nipātanāt| kiṃ punarnipātanam ? ṭhkarmaṇi bhṛtau'
(3.2.22), ṭhmatibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' (3.2.188) ṭhrajaḥkṛṣyāsutipariṣado
valac' (5.2.112) #iti||

110. vibhāṣākhyānaparipraśnayoriñ ca| (3.3.110)
iha sūtre pūrvamākhyānasya nirdeaśaḥ, paścāt paripraśnasya; vṛtau tu

bhavati| tamevana saṅkarābhāvaṃ darśayitumāha-- ṭhyena 'ityādi| evaṃ
hi sarvasādṛśyaṃ bhavati yadi yena viśeṣaṇena vartamāne
vihitāstenaiva vartamānasāmīpye bhavanti, nānyathā|

grahaṇam| ṭhpavamānaḥ, yajamānaḥ'iti| ṭhpūṅyajoḥ śānan' (3.2.128)
vihitaḥ,sa vartamānasāmīpye'pi tābhyāmeva bhavati, na dhātvantarāt|
ṭhalaṅgariṣṇuḥ' iti| tācchīlyādiviśiṣṭe kartaryalampūrvāt kṛña
iṣṇudvihitaḥ, vartamānasāmīpye'pi tatpūrvādeva bhavati| tasminneva
cārthe ṭhparudagaccchat' ityatra viprakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ laReĀva bhavati| ṭhvarṣeṇa
gamiṣyati' iti| atrāpi lṛḍeva bhavati|
ṭhyo manyate' ityādināpi pratipatṛviśeṣaṃ prati sūtraṃ pratyācaṣṭe|
ṭhkālāntaragatistu' ityādi| kālāntaraṃ vartamānasamīpo bhūto
bhaviṣyaṃśca kālaḥ, tasya yā gatiḥ u pratītiḥ| āgacchāmītyasya padasya
vartamānakālaviśeṣe'pyayaṃ gacchāmītyato vākyāt kadā devadata
gamiṣyasītyedvākyasamanantaraṃ prayujyamānādbhavati| vākyagamyo'pi
kālo yadi padasaṃskāravelāyāmupayujyate yujyeta sūtrārambhaḥ, na
cāsau tatropayujyate; yasmācchāstreṇa padasya saṃskāraḥ kriyate, na
vākyasya| pade saṃskriyamāṇe tadgamya eva kāla upayujyate, tena
vākyagamya ityabhiprāyaḥ| itikaraṇaḥ prakṛtapratyavamarśaka iti| evaṃ yo
manyate u avagaccchati taṃ pratīdaṃ nārabdhavyameva| yadarthamārabhyate
teṣāṃ pratyayānāṃ ṭhvartamāne laṭ' (3.2.123) ityādinaiva
śāstreṇāsiddhatvāt| prakaraṇagrahaṇena kevalamidaṃ sūtraṃ nārabdhavyam,
api tu ṭhaśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca' (3.3.132) ityevamādīnyapi
nārabdhavyanīti darśayati| ṭhtādṛśam'ityādi| evañca yastu tādṛśaḥ
pratipatā na bhavati mandabuddhistaṃ pratyārabdhavyamevetyuktaṃ bhavati| na
hyasāvevaṃ nyāyena pratipatuṃ samarthaḥ| ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| yasmāt
tatraivaṃ vākyagamyaḥ kālaḥ padasaṃskāravelāyāṃ nopayujyate, evañca
sati śvaḥ kariṣyatītyemādyaupapadyate| tatrāpi hi kariṣyatītyetat padaṃ
bhaviṣyatyeva kāle vartata iti ṭhlṛṭ śeṣe ca' (3.3.13) ityeva lṛṭ
siddhaḥ| bhaviṣyadanadyatanastu kālo'yam| yadyautarakālaḥ pratīyate
tathāpyasau vākyārtha iti padasaṃskāre nāśrīyate| yadi tu
vākyagamyo'pi kālaḥ padasaṃskāre samāśrīyeta, tadā tu
kariṣyatītyevamādi nopapadyeta-- bhaviṣyadanadyatane luṭaiva
bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā||

169. arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca| (3.3.169)
ṭhvoḍhavyaḥ'iti| ṭhho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), ṭhjhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40), ṭhṣṭuanā
ṣṭuaḥ'(8.4.41), ṭhḍho dhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13) , ṭhsahivahorodavarṇasya'
(6.3.112) ityete vidhayaḥ kartavyāḥ| ṭhatha'ityādi dveṣyam| ṭhyo'yam'
ityādi parīhāraḥ| vāsarūpavidhiḥ strdhikārāt pareṇa
nāvaśyambhavatītyuktameva||

170. āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ| (3.3.170)
ṭhāvaśyakam'iti| manojñāditvādÂvuñ| ṭhupādhirayam'iti|
pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| ṭhnopapapadam' iti| upapadatve tu
kārī, hārīti rūpaṃ nasyādityabhiprāyaḥ|ṭhorāvaśyake'(3.2.125) ityatra
pratipāditamevāvaśyamupādhiḥ, nopapadamiti;tadihāpi
tadvadevopādhikatvamāvaśyakasya vaditavyam| tena saha
nirddeśādādhamarṇyamapyupādhireva, nopapadamiti|
yadyāvaśyakamapādhirnopapadam, ṭhupapadamatiṅ'(2.2.19) iti samāso na
syāt, na cānyallakṣaṇamasti yeneha samāsaḥ syāditi yo manyet,
taṃ pratyāha-- ṭhmayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaḥ' iti ṭhsahasraṃ
dāyī'iti|ṭhakenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' (2.3.70) iti ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ
pratiṣiddhāyāṃ dvitīyaiva bhavati||

171. kṛtyāśca| (3.3.171)
ṭhkimartham'ityādi codyam| ṭhviśeṣavihitena'iti
parīhāraḥ|ṭhkartari'ityādinā parīhāravighaṭanañca|
ṭhkecit'ityādinā parakīyamatena parohārasamarthanam|
ṭhbhavyageyam'iti| ṭhsamudāyeṣu hi vṛtāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi
vartante' (śā.pa.85) iti bhavyageyādayaḥ śabdā avayavabhūteṣu
kṛtyeṣviha vartante| ṭhkartṛvācinaḥ'iti| bhavyageyādisūtreṇaiṣāṃ
pakṣe kartari nipātanāt| yogavibhāga utarārthaḥ||

172. śaki liṅ ca| (3.3.172)
ṭhprakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇañcaitat' |
pūrveṇābhiprāyeṇopapadanirāsārthamidamucyate|
ṭhjīvyāt'iti|ṭhskoḥ'(8.2.29) iti salopaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ
liṅgrahaṇam, ṭhloṭ ca'(3.3.162) ityeva siddham, cakāreṇa
hyanukṛṣyamāṇo liṅpi bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; yathaiva hi
cakāreṇa liṅnukṛyate tathā kṛtyā apyanukṛṣyeran| nanu
nivartiṣyante kṛtyāḥ, teṣu nivṛteṣu liṅ
evānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro bhaviṣyati ? satyametat; evaṃ yadi teṣāṃ
nivṛtirvijñāsyate liṅe'pi nivṛtiḥ syāt|
vyākhyānādanuvartiṣyata iti cedevamapi pratipatigauravaṃ syāt|
tasmāt pratipatigauravaparīhārārthaṃ yathānyāsameva nyāyyam| atra
vidhyādisūtre (3.3.161) evāśīrgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kṛtam, evaṃ hi
liṅloṭorgrahaṇaṃ na kṛtaṃ bhavati ? nai śakyam; vidhyādisūtre pāṭhe
sati ṭhsme loṭ' (3.3.165) ityevamādibhiḥ paratvādbādhā syāt|
ihatu kriyamāṇe paratvādeṣa yogasteṣāṃ bādhako bhaviṣyatīti na
bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅga| avaśyañcotarārthamāśīrgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam--
ṭhkticktau ca saṃjñāyām' (3.3.174) ityāśiṣi yathā syātām| ||

174. kticktau ca saṃjñāyām| (3.3.174)
ṭhsamudāyena'iti| prakṛtipratyayasamudāyena| etena
samudāyopādhitāṃ saṃjñāyā darśayati| ṭhtantiḥ'iti| ṭhtanu
vistāre'(dhā.pā.1463), atra ṭhanunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti'(6.4.15)
iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, ṭhanudātopadeśa'(6.4.37)
ityādinānusikalopaśca; tadubhayaṃ ṭhna ktici dīrghaśca' (6.4.39) iti
niṣidhyate| ṭhsātiḥ'iti| ṭhṣaṇu dāne'(dhā.pā.1464), ṭhjanasanakhanāṃ
sañjhaloḥ'(6.4.42) ityātvam| ṭhdevadataḥ'iti| ḍudāño niṣṭhāyām
ṭhdo dad ghoḥ'(7.4.46) iti dadādeśaḥ, ṭhkhari ca'(8.4.55) iti
cartvam||

175. māiṅ luṅ| (3.3.175)
ṭhmā karṣit' iti| ṭhna māṅyoge' (6.4.74) ityaḍāgamābhāvaḥ||
