atha tṛtīyādhyāyasya
caturthaḥ pādaḥ
1. dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ| (3.4.1)
ṭhdhātvarthe dhātuśabdaḥ' iti| abhidheye'bhidhānopacāraṃ kṛtvā
dhātvartho'tra dhātuśabdena nirddiṣṭa iti darśayati| bhvādiṣvevāyaṃ
dhātuśabdo vartate, svārthe guṇībhūtasya dhātuśabdasya śabdāntareṇa
sambandho na syāt; tasmāddhātvartha evāyaṃ dhātuśabdo vartate, na
bhvādiṣu| tataśca dhātusambandha ityasya dhātvarthasambandha ityeṣo'rtho
vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhdhātvarthānāṃ sambandho dhātusambandhaḥ' iti| kathaṃ
punaḥ sambandha ityāha-- ṭhviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ' iti| ṭhayathākāloktā
api' ityādi| yo yasyātmīyaḥ kālo yathākālam|
ṭhyathā'sādṛśye'(2.1.7) iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, yathākāle uktā
yathākāloktāḥ, ṭhsaptamī'(2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ,na
yathākāloktāḥ u ayathākāloktāḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- svaiḥ
svairvidhāyakairvākyairyatra yasmin yasmin kāle ye ye
vihitāstato'nyatrakāle'pi prayuktāḥ pratyayāḥ sādhavo bhavantīti|
ṭhagniṣṭomayājī' ityādīnyudāharaṇāni darśayati| sarvatra
tiṅntadācyo'rtho viśeṣyaḥ, subantavācyastu viśeṣaṇam|
ṭhagniṣṭomayājīti bhūtakālaḥ' iti| bhūtaḥ kālo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ|
bhūtakālatvaṃtu bhūtādhikāre ṭhkaraṇe yajaḥ'(3.2.85) iti
ṇinervidha#anāt| ṭhjaniteti bhaviṣyatkālaḥ' iti| bhaviṣyan
kālo'syeti bahuvrīhireva| bhaviṣyatkālatvaṃ tu bhaviṣyadanadyatane
lṛṭo vidhānāt| ṭhtatra'iti| nirdhāraṇe saptamī|
tayorbhūtakālabhaviṣyatkālayormadhye yo bhūtakālaḥ sa
bhaviṣyatkālena sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati| agniṣṭomayājīti
bhūtakālo janiteti bhaviṣyatkālenāpi sambadhyamāno bhaviṣyatkāla
eva sampadyate| dvitīye'pyudāharaṇe ṭhkṛtaḥ' iti bhūtakālaḥ; bhūte
niṣṭhāvidhānāt| ṭhbhavitā' iti bhaviṣyatkālaḥ pūrvavadeva| tatra
bhūtakāla itareṇāpi sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati| tṛtīye'pi
ṭhbhāvī'iti bhaviṣyatkālaḥ; ṭhbhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ'(3.3.3) iti vacanāt|
ṭhāsīt' iti bhūtakālaḥ; bhūtānadyatane laṅe vidhānāt| tatra
bhaviṣyatkālo bhūtakālenāpi sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati|
ihāgniṣṭomayājyasya putro janiteti bhūtakālo bhaviṣyatkālenāpi
sambadhyamāno bhaviṣyatkālaḥ sampadyate| tathā hyayamatrārthaḥ pratīyate--
so'syaputro janitā yo'gniṣṭomena yaṣṭeti| na ca bhaviṣyatkālo
bhūtakālenābhisambadhyamāno bhūtakālatāṃ pratipadyate, na hyatrāyamarthaḥ
pratīyate-- so'sya putro jāto yo'gniṣṭomeneṣṭavāniti|
itarayorapyudāharaṇayorviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyakālatāmāpadyate,
yatastatrāyamartho'vagamyate-- sa śvo bhavitā kaṭo yaḥ kariṣyate, tat
kṛtyamāsīd yadabhūtamiti| tadetatkathaṃ bhavati ? viparyayaḥ kasmānna
bhavati ? ityāha-- ṭhviśeṣaṇam'ityādi| viśeṣaṇaṃ hi
parārthatvādÂguṇo'pradhānamityarthaḥ| tena ca pradhānakālasya
viśeṣyasyopakāraḥ kartavyaḥ| na ca tat pradhānamaparityajya svakālaṃ
pradhānakālamapratipadyamānaṃ pradhānopakārakriyāṃ kartuṃ samartha
bhavatīti pradhānasya yaḥ kālastamurudhyate| viśeṣyaṃ
tūpakāryatvātpradhānam|na ca pradhānasya guṇakālāpatiryuktā, anyathā
yadiguṇakālaṃ pradhānakālaḥ pratipadyeta tadā tasya pradhānatvaṃ hīyeta|
tena na bhavati viparyayaḥ|
atha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pratyaya ityanuvartata ityata āha--
ṭhpratyayādhikāre'ityādi| pūrvakaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ dhātusambaddham,
atastadihāśrīyamāṇaṃ dhātvadhikāravihitānāṃ pratyayānāṃ sādhutve
sampadyate| atra punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe pratyayamātraṃ gṛhyate, tadarthaṃ punaḥ
pratyayagrahaṇam| ṭhkālabhede' iti| kālaviśeṣe,asmātkālādanyasmin
kāla ityarthaḥ| ṭhgomānāsīt'iti | gomāniti vartamānakālaḥ,
ṭhtadasya'(5.2.94) ityādinā vartamānakālamastītyupādāya matupo
vidhānāt| sa bhūtabhaviṣyatkālābhyāṃ sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati||

2. kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ loṭo hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ| (3.4.2)
ṭhprakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṃ caitat'iti| etenopapapadatvaṃ nirasyati|
upapadatve hi kevalāddhātorna syādityādityabhiprāyaḥ| atra
tiṅadeśau vā hisvau syātām, loḍādeśau veti dvau pakṣau|
nanu ca prathamapakṣāśaṅkāyāḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti; loṭa iti
vacanāt,tat kathamasāvāśaṅkitaḥ ? loṭsthānikatvādādeśo'pi
loḍÂvyapadeśamāsādayīti yuktamāśaṅkitum| tatra hi yadi
pūrvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tadā ṭhbhuṅkṣva bhuṅkṣvetyevāhaṃ bhuñjai'iti
ṭhāḍutamasya picca' (3.4.92) iti, pitvānṅtviṃ nāsti, tataśca
ṭhśnaṣorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityākāralopo na syāt| ubhāvapi ca
parasmaipadānāmātmanepadānāmaniyamena
syātām;niyamahetorabhāvāt| sāmānyena tiṅaṃ sthāne
vidhīyamānayoḥ kṛta etallabhyate ! yataḥ parasmaipadānāṃ hyādeśena
bhavivyam, itareṣāṃ svādeśeneti| tasmādduṣṭo'yaṃ pakṣa iti matvā
dvitīyapakṣamāśrityāha-- ṭhtasya ca loṭaḥ' ityādi| yasmin pakṣe doṣaḥ
prasajati taṃ pratividhāsyati| ṭhtadhvaṃbhāvinastu vā bhavataḥ' iti| loṭa
ityapekṣyate| taśca dhvañca tadhvamau, tau bhāvinau yasya loṭaḥ sa
taṣvambhāvī| etena tādaśārtho loḍeva sthānī; tādarthyāt, sūtre
taśabdena vyapadiṣṭo dhvamādeśārthaśca dhva#ṃśabdeneti darśayati| atha
tadhvamāvevasthāninau kasmānna vijñāyete ? aśakyaṃ hi tau sthānitvena
vijñātum| tayorapi sthānitve'loḍādeśayorapi hisvau
syātām| atha tadhvamau viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ-- loṭo yau tadhvamāviti,
tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; evamapi pratipatigauravaṃ syāt|
tadhvambhāvinau loṭa eva sthānitvaṃ yuktam, na tadhvamoḥ|
yaditarhi loṭo hisvāvādeśau, na tadādeśānāṃ tiṅameva, evañca
ṭhlaḥ parasmaipadam' (1.4.99) iti tayoḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāt, tataśca
ṭhśeṣātkartari parasmaipadam'(1.3.78) ityubhāvapi parasmaipadibhya eva
syātām; tiṅkṣvasanniveśācca tadantasya tiṅntatā na syāt, tataśca
ṭhtiṅṅtiṅḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāto na syādityata āha--
ṭhyogavibhāgaśca' ityādi| ṭhloḍityeva' iti| etena dvitīye yoge
loḍityasyānuvṛtiṃ darśayati| ṭhloḍdharmāṇau'ityādi| loṭa iva
dharmastiṅtvāditvāryayostau loḍÂdharmāṇau| nanu ca
loḍādeśānāṃ tiṅtvādi dharmaḥ, na loṭaḥ ? ādeśadvāreṇa
sthānino'pi loṭastiṅtvādidharmo bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| kathaṃ
punaryogavibhāge sati loḍÂdharmāṇau tau bhavataḥ ? yogavibhāge
sati dvitīye yoge loṭaśabdo yo'nuvartate
tenārthādvibhaktervipariṇāmo bhavatīti ṣaṣṭhaḷntatāmāpannena hisvau
viśeṣyete-- loṭo yau hisvāviti| tataśca loḍādeśayoḥ
sipthāsoḥ sthāne yau hisvau ṭhserhyapicca' (3.2.87) ityādinā
śāstreṇa vidhāsyete, tāveva yathāsvamupātaviśeṣāviha loṭaḥ
sthāne vidhīyete, nāpūrvāviti| tena loḍÂdharmāṇau tau
ityeṣo'rtho labhyata eva| ṭhtena'ityādi| ata evau yathoktena praka#areṇa,
loḍÂdharmāṇau hisvau loṭaḥ sthāne bhavataḥ| tena
parasmaipadatvanamātmanepadatvañca bhedena viṣayavibhāgena
vyavatiṣṭhate| tatra hiśabde parasmaipadatvaṃ vyatiṣṭhate;
loṭÂsambandhino heḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñakatvāt| svaśabde
cātmanepadatvaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate;svaśabdasya loṭÂsambandhina
ātmanepadasaṃjñakatvāt| ṭhtiṅtvañca dvayorapi bhavati' iti|
loṭÂsambandhinostayordvayorapi tiṅntatvāt| nanu ca
sipthāsorloḍādeśayostau sambandhinau, tadādeśatvāt, na
loṭaḥ, tatkathaṃ loṭsambandhitvena vyadiśyete ? ādeśadvāreṇa
loṭÂsambandhitvaṃ tayorapyastītyadoṣaḥ| yadi tarhi loḍdharmāṇau
bhavataḥ, evamekavacanasaṃjñā syāt, madhyamapuruṣasaṃjñā ca, tayorapi
loḍÂdharmatvāt, tataśca vacanāntarabhāvinaḥ puruṣāntarabhāvinaśca
loṭo na syātām ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;yadi hyaekavacanamadhyamapuruṣasaṃjñe
api syātāṃ vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt, vināpyanena vacanena
madhyamapuruṣaikavacanayorhisvayoḥ siddhatvāt|
ṭhlunīhi lunīhi'iti| ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre dvau bhavataḥ' (vā.886) iti
dvirvacanam|ṭhī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itītvam| ṭhlunanti'iti|
ṭhśnābhyastayorātaḥ'(6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| ṭhatha vā' ityādinā ṭhvā
ca tadhvamoḥ' iti vāgrahamasya phalaṃ darśayati| 
ṭhalāvīt' iti| ṭhsici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu'(7.2.1) iti vṛddhi,
ṭhārdhadhātukasyeḍÂvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) itīṭ,ṭhastisico'pṛkte'
(7.3.96) itīṭ, ṭhiṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| ṭhalāviṣṭām'
iti| ṭhtasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādinā tasastām| ṭhalāviṣuḥ' iti|
sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjusādeśaḥ| ṭhevaṃ
madhyamotatayopapi nāsti-kāśikā,padamañjarī ca}rapyudāhāryam'
iti| lunīhi lunīhītyeva tvamalāvīryuvāmalāviṣṭaṃ
yūyamalāviṣṭa| atha vā-- lunīta lunītetyeva yūyamalāviṣṭa|
lunīhi nīhītyevāhamalāviṣam, āvāmalāviṣvi, vayamalāviṣma|
ṭhevaṃ madhyamotamayopapi nāsti-kāśikā}rapyudāhāryam' iti|
lunīhi lunīhītyevaṃ tvaṃ laviṣyasi, yuvāṃ laviṣyathaḥ, yūyaṃ
lavipyatha| atha vā-- lunīta lunītetyeva yūyaṃ laviṣyatha| lunīhi
lunīhītyevāhaṃ laviṣyāmi, āvāṃ laviṣyāvaḥ, vayaṃ laviṣyāmaḥ|
ṭhadhīyāt' iti| iyaṅ| ṭhadhīyate' iti| ṭhātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5)
ityadādeśaḥ| ṭhevaṃ psarveṣu lakāreṣūdāhāryam-kāśikā, padamañjarī
ca}sarvalakāreṣūdāhāryam' iti| laṅ-lunīhi
lunīhītyevāyamalunāt, imāvalunītām, ime'lunan| lunīhi
lunīhītyeva tvamalunaḥ, yuvāmalunītamÂ, yūyamalunīta| atha vā--
lulīta lunītetyeva yūyamalunīta| lunīhi
lanīhītyevāhamalunām, āvāmalunīva, vamamalunīma|
adhīṣvādhīṣvetyevāyamadhyaita, imāvadhyaiyātām,ime'dhyaiyata|

yūyamadhyaidhvam| atha vā-- adhīdhvamadhīdhvamityeva yūyamadhyaidhvam|

lakāreṣvatigranthavistarabhayānnodāhriyate|anayā diśā
svayamevābhyupagamyodāhāryam|
atha lunīhi lunohīti kathamatra dvirvacanam, yāvatā dhātunaiva
kriyāsamabhihāro'vagamitaḥ;
tadviśiṣṭakriyāvacanāddhātorloḍvidhānāt ? atha vā-- avagamite
sati tasmin dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti cedevaṃ yaṅntasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ
syāt ? ityata āha-- ṭhkriyāsamabhihārābhivyaktau' ityādi| yadyapi
kriyāsamabhihāraviśiṣṭakriyābhidhāyino dhātorloḍ bhavati, tathāpi
yā tasya kriyāsamabhihārabhivyaktiḥ sā dhātunā na kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ?
loḍṬava| sa catāṃ kartuṃ dvirvacanasahita eva samartho bhavati, na
kevalaḥ; tatra tasyāvidhānāt| sa hi loṭa ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve
cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) iti karmādiṣu vidhīyate, na
kriyāsamabhihāre| tasmāt tadabhivyaktau kartavyāyāṃ loṭ
svayamasamartha iti dvirvacanamapekṣate, tena tadantasya dvirvacanaṃ
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kena punarvidhīyamānaṃ dvirvacanamapekṣata ityāha--
ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre' ityādi| ṭhyaṅpratyayaḥ punaḥ' ityādi| yaṅpratyayo
hi kriyāsamabhihāra eva vidhīyate| tenāsau tatra
vidhīyamānastadabhivyaktau svayameva samartha iti nāpekṣate dvirvacanam|
tena tadantasya dvirvacanaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||

3.samuccaye'nyatarasyām| (3.4.3)
ṭhanekakriyādhyāhāraḥ' iti| anekāsāṃ kriyāṇāṃ cīyamānatetyarthaḥ|
etena samabhihārāt samuccayasya bhedaṃ darśayati| samabhihāro'pi
paunaḥpunyam, bhṛśārtho vā, sa caikasyā eva kriyāyāḥ sambhavaḥ|
samuccayaḥ punaranekāsāṃ kriyāṇām|
ṭhbhāṣṭramaṭa'iti| ṭhato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti luk| atra
sādhanabhedādbhedamupāgatānāmanakāsāmaṭanakriyāṇāṃ samuccayaḥ|
ṭhatha vā' ityādi| prathamenātha vetigrahaṇena ṭhvā ca tadhvamoḥ' (3.4.2)
iti vāgrahaṇapratipāditaṃ vikalpaṃ darśayati, dvitīyenānyatarasyāṃ
(3.4.3) grahaṇapratipāditam||

4. yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ pūrvasmin| (3.4.4)
ṭhpūrvasmina loḍÂvidhāne' ityādervākyasya
yasmāddhātorityādinārthaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| ṭhdhātusambandhe' ityādi|
dhātusambandha (3.4.1) ityanuvṛterdhātusambandha eva loḍÂvidhānam,
ato'nu prayogaḥ siddhaḥ eva, na hi tena vinā dhātusambandho bhavati;
tasya dviṣṭhatvāt| yadyevam, kimarthamidaṃ vacanam ? ityāha--
ṭhyathāvidhyarthaṃ tu' iti| atha vyavahitaprayogasya vā pūrvasya prayogasya
vā nivṛtyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati, yathā-- ṭhkṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi'
(3.1.40) iti ? na; tayorapīṣṭatvāt| iṣyate hi vyavahitaprogaḥ-
lunīhi lunīhītyavāyaṃ devadato lunāti|
pūrvaprayogo'pīṣyate-- lunāti devadato lunīhi lunīhīti|
tasmādyathā vidhyarthamevedaṃ yuktam| nanu caṭhsamuccaye
sāmānyavacanasya' (3.4.5) iti dhātvantarasya samānārthasya
prayogābhyanujñānāt kriyāsamabhihāre yathāvidhyanuprayogo
bhaviṣyatīti, tatkimanena vacanena ? naitadasti, samuccaya eva hi
niyamaḥ syāt, kriyāsamabhihāre tu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ syāt,
dhātvantarasya ca samānārthasya| tasmādārabdhavyamidam||

5. samuccaye sāmānyavacanasya| (3.4.5)
ṭhsarvaviśeṣānuprayogānivṛtyartham' iti| yadīdaṃ nārabhyate tadā
yāvadbhyo dhātubhyo loḍvihitastāvatāmevānuprayogaḥ
prasajyeta; tatastannivṛtyarthametat| nanu cāntareṇāpīdaṃ vacanaṃ
lāghavāt sāmānyavacanasyaivānuprayogo bhaviṣyati|
sarvaviśeṣānuprayoge hyaedanaṃ bhuṅkṣva saktūn piba dhānāḥ khāda
ityevāyaṃ bhuṅkte pibati khādatīti sarveṣu tadā taruśabdasyaiva
prayogaḥ syāt, vanaspatiśabdaprabhṛtayastūccchidyeran, na caivam,
tasmānnāsti laukikaśabdaprayoge gurulāghavaṃ pratyādaraḥ| nanu ca
bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādāvudāharaṇe kārakasyaiva samuccayo bhrāṣṭrādeḥ, na
kriyāyāḥ, tasyā ekatvāt; anekādhāratvañca sāmānyam, ekatve
kriyāyāstanna sambhavati, tatkathaṃ sāmānyavacanasyānuprayoga upapadyate ?
ityāha-- ṭhbhrāṣṭamaṭa'ityādi| gatārtham||

6. cchandasi luṅlaṅliṭaḥ| (3.4.6)

8.upasaṃvādaśaṅkayośca| (3.4.8)

upasaṃvādaśabdasyemau paryāyau| ṭhyadi me bhavān'
ityādinosavādasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| kāraṇata
ityādināpyāśaṅkāyāḥ| ṭhanusaraṇam' iti| anugamanam,
anumānamityarthaḥ| ṭhtarka utprekṣā' iti| āśaṅkāyā imau rpyāyau|
ṭhahameva' ityādi| devaiḥ paśupatiruktastripuraṃ jahīti, tenoktam--
ṭhahameva paśūnāmīśai' iti. brahmahatyābhāgaṃ gṛhāṇetyukte āditya
idamuktavān ṭhmadagrā eva vo grahā gṛhyāntai| maddevatānyeva vaḥ
pātrāṇyucyāntai| ṭhīśai'iti-- ṭhīśa aiśvarye' (dhā.pā.1020),
utamapuruṣaikavacanam, iṭ, ṭeretvam, ṭheta ai' (3.4.93)| ṭhgṛhyāntai'
iti--graha upādāne' (dhā.pā.1533), ṭhjho'ntaḥ' (7.1.3), karmaṇi
ṭhsārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67), grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam|
śeṣaṃ pūrvavat sādhanam| ṭhucyāntai' iti-- ṭhvaca paribhāṣaṇe'
(dhā.pā.1063), vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
ṭhpatāma' iti-- ṭhpatlṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.845), mas, ṭhleṭo'ḍāṭau'
(3.4.94) ityāṭ| ṭhjihmācaraṇena' ityādinā
pūrvoktamāśaṅkālakṣaṇamudāharaṇe darśayati| ṭhlirṅtha evāyam' iti|
hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ| katham ? upasaṃvāde tāvat-- yadi me
bhavānidaṃ kuryādahamapi ta idaṃ dāsyāmītyevaṃvidhaṃ
paribhāṣaṇalakṣaṇam| tatra ca karaṇaṃ hetuḥ, dānaṃ hetumaditi yukta
upasaṃvādo lirṅthaḥ| āśaṅkāpi kāraṇataḥ kāryānusaraṇam| tatrāpi
kāraṇaṃ hetuḥ, kāryānusaraṇaṃ hetumadityāśaṅkāpi lirṅtha eva|
yadyevamma, pūrveṇaiva siddham, tatkimarthamidamucyate ? ityāha--
ṭhnityārtha vacanam' iti| syādetat pūrveṇaiva nityaṃ
bhaviṣyatītyāha-- ṭhpūrvasūtre' ityādi||

kṛt' (3.4.67) iti vacanātumun kartaryeva syāt| tumarthagrahaṇe hi

19. udīcāṃ māṅe vyatīhāre| (3.4.19)

pūrvakāle' (3.4.21) ityanenaivātra ktvāpratyayo bhavati, asti hyatrāpi
samānakartṛkatvam| tathā hi-- ya evāpamayateḥ kartā sa eva

samānakartṛkayorityasmādvacanādyācaterapi syāt ? naiṣa doṣa-;

yācateḥ ktavā na bhaviṣyati| ṭhudīcāṃgrahaṇāt' ityādi|
udīcāṃgrahaṇamiha vikalpārtham| tena yathāprāptamapi pakṣe bhavati|
yācateḥ ktvā| mayaterlaḍādiḥ|

kṛtātvasyāyaṃ nirdaśaḥ' iti| kutaḥ punaretadavagatam ?
vyatīhāragrahaṇāt| meReĀva vyatīhāre vartate, na māṅ, tasmānmeṅ
evāyaṃ nirdeaśa iti vijñāyate| kimarthaṃ punarevaṃ nirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ,kṛte
yatra sati sandehaḥ syāt, na meṅ ityevāsandigdhaḥ kartavya syādityata
āha-- ṭhjñāpanārthaḥ'iti| meṅ ityevaṃ nirdeaśe kartavye yaḥ
sānubandhakasya kṛtātvasya nirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ sa jñāpanārthaḥ|
tenaitajjñāpayate-- ṭhnānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam' iti| ṭhtena'

20. parāvarayoge ca| (3.4.20)
ihemau parāvaraśabdau sambandhiśabdau| pūrvañcāpekṣya paro bhavati,

ityāha-- ṭhpareṇa pūrvasya' ityādi| ṭhparanadīyogena parvato
viśiṣyate' iti| tathā hyaprāpya nadaĀ parvata ityukte parayā nadyā

parvatena nadyā ca yo yogastadviśiṣṭa nadī vijñāyate||

21. samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāleḥ| (3.4.21)
dhātvadhikārāddhātvarthasyaiva samānakartṛkatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--
ṭhsamānaḥ kartā yayordhātvarthayoḥṭa ityādi| nirdhāraṇe ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī|
samānaśabdaścāyamekavācī| nanu śakti kārakam, anyā ca
pūrvakālakriyāyāḥ, tatkutaḥ samānakartṛkatvaṃ vijñāyate ? ityāha--
ṭhśaktiśaktimatoḥ' ityādi| śaktiḥ śaktimāÄśca śaktiśaktimantau| yaśca
śaktyādhāro yā ca śaktistayoriha bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ| tena
śaktyādhāra eka eva devadataḥ kartā, sa cobhayorapi kriyayoreka
eveti yuktaṃ samānakartṛkatvam| ṭhpītvā' iti| pūrvavadītvam | iha
ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ' iti dvirvacanena nirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ tena dve eva
kriye pratyupasthāsyete, na bahvyaḥ, tataśca dvayoreva kriyayoḥ
pratyupasthāpitayoḥ syāt, na bahvīṣu ? ityāha-- ṭhdvivacanam'
ityādi| kriyāpradhānatvādasya nirdeaśasya| nātra dvivacanaṃ pradhānam;
nāntarīyakatvāt| tena dvivacanena nirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ| avaśyaṃ yena
kenacidvacanena nirdeaśaḥ kartavyaḥ, tasmādatantratvādÂdvivacanasya,
bahvīṣvapi kriyāsu bhavatyeva|
ṭhbhuktavati brāhmaṇe vrajati' siti| atra bhujikriyāyā brāhmaṇaḥ kartā,
vrajatikriyāyāstu devadata iti samānakartṛkatvābhāvaḥ| ṭhvrajati
jalpati ca' iti| yaugapadyādiha kriyāyāḥ pūrvakālatā nāsti|
ṭhvyādāya' iti| dadātervyāṅpūrvasya rūpam| ṭhsammīlya' iti| ṭhmīla
smīla kṣmīla nimeṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.517,519,520) ityasya sampūrvasya
hetumaṇṇyantasya| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na sidhyītyāha--
ṭhapūrvakālatvāt'upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
pratipādanam-- pūrvayogāccakāyo'nuvartate, sa
cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena mukhaṃ vyādāya svapitītyādau
pūrvakālatvābhāve'pi bhaviṣyatīti||

22. abhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca| (3.4.22)

dvirvacanasahitayoreva ktvāṇamuloḥ sāmarthyam, na kevalayoḥ;

23. na yadyanākāṅkṣe| (3.4.23)
ṭhanākāṅkṣe' iti| na vidyata ākāṅkṣā u apekṣā yasya sa tathoktaḥ|
ṭhktvā tu pūrvasūtravihito'pi' iti| apiśabdādanantaravihito'pi
yuktaṃ yadanantarasūtravihitaḥ pratiṣidhyate-- ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā
bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.99) iti kṛtvā| pūrvasūtreṇa vihitasya
tu kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ? prakaraṇāpekṣayā pratiṣedhavidhānāt|
pūrvakālaprakaraṇe yat prāpnoti tanna bhavatītyevamayaṃ
pūrvakālaprakaraṇāpekṣayā pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| tasmādyauktaḥ

24. vibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu| (3.4.24)
ṭhābhīkṣaṇye' iti nānuvartate' iti| ṭhaprāptavibhāṣeyam' ityatreyaṃ
yuktiḥ| nanu ca pratāptavibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā,ṇamulyaprāpte ktvāpratyaye
ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) ityādinā prāpte satyārambhāt ?
naitadasti; anantarasūtravihitau hi
ktvāṇmulāvityadhikṛtyāprāptavibhāṣeyamityucyate| yastu
ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) ityādinā kevalaḥ ktvā vihitastaṃ prati
vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyameva; vāsarūpavidhinā
tatpratipāditasyārthasya siddhatvāt| ṭhnanu ca'
ityādinā'nantaroktavibhāṣāgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ vighaṭayati |
ṭhktvāṇamulī yatra' ityādi| vāsarūpavidhinaiva pakṣe laḍādiṣu|
siddheṣu yat tadarthaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate tena yatra ktvāṇamulau
yugapadvidhīyete tatra vāsarūpavidhirnāstītyeṣo'rtho jñāpyate|
kimetasya prayojanaṃ jñāpanasya ? ityāha-- ṭhtena' ityādi|
ṭhupapadasamāsaḥ' ityādi| ṭhamaivāvyayena' (2.2.20) ityupapadasamāsaḥ
prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- ṭhuktam' ityādi| ṭhamaiva yat
tulyavidhānamupapadaṃ tat samasyate' (kā.va.2.2.20) ityuktaṃ prāk|
agne bhṛtīnyupapadānyamā cānyena ktvāpratyayena tulyavidhānam,
ato na samasyante||

25. karmaṇyākrośe kṛñaḥ khamuñ| (3.4.25)

26. svādumi ṇamul| (3.4.26)
ṭhsvādumītyarthagrahaṇamÂ' iti| nanu ca ṭhsvaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā'
(1.1.68) iti vacanāt svarūpasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam ? naitadasti;
śabdānuśāsanaprastāvādeva hi śabdasyeti siddhe śabdagrahaṇaṃ yatra
śabdaparo nirdeaśastatra svaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhyate nārthaparanirdeaśa iti
jñāpanārthaṃ kṛtam, iha cārthaparo nirdeaśaḥ| tasmādarthagrahaṇameva
yuktam| arthaparatvaṃ tu
nirdeaśasyāviccchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśādvijñāyate| arthagrahaṇe ca
sati tatparyāyeṣvapi pratyayo labhyata ityāha-- ṭhsvādvartheṣu' ityādi|
atha ṭhsvādumi' iti kimarthaṃ makārāntatvaṃ nipātyate,
māntasyopapadasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syāditi cet ? na;
yadyetatproyajanam, na nipātayitavyam, anantarasūtre khamuñaḥ
prakṛtatvāt sa eva vidhāsyate| asmiṃśca vihite mumaiva
māntatvamupapadasya
bhaviṣyatītyetaccodyamāpākartumāha--ṭhsvādumi'ityādi|
etenaitaddarśayati--yadyapi khamuñi sati sidhyati makārāntatvam,
īkārapratiṣedhastu na sidhyati, tataśca svaduśabdādupapadāt ṭhvoto
guṇavacanāt' (4.1.44) iti ṅīṣ prasajyet, tathā cāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ
syāt| mākārāntatvanipātane hi nimitasya
vihitatvānṅīṣprasaṅgo nāsti| tasmādyo'pi khamuñaṃ vidadhāti
tenāpyavaśyamīkārapratiṣedhārthaṃ makārāntaṃ nipātayitavyamiti|
yadyapi parasyābhimatam-- ṭhkhamuñi vihite mumaiva makārāntatvaṃ
bhaviṣyati' iti, tadapi na sarvatreti sūcayitumāha-- ṭhcvyantasya'
ityādi| anenaitaddarśayati-- yadi makārāntatvaṃ na nipātyeta, tadā
satyapi khamuñi makārāntatvaṃ cvyantasyopapadasya na syāt;
tasyāvyayatvāt| mumÂvidhau ca ṭhkhityanavyayasya' (6.3.66)
ityadhikārāt| tasmādyo'pi khamuñaṃ vidadhāti tenāpi
makārāntatvanipātanaṃ kartavyam| evaṃ hi makārāntatvanipātanameva
kriyatām, pratyayastu prakṛtaḥ khamuñeva vidhātavyaḥ ? aśakyaḥ khamuñ
vidhātum; khamuñpratyaye hi makārāntatvanipātanamavyayārthaṃ
vijñāyate,tataśca ṭhcvau ca' (6.3.64) iti dīrghatvaṃ syādeva| ṇamuli
sati sarvavidhayapavādastu vijñāyeta, tena dīrghatvamapi na bhavati|
avaśyañcotarārthaṃ ṇamul vidheyaḥ, na ca tasminnutaratra vidhīyamāne
lāghavaṃ bhavati, nāpīha gauravam|
kva punarartha ete pratyā bhavantītyāha-- ṭhtumarothādhikārācca'
ityādi|| ṭhete' iti| ye tumarthadhikāre vihitāḥ| ṭhyadyevam' iti|
yadi tumarthe bhavantītyarthaḥ| ṭhbhujipratyayena' ityādi| yadyapi
ṇamulā'nabhihitaḥ kartā, tathāpi bhujipratyayena laṭābhihita iti na
bhavitavyaṃ tṛtīyayā| nanu ca śaktilakṣaṇaḥ kartā, anyā ca
svādukaraṇaviṣayā śaktiḥ, anyā ca bhujikriyāviṣayā, tatra
laṭābhihitāyāmapi bhujikriyāviṣāyāyāṃ śaktāvitarasyāḥ śakteḥ
kartṛsaṃjñāyā anabhidhānāt pprāpnotītyeva-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ}
prāpnotyeva tṛtīyetyāha-- ṭhna cāsmin' ityādi| atra hi
samānakartṛkaprakaraṇe śaktamataḥ śaktīnāñca bhedo na vivakṣyate| tena
śaktimān devadataḥ kartā| sa caika evābhihitaśceti
kutastatīyāprasaṅgaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhedenopādānaṃ na vivakṣitam ?
ityāha-- ṭhsamānakartṛkatve hi' ityādi| abhyupagamyāpi
bhedavivakṣām, parihārāntaramāha-- ṭhpradhānaśaktyabhidhāne' ityādi|
kiṃ kṛtaḥ punaratra kartṛśaktyoḥ pradhānaguṇabhāvaḥ ? kriyākṛtaḥ;
svāduṅkāraṃ hi guṇabhūtam, bhujikriyārthatvāt| bhujikriyā tu
pradhānam; tenopakāryatvāt| kriyāyāśca guṇapradānabhāvāt
tadviṣayayorapi kartṛśaktyoḥ pradhānaguṇabhāvo bhavati| tatra
pradhānaśaktāvabhihitāyāmapradānaśaktirabhihitatvāt prakāśate u
pratibhāsate; pradhānānuyāyitvādÂguṇānām| tena tṛtīyā na
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||

27. anyathaivaṃkathamitthaṃsu siddhāprayogaścet| (3.4.27)
ṭhsiddhāprayogaḥ' iti| siddho'prayogo yasya sa tathoktaḥ|
ṭhnirarthakatvāt' ityādi| abhidheyābhāvāt prayojanābhāvādvā
nirarthakatvam| ṭhevameva' iti| nirarthakatvamevetyarthaḥ| ṭhanyathā
bhuṅkte' ityādinā tadevānarthakatvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā siddhāprayogatāṃ
darśayati| anyathā bhuṅkte iti yāvānevārthaḥ karotāvaprayujyamāne
gamyate tāvānevārthaḥ karotāvaprayujyamāne gamyate
tāvānevārtho'nyathākāraṃ bhuṅkta iti karotau prayujyamāne'pi|
tasmādanarthakaḥ karotiḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ prayujyamāna evānarthako bhavati ?
anyathādayaete prakāravacanāḥ, te yadānuprayogadhātorarthas
prakāramācakṣate tadā kṛñapi tairviśeṣyamāṇastadīyaprakāramācaṣṭe,
gacānyata evāvagata ityanarthako bhavati| yadyevam, avagatārthatvāt
tasya prayogo na prāpnoti ? naivam; avagatārthamapi prayogo
dṛśyate-- apūpau dvāvānaya, pacāmyahamiti|
ṭhanyathā kṛtvā śiro bhuṅkte' ityatrānyathāśabdena padāntarasya
śirasaḥ prakāramākhyāyate| sa vinā karotinā nāvagamyate| yadi hi
karotirna prayujyeta, bhujikriyāgata eva prakāro'nyathālakṣaṇaḥ
pratīyateta, na śirogataḥ| śirasastu bhujyamānataivāvagamyeta|
tasmānnātra karotiḥ śiddhāprayogaḥ||

28. yathātathayorasūyāprativacane| (3.4.28)
ṭhasūyāprativacane' iti| asūyāprabhavaṃ prativacanamasūyāprativacanam|
ṭhyadyasūyan' ityādi| asūyanniti śatrantametat| kaṇḍvādiyagantaḥ|
asya prativaktītyanena sambandhaḥ| prativakti u pratibhaṇati, prativacanaṃ
vadātītyarthaḥ| ṭhpṛccchati' iti| saptamyantametat| pṛccchati sati
yadyasūyan u asūyāṃ kurvan prativakti tadā tatra pṛccchati yat
prativacanaṃ tadasūyāprativacanam| ṭhyathākāram' ityādi| kathaṃ bhavān
bhokṣyate ityevaṃ vacanaṃ pṛccchati satyasūyāprativacanam|
ṭhyathākāram' ityādi| kathaṃ bhavān bhokṣyate ityevaṃ vacanaṃ pṛccchati
satyasūyāprativacanametat| ṭhyathā kṛtvā'haṃ bhokṣye tathā drakṣyasi'
iti. naitadasūyāprativacanam| kiṃ tarhi ? tadvyākhyānam||

47.upadaṃstṛtīyāyām| (3.4.47)
iha ṭhmūlakenopadaṃśaṃ bhuṅkte' ityādau karaṇe tṛtīyā, tadantaṃ
mūlakādyaupapadam| tacca karaṇamudaṃśervā syāt, bhujervā ?
tatropadaṃśestāvannopapadyate; anyasmin phyupadiśyamāne-mudritaḥ
pāṭhaḥ} hyupadaṃśyamāne'nyat karaṇaṃ bhavati, iha ca tadeva
mūlakādyaupadaśyate, nāparaṃ kiñcit| bhujiṃ tu pratyupapadyata eva
karaṇabhāvaḥ, kintūpapadasaṃjñā na syāt, tadabhāvadupapadasamāsaśca;
yasmādupapadamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇaṃ samarthaparibhāṣāyā
vyāpārtham, teneha tasyāmupasthitāyāṃ yameva prati yasya sāmarthya
tameva prati tasyopapadasaṃjñāyā bhavitavyam| bhujiṃ tu prati
tasyopapadasaṃjñayā bhavitavyam| bhujiṃ tu prati mūlakādeḥ
sāmarthyam, nopadaṃśi pratīti codyamāśaṅkyāha-- ṭhmūlakādi
copadaṃśe' ityādi| yadyapi bhujiṃ prati mūlakādeḥ karaṇabhāvaḥ
tathāpyupadaṃśinā saha sāmarthyamupapadyata eva; yatastasya karma| na ca
bhujinā saraha sambandhe satyupadaṃśinā saha sambandho nivartate;
virodhābhāvāt| tasmādupapadyata evopapadatvam, tasmiṃśca
satyupapadasamāsaḥ|
ṭhkriyābhede sati'iti| kriyābhedagrahaṇena
ktvāpratyayaviṣayamupalakṣayati| yatra kriyāṇāṃ paurvāparyaṃ
samānakartṛkatvañca sa ktvāpratyayasya viṣayaḥ| etaccobhayaṃ kriyābhede
sati bhavatīti ktvāpratyayasya viṣaya upalakṣyate| ṭhmūlakenopadaśya
bhuṅkte' iti| ṭhaniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ||

56. viśipatipadiskandāṃ vyāpyamānāsevyamānayoḥ| (3.4.56)
ṭhviśyādibhiḥ kriyādibhiḥ' iti| ādiśabdena patyāditrayāṇāṃ
grahaṇam| ṭhanavayavena' iti| sākalyena| ṭhpadārthānām' iti|
gehādīnām|ṭhtātparyam' iti| kriyāṇāṃ
paunaḥpunyamābhīkṣṇyamityarthaḥ| ṭhdravye vyāptiḥ' ityādinā
vyāpyamānāsevyamānayorviṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati| yadi vyāpyamāna
āsevyamāne cārthe pratyayo bhavati, evañca sati tayorarthayornityatā
vīpsā ca vidyata iti ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ'(8.1.4) iti dvivacanena
bhavitavyam, tat kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- ṭhsamānena'ityādi| yadyapi
samāsastayorarthayorna vidhīyate, purastādeva pratipāditam| ṭhtathā
ca vakṣyati'iti|bhāṣyakāraḥ| ṭhsupsu vīpsā 'iti vacanāt
ṭhvyāptamānatāyāṃ dravyavacanasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavati'ityuktaṃ bhavati|
ṭhtiṅkṣu nityatā'iti vacanāt ṭhāsedhyamānatāyāṃ kriyāvacanasya
dvirvacanaṃ bhavati' ityuktaṃ bhavati| 
ṭhgehaṃgeham'iti| dravyamavacanasya dvirvacamanam|
ṭhgehamanupraveśamanupraveśam'iti| kriyāvacanasya|ṭhnanu ca'ityādi
deśyaṃ ṭhktvānivṛtyartham'ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkya nirākaroti|
syādetat, ṭhābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca' (3.4.22) ityanena ktvāṇamulau
dvāvapi vihitau, tatra yadi viśyādibhyaḥ punarāsevāyāṃ ṇamul
vidhīyeta tadā ktvāpratyayo'pi syāt| atastannivṛtyarthaṃ
punarṇamulucyata iti ? etacca nāsti; iṣṭatvāt| iṣyate hyāsevāyāṃ
viśiprabhṛtibhyaḥ ktvā-- gehamanupraviśyānupraviśyāsta iti|
tasmādayuktaṃ tannivṛtyarthaṃ punarṇamulgrahaṇam|
ṭhdvitīyāntopapadārtham' ityādi| yadi ktvānivṛtyarthaṃ na prayujyate
tadā dvitīyāntasyopapadasaṃjñārthaṃ punarvacanam| anena
ṭhdvitīyāyāñca' (3.4.53) ityadhikārāddvitīyānta upapade
pratyayavidhānam| ato dvitīyāntasyopapadasaṃjñā labhyate| kimarthaṃ
punardvitīyāntasyopapadatvamiṣyate ? ityāha-- ṭhupapadasamāsaḥ'
ityādi| pakṣagrahaṇaṃ ṭhtṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' (2.2.21) iti
vikalpena samāsavidhānāt| syādetat--tenāpi ṇamulvidhāna
upapadasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatītyata āha--ṭhtena hi'ityādi| na hi
tenopapadasambandhe ṇamul vidhīyate; saptamīsthasya
kasyaciccchabdasyābhāvāt| tasmāt tena ṇamulvidhāne
satyupapadatvābhāva eva syāt||

madhyavartinā pānakriyā vyavadhīyate, na tatheha gatiḥ| tatra
cāhañcchabdātṛ ṭhkālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā|

yatnābhāvāt| yathā tena ktvāpratyayasyānvācīyamānatā vijñāyeta

nirdeaśāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnāt| iha pratyaye vidhīyamāne ṭhparaśca'

62. nādhārthapratyaye cvyarthe| (3.4.62)
ṭhnārtho dhārthaśca' iti| nāpratyayasahacarito'rtho nā ityucyate,
dhāpratyayasahacaritaśca dhā iti| nā'rtho yasya pratyayasya sa nārthaḥ
dhā'rtho yasya pratyayasya sa dhārtha iti| ṭhdvidhākṛtya' iti| ṭhsaṃkhyāyā
vidhārthe dhā' (5.3.42)| ṭhdvaidhaṃ kṛtvā' iti| ṭhdvitryosca dhamuñ' (5.3.45)
iti dhamuñ| ṭhdvedhākṛtya' iti| ṭhedhācca' (5.3.46) ityedhāc|
ṭhhiruk kṛtvā, pṛthak kṛtvā' iti| asati pratyayagrahaṇe
hirukpṛthakśabdayorasahārthatvāt nārthatvanamastīti
tayorapyupapadayoḥ ktvāṇamulau syātām| pūrvasūtrādeva
pratyayagrahaṇānuvṛtyā siddhe punariha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ
sukhapratipatyartham| pūrvakaṃ hi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ
samāsaikadeśatvādyatnānuvṛtaṃ syāt| ṭhnānā kṛtvā kāṣṭhāni gataḥ'
iti| cvyartho'tra nāsti; prakṛtyanyāvasthāyā avivakṣitatvāt|
ṭhdhārthamarthagrahaṇam' iti| dhāpratyayo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat
tathoktaḥ| dhārthā hi pratyayā bahavaḥ,tatrasatyarthagrahaṇe dhāpratyayasyaiva
grahaṇaṃ syāt, nānyeṣāṃ tadarthānām| athagrahaṇe tu sati teṣāmapi
grahaṇaṃ bhavati| atha nārthamapyarthagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- ṭhnā
punareka eva' iti| arthagrahaṇaṃ hi tatra kriyate yatra bahavo grāhyāḥ
sambhavanti, nāpratyayastveka eva,tasya cārthagrahaṇamantareṇa sidhyatīti na
tadarthamarthagrahaṇam| nanu ca ghamuñādīnāmapi sthānivadbhāvādeva
dhāgrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, atodhārthamapyarthagrahaṇamayuktam ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; aghādeśo'pi dhārthapratyayo'sti, ṭhghamuñantāt svārthe
ḍadarśanam' (vyā.pa.610) iti vacanāt| tasmāddhārthamarthagrahaṇaṃ
karttavyam|
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ-- nārthamapyarthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva| tathā hi-- dvau
nāpratyayau; eko niranubandhakaḥ, dvitīyaḥ sānubandhakaḥ|
tatrāsatyarthagrahaṇe ṭhniranubandhagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53)
iti nāpratyayasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na sānubandhakasya nāñaḥ| arthagrahaṇe
tu sati tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati||

63. tūṣṇīmi bhuvaḥ| (3.4.63)
nanu ca ṭhsvāṅge taspratyaye kṛbhvoḥ' (3.4.61) ityato
bhūgrahaṇamanuvartata eva, tat kimarthaṃ bhuva itīhocyate ? ityāha--
ṭhbhūgrahaṇam' ityādi| pūrva hi bhūgrahaṇaṃ kṛñā sambaddham,
atastadanuvṛtau tasyāpyanuvṛtiḥ syāt; atastannivṛtyarthaṃ punariha
bhūgrahaṇam||

64. anvacyānulomye| (3.4.64)
ṭhanvaci' iti nirdeaśastiryacītyanena vyākhyātaḥ| ṭhanvagbhūya'iti|
pūrvavat kvini kṛte tadantasya jaśtve kṛte ca rūpam|
ṭhanvagbhūtvāṭa iti| anucaro bhūtvā tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ||

65. śakadhṛṣajñāglāghaṭarabhalabhakramasahārhāstyartheṣu tumun| (3.4.65)
nanu ca ṭhtumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' (3.3.10) ityevaṃ
śakādiṣūpapadeṣu tumun siddhaḥ, tat kimartho'yamārambha ityāha--
ṭhakriyārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti| akriyārtheṣvapi śakādiṣu tumun yathā
syādityevamartho'yamārambhaḥ| na hi śaknoti bhoktumityādau
kriyārthopapadaṃ gamyate| kiṃ tarhi ? arthāntaram, anyadeva| iha
tāvat-- ṭhśaknoti bhoktum, utsahate bhoktum, jānāti bhoktum'
iti prāvīṇyaṃ gamyate| ṭhglāyati bhoktum' iti tadaśaktatā gamyate,
ṭhghaṭayati bhoktum, arhati bhoktum' iti tadyogyatāmātram| ṭhārabhate
bhoktum, prakramate bhoktum' iti bhujerevādyāvasthānakriyāntaram|
ṭhlabhate bhoktum' iti pratyākhyānam| ṭhasti bhoktum' ityādau
sambhavamātram||

66. paryāptivacaneṣvalamartheṣu| (3.4.66)
ṭhparyāptiranyūnatā' iti| paripūrṇatetyarthaḥ| ṭhalamarthaviśiṣṭeṣu'
iti| yadyapi bhūṣaṇādayo'lamarthāḥ, tathāpi paryāptivacane
sāmarthyemeva sambhavatīti tadeva gṛhyate| prayogadarśanārthabodhena
vyākhyānato vā| tenālamarthaviśiṣṭeṣvityayamartho bhavati| yadyevam,
sāmarthyeṣvityevaṃ kasmānnaktam ? naivaṃ śakyam ; evaṃ hyucyamāne
sāmarthyena bhuṅkte, balena bhuṅkta ityādāvapi syāt| yathānyāse
tu na doṣaḥ; na hyatra paryāptirdṛśyate| kiṃ tarhi ? saukaryam|
sukarametadityarthaḥ| yathāvidhyasya sambhavamātraṃ vivakṣitam,
sambhavatyevaṃvidhasya karaṇamityarthaḥ||

67. kartari kṛt| (3.4.67)
kimarthamidam ? kartari tṛjādayo yathā syuḥ| kva tarhi syuḥ ?
anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe (pu.pa.pā.90)| nanu ca svārthe yatra
pratyayamiccchati tatra bhāvagrahaṇaṃ karoti, yathā-- ghañādividhau bhāva
iti, na caite ghañādayaḥ svārthe bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi? tasya dharme
siddhatākhye; tathā lakārādividhau ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve
cākarmakebhyaḥ'(3.4.69) ityatra sūtre lakārā api naiva svārthe
vidhīyante, kiṃ tarhi ? tasya dharme sādhyatākhye ? yadyapi ghañādīnāṃ
lakārāṇāñca bhāve vidhānam, tathāpi śabdaśaktistvābhāvyādeṣa
viṣayavibhāgo labhyate| ghañādīnāṃ hi dhātvarthasya
siddhatāmevābhidhātuṃ sāmarthyam, lakārāṇāṃ sādhyatāmeva| tadevaṃ
yadanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti, tasmāt tṛjādayo'pi
tatraiva bhaveyuḥ, ataḥ kartaryeva te yathā
syurityevamarthamidamārabhyate|
atra ca dvedham-- kṛdutpativākyānāmayaṃ śeṣo vā syāt--
ṇvultṛcau kartari, nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ kartarīti ?
arthādeśo vā ? nirapekṣaiḥ svaiḥ svairvidhāyakaivarvākyairvihitānāṃ
kṛtāṃ paścādanenārtha ādiśyeta-- ye na lakṣaṇāntaraiḥ kṛto
vihitāste kartari vācye bhavantīti| tatra yadi dvitīyaḥ pakṣa
āśrīyeta tato yathā tṛjādīnāmanenartha ākhyāyate, tathā
khyunnādīnāmapi; viśeṣānupādānāt, tataste'pi kartari syuḥ|
sveṣu vidhivākyeṣu karaṇādīnāmupādānāt kaṇādiṣvapi|
yadyapyekasya pratyayasya kartari karaṇe ca yagupadÂvṛtirna sambhavati,
tathāpi vacanasāmarthyāt paryāyeṇa kartari karaṇe ca syuriti|
tasmādduṣṭo'yaṃ pakṣa iti prathamaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--
ṭhkṛdutpativākyānām' ityādi| anena teṣāmasya caikavākyatāmāha|
yadyevam, khyunnādivākyeṣvapyanenopasthātavyam-- teṣāmapyayaṃ śeṣa
iti kṛtvā, tataścāsminnapi pakṣe dvitīye pakṣe bhāvī doṣaḥ syāt?
ityata āha-- ṭhtatra yeṣu' ityādi| tatraiva he#utamāha--
ṭharthākāṅkṣatvāt' iti| śeṣo hi teṣāṃ bhavati
yānyaparisamāptatvādarthamākāṅkṣanti, nānyeṣām| ato yeṣu
vākyeṣvartho na#adiśyate teṣāmeva sākāṅkṣatvāt śeṣo'yaṃ yuktaḥ|
tṛjādīnāmeva vidhāyakāni vākyānyarthānādaśādarthākāṅkṣāṇi|
tathā hi-- ṭhṇvultṛcau bhavataḥ' ityukte'rthaviśeṣākāṅkṣā bhavati--
kvemau bhavata iti| tasmāt teṣāmevāyaṃ śeṣa iti
teṣvevopatiṣṭhate| ṭhna khyunnādivākyeṣu' iti| ṭhupatiṣṭhate' iti|
prakṛtenaiva sambandhaḥ| ṭhsākṣāt' ityādi| anupasthāne kāraṇam|
khyunnādivākyānyarthākāṅkṣāṇi na bhavanti, teṣu
karaṇādīnāmarthānāṃ sākṣānnirdeaśāt| tasyānna teṣāmayaṃ śeṣa iti na
teṣūpatiṣṭhate,ato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ||

68. bhavyageyapravacīyopasthānīyajanyāplāvyāpātyā vā| (3.4.68)
bhavyādiṣu geyapravacanīyopasthānīyāḥ sakarmakāḥ| tena teṣāṃ
karmaṇi prāpte kartari ca nipātanam| śeṣāṇāmakarmakāṇāṃ bhāve
kartari ca| ṭhbhavyaḥ' iti| ṭhaco yat' (3.1.97), guṇaḥ,
ṭhdhātostannimitasyaiva' (6.1.80) ityavādeśaḥ| ṭhgeyaḥ' iti| ṭhīdyati'
(6.4.65) itītvam,guṇaḥ| ṭhsāmnām' iti| karmaṇi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī|
ṭhupasthānīyaḥ' iti| anīyar| ṭhjanyaḥ'iti| ṭhaco yat' (3.1.97) ityatra
ṭhtakiśasiyaticatijanīnāmupasaṃkhyānam' (vā.213) iti yat|
ṭhāplāvyaḥ' iti| plavateḥ ṭhorāvaśyake' (3.1.125) ṇyat,vṛddhiḥ,
pūrvavadāvādeśaḥ| ṭhāpātyaḥ' iti| ṭhṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124)||

69. laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ| (3.4.69)
pūrvasūtreṇa kṛtsaṃjñakatvāllakāraḥ kartaryeva prāpnoti na
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ, atastayorapi yathā syādityevamarthamidamārabdham| ṭhla
ityutsṛṣṭānubandhakam ityādi| laḍādīnāṃ daśānāṃ lakārānāṃ
viśeṣakarānanubandhānutsṛjya ṭhlaḥ' iti sāmānyaṃ gṛhyate|
ṭhprathamābahuvacanāntañcaitat' iti| pañcamīṣaṣṭhekavacanāśaṅkāṃ
nirākaroti| pañcamyāṃ hyasyāṃ lakārāt paro yastasyaivārtho
nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt, tataśca kartaryeva lakāraḥ syāt,
ṣaṣṭhaḷamevāsyāmanantaryalakṣaṇā vijñāyeta| tathā ca lakārasya
yo'nantarastasyaivārthanirdeaśaḥ syāt, tataśca sa eva doṣo yaḥ
pañcamyām| atrāpyādeśāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate ?evamapi
lakārādeśānāmanenāmartho nirdiśyata ityayameva viṣayārtho na
nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt| nanu ca lakārasya prayoga eva nāsti, tatkathaṃ tasyaiva
karmādayo'rthāḥ ? sāmarthyāt tadādeśānāmete'rthā vijñāsyanta
ityadoṣaḥ| ṭhsakarmakebhyo bhāve na bhavanti' iti| akarmakebhya iti
vacanāt; anyathā hi tadanarthakaṃ syāt||

70.tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ| (3.4.70)
ṭhtayoreva bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti| etena ṭhtayoḥ' ityanena
ṭhbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' ityasya pratyavamarśa iti darśayati| nanu cānantarasūtre
dve vākye-- ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi bhavanti kartari ca' ityekaṃ vākyam, ṭhbhāve
cākarmakebhyo'pi bhavanti kartari ca' iti dvitīyam,
tatrānantaravākyaśrutayoḥ kartṛbhāvayoreva tayorityanena
pratyavamarśo yuktaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ| yadayamutarasūtre ṭhkartari ca'
(3.4.71) iti karoti,tato'vasīyate--- bhāvakarmaṇoreva pratyavamarśa
iti yadi bhāvakartroreva pratyavamarśaḥ syāt, kartṛgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syāt; kartaryanenaiva siddhatvāt| evaṃ hi tatra vaktuaṃ yuktaṃ syāt--
karmaṇi ceti, karmaṇi kenacidaprāptaḥ syāt| yadā punariha
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ pratyavamarśastadā yuktaṃ kartarigrahaṇam, kartaryaprāpte
yathā syāt| yathāprāptaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| tasmādbhāvakarmaṇoreva
pratyavamarśo yuktaḥ| ṭhevakāraḥ' ityādinā evakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ
apakarṣaṇārthaḥ u nivṛtyarthaḥ|
ṭhśayitam' iti| ṭhniṣṭhā śīṅ' (1.2.19) ityādinā
kitvapraratiṣedhādguṇaḥ|
ṭhīṣatkaraḥ,sukaraḥ' iti| ṭhīṣaduḥsuṣu' (3.3.126) ityādinā khal| 
ṭhīṣadāḍhaḷṃbhavam' iti| atrāpi ṭhkartṛkarmaṇośca bhūkṛñoḥ
(3.3.127)||

71. ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca| (3.4.71)
ṭhādikarmaṇi' iti| ādiścāsau karma ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ|
ṭhkriyākṣaṇaḥ' iti| etena karmaśabdokriyāṃ karmācaṣṭe, na sādhanaṃ
karmeti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- ṭhkriyāṃ karmācaṣṭa iti
? ādiśabdena viśeṣaṇāt| bahunāṃ kriyākṣaṇanāmādimadhyāntabhāve
satyanādibhūtakriyākṣamavyavacchedādādibhūto yaḥ
kriyākṣaṇastadādikarmeti yuktaṃ pratipādayitum| ādigrahaṇena sādhanaṃ
karma tvekamevetyādiśabdena viśeṣayituṃ na śakyate;
āderanādibhūtatvāpekṣatvādādiśabdasya tatrāpravṛtiḥ,
vyavacchedyābhāvāt| ādikarmaṇi ca ṭhbhūte' (3.2.84) ityanuvartamāne
ṭhniṣṭhā' (3.2.102) ityanenaiva vihita iti darśayatinnāha--ṭhtasmin'
ityādi| ādyo yaḥ kriyākṣaṇaḥ sa pariniṣpannatvādÂbhūto bhavatīti
yuktā tasya bhūtatvena vivakṣitatā| ṭhprakṛtaḥ kaṭṃa devadataḥ' iti|
kartari ktaḥ| tenaiva kartā'bhihita iti devadataśabdāt tṛtīyā na
bhavati| karmaṇastvanabhihitatvāt kaṭaśabdāddvitīyā bhavatyeva|
ṭhprakṛtaḥ kaṭo devadatena' iti| atra karmaṇi ktaḥ| tenaiva
karṇaṇo'bhihitatvāddvitīyā na bhavati|
kartaranabhihitatvāddevadataśabdāt tṛtīyā bhavatyeva| ṭhprakṛtaṃ
devadatena' iti| bhāve ktapratyayaḥ| sarvatra praśabda ādikarma
dyotayati| nanu cādibhūtakriyākṣamakāle kaṭo'nabhinirvṛta eva
bhavati, kaṭakāraṇabhūtā eva pīraṇādayastadānīṃ santi, na ca tadavasthaḥ
kaṭaḥ tadavasthaḥ kaṭaḥ, tatkathaṃ prakṛtaḥ kaṭa iti bhūtakālena
prakṛtaśabdena kaṭasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? ādyena kriyākṣaṇena yo
vīraṇādīnāṃ viśeṣa āhitastatra tādarthyāt kaṭaśabdo vartate, sa ca
bhūta evetyadoṣaḥ||

72. gatyarthākarmakaśliṣaśīṅsthāsavasajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca| (3.4.72)
ṭhupasthitaḥ' iti| ṭhdyatisyatimāsthāmiti kiti' (7.4.40) itītvam|
ṭhanūṣitaḥ' iti| vacyādinā (6.1.15 samprasāraṇam, ṭhvasatikṣughoḥ'
(7.2.52) itīṭ, ṭhśāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.23.60) iti ṣatvam|
ṭhanujātaḥ' iti| ṭhjanasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ' (6.4.42) ityātvam| ṭhārūḍhaḥ'
iti| ṭhho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), ṭhjhaṣastathorddho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam,
ṭhṣṭuanā ṣṭuaḥ' (8.4.41), ṭh ḍho ḍhea lopaḥ' (8.3.13), ṭhḍhralope pūrvasya'
(6.3.111) iti dīrghaḥ| ṭhanujīrṇaḥ' iti| ṭhjṛ vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1494),
ṭhṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itītvam, ṭhhali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvam,

73. dāśagoghnau sampradāne| (3.4.73)
ṭhgoghnaḥ' iti| sa eva hanteḥ pacādyac| sampradāne'c nipātyate,
upadhālopaśca| atha vā-- ṭakÂpratyayo nipātyate, upadhālopaśca
ṭhgamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinaiva siddhaḥ, ṭhho hanteḥ' (7.3.54) ityādinā
kutvam| yadi sampradāne ṭhgoghnaḥ' iti nipātyate,
tataścāṇḍālāderapi tenābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti; yasmāt tasmai api ye
hyāgatāya dātuṃ ghnanti te'pi sukṛta ityata āha--
ṭhnipātanasāmarthyāt' ityādi| yathaiva hyatra nipātanasāmarthyāt
kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ labhyate tathā'rthaviśeṣo'pi| tasmādyadyapi
ṭhgoghnaḥ' ityaviśeṣeṇa nipātyate, tathāpi viśiṣṭasyaiva| tena
ṛtvigāderabhidhānam, nānyasya cāṇḍālādeḥ| yadā tarhi dātuṃ
hanyate tadā tasya goghna ityabhidhāṃ na prāpnotītyata āha-- ṭhasatyapi'
ityādi| yathā hyapacannapi yogyatayā pācaka ityucyate, tathā'satyapi
gohanane goghna iti||

74. bhīmādayo'pādāne| (3.4.74)
ṭhpuṇādipratyayāntā ete-- kāśikā'} ūṇādipratyayā ete'| iti|
uṇādayaḥ pratyayā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| ke punasta uṇādayaḥ pratyayāḥ ?
ityata āha-- ṭhśyādhūsūbhyo mak' ityādi| ādiśabdena
maṅkvannādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yadi tarhyuṇādipratyayā ete, evaṃ
satyuṇādipratyayānāṃ rūḍhiśabdāt kriyākārakasambandhābhāvādapādāne
vṛtirna sambhavatyeva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; rūḍhiśabdeṣvapi keṣāñcit
kriyākārakasambandho'styeva, yathā-- tailapāyikādiṣu|
ato'deśyametat| ṭhtābhyām' ityādi| nanu cāsatyasmin sūtre
tābhyāmityeṣa nirdeaśo nopapadyate; apādānasyāprakṛtatvāt,
tatkutaḥ paryudāsasya prasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣa-; arthakatvametat|
asmin hyasati tatraivaṃ sūtraṃ kartavyam--
tato'pādānāccānyatroṇādaya iti| tathā ca yadīdaṃ nocyeta,tadā
syādeva paryudāsaḥ||

75. tābhyāmanyatroṇādayaḥ| (3.4.75)
atha kimarthaṃ tābhyāmityanena sampradānāpādānapratyavamarśaḥ kriyate,
etāvadeva vaktavyam-- avyatroṇādaya iti, prakṛtatvādeva hi
tayostābhyāmanyatroṇādayo vijñāsyante ? ata āha--
ṭhsampradānapratyavamarśārtham' ityādi| ṭhanyathā hi' ityādi| yadi
ṭhtābhyām' ityanena tayoḥ pratyavamarśo na kriyate ityarthaḥ|
ṭhanantaratvāt' ityādi| ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā'
(vyā.pa.19) iti nyāyādapādānasyaiva paryudāsaḥ syāt, yadi
tābhyāmiti nirdeaśo na kriyeta| ṭhkṛṣiḥ' iti| ṭhik kṛṣyādibhyaḥ'
(vā.324) itīk| ṭhtantuḥ' iti|
ṭhsitanigamimasisacyāvidhāñkruśibhyastun' (da.u.1.122) iti tun|
ṭhcarma' iti | manin||

76. kto'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ| (3.4.76)
nanu ca neyaṃ loke prasiddhiḥ -- dhrauvyārthā akarmakāḥ,
pratyavasānārthā abyavahārthā iti, tatkathamayamartho labhyate ? ityata
āha-- ṭhsvanikāyaprasiddhiḥ' iti| svanikāyaḥ u vaiyākaraṇasaṅghaḥ,
tatreyaṃ prasiddhiḥ| ṭhkartṛbhāvādhikaraṇeṣu' iti| bhāvakarmaṇoḥ
ṭhtayoreva' (3.4.70) ityādinā| ṭhidameṣām' iti|
ṭhadhikaraṇavācinām' (2.3.68) iti ṣaṣṭhī|
ṭhkatham' ityādi| ṭhbhuktā brāhmaṇāḥ, pītā gāvaḥ' iti| kartari niṣṭhā,
anyathā'nabhihitatvāt karturbrāhmaṇaśabdādgośabdacca kartari
tṛtīyā syāt| na pratyavasānārthebhyaḥ kenacit kartari kto vihitaḥ,
tatkathametau sūtrādanantaramidaṃ kasmānna paṭhaḷte, ekaḥ evaṃ sati guṇo
bhavati, dviḥ ktagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati| tadevaṃ vaktavyam --ādirmaṇi
ktaḥ kartari ca, tataḥ śliṣaśīṅsthāsavajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca,
tato'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhya iti, evañca dviḥ
ktagrahaṇaṃ gatyarthākarmakagrahaṇañca na kartavyaṃ bhavati ? aśakyamevaṃ
vaktum; evaṃ hyucyamāne yathā dhrauvyārthebhyaḥ kartari kto bhavati,
tathā pratyavasānārthebhyo'pi syāt, sa ca neṣyate|
tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||

3. striyām| (4.1.3)
ṭhṅyāporanenaiva vidhānāt' iti| etena ṭhstriyām' ityadhikṛtya

13. ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām| (4.1.13)

16. yañaśca| (4.1.16)

viśeṣaṇamapatyaṃ gṛhyaet| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- utarasūtre vikalpārthaṃ

ṭhtaddhitaluki sati'iti| etena ṭhtaddhitaluki' ityeṣā viṣayasaptamīti
darśayati| parasaptamītyeṣānopapadyate;luko'bhāvarūpatvāt, abhāve
ca paurvāparyābhāvāt| ṭhsarvato mānaṃ parimāṇam' iti| pariśabdaḥ
sarvato bhāve| sarvata ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate u pariccchadyate
yena tatparimāṇam- prasthādiḥ|
ṭhpañcāśvā' iti| taddhitārthe dviguḥ, ṭhtena krītam' (5.1.37)
ityārhīyaṣṭhak, ṭhadhyarthapūrvāddvigorluk'(5.1.28) | ṭhkālaḥ saṃkhyā
ca na parimāṇam' iti| na hi tābhyāmārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate|
jñāpakācca na tayoḥ parimāṇatvamavasīyate| yadayaṃ
ṭhparimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) iti siddhāyāmutarapadavṛddhau
ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca'(7.3.15) iti saṃkhyāsaṃvatsaragrahaṇaṃ
karoti, tajjñāpayati--kālaḥ saṃkhyā ca na parimāṇaṃ bhavatīti|
vistādi ca parimāṇaviśeṣa eva grahītavyaḥ| ato vṛtigranthaḥ--
parimāṇārthaṃ grahaṇamiti | kāṇḍasya vā parimāṇatve tūtarasūtreṇa
niyamārthatā na virudhyate| yadyevaṃ ṭhkālāḥ parimāṇinā' (2.2.5) ityatra
sāmarthyāt parimāṇavacanāḥ kālaśabdāḥ samasyanta iti yaduktaṃ
tadvirudhyate ? nāsti virodhaḥ; upacāreṇa tathānyatra parimāṇivācinā
subantenābhidhānāt| iha hi mukhyaṃ kālasya parimāṇatve niṣidhyate|
tatra hyaaipacārikaṃ kālasya parimāṇatvamāśritya parimāṇavacanāḥ
kālaśabdā ityuktam-- kālāḥ parimāṇaneti bruvatā|
parimāṇavacanatvaṃ kālaśabdānāmupayuktaṃ bhavati,na hi tena vinā
parimāṇāpekṣayotarapadasya parimāṇivyapadeśa upapadyate| na ca kālasya
mukhyaṃ parimāṇatvamasti| ataḥ sāmarthyādaupacārikaṃ
parimāṇatvamāśritamiti gamyate| upacārasya hetuḥ paricchedasya
hetutvamātram, parimāṇasya sādharmyam| kālo hi
māsādirjātādisamabandhinīmādityagatiṃ gamayatīti bhavati
paricchedasya hetuḥ| ataḥ parimāṇasādharmyādupapadyate, tatra ca
parimāṇopacāraḥ| ṭhdvivarṣā, trivirṣā' iti| dve varṣe bhūteti
ṭhsamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvī' (5.1.80) ityanena vihitasya ṭhakaḥ
ṭhvarṣālluk' (5.1.88)iti luk pākṣikaḥ| citavatve tu pratyayārthasya
vivakṣite ṭhcitavati nityam' (5.1.89) iti nityameva luk| dve varṣe
pramāṇamasyā iti ṭhpramāṇe lo dvigornityam' (vā.558,559) iti
nityameva luk| ṭhdviśatā, triśatā' iti| dvābhyāṃ śatābhyāṃ krīteti
ṭhpaṇapādamāṣasaśatādyat' 5.1.34) iti yati prāpte ṭhśāṇādvā' (5.1.35)
ityatropasaṃkhyānam-- ṭhśatācceti vaktavyam'(vā. 510) iti| tena
śatasaśabdāt pakṣe ṭhsaṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' (5.1.22) iti
kan,tasya pūrvavalluk|
ṭhdvivistā'iti| dvau bistau pacati| ṭhsambhavatyavaharati pacati' (5.1.52)
ityanenārhīyaṣṭhak, tasya pūrvavalluk| dvāvācitau pacati
ṭhdvyācitā'| ṭhāḍhakācitapātrātsakho'nyatarasyām' (5.1.53) iti
vartamāne ṭhdvigoḥ ṣṭhṃaśca' (5.1.54) iti ṣṭhan, tasya pūrvalluk|
dvābhyāṃ kambalyābhyāṃ krītā ṭhdvikambalyā'| ṭhtena krītam' (5.1.37) iti
ṭhak,tadvadeva| luk|
ṭhdvyāḍhakī' iti| dvāvāḍhakau pacati|
ṭhāḍhakācitapātrātkho'nyatarasyām' (5.1.53) iti vartamāne ṭhdvigoḥ
ṣṭhṃaśca' (5.1.54) itipakṣe ṣṭhan, tasyā luk| ṭhpañcāśvī' iti|
pūrvavat samāhāre dviguḥ|
ihemau dvaupratiṣedhāvucyete, tatraikaḥ śakyamakartum| katham ? evaṃ
sūtranyāsaḥ kariṣyate-- parimāṇāntātaddhitalukīti| pūrveṇaiva siddhe
niyamārthametat-- parimāṇāntādeva taddhitaluki ṅībbhavati,
nānyasmāt| tena dvyāḍhakītyādāveva bhavati, na
pañcāśvetyādau;tato vistācitakambalyebhyo na
taddhitalukītyanuvartate,bistādibhyaḥ parimāṇebhyo'pi taddhitaluki
ṅībna bhavatīti ? naivaṃ śakyam; viparīto'pi niyamaḥ
sambhāvyeta--parimāṇāntāt taddhitalukyevana bhavati, nānyatreti|
tataśca dvayoḥ kuḍavayoḥ samāhāro dvikuḍavītra na syāt|
tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||

23. kāṇḍāntātkṣetre| (4.1.23)
ṭhniyamārtham' iti| kṣetra eva yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi|
athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā sāmarthyādeva tadantavidhirlabhyata eva,
yathā-- pūrvasmin sūtre, na hi kevalasya kāṇḍaśabdasya
kenaciddvigusaṃjñā vihitā ? satyametat, kintvasatyagrahaṇe
kāṇaḍameva kṣetreṇa viśiṣyeta-- kāṇḍaśabda eva kevalo yaḥ kṣetre
vartate iti, tataśceha pratiṣedhaḥ syāt-- dvābhyāṃ kāṇḍasaṃjñakābhyāṃ
kṣetrābhyāṃ krītā dvikāṇḍī vaḍaveti| iha tu na syāt-- dve kāṇḍe
pramāṇamasyāḥ kṣetrabhakteḥ dvikāṇḍā kṣetra bhaktiriti| antasūtre tu sati
kāṇḍaśabdasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kṣetraṃ na bhavati; tasya dvigo guṇabhūtatvāt|

24. puruṣātpramāṇe'nyatarasyām| (4.1.24)
ṭhpramaṇe yaḥ puruṣaśabdo vartate'iti| jātivacano'pi puruṣaśabdaḥ,
yadā pramāṇaśabdenābhisambadhyate tadā puruṣagate pramāṇe vartate|
bhavati padāntarasambandhena śabdasyārthāntare vṛtiḥ, yathā-- siṃho
māṇavaka iti| siṃhaśabdo jātivacano'pi
māṇavakasānnidhyācchāṬryalakṣaṇaṃ guṇamācaṣṭe| ṭhdvipuruṣī' iti|
ṭhpramāṇe dvayasac'(5.2.37) iti vihitasya dvayasacaḥ ṭhpramāṇe lo
dvigornityam'(vā. 558,559) iti luk|
ṭhaparimāṇāntatvāt pratiṣedha prāpte'iti| ṭhaparimāṇavista' (4.1.22)
ityādinā| 
ṭhdvābhyāṃ puruṣābhyāṃ krītā dvipuruṣā' iti| pūrvavadārhīyasya ṭhako
luk|
ṭhtaddhitaluki' ityeva| ṭhpañcapuruṣī' iti| pramāṇārthavṛtānāmeva
samāhārānnāsti dvyaṅgavikalatā||

25. bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ| (4.1.25)
ṭhūdhaso'naṅiti samāsānte kṛte' iti| akṛta eva samāse bahuvrīhyarthaṃ
utarapade pūrvaṃ samāsāntena bhavitavyamiti prāk tataḥ samāsānta eva
bhavati, tato bahuvrīhiḥ tataḥ strīpratyayaḥ-- ityevaivānupūrvī|ṭhano
bahuvrīheḥ' ityādi| itiśabda ādyarthe| ṭhano bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12)
ityādinā śāstrāntareṇetyarthaḥ| tatra ṭhano bahuvrīheḥ' ityanena
sūtreṇa pratiṣedhe prāpte ṭhḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) ityanena
ḍāp| ṭhkuṇḍoghnī' iti| kuṇḍamivodho'syā iti
bahuvrīhiḥ,ṭhallopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ|
ṭhprāptodhāḥ' iti| ṭhprāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā' (2.2.4) iti tatpuruṣaḥ,
ṭhatvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ|
ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ'ityādi| ṭhana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' (4.1.28)
ityetenāpi vidhīyamānasya ṅīpo'yaṃ ṅībbādhaka iṣyate| kathaṃ
punarihocyamānastasya bādhako bhavati ? utarasūtrānuvṛteḥ|
asatyānutaratrānuvṛtau ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante'
(vyā.pa.10) ityevamayaṃ ṅībḍāppratiṣedhāveva bādhate,
nopadhālopino ṅīṣam| tataśacopadhālopinaḥ paratvāt sa eva
pakṣe bhavet| tasmāt ṭhana upadhālopinaḥ' (4.1.28) ityatrāsyānuvṛtiḥ
kartavyāḥ| tenopadhālopino'pyūdhasantānṅīṣeva bhavati|
ṭhsamāsāntaśca striyāmeva' iti| samāsāntavidheranityatvāt|
anityatvaṃ tu punarūdhaḥśabdena sakārāntenāsamāsāntena
viśeṣaṇādvijñāyate| yadi hi nityaḥ syāt ṭhbahuvrīherūghnaḥ' iti
nirdeaśaḥ syāt||

26.saṃkhyāvyayāderṅīp| (4.1.26)
ṭhdvyūghnī'ityādi| dve ūdhasī asyāḥ|
trīṇyūdhāṃsyasyāḥ|abigatamūdho'syāḥ|nirgatamūdho'syā iti vigrahaḥ|
ṭhādigrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| evaṃ manyate-- saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmityeva
vaktavyam, ṭhbahuvrīherūdhasaḥ' (4.1.25) iti hi vartate,,
tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate--- saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmutaro ya
ūdhaḥśabdastadantābahuvrīherṅībbhavatīti, tathā ca
niṣpalamādigrahaṇam, vināpi tena siddhatvāditi| ṭhdvividhoghnī'
ityādi| yadyādigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā ṭhsaṃkhyāvyayābhyām' iti
pañcamīnirdeaśāt saṃkhyāyā anantaro ya ūdhaḥśabdastadantādeva syāt|
yatra tu vyavadhānaṃ tatra tu na syāt, ādigrahaṇātu tatrāpi bhavati|
dvividhamūdho yasyā iti vigrahaḥ| atrādigrahaṇe sati vidhaśabdena
vyavadhāne'pi bhavati||

27.dāmahāyanāntācca| (4.1.27)
ṭhūdhasaḥ' iti nivṛtam,prakṛtyantaropādānāt|
ṭhsaṃkhyāgrahaṇanuvartate, nāvyayagrahaṇam' iti| saṃkhyāgrahaṇasyaiva
svaritatvāt| ṭhḍāppratiṣedhavikalpeṣu prāpteṣu' iti|
ṭhḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) ityādinā ḍāpi prāpte ṭhano
bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) iti pratiṣedha ṭhana upadhālopino'nyatarasyāmṭa
(4.1.28) iti vikalpe ca| dve dāmanī asyā iti ṭhdvidāmnī'| ṭhdvau
hāyanāvasyā iti ṭhdvihāyanī'| 
ṭhhāyano vayasi smṛtaḥ' iti| prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ| kasya prakṛtiḥ ?
ṅīpaḥ prakṛtatvāt tasyaiva| bahuvrīhyadhikārādatra hāyamānto
bahuvrīhiriti gamyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- hāyamānto
bahuvrīhirvayasi gamyamāne ṅīpaḥ prakṛtirācāryaiḥ smṛta iti| tena
yadi vayo gamyate tato ṅībbhavati, nānyathā|
etaccotarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyobhayoryogayoḥ
śeṣabhūtatvādvyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| atha tricaturbhyāṃ
hāyanasyāpyupasaṃkhyānādyathā hi trihāyanī caturhāyaṇītyatra ṇatvaṃ
bhavati; tathā trihāyanā śālā, caturhāyanā śāletyatrāpi kasmānna
bhavati ? ityāha -- ṭhṇatvamapi' ityādi| tadapi hi
ṇatvamaupasaṃkhyānikamācāryairvayasyeva smaryate| na ca śālāyā vayaḥ
sambhavati, tasya prāṇidharmatvāditi neha ṇatvaṃ pravartate|
antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| bahuvrīhyadhikārādeva hi sāmarthyāt
tadantavidhirlabhyate; na hi
kevalayordāmahāyanaśabdayorbahuvrīhisaṃjñā kenacidvihitā||

28.ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām| (4.1.28)
ṭhupadhālopī'iti| upadhālopo yasya ṅīpi parataḥ sambhavati sa
upadhālopī|
ṭhnanu' ityādi| ṭhano bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) iti pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ,
ṭhḍābubhābhyāmamanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) iti ḍāp,
anayatarasyāṃgrahaṇācca pakṣe ṅīp| yadi tarhi
ṭhḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' ityanena ṅībapi vidhīyate, tadā dāmā
pāmetyatrāpi syāt ? anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvānna
bhaviṣyati| ṭhanupadhālopinaḥ' ityādi| yadīdaṃ nocyeta,
anupadhālopino'pi ṅīp syāt| tasmādupadhālopina eva ṅībyathā
syāt, anupadhalopino mā bhūdityevamarthamidamucyate |
ṭhbahurājā' iti| ṅīppratiṣedhaḥ| ṭhsarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti
nopadhāyā dīrghaḥ| ṭhbahurājñī' iti| ṅīp, ṭhallopo'naḥ' (6.4.134)|
ṭhbahurāje' iti| ḍāp, ṭhāṬṅ āpaḥ' (7.1.18) iti śībhāvaḥ,
ṭhādguṇaḥ' (6.1.97)| dvivacananirdeaśo ḍāpo'bhivyaktaye| ekavacane hi
ḍāppratiṣedhayorna kaścidviśeṣaḥ; ubhayatrāpi tulyarūpatvāt| kvacit
ṭhbahurājāḥ' iti bahuvacanena nirdeaśaḥ, tasyāpi tedava prayojanam|
ṭhbahumatsyā' iti| ṭhsūryātiṣyāgastyamastyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ' (6.4.149)
iti lopavidhānādupadhālopītyeṣa bahuvrīhiḥ| ṭhsuparvā' iti|
ayamupadhālopī na bhavati| ṭhna saṃyogādvamantāt' (6.4.137)
ityupadhālopapratiṣedhāt||

29. nityaṃ saṃjñācchandasoḥ| (4.1.29)
nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| pūrvaṇaiva hi vikalpena ṅīp siddhaḥ,
tadārambhasāmarthyādeva ṅībnityaṃ bhaviṣyati, anyathā hīdaṃ
vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt||

30. kevalamāmākabhāgadheyapāpāparasamānāryakṛtasumaṅgalabheṣajācca|
(4.1.30)
atha māmakagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'smadaḥ ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇi
kṛte ṭhtavakamamakāvekavacane' (4.3.3) itimamakādeśena māmaka iti
bhavati, tataśca ṭhṭiḍÂḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) ityeva ṅīpsiddheḥ ?
satyametat; niyamārthaṃ tu māmakaśabdasya grahaṇam;
saṃjñāccchandasoryathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi||

31. rātreścājasau| (4.1.31)
ṭhajasau' iti | viṣayasaptamīyam, na parasaptamī, kutaḥ ?
strīpratyayasyāntaraṅgatvājjasaḥ paratvāvirodhādviṣayasaptamītve na
doṣa ityāha-- ṭhjasviṣayatvāt' ityādi|
ṭhajasādiṣviti vaktavyam'iti|jāsādiviṣayādanyatra
rātriśabdānṅībbhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- iha lāghavārthaṃ ṭhajasi' iti vaktavye'jasāvityuktam,
mātrādhikyādarthādhikyasūcanārtham, tenājasādiṣu ṅībbhavatīti|
ādiśabdenāmādīnāṃ grahaṇam|
ṭhkatham' ityādi| ṭhrātryaḥ' iti| rātriśabdasya jasantasya prayogaḥ| evaṃ
hi ṭhdīrghājjasi ca' (6.1.105) iti savarṇadīrghatve pratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśa
upapadyate, nānyathā| yadi tu rātriśabdasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ syāt, tataḥ
ṭhjasi ca'(7.3.109) iti guṇe kṛte'yādeśe ca rātraya iti rūpaṃ syāt|
īkārāntaśca rātriśabdo na sambhavati;ajasāviti ṅīppratiṣedhāt|
tataśca rātrya iti prayogo nopapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhṅīṣayam'ityādi|
nanuca rātriśabdo bahvādiṣu paṭhaḷte, tatkathaṃ bahvādilakṣaṇastato
ṅīṣbhaviṣyati ? ityata āha--ṭhtatra hi' ityādi|
ṭhkṛdikārādaktinaḥ'iti| kṛta ikāraḥ kṛdikāraḥ,tadantānṅīṣ
bhavati|ṭhvṛdṛbhyāṃ vin' (da.u. 1.23) varvī, darvī| yastu ktinsambandhī
tadantānna bhavati-- ṭhstriyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) kṛtiḥ, hṛtiḥ|
ṭhsarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' iti| eka ācāryā sarvato'ktinnarthāt
kṛdikārādakṛdikārācca ṅīṣ bhavatītyāhuḥ, rājiḥ rājī|
rājiśabdo'vyayutpatipakṣe kṛtikārānto na bhavati| aktinnarthāditi,
na vidyate ktinnartho yasya so'ktinnarthaḥ, tasmāt sarvato ṅīṣ bhavati|
yastu ktinnarthastadantānna bhavati-- kṛtiḥ hṛtiḥ| ṭhākrośe nañyaniḥ'
(3.3.112) -- akaraṇiḥ, aharaṇiḥ| rātriśabdaścāyaṃ vyutpatipakṣe
kṛdikārānto bhavati, ṭhrā ādāne' (dhā.pā.1057), ṭhrāśadibhyāṃ
trip' (da.u.1.36) rātriḥ, tasmāt pakṣe ṅīṣ rātrī| avyutpatapakṣe tu
kṛdikārānto na bhavati, tataḥ ṭhsarvato'ktinnarthāt' (ga.sū.51) iti
ṅīṣ||

32. antarvatpativatornuk| (4.1.32)
ṭhsa tu nakārāntatvādeva siddhaḥ' iti| ṭhṛnnebhyo ṅīp' 4.1.5)
ityanena| ṭhnipātanasāmarthyāt' ityādi| yathaiva hi
nipātanasāmarthyādanyat kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati,
tathārthaviśeṣe'pi vṛtiḥ| kasminpunararthaviśeṣe vṛtirbhavati ?
ityata āha-- ṭhantarvatpativat' ityādi| yathākramamantarvadityasya
garbhasaṃyoge vṛtiḥ, patipadityasya bhartṛsaṃyoge| garbheṇa saṃyogo
garbhasaṃyogaḥ, sa kasyā bhavati ? yasyāḥ kukṣau garbho vyajyate| bhartrā
saṃyogo bhartusaṃyogaḥ, sa ca kasyā bhavati ? yasyāḥ patirjīvati|
bhartā ceha yo'gnisākṣipūrvakeṇa pāṇigrahaṇanena sambandhī sa
evābhimataḥ, natu yaḥ pṛthivīsvāmī| ṭhprāśatibhyāṃ da.u.} iha tu na
bhavati iti-- antarasyāṃ śālāyāṃ vidyate' (iti) śālāyāṃ kukṣigatena
garbheṇa sambandhābhāvāt| ṭhpatimatī' iti| parirasyā astīti matup,
ṭhugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp| atra patiśabda īśvare svamini vartate|
tena saṃyoge ca na pativaditi nipātyate| yena tu saṃyogo
nipātyate sa cākhyāta eva|
ṭhmatubnipātyate' iti| antaḥśabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvāt
prathamāsamarthatā nāsti| prathamāsamarthāccāstisamānādhikaraṇena
matubvidhīyate, na cāstināntaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam,
tasmānmatubna prāpnotīti nipātyate| ṭhvatvaṃ na siddham' iti|
ṭhmādupadhāyāśca' (8.2.9) ityādinaivākāropadhatvāt| ṭhnipātyate'
iti| kenacidaprāptatvāt| ṭh matupsiddhaḥ'iti| patirasyāstīti
prathamāsamarthasya patiśabdasyāstinā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| ṭhgarbhiṇī'
ityanena garbhasaṃyogaṃ darśayati| ṭhjīvapatiḥ'ityanenāpi
bhartṛsaṃyogam|
ṭhantarvatpativatoḥ'ityādi| antarvatpativadityetayoḥ
śabdayornipātanānmatubavatve bhavataḥ, yathākramaṃ garbhiṇyāṃ jīvapatyāṃ
ca striyāmabhidheyāyām| garbho'syā astīti garbhiṇī| jīvatīti jīvaḥ,
pacādyac; jīvaḥ gatiryasyāḥ sā jīvapatiḥ|nanu ca ṭhpatiḥ samāsa eva'
(1.4.8) iti ghisaṃjñoya'yaṃ patiśabdaḥ,tatra ṭhacca gheḥ' (7.3.119)
ityātvautvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ jīvapatāviti bhavitavyam, tadayukto
jīvapatyāmiti nirdeaśaḥ ? naitadasti; ṭhśeṣo ghyasakhi'(1.4.7) iti,
siddhāyāmeva ghisaṃjñāyāṃ ṭhpatiḥ samāsa eva' (1.4.8) ityanena śeṣasyaiva
patiśabdasya ghisaṃjñā niyamārthaṃ vidhīyate, na cāyaṃ śeṣaḥ; ṭhṅiti
hrasvaśca' (1.4.6) iti nadīsaṃjñāsambhavāt| nadīsaṃjñāyāṃ ca satyāṃ
ṭhidudbhyām' (7.3.117) iti ṭhReĀrām nadyāmnībhyaḥ' (7.3.116) ityām,
yaṇādeśe jīvapatyāmiti bhavati| ṭhvā ccchandasi nugvidhiḥ' | cchandasi
vikalpe tu nugvidhirbhavati| sa ca vakṣyamāṇasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya
siṃhāvalokitanyāyenānuvṛtervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate|
nukpakṣe ṭhṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp| ṭhantarvatnī' iti|
anukpakṣe ṭhugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp--antarvatīti bhavati||

33. patyurno yajñasaṃyoge| (4.1.33)
ṭhyajñasaṃyoge' iti| yajñasambandhe| kasya punaryajñena saṃyogaḥ ?
patiśabdavācyārthasya| atha patiśabdasyaiva kasmānna bhavati ? asambhavāt|
tayorhi vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ syāt, na kevalaḥ patiśabdo
yajñasya vācakaḥ| kathaṃ punaryajñena saṃyoga ityāha-- ṭhtatsādhanatvāt'
iti| tasya yajñasya sādhanaṃ tatsādhanam, tadbhāvo yajñasādhanatvam|
tasmādyajñena saṃyogo bhavati| yajamānasya yā bhāryā tasyā yāgaṃ prati
sādhanabhāvo'stīti; vinā tayā tadaniṣpateḥ| na hi
bhāryāvirahitastrairṇikaḥ kevalo yajñe'dhikriyate| tasmāt sa tayā
karaṇabhūtayā yajñaṃ niṣpādayatītyasti tasyā yajñena saha
kriyākārakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ| ṭhtatphalagrahītṛtvādvā' iti| yajñasaṃyoge
dvitīyo hetuḥ| anena tu svasvāmibhāvalakṣamaḥ sambandhaḥ pratipādyate|
yajñasya yatpradhānaṃ phalaṃ svargākhyaṃ tadyajamānasya patnī parigṛhṇāti|
ato yadyapi yajñaṃ prati tasyāḥ sādhanatvaṃ na vivakṣyate, tathāpi
tatphalasya grahaṇāt, yathā yajamānasya yajñena hasa
svasvāmibhāvasambandhaḥ, tathā tatpatnyā api| atha phalagrahītṛtvāditi
kathamatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ? kathañca na syāt ? ṭhkartari ca' (2.2.16) iti
tṛcā saha ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhāt ? naivāyaṃ tṛjantena
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? dvitīyeti yogavibhāgāt tṛnnantena
dvitīyāsamāsaḥ| atha vā-- yājakādiṣu grahītṛśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena
ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhaviṣyati| athāpi tatra na paṭhaḷte ? evamapi
ṭhyājakādibhiśca' (2.2.9) iti
cakārasyānuktasamucayārthatvādbhaviṣyati| ṭhṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5)
iti grahītṛśabdādiha ṅīp na bhavati, strītvasyāvivakṣitatvāt|
kvacit ṭhphalagṛhṇītatvāt' iti pāṭhaḥ|tatra
phalagṛhītaśabdayorbahuvrīhiḥ| phalaśabdasya jātivācitvānniṣṭhāyāḥ
pūrvanipāte prāpte ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam' (vā.116) iti
gṛhītaśabdasya paranipātaḥ|
ṭhkatham' ityādi| eṃ manyate-- ṭhśūdrasyaiva tāvadyajñe'nadhikṛtvādyajñena
saṃyogo nāsti, kiṃ punastadbhāryāyāḥ ? ataḥ ṭhvṛṣalasya patnī'
ityeṣa prayogo nopapadyate' iti| ṭhupamānādbhaviṣyati' iti|
patnīvaddhi patnī| yathaiva hi yajamānasya patnyagnisākṣipūrvakeṇa
tatpatyuḥ sambandhinī tatkāryeṣu cādhikṛtā tathā vṛṣalasya bhāryā'pi|
tasmāt patnīsamādharmyāt sā'pi patnītyucyate||

34. vibhāṣā sapūrvasya| (4.1.34)
ṭhpatiśabdāntasya'ityādi| etena patiśabdasya grahaṇam, sapūrvagrahaṇam,
anupasarjanagrahaṇañca -- trayamapyetat prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇamiti
darśayati| sahaśabdo'yamastyeva tulyayoge-- saśiṣyo gururāgata
iti, guroḥ śiṣyasya cāgamanena tulyayogaḥ pratīyate; asti ca
satāvacanaḥ, yathā-- sahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gardabhī' iti,
vidyamanairevetyarthaḥ| tadiha satāvacano gṛhyate, sapūrvasya
vidyamānapūrvasyetvarthaḥ| yadi hi tulyayoge vartamāno gṛhyate,
tato'yamarthaḥ syāt---sahapūrveṇa patiśabdāntasya nakāro bhavatīti|
tataśca patiśabdāt pūrvasyāpi vṛddhādiśabdasya nakāraḥ syāt| evaṃ
hi tulyayogo bhavati yadi nakāra ubhayorapi bhavati|
pūrvaśabdo'yamastyeva vyavasthāśabdaḥ, yathā--pūrvaṃ mathurāyāḥ
pāṭaliputramiti; astyavayavavacanaḥ, yathā-- pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti|
tadihāvayavavacano gṛhyate| saha vidyamānaḥ pūrvo'vayavo yasya tat
sapūrvamityucyate| yadi vyavasthāśabdo gṛhyaeta, tatrāyamarthaḥ syāt--
vidyamānaḥ pūrvo yasmāt tasya patiśabdāntasya nakāro bhavatīti|
tatasca dṛḍhapatnītyatra na syāt, na hi patiśabdāntādihakaścit
pūrvo'stīti| atha patiśabdasyaiva sapūrvatvamanupasarjanatvañca
viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? aśakyatvāt| sa hyavayavavacanaṃ vā
pūrvaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā viśiṣyeta, vyavasthāśabdaṃ vā| tatra
pūrvastāvadayuktaḥ kalpaḥ avyabhicārāt, asambhavācca| katham ? yadi
pakāraṃ pūrvamabhipretya vidyamānaḥ pūrvo'vayavo yasyeti viśiṣyeta,
tato'vyabhicārādayuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam| na hi pakāreṇa yasya pūrvatvaṃ
tatpatiśabdo vyabhicarati| atha śabdāntaram ? tadasambhavādayuktaṃ
viśeṣaṇam| na hi śabdāntaraṃ patiśabdasyāvayava upapadyate|
vyavasthāśabdapakṣe tu vidyamānaḥ pūrvo yasmāt taditi viśiṣyate|
yujyate ca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ| kintu vākye'pi nakāraḥ
prāpnoti---- grāmasya patiriyaṃ brāhmaṇīti; asti hyatra patiśabdāt
pūrvo grāmaśabda-| anupasarjanagrahaṇenāpi patiśabde viśiṣyamāne
bahuvrīhau vikalpo na prāpnoti-- dṛḍhaḥ patirasyā dṛḍhapatiḥ,
dṛḍhapatnīti| na hyatrānupasarjanaṃ patiśabdaḥ,
sarvopasarjanatvādÂbahuvrīheriti
bahuvrīhyavayavānāmapyupasarjanatvāt| tasmāt prātipadikasyaiva
viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam|
ṭhpatiriyaṃ brāhmaṇī grāmasya' iti| nanu ca vyapadeśivadbhāvādidamapi
sapūrvamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭuam| na ca
ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'pratipadikena' (śāk.pa.65) iti
vyapadeśivadbhāvābhāvaḥ; prātipadikatvāt| yadyevam,
patiśabdāntatāpi nāstīti, ato dvyaṅgavikalatā ? naitadasti;
sapūrvagrahaṇe hi kriyamāṇe patiśabdāntasyetyeṣo'rtho labhyate|
akriyamāṇe tu tasmin śabdasyaiva śuddhasya nakāro vijñāyate||

35. nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu| (4.1.35)
ṭhsapatnyādiṣu' iti| ke punaḥ saptnatyādayaḥ ? ye paṭhaḷnte| teṣu
prātipadikeṣu yeṣāṃ samānādīni pūrvapadāni te sapatnyādayaḥ|
kuta etat ? samānādīnāṃ gaṇe pāṭhāt, sapatnyādīnāṃ cāpāṭhāt|
lāghavārthaṃ samānārthaṃ samānādiṣviti pravaktavye kṛte nakāradeśasya
sapratyayasya ca sapatnyādiṣviti samudāyasyoccāraṇam-- niyogata
eva samudāya īkāranta eva yathā syādityevamartham| tena sapatnī
bhāryā yasya sa sapatnībhārya iti ṭhstriyāṃ puṃvat' (6.3.34) iti
puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati| ṭhsapatnyādiṣu nityam' ityādi|
samānādiṣu pūrveṣvayavayaveṣu satsu nityaṃ patiśabdasya
nakārādeśo bhayatītyarthaḥ| yadi pūrveṇa vikalpe prāpta idaṃ vacanam,
evaṃ hi nityagrāhaṇayanarthakam, ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi nityaṃ
vidhirbhaviṣyatītyata āha-- ṭhnityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham' iti|
ṭhdāsāccchandasi' iti| dāsaśabdāt paro yaḥ patiśabdastadantasya
prātipadikasya cacchandasi viṣaye nityaṃ nakārādeśo bhavati| dāsaḥ
patiryasyāḥ sā dāsapatnī| bhāṣāyāṃ tu pūrÂveṇa vikalpaḥ--
dāsapatiḥ, dāsapatnīti||

36. pūtakratorai ca| (4.1.36)
ṭhaikāraścāntādeśo bhavati' iti| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam--
ādejño'yamiti, na punaḥ pratyayaḥ ? utarasūtre'pyādeśatvāt|
utarasūtre hyayamevaikāro'nuvartate, tatra cāsyādeśatvam| ata
ihāpyādeśatvamavasīyate| utarasūtre kuto'syādeśatvaṃ niścitamiti
cet ? udātavacanāt| yadi hi pratyayaḥ,
tasyādyaudātatvādudātavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt;
pratyayasvareṇaivodātatvasya siddhatvāt|
ṭhtraya ete yogāḥ' iti| ayaṃ caikaḥ, vakṣyamāṇau cānantarau-- dvau-- ete
trayo yogāḥ puṃyogaprakaṇe ṭhpuṃyogādākhyāyām' (4.1.48)
ityevamādau draṣṭavyāḥ; tasminneṣāṃ svaritatvenānuvṛteḥ| pūtaḥ
kraturyena pukaṣeṇa sa pūtakratuḥ, tasya strī pūtakratāyī||

37. vṛṣākapyagnikusitakusīdānāmudātaḥ| (4.1.37)
ṭhvṛṣākapiśabdo madhyodātaḥ' iti| ṭhlaghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo
guruḥ' (phiṭ.2.42) iti vanacāt| asyāyamarthaḥ-- laghāvante parato
dvayośca laghvoḥ parato bahvacśabdasya yo guruḥ sa udāto
bhavatīti| ṭhbahvaṣ' iti bahvajityarthaḥ| pāṇineryaścakāreṇa
pratyāhāraḥ so'nyeṣāmācāryāṇāṃ matena ṣakāreṇa| vṛṣākapiśabde
kapiśabdasambandhinorlaghvoḥ parataḥ pūrva ākāro gurutara udāto
bhavati, śeṣamanudātam| tatra yadyaudātagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetānudātasya
sthāne ya ādeśaḥ sthānivadbhāvena so'nudāta eva syāt|
tasmādvṛṣākapi śabda udātatvaṃ prayojayati| ṭhagnyādiṣu
punarantodāteṣu' iti| ṭhphiṣaḥ' (phi.sū.1.1)
ityādināgnyādīnāmantodātatvam| ādiśabdena
kusitakusīdayorgrahaṇam| ṭhphiṣ' iti prātipadikasyaiva
punaranyācāryākṛtā saṃjñā||

38. manorau vā| (4.1.38)
ṭhvāgrahaṇena dvāvapi vikalpyete' iti| pratyekaṃ
vāgrahaṇenābhisambandhāt| yadā caikāraukārau na bhavatastadā ṅībapi
na bhavati ; tasya sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt| ṭhmanuśabda ādyaudātaḥ' iti|
etenodātagrahaṇamanuvartayitavyam; anyathā śeṣasyānudātatve
sthānivadbhāvenādeśasyāpyanudātatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| ṭhmana jñāne'
(dhā.pā.1176) ṭhpbhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanimamasjbhya uḥ--
da.u.}bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanidhanimimasjbhya uḥ' (da.u.1.92)
ityanuvartāne ṭhdhānye nit' (da.u.1.94) iti ca
ṭhśṛsvṛsnihitrapyasivasihaniklidibandhimānibhyaśca' (da.u.1.95)
ityupratyayaḥ, nitvāt ṭhñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyaudātatvaṃ
bhavati manuśabdasya||

39. varṇādanudātātopadhāto naḥ| (4.1.39)
ṭhvarṇānāṃ taṇitanitāntānām' (phi.sū.2.23) ityasyāyamarthaḥ--
varṇavācināṃ taśabdāntānāṃ ṇakārāntānāṃ tiśabdāntānāṃ
niśabdāntānāṃ cādirudāto bhavatīti, ādigrahaṇamudātagrahaṇaṃ ca
prakṛtaṃ tatrānuvartate|
ṭhprakṛtā' iti| prakarṣeṇa kṛteti, ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.12) iti
samāsaḥ| praśabdo'yaṃ nipātaḥ, ṭhnipātā ādyaudātāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80)
ṭhupasargāścābhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) ityudātaḥ| samāse'pi kṛte
ṭhgitaranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudāta eva
bhavatīti| seṣamanudātam| ṭhghṛtāditvādantodātaḥ' iti|
ṭhghṛtādīnāñca' (phi. sū.1.21.) ityantodātatvavidhānāt| etacca
phiṭsūtre paṭhaḷte| ṭhśiti' iti ṭhvarṇānām' (phi.sū.2.33) ityādinā
śitiśabda ādyaudātaḥ| 
ṭhpiśaṅgāt' ityādi| piśaṅgaśabdaḥ ṭhlaghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42)
ityādinā madhyodātaḥ, tataḥ ṭhanyato ṅīṣ' (41.36)
ityataścakāro'nuktasamuccayārtho'nuvartate| tena piśaṅgādapi
ṅībbhavatīti| ṭhvaktavyam' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- ṭhmanorau vā' (4.1.39) ityato vetyanuvartate,sā ca
vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenāsitapalitaśabdābhyāṃ ṅīṣna bhaviṣyatyeveti|
ṭhvarṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām' (phi.sū.2.33) iyādyaudātau
asitapalitaśabdau|
ṭhtayoścchandasi' ityādi| asitapalitaśabdayostakārasya knameka
ācāryā iccchanti| sa tu ṭhvyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) ityeva siddhaḥ|
ṭhbhāṣāyāmapīṣyate' iti| etena pratyācaṣṭe| ṭhasiknikānām' iti|
ajñātārthe ṭhprāgivātkaḥ' (5.3.70) itikaḥ, ṭhke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ||

40. anyato ṅīṣ| (4.1.40)
ṭhsāraṅgī, kalmāṣī' iti| ṭhlaghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā
madhyodātau sāraṅgakalmāvaśabdau| ṭhśavalī' iti| ṭhśapa akrośe'

śabalaśabdaḥ| ṭhkhaṭvā' iti| ṭhkhaṭa kāṅkṣāyām (dhā.pā.309),
ṭhaśūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan' (da.u.8.125) iti kvan,
nitsarveraṇādyaudātaḥ khaṭvāśabdāḥ| ṭhkṛṣṇā' iti| ṭhkṛṣa vilekhane'
(dhā.pā.990) ṭhpiṇsiñdīRuṣyavibhyo nak--da.u.)
iṇsiñjidīRuṣyavibhyo nak', ṭhkṛṣervarṇe' (da.u.5.35.37) iti nak,

(dhā.pā.443) ṭhsalikalyanimahibhaḍibhaṇḍiśaṇḍipiṇḍituṇḍikukibhūbhya

41. ṣidÂgaurādibhyaśca| (4.1.41)
ṭhṣidbhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ' iti| ṣakāra idyeṣāṃ tāni| kathaṃ punaḥ
prātipadikāni ṣinti bhavanti, yāvatā dhvunādeḥ pratyayasya ṣakāra
itsaṃjñakaḥ,na tu teṣām ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avayavagataṃ hi ṣitvaṃ
samudāyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, yathā-- akṣigataṃ kāṇatvaṃ puruṣasya
--kāṇaḥ puruṣa iti| yadyevam, dhātugatamapi ṣitvaṃ samudāyasya
viśeṣaṇaṃ prāpnoti, ṭhtrapūṣ lajjāyām' (dhā.pā.347), aṅ,
apatrapeti ? naitadasti; yo hyanubandho'vayave niṣprayojanaḥ sa
samudāyārtho vijñāyate| dhātostu vidyata eva ṣitkaraṇasya nānyat
prayojanamasti, ataḥ samudayārthameva tadvijñāyate| ṭhrajakī' iti| atra
ṭhrañjeśca' (6.4.26) ityatra
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādanunāsikalopaḥ|
gaurādiṣu gauraśabdasya satyapi varṇavācitve
prātipadikasvareṇāntodātatvāt pūrveṇa prāpnotītīha pāṭhaḥ|
matsyādīnāṃ yakāropadhānām ṭhayopadhāt' (4.1.63) iti
jātilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣaḥ pratiṣedhe prāpte| śṛṅgaśabdasya prāk

atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pūrveṇaiva siddhe vikalpe
satyārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ bhaviṣyati ? ityata āha--
ṭhnityagrahaṇamutarārtham' iti||

47. bhuvaśca| (4.1.47)
ṭhprabhvī' ityādi| ṭhbhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ' (3.2.179) ityataḥ ṭhbhuvaḥ'
ityanuvartamāne ṭhvipraṃśabhyo ḍvasaṃjñāyām' (3.2.180) itipratyayaḥ,
tadantānṅīṣ| ṭhsvayambhūḥ' iti| bhavateḥ kvibantasya rūpam| nanu ca
ṭhbhuvaḥ' iti bhūśabdāddīrghādiyaṃ pañcamī, , tataśca dīrghādeva
pratyayena bhavitavyam, na hrasvādityata āha-- ṭhhrasvādeveyaṃ pañcamī '
iti| tarhi ṭhbhuvaḥ'iti nirdeaśo nopapadyate, ṭhgherṅiti' (7.3.111) iti
guṇe kṛte ṭhbhoḥ' iti nirdeaśena bhavitavyam ? ityata āha-- ṭhsautro
nirdeaśaḥ'iti| cchandasi varṇavyatyaya uktaḥ| tena tasya guṇe'kṛta
uvaṅadeśaḥ kṛta iti darśayati||

48. puṃyogādākhyām| (4.1.48)
ṭhpuṃyogāt' iti| ṭhvibhāṣā guṇe'striyām' (2.3.25) iti hetau
pañcamī| yogaḥ u sambandhaḥ| ṭhākhyāyām' iti| pañcamyartha eṣā
ṭhvyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti saptamī| ākhyāyate'nayā
prātipadikakārtha iti śrutyā''khyā| ṭhpuṃsa ākhyāyām' iti| puṃso
vācakabhūtamityarthaḥ| taddhi puṃyogāddhetoḥ samprati striyāṃ vartate;
na puṃsi| atīta e kāle puṃso vācakamāsīt, ato bhūtagrahaṇam|
etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yat prātipadikaṃ prāk puṃso vācakamabhūt,
paścātu paṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartate tasmān ṅīṣbhavatīti|
kathaṃ punaryoge guṇabhāvamāpannasya puṃsa ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ
yujyate, striyāmityanuvṛteḥ striyā eva ? naitadasti; yo hi
puṃyogāt striyāṃ vartate so'vaśyaṃ striyamacaṣṭa iti
viseṣaṇamidamadanarthamakameva syāt| puṃyogasya tarhīdaṃ viśeṣaṇam
? na; asambhavāt| na sambhavatyeva hi tat prātipadikaṃ yat
puṃyogāddhetoḥ pūrvaṃ striyāṃ vartate, puṃyogasya cākhyābhūtaṃ
bhavati| gaṇakādayo hi ye śabdāḥ puṃyogāt striyāṃ vartante te
sarve eva vācakāḥ prāgabhūvan, na puṃyogasya| ye tu puṃyogādayaḥ
śabdāḥ puṃyogasya vācakāḥ, te puṃyogāt striyāṃ na vartanta eva|
na ceha kaścit tathāvidho'nya prakṛtaḥ, nāpi śrūyate,
yasyākhyāgrahaṇena sambandhaḥ syāt| tasmādguṇabhūtasyāpi puṃsa
evānena sambandho vijñāyate| ṭhgaṇakī' ityādi| gaṇayatīti
gaṇaka,ṇvul| pratiṣṭhita iti praṣṭhaḥ, ṭhātascopasarge' (6.1.136) iti kaḥ|
ṭhpraṣṭho'gragāmini' (8.3.92) iti nipātanānmūrdhanyaḥ| sarva ete puṃso
vācakāḥ| puṃyogātu yadotarakālaṃ striyāṃ vartante tadaitebhyo
ṅīṣ| ṭhpuṃsi śabdapravṛtinimitasya sambhavāt' iti|
gaṇanādikriyāsvabhāvaṃ yadgaṇakādiśabdānāṃ pravṛtinimitaṃ tasya
puṃsi sambhavaḥ, na striyām, nāpi napaṃsake| tasmāt puṃsi śabde
ete| puṃso vācakā ete śabdā ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi striyāṃ vartante ?
ityāha-- ṭhtadyogāt' ityādi| tadyogaḥ u tasyāyamiti sambandhaḥ,
svasvāmibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| tasmādete puṃśabdā api svabhāvataḥ striyāṃ
vartante| yathaiva tadyogāt striyāṃ snānodvartanapariṣekādīn
labhate tathā tāccchabdyamapi|
ṭhdevadatā' iti| atra devadataśabdasaṃjñakena puruṣeṇa
yogāddevadataśabdaḥ striyāṃ na vartate| kiṃ tarhi ? svata eva, tasyā
hīyaṃ saṃjñā kṛtā| ṭhparisṛṣṭā, prajātā' iti| prasūtetyarthaḥ|
nirluṭhitagarbheti yāvat| parisṛṣṭaprajātaśabdau striyāṃ vartamāno
prasavanimitamupādāya pravartete| parisargaḥ, prajanaḥ, prasava ityekārthā
ete śabdāḥ| tasya ca prasavasya puṃyogo nimitam, tena vinā
tadabhāvāt| tasmāt puṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartata iti| vartata
iti| na tu puṃśabdākhya iti īkāro na bhavatīti| ṭhete śabdāḥ' iti|
bahuvacanaṃ ye'nye'pyevaṃjātīyāḥ śabdāstānapekṣya veditavyam;
anyathā hi parisṛṣṭaprajātaśabdayordvitvadetau śabdāviti vaktavyaṃ
syāt|
ṭhgopālikādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti| siddhye iti
vākyaśeṣaḥ| gopālikādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ siddhaye ṅībpratiṣedhaḥ| sa
tu ṭhvoto guṇavacanāta' (4.1.44) ityato vetyanuvṛtestasya
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya pratipādyaḥ|
ṭhsūryāddevatāyāṃ cāvvaktavyaḥ'iti| nanu ca ṅīṣa eva pratiṣedho
vaktavyaḥ, ṅīṣi pratiṣiddhe ṭābbhaviṣyati, ṭāpi ca sūryeti sidhyatyeva
? naitadevam; yadyapi hi rūpaṃ siddhyati, svaratu na sidhyati,
yasmāt sūryaśabdo'yamādyaudātaḥ| tathā hi ṭhrājasūyasūryaḥ' (3.1.114)
ityatra kyabanto nipātitaḥ, tataḥ kyapaḥ pitvādanudātatvam|
dhātostu suvateḥ sartervā dhātusvareṇāntodātatvam| tatra ṭāpi
satyanudātatvaṃ syāt, tu satyantodātatā bhavati| pitkaraṇaṃ tu
ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārtham|
ṭhsūrī'iti| sūryasya strī mānuṣī sūrī, ṅīṣeva bhavati,
ṭhsūryatiṣyāgastyamastyānām' (6.4.149) iti yalopaḥ||

49.
indravaruṇabhavaśarvarudramṛḍahimāraṇyayavayanamātulācāryāṇāmānuk|
(4.1.49)
ṭhyeṣām' iti| indrāṇīnām| ṭhanyeṣāṃ tu' iti| himādīnām| atha
kimarthamānuk kriyate, anugeva nocyeta, tena savarṇadīrghatvena
sidhyati ? na sidhyati; ṭhato guṇe' (6.1.97) iti pararūpatvaṃ hi
prāpnoti| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, pararūpe hi nugeva
vaktavyaḥ syāt| evaṃ tarhyakāroccāraṇasamarthyādbhaviṣyati|
lvarasandhireva na bhavatītyevamapi vijñāyate| tasmānmaivaṃ
vijñāyītyānugeva vaktavyaḥ| atha vā-- indramācaṣṭa iti ṭhtatkaroti
tadācaṣṭe' (vā.200,201) iti ṇici ṭhṇāviṣṭavat prātipadikasya'
(vā.813) iti ṭilopaḥ, indrayateḥ kvip, ṇilopaḥ, indraḥ
strīndrāṇītyatra dīrghaghasyākārasya śravaṇaṃ yathā
syādityevamarthamānuko vidhānam| ānuki hi sati dīrgho na
śrūyeta| nanu ca naivātra ṅīṣā bhavitavyam, ata ityadhikārāt ?
dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati|
ṭhhimāraṇyayormahatve' iti| mahatvena yuktā himādayaḥ
strīliṅgenābhisambadhynate yadā, tadā strītvavivakṣāyāmanayoḥ
pratyayāgamayorvidhānamityetadanenākhyāyate, na tu
strīpratyayasyāyamapavāda ucyate| strītva eva hi pratyayo bhavati|
ṭhyathāddoṣe'iti| yavāddoṣe gamyamāne striyāṃ ṅīṣ bhavati-- duṣṭo
yavo yavānī|
ṭhyavanāllipyām' iti| ṭhyavanānāṃ lipiḥ' iti| ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120)
ityapprasaṅge ṅīṣ vidhīyate, sa tu tadarthasya ṅīṣaiva dyotitatvānna
bhavati| 
ṭhācāryadaṇatvañca' iti| nedamapūrvaṃ vaktavyam, kṣubhnādiṣvasya
pāṭhāt|
ṭhsvārtha evāyaṃ vidhiḥ' iti| evakāreṇa puṃyogo vyavaccchidyate| yadi
hi puṃyoge vidhirayaṃ syāt śūdrā'pi kṣatriyasya bhāryā
kṣatriyāṇīti syāt| tasmāt svārthe evāyaṃ vidhiḥ-- kṣatriyaiva
kṣatriyāṇīti| ṭhpuṃyoge tu ṅīṣaiva bhavitavyam' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa|
ṭhlicca'iti| kasya tallitvam ? ānukaḥ| tathā hi-- mudgalānīśabdas
dvitīya udāta āmyāye paṭhaḷte| ṅīṣastu litve tṛtīya udātaḥ
syāt||

50. krītātkaraṇapūrvāt| (4.1.50)
karaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ yasminnityādinā karaṇapūrvagrahaṇaṃ krītagrahaṇañca
ubhayamapyetatprātipadikasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati|
pūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacanaḥ| karaṇamavayavo yasminnityarthaḥ| atha
krītaśabdasyaiva karaṇapūrvagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ?
aśakyatvāt | krītaśabdo hyavayavavācinaṃ vā pūrvaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā
viśeṣyeta-- karaṇaṃ pūrvasminniti ? vyavasthāśabdaṃ vā-- karaṇaṃ
pūrvamasmāditi ? tatra prathamaḥ pakṣo na sambhavati; na hyatra krītaśabdasya
karaṇavāciśabdāntaramavayava upapadyate, dvitīyastu sambhavati, kintu
vākye'pi syāt-- aśvena krīteti, asti hyatra krītaśabdāt karaṇaṃ
pūrvam| prātipadike tu viśeṣyamāṇe na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hyaśvena
krītetyetat karaṇāvayavaṃ krītaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikam| kiṃ tarhi ?
vākyam| tasmāt prakṛtaṃ prātipadikaṃ sāmānyamevāvayavavācinā
pūrvaśabdena viśeṣyate| krītaśabdenāpi tadeva karaṇapūrvaṃ
prātipadikam| tena tasmin viśeṣyamāṇe sāmarthyāt tadantavidhiḥ
prasajyetetyāha-- ṭhkrītaśabdāt prātipadikāt' iti| ṭhvastrakrītī,
vasanakrītī' iti| 
atra ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ
prāksubutpateḥ' (vyā.pa.vṛ.138) iti vastravasanayoḥ karaṇayoḥ
krītaśabdena ṭhkartakaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) iti prāgeva
subutpateḥ samāsaḥ|
ṭhsukrītā, duṣkrītā' iti| gatyupapadatvāt prāgeva subutpateḥ
ṭhkugatiprādayaḥra' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| duṣkrītetyatra ṭhidudupadhasya
cāpratyaya' (8.3.41) iti ṣatvam|
ṭhṭābantena samāsaḥ' iti| subantayoreveti veditavyam| ṭāpi
vihite kṛdantatāyā vihitatvāt| atra kiṃ ṭāp kriyatām ? uta
vibhaktiriti ? antaraṅgatvāṭṭāp| paścādbahiraṅgā
vibhaktiriti vibhaktyantayoḥ samāsaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu
ṭābvibhaktyoḥ ṭhṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatra
pratipāditam| kṛte tarhi ṭāpi ṅīṣ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- ṭhata iti
ca' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ ṭābantena samāsaḥ sidhyati, yāvatā
ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ'
(vyā.pa.vṛ.138) iti prāgeva kṛdantatāyāṃ samāsena bhavitavyamityata
āha-- ṭhgatikārakopapadānām' ityādi. kathaṃ punarbahulaṃ taducyate
? ityāha-- ṭhkartṛkaraṇe' ityādi| ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam'
(2.1.32) ityanena hi gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ samāso
vidhīyate| sa ca bahulagrahaṇāt kvacit kṛdantāvasthāyāṃ prāgeva
subutpateḥ, kvacidanyathā| tena ṭhgatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha
samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpateḥ (vyā.pa.vṛ.138) iti bahulaṃ
tadācāryairucyate| tataśca ṭābantenāpi kvacitsamāso labhyata
ityabhiprāyaḥ||

51. ktādalpākhyāyām| (4.1.51)
ṭhabhraviliptī' iti| ṭhlipa upadehe' (dhā.pā.1433), asmāt ktaḥ|
alpairabhrairviliptetyasyāmarthavivakṣāyāṃ pūrvavatprāksubutpateḥ
samāsaḥ| alpaśabdastu gatārthatvānna prayujyate| ṭhcandanānuliptā' iti|
bahucandanānuliptetyarthaḥ||

52. bahuvrīheścāntodātāt| (4.1.52)
ṭhśaṅkhabhinnī' iti| ṭhradābhyām' (8.2.42) iti natvam| niṣṭhāntasya
ṭhniṣṭhā' (2.2.36) iti pūrvanipāte prāpte ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyaḥ
paravacanam' (vā.116) iti sa na bhavati| śaṅkhādiśabdā hi
jātivacanāḥ| ata eva hi ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt
kto'kṛtamitapratipannāḥ' (6.2.170) ityantodātatvaṃ bhavati|
ṭhgalakotkṛtī' iti| ṭhkṛtī chedane' (dhā.pā.1435) ityasmāt ktaḥ|
ṭhkeśalūnī' iti| keśān lunātīti| ṭhlvādibhyaḥ' (8.2.44) iti natvaṃ
codayati|
ṭhpādapatitā' iti| ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) iti
tatpuruṣasamāse'ntodātatvam|
ṭhantodātājjātapratiṣedhaḥ' iti| antodātādbahuvrīherṅīṣo
vidhāne jātaśabdāntāt pratiṣedhaḥ, sa cāntagrahaṇādeva labhyata iti na
vaktavyam| ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyameva, vinā'pi tena yathā
ṭhvarṇaādanudātāt' (4.1.39) ityatrānudātāntāditi vijñāyate,
tathehāpyantodātantāditi vijñāsyate ? tadevamarthaṃ kriyate---
antodāta eva yo nityaṃ bahuvrīhistato yathā syāt, vikalpena
yo'ntodātastato mā bhūditi| iha ca dantājātā, stanajātetyatra
ṭhvā jāte' (6.2.171) iti vikalpenāntotatvam, ato'yaṃ vidhirna
bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- utarasūtre vāgrahaṇamubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣaḥ,
vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca, tena jātaśabdāntānna bhaviṣyati| asmiṃstu
vyākhyāne'ntagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthameveti veditavyam|
ṭhpāṇigṛhītyādīnāmarthaviśeṣe'iti| ṭhsiddhaye' iti śeṣaḥ|
pāṇigṛhītītyādīnāṃ siddhyarthaṃ viśeṣa eva ṅībbhavati, na sarvatra|
etadapi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā labhyate| viśeṣastu pāṇigrahaṇasya
veditavyaḥ| āgnisākṣipūrvakaṃ bhāryārthaṃ yasyā pāṇigrahaṇaṃ kriyate
sā pāṇigṛhītīti bhavati| ṭhyathākathañcit' iti| yathoktāt
prakārādanyena kenāpi prakāreṇetyarthaḥ|
ṭhabahunañ' ityādi| bahvādipūrvānṅīṣ na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tasyaiva vāgrahaṇasya
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya kartavyam| ṭhjātikālasukhādi' ityādi|
ṭhbahukṛte' ityatra ṭhbahornañvadutarapadabhūmni' (6.2.175)
ityantodātatvam| ṭhakṛtā, sakṛtā' ityatra ṭhnañsubhyām' (6.2.1732)
iti| ṭhmāsajātaḥ' ityādiṣu ṭhjātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt ktaḥ'
(6.2.170) iti||

53. asvāṅgapūrvapadādvā| (4.1.53)
ṭhasvāṅgapūrvapadāt' iti| na svāṅgam u asvāṅgam, tat

sūtreṇaivānenāvasya bahuvrīhitvādbhaviṣyati ṅīṣ, kimarthaṃ
