54. svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopadhāt| (4.1.54) 
ṭhcandramukhī' iti| candra iva mukhamasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra ca
ṭhprathamānirdiṣṭam' (1.2.43) ityādinā mukhaśabdasyopasarjanasaṃjñā|
ṭhatikeśī' iti| ṭhkugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| ṭheka vibhakti ca'
(1.2.44) iti keśabdasyopasarjanatvam|
ṭhaṅga' iti| aṅgādibhya upasarjanebhyo ṅīṣ bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimartham ? saṃyogopadhatvānṅīṣ na
prāpnoti, tadarthametadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| tadidaṃ vyākhyānam--
utarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāṅgādibhyaḥ
saṃyogopadhebhyo ṅībbhavatīti| 
ṭhadravam' iti| mukhanāsikābhyāṃ yo'bhiniṣkrāmati vāyuḥ sa prāṇaḥ,
prāṇo'syāstīti, prāṇī, tatra yatiṣṭhati tatprāṇistham; mukhādi
svāṅgamucyate| yadyevam, kapho'pi svāṅgaṃ syāt, tataśca
bahukaphetyatra ṅīṣ prasajyeta ? ityata āha-- ṭhadravam' iti|
viśeṣaṇopādānānna bhavatyayaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, kaphasya dravātmakatvāt|
evamapi jñānaṃ svāṅgaṃ bhavet, prāṇisthatvādadravatvācca, tataśca
bahujñānetyatrāpi ṅīṣ syāt ? ityata āha-- ṭhmūrtimat' iti|
asarvagatāni yāni dravyāṇi teṣāṃ parimāṇaṃ hrasvādimadyat
tanmūrtiḥ, sā yasyāsti tanmūrtimat| na ca
tadÂjñāne'stīti;nirguṇatvāt| guṇānāṃ ca
jñānasyātmaguṇatvānnāsya svāṅgatvaprasaṅgaḥ| yeṣāmapi
kāṭhinyādisparśaviśeṣo mūrtiḥ, tanmatenāpi naiva jñāṃ
mūrtimadbhavati, na hi jñānasya sparśo'sti| evamapi śophasya
śvayathusaṃjñakasya svāṅgatvaṃ prāpnotyeva;
yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvāt| tataśca bahuśophetyatra ṅīṣ
prasajyetetyata āha-- ṭhavikārajam' iti| vikāraḥ u dhātuvaiṣamyam,
bhūtaprakṣoma ityarthaḥ, tato jātaṃ vikārajam| na vikārajam u
avikārajam| tadevaṃ viśeṣamopādānasāmarthyāt| śophasyāpi
svāṅgatvaṃ na prāpnoti| yadi prāṇisthaṃ svāṅgaṃ bhavati, evaṃ tarhi
rathyādipatitānāṃ keśānāṃ svāṅgatvaṃ na syāt, tataśca dīrghakeśī
rathyeti na sidhyatītyata āha-- ṭhatatstham' ityādi| tasmin prāṇini
tiṣṭhatīti tatstham, na tatstham atatstham u aṇistham| evamapi
keśādi svāṅgaṃ bhavati yadi tatprāṇini pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati|
pratimāvayavānāṃ tarhi mukhādīnāṃ svāṅgatā na syāt,
aprāṇisthatvāt, tataśca dīrghamukhī pratimeti ṅīṣ na syāt? ityata
āha-- ṭhtasya cetatathā' iti| tasya prāṇinastat svāṅgaṃ yathā yutaṃ
yena prakāreṇa saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa sambaddhaṃ tathā tena
prakāreṇāprāṇino'pi yadi sambaddhaṃ bhavatyevamapi tasya svāṅgatvaṃ
bhavati| atha vā-- tasya cedaṃ prāṇinastat svāṅgaṃ tathā yadi yutaṃ
sambhavati yathā prāṇinaḥ, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati|
anyeṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ- ṭhtena cetatathā yutam' iti| tena prāṇinā yena
prakāreṇa saṃsthānaviśeṣādinā sambaddhaṃ tathā yadyaprāṇināpi sambaddhaṃ
bhavati, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati| atha vā--tenāprāṇinā tanmukhādi
yadi tathā yutam u sambaddhaṃ bhavati yathā prāṇinā, evamapi svāṅgaṃ
bhavati| atha vā tena cenmuravādīnāṃ svāṅgena tadaprāṇisthaṃ dravyaṃ
tathā yadi yutaṃ bhavati yathā prāṇidravyam, evamapi svāṅgaṃ
bhavatīti| sarvathāyayamarthaḥ-- yādṛśaṃ prāṇino mukhādi svāṅgaṃ
tādṛśameva yadyaprāṇino'pi bhavati svāṅgamevameva bhavatīti||

55. nāsikodarauṣṭhajaṅghādantakarṇaśṛṅgācca| (4.1.55)
ṭhbahvajlakṣaṇe' ityādi| nāsikodarayoḥ| ṭhna kroḍādibahvacaḥ' (4.1.56)
iti bahvajlakṣaṇe pratiṣedhe prāpte vacanam| śeṣāṇām
ṭhasaṃyogopadhāt' (4.1.54) iti saṃyogopalakṣaṇe|
ṭhsahanañvidyamānapūrvalakṣaṇanastu pratiṣedho bhavatyeva' iti|
nāsikodarayostāvadayaṃ yogaḥ ṭhpurastādapavādā anantarān
vidhīn bādhante, notarān' (vyā.pa.9) ityanantarameva bahvajlakṣaṇaṃ
pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, na sahādilakṣaṇam| oṣṭhādiṣvapi ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ
pūrvān vidhīn bādhante' (vyā.pa.10) iti pūrvameva
saṃyogopadhalakṣaṇam, tenāsau bhavatyevama-- sahanāsikā, anāsikā,
vidyamānanāsiketi| ṭhbimboṣṭhī' iti| bimbamivoṣṭhau yasyāḥ sā
bimboṣṭhī-- ṭhotvaṣṭhayoḥ samāse vā pararūpaṃ vaktavyam' (vā.687)
ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṃ pararūpatvam| ye tu bimbauṣṭītyaukāraṃ paṭhanti
te ṭhvṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhiṃ kurvanti|
ṭhpucchācceti vaktavyam' iti| pucchāntācca prātipadikānṅīṣ
bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| kimartham ? saṃyogopadhādapi
pucchāntādyathā syāt| vyākhyānaṃ tu
cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya kartavyam| ṭhkalyāṇapucchī' iti|
kalyāṇaṃ puccchamasyāḥ|
ṭhkabara' ityādi| kabarādibhyo yaḥ puccchaśabdastadantānṅīṣ
bhavatīti| eṣo'pi tata eva cakārādvāgrahaṇasya vā
vyavasthitavibhāṣātvallabhyate| kabaraṃ pucche yasyāḥ sā kabarapucchī|
evaṃ ṭhmaṇipucchī, viṣapucchī, śarapucchī' iti| ṭhsaptamīviśeṣaṇe
bahuvrīhau' (2.2.35) iti puccchasya pūrvanipāto na bhavati; ṭhsaptamyāḥ
pūrvanipāte gaḍvādibhyaḥ paravacanam' (vā. 115) iti vacanāt| 
ṭhupamānāt pakṣāt pucchācca' iti| nityamiti sambadhyate| etadapi
pūrvoktāt kāraṇadvayāllabhyate| ṭhpucchācceti vaktavyam' (vā.364)
ityanenaiva siddhe punariha puccchagrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham,nityārthaṃ vā|
ulūkasyeva pucchṃa yasyāḥ sā ṭhulūkapucchī' ||

56. na kroḍādibahvacaḥ| (4.1.56) 
ṭhkalyāṇakrīḍā' iti| kroḍāśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ|
ṭhkroḍāghāṭājihvāśirodharāsaṅgakulāspṛhāmāyā' iti
liṅgakārikāyāṃ pāṭhāt| kalyāṇī kroḍā'syā iti vigrahaḥ|
ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat' (6.3.34) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| utarapadasya
ṭhgostriyoḥ' (1.2.48) ityādinā hrasvaḥ| tataḥ
ṭhsvāṅgāccopasarjanāt' (4.1.54) ityādinā prāptasya ṅīpo'nena
pratiṣedhaḥ tataṣṭāp| ṭhmahālalāṭā'iti| ṭhāmanmahat' (6.346)
ityādinātvam||

57. sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca| (4.1.57)
ṭhsakeśā' iti| saha keśairvartata iti| ṭhtena saheti tulyoge'
(2.2.28) iti samāsaḥ| ṭhvopasarjanasya' (6.3.82) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ|
ṭhakeśā'iti| avidyamānāḥ keśā asyeti, ṭhnaño'styarthānāṃ
bahuvrīhirutarapadalopaśca' (vā.102) iti vidyamānaśabdalopaḥ| atha
pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kim, sahanañvidyamānādityevocyeta, etayā hi
pañcamyā svāṅge viśeṣyamāṇe sahādipūrvatā labhyata eva ?
naitadevam; pañcamī hi paratvena svāṅgaṃ viśeṣayet-- sahādibhyaḥ
paraṃ yat svāṅgamiti| tataśca sahādibhyaḥ pareṇa
svāṅgenānyasyāpi kalyāṇaṃ vidyamānamukhamasyā iti vigrahaḥ| atha vā--
vidyamānaṃ mukhaṃ yasya sa vidyamānamukhaḥ, kalyāṇo vidyamānamukho yasyā
iti vigrahaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇe sati pūrvaśabdasyāvayavavācitvāt
sahādipūrvatvena prātipadikaṃ viśeṣyata iti sahādyavayavaṃ yat
svāṅgāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ tasmāditi vijñāyamāne nātra pratiṣedho
bhavati, na hyaetat sahādyavayavameva| kiṃ tarhi ? kalyāṇaśabdāvayavamiti
na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ||

58. nakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām| (4.1.58)

ceyaṃ saṃjñā| tathā hi-- ṭhpūrvapadāt' (8.4.3) ityādinā ṇatvaṃ na

59. dīrghajihvī ca ccchandasi| (4.1.59)
atha kimarthamīkārāntanipātanaṃ kriyate, na ṭhdīrghajihvā ccchandasi'

vijñāyeteti cet ? na; saṃyogopadhatvena prāptyabhāvāt,
prāptipūrvakatvācca pratiṣedhānām| tasmāt sāmarthyādvidhireva

60. dikpūrvapadānṅīp| (4.1.60)

etenaitat sūcayati-- ṭhsvāṅgāccoparsjanāsaṃyogopadhāt'

62. sakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām| (4.1.62)
ṭhsakhī' iti| sakhiśabdānṅīp| nāsyāḥ śiśurastīti vākyaśeṣeṇa
bahuvrīhiṃ darśayannaśiśuśabdo yo bahuvrīhistasyāśiśvīti
nipātyate| na tu tatpuruṣo yastasyeti darśayati| tatpuruṣe hi na
śiśuraśiśurityevaṃ bhavati| ṭhsakhā' iti| ṭhanaṅ sau' (7.1.93)
ityanaṅadeśaḥ, ṭhnopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) ṭhsarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti
dīrghaḥ| ṭhsakhyaśiśubhyām' ityevaṃ vaktavye yannipātanaṃ kriyate,
tasyaitat prayojanam-- tulyaśruteḥ śabdāntarasyāpi yathā syāt,
saha khena yā vartate sā sakhīti||

63. jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt| (4.1.63)
jāseḥ prātipadikāditi sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapaterjātivāci yat
prātipadikaṃ tadihābhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā
jātiśabdenoktam, ata eva vṛtāvāha-- ṭhjātivāci yat
prātipadikam' iti| ṭhastrīviṣayāt' iti| ananyatrābhāve'pi
viṣayaśabdo vartate, ata eva vṛtāvāha-- ṭhna cet striyāmeva
niyatam' iti| na striyāmeva yasya bhāvaḥ, kintu striyāṃ cānyatra ca
tadastrīviṣayam|
jātirityucyate, keyaṃ jātirnāmeti
praśnasyotaramāha--ṭhākṛtigrahaṇā' ityādi| ākriyate
vyajyate'nayetyākṛtiḥ u saṃsthānamucyate| tathā hi-- durākṛtiḥ
duḥsaṃsthānamucyate, svākṛtiśca susaṃsthānam| gṛhyate'nenetita
grahaṇam, karaṇe lyuṭ| ākṛtirgrahaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā''kṛtikagrahaṇā,
saṃsthānavyaṅgyeti yāvat| nanu
cākṛtiśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyādÂgrahaṇaśabdasya striyāṃ vṛtiriti
ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tadantena samāse kṛte
ṭhnadyaﬁtaśca' (5.4.153) iti kap, tataścākṛtigrahaṇīketi prāpnoti ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; grahaṇaśabdo hi pūrva karaṇasāmānye vyutpāditaḥ,
paścādviśeṣeṇābhisambadhyate| tatra padāntarasannidhāne yastasya
liṅgaviśeṣasambandhaḥ, sa ca bahiraṅga iti
sāmānyaliṅgenaivāntaraṅgeṇa vākyaṃ kṛtvā samāsaḥ kriyate,
yathā-- ṭhmukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ' (1.1.8) ityatra| tadanena
lakṣaṇena sāmānyarūpā gotvādilakṣaṇā jātirityuktaṃ bhavati|
gotvādayo hi viṣāṇādimatsaṃsthānavyaṅgyatvādākṛtigrahaṇāḥ|
etena lakṣaṇena brāhṇatvādayo jātiviśeṣā na saṃgṛhītāḥ| na hi te
saṃsthānavyaṅgyāḥ; tadāśrayasya saṃsthānasyābhinnatvāt| yādṛśaṃ hi
saṃsthānaṃ brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyādeḥ saṃsthānamapi tādṛśamevetyato
dvitīyaṃ lakṣaṇamāha-- ṭhliṅgānāñca' ityādi| yāpi sarvāṇi
liṅgāni na bhajati sāpyasaṃsthānavyaṅgyāpi jātiḥ, yathā--
brāhmaṇatvādiḥ| sā hi strīliṅgaṃ puṃliṅgaṃ ca bhajati-- brāhmaṇaeḥ,
brāhmaṇīti, na tu napuṃsakaliṅgamityasarvaliṅgabhāgbhavati|
brāhmaṇatvādiṣvapyudeśābhivyaṅgyatā'śrayaṇīyā, anyathā devadataḥ,
devadateti liṅgadvayaṃ bhajati, atrāpi jātitvaṃ syāt. na cāyaṃ
jātiśabda iṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃjñāśabdaḥ| vidhyarthañcedam | ataḥ
sarvaliṅgabhājo'pi pūrveṇa lakṣaṇena jātitvamasti,
yathā--taṭaḥ,taṭī, taṭamiti| sarvaliṅgaṃ bhajata iti sarvaliṅgabhāk,
karmaṇyupapade ṭhbhajo ṇviḥ'(3.2.62) iti ṇviḥ| nanu ca
liṅgāpekṣayā sarvaśabda upapade bhajo ṇvipratyayo na prāpnoti,
upapadāśrayatvā, upapadasamāsaśca asamarthatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva
hi devadatasya gurukulamityatrāsāmarthye'pi samāso bhavati,
gamakatvāt; tathaivamubhayamapi bhaviṣyatīti|
sā ca jātiḥ-- ṭhsakṛdākhyātanirgrāhyā' iti| sakṛt u ekavāram,
ākhyātā u upadiṣṭā, nirgrāhyā u niścayena grāhyā| etena
jātidharmānekatvanityatvapratyekaparisamāptitvalakṣaṇān darśayati|
sakṛdevāraṃ yasmāt kṛṣṇe dhavale vā gopiṇḍa ākhyātā
tadvilakṣaṇe'pi gopiṇḍe nirgrāhyā, tasmādeva nityā pratyekaṃ
parisamāptā ca| yadi hyaekā na syāt, sakṛdākhyātā gauriti
piṇḍāntare na gṛhyaeta| yadi ca nityā na bhavet, piṇḍavināśe tasyā

satyakārasya| nanu ca ṭhanantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' (vyā.pa.63) iti
rephasyaiva bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vṛddheryā'ntaramā prakṛtistatra
ṣaṣṭhī, yatra ṣaṣṭhī tatrādeśa ityakāraḥ sthānī jñāyate|
putraśabdamatra kecit paṭhanti, na sa kevalaḥ stiyāṃ vartata ityayaṃ

76. taddhitāḥ| (4.1.76)
ṭhyuvatiḥ' iti| taddhitasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṭhkṛtaddhita' (1.2.46) ityādinā
prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavati| atha ṭhtaddhitāḥ' iti na sambhavati
bahuvacananirdeaśaḥ, yathaiva hi ṭhpratyayaḥ' (3.1.1) ityekavacananirdeaśe'pi
vakṣyamāṇānāṃ bahūnāmapi sannādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ sā saṃjñā bhaviṣyati,
tathā'trāpyekavacanenaiva nirdeaśaḥ kartavyaḥ ? ityata āha--
ṭhbahuvacanam' ityādi| ekavacana eva kartavye yadbahuvacanaṃ kriyate
tasyaitatprayojanam--anuktā ye taddhitā
lakṣaṇavākyairanabhihitāsteṣāmapi parigraho yathā syāt| tataḥ
ṭhpṛthivyā ñāñau' (vā.376) ityādi na kartavyaṃ bhavati|
bahuvacananenaivānuktataddhitaparigrahārthena teṣāṃ siddhatve mahatyāḥ
saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇa etat prayojanam, anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta--
tebhyo hitāstaddhitāḥ| tadityanena laukikā vaidikāśca śabdāḥ
pratyavamṛśyante; teṣāṃ vyutpādyatvena prakṛtatvāt tena tatraiva
bhavantyaṇādayo yatra ca bhavantasteṣāmupakāriṇo bhavanti, nānyatreti|
tenābhidhānalakṣaṇatvaṃ taddhitānāmupapannaṃ bhavati| atha taddhitādhikāraḥ
strīpratyayānāmādita eva kasmānna kriyate ? kimeva sati bhavati ?
taddhitānāmupapannaṃ taddhitānantatvāt prātipadikamiti
ṭhṅyāpprātipada#kāt' (4.1.1) ityitra ṅyābgrahamaṃ na kartavyaṃ
bhavati, ṭhprācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ' (4.1.17) ityatra ca taddhitagrahaṇam, ṭhyasyeti
ca' (6.4.148) itīkāragrahaṇañca;taddhita ityevaṃ siddhatvāt ? aśakyamevaṃ
kartum; evaṃ hi kriyamāṇe tatra ṅyābgrahaṇasya yat pūrvaṃ
prayojanamuktaṃ tanna syāt; ṅībṅīṣṅīnāñca ṅkārasyetsaṃjñā
ṭhataddhite' (1.3.8) iti pratiṣedhāt| iha ca paṭvīti ṭhorguṇaḥ'
(6.4.146) iti guṇaḥ syāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu||

79. gotrāvayavāt| (4.1.79)
gotrañca tadavayavañceti gotrāvayavaḥ| iha tvabhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ
kṛtvā tadabhidhāyiprātipadikaṃ gotrāvayava śabdenoktam| nanu caivaṃ
vigrahe viśeṣaṇatvādavayavaśabdasya nīlotpala iva nīlaśabdasya
pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| rājadantāderākṛtigaṇatvādviśeṣaṇasya
paranipāto bhaviṣyati| gotraṃ punariha laukikaṃ gṛhyate, na
pāribhāṣikam| loke ca pradhānabhūta ādipuruṣaḥ
svaprabhavasyāpatyasantānasya saṃjñākārī gotramucyate| tathā hi bharato
nāma kaścidādyaḥ pradhānaḥ puruṣo'bhūt, tena sarva eva tatpūrvakāḥ
putrapautrādayo bharatā iti vyapadiśyante|
avayavaśabdo'yamastyevaikadeśe, tatsambandhādavayavīti samudāya
ucyate| asti ca pṛthagbhāve--avayutiḥ u avayavaḥ, pṛthagbhūta ityarthaḥ|
yadyapi yautirmiśraṇe paṭhaḷte, tathāpyanekārthatvāddhādūnāmavapūrvaḥ
pṛtaghbhāvamācaṣṭe| astyapradhāne, yathā-- kulāvayavo'yam,
saṅghāvayavo'yamiti| kulasay saṅghasya cāpradhānabhūto'yamiti
gamyate| tatra yadeyakadeśavācī gṛhyate tadupādānamanarthakaṃ syāt,
gotrādityeva vaktavyam| gotrādavayavo'pi hi gotraṃ bhavati, yathā--
kṣīrāvayavaḥ kṣīramiti| athāpi pṛthagbhāve gotrādanyatra vartamāno
gṛhyate, evamapi puṇikādibhyo vihitayoraṇiño vihitau;
aniṣṭañcaitat; tasyaikadeśavācini pṛthagbhāvavācini vākyaśabde
doṣa ityatrāpradhānavācyeva gṛhyate| ṭhgotrāvayavāḥ' iti|
puṇikādiśrutīnāmetadviśeṣaṇam| apradhānagotrābhidhāyinya ityarthaḥ|
ṭhgotrabhamatāḥ' iti| gotramityevamabhimatā gotrābhivāyinya ityevaṃ
loke prasiddhāḥ| na punargotrādhyāye paṭhitā ityarthaḥ| ata eva
tāsāmapradhānyam; gotrādhyāye'paṭhitatvāt| ṭhkulākhyāḥ' iti|
kulam u gotram, ākhyāyata ābhirityākhyāḥ, gotreṇetyevamādi|
ṭhtataḥ' iti| yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭābhyaḥ puṇikādiśrutibhyaḥ| yadi
tarhi tato gotravihitayoraṇiñoḥ ṣyaṅ bhavatyevaṃ
satyapārthako'yaṃ yogaḥ, pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt ? ityata āha--
ṭhagurupotamartha ārambhaḥ'iti| ṭhpauṇikyā' ityādi|
puṇikabhuṇikamukharaśabdebhyaḥ ṭhata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñantasya
ṣyaṅścāp||

82. samarthānāṃ prathamādvā| (4.1.82)

viśeṣavihitaḥ| sāmānyavihitaśca viśeṣavihitena bādhyate ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ayaṃ yogastayoryogayoranuvartiṣyate; tatrāpyapatye'rthe
kuruśabdo'navakāśa ityañapi tato bhaviṣyati| apatyārthasya
ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ vā kaurava iti bhaviṣyati|
ṭhgrīṣmādaccchandasīti vaktavyam' (iti)| grīṣmaśabdādaccchandasyabhideye'ñ
bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamityāha-- ṭhiha mā
bhūt' ityādi| cchandasi triṣṭuavādau vācye sandhivelādisūtreṇa
(4.3.16) ṛtvaṇeva yathā syāt, añmā bhūdityevamartham| tena graiṣmī
triṣṭuavityañ na bhavati| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- veti vartate, sā ca
vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena grīṣmaśabdāccchandasi vācye'ñ na bhavatīti|
ṭhvṛtaṃ gṛhyate' iti| yasya triṣṭuajjagatītyādayo viśeṣāstadiha
vṛtam; ataścchando gṛhyate, na vedaḥ||

87. strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt| (4.1.87)
ṭhatra tāvat strīśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇam, na ṭābādistrīpratyayantasya
śabdasya| tato hi ṭhstrībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) iti ḍhakaṃ vakṣati,
tatsāhacaryāt puṃśabdo'pi taddharmaiva vijñāyate| tasyāpi
svarūpagrahaṇeva| ṭhpausnam' iti| ṭhsaṃyogānatasya lopaḥ' (8.2.23) iti
lopaḥ|
yadi prāgbhavanasaṃśabdanāt strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsanañau bhavataḥ,
vatyarthe'pi tau syātām, tataśca strīvat, puṃvaditi na
sidhyedityāha- ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat' ityādi| yadayam ṭhstriyāṃ puṃvat'
(6.3.34) iti nirdeaśaṃ karoti tato jñāyate-- vatyarthe nañsnañau na
bhavataḥ| nanu caitasmānnirdeaśāt snañpratyayo vatyarthe na bhavatīti
śakyaṃ vijñātum, na tu nañpratyayo na bhavatīti, tataśca strīvaditi
na sidhyati ? ityata āha-- ṭhyogāpekṣañca' ityādi| ṭhpuṃvat' iti
nirdeaśādayaṃ yogo vatyarthe na pravartate-- ityavamarthamidaṃ
yogāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam, na tu snañpratyayāpekṣam| tena
strīvadityetadapi sidhyati||

88. dvigorluganapatye| (4.1.88) 
ṭhprāgdīvyataḥ' iti| tasya svaritatvāt| ṭhna bhavanāt'iti|
viparyayāt| dvigoriti pañcamī ceyaṃ syāt ? ṣaṣṭhī vā ? tatra yadi
pañcamī, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt-- dvigoḥ parasyānapratyapratyayasya
prāgdīyavyatīyasya lugbhavatīti| tataśca yathā dvigusaṃjñānimitasya
lugbhavati-- pañcakapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ puroḍāśaḥ pañcakapāla iti,
tathā yo dviragornimitaṃ na bhavati tasyāpi syāt-- pañcakapālasya
puroḍāśasyedaṃ khaṇḍam| ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇ--
pāñcakapālamiti| tamimaṃ pañcamīpakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā,
ṣaṣṭīpakṣamāśrityāha-- dvigoriti ṣaṣṭhī' iti| ṭhdvigoryaḥ sambandhī'
iti| yasya taddhitasyārthe ṭhtaddhitārthotarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti
samāhāradvigurvidhīyate sa dvigoḥ sambandhīti; arthadvāreṇa tadarthasya
dvigusambandhitvāt| so'pi taddvāreṇa dvigusambandhī|
ṭhnimitatvena'iti| anena nimitanaimitikabhāvena yaḥ sambandho tasya
lugbhavati, na tu paurvāparyabhāvena yastasyeti darśayati| etacca
nimitanaimitikabhāvasyāntaraṅgatvāllabhyate| sa hi
dvigorādyastaddhitena sambandhaḥ; tasmāt sa gṛhyate|
paurvāparyabhāvastūtarakālamapi bhavatīti bahiraṅgo bhavati, ato
na tasya grahaṇam| ṭhpañcakapālaḥ' iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛta iti
ṭhtaddhitārtha' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ, ṭhsaṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti
dvigusaṃjñā, ṭhsaṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityaṇ, tasya luk| ṭhdvivedaḥ'iti|
dvau vedāvadhīta iti pūrvavatsamāsaḥ, ṭhtadadhīte tadveda' (4.1.59)
ityaṇ|
ṭhdvaidevavatiḥ' iti| dvayordeavadatayorapatyamiti ṭhata iñ' (4.1.95)|
ṭhpañcakapālasyedamiti pāñcakapālam' iti| atra saṃskṛtārthe yaḥ prathamaḥ
pratyaya utpannaḥ sa eva dvigornimitam, na tu ya utarakālaṃ
tasyedamityarthavivakṣāyām| na hi tasyārthe viṣayabhūte
dvigurvihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃskṛtārthe yo vihitastasya|
tenādvigunimitatvāt ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.1120) iti yo
vihitastasyeha lugna bhavati| ṭhatha vā' ityādi| pūrvaṃ hi
dvigoryastaddhito nimitaṃ tasya lugvihitaḥ, idānīṃ dvigoreva
vidhīyata ityasti viśeṣaḥ| kathaṃ punardvigoreva lugbhavati ? ityata
āha-- ṭhdvigoriti sthānaṣaṣṭhī' iti|
ṭhnanu ca' ityādinānantarokaktavyākhyānaṃ vighaṭayati| ṭhpratyayasya
lukślulupaḥ' (1.1.61) itilugādikāḥ pratyayādarśanasyaitāḥ saṃjñā
vihitāḥ, tato lugucyamāno'nena na śakto dvigoreva lukaṃ
vidhātumityābhiprāyaḥ| ṭhsatyametat' iti| yadanantaramuktam|
yadyevam, kathaṃ luksaṃjñāyā dvigorluglabhyate ? ityata āha--
ṭhupācāreṇa tu' ityādi| atathābhūte vastuni
yo'dhyāropitatathābhāvo jñānaviśeṣaḥ sa upacāraḥ| lakṣyate'nayeti
lakṣaṇā, sāpunarihopacāra eva ṭhetena hyadvigurūpastaddhito
dvigurūpatayā lakṣyate| yathā mañcāḥ krośantītyatrāmañcarūpā api
puruṣā mañcarūpatayā lakṣyante, tathehāpyadvigurūpastaddhito
dvigurūpatayā| upacārasya tu nibandhanaṃ dvigunimitabhūtatvam,
yadāha--- ṭh dvigunimitabhūtaḥ pratyaya eva dviguḥ' iti| bhavati hi
kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ, yathā-- āyurghṛtamiti| ṭhdvigunimitako'pi
tarhi' ityādi| dvigurnimitaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| yo dharma upacārasya
nibandhanaṃ sa iha guṇaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| guṇanimitā kalpanā u
guṇanimitakalpanā, sā punarupacārātmikaiva veditavyā|
yadyaupacāreṇa dvigornimitaṃ pratyayo'pi dvigurucyate, dviguryasya
nimitaṃ so'pa# giuṇyā kalpanayā kasmāddviguriti nocyate ?
kārye'pi hi kāraṇaśabda upacārāt prayujyamāno vidyata eva, yathā--
purātanaṃ sarvamidaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karma bhujyata iti| ṭhpāñcakapālam'
iti| pañcakapālasya puroḍāśasyedaṃ khaṇḍamityaṇ, sa ca
dvigorutpannatvāddvigunimitaka ityabhiprāyaḥ| na tasya dvigutvaṃ
nimitamiti niṣpannatvāddvagostaddhitasyotpadyamānasya na dvigutvaṃ
nimitaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikam| tathā hi-- nāsau dvigurityevaṃ
vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikādityevam| tasmāt sannihitā'pi
dvigutā na pratyayasya nimitamiti, na ca pratyayo dvigurityupacāreṇa
vyapadeṣṭuṃa śakyata iti| ṭhitarastu' iti| taddhitapratyayaḥ, yas
mūlodāharaṇe lugdarśitaḥ| ṭhdvigutvasyaiva nimitam' iti| evakāreṇa
prātipadikasya vyavacchedaḥ kriyate-- dvigutvasyaiva nimitam, na tu
prātipadikatvasya; yatastadarthe dvigusamāso vidhīyate,na tu
prātipadikatvamityasti viśeṣaḥ| tataśca dvigoryo nimitaṃ tatraiva
dvigutvavyapadeśa upācārādbhavati| na tu niṣpannāddvigorya
utpadyate tatrāpi|
ṭhyadyevam'ityādi| yadi dvigoryo nimitaṃ taddhitaḥ so'tra
nimitatvādupācāreṇa dvigurucyate tasya lopo bhathavi| evaṃ satīha
kathaṃ lopaḥ-- pañcakapālyāṃ saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapāla iti ? atra hi
pañcānāṃ kapālānāṃ samāhāra iti samāhāre dvigau niṣpanne
tatastūtarakālaṃ taddhito vidhīyamāno na dvigornimitaṃ bhavati|
ṭhnaivātra' ityādi parihāraḥ| kasmānnotpadyata ityāha-- ṭhtraiśabdyaṃ hi'
ityādi| traya eva śabdāḥ u traiśabdyam| cāturvarṇyāditvāt svārthe
ṣyañ| ihāsmābhistraiśabdyaṃ sādhyam|
pañcakapālīśabdastaddhitotpatimantareṇāpi siddhatīti na tasmāt
taddhita utpadyate| ṭhpañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ' ityādinā traiśabdyaṃ
darśayati| ṭhdvayoḥ śabdayoḥ' ityādi| yaśca samāhāre
pañcakapālīśabdaḥ, yaśca taddhitārthaviṣaye samāse pañcakapālaśabdastau
dvāvapi samānārthau,tayorekena pūrveṇa vigraha eveti tasmānna
taddhitotpatirvijñeyā| ṭhaparasmādutpatiḥ' iti| pañcakapālaśabdāt|
avyavikanyāyena| yathā'vermāṃsamāvikamityaviśabdena
vigrahaḥ,aviśabdastu pratyayamutpādayati tadvadihāpi|
ṭhatheha kasmānna bhavati' ityādi| rūpyamayaṭāvapi hi
dvigornimitabhūtau, atastayorapi lukā bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ|
ṭhvetyanuvartate' iti ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā'(4.1.82) ityataḥ|
nanvevamapi sarvatra vikalpena luk prāpnotītyata āha-- ṭhsā ca'
ityādi| ca śabdo hetau| yasmāt sā vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate,
tena pañcakapāla ityādau nityaṃ lugbhavati| pañcagargarūpyamityādau na
bhavatyeva||

89. gotre'lugaci| (4.1.89)
ṭhaci' iti| yadyeṣā parasaptamī syāccchavidhāvitaretarāśrayatā prasajyeta|
katham ? gargasyāpatyāni bahuni ṭhgargādibhyo yañ' (4.1.105), tasya
yadi luk syācchāe na syāt| lupte'pi tasmin ṭhpratyayalope
pratyayalakṣaṇam' (1.1.62) iti cet ? ṭhna lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti
pratyayalopapratiṣedhādÂvṛddhyabhāvena vṛddhasaṃjñā na syāt, tataśca
vṛddhalakṣaṇacchāe na syāt| tasmādÂvṛddhatvaṃ prātipadikasya
vāñcchato'luk pūrva syāt| sa cāluka che parato yadi bhavati
tataścālugvinimitaścchaḥ,
tannimitaścālugitivyaktamitaretarāśrayatvam| tadimaṃ parasaptamyāṃ
doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣayasaptamīyamiti darśayannāha--ṭhajādau
prāgdīvyatīye viṣayabhūte' iti| viṣayabhūte u anutpanna eva buddhistha
ityarthaḥ| ṭhgārgīyāḥ' iti| gargasyāpatyāni bahūni| gargāditvādyañ
(4.1.105) | tasya gargāṇāñchātrā ityarthavivakṣāyāmajādāvanutpanne
buddhyabhimukhīkṛte viṣayabhūte ṭhyañiñośca' (4.1.101) itiyo luk
prāpnoti tasyānena pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, tataścādivṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ
tannibandhanāyāṃ ca vṛddhasaṃjñāyām ṭhvṛddhāccchaḥ' (4.1.114) iti ccchaḥ,
īyādeśaḥ, ṭhyasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ, ṭhāpatyasya ca
taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) ita yakārasya| ṭhvāstīyāḥ' iti| pūrveṇa
tulyam| ṭhātreyīyāḥ' iti| attrerapatyāni bahūni| ṭhitaścāniñaḥ'
(4.1.122) iti ḍhak, tasya ṭhatribhṛgukutsa' (2.4.65) ityādinā luki
prāpte'trīṇāṃ chātrā iti cche viṣayabhūte tasya pratiṣedhaḥ|
ṭhkhārapāyaṇīyāḥ' iti| kharapasyāpatyāni bahūni| ṭhnaḍādibhyaḥ phak'
(4.1.99), ṭhyaskādibhyo gotre' (2.4.63)iti tasya prāptasya lukaḥ
kharapāṇāṃ chātrā iti cche viṣayabhūte pratiṣedhaḥ|
ṭhkaubalam, vādaram' iti| kubalīvadarīśabdau gaurādiṅīṣantau
pratyayasvareṇāntodātau, tayoḥ śeṣamanudātam| tena kubalyā
vikāraḥ phalam, vadaryā vikāraḥ phalamityarthavivakṣāyām|
ṭhanudātāderañ' (4.2.44) tasya ṭhphale luk' (4.3.163) iti tayorlug
yaḥ prāpnoti tasya kubalasyedaṃ vadarasyedamityarthavivakṣāyāmajādau
che viṣayabhūte pratiṣedho na bhavati; gotragrahaṇāt| gotre yaḥ
pratyayo vācakatvena vartate tasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| na
cāyamañ gotre vācakatvena vartate, api tu vikāre, tena tasya
lugbhavatyeva| tasmin sati ṭhluktaddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti
strīpratyayasyāpi luk| añi lupte vṛddhyabhāvādÂvṛddhatvaṃ
nāstītyaṇeva bhavati, na tu ccchaḥ| ṭhgargarūpyam, gargamayam' iti|
pūrvavadrūpamayaṭau| yadyatrāluk syādgārgyarūpyaṃ gārgyamayamiti
syāt| ṭhgārgīyam' iti| ṭhtasmai hitam' (5.1.5) iti ṭhprākkrītāccchaḥ'
(5.1.1) iti ccchaḥ, sa ca prāgdīvyatīyo na bhavati; dīvyataḥ pareṇa
vidhānāt| ṭhgotrasya' iti| gotrapratyayasya | ṭhbahuṣu lopinaḥ' iti|
bahuṣvartheṣūtpannasya yasya lopo vidhīyate sa bahuṣu lopī|
ṭhbahuvacanāntasya pravṛtau' iti| pravṛtiḥ u arthāntarasaṃkrāntiḥ|
etaduktaṃ bhavati-- bahuvacanāntasyārthāntarasaṃkrāntāviti| sā
cārthāntarasaṃkrāntāviti| sā cārthāntarasaṃkrāntistadantādyadā yūni
pratyaya utpadyate tadā bhavatīti veditavyam; tadā gotrāntasya yūni
pravṛteḥ| ṭhdvayekayoḥ' iti| yadā gotrapratyayāntādekasminnarthe yūni
dvayorvā yūnoḥ utpadyate tadā'rthāntarasaṃkrāntau satyāmalugbhavati|
bidasyāpatyānibahuni| ṭhanuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ña' (4.1.104)
ityañ, sa ca ṭhyañañośca' (2.4.64) iti bahuṣu lugvidhānādbahuṣu
lopī bhavati, tadantādyauvavivakṣāyāmekasmin yūni dvayorvā ṭhata
iñ' (4.195), tasya ṇyakṣatriyādisūtreṇa (2.458) luki kṛte
gotrapratyayāntasya tasyārthāntarasaṃkrāntau satyāṃ gotrapratyayasyāña
ihāpi bahuṣūtpannasya lagna bhavati| kathaṃ punarna bhavati,
yāvatā'luko viṣayābhāvāt prāgdīvyatīyo'jātiriñ pratyaya
upanītaḥ ? pratyayalakṣaṇam' (vyā.pa.96) iti ca paribhāṣā| yathā gave
hitaṃ gohitamiti caturthīsamāse subluki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena
caturthīvibhaktimāśritya gośabdasya ṭheco'yavāyāvaḥ' ityavādeśo na
bhavati; varṇāśrayatvāt| varṇāśrayatvaṃ tu tasyāci vidhānāt| yathā ca
ṭhvarṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇamṭa (vyā.pa.96) iti paribhāṣā, tathā
baidaḥ, baidau-- ityatrāpyalukā varṇāśrayatayā na bhavitavyam ?
naitadasti, na hyalugatra varṇāśrayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? taddhitāśrayaḥ| acītyetat
tviha sūtre viśeṣaṇatvenoktam| ata eva vṛtāvuktam-- ajādau
prāgdīvyatīye pratyaya iti| tasmāt tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā
ihovasthāne'sati ṭhgotre'lugaci' iti bhavatīti, anenaivātrāluk
siddhaḥ| sa ca bahuṣu yuvasu mā bhūditi
dvayekayorevetyupasaṃkhyānam| tatra bidā ityeva bhavati|
ṭhekavacanadvivacanāntasya' ityādi| ekavacanāntatasya gotrapratyayasya
dvivacanāntasya ca bahuṣvartheṣu yuvasaṃjñakeṣu pravṛtau saṃkrāntau
satyāṃ lugvaktavyaḥ| tatra baidasyetyekavacanāntaṃ gotram,
baidayoriti dvivacanāntamÂ| atra ca pūrvavadañ,
tayoryuvāpatyabahutvavivakṣāyām ṭhata iñ' (4.1.95) | tasya
ṇyakṣatriyādisūtreṇa (2.4.58) luki kṛte'ño'pi gotrapratyayasya
lugiṣyate| sa ca na prāpnoti, tasmādupasaṃkhyāyate| kiṃ punaḥ
kāraṇaṃ na prāpnoti ? ityāha-- ṭhna hyatra' ityādi| ṭhyañañośca' (2.4.64)
iti anena hi bahuṣūtpannorlugvidhīyate, na cāñ huhaṣūtpanna,kiṃ
tarhi ? ekasmin dvayośca, tasmānna prāpnotīti| tadevaṃ sarvathā
bahuṣu bidā ityevaṃ bhavitavyamiti sthitam||

90. yūni luk| (4.1.90)
ṭhyūni' iti| ṭhvyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe saptamī| ata
eva vṛtāvāha--ṭhyuvapratyayasya' iti| ajādau pratyaye vivakṣite
buddhisya ityādinā'cīti viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| yadyeṣāṃ
parasaptamī syāt, yatrāpi ccchapratyayo neṣyate tatrāpi syāt|
yuvapratyayāntasya buddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|
ṭhphāṇṭāhṛtarūpyam, phāṇṭāhṛtamayam' iti| yadyatra luk syāt,
phāṇṭāhṛtarūpyaṃ phāṇṭāhṛtamayamiti na syāt| ṭhbhāgavitikīyam' iti|
prākkrītīyaccchaḥ (5.1.1) pūÂvavat||

91. phakphiñoranyatarasyām| (4.1.91)
ṭhgārgīyāḥ, vātsīyāḥ' iti| pūrvapadakārayakāralopaḥ| ṭhvā' (4.1.82)
iti vartamāne'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ ṭhpūrvasūtre nityo vidhiḥ' iti

92. tasyāpatyam| (4.1.92)
ṭhpūrvairutaraiśca pratyayairabhisaṃbadhyate' iti| tatra pūrvaistāvadaṇādibhiḥ
sambadhyate; asaṃyuktavidhānāt| asya yadi pūrvairabhisambandho na
bhavet ṭhtasyāpatyamata iñ' ityekayogameva kuryāt| yatastu ṭhata
iñ' (4.1.95) ityanena ṭhtasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityetadasaṃyuktaṃ
karoti, tato'saṃyuktavidhānātpūrvārthametadvijñāyata ityevaṃ
tāvatpūrvairabhisambadhyate| utarairapyabhisambadhyate; teṣvasya
svaritatvāt| ṭhtasya' iti| puṃlliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ kriyate,
ekavacanena ca| tena puṃlliṅgādevotpatiḥ syāt, ekavacanāntācca|
strīliṅgānnapuṃsakācca na syāt-- devadatāyā apatyam,
kulasyāpatyamevamādau na syāt| dvivacanabahuvacanāntācca--
dvayormātrorapatyam, tisṛṇāṃ mātṛṇāmapatyevamādau na syāt| atha
napuṃsakaliṅgenāyaṃ nirdeaśaḥ ? strīliṅgāt puṃlliṅgācca na
syāt| apatyamityekavacane'tra nirdeaśaḥ kriyate, tenaikasminnevāpatye
syāt, na dvayornāpi bahuṣu-- upagorapatye āṬpagavau;
upagorapatyānyaupagavā iti| etasmin pūrvapakṣa idamāha--
ṭhprakṛtyartaviśiṣṭaḥ' ityādi| ṭhgṛhyate' iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|
prakṛtyartha upagavādiśabdānāmarthaḥ,tena viśiṣṭaḥ
ṣaṣṭhaḷrtho'patyāpatyavatsambandhaḥ| nanu ca tasyātra taccchabdasya
sāmānyavācino grahaṇam, tasya kṛta upagavādirarthaviśeṣaḥ, yena
ṣaṣṭhaḷrtho viśiṣyate ? tasyetyasya viśeṣopalakṣaṇatvādadoṣāḥ|
viśeṣopalakṣaṇatvaṃ cāsya prāgeva pratipāditam| tasmādviśeṣa
evopagvādiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ| ṭhapatyamātrañca' iti | mātraśabdo'dhikasya
liṅgādervyavacchedāya|
ṭhliṅgavacanādikam' iti| ādiśabdena kālasya grahaṇam| vartamānena
hi kālenāyaṃ nirdeaśaḥ kriyate| yathoktam-- ṭhyatrāpi
sākṣādanyakriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāpyastirbhavantīparaḥ
prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate' iti| tatra
vartamānakālavivakṣāyāṃ kālāntare na syāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
liṅgavacanādi na vivakṣyate ? tasyāpradhānyāt| avaśyaṃ hi yena
kenacilliṅgādinā nirdeaśaḥ kartavya iti, nāntarīyakatvāt|
tasyehopādānam, yathā-- dhānyārthinaḥ palālāderapradhānasyāpi|
ṭhtasyedam' ityādi| ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityetatsūtramapatyārthe'pi
vartate| yo hyupagorapatyamupagorasāvayamiti śakyate
vyapadeṣṭuam| tasyedamityasya viśeṣā hyaete-- apatyam, samūhaḥ,
nivāsaḥ, vikāra iti| tataśca ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120)
ityanenaivāpatyārthe'pyaṇ siddhaḥ, tat kimarthaṃ tasyāpatyamityetat
sūtraṃ kṛtam ? ṭhbādhanārtham kṛtaṃ bhavet' iti| ṭhtasyedam'
(4.3.120) ityanena vidhīyamānasyāṇo yo bādhakaḥ ṭhvṛddhāccchaḥ' (4.2.114)
iti ccchaḥ prāpnoti, tadbādhanārthamidaṃ kṛtam|
etatsūtravihitenāṇā cchapratyayasya bādhanaṃ yathā syāt| kathaṃ
punaraśaiṣikaḥ śaiṣikaṃ bādhate ?
apatyādibhyaścaturarthīparyantebhyo'nyoṣaḍarthaḥ śaiṣikāṇāṃ viṣayaḥ|
ayaṃ cāpatyāccchaviṣaye nāstyeva| tadasannayaṃ kathaṃ cchapratyayaṃ bādhiṣyata
ityata āha-- ṭhutsargaḥ śeṣa evāsau' iti| asatyasmin yoga
ityabhiprāyaḥ| asāvityanena prakṛtatvāt tasyāpatyamityeṣo'rthaḥ
pratyavamṛśyate| utsarga utpannenāpyaṇā sa evārtha
utsargasāhacaryāducyate| utsargasāhacaryantu tasya
tatrotsargasyāṇādervidhānāt| ihāpi kriyamāṇe ṭhtasyāpatyam'
(4.1.92) ityetasmin yoge ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120)
ityetasminnanupraveśādyathānyastadviśeṣaḥ śeṣo bhavati
tathā'patyārtho'pi| asti tasyāpyupayuktāpekṣamanyatvam,
ṭhcaturarthīparyanteṣvanantarbhāvāt| tataśca śeṣatvādapatyārthe
ccchapratyayaḥ prāpnoti| asmiṃstu yoge ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityatra
śeṣe nānupraviśati; upayuktatvāt| tataścāśeṣatvādapatye
cchapratyayasya cchapratyayasya prāptirnāstyeva|
saivāprāptirbādhanaśabdenoktā| atha bādhanārthasyāsya kiṃ
prayojanamityāha-- ṭhvṛddhānyasya prayojanam' iti| vṛddhāni
prātipadikānyasya yogasya prayojanam| bhānorapatyaṃ bhānavaḥ,
śyāmagorapatyaṃ śyāmagava ityatrāṇ siddho bhavati| asati tvasmin
yoke'patyārthaḥ pūrvoktarītyā śeṣaḥ syāt| tataśca tatra vṛddhebhyacaḥ
ṭhvṛddhāccchaḥ' (4.2.114) prasajyeta||

93. eko gotre| (4.1.93)
ṭhkṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ'(vyā.pa.6) iti
paribhāṣikasyaiva gotrasya grahaṇam| apatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇācca|
apatyamātraṃ hi laukikaṃ gotram, tasya yadīha grahaṇamabhimataṃ syādeka
ityevaṃ brūyāt, laukikasya gotrāpatyādhikārādeva labdhatvāt|
tasmādgotragrahaṇācca pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇamatyāha--ṭhapatyaṃ
pautraprabhṛti gotram' iti| ṭhbhedena' ityādi| bhedena u vibhāgena,
apatyamapatyaṃ prati u pratyayatyam| yāvantyapatyāni sambhavanti
tebhyo'pi sarvebhyaḥ pratyayānāmutpateḥ prasaṅge prāptau
satyāmityarthaḥ| sarveṣāmapatyena yogena
gargagārgigārgyagārgyāyaṇānāmanyatamasya yadapatyaṃ tatsarveṣāmapatyaṃ
bhavatīti paramaprakṛteranantaragotramuvalakṣaṇāḥ pratyayāḥ prāpnuvanti|
gargasya yadapatyaṃ tatsarveṣāṃ gārgigārgyagārgyāyaṇānāmapi sambandhi
bhavati| tathā hyatra yadyapi gargasyāpatyamiti gargaśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate,
tathāpi nāyaṃniyamo labhyate-- gargaśabdādevotpatiriti, api tu
kāmacāraḥ| tataśca yadā gargaśabdādutpatirbhavati tadā gargāditvādyañ
(4.1.105) , yadā gārgiśabdāt tadā ṭhyañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak,
yadāpi gārgyaśabdāt tadāpi sa eva phak, yadā gārgyāyamaśabdāt
tadā ṭhata iñ' (4.1.95) | evaṃ pratyapatyaṃ vibhāgena pratyayānāmutpatau
prasaktāyāmanena niyamaḥ kriyate-- ṭheka eva pratyayo bhavati' iti| etena
pratyayaniyama iti darśayati| pratyayaniyamastvekastvekaśabdasya
pratyayaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāllabhyate| ekaśabdaścāsminniyame
saṃkhyāvacano veditavyaḥ yathā--ekaḥ,dvau, bahava iti| evakāreṇa
dvayādivyavacchedaḥ kriyate-- eka eva pratyayo bhavati,na dvau, nāpi
bahava iti| sa caikaḥ pratyayo bhavannekagrahaṇāt paramaprakṛtereva
bhavatīti sāmarthyāduktaṃ bhavatīti| yadi hi gārgiśabdādutpadyet, dvau
syātām-- iñphakau, naikaḥ ? atha gārgyaśabdādevamapi dvāveva--
yañphakau ? atha gārgyāyaṇaśabdāt, trayaḥ syuḥ-- yañphagiñaḥ|
tasmānmūlaprakṛterevotpatāvekaḥ pratyayaḥ sidhyatītyekagrahaṇaṃ
kurvatā sāmarthyānmūlaprakṛtereva gotrapratyayasyotpatiruktā bhavati|
nanu cotpādayitaivāpatyena sambadhyate, evaṃ hi loke dṛśyate--
pitāmahasyotsaṅge dārakamāsīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaścit pṛccchati--
kasyāyamiti ? sa āha-- devadatasyeti, tenotpādayitāraṃ
vyapadiśati, nātmānam ? tataḥ sarveṣāmapatyena yogābhāvāt
pratyapatyaṃ bhedena pratyayotpatiprasaṅgo nāstyeveti
nivartyābhāvādidaṃ niyamārthaṃ nārabdhamityata āha-- ṭhsarve'patyena
yujyante' iti|
atraivopapatimāha-- ṭhapatanādapatyam' iti| yannimitaṃ hi yasay
pāpeṣvapatanaṃ tadapatanāt tasyāpatyaṃ bhavati| tasmādyo vyavahitena
janitaḥ so'pi paramaprakṛtivācyasyārthasyāpatyaṃ bhavati,tasyāpi
yenāpatanāt| paramaprakṛtigrahaṇañcopalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam|
itaraprakṛtivācyasyāpi hyarthasyāvyavahitajanito'patyaṃ bhavatyeva|
yatpunaruktam-- kasyāyamityukte utpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati,
nātmānamiti, na tenotpādayiturevāpatyena yogaḥ, śakyate
pratipādayitum| yasmānna tatra yasya tenāpatanaṃ sa jijñāsitaḥ syāt,
kiṃ tarhi ? ya utpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati nātmānam| yadi yasya tu
tenāpatanaṃ sa jijñāsitaḥ syāt, tadā''tmānamapi vyapadiśedeva|
yadi ca sarve'patyena na yujyeran, ṭhapatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram'
(4.1.162) iti yo'yamapatyapautraprabhṛtiśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena
nirdeaśaḥ, sa nopapadyate; yadapekṣayā pautrādivyapadeśamāsādayanti
pumāṃsastaṃ prati teṣāmanapatyatvāt| tasmādato'pi nirdeaśāt--
sarve'patyena yujyanta iti vijñāyate| ṭhtatputtro'pi gārgyaḥ' iti|
apiśabdāt tatpautrādirapi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatputtro'pi gārgya
ityāha-- ṭhsarvasmin' ityādi| yadapi gārgyāyaṇa ityatraikena
vyavahitena janitaṃ gotrāpatyaṃ yasmāt tatrāpi gargaśabdādyañeva
bhavati, tasmāt tatputtro'pi gārgyo bhavati| gargaśabdādityanena
paramaprakṛterbhavatīti darśayati| etaccaikagrahaṇāllabhyata ityuktam|
ṭhatha vā' ityādinā prakṛtiniyamaṃ darśayati
prakṛtiniyamastvekaśabdasya prakṛtisāmānādhikaraṇyāllabhyate|
ekaśabdo'tra prāthamyaniyame vartata iti veditavyam, yathā-- vargāṇāṃ
prathamadvitīyāḥ saṃvṛtakaṇṭhāḥ śvāsānupradānā aghoṣā eke'lpaprāṇā
itare sarve mahāprāṇā iti| atra hi prathame'lpaprāṇā iti gamyate|
ekaśabdasyedaṃ vivaraṇam-- ṭhprathamā prakṛtiḥ' iti| kā ca prathamā ? yā
paramaprakṛtirapratyayāntā ṭhgarga naḍa' ityevamādikā|
ṭhprakṛtirniyamyate' iti| prathamaiva prakṛtiḥ pratyayamutpādayati,
nāprathamā-- gārgigārgyagārgyāyaṇaprabhṛtiśabdāḥ pratyayāntāḥ|
gargasyāpatyaṃ gārgyaḥ, tatputtro'pi gārgyaḥ| naḍasyāpatyaṃ
nāḍāyanaḥ, tatputtro'pi nāḍāyanaḥ| sarvatra vyavahitajanite'pi
gotrāpatye prathamā prakṛtiḥ pratyayamutpādayati||

94. gotrādyaūnyastriyām| (4.1.94)
ṭhayamapi niyamaḥ' iti| na kevalaṃ pūrvaḥ--- ityapiśabdena darśayati|
sarveṣāṃ hyapatyena yoge paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhyo'pi
yuvāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, atastannivṛtyarthaṃ niyamaḥ
kriyate| ṭhgotrādeva'iti| gotrapatyayāntādevetyarthaḥ| anena
niyamasvarūpaṃ darśayati| ṭhna parama' ityādinā niyamasya vyavacchedyam|
ṭhgārgyāyaṇaḥ, dākṣāyaṇaḥ' iti| gotre yau yañiñau vihitau
tadantāt ṭhyañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| ṭhāṬpagaviḥ' nāḍāyaniḥ'
iti| gotre yāvaṇphakau vihitau tadantāt ṭhata iñ' (4.1.95)|
ṭhdākṣī' iti| vakṣasyāpatyaṃ caturtha strī| ṭhata iñ' (4.1.95), ṭhito
manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ|
ṭhkiṃ punaratra pratiṣidhyate' iti| sarvasmin pratiṣidhyamāne doṣaṃ
manyate| tameva doṣamāviṣkartumāha-- ṭhyadi' ityādi|
ṭhstriyāmaniyamaḥ prāpnoti' iti| paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhyo'pi
striyāṃ yuvapratyayaḥ prāpnotītyarthaḥ| ṭhgotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñayā
bādhitatvāt' iti| ṭhjīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā' ityatra
tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena abhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti| ṭhtasmāt'
ityādi| yata eva ca niyamayuvapratyayayorubhayorapi pratiṣedhe doṣaḥ,
tasmāt tannirāsāya yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ| tatra ṭh gotrādyaūni'
ityeko yogaḥ, anena ca niyamaḥ kriyate, yadāha-- ṭhgotrād yūni
pratyayo bhavati' iti. tataḥ ṭhastri yām' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ| tena ca
yūnītyatra yaduktaṃ kāryaṃ tasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, yadāha-- ṭhyūni
yaduktaṃ striyāṃ tanna bhavati' iti| ṭhyuvasaṃjñaiva pratiṣidhyate' iti|
katham ? ṭhastriyām' ityatra hi yoge yūnītyetadanuvartate, tenaivaṃ
vijñāyate-- yūni yaduktaṃ kāryaṃ striyāṃ tanna bhavatīti| yuvasaṃjñā ca
yūnyeva kāryayuktetyataḥ saiva pratiṣidhyate| ṭhyuvasaṃjñaiva' iti|
evakāreṇa niyamayuvapratyayorvyavacchedaḥ kriyate| ṭhtena strī
gotrapatyayenābhidhāsyate' iti| tasyāṃ yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ
gotrasaṃjñāyā avicalatvāt||

25. ata iñ| (4.1.95)
ṭhataḥ'ityanena prakṛtaṃ prātipadikaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca
tadantavidhirbhavatītyata āha-- ṭhakārāntāt prātipadikāt' iti|
athāta iti ṭhata sātatyagamane' (dhā.pā.34) ityasya kvibantasya grahaṇaṃ
kasmānna vijñāyate ? ṭhśivādibhyo'ṇ' (4.1.112) iti vacanāt|
taddhīño bādhanārthaṃ kriyate| yadi ceha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt,
śivādibhyaḥ prasaṅga eva nāstīti
tebhyastadbādhanārthamaṇvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt,
krauḍaḷadīnāñceñantānāṃ pāṭhāt| tasmādakārāntasyaivedaṃ grahaṇam|
yadyevam, asyāpatyamirityatra na prāpnoti, anakārāntatvāt ? etadapi
vyapadeśivadbhāvenākārāntaṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| ṭhśubhaṃyāḥ,
kīlālapāḥ' iti| yāteḥ, pibateśca ṭhāto maninkvanibvanipaśca'
(3.2.74) ityatra hi ṭhvijupeścchandasi' (3.2.73) ityataścakāreṇa
vijapyanukṛṣyate|
ṭhkatham' ityādi| daśarathaśabdādapyakārāntadiñā bhavitavyam| tataḥ
ṭhdāśarathāya' ityaṇantasya prayogo nopapadyata iti bhāvaḥ|
ṭhśeṣavivakṣāyām' ityādi| etena
daśarathasyāyamityarthavivakṣāyāmatrāṇa vihitaḥ, na tu ṭhtasyāpatyam'
(4.1.92) ityarthavivakṣāyāmiti darśayati| yadā tu daśarathasyāpatyamiti
vivakṣyate, tadeñbhavatyeva-- dāśarathiriti||

96. bāhvādibhyaśca| (4.1.96)
ṭhbāhaviḥ' iti| ṭhorguṇaḥ' (6.4.146)| 
ṭhkvacit' iti| ajīgartāviṣkārānteṣu| bāhuprabhṛtīnāṃ
vaṭākuparyantānāmanakārāntatvāt prāptyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| cūḍāśabdasya ca
ṭhdvaya caḥ' (4.1.121) iti ḍhaki prāpte| vṛkalādīnāṃ prāk
puṣkarasaccchabdāt ṭhavṛddhābhyo nadīmānuṣībhyaḥ' (4.1.113) ityaṇi
prāpte| puṣkarasadityevamādīnāṃ lomaśabdaparyantānāṃ prāptyarthaḥ,
anakārāntatvāt|
ṭhamitaujasaḥ salopaśca' iti| amitaujasśabdādiñ bhavati, salopaśca|
āmitaujiḥ| udañcviti paṭhaḷte, tatrāñcaterdhātoścakāro
veditavyaḥ| nāyaṃ punarakārāntaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? kvinnantaḥ,
pratyayavelāyāṃ nipātanādanunāsakilopo na bhavati|
udīco'patyamaudañciḥ| śiraḥ śabdastadantavidhiṃ prayojayati,
kevalasya napuṃsakasyāpatyena sambandhābhāvāt| hastiśiraso'patyaṃ
hāstiśīrṣiḥ, ṭhye ca taddhite' (6.1.61) ityatra
cakārasyānuktasamuccalomno'patyam-- āṬrdhvalomiḥ| ajīgartādīnāṃ
prāgudaṅkaśabdāt ṭhṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇi' (4.1.114) ityādināṇibādhake
prāpte| ṭhudaṅkaḥ saṃjñāyām' iti| udaṅko nāma kaścit,
tasyāpatyamaudaṅkiḥ| ṭhsambhūyo'mbhasoḥ salopaśca' (iti)|
sambhūyas, ambhasityetayoriñ bhavati, sakāralopaśca--
sāmbhūyiḥ,āmbhiḥ| ṭhbāhvādiprabhṛtiṣu' iti| prabhṛtiśabdeneta ūrdhvaṃ
ye vakṣyante te parigṛhyante| ṭhyeṣāṃ darśanaṃ gotrabhāve laukike'
iti| darśanaṃ u prasiddhiḥ| laukike gotre bhāvaḥ u saṃjñākāritvam|
yeṣāṃ laukikagotrabhāve prasiddhisteṣāṃ bāhvādiṣu parigraho
draṣṭavyaḥ | ṭhtato'nyatra teṣāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| yeṣāṃ laukike
gotrabhāve na darśanamapi tu tato'nyatra darśanam, teṣāṃ pratiṣedho
veditavyaḥ| tena bāhurnāma kaścidādipuruṣo yaḥ saṃjñākāritvena
prasiddho yadapatyasantānāntaḥ pātinaḥ pumāṃso
bāhuvyapadeśamāsādayanti, tata eveñ bhavati| yastvidālīntano
bāhurnāma kaścit tato'ṇeva bhavati-- bāhava iti| etacca
vetyanuvṛtervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāccalabhyate| sambandhiśabdānāñca
śvaśurādīnāñca yatkāryamucyate tasya tatsādṛśyāt pratiṣedho
bhavati| atrāpi pūrvokta eva heturveditavyaḥ| rājaśvaśurādyat' (4.1.137)
iti śvaśuraśabdādyatpratyayaḥ sambandhiśabdādeva bhavati, na saṃjñāśabdāt|
tena śvaśuro nāma kaścit, tasyāpatyaṃ śvāśuritīñeva bhavati|
ṭhsaṃjñāśvaśurasya' iti| saṃjñayā yaḥ śvaśuraḥ, na sambandhena sa
saṃjñāśvaśuraḥ||

97. sudhāturakaṅ ca| (4.1.97)
ṭhvyāsavaruḍa' ityādi| vyāsādīnāmiñ, tatsanniyogena cākaṅadeśo
bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--
pūrvasūtrāmiha cakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ,tena
vyāsādīnāmapi bhaviṣyati| ṭhvaiyāsakiḥ' iti| ṭhna yvābhyām' (7.3.3)
ityādinaijvṛddhipratiṣedhau| atha bāhvādiṣveva sudhātṛśabdamadhītya
tatra cākaṅadeśaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yathā-- amitaujasaḥ salopaśceti
gaṇe paṭhaḷte ? sūtre vā, na tatra kaścillāghavābhāvādviśeṣo labhyata
iti yatkiñcidetat||

98. gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ| (4.1.98)
ṭhiño'pavādaḥ' iti| akārāntatvāt kuñjādīnām| ṭhcakāro
viśeṣaṇārthaḥ'iti| yadyatra cakāro na kriyeta tataḥ
ṭhvrātacphañorastriyām' (5.3.113) ityatrāpi naiva kriyate,

tadrājasaṃjñakatvāt ṭhtadrājasya bahuṣu' (2.4.62) ityādinā luk| kiṃ
punaratra ñitvasvareṇa bhavitavyam ? uta citsvareṇa ? ityata āha--
ṭhekavacanadvivacanayoḥ' ityādi| ekavacanadvivacanayostāvat sati
tasmin citsvare paścād ñye vihite samupajāyamāno ñitsvaraḥ

99.naḍādibhyaḥ phak| (4.1.99)
naḍādiṣu ṭhśalaṅku śalaṅkañca' iti paṭhaḷte| tasyāyamarthaḥ-
śalaṅkuśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati śalaṅkabhāvaṃ cāpadyate, tena
śālaṅkāyana iti bhavati| ṭhpailādiṣu 'iti| pailādiṣu
śālaṅkiśabda iñantaḥ paṭhaḷte, tata utpannasya yuvapratyayasya lugyathā
syāt-- ṭhśālaṅki pitā, śālaṅkiḥ putraḥ' iti| tatra hi
ṭhṇyakṣatriyārṣañitaḥ' (2.4.58) ityādeḥ sūtrāt ṭhyūni luk' iti
cānuvartate, tasya śālaṅgiśabdasya tatra pāṭho na yujyate--
naḍādiṣu pāṭhāt phakā bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā, tat kathamiñantastatra
paṭhaḷta iti codyam| tasya parihāramāha-- ṭhgotraviśeṣe' ityādi|
kauśikaṃ yadgotraṃ tatraiva śalaṅkuśabdādācāryaḥ phakaṃ smaranti,
tato'nyatra tviñeva bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| sa tviñ
bāhvāderākṛtigaṇatvāllabhyate| abhyupetyāpi gotramātre phako
vidhānam| parihārāntaramāha-- ṭhatha vā' ityādi| iño bhāva
upalakṣaṇam| śalaṅkabhāvasyāpi hi pailādipāṭha eva jñāpakam|
pūrvatrāpi parihāre tasya eva jñāpakaṃ veditavyam| ṭhagniśarman
vṛṣagaṇe' iti| agniśarmañśabdādvṛṣagaṇe gotre phagbhavati--
āgniśarmāyaṇaḥ| anyatrāṇeva-- āgniśarmaḥ| ṭhamuṣya' iti paṭhaḷte|
tatar nipātanādvibhakteraluk-- āmuṣyāyaṇa iti| ṭhkṛṣṇaraṇau
brāhmaṇavāśiṣṭhayoḥ' iti| kṛṣṇaraṇaśabdau yathākramaṃ brāhmaṇe vāśiṣṭhe
cābhidheye phakamutpādayataḥ| kārṣṇāyano brāhmaṇaḥ| rāṇāyaṇo
vaśiṣṭhaḥ| vaśiṣṭhagotra ityarthaḥ| anyatreñeva bhavati-- kārṣṇiḥ,
rāṇiriti| ṭhkroṣṭua kroṣṭañca' iti paṭhaḷte| kroṣṭuaśabdaḥ
phakamutpādayati, kroṣṭañcāpadyate -- krauṣṭāyanaḥ||

104. anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ| (4.1.104)
ṭhye punaratrānṛṣiśabdāḥ' ityādi| nanu ca sūtre ānantaryaśabdo
bhāvapratyayānta upātaḥ,tatraivaṃ vivaritavyam-- ye
punaratrānṛṣiśabdāḥ putrādayastebhyo'patyānantarya eva bhavati ?
naitadasti; na hyayaṃ bhāve ṣyañ vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? svārtha eva,
cāturvarṇyavat; anyathāpatyasya dharma ānantarye pratyayaḥ dharma ānantarye
pratyayaḥ syāt, nāpatye, tatreṣyate ca| 
kathaṃ punargotrādhikāre satyanuṣibhyo'nantarāpatya eva pratyayo
labhyate ? atra gotragrahaṇaṃ nivartate| ṛṣiśabdebhyo'nantarāpatya eva
svadityata āha-- ṭhanṛṣyānantarya ityasyāyam' ityādi| ṭhyadyayamarthaḥ'
ityādi| asmin hyarthe satyanṛṣyānantarya ityetadviṣyartha bhavati;
anṛṣeranantarāpatye pratyayavidhānāt| tataśca ṛṣyapatya
ānantaryepratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syādityāha--
ṭhṛṣiśabdo'traṛṣijātāvṛṣitve vartate| ṭhapatyeṣu nairantaryam'
iti| ṭhsaptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ|
paścādṛṣerapatyanairantaryamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tadāyamartho bhavati--
ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryaviṣaye'ñaḥ pratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāt|
atha vā-- ṛṣayaśca te'patyāni ca ṛṣyapatyāni, teṣāṃ nairantaryaṃ
tadviṣaye pratiṣedho'ñaḥ pratyayasya na kṛtaṛ syādityarthaḥ| tatar ko
doṣaḥ ? ityāha-- ṭhtatredam' ityādi| sapta kāśyapā
ṛṣayo'patyāpatyavatsambandhena parasapraṃ sambaddhāḥ, yeṣāṃ mitrahūrnāma
kāśyapaḥ saptamaḥ, teṣāmuṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryam| tatra
ṛṣyapatyānāṃ vā nairantarye viṣaye'ñaḥ pratiṣedha
iṣyate,kāśyapānāmityetadrūpaṃ yathā syāt| añi sati tasya bahuṣu
lopābhāvāt kāśyapānāmiti prāpnoti| sa ca pratiṣaedho'sminnarthe
sati na prāpnoti, tataśca kāśyapānāmiti na sidhyati| tasmāt
ṭhanṛṣyānantarye' ityasya ṛṣyapatyanairantaryeṇa na bhavatītyeṣo'rtho
vijñāyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhanantarāpatyarūpeṇaiva' iti| na cātra
gotrāpatyaṃ vivakṣitam| kiṃ tarhi ? kiṃ tarhi ? anantarāpatyam|
ato'nantarāpatyarūpeṇaiva ṛṣyaṇā ṛṣyandhakādiṣu (4.1.114) vihitena
kāśyapānāmityabhidhānaṃ bhaviṣyati| etadeva draḍhayitumāha-- ṭhavaśyañca'
ityādi| ṛṣyapatyaṃ nairantaryaṃ viṣayo yasya pratiṣedhasya sa tathoktaḥ|
ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu ṛṣyapatyānāṃ vā yannairarantarya tadviṣaye
pratiṣedhe vijñāyamāna ityarthaḥ| ṭhkauśiko viśvāmitra iti duṣyati'
iti| kiṃ kāraṇam ? viśvāmitrastapastepe-- nānṛṣiḥ syāmiti,
tatrabhavānṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ,sa punastapakṣepe --nānṛṣeḥ puttraḥ
syāmiti, tatrabhavān gādhirapi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ; sa punastapastepe--
nānṛṣeḥ pautraḥ syāmiti; tatrabhavān kuśiko'pi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ|
tadetadbhavati-- ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryam,ṛṣyapatyānāṃ
vānantaryam| tataśca ṛṣyapatyanairantarye na bhavatītyevaṃ vijñāyamāne
kauśiko viśvāmitra iti na sidhyati|
ṭhparastrī paraśuñca' iti|parastrīśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati
pareśubhāvañcāpadyate| parastriyā apatyaṃ pāraśavaḥ||

supiṣṭamayūrakharadūratakṣannityevaṃ supiṣṭādibhiḥ saha paṭhaḷte, yathā
teṣāñceñapavādārtho'tra pāṭhaḥ, taiḥ sāhacaryādasyāpīñapavādārtha eva
pāṭho vijñāsyate| tatra śivādīnāṃ prāg bhūriśabdādiñapavādārthaṃ
vacanam| bhūri, sandhi, muni-- ityeteṣāṃ ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti
ḍhaki prāpte| kuṭhāra, anabhimlāna-- ityetayoḥ kakutstha--
ityemādīnāṃ prāg jaratkāruśabdādiño bādhanārtham|
jaratkāruprabhṛtīnāṃ prāk supiṣṭaśabdāt ṭhstrībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120)
iti ḍhaki prāpte| supiṣṭādīnāṃ prāk takṣañśabdādiñaḥ| takṣannityasya
kārilakṣaṇodīcāmiñaḥ| ṛṣṭiṣeṇasya senāntalakṣamasya ṇyasya ca
bādhanārtham| gaṅgādipāṭÂśabdayoryasminnaprāpta iha pāṭhaḥ sa
vṛtikāreṇaiva vyākhyātaḥ| yaskādibhyaḥ prāg bhūmiśabdādiñi prāpte|
bhūmiśabdasya ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhaki| ilāśabdasyāpi
ṭhpdvyacaḥ iti sūtram} dvyacaśca' (4.1.121) iti ḍhaki| emeva
sapatnīśabdasyāpi ṭhstrībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) iti ḍhakyeva| ṭhdvyaco
nadyāḥ' iti| nadīvācakā ye dvyacastebhyo'ṇ bhavati, sandhyā--
sāndhyam, kulyā-- kaulyam| nanu cātra tannāmiko'ṇastyeva ?
satyamasti; sa tu ṭhdvyacaḥ' (4.1.121) iti ḍhakā bādhyate| tasmāt
tadbādhanārthaṃ vacanam| ṭhtriveṇī trivaṇañca' iti| triveṇīśabdaḥ
pratyayamutpādayati, trivaṇañcāpadyate| triveṇyā apatyaṃ traivaṇaḥ||

113. avṛddhābhyo nadīmānuṣībhyastannāmikābhyaḥ| (4.1.113)
śāstrāntare paribhāṣitamapi vṛddhamasti-- apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti;
iha śāstre'pi paribhāṣitaṃ vṛddhamasti
ṭhvṛddhiryasyācāmādistadÂvṛddham' (1.1.73) iti, ato vṛddhapratiṣedhe
kasyacit sandehaḥ syāt-- kasya vṛddhasyāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃsvit
yadiha paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ? uta yacchāstrāntareṇa
paribhāṣitaṃ tasyeti ? atastannirāsāya ṭhvṛddhiryasya' 91.1.73)
ityādineha śāstre yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti
darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- iha vṛddhaṃ yat paribhāṣitaṃ
tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- iha
vṛddhaṃ yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti ?
nadīmānuṣīnāmadheyasya gotrapratyayāntasyāsambhavāt| nadīgrahaṇe
tviha laukikyeva nadī gṛhyate, na tu pāribhāṣikī| kuta etat ?
laukikārthavṛtinā mānuṣīśabdena sāhacaryāt| atha svarūpagrahaṇameva
nadīmānuṣīśabdayoḥ kasmānna bhavati ? vṛddhapratiṣedhāt| svarūpagrahaṇe
hi vṛddhapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt; prasaṅgābhāvāt|
bahuvacananirdeaśācca na svarūpagrahaṇam| svarūpagrahaṇe hī
nadīmānuṣīśabdayordvitvādÂdvicanenaiva nirdeaśaṃ kuryāt|
ṭhavṛddhābhyiti śabdadharmaḥ syāt| yadi tarhyarthadharmo'yam, kathaṃ
nadīmānuṣībhya ityanena prakṛtayo nirdiśyante, arthadharma eva hyaevaṃ
nirdiṣṭo bhavati, na prakṛtayaḥ? ityata āha-- ṭhtena' ityādi|
tenārthabhedopacārāt| nadīmānuṣyabhidhāyinyaḥ prakṛtayo
nirdiśyante| ṭhpratyayaprakṛtiḥ' iti| pratyayasya prakṛtiriti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṭhḍhako'pavādaḥ' iti| avṛddhādīnāṃ nadīnāṃ manuṣīṇāṃ
nāmadheyānāṃ strīpratyayāntatvāt| ṭhvaitastaḥ, nārmadaḥ' iti|
vitastānarmadāśabdābhyāmaṇ| ṭhśaikṣitaḥ' iti| śikṣitāśabdāt|
ṭhsauparṇeyaḥ, vainateyaḥ' iti| suparṇāvinatāśabdau pakṣiṇīnāmadheye,
na nadīmānuṣyau| ṭhśaubhaneya-' iti| śobhanāśabdo vartate
nadīmānuṣyarthaḥ, na tu saṃjñātvena, kiṃ tarhi ? viśeṣaṇatvena||

114. ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca| (4.1.114)
ṭhiño'pavādaḥ' iti| nanu cānakārāntebhyo'tstryādibhyo ye
ḍhagādayaḥ prāpnuvanti tadapavāda eva yukta ityata āha--
ṭhattryādibhyastu' ityādi| ekenādiśabdena ṛṣayo
jātasenādayo'ndhakādiṣu ca vartamānā ugrasenādayaḥ, parigṛhyante,
dvitīyena ṇyādayaḥ pratyayāḥ| tatra ṛṣyaṇo'vakāśaḥ-- vāsiṣṭhaḥ,
ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti
ḍhako'vakāśaḥ--dauleyaḥ;atriśabdādubhayaprāptau paratvād ḍhagbhavati--
āttreyaḥ| ṛṣyaṇo'vakāśaḥ sa eva, senāntalakṣamasya ṇyasyāvakāśaḥ--
kāriṣeṇyaḥ, hāriṣeṇyaḥ;jātaseno nāma ṛṣiḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau
paratvāṇṇyo bhavati--- jātasenyaḥ| andhakāṇo'vakāśaḥ--vāsudevaḥ,
ṇyasya sa eva; śūraseno viṣvakseno nāma vṛṣṇiḥ,
tasmādubhyaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati-- śaurasenyaḥ , vaiṣvaksenyaḥ|
kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ--nākulaḥ,ṇyasya sa eva; ugraseno
nāmāndhakaḥ,tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati-- āṬgrasenyaḥ|
vṛṣṇyaṇo'vakāśaḥ-- vāsudevaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; śūraseno viṣvakseno
nāma vṛṣṇiḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati--
śaurasenyaḥ, vaiṣvaksenyaḥ| kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ--nākulaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva;
bhīmaseno nāma kuruḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati--
bhaimasenyaḥ|
ṭhkathaṃ punaḥ' ityādi codyam| ṭhkecidāhuḥ' ityādi codyaparihāraḥ|
ṭhkākatālīyam' iti| abuddhipūrvakamityarthaḥ| ṭhsaṅkalitāḥ' iti|
samuccitāḥ| ṭhnityā eva' iti| andhakādīnāṃ vaṃśānāmanāditvāt||

115. māturutsaṃkhyāsambhadrūparvāyāḥ| (4.1.115)
ṭhdvaimāturaḥ'iti| prāk taddhitārthe viṣaye dvikuḥ, paścāt taddhitaḥ|
ṭhsāmmāturaḥ' iti| pūrvaṃ prādisamāsaḥ, paścāt
taddhitaḥ|ṭhbhādramāturaḥ' iti| pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ; tatastaddhitaḥ|
atha pratyayārtha vacanaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- ṭhpratyayaḥ punaḥ'
ityādi| utsargalakṣaṇenaiva ṭhtasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityanena| nanu ca
saṃkhyādipūrvatvaṃ mātṛśabdasya viśeṣaṇam, tatra mātṛśabdāpekṣayā
nirdeaśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ puṃlliṅga eva dṛśyate, tatkathaṃ
ṭhsaṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ' iti strīliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ ? ityata āha--
ṭhstrīliṅganirdeaśo'rthāpekṣaḥ' iti| mātuḥ śabdasya
yo'rthastadapekṣo'yaṃ nirdeaśaḥ, sa cārthaḥ strīliṅgaḥ| tena
strīliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ| ṭhtena' ityādinārthāpekṣasya phalaṃ
darśayati| arthāpekṣe hi strīliṅganirdeaśe strīliṅgo yasyārtho
mātṛśabdasya , tasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam, tena dhānayamāturgrahaṇaṃ
na bhavati| na hi tasya strīliṅgo'rthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? puṃlliṅgaḥ|
dhānyaṃ mimīte yo bhṛtakaḥ sa dhānyamātetyucyate|
ṭhsaumātraḥ' iti| prāk prādisamāsaḥ| tata āṬtsargiko'ṇ||

138.kṣatrādghaḥ| (4.1.138)
ṭhghapratyayo bhavati' iti| ghaśabda eva, na tu taraptamapāviti

taraptamaporiyaṃ saṃjñā, coccaritā saṃjñinaṃ sampratyayāyatīti

ghaḥ śrūyate svarūpameva gṛhyata iti| na hi saṃjñinorgrahaṇena
pratyayāderghaḥ sambhavati||

139. kulātkhaḥ| (4.1.139)
ṭhutarasūtre' ityādi| utarasūtre hi pūrvapadapratiṣedhādyasyāṃ
paribhāṣāyāṃ prātipadikaśrutirasti, sā'tra nopatiṣṭhata ityeṣo'rtho
jñāyate| yadi hyupatiṣṭheta, tadā grahaṇavatā prātipadikena
tadantavidhipratiṣedhādeva (vyā.pa.89) sa pūrvapadānna
bhaviṣyatītyapūrvapadāditi pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt|
sāmānyāpekṣañca jñāpakam; tena ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena'
(śāka.pa.65), ṭhgrahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirneṣyate'
(vyā.pa.89) ityetayorapīha paribhāṣayorupasthānaṃ na bhavati| tataśca
kulaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ kulaśabdo gṛhyate||

140. apūrvapadādanyatarasyāṃ yaḍḍhakañau| (4.1.140)
nanu pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ; na ca kulaśabdasya padāntaramavayava
upapadyate; pṛthagbhūtavāt, anārambhakatvācca, tato
vyapacchedyābhāvādapūrvapadādityuktametatkulaśabdasya viśeṣaṇam ?
ityāha-- ṭhsamāsasambandhi' ityādi| samāse satyetadbhavati--
pūrvapadam, utarapadamiti| tasmāt samāsasambandhinaḥ
pūrvapadsayābhāvena kulaśabdo viśeṣyate-- avidyamānaṃ
samāsasambandhi pūrvapadaṃ yasyeti| kasya cāvidyamānam ? yaḥ
samāsasyāntabhūto na bhavati kevalaḥ kulaśabdaḥ,tena kevalāt
kulaśabdādayaṃ vidhirityuktaṃ bhavati| atha vyavasthāvācyeva pūrvaśabdaḥ
kasmānnāśrīyate ? aśakyatvāt| tatra hyāśrīyamāṇe'vidyamānaṃ pūrvapadaṃ
yasmāt kulaśabdāt so'pūrvapadaśabdenocyate| tataśca devadataḥ
kulyo devadataḥ kauleyaka iti vākye yaÃḍḍhakañau na syātām;
devadatasyeha pūrvapadasya vidyamānatvāt| ṭhpadagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti|
apūrvādityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, evamapi hīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, laghu ca sūtraṃ
bhavatīti manyate| ṭhbahucpūrvapadādapi yathā syāt' iti|
ṭhapūrvāt' ityucyamāne bahuc pūrvaṃ yatpratātipadikaṃ bahujasya
pūrvaṃ iti tataḥ pratyayo na syāt| padagrahaṇe tu sati tato'pi
bhavati; tasyāpūrvapadatvāt| ṭhbahukulyaḥ' iti| īṣadasamāptaṃ
kulamiti ṭhvibhāṣā supo bahuc purastātu' (5.3.68) iti bahuc|
bahukulasyāpatyaṃ bahukulyaḥ||

146. revatyādibhyaṣṭak| (4.1.146)

147. gotrastriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca| (4.1.147)
ṭhapatyaṃ prautraprabhṛti gotraṃ gṛhyate' iti| na laukikamapatyamātram,
tadÂgrahaṇe hi gotragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| apatyādhikārādeva
tadÂgrahaṇasya labdhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ṭhpiturasaṃvijñāne' iti|
aprasiddhau| tasya piturasaṃvijñānapradarśanārthaṃ mātrā yo
vyapadeśo'sti tena kutsā syāt| ṭhgārgo jālmo gārgikaḥ' iti|
gargaśabdādgotre gargādiyañantāt ṭhyañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīpi
ṭhhalastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) itilope sati yakārasya gārgī iti sthite
ṇaṭhakau| ṭhglaucukāyanaḥ' ityādi| glucakasyāpatyaṃ gotraṃ strī
ṭhprācāmavṛddhāt' phin bahulam' (4.1.160) iti phin,tataḥ ṭhito
manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ,tato ṇaṭhakau|
ṭhkārikeyaḥ'iti| kārakaśabdāṇṇvulantāṭṭāp|kārikāśabdo'yaṃ
gotre na vartate,tato ḍhageva bhavati| ṭhāṬpagaviḥ'iti| upagorapatyaṃ
gotraṃ pumān,aṇ, tadantādiñeva bhavati| atra kenacit
pratiṣiddhācaraṇādinā kutsā veditavyā|ṭhgārgeyo māṇavakaḥ' iti| atra
pitari vijñāte mātuḥ parijñānārthaṃ tanmatrā vyapadeśaḥ kriyata iti
nāsti kutsā, tena ḍhagena bhavati||

148.vṛddhāṭṭhaksauvīreṣu bahulam| (4.1.148)
ṭhsauvīreṣviti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam' iti| sauvīreṣu yadÂvṛddhaṃ
sauvīragotrābhidhāyi yadÂvṛddhamityarthaḥ| ṭhbhāgaviteḥṭa ityādi|
bhagavitasyāpatyaṃ gotram| ṭhata iña' (4.1.95) , tadantāt ṭhak--
ṭhbhāgavitikaḥ' | ṭhbhāgavitāyanaḥ' iti| ṭhyañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti
phak| tṛṇādibindorapatyamautsargiko'ṇ tārṇabindavaḥ, tataṣṭhak--
ṭhtārṇabindavikaḥ'| pūrvasūtre ṭhak cānukṛṣṭa itīha nānuvartata iti
punaṣṭhaggrahaṇaṃ ṇsaya nivṛtyartham| vāpūrvakaṃ hi ṭhaggrahaṇaṃ
ṇapratyayena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛtau tasyāpyanuvṛtiḥ syāt|
ṭhbhāgapūrvapado vṛtiḥ' ityādi| yebhyo'nena sūtreṇa ṭhagiṣyate, ta
etena ślokena parigaṇyante| ṭhbhāga' ityetat pūrvapadaṃ yasya
vṛtiśabdasya sa tathoktaḥ| ayaṃ tāvadeko bhāgavitiḥ,
dvitīyastārṇabindavaḥ, tṛtīyastvākaśāpeyaḥ-- ya ete trayaḥ śabdāḥ
,gotre ṭhagbahulaṃ tata iti| sauvīragotravacanāntāt
prātipadikādbahulaṃ yaṣṭhagucyate sa tatastebhya eva
bhāgavitiprabhṛtibhyastribhyo bhavati, nānyebhya ityarthaḥ|
atha vṛddhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā
pūrvasūtrādgotragrahaṇamanuvartate, sauvīragrahaṇenaiva
viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ; yaccasauvīragotre vartate prātipadikaṃ
bhāgavityādikaṃ tadvṛddhameva, tato nivṛtyabhāvādapārthakaṃ
vṛddhagrahaṇam ? ityāha -- ṭhvṛddhagrahaṇam' ityādi| taddhi gotragrahaṇaṃ
striyā viśeṣaṇam, atastasminnanuvartamāne viśeṣyāyāḥ striyā
anuvṛtiḥ syāt| tasmāt tannidṛtyarthaṃ vṛddhagrahaṇam|
gotragrahaṇamevānuvartiṣyate; tasyaiva svaritatvāt, na strīti--
etadvyākhyeyaṃ bhavati| vyākhyānācca laghu vṛddhagrahaṇameva|
ṭhāṬpagaviḥ' iti| aṇantādiñ| nanu ca parigaṇanaṃ
kṛtam,tatkathamaupagavaśabdāt ṭhakprasaṅgaḥ ? sauvīragrahaṇe sati
tatparigaṇanam| tathā hi-- bhāgavitiprabhṛtayaḥ
sauvīragotrābhidhāyina eva parigaṇitāḥ| tatrāsati sauvīragrahaṇe
āṬpagavaśabdādapi prasajyate-- ṭhbhāgavitāyanaḥ' iti| pūrvavat phak|
atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham,na, vāgrahaṇameva kriyeta,tenāpi hi
bhāgavitiko bhāghavitikāyana ityādi sidhyatyeva ? ityata āha--
ṭhbahulagrahaṇam' ityādi| vāgrahaṇādvikalpamātraṃ labhyate, na
tūpādhivaicitryam| bahulagrahaṇe tu tadapi| tasmādupādhīnāṃ
viśeṣamānāṃ vaicitryam u nānāprakāratā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ
bahulagrahaṇam| tadevopādhivaicitryaṃ darśayitumāha-- ṭhgotrastriyā
ityārabhya' ityādi| sukhāvabodham||

149.pheśca ca| (4.1.149)
ṭhyamundaśca'ityādi| yebhyo'nena sūtreṇa cchaṭhakāviṣyete, teṣāmanena
ślokena parigaṇanaṃ kriyate, tatu bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtereva labhyata
ityevaṃ tadveditavyam| yamundamuddiśya vṛtikāreṇaivodāharaṇaṃ
darśitam| itarayostu darśayāmaḥ-- suyāmno'patyaṃ, phiñ--
sauyāmāyaniḥ,tasyāpatyaṃ sauyāmāyanikaḥ| vṛṣasyāpatyaṃ,phiñ, tasya
vārdhyāyaṇiḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ vārṣyāyaṇīyaḥ,vārṣyāyaṇikaḥ| ete
yamundādayaḥ śabdāḥ phiñaḥ smṛtāḥ u phiñantā vijñātāḥ| ṭhgotrastriyāḥ
kutsane ṇa ca' (4.1.147) ityādayaścatvāro yogāḥ| tatrādyaḥ kutsana eva,
antyaḥ sauvīreṣveva| madhyamau tu dvau sauvīreṣu kutsāyāñca
śabdavitsmaret jānīyāt||

150. phāṇṭāhṛtimimatābhyāṃ maphiñau| (4.1.150) 
ṭhālpāctarasya' ityādi| mimataśabdo'yamalpāctaraḥ, tasya ṭhalpāctaram'
(2.2.34) iti pūrvanipāte prāpte yaḥ paranipātaḥ sa
lakṣamavyabhicāracihnaṃ sūcayati| yathedaṃ pūrvanipātalakṣaṇaṃ
vyabhicarati u svaviṣaye na pravartate, tathā yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīti
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| ata evaikaikasmāt pratyayadvayaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati||

151.kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ| (4.1.151)
ṭhkauravyaḥ' iti| ṭhorguṇaḥ' (6.4.156), ṭhvānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79)
ityavādaśaḥ| ṭhkurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punaḥ
kuruśabdādaparo'pi ṇyapratyayo bhaviṣyati, yāvatānenaiva siddham,
tadeva hi rūpam, sa evaca svaraḥ ? ityata āha-- ṭhsa tu kṣatriyāt'
iti| anenārthabhedaṃ darśayati| sa hi ṭhjanapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādaña'
(4.1.168)ityadhikārāt kṣatriyādbhavati, ayaṃ tu tato'nyataḥ|
tataścaikaḥ kṣatriyāpatyo bhavati, aparastvakṣatriyāpatya iti spaṣṭa
evārthabhedaḥ| rūpaviśeṣo'pi bahuṣu vidyata iti darśayannāha--
ṭhtadrājasaṃjñakaḥ' ityādi| tasya hi tadrājasaṃjñakatvāt ṭhtadrājasya
bahuṣu' (2.4.62) ityādinā bahuṣu lukā bhavitavyam -- kurava iti|
ayaṃ tu śrūyata eva kauravyā iti|
rathakāraśabdo'tar paṭhaḷte, tatra rathakāraśabdaścāstyeva jātivacanaḥ,
asti ca kārivacanaḥ, tadiha tayoḥ kataraḥ paṭhaḷte ? ityāha--
ṭhrathakāraśabdo'tra paṭhaḷte' ityādi| atha kārivacano'pi kasmānna
paṭhaḷte ? ityāha-- ṭhkāriṇastu' ityādi| yo hi vacano
rathakāraśabdaḥ, tata utarasūtreṇaiva ṇyaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkitra tasya pāṭhena !
ṭhpuṃvadbhāvo na bhavati' iti| ṭhbhasyā'ḍha taddhite' (vā.731) iti yaḥ
puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, sa keśinī śabdasya na bhavati| yadi syāt,
ṭhnastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilope kṛte ṭhkaiśyaḥ' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ
syāt| kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- ṭhstrīpratyayasya nirdeaśasāmarthyāt'
iti|yadi hi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt, strīpratyayenāsya nirdeaśo'narthakaḥ
syāt, puṃlliṅgamevainaṃ paṭhet| puṃlliṅgasyāpi pāṭhe
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā keśinīśabdādapi pratyayaḥ sidhyati| nanu
ca puṃlliṅganivṛtyarthaḥ strīpratyayāntasya pāṭhaḥ syāt ? naitadasti;
abhidhānādeva hi puṃlliṅgānna bhaviṣyati|
ṭhtasya kaṇvādivat'iti| apatyādhikāre'yamatideśo bhavan
kaṇvādibhirapatyapratyayāntairvijñāyate| kaṇvādayaśca gargādyantaḥ
pātinaḥ, tena yañantānāṃ kaṇvādīnāṃ yatkāryaṃ tadvāmarathyasya
svaravarjaṃ bhavatītyayaṃ bhavati| ṭhlugādikam' iti| ādiśabdena
ṅībādikaṃ gṛhyate| kaṇvādīnamapatyapratyayasya ṭhyañañośca' (2.4.64) iti
bahuṣu lugbhavati| striyāṃ ṭhyañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp| ṭhprācāṃ ṣpha
taddhite' (4.1.17) itiṣpha pratyayaḥ
striyāmeva| ṭhyañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| śaiṣikeṣvartheṣu
ṭhkaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityaṇ ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120)
ityarthavivakṣāyām| ṭhsaṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñām' (4.3.127)
ityaṇ| etāni kāryāṇi yathā kaṇvādīnāṃ bhavanti tatā
vāmarathyasyāpi| eṣāṃ ṭhvāmarathā' ityādīni yathākramamudāharaṇāni|
ṭhnātideśikamādyaudātatvam' iti| yathā kaṇvādīnāṃ yañantānāṃ
ñitsvareṇādyaudātatvaṃ, na tathā vāmarathyasya, kiṃ tarhi ?
pratyayasvareṇāntodātatvameva bhavati| ṭhsamrājaḥ kṣatriye' iti| samrājaḥ
kṣatriye ṇyo bhavati, samrājo'patyaṃ sāmrājyaḥ| anyatrāṇeva--
sāmrājaḥ||

152. senāntalakṣamakāribhyaśca| (4.1.152)
atra grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhi (vyā.pa.89)
pratiṣedhāllakṣaṇaśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇam| ata evāha-- ṭhlakṣaṇaśabdāt'
iti| kārītyarthagrahaṇam| tatrārthe kāryasyābhāvāt tadvācinaḥ pratyayo
vijñāyata ityāha-- ṭhkārivacanebhyaśca' iti|yathā lakṣaṇaśabdasya
svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tathā kāriśabdasya kasmānna bhavati ? śivādiṣu takṣanniti
pāṭhāt| asya hi kārilakṣaṇamiñaṃ bādhituṃ tatra pāṭhaḥ| yadi ca
kāriśabdasyeha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, takṣanśabdādibhyaḥ
prāpterasambhavādutsargeṇaivāṇā bhavitavyamiti tasya śivādiṣu
pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| arthagrahaṇe tvanena prāptasyeño bādhanārthastatra
pāṭho yujyate||

153. udīcāmiñ| (4.1.153)
ṭhvacanasāmarthyāt' ityādi| ṇyo'pyucyate, iñapi,
vacanasāmarthyādevāntareṇācāryagrahaṇaṃ tayoḥ samāveśe siddhe
tadācāryagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tadvaicitryārtham|
ācāryagrahaṇasyātiricyamānatvādayamartho labhyate,
granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā| nanu ca
pūjārthamācāryagrahaṇaṃ syāt ? naitadasti; evaṃ hi prācāmapi grahaṇaṃ
kartavyaṃ syāt| te'pi hi senāntalakṣaṇakāribhya iñaṃ smaranti|
ṭhtakṣanśabdaḥ' ityādinā vaicitryaṃ darśayati| ṭhtākṣṇaḥ' iti| śivādyaṇi
kṛte ṭhṣapūrvahandhṛtarājñāmaṇi' (6.4.135) ityallopaḥ| ṭhtākṣaṇyaḥ' iti|
ṭhye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ||

154. tikādibhyaḥ phiñ| (4.1.154)
ṭhkauravyaśabdaḥ paṭhaḷte' ityādi| kauravyaśabdo'yamastyeva
kṣatriyagotravacano yaḥ ṭhkurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.172) iti
ṇyapratyayāntaḥ; tayoriha pūrvo gṛhyate| kuta etat ? āṬrasaśabdena
sāhacaryāt| āṬrasaśabdo'yaṃ ṭhjanapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādañ' (4.1.168)
ityañpratyayāntaḥ, tenāsau kṣatriyavacanaḥ,
tatsāhacaryāccakauravyaśabdo yaḥ kṣatriyapratyayāntatvāt
kṣatriyavacanaḥ sa eva gṛhyate|
ṭhyastu' ityādi| yastu ṭhkurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.15)| iti
ṇyapratyayānto brāhmaṇādigotravacanaḥ, tasmāt ṭhata iñ' (4.1.95)
idīñaiva bhavitavyam, tatraitat syāt ? svamanīṣikeyaṃ bhavata
ityāha-- ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| yata evaṃ brāhmaṇādigotravacanādiñaiva
bhavitavyam| tathā hi ṇyakṣatriyādi (2.4.58) sūtre pūrverapi
vṛtikāraiḥ--- kauravyaḥ pitā, kauravyaḥ putra ityudāhṛtam| yadi
cātaḥ phiñ syāt tadudāharaṇaṃ na yujyeta|na hi
ṇyapratyayāntādvihitasya phiño yūni lugucyate, api tvaṇiñoḥ||

155.kauśalyakārmāryābhyāñca| (4.1.155)
ṭhparamaprakṛterevāyaṃ pratyaya iṣyate' iti| kośalaśabdāt,
karmāraśabdācca| evakāḥ ṭhvṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅ' (4.1.171) iti
ñyaṅnto yaḥ kauśalyaśabdaḥ, yaśca ṭhsenāntalakṣaṇakāribhyaśca' (4.1.152)
iti kārilakṣaṇaṇyapratyayāntaḥ karmāryaśabdaḥ tayorvyavacchedāya|
yadi mūlaprakṛtereveṣyate, kathamidaṃ vikṛtaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ śrayūte ?
ityāha-- ṭhpratyayasanniyogena' ityādi| na ceyaṃ svamanīṣikā, api
tvācāryaṇāmeva bhāṣyakāraprabhṛti#īnāmidaṃ matamiti darśayannāha--
ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| kaḥ punaḥ paramaprakṛteḥ pratyayāntādvatpatau viśeṣaḥ
? paramaprakṛterutpatāvapatyamātre pratyayo labhyate, pratyayāntāt
tūtpatau ṭhgotrādyaūni' (4.1.94) iti vacanāt ṭhyūnyapatye' ityeva
viśeṣaḥ| ṭhyuḍ vādiṣṭasya' iti| ādiṣṭagrahaṇamāyannādeśae kṛte
yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā hyanāditvādāyannādeśo na syāt|
ṭhdāgavyāvaniḥ' iti| ṭhorguṇeḥ' (6.4.146) kṛte ṭhvānto yi pratyaye'
(6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ||

157.udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt| (4.1.157)
ṭhvṛddhāt' iti| ihaiva yatpāribhāṣikaṃ vṛddhaṃ tadÂgṛhyate, na
śāstrāntaraprasiddham, agotrāditi pratiṣedhāt| ṭhkāriśabdāt'

158. vākinādīnāṃ kukca| (4.1.158)
ṭhyadiha vṛddhamagotram' iti| vākinaśabdādikākaparyantam|
ṭhiñādyapavādo yogaḥ' iti| ādiśabdenāṇo grahaṇam| tatra
carmivarmaśabdayoraṇo'pavādaḥ śeṣāṇāmiñaḥ|
ṭhcamivarmiṇornalopaśca' iti| carmin, varmin-- ityetayoḥ
kukphiñau bhavataḥ, nalopaśceti| kuki kṛte
prātipadikasyānakārāntatvānnalopo'tra na prāpnotīti vidhīyate--
cārmikāyaṇiḥ,vārmikāyaṇiḥ||

159. putrāntādanyatarasyām| (4.1.159)
ṭhtena' ityādi| vacanāt pūrvasūtreṇaivodīcāṃ matena yaḥ pakṣe
phiñ vihitastasminnanenānyatarasyāṃ kugāgamo'pi vidhīyate|tena
trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti||

160.prācāmavṛddhātphinbahulam| (4.1.160)
ṭhvikalpārthaḥ' iti| vikalpaprayojanāya| ṭhekenaiva sidhyati' iti|
vikalpārthatvāditi|prakṛtatvādvikalpa iti gamyate| atra ca kimarthaṃ
sarveṣāṃ grahaṇamityadhyāhāryam| tatretyādyautaram| yaccodīcāṃgrahaṇaṃ
yacca prācāṃgrahaṇam, tadubhayaṃ pūjārtham| ṭhbahulagrahaṇaṃ
vaicitryārtham' (iti)| pāriśeṣyādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ
vikalpārthamityuktaṃ bhavati| ṭhkvacit' ityādinā bahulagrahaṇasya
vaicitryārthatāṃ darśayati||

161. manorjātāvañyatau ṣuk ca| (4.1.161)
ṭhtathā ca' ityādi | yasmādapatyārtho'tra nāsti, evañca kṛtvā mānuṣā
iti bahuṣu lugna bhavati| apatyārthe tu sati ṭhyañañośca' (2.4.64) iti
bahuṣu luk prasajyeta|
ṭhapatye kutsite' ityādi| mūrdhanyopasaṃkhyānaparo'yaṃ ślokaḥ|
aṇpratyayo'patyavivakṣāyām ṭhtasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityenaiva sidhyati|
nanu ca mūrdhanyo'pi ca bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtyā sidhyatyeva ? evaṃ tarhi
bahulagrahaṇānuvṛterlabhya evārthaḥ ślokena kathyate| sa cāpi
mūrdhanyo viśiṣṭa eva viṣaye mūḍhādāvapatye bhavati, na sarvatra|
anadhītavedatvadajño mūḍhaḥ| mūḍhatvādeva pratiṣiddhācaraṇādvā kutsito
yaḥ sa brāhmaṇajātīyo māṇava ucyate||

162. apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram| (4.1.162)
prabhṛtiśabda ādiśabdasyārthe| pautraḥ prabhṛtiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| yadi
pautraprabhṛti yadapatyaṃ tadÂgotrasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, gargasyāpi gotrasaṃjñā
prāpnoti, so'pi kañcit prati pautro bhavatyeva| satyāñca
gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ gotraśabdādanantarāpatye pratyayo na prāpnotīti
codyamāśaṅkyāha-- ṭhsambandhiśabdatvāt' ityādi| gotrasaṃjñā hyapatyas
potraprabhṛtervidhīyate| te ca yascāpatyamiti sambandhiśabdo'sau
niyogato'patyavantamapekṣata| tena tasya yadapatyaṃ tadapekṣayā
gotrasaṃjñā vidhīyate| na ca yasya gargaḥ potrastasyāsau
gargo'ptayamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭuam ; apatyatvasya
tatrāpratibhāsanāt| apratibhāsanaṃ pustastasya dvato'vivakṣitatvāt|
yadapi hi tatrāpatyatvaṃ tadapyavivakṣitasvarūpeṇa nākhyātam,
tato'patyasya potraprabhṛtervidhīyate| ataḥ svarūpeṇa pratibhāsamāno na
bhavati gargasya gotrasaṃjñāyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ|ṭhgargasya pautraprabhṛti' iti|
gargasambandhi pautrādyapatyaṃ gārgya iti gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṭhgotre
kuñjādibhyaścphañ' (4.1.98) ityato gotra ityanuvartamāne
ṭhgargādibhyo yaÃñ' (4.1.105) itigotre'patye yañ bhavati|
ṭhapatyamiti vyapadeśo'yam' iti| saṃjñina iti śeṣaḥ| taccotarasūtra
ityabhiprāyaḥ| iha tu pautrasyāpatyatvāvyabhicārāt tadapatyameva
pratyayāntaiḥ vijñāyata iti nārthaḥ saṃjñivyapedaśārthenāpatyagrahaṇena|
utarasūtre tu pautraprabhṛtyetat ṣaṣṭhaḷntaṃ vipariṇamya pautraprabhṛteḥ
sambandhino'patyasya yuvasaṃjñeṣyate, sā cāpatyagrahaṇamantareṇa na
labhyate| anyadapi hyapatyāt pautraprabhṛteḥ sambandhyasti, tatra na
jñāyate-- kasyeyaṃ saṃjñeti ? atastatra saṃjñino vyapadeśāya
yuktamapatyagrahaṇamityeke|
iha tu saṃjñivyapedaśārthaṃ yuktamapatyagrahaṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ| asati
hyapatyagrahaṇe sambnadhiśabdatvādapatyaśabdasyetyādi yaduktaṃ
codyanirāsāya tadaghaṭamānaṃ syāt| tataśca gargasyāpi gotrasaṃjñā
syādeva| tasmādihāpi saṃjñivyapeśāyāpatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva,
apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya saṃjñā yathā syāt|
ṭhanyasya mā bhūt' iti| nanu ca tasmādeva tatprakṛtamapatyagrahaṇaṃ
tadeva saṃjñivyadeśāya bhaviṣyati, tat kimapareṇāpatyagrahaṇena ?
naitadasti; taddhi pratyayārthatayā pkṛtaṃ kathaṃ saṃjñino vyapadeśāya
syāt; syādetat yadyapi tatpratyayārthe kṛtaṃ tathāpi
tasyehānuvṛtas tatprayojanaṃ nāstītyataḥ saṃjñivyapadeśāya
vijñāsyata iti ?etacca nāsti; utarārthaṃ
hyadhikārāṇāmanuvṛtirdṛśyate,vyākhyānañcaivaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt,
vyākhyānācca vacanameva laghutaramityapatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| ṭhkauñji-,
gārgiḥra' iti| anantarasya gotrasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt ṭhgotre
kuñjādibhyaścphañ' (4.1.98), ṭhgargādibhyo yañ' (4.1.105) iti yaśca
gotre vidhīyamāno na sa bhavati||

163. jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā| (4.1.163)
ṭhabhijanaprabandhaḥ' iti| abhajanāḥ u pitāmahādayaḥ, prabandhaḥ u santānaḥ,
tatra bhavo vaṃśya iti digāditvādyat| ṭhpautraprabhṛtyapatyam' iti|
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṭhpautraprabhṛtīti ca' ityādi| yadi pautraprabhṛtītyetat
sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyaṃ viśeṣayet pautraprabhṛti yadapatyamiti
tadārabhya yuvasaṃjñā syāt, taccāniṣṭam| tasmānnaitat
sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyasya viśeṣaṇam kiṃ tarhi ?
arthādvibhavanaktavipariṇāme kṛte ṣaṣṭhaḷntatāmāpannaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyena
pautraprabhṛryadapatyamiti, tathā sati yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate
taddarśayitumāha-- ṭhtena' ityādi| yata evaṃ vibhaktivipariṇāme kṛte
pautraprabhṛtītyanena ṣaṣṭhaḷntenāpatyaṃ viśeṣyate tena caturthādārabhya
yuvasaṃjñā vidhīyate, tasya ca vibhaktapariṇāmasyāpatyaṃ hetuḥ|
apatyaśabdo hi sambandhiśabdatvanāddhetvādyapekṣate,tatra ṣaṣṭhaḷa
heturbhavati| sannihitatvācca| pautraprabhṛti tasyetyetadevāpekṣate,
tatastatraiva ṣaṣṭhaĀ prakalpayati|yadi tarhyapatyagrahamasāmarthyāt
pautraprabhṛteḥ ṣaṣṭhīvipariṇāmo bhavati, pūrvasūtre'pi kasmānna
bhavati ? tatra prathamāyā anavakāśatvāt| pūrvasūtre hyakṛtārthā prathamā,
tato na śakyate tasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaĀ vipariṇamayitum| iha tu kṛtārthā
śakyate ṣaṣṭhībhāvena vipariṇamayitum| ṭhgārgyāyaṇaḥ' iti| iha
yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṭhgotrādyaūnyastriyām' (4.1.94) iti
gotrapratyayāntādyaūni pratyayo bhavati| ṭhtu śabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ' iti|
kaḥ punaḥ saṃjñāsamāveśe doṣaḥ kathyate ? śālaṅkerapatyaṃ yuvā
ṭhyañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak, pailasyāpatyaṃ yuvā ṭhaṇo
dvyacaḥ'(4.1.156) ita phiñ,tayoḥ ṭhpailādibhyaśca' (1.4.59) iti
lugucyate-- śālaṅkiryuvā, pailo yuveti| yadi ca
gotrayuvasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśaḥ syāt tadā śālaṅkeryūnaśchātrā
ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ prāgdīvyatīye'jādau pratyaye viṣayabhūte
gotrādayaḥ ṭhgotre'lugaci' (4.1.89) ityaluk syāt| tatastasmādyaūno
gotrasaṃjñā mā bhūdityavadhāraṇārthastuśabdaḥ kriyate||

164. bhrātari ca jyāyasi| (4.1.164)
bhrātṛśabdas sambandhiśabdatvādyadapekṣaṃ bhrātṛtvaṃ meva bhrātaraṃ
saṃjñitvenopakṣipati| jyāyāniti praśasyatarovṛddhataraścābhidhīyate|
tasya ca jyāyastvaṃ guṇairvayasā vā| yuvānaṃ pratiyoginamapekṣya
bhavatīti sa eva jyāyasītyanena pratiyogī pratyupasthāpyate| tena
bhrātureva kanīyasaḥ saṃjñā vijñāsyata iti matvāha-- ṭhkanīyān bhrātaḥ
yavasaṃjño bhavati' iti| ṭhpūrvajāḥ' ityādinā avaṃśyārthatāmārambhasya
samarthayate| ṭhakāraṇatvāt' ityanenāpi bhrāturavaṃśyatvam| yo hi
sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa vā kāraṇaṃ sa vaṃśyaḥ, na ca bhrātā kāraṇam,
tasmādasau vaṃśyo na bhavatīti|| gārgye jīvati bhrātari
jīvatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ vātsye jīvati vātsyāyano'sya kanīyān bhrātā,
dākṣau jīvati dākṣāyaṇo'sya kanīyān bhrātā veditavyaḥ||

165. vānyasmin sapiṇḍe sthaviratare jīvati| (4.1.165)
ṭhsaptamapuruṣāvadhayaḥ' iti| saptamaḥ puruṣo'vadhiryeṣāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ
te tathoktāḥ samānapiṇḍāḥ,nipātanāt sabhāvaḥ, ṭhsamānasya' (6.3.84)
iti yogavibhāgādvā| tasya ca yogavibhāgasyaitalliṅgam, tena
sapiṇḍāḥ śāstreṣvā saptamātpuruṣāt| pareṇa ye te sapiṇḍā
nocyante| ṭhyeṣām' ityatyādhikāra iti pareṇa sambandhaḥ|
ṭhubhayatra' iti| janmani maraṇe ca| ṭhityevamādikāyām' iti|
ādiśabdena nivṛtty#adikāḥ kriyāśca gṛhyante| tathā coktam---
ubhayatra daśāhāni kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate|
dānaṃ pratigraho yajñaḥ svādhyāyaśca nivartate|| iti||
ṭhjīvati' iti| saptamyekavacanametat| prathamāyāśca sthāne
subvyatyayena saptamī vihitā, ata evāha-- ṭhjīvadeva' iti|
ṭhtarabnirdeaśaḥ' ityādi| asati hi tarabnirdeaśe
sthaviraśabdādvayaḥprakarṣamātraṃ gamyate, tarapā tu sthānaprakarṣo'pi
gamyate| tasmādubhayorutkarṣārthastarabnirdeaśaḥ kṛtaḥ| ṭhpitṛvye
pitāmahe bhrātari ca' iti | dvāvapyetau sthānata utkṛṣṭau|
sthānaśabdena ceha sambandhaviśeṣa ucyate; anekārthatvāddhātūnām|
ṭhgārgya eva bhavati' iti| na gārgyāyaṇaḥ|yuvasaṃjñāyāmasatyāṃ
yuvapratyayasya phako'nutpateḥ | ṭhmṛte' iti| sthaviratare sapiṇḍe|
ṭhmṛto vā' iti| pautraprabhṛtirapyatra mṛto'rthaḥ||

166. vṛddhasya ca pūjāyām| (4.1.166)
ṭhapatyamantarhitam' ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa paribhāṣitaṃ yadÂvṛddhaṃ
tatparigṛhyate, na tu yadiha śāstre paribhāṣitaṃ taditi darśayati|
kutaḥ punaretadavagatam-- śāstrāntaraparibhāṣitamiha vṛddhatvaṃ gṛhyata
iti ? apatyādhikārāt| śabdātmakasya vṛddhasyāpatvāsambhavādvijñāyate|
ṭhpūjāyāṃ gamyamānāyām' iti| kā punariha pūjā vivakṣitā ?
yuvatvameva| taddhi loke sarvaprāṇināmabhimatam| nanu ca neha
yuvaśabdo vayaḥ padārthaka evāyaṃ yuvaśabdo gotre vartiṣyate|
ṭhsaṃjñāsāmarthyāt' ityādinā saṃjñāpraṇayanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati|
gotrapratyayenābhihitamapi gotram| saṃjñāsāmarthyāt
punaryuvapratyayo vidhīyate gārgyāyaṇa iti| atha kimarthaṃ vṛddhasyeti
ṣaṣṭhaḷa nirdeaśaḥ kriyate, na vṛddhamiti prathamāntaṃ nirdiśyate,evaṃ hi
laghu sūtraṃ bhavati ? ityāha-- ṭhvṛddhasya' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau|
yasmādvicitrā sūtrasya kṛtiḥ; tasmādÂvṛddhasyeti ṣaṣṭhaḷa nirdeaśaḥ|
evaṃ hi sūtre kṛte vaicitryaṃ sambhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ|ṭhtatra bhavān
gārgyāyaṇaḥ' iti| tatrabhavaccchabdasya pūjāvacanasya prayogeṇa pūjāṃ
gamayatīti||

167. yūnaśca kutsāyām| (4.1.167)
nanu ca yuvasaṃjñā pūrvamevābhinirvṛtā,yadāha-- ṭhyūnaśca' iti|na
hyasatyāṃ tasyāmayaṃ nirdeaśa upapadyate, tadabhinirvṛtāyāstasyāḥ
punarvikalpena vidhānamanupapannamityata āha-- ṭhnivṛtipradhāno
vikalpaḥ' iti| nāyaṃ vidhipradhāno vikalpaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ?
pratiṣedhapratipādanapara ityarthaḥ| siddhāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ gotrasaṃjñā
vaktavyāḥ; anyathā yūno gotrapratyayenābhidhānaṃ na syāt ? ityata
āha-- ṭhyuvasaṃjñāyām' ityādi| gotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñā pratipakṣaḥ
pratyanīkaḥ| sā cennivṛtā gotrasaṃjñaiva pravartate; pratipakṣābhāvāt,
ato na vaktabgeti bhāvaḥ| ṭhgārgyo jālmaḥ'iti| jālmaśabdas
kutsāvacanas prayogeṇa kutsāṃ gamayati| kutsā punariha yūno
vṛddhatayābhidhānasyaivānabhimatatvāt| ata evākutsite yuveti
vākyārthaṃ padamanvākhyāyate| sā ca kutsā yā'nyā vā tato veti
viśeṣo nāśrīyate, yathā-- kadannādiviṣaye devadatādīnām||

168. janapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ| (4.1.168)
janapadavṛtiśabdaḥ pañcālādirjanapada ityuktaḥ,kṣatriyavṛtiḥ kṣatriya
ityabhidhāne'bhidheyopacārāt, sāhacaryādvā| nanu pañcālādayaḥ
śabdāḥ, te ṭhtasya nivāsaḥ' (4.2.69) iti taddhite kṛte tasya ṭhjanapade
lup' (4.2.81) iti lupi ca janapade vartante, tat kathamavarakālayā
janapadaśabdatayā nityāḥ kṣatriyaśabdā viśeṣyante ? kathaṃ punaḥ
kṣatriyasambandhādete janapade vartanta ityetadabhidhātumarhati
vidvān| sūtrakāreṇa hi ṭhtadaśi,Âyaṃ
saṃjñāpramāṇatvālluvyogāprakhyānāt' (1.2.53,54) itiyuktavadbhāvaṃ
lupañca pratyādiśatā janapade kṣatriyeṣviva svata eva
pañcālādiśabdasya vṛtiruktā| yathā śabdā nityāstathā pañcālādirapi
janapada iti kuto janapadavacanānatāyā avarakālatā !ṭhpāñcālaḥ'
ityādi| pañcālādayaḥ śabdā deśe santaḥ kṣatriyavācino'pi bhavanti
svabhāvata eva, tebhyo'patyārthe'ñ| ṭhaikṣvākaḥ' iti| ikṣvākuśabdasya
ṭhdāṇḍināyanahastināyana' (6.4.174) ityādau sūtre ukāralopo
nipātitaḥ|
ṭhdrauhyavaḥ' iti| drahyuśabdaḥ kṣatriyavacana eva, na janapadaśabdaḥ, tenāṇeva
bhavati| ṭhpāñcālirvaidehiḥ' iti| iha pañcālavidehaśabdau bhavato
janapadaśabdau, na tu kṣatriyavacanau| api tu brāhmaṇavacano, teneñeva
bhavati| 
ṭhkṣatriyasamānaśabdāt' ityādi| kṣatriyavacana eva śabda upacāreṇa
kṣatriya ityuktaḥ janapadaśabdo janapada iti| kṣatriyeṇa samānaḥ śabdo
yasya sa tathoktaḥ| tasmāt kṣatriyasamānaśabdādasyeti
ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādrājanyabhidheye'patyavat pratyayotpatiriti vaktavyam|
ṭhavṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt' (4.2.125) (iti) prāptasya
vuño'pavādaḥ| yathā pañcālasyāpatyamityatra bhavati pāñcālaḥ, tathā
pañcālānāṃ rājā pāñcāla ityatrāpi bhavati|ṭhmāgadhaḥ' iti|
magadhaśabdādapatye ṭhdvyañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādināṇ bhavati, tathā
tas yarājetyatrāpi||

171. vṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅ| (4.1.171) 
vṛddhagrahaṇeneha ṭhvṛddhiryasyācāmādistaddvṛddham' (1.1.73) iti gṛhyate,

172. kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ| (4.1.172)
añaṇorapavādaḥ| kuruśabdasyatu dvyajlakṣaṇasyāṇaḥ| kuruśabdāt

atastaṃ bādhituṃ punarṇyo vidhīyate|| 

173. sālvāvayavapratyagrathakalakūṭāśmakādiñ| (4.1.173)
ṭhajapīṣyate' iti| tannāmikālakṣaṇaḥ| kuto vijñāyate ? sālva iti

bhavanti| ataste'pyaupacārikaṃ sālvāpadeśamāsādayanti||

174. te tadrājāḥ| (4.1.174)

hi yadantarā vyavadhāyaṃ kṛtaṃ tasyaitadeva prayojanam| tena ye

bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām' (2.4.62) ityatra kāryāśrayamudāhṛtam| iha tu
prakaraṇe rūpāśrayam||

177. ataśca| (4.1.177)
ṭhtakāro vispaṣṭārthaḥ' iti| takāre hyasati ṭhasya' iti nirdeaśena
bhavitavyam, tataśca samānatvānnirdeaśasya sandehaḥ syāt--
kimayavamavarṇasya nirdeaśaḥ ? āhostavit idamaḥ ? iti| takāre tu
satyeṣa doṣo na bhavati; taparasya vaṇaṣveva prasiddhatvāt|
dīrghanivṛtyarthastu takāro na bhavati, dīrghasyāsambhavāt|
ṭhsūrasenī| madrī' iti| sūrasenāśabdādyo'ñ, mdaraśabdādyo
dvyajlakṣaṇo'ṇ -- tayorluki kṛte
ṭhjāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣ| ṭhdarat' iti|
daraccchabdād dvyañmagadhalakṣaṇasyāṇo (4.1.170) luk|
yadi ṭhataḥ' iti varṇasyedaṃ grahaṇam, evaṃsati varṇagrahamaṃ tadantavidhiṃ
prayojayatītīhāpi prāpnoti--- āmbaṣaṣṭhaḷa, sauvīryā iti ? ata
āha-- ṭhavantyādibhya luk' ityādi| yadyatra tadantavidhiḥ
syādavantyādibhyo lugvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; anenaiva siddhatvāt|
tadantavidhāvasatyakāragrahaṇamātreṇa na sidhyatītyavantyādibhyo
lugvacanamanarthavadbhavati||
