 atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ 
dvitīyo pādaḥ| 
1. tena raktaṃ rāgāt| (4.2.1)
rañjirayamastyevānurāge -- deve raktaḥ, striyāṃ rakta iti; asti ca
varṇaviśeṣe -- rakto gauriti, lohita ityarthaḥ; asti śuklasya
varṇāntarāpādane --raktaḥ paṭa iti, śuklamapanīya raktādikaṃ
varṇāntaramāpādita ityarthaḥ| iha tṛtīye'rthe vartamāno gṛhyate,
yadāha-- ṭhśuklasya' ityādi| rāgaśabdo'yamastyeva bhāvasādhanaḥ, asti
ca karaṇasādhanaḥ; tatreha dvitīyo gṛhyate, yadāha-- ṭhrajyate'neneti
rāgaḥ' iti| rāgagrahaṇena cārthasya grahaṇam, na svarūpasya| tena
rāgaviśeṣavācinaḥ prātipadikāt pratyayo vijñāyate, na tu
rāgaśabdādevetyata āha-- ṭhrāgaviśeṣavācinaḥ prātipadikāt' iti|
atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? arthaparatvānnirdeaśasya| yatra śabdaparo
nirdeaśastatra svarūpaṃ gṛhyate,na yatrārthaparo nirdeaśa iti prāk
pratipāditameva| arthaparatvañca
nirdeaśasyāviccchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśādgamyate| yadi tarhi
śuklasya varṇāntarāpādanamityabhiprāyeṇāha-- ṭhkatham' iti|
ṭhupamānāt' ityādi parihāraḥ| yathā ṭhgaurvāhīkaḥ'
ityupamānādÂgośabdo'rthāntare vāhīke vartate,tathehāpi
kāṣāyādiśabdo gardabhakarṇādāviti bhāvaḥ||

2. lākṣārocanāśakalakardamāṭṭhak| (4.2.2)
ṭhśakalakardamābhyāmaṇapīṣyate' iti| sa ca ṭhvānyasmin sapiṇḍe'
(4.1.165) ityato maṇḍūakaplutinyāyena vāgrahaṇānuvṛterlabhyate| na
caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅgo bhavati; vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt||

3. nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ| (4.2.3)
iha kālaṃ kriyātmānaṃ kecidiccchinti, apare
dravyātmānamākāśādikalpam| darśanadvayamapi
caitadihāśrayitumayuktam| pūrvasmin darśane samāśrīyamāṇe
sūryādidravayāntarsayāyāṃ vā kriyāyā nakṣatreṇa yogaḥ syāt ?
ātmasthāyā vā ? pūrvasyāstāvanna sambhavati, arthāntarāsamavāyāt|
anyathā hyākāśādayo'pi kriyāvantaḥ syu| na hyarthāntarasamavāyinyā api
kriyāyā dravyāntareṇa yogaḥ syāt| ātmasthāyāstu kriyāyā vidyate
nakṣatreṇa yogaḥ, kintu yuktagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate;
vyavacchedyābhāvāt| na hi puṣyādisthāyāḥ kālasya puṣyādibhiḥ
kadācidyogo yujyate yadvyavacchedārthaṃ yuktagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| evaṃ
tāvat ṭhkriyā kālaḥ' ityetaddarsanamatrāśrayitumayuktam|
dvitīyamapyayuktameva; yasmāt kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇaheturiha
yogo'bhipretaḥ| tathā hi kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇārthameva
pauṣītyādiloke prayujyate| sa caivaṃvidho yogastayoreva
bhavatīti yayoḥ sannikarṣaviprakarṣe staḥ, yathā-- puṣyacandramasoḥ|
tayorhi kadācit sannikarṣo bhavati, tadācidviprakarṣaḥ| na ca
nakṣatrakālayoḥ kadācit sannikarṣaviprakarṣaiḥ
staḥ,tayornityatvādityetaccetasi kṛtvāha-- ṭhkathaṃ punaḥ' itya#adi|
na kathañcidityabhiprāyaḥ| nakṣatranikaṭavartini candramasi vartamānaḥ sūtre
nakṣatraśabda upāta ityetat sūcayannāha-- ṭhpuṣyādisamīpasthe' ityādi|
yataiva hi sāmīpyāt ṭhgaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' iti gaṅgāsamīpasthe
deśe gaṅgāśabdo vartate, tathehāpi puṣyadayo
nakṣatraviśeṣavācinaḥ śabdāḥ puṣyādisamīpasthe candramasi vartante|
tena tatraiva vartamānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti| tena
pukhyādisamīpasthacandramasā kālasya viśeṣāvadhāraṇaheturyoga
upapadyate| tadavasthasya candramasaḥ kādācitkatvāt| puṣyasamīpasthena
candramasā yukta ityarthaḥ; tadavasthe candramasi puṣyaśabdasya vṛteḥ|
ṭhpauṣī' iti| ṭhsūryatiṣyāgastyamastyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ (6.4.149) ityatra
ṭhptiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi yalopaḥ' iti mu.pāṭha|}
tiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi' (vā.808) iti vacanādyalopaḥ||

4. lubaviśeṣe| (4.2.4)
yadyaviśeṣe lugbhavati, ihāpi prāpnoti-- pauṣī
rātriḥ,pauṣamahariti, atrāpyaviśeṣī gamyata eva| tathā hi--
pauṣīrātrirityukte, adya śvo veti viśeṣo na gamyata ityata āha-- ṭhna
cet nakṣatrayuktasya' ityādi| evaṃ manyate-- ṭhnakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ'
(4.2.3) ityanuvartate, tena tadviśeṣa eva na bhavatīti|
ṭhrātryādiviśeṣaḥ' iti|ādiśabdenāha, muhūrtaḥ, lavaḥ-- ityete
viśeṣā gṛhyante| ṭhyāvān' ityādi| anantaroktamevārthaṃ
vispaṣṭīkaroti| kiyāṃśca kālo nakṣatreṇa yujyate ? ahorātraḥ|
tadevaṃ yāvān kālo nakṣatreṇa yuktastasyāviśeṣe na gamyate, api
tu tadekadeśasya rātreḥ, ahno veti nāyaṃ lupo viṣayaḥ| yadyevam,
pratyayasyāpi kathamekadeśo viṣayaḥ ?samudāyadvāreṇa tadantaḥpātino
gṛhyante| ekadeśānāmapi yogāt pūrveṇa pratyayotpatiḥ siddhā
bavati| punarihāvayavasyaikadeśo lupo viṣaya iti| iha tarhi
prāpnoti-- pauṣo'horātra iti, at yāvān kālo nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ,
tasyāviśeṣo gamyate, tathā hyahorātra ityukte na jñāyate-- kimatītaḥ,
athānāgataḥ,atha vartamāna iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; aviśeṣa iti
prasajyapratiṣedho'yam| tena nakṣatrayuktasya kālasya yatra viśeṣo
rārtyādistatra na lugbhavatīti jñāyate, na tu yatrāviśeṣastatra tu
lubbhavatīti||

5. saṃjñāyāṃ śravaṇāśvatthābhyām| (4.2.5)
ṭhlupi yuktavadbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati' iti| yadi syāt, śravaṇaśabdasya
puṃlliṅgatā syāt| ṭhnipātanāt' ityādinā parihāraḥ| gatārthaḥ||

6. dvandvāccchaḥ| (4.2.6)
nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ yatprakṛtaṃ tadihārthāt ṣaṣṭhaḷntaṃ vipariṇamyate|tena
nakṣatrāṇāṃ yo dvandvastasmāt pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha--
ṭhnakṣatradvandvāt' iti| ṭhviśeṣe cāviśeṣe ca' iti| aviśeṣagrahaṇasya
nivṛtatvāt| ṭhadya rādhānurādhīyam' iti| nanu cāviśeṣe lupā
bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ pratyayasya śravaṇamityāha-- ṭhlupaṃ
paratvādbādhate' iti||

7. dṛṣṭaṃ sāma| (4.27)

(5.2.55) iti tīyaṃ vakṣyati, tadantāt svārtha īkagvaktavyaḥ|
ṭhna vidyāyāḥ'iti| vidyāyā abhidhāne tīyādīkagna bhavati|
ṭhgotrādahkavat' iti| yathā tasyāṅka ityatrārthe vivanakṣite
gotrāt pratyayo bhavati, ṭhtena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma' (4.2.7) ityatrārthe
vivakṣite tathaiveṣyate| ṭhāṬpavena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma' iti| āṬpagavaśabdaḥ
ṭhtasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) itigotrapratyayāntaḥ| ṭhgotracaraṇādÂvuñ
bhavati' iti| yathaupagavasyāyamaṅka āṬpagavaka
ityaupagavaśabdādÂgotrapratyayāntādaṅke vuñbhavati, tathā ṭhtena
dṛṣṭaṃ sāma' ityatrāpi| nanu ca ṭhgotracaraṇādÂvuñ' (4.3.126) ityatra
nāṅkārtha upātaḥ, tatkathamanenāhkavadityucyamāne vuñ bavati ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatrāṅkavadityanena vihitasyedamartho vivakṣyate| ṭhtena
gotrapratyayāntādyathā ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityatrārthe pratyaya iṣyate,

9. vāmadevāḍḍaḷḍḍaḷai| (4.2.9)
ṭhpudāharaṇadvayaṃ mūle nāsti, evameva vāmadevy iti dṛśyate|}
vāmadevyam, vāgamadevyam' iti| ekastitsvareṇāntasvaritaḥ,
dvitīyaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ|
ṭhṅtkiraṇaṃ kimarthamÂ' iti| ṭhyasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityevaṃ lopasya
siddhatvāḍÂḍitkaraṇasyānarthakyaṃ manyate-- ḍaḷḍḍaḷavityādi| na
vāmadevyamavāmadevyamiti-- -- atra ṭhnaño guṇapratiṣedhe
sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ' (6.2.155) ityato naña ityanuvartamāne
ṭhyayatoścātadarthe' (6.2.156) ityutarapadasyāntodātatve
vidhīyamāne'nayorgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartha ḍitkaraṇam| asati ca
tatrānayorgrahaṇe naña eva svaro bhavati, sa punarudātaḥ| ṭhnipātā

ḍitkaraṇe kasmādanayorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati ? ityāhṛ-- ṭhniranubandhagrahaṇe

nivṛtiḥ kriyate| yadÂgrahaṇe'pi ṭhekānubandhakaraṇe na
dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) iti paribhāṣayā yataḥ| anayośca

saṅgrahaśloke ṭhatadarthe' ityanena ṭhyayatoścātadarthe' (6.2.156)

10. parivṛto rathaḥ| (4.2.10)
ṭhcārmaṇaḥ'iti| ṭhan' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāve ṭilopo na bhavati|
ṭhna saṃyogā4dvamantāt' (6.4.137) ityallopo na bhavati|
atheha kasmānna bhavati-- chāttraiḥ parivṛto ratha iti ? atrāha--
ṭhsamantādveṣṭitaḥ' ityādi| vṛṇotirayaṃ veṣṭane vartate, tasya
pariṇā sarvato bhāvo dyotyate| tasmādyaḥ sarvato veṣṭaḷte tatraiva
tyayena bhavitavyam, na tu chāttraiḥ rathaḥ sarvato veṣṭitaḥ, tato na
tatra pratyayasya prasaṅgaḥ| yastu chāttraiḥ parivṛto ratha iti
prayogaḥ,saparivṛtasyādhyāropeṇaupacārikaḥ|naca mukhye sati
parivṛtatve gauṇasyādhyāropitasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam||

11.pāṇḍukambalādiniḥ| (4.2.11)
ṭhpāṇḍukambalī' iti| ṭhsau ca' (6.4.13) iti dīrghaḥ|
ṭhmatvarthīyenaiva siddhe' iti| yaddhi yena samntādveṣṭitaṃ tat
tasyāsti| tasmāt ṭhata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) iti mtavarthīyeneninā
siddhe yatadvacanaṃ tadaṇo nivṛtyartham| yadi labhyeta, tannārabhyeta|
yadi hyaetadvacanaṃ na syāt, tadā ṭhparivṛto rathaḥ'(4.2.10)
ityaṇprasajyet, tataśca pāṇḍukambala iti syāt, pāṇḍukambalīti
ceṣyate| tasmādaṇninṛtyarthamucyate||

12. dvaipavaiyāghrādañ| (4.2.12)
ṭhdvīpivyāghrayorvikāra' ityādi| dvīpino vikāraścarma, vyāghrasya
vikāraścarma-- ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ ṭhprāṇirajatādvibhyo'ñ' (4.3.154)
ityañpratyayāntatvāt dvaipavaiyāghraśabdayoḥ, tābhyāmiha
dvīpivyāghravikāratvāccarmaṇi abhidhīyete| carmaṇaiva
dvīpivyāghravikāreṇa rathasya parivṛtatvaṃ sambhavati, na
vikāramātreṇeti carmaṇī iha dvaipavaiyāghraśabdābhyāṃ vivakṣite iti
gamyate||

13. kaumārāpūrvavacane| (4.2.13)
ṭhapūrvavacane'iti| apūrvasya vacana iti, apūrvābhidhāna ityarthaḥ|
kasyāpūrvavacanamityāha--ṭhpāṇigrahaṇasya' ityādi| etacca
sāmānyoktāvapi nipātanasāmarthyāllabhyate| yathaiva hi
nipātanasāmarthyādanyadapi kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ
labhyate,tathedamapi| ṭhubhayataḥ striyām' ityādi| yadi kaumāra iti
pumānabhidhīyate, evamapyasyāpūrvatvaṃ yadā striyā eva viśeṣaṇaṃ
bhavati, na puṃsaḥ evamatannipātyate nānyathetyarthaḥ| ṭhapūrvapatim'
iti| nāsyāḥ pūrvaḥ patiriti bahuvrīhiḥ| patyā saha yasyāḥ
pāṇigrahaṇaṃ nivṛtaṃ sā'pūrvapatiḥ| tāṃ patirupapannaḥ
prāptavānityarthaḥ| ṭhapūrvapatiḥ' iti| ayamapi bahuvrīhiḥ|
ṭhkaumārāpūrvavacane' ityādi| kaumāra ityetannipātyate,
apūrvavacane| kiṃ punariha nipātyata ityāha-- ṭhkumāryā aṇvidhīyate'
iti| kumārīśabdādaṇ nipātyata ityarthaḥ| kadetyāha-- ṭhapūrvatvaṃ
yadā tasyāḥ' iti| iha hi nipātanena pumānabhidhīyate, strī vā,tatra
dvayorapi pakṣayorapūrvatvam| yadā tasyāḥ striyā viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati,
na puṃsaḥ, tadetannipātanam, nānyathetyarthaḥ| ṭhkumāryā bhavatīti vā'
iti| anena yogaḥ pratyākhyāyate| yo hi kumāraĀ prāptavānasau tatra
bhavati| tatasca ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) iti śaiṣike bhavārthe'ṇantaṃ
kaumāraśabdaṃ vyutpadyeta,tataḥ puṃyagolakṣaṇe ṅīṣi sati hi
kumārītyetat siddham| svarakṛto viśeṣo nāstyeva| tathā hi
aṇantānṅīṣyapi kṛte ṭhyasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lope ca
ṭhanudātasya ca yatrodātalopaḥ' (6.1.161) ityudātena ṅīpā

21. sāsminpaurṇamāsīti saṃjñāyām| (4.2.21)
ṭhtataścedvivakṣā bhavati' iti| tata iti pratyayānto nirdiśyate|
etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadi pratyayāntālloke'sya vivakṣā bhavatyevaṃ
pratyayo bhavati; nānyathetyarthaḥ| ṭhpratyayāntena ca' ityādinā saṃjñāyāḥ

tadantānṅīp|

ṭhprayogānusaraṇam' iti| prayogānusaraṇaṃ prayogopalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ|

bhṛtakamāsādau| iti karaṇenāpyetadeva kriyate| tathā hi--
pratyayāntādyadi lokasyārthavivakṣā bhavati, evaṃ hi pratyaya
utpādayitavyaḥ, nānyatheti| evamarthamitikaraṇa upādīyate, tataśca
lokavivakṣā māsārdhamāsasaṃvatsaraviṣayā bhavati, evaṃ hi na
bhṛtakamāsādiviṣayā| tasmāt proyagānusaraṇam, ubhayorapi phalaṃ
tulyameva| ṭhsaṃjñā' ityādi| nanu ca yathā saṃjñāśabdaḥ
prayogānusaraṇaphalatayā loke prasiddhaḥ, tathetikaraṇo'pi,
tatkimarthamiha tasya tena tulyatvameva jñāyate ? ityāha--- ṭhna hyayam'
ityādi| tathā hi-- loke'yaṃ saṃjñāśabdaḥ prayogānusaraṇaphalatvena
yathā prasiddhaḥ, na tathetikaraṇaḥ| tasmādasya tena tulyatā jñāpiteti
bhāvaḥ| ṭhsaṃjñārthatveṭa ityādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati|
saṃjñayā tulyo'rtho yasya sa saṃjñārthaḥ| samāsena gamyamānatvāt
tulyaśabdo na prayujyate, yathā ṭhrucyarthānām' (1.4.33) ityatra
rucinā samānaśabda iti bhāvaḥ| saṃjñārthasya bhāvaḥ u saṃjñārthatvam|
arthaśabdaścāyaṃ prayojanavacanaḥ| ṭhtadupapannaṃ bhavati' iti| yata eva
saṃjñāśabdenetikaraṇasya tulyārthatā jñāpitā tena yatra yatra
prayogānusāraṇārthaṃ itikaraṇaḥ, tatastataśca vivakṣā bhavatītyucyate--
tadupapannaṃ bhavatīti; itakaraṇasya saṃjñāprayojanatvāt|
ṭhpūrṇamāsādaṇ' iti| pūrṇo māso yasyaṃ tithāviti tatrārthe
bahuvrīhiḥ| asmādeva nipatānādaṇ| pūrṇamāsasyeyaṃ ṭhpaurṇamāsī'|

24. sāsya devatā| (4.2.24)
ṭhtasminnabhidheye' iti| yāgasampradānabhūtadevatāsvāminīke

nāsti; mantraśabdābhāvena mantrastulyatathānupātatvāt| tasmādatra
pratyayena na bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| ṭhupamānādbhaviṣyati' iti|
devatāsvāminīka evātra pratyaya upapadyate| yastvarthāntare
pratyayāntaprayogaḥ sa āgneya ivāgneya ityupamānādbhaviṣyati,
yathā-- kāṣāyau gargabhasya karṇāviti| nanu ca sāsmin
paurṇamāsīti seti prakṛtameva| tatkimarthaṃ punariha
samarthavibhaktirnirdeaśyata ityata āhu-- ṭhseti prakṛte' ityādi| yadidaṃ

59. tadadhīte tadveda| (4.2.59)

proktārthavihitasya cāṇa ihopasarjanatvāt||

67. tadasminnastīti deśe tannāmni| (4.3.67)
ṭhpratyayāntanāmā' iti| yadi tarhi tannāmni deśe pratyayaḥ,
itikaraṇo'narthakaḥ, tannāmagrahaṇādevātiprasaṅganivṛtiḥ ?
naitadasti; dvividhaṃ hi nāma-- saṅketitam, anuvṛtañca|
saṅketitaṃ yadadyāpi vyavahārapadavīṃ nānupatati, tatrānuvṛtaṃ
yannāma tatrāyaṃ yogaḥ| anuvṛtañca vyāvahārikam,
tatpratipatyarthamitikaraṇaḥ kriyate, grāmādiviśeṣaparigrahārthaśca|
yadyevam, itikaraṇa eva kriyatām, kiṃ tannāmnītyanena ? etadapi na
kartavyam; nāmadheyatā virodhino'pi balīyaso'pi pratyayān
bādhitvam| katham ? nāprāpte matupyayaṃ yoga ārabhyamāṇe
matupamavādatvādbādhate| tadapavādaistviniṭhanādibhiḥ saha
sampradhāraṇāyāmapavādavipratiṣedhādiniṭhanādaya eva syuḥ| nāmagrahaṇe
tu sati balīyobhirapi sampradhāraṇāyāḥ sampratyayo bhavati-- yo
nāmadheyatāṃ gamayati sa cāturthika eveti| ataḥ sa eva bhavati||

68. tena nirvṛtatam| (4.2.68)

77. suvāstvādibhyo'ṇ| (4.2.77)
ṭhuvarmāntalakṣaṇasya' ityādi| ya uvarṇāntāstebhyaḥ ṭhorañ' (4.2.71) iti
prāptasyāño'pavādaḥ| śeṣebhyaśca ṭhbahvacaḥ kūpeṣu' (4.2.73) ityādinā
prāptasya kūpalakṣaṇsya| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, subāstvādibhyo
yatāvihitamevocyeta| punarvacanaṃ yo vihito na ca prāpnoti
tadartaṃ vijñāyate| aṇeva ca vihito na prāpnoti; apavādena
bādhitvā |atha sa bhaviṣyītyata āha-- ṭhaṇgrahaṇam' ityādi| asati
hyaṇgrahaṇe ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante notarān'
(vyā.pa.10) iti nadīmatupā saha samprasāraṇāyāṃ paratvānnadīpamatup
syāt| aṇo grahaṇādaṇeva bhavati| tasmānmatupo
bādhanārthaṇgrahaṇam||

78. roṇī| (4.2.78)
ṭhko'yaṃ nirdeaśaḥ'iti| kutsito'yaṃ nirdeaśa ityarthaḥ| kutsitaṃ tu
lakṣaṇātikrāntatvāt| tadeva lakṣaṇātikrāntatvaṃ darśayitumāha
ṭhyāvatā'ityādi| sarvāvasthā ca kevalasya tadantasya ca pratipatiḥ
prakṛtatvena yathā syādityevamarthamucyate| yadi ṭhroṇyāḥ'
ityādinirdeaśaḥ kriyeta tadā ṭhgrahaṇavatā prātipadikena
tadantavidhirna' (vyā.pa.89) iti kevalādeva syāta, na tadantāt|
roṇīti śāstrānapekṣeṇa nirdeaśena śāstranirapekṣatvamihocyate,
tadasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anapekṣaṇādiha tadantāpi pratyayaḥ siddho bhavati.
nanu ca grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, na cedaṃ
prātipadikam; strīpratyayāntatvāt| atha matam-- ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe
liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.29) iti prātipadikasya
tadantavidheḥ pratiṣidhyamānaḥ strīpratyayāntasyāpi pratiṣidhyata
iti,etacca yatra hi prātipadikasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tadviṣayā paribhāṣeti
prāg jñāpitametat ? evaṃ tarhi tasya jñāpanasya prāyikatvaṃ darśayati|
tena kvacidasvarūpagrahaṇe'pyeṣā paribhāṣā pravartate| tena
kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayatītyatra ṭhjātiṣṭhavat prātipadikasya'
(vā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvaḥ siddho bhavati||

91. naḍādīnāṃ kuk ca| (4.2.91)
ṭhkruñcāyā hrasvatvañca' iti| kruñcāśabdasya kugbhavati hrasvatvañca--
ṭhkrauñcakīyam' iti| ṭhtikṣannalopaśca' iti| takṣannityasya kugāgamo

92. śeṣe| (4.2.92)
ṭhupayuktādanyaḥ śeṣaḥ' ityetadgrahaṇakavākyam| tadeva
ṭhapatyādibhyaḥ'ityādinā vivṛṇoti|apatyādayo hi
cāturarthyaparyantāḥ pratyayavidhau viniyuktāḥ, tasmāt tebhyo
yo'nyo jātādirarthaḥ,sa śeṣaḥ| nanu ca nivṛtā apatyādayaḥ,
tebhyaścāntareṣu jātādiṣi yeṣu ghādayastato'patyādiṣu naiva te
prāpnuvantīti tatkiṃ tannivṛtyarthena śeṣādhikāreṇa ? itya āha--
ṭhtasyedam' ityādi| jātādiṣvartheṣu tasyedamityeṣo'rthaḥ paṭhaḷte|
taccāpatyādīnāṃ sāmānyam| sāmānye ca vidhīyamānastadviśeṣe'pi
vidhīyate| tadupalakṣaṇatvāt sāmānyasya| atastasyedaṃ
viśeṣatvājjātādyantaḥpātiṣvapatyādiṣu ghādayaḥ prāpnuvanti| tasmāt
teṣu mā bhūvanniti śeṣādhikāraḥ kriyate|
ṭhkiñca' ityādinā prayojanāntaraṃ darśayati| asati hi śeṣādhikāre
ghādīnāṃ prathamārthenaiva sambandhamanubhavatāṃ tatraiva kṛtārthatā
vijñāyeta| tatra dvitīyādiṣvartheṣu prāgdīvyatīyā evāṇādayaḥ syuḥ, na
tu ghādayaḥ| śeṣaśabdastūpayuktādanyatayā jātādīnarthānekīkṛtya
śaknotyabhidhātum-- ṭhsarvatra ghādayaḥ sidhyantīti| ataḥ sākalyārthaṃ vā
śeṣavacanam| ṭhlakṣamaṃ cādhikāraśca, iti| iha lakṣaṇasya
vidhāyakatvāllakṣyate'neneti lakṣaṇamiti kṛtvā; utaratrādhikāraḥ
svaritatvāt| tatra yadā'sya lakṣaṇam,cākṣuṣādayaḥ sidhyanti| yadā
svadhikāratā, tadā sarveṣu jātādiṣvartheṣu ghādayo bhavanti| yadi
tarhi śeṣa itilakṣaṇamapīdamanenaiva yathā grahaṇādiṣvartheṣu pratyayo
bhavati, tathā jātādiṣvapi bhaviṣyatīti jātādyanukramaṇamanarthakam ?
na; apavādavidhānārthatvāt| yāni tvanapavādārthāni
jātanivṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ--ityevamādīni tāni śeṣagrahaṇasyaiva
prapañco veditavyaḥ||

93. rāṣṭrāvārapārādghakhau| (4.2.93)
rāṣṭraśabdāt ṭhvṛddhāccchaḥ'(4.2.114) iti cche prāpte|avārapāraśabdādaṇi
ghakhau vidhīyete| avārasya pāramavārapāramiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
rājadantādiṣu darśanāt pārāvāramityapi pakṣe bhavati|
vigṛhītādviparītācca labhyate| vaktavyamevaitat| atha vā-- ekaśeṣo
vijñāsyate, tatraikaḥ samudāyārethaḥ, aparo'vayavārtho bhaviṣyati|
viparītasyāpi ṭhekārthānāṃ virūpāṇām' (1.2.64.vā.23) ityekaśeṣo
na virudhyate, thā-- vakradaṇḍaśca kuṭiladaṇḍaśca kuṭiladaṇḍāviti, yathā
ca yaṅlukāviti | nanu ca tasyaivaṃ prakṛtayo bhavanti, pañca
rāṣṭrādiśabdāḥ,pratyayau tu dvau-- iti vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyātānudeśo
na sidhyati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;nirdeaśāpekṣaṃ hi yathāsaṃkhyatvam| nirdeaśaśca
dvayoreva tadapekṣayā prakṛte yathāsaṃkhyatvam| evaṃ pañcādyabheda
upajāyate, na sa yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bādhate| yathā vuñādīnāñca gaṇāpekṣayā
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pravṛte tu yathāsaṃkhyena pratyayotpativelāyāṃ gaṇeṣu
yadyapi prātipadikarūpāṇyasamasaṃkhyāni bhavanti, tathātrāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ
na hīyate| kutaḥ punaravagatam-- ekaśeṣo'yamiti ? vyākhyānāt|
ṭhprakṛtiviśeṣopādānamātreṇa' iti| mātraśabdo
jātādyarthavibhaktinirdeaśasya ca vyavacchedāya||

97.nadyādibhyo ḍhak| (4.2.97)

100. raṅkoramanuṣye ca| (4.2.100) 
ṭhordeaśe ṭhañ' (4.2.119) iti ṭhañi ṭhjanapadatadavadhyośca' (4.2.124) iti
janapadalakṣaṇe vuñi ṭhkopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) ityaṇi prāpte vacanam| 
ṭhpkacchādipāṭhādamanuṣye'ṇāpi--kāśikā,padamañjarī ca|}

ṭhkopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) ityaṇ grahaṇānuvṛteḥ|
ṭhnañivayuktanyāyena'iti| nañyukte cevayukte ca tatsadṛśasampratyayo

tena manuṣyasadṛśe prāṇini ṣphagaṇau bhavataḥ| aprāṇini tu
kacchādipāṭhādaṇeva bhavati, na ṣpak-- ṭhrāṅkavaḥ kambalaḥ'iti|
ṭhviśeṣa vihitena' ityādi| yadīhāpyaṇna kriyeta,tadāṭhpkacchādibhyaśca

101. dyauprāgapāgudakpratīco yat| (4.2.101)

ṭhpavācyam--itikāśikāpāṭhaḥ,padamañjarīpāṭhaśca| }apācyam' iti|

iti|ṭhuda īt' (6.4.139) itīkāraḥ| ṭhprāktanam' iti| prākśabdāt
ṭhdikśabdebhyaḥ saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo dik' (5.3.27)

103. varṇau vuk| (4.2.103)
ṭhvarṇuḥ' iti| nado'bhidhīyate| srotasi ca kanthā na sambhavīti
sāmīpikamadhikaraṇaṃ vijñāyate, ata āha-- ṭhtatsamīpo deśo
varṇuḥ' iti| varṇuśabdāt ṭhadūrabhavaśca' (4.2.70) ityatrārthe
ṭhsuvāstvādibhyo'ṇ' (4.2.77) ityaṇ, tasya ṭhjanapade lup' (4.2.81)
iti lupi kṛte varṇuriti bhavati| nanu ca pratipadavidhānāt
pratyayasya lubna bhavati ? naivam; suvāstvādipāṭho hi
janapadādānyasmin pratyayārthe kṛtārthaḥ--ṭhvārṇavo grāmo
nagaramiti, na tu janapade| tatra tu paratvāllopena bhavitavyam|
ṭhtaddhiṣayārtha'iti| viṣayagrahaṇena varṇāditi saptamyā
viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| sa varṇudeśo viṣayo yasya
tadviṣayārthaḥ| sā punaḥ kanthaiva||

104.avyayātyap| (4.2.104)
ṭhameha' ityādi| parigaṇanam|
etaccotarasūtrasthasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyabhoryogayoḥ vijñāyate
vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| amāśabdaḥ samīvācī,
svarādipāṭhādavyayatvam| ihetyādīnāṃ
ṭhtaddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ'(1.1.38) iti| amā bhavo'mātyaḥ|
ṭhāṬpariṣṭaḥ' iti| upariṣṭādbhavatītyaṇi kṛte ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre
ṭilopo vaktavyaḥ' (vā.842) iti ṭilopaḥ|parato bhavaḥ ṭhpārastaḥ'|
parataḥ śabdaḥ ṭhvibhāṣā parāvarābhyām' (5.3.29) ityasujantaḥ|
ṭhārātīyaḥ' iti| atra ṭilopo na bhavati; ṭhbahiṣaṣṭilopaśca'
(vā.378) ityatrānityatvasya jñāpitatvāt|
ṭhtyabnerdhruve' iti| niśabdādhruve vācye tyabbhavati| niyate
sarvakāle bhavo nityaḥ|
ṭhniso gate' iti| niḥśabdādgate vācye tyabbhavati| ṭhniṣṭaḷḥ'
iti| ṭhhrasvātādau taddhite' (8.3.99) iti mūrdhanyaḥ| evamādaviṣṭaḷ
ityatrāpi bhavati||

105. aiṣamohyaḥśvaso'ntarasyām| (4.2.105)

106.tīrarūpyotarapadādaññau| (4.2.106)
atha tīrarūpyotarādityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ
bhavatīti ? ata āha-- ṭhtīrarūpyāntāt' ityādi| yadīha
tīrarūpyāntādityujyeta, bahucpūrvādapi syāt-- bahutīre jāta
iti, bhavati hyaetat tīrāntam| utarapadagrahaṇe hyaeṣo'tiprasaṅgo na
bhavati, na hyaetat, tīrotarapadam, yasmāt samāse satyetadbhavati|
pūrvapadamutarapadamiti nyāyena nāyaṃ samāsaḥ||

107. dikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ| (4.2.107)
ṭhpaurvaśālaḥ'iti| pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhavaḥ paurvaśālaḥ| ṭhtaddhitārthaḥ'
(2.1.51) ityādinā taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tataḥ pratyayaḥ|
atha padagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? ṭhna dikpūrvāt' ityevocyeta ? ityata
āha-- ṭhpadagrahaṇam' ityādi| asati hi padagrahaṇa svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt|
tathā ca diggajaḥ, dignāgaḥ, digdāhaḥ-- ityevamādiḥ
prakṛtirvijñāyate| padagrahaṇe tu sati digviśeṣo gṛhyate,katham ?
padagrahaṇasāmarthyādvyādhikaraṇe bahuvrīhirvijñāyate-- diśaḥ
pūrvapadaṃ yasya | diśa iti ca vācakāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate| teneha
tadabhidhāyī pūrvādidikśabdo gṛhyate|

108. madrebhyo'ñ| (4.2.108)
ṭhpaurvamadraḥ' iti| pūrvavat taddhitārthe (2.1.51) samāsaḥ, tato'ṇi
prāpte,ṭhavṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt' (4.2.125) itica vṛñi,
ṭhmadravṛjyoḥ kan' (4.2.131) iti kanyañ vidhīyate||

109. udīcyagrāmācca bahvaco'ntodātau| (4.2.109)
ṭhśaivapuram, māhānagaram' iti| śivapuramahānagaraśabdau
samāsasvareṇāntodātau|
ṭhmāthuram' iti| mathurāśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ|
madhyadeśagrāmastu, tenāṇeva bhavati| ṭhdhvājam' iti| dhvajīśabdaḥ
pippalyāditvānṅīṣantaḥ|gaurādiṣu hi ppilyādayaḥ
paṭhaḷnte,tenāsau pratyayasvareṇāntodātaḥ| udīcyagrāmasya bahvajanto
bhavati| ṭhdhānaśabda udātaḥ' iti| ṭhgatikārakopapadāt' (6.2.139) iti
dhānaśabdasya lyuḍantasya prakṛtibhāvāt||

110. prasthotarapadaladyādikopadhādaṇ| (4.2.110)
ṭhudīcyagrāmalakṣaṇasyāño'pavādaḥ' iti|
prasthotarapadādīnāmudīcyagrānatvāt| ṭhmādrīprasthaḥ, māhakīprasthaḥ'
iti| atra prakṛtiḥ samāsasvareṇāntodātā| athotarapadagrahaṇaṃ
kimartham, na prasthāntādityevocyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; tadihāpi
prasajyeta--utamakarṇīprasthaḥ| tatrāpyutarapadagrahaṇānna bhavati| na hyatra
prasthaśabda utarapadam, kiṃ tarhi ? karṇīprasthaśabdaḥ|
ṭhtataṣṭhaññiṭhayorapavādaḥ'iti ṭhvāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' (4.2.117) iti
prāptayoḥ| atha vāhīkaśabdaḥ kimartamiha paṭhaḷte, yāvatā
kopadhatvādevāṇ siddhaḥ ? atrāha-- ṭhvāhīkaśabdaḥ' ityādi| yadi
vāhīkaśabda iha na paṭhaḷte, paratvāt ṭhvṛddhāccchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti ccchaḥ
syāt| kopadhasya tu nilīka ityatrāvṛddhamavakāśaḥ| tasmātparamapi cchṃa
bādhitvā'ṇ yathā syāditi kopadho'pi vāhīkaśabdaḥ paṭhaḷte|
athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na yāvatā yathāvihitamevocyeta ?na;
punarvidhānādaṇeva bhavatīti vijñāyate| apavādasya vidhāne
punarvidhānamanarthakamityāha--ṭhajagrahamam' ityādi| yadatra vṛddhaṃ
vāhīkagrāmaḥ,tasmāt ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityato'ṇi prāpte ṭh
vṛddhāccchaḥ' (4.2.114) prāpnoti, tasmin ṭhvāhīkagrahāmebhyaśca' (4.2.117)
iti ṭhaññiṭhau, tau paratvāt bādhitvā yadyatrāṇgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta
tadā punarvidhānācccha eva syāt| aṇgrahaṇādeva bhavati-- goṣṭhaḷaṃ
bhavaṃ ṭhgauṣaṭhaḷm' iti| tasmāt bādhakamapi bādhitvā'ṇeva yathā
syādityevamarthamaṇgrahaṇam| kopadhagrahaṇamihājanapadārtham|
janapadatadavadhi'(4.2.124) ṭhkopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) ityanena siddhaḥ|
yakṛllomaśabdaḥ paladyādiṣu paṭhaḷte, tasya nalopa nipātyate,anyathā
ṭhan' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāve sati yakṛllomni bhavaḥ yākṛlloma
iti na sidhyet||

111. kaṇvādibhyo gotre| (4.2.111)
ṭhgotragrahaṇamiha na pratyayārtham' iti| śeṣādhikārāt| yadi hi
pratyayārthaḥ syāt, śeṣādhikāro vācyeta| ṭhpna ca--kāśikā
padamañjarī ca} na prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam'(iti)| asambhavāt| na hi

gotrapratyayāntebhyaḥ kaṇvādibhyo'ṇ bhavatīti darśayati|
ṭhcchasyāpavādaḥ' iti| gotrapratyayāntānāṃ kaṇvādīnāṃ vṛddhatvāt|

112. iñaśca| (4.2.112)

113.na dvyacaḥ prācyabharateṣu| (4.2.113)
ṭhpaiṅgīyāḥ, prauṣṭhīyāḥ'iti| prācyagotrodāharaṇam|

codyam| ṭhnaitadasti' iti parihāraḥ| ubhayañcaitat,tadudāharaṇam|

114. vṛddhāccchaḥ| (4.2.114)

rūpotarapadātu chṃa bādhitvā ṭhdhanyayopadhādÂvuñ' (4.2.121) iti

bhavaḥ sāḍalapurīyaḥ| kopadhalakṣamam--āṬdake bhava āṬdakīyaḥ,
caulluke bhavaḥ caullukīyaḥ| teṣāṃ tu vidhīnāmavṛddho'vakāśaḥ||

115. bhavataṣṭhakcchasau| (4.2.115)

116.kāśyādibhyaṣṭhaññiṭhau| (4.2.16)
kāśicediśabdābhyāṃ janapadalakṣaṇe (4.2.124) vuñi prāpte sājāteḥ
ṭhiñaśca' (4.2.112) ityaṇi, saṃvāhādibhyo vṛddhacche (4.2.114) ,
hastikarṣūśabdāt ṭhordeaśe ṭhañ' (4.2.119) iti ṭhañi, pariśiṣṭebhyaḥ
ṭhprāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityaṇīdamārabhyate| kathaṃ punarñakāra eva
viparyastadeśe'nubandhe kriyamāṇe viśeṣa ityata āha-- ṭhstrīpratyaye
viśeṣaḥ' iti| ante hi ñakāre'nubandhe sati ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ'(4.1.15)
itiṅībbhavati| ādau hi sati ṭābeva bhavati|
ṭhvṛddhādityanuvartate' iti| yadyevam, atra ye vṛddhāḥ paṭhaḷnte tebhyaḥ
ptyaye na prāpnoti ? ityāha-- ṭhyetvavṛddhāḥ'ityādi|
yadi tarhyavṛddhebhyo'pi vacanaprāmāṇyātpratyayo bhavati,
vṛddhādityasyānuvṛtirapārthiketyata āha-- ṭhdevadataśabdaḥ' ityādi|
devadataśabdasya prāgdeśa eva hi vartamāne'sya vṛddhasaṃjñā, na
vāhīkagrāme| tatra yadi vṛddhāditi nānuvartate,
vāhīkagrāmavācino'pi tataṣṭhaññiṭhau syātām| tasmāt
tannivṛtyarthaṃ vṛddhādhikāro'rthavān bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| ṭhkatham'
ityādinā vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ devadatīyā iti bhāṣyakārasyopanyāse
tadudāharaṇaṃ vighaṭayya ṭhtatraivaṃ varṇayanti' ityādinā samarthayate|
ṭhāpadādipūrvapadātkālāt' iti| āpaccchabda ādiryeṣāṃ
tānyāpadādīni| tāni pūrarvapadaṃ yasya tadāpadādipūrvapadam|
tataḥ kālāṭṭhaññiṭhau bhavataḥ|ādiśabdenordhvādayaḥ śabdā gṛhyante||

121. ghanvayopadhādÂvuñ| (4.2.121)

122. prasthapuravahāntācca| (4.2.122)
ṭhvṛddhādityeva' iti| yadi tarhi vṛddhādityanuvartate
vṛddhādhikārādeva svarūpagrahaṇābhāvāt kathaṃ tadantavidhirbhavati, nahi

tatkimantagrahaṇena ? maivam; satyapi vṛddhādhikāre yathā dhanveti

123. ropadhetoḥ prācām| (4.2.123)
ṭhīkārāntācca' iti|kataṃ punarjñāyate---dīrghasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na
hrasvasyeti ? sāmarthyāt | prāggrahaṇaṃ hi deśasya viśeṣaṇam|
vṛddhāditi vartate, na ca vṛddhamikārāntaṃ prāgdeśavācyasti,
tasmāddīrghasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti vijñāyate| ekacakrāśabdasya tu ṭheṅ
prācām' (1.1.75) iti vṛddhasaṃjñā|
atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, neha kiñcitasya vyāvartyamastītyata
āha-- ṭhtaparakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamṭa (iti)| asati hi tasmin ropadha
iti sthite guṇe kṛte vibhaktau ca ropadhayoriti nirdeaśaḥ syāt|
tatraiva sandehaḥ syāt--kiṃ ropadhasyedaṃ grahaṇam ? uta
ropadhasyekārāntasyeti ? taparakaraṇe tu sati sandeho na bhavati|
īropadhāditi noktam, vaicitryārtham||

124. janapadatadavadhyośca| (4.2.124)
ṭhtadavadherapi' ityādi| ṭhjanapadatadavadhyośca' ityatra taccchabdena
sannihitatvājjanapada evaparāmṛśyate| na cāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
ṣaṣṭīsamāse hyajanapado'pi yo'vadhistato'pi vuñ prasajyeta| ccha eva
tasyeṣyate-- mauñjī nāma vāhīkānāmavadhirgrāmaḥ, tatra bhavo
mauñjīya iti| tasmāt samānādhikaraṇa evāyaṃ samāsaḥ-- saeva
janapado'vadhirmaryādā tadavadhiriti| tena janapadāvadhireva eva
gṛhyante, na grāmaḥ|
ṭhkimarthaṃ tarhi tadavadhigrahaṇam' iti| yadi tadavadhirapi janapada eva
gṛhyate,nirarthakaṃ tarhi tasya grahaṇam, ṭhjanapadācca' ityetāvadeva
vaktavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhbādhakabādhanārtham' iti|
gartotarapadādvakṣyamāṇaśccha eva paratvādviśeṣavihitatvācca bādhakaḥ,
tasya bādhanārthaṃ tadavadhigrahaṇam|tenahi trigarteṣu bhavastraigartaka
ityatrotarasūtreṇa gartatotarapadācchṃa bādhitvā vuñeva bhavati||

125. avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt| (4.2.125)
ṭhaṇcchayorapavādaḥ' iti| avṛddhādaṇo'pavādaḥ, vṛddhāccchasya| atha
viṣayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, vināpi tena viśeṣo labhyata eva| katham ?
iha janapadatadavadhiśabdābhyāṃ samānādhikaraṇatvādvahuvacanaśabdo na
pāribhāṣiko vijñāyate,kiṃ tarhi ? anvarthaḥ-- bahūnāmarthānāṃ vacano
yo janapadastadavadhiśceti| yaśca bahūnāmarthānāṃ vacanaḥ so'rthān
bahūn brūvan sāmarthyādeva bahuvacanaviṣayo bhavati ? ityāha--
ṭhviṣayagrahaṇam' ityādi| ananyatrabhāvaḥ kathaṃ nāma labhyata ityevamarthaṃ
viṣayagrahaṇam| ananyatrabhāvaḥ kimarthamiṣyata ityāha-- janapadaikadeśaḥ
kriyate| vartanī ca vartanī ca vartanī ca vartanyaḥ,tadbahūnāṃ
vācako bhavati| tataśca yadi viṣayaghaṇaṃ na kriyate tato vartanīṣu
bhava iti vuñ syāt| viṣayagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati, ananyatrabhāvo
viṣayaḥ| tenaivaṃ vijñāyate-- bahuvacanaṃ na yo vyabhacarati|
yaścaikaśeṣaḥ sa bahūvacanaṃ vyabhicarati, tasyahi vivakṣābhāve
bahutvāt| dvayorapi ca kadācidÂvṛteḥ|
ṭhapigrahaṇam' iti| apigrahaṇaṃ hi vṛddhādapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ
kriyate| vṛddhātpūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, tat kimapigrahaṇena ?
ṭhtakrakauṇḍinyāyena' iti| yathā ṭhbrāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatā takraṃ
kauṇÃḍinyāya' iti sāmānyena vṛtasya dadhidānasya viśeṣe
vartamānena takradānena bādhā kriyate, tathehāpi bahuvacanaviṣaye ca
sāmānyena pravṛtasya pūrvayogasya bahuvacanaviṣaye vartamānenānena
yogena bādhā vijñāyate| tasmādÂvṛddhādapi yathā syādityapi
śabdena samuccīyate||

126. kacchāgnivaktragartotarapadāt| (4.2.126)
kaccchaśabdārthamutarapadagrahaṇāt, sa hi kevalo'pi deśa vartate|
itareṣāṃ tu kevalānaṃ deśe vṛtyasambhavāt sāmarthyādeva
tadantavidhirlabhyata itītarān pratyutarapadagrahaṇamanarthakam|
ṭhkacchāgnivaktragartāntāt' iti noktam, bahucpūrvānmā bhūt|
yadā hi kaccchadeśena deśāntarantarasya guṇasāmye satīṣadasamāptaḥ
kaccchadeśa iti kaccchaśabdādbahuc kriyate tadā bahukaccchaśabdo
deśavacana iti| antagrahaṇe tu sati tato'pi pratyayaḥ syāt,
utarapadagrahaṇānna bhavati| ṭhdārukaccchaḥ'iti| kaccchaśabdasyotarapadasya
vṛddhasyodāharaṇam| ṭhpaippalīkaccchakaḥ' ityavṛddhasyodāharaṇam,
evamanyādyautarapadānāmapi| ekavṛddhasyodāharaṇam| aparaṃ vṛddhasya
veditavyam||

127. dhūmādibhyaśca| (4.2.127)

128. nagarātkutsanaprāvīṇyayoḥ| (4.2.128)

129. araṇyānmanuṣye| (4.2.129)

1.yuṣmadasmadoranyatarasyāṃ khañca| (4.3.1)

vaiṣamyam| sarvathā nāsti yathāsaṃkhyaprasaṅga||

2. tasminnaṇi ca yuṣmākāsmākau| (4.3.2)

prāgeva tatraiva pratītyutpateḥ| tatra punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
sākṣādvihitvam,ānantaryācca khañaḥ, tasyaiva yuktaḥ| nanu ca pūrvasūtre
Kañceti cakāreṇa cchāe'nukṛṣyate,vācakadeśaśca vācya iti khañaśccha
evānantaro bhavati| syādanantaro yadi cakārastasya vācakaḥ syāt, na
cāsau tasya vācakaḥ | sa hi samīpavartinaḥ padārthāntarasya
sahāyatāmātramācaṣṭe| khañaḥ sahāyatāmākhyāya nivṛte cakāre sā
sahāyatā prakaraṇācchenaiva vijñāyate| tasmāccakāraścchasya vācako na
bhavatīti nāsau tādṛśaḥ|
tatkṛtayostasyānantarya ṭhnimitayoḥ' ityādi| dve hi nimite--
khañaṇau, nimitanāvapi dvāvevādeśau, tataḥ samānatvadyathāsaṃkhyenātra
bhavitavyamiti manyamānas praśnaḥ| ṭhyogavibhāgaḥ ityādi' parihāraḥ|
ṭhyuṣmadīyaḥ, asmadīyaḥ' iti| yadi ṭhtasminnaṇi ca' iti nocyeta to
yathā pūrvasūtravihitayoḥ khañaṇorimāvādeśau bhavatastathā cche'pi

3.tavakamamakāvekavacane| (4.3.3)
pūrveṇa yuṣmākāsmākayoḥ prāptayoḥ ṭhpratyayotarapadayośca' (7.2.98)
iti tvamayorekavacanetavakamamakāvādeśau vidhīyete|

ajahaddharmatvādadhikārāṇām| tasmādihāpi
pūrvakayogavibhāgādyavāsaṃkhyabhāvaḥ| 
iha sarvavidhibhyo lugvidhirvalavānityekavacanasya luki kṛte

samarthayitavyā| tadapi pratyayalopalakṣamaṃ pratiṣedhalakṣaṇaṃ
pratiṣedhayitumāha-- ṭhnanu ca' ityādi| ṭhvacanāt' ityādi parihāraḥ|
yadi hi pratyayalopalakṣaṇaṃ na syādidaṃ vacanamapārthakaṃ
syādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca yasyaivaka vacanaparatā sambhavati tasya
viśeṣaṇārthamekavacanaṃ syāt, kasyaikavacanaparatā sambhavati ?
nimitasya khañādeḥ| nimite tvekavacanaparatvena viśeṣyamāṇe
satīhaiva syātām-- yauṣmākaḥ putraḥ, āsmākaḥ putraḥ; atra
hyaekavacanaparatvam, taddhi tasyopapadyate; iha ca na syātām-- tāvakāḥ
putrāḥ, māmakāḥ putrā iti| na hyatra nimitasyaikavacanaparatā
sambhavatīti ? naitadasti; yuṣmadasmadī pūrvasūtre viśeṣe abhūtām|

ata eva yuṣmadasmadī viśeṣyete| tadihāpi tathābhūte evānuvartete;

yuktam| atha vā tavakamamakayorvidheyatvena prādhānyāt
tayorevaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| tayoreva tadviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavat
sthānidvārakameva bhavati| yadi sthāninorekavacanaparatā, evamādeśau
sthānivatvādekavacanaparau bhavataḥ| tadanenāpi prakāreṇa
yuṣmadasmadorekavacanaviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| na tu kathañcinnimitasya
khañādeḥ|
ṭhatha vā' ityādi| purvaṃ pāribhāṣikamekavacanamāśritya vyākhyātam,

gośālakharaśālayorhrasvāntayoḥ pāṭhānnapuṃsakayorgrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate|

napuṃsakayorgrahaṇam, tathāpi pratipadikagragaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi
grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati iti strīliṅgābhyāmapi lugbhavatyeva|
udāharaṇe'pyautsargisyāṇau luk||

36. vatsaśālābhijidaśvayuktśatabhiṣajo vā| (4.3.36)

vatsaśālaśabdo napuṃsakaliṅgo gṛhyate| kuta
etas?vyaptervyāyāta;napuṃsakaliṅgasya hi grahaṇe
liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā strīliṅgādapi lugna sidhyati; na tu
strīliṅgasya grahaṇe napuṃsakāt| 
ṭhbahulagrahaṇasyāyaṃ prapañcaḥ' iti| vatsaśālaśabdo yadyapi nakṣatravacano
na bhavati, tathāpi bahulavacanāt tato'pi lugbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ||

37. nakṣatrebhyo bahulam| (4.3.37)
ṭhrohiṇaḥ'ityādau nakṣatrāṇaḥ pakṣe luk| ṭhmṛgaśirāḥ'iti|
ṭhatvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ|ṭhmārgaśīrṣaḥ'iti| ṭhye ca
taddhite' (6.1.61) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāccchirasaḥ
śīrṣabhāvaḥ| atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? napūrvasūtrādeva
vāgrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate ? idaṃ prayojanam-- na kvacidanyadeva yathā
syāt, tena phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau siddhau bhavataḥ|
śraviṣṭhāṣāḍhābhyāñcchaṇapīti||

38. kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ| (4.3.38)
ṭhnanu ca' ityādi| janmavadvastu jātaśabdasyārthaḥ, kṛtasyāpi
janmāstyeva, tasmādyadyatra kṛtaṃ jātamapi tatatra bhavati| ṭhyacca krītam'
ityādi| prāptaṃ labdhamucyate| krītaṃ prāptamapapi tadbhavatyeva,
tasmāt krītaṃ labdhamapi bhavati| ṭhśabdasyārthasyābhinnatvāt'
iti|svajanmanyanubhūtakartṛbhāvo jātaśabdasyārthaḥ| jātaśabdasyaiva
viśeṣopalakṣitaparavyāpāro svajanmaniṣpatau kṛtaśabdasyārthaḥ|
prāptisāmānyaṃ labdhaśabdasyārthaḥ| prāptiviśeṣo yasya mūlahetukā
prāptiḥ| sa krītaśabdasyārthaḥ| na ca sāmānyaviśeṣayorekārthatā
yuktā| mā bhūtparyāyaprasaṅga iti bhidyate śabdārthaḥ| ṭhvastumātreṇa'
iti| krītalabdhayoryadādhārabhūtaṃ vsatumātraṃ tasyābhinnarūpatvātkrītaṃ
labdhaṃ bhavati| mātragrahaṇaṃ śabdārthavyavacchedārtham| ata evāha--
ṭhśabdārthastu bhidyata eva' (iti)| na hi yena rūpeṇa krītaśabdena
tatpratyāyyate tenaiva labdhaśabdena| evaṃ
jātakṛtaśabdayorvastutvenābhinnatvam| śabdārthadvāreṇa tu
bhinnārthatvameva| anyenaiva hi rūpeṇa jātaśabdena tadvastu pratyāyyate,
anyena kṛtaśabdena||

39. prāyabhavaḥ| (4.3.39)
ṭhprāyabhavagrahaṇamanarthakam' iti|
vaicitryādanyasyārthasyābhāvādanarthamityucyate| vaicitryeṇa tu
sārthakameva| kasmāt punararthakamiti ? ṭhtatra bhavena kṛtārthatvāt'
iti| yat ṭhprāyabhavaḥ'ityasya sādhyam, tasya ṭhtatra bhavaḥ'(4.3.53)
ityanenaiva sādhitatvāditibhāvaḥ| yo hi rājye prāyeṇa bhavati
tatrāsau bhavatyeva| tataśca tatra bhave tasyāntarbhāvāt ṭhtatra bhavaḥ'
(4.3.53) ityanenaiva kṛtaṃ sampādanamriti kiṃ prāyabhavagrahaṇena ?
ṭhanityabhavaḥ' ityādinā parasyotaramāśaṅkate|syādetat--
anityabhavaḥ prāyabhavo nityabhavastatra bhava iti, tasmāt tatra bhavena
prāyabhavsayāsaṃgrahānna sidhyati ? ityāśaṅkyāha-- ṭhmuktasaṃśayena
tulyam' iti| muktastyaktaḥ saṃśayo yena tat muktasaṃśayam|
nyāyyastatra bhavo'yamiti yo niścitastena tulyaṃ bhavati| tathā hi--
sraghne bhavo devadataḥ sraughna ityucyate, na cāsau srughne sadā bhavati,
avaśyaṃ hi kadācidudagdesādīnapakrāmati, atha ca tatrabhavapratyayo
bhavati| yadi ca nityabhavastatra bhavaḥ ? jihvāmūle bhavo varṇaḥ
jihvāmūlīya ityatra ṭhtatra bhavaḥra' (4.3.53) ityadhikāre
jihvāmūlāṅguleścchaḥ' (4.3.ka62) iti cchāe na syāt, na hi varṇo
nityaṃ jihvāmūle bhavati| tasmāt prāyabhava kakakakakakakakakasya
tatrabhavāntarbhavāt tato na ṇyatiricyata itnarthakaṃ prayabhavagrahaṇam||

40. upajānūpakarṇopanīveṣṭhak| (4.3.40)
jānunaḥ samīpam, karṇasya samīpam, nāvyāḥ samīpamiti-- ṭhavyayaṃ
vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībāvaḥ| ṭhpāṬpajānukaḥ-- kāśikā'}
upajānukaḥ' iti| ṭhisusuktantāt kaḥ' (7.3.51)||

41. sambhūte| (4.3.41)
ṭhavaklṛptiḥ'ityādi| avaklṛpti u sambhāvanā| pramāṇānatirekaḥ u
ādhārapramāṇādādheyapramāṇasyānatiriktatā, yasyāṃ satyāṃ
sravamādheyamādhāramanupraviśati| ṭhsrudhne sambhavati' (iti)| yastu
srudhne sambhāvyate, srughnapramāṇānnātiricyate, tadanupravaśāt sa
senādiko'rtha evamucyate||

42. kośāḍḍhañ| (4.3.42)

ṭhkauśeyaṃ vastram' iti| nanu ca vasraṃ kauśeyaṃ na sambhavati, kintu
kṛmiḥ, tataśca kṛmāveva syāt, na vastre; api ca
viśeṣānabhidhānāt khaḍgasambandhino'pi kośāt pratyayaḥ
prasajyetetyāha-- ṭhrūḍhireṣā' ityādi| rūḍhiśabdo hi
yathākathañcidutpādyate, na tatrāvaśyamavayavārtho'pekṣyaḥ,
kvacidavayavārthāsambhavāt| tathā hi tailaṃ pibatītyevaṃ
tailapāyikāśabdo vyutpādyate, na tatrāvaśyamavayavārtho'pekṣyaḥ,
kvacivayavārthāsambhavāt| tathā hi tailaṃ pibatītyevaṃ
tailapāyikāśabdo vyutpādyate, sa ca tailapānakriyārahita eva kvacit
prāṇiviśeṣe vartate| sasmādyadyapi na kṛmau| atha khaṅgakośādutpatau
ko doṣaḥ, yena tataḥ pratyayo neṣyate ? khaṅgasyābidhānaṃ
prāpnoti| sa hi tatra sambhavatīti cet ? itarasmādapi tarhi kośāt
pratyayotpatau ca kṛmerabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, sa hi tatra sambhavati| atha
tatrāpi rūḍhivaśādvastrasyābhidhānam, na kṛmeḥ| itarasmādapi tarhi
kośādutpatau vasrasyābhidhānaṃ na khaṅgasya ? evaṃ manayate-- yadyapi
sambhūtādhikāre kośāḍḍhañ vidhīyate, tathāpi kauśeyaśabdānna
sambhavo'rtha pratīyate, api tu vikāro'rthaḥ; rūḍhivaśāt| kauśeyaṃ
vasramitikośavikāro vasramityarthaḥ| tathā ca vārtikakāreṇoktam--
ṭhvikāre kośāḍḍhañ, ṭhpsambhūtārthānupapatiḥ--vā.pāṭhaḥ'}
sambhūtārthānupapateḥ' (vā. 1,2(4.3.42) iti| vikārasca
kauśeyaśabdāt kṛmikośasya pratīyate, na khaṅgakośasya ;
rūḍhivaśāt| tasmādyasya vikāraḥ pratīyate tadabhidhāyina eva
kośaśabdādyaukkataḥ pratyayaḥ netarasmāt||

43. kālātsādhupuṣpyatpacyamāneṣu| (4.3.43)
kālāditi svaryate, prakṛtīrutarā viśeṣayitum| na ca svarūpagrahaṇe
satyutarāḥ prakṛtayaḥ śakyā viśeṣayitum; svarūpasyādhāraṇatvāt|
tasmādarthagrahaṇamevaitat| tenakālaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo vijñāyata
ityāha-- ṭhkālaviśeṣavācibyaḥ' ityādi| ṭhhaimanaḥ' iti| ṭhsarvatrāṇ ca
talopaśca' (4.3.22)| ṭhśaiśiraḥ' ityādau sandhivelādisūtreṇa (4.3.16)
ṛtvaṇ||

44. upte ca| (4.3.44)

sādhvādiṣu mā bhūt||

45. āśvayujyā vuñ| (4.3.45)

kālāṭṭhañ vihitaḥ| na cāśvayujīśabdaḥ kālavācī, tataḥ kutaṣṭhañ ?

48. kalāpyaśvatthayavabusādÂvun| (4.3.48)
kathaṃ punaḥ kalāpādayaḥ śabdāḥ kāle vartante, yāvatā mayūrādiṣu
teṣāṃ vṛtiḥ prasiddhetyata āha-- ṭhkālāpyādayaḥ śabdāḥ' ityādi|
evameva viṣayaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti-- ṭhyasminkāle' ityādi| aśvatthaśabdo'tra
vṛkṣaviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ| tena sarva eva kālaḥ sambadhyata iti tadÂdvāreṇa
kālaviśeṣo na saṃjñāyate| tasmādaśvatthaphalasahacāriṇi
kāle'śvatthaśabdo vartata iti darśayitumāha-- ṭhyasmānnaśvatthāḥ
phalanti' ityādi| aśvatthaśabdo yadyapi vṛkṣe vartate, tathāpi phale
vartate eva||

49. grīṣmāvarasādÂvuñ| (4.3.49)

kālāṭṭhañaḥ| avarā cāsau samā cetyavarasamā||

50. saṃvatsarāgrahāyaṇībhyāṃ ṭhañca| (4.3.50)
kālāṭṭhañi prāpte vacanam| tena ṭhañ na vaktavya iti| vuñi
vikalpite vināpi ṭhañgrahaṇena pakṣe yathāprāptaṃ ṭhañeva
bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhṭhañgrahaṇam' ityādi| tatra yadyatra ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ na
kriyeta ṭhsandhivelā' (4.3.16) ityādiṣu ṭhsaṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoḥ'
(ga.sū.104) iti pāṭhāt sandhivelādyaṇaṣṭhañapavādatvādaṇatvena kāle
vivakṣite vuñā mukte'ṇeva syāt| ṭhañgrahaṇādaṇamapi bādhitvā
ṭhañeva bhavati||

51. vyāharati mṛgaḥ| (4.3.51) 
ṭhnaiśikaḥ,naiśaḥ| prādoṣikaḥ, prādoṣaḥ' iti| niśāpradoṣābhyāṃ
(4.3.14)ṭhañ| tena mukte pakṣa ṛtvaṇeva bhavati||

52. tadasya soḍham| (4.3.52)
kālāditi vartate, na ca kālo jīyate,
tasmānnisāsahacaritamihādhyayanaṃ gauṇyā vṛtyā
niśetyevamādibhirabhidhīyata iti vijñāyate| ata evāha--
ṭhniśāsahacaritamadhyayanaṃ niśā' iti||

53. tatra bhavaḥ| (4.3.53)

54. digādibhyo yat| (4.3.54)
ṭhaṇaścchasya cāpavādaḥra' iti| yaddigādiṣu vṛddhaṃ vāpyādi
tataścchasyāpavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvaṇaḥ prāgdīvyatīyasya|
atha mukhajaghanayośca kimarthaḥ pāṭho digādiṣu , yāvatā
śarīrāvayavāt tābhyāmutarasūtreṇaiva (4.3.55) bhaviṣyati ? ityāha--
ṭhmukhajaghanayoḥ' iti| senāvayavavācinau hi yau mukhajaghanaśabdau
tau śarīravayavavācinau na bhavataḥ| pāṇipādādyavayavasvabhāvaṃ hi
śarīram, na caivamātmikā senā; kiṃ tarhi ? rathādisamudāyātmikā| 
ṭhudakātsaṃjñāyām' iti| udakaśabdāt saṃjñāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ
yadbhavati-- udakyā strī, rajasvalocyate| na cātra prakṛtyarthaḥ
pratyayārtho vā vidyate| sā ca tayoravidyamānatā saṃjñāgrahaṇena
vijñāyate| saṃjñāyāmanyatra-- āṬdako matsya iti, atrāṇeva bhavati||

55. śarīrāvayavācca| (4.3.55)
ṭhaṇo'pavādaḥ' iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt| yastu
pādādivṛddhastataḥ paratvādyat chṃa bādhate||

56. dṛtikukṣikalaśivastyastyaherḍhañ| (4.3.56)
dṛtikukṣibhyāṃ śarīrāvayatvādyati prāpte;kukṣiśabdo dhūmādaṣvapi
paṭhaḷte, tasmāt ṭhdhūmādibhyaśca' (4.2.127) iti vuñi prāpte;
śeṣebhyastvaṇi ḍhañi vidhīyate|
astiśabdastiṅnto mā vijñāyītyata āha-- ṭhastiśabdaḥ' ityādi|
ṭhvibhaktisvarapratirūpakāśceti nipātā bhavanti' iti nipātasaṃjñakaṃ
tiṅntasadṛśaṃ prātipadikametat, na tiṅntaḥ| etacca tiṅntena
samānārtham, yathā-- astikṣīrā brāhmaṇīti| bhinnārthaśca yathā dhane
vartate, yathā--- astimāniti| dhanavāniti gamyate | tadiha
viśeṣasyānabhidhānādubhayasyāpi grahaṇam||

57. grīvābhyo'ṇÂ ca| (4.3.57)
bahuvacananirdeaśādbahuvacanāntāt pratyayena bhavitavyam, anyathā
hyaekavacenaiva nirdeaśaṃ kuryāditi kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ
nirākartumāha-- ṭhgrīvāśabdaḥra' ityādi|
arthaviśeṣādbahuvacananirdeaśaḥ kutaḥ, na tu bahuvacanāntādeva yathā
syāditi darśayati||

58. gambhīrāññyaḥ| (4.3.58)
ṭhbahirdeava' ityādi| bahurdeavapañcajanebhyaśca ñyo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- cakāro'tra vartate, tena
bahirādibhyo'pi ñyo bhaviṣyatīti||

59. avyayībhāvācca| (4.3.59)
ṭhkiṃ tarhi' ityādi| kathaṃ punaravyayībhāvāditi sāmānyenocyamānaḥ
pratyayaḥ parimukhādereva ? ityata āha-- ṭhparimukhādīnāñca' ityādi|
caśabdo hetau| na hyantat kāryamasti parimukhādigaṇapāṭhasya| tatra
yadyapyetadapi na syāt, vidhyarthameva tasya syāt, tasmāt
parimukhādereva bhavati, na sarvasmādavyayībhāvāt| yadyevam,
parimukhāderityevaṃ vaktavyamityāha-- ṭhteṣām' ityādi| yadi hi
parimukhāderityucyate, tato'satyavyayībhāvagrahaṇe
tatpuruṣebhyo'pi parimukhādibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ syāt, tasmiṃstu sati na
bhavati-- parigataṃ mukhaṃ parimukhamiti prādisamāsaḥ, tatra bhavaḥ
parimukhaḥ; aṇeva bhavati| api cotarārdhamavyayībhāvagrahaṇamavaśyameva
kartavyam-- ṭhantaḥpūrvapadāṭṭhañ' (4.3.60) | ṭhgrāmātparyanupūrvāt'
(4.3.61) ityavyayībhāvādyathā syāt| ṭhpārihanavyam' iti| ṭhorguṇaḥra'
(6.4.146), ṭhvānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| ṭhāṬpakūlam'
iti| ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ| eṣa ca
parimukhādiṣu na paṭhaḷta ityaṇeva bhavati| atra piramukhamiti
kathamavyayībhāvaḥ ? yāvatā apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā (2.1.12)
samasyante, pañcamī ca pariṇā karmapravacanīyena yoge bhavati,
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tu ṭhapaparī vardane' (1.4.88) ityanena, na ca
parimukhe varjanaṃ gamyate, kiṃ tarhi ? sarvatobhāvaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi
ṭhavyayam' (2.1.6) iti yogavibhāgavyayībhāvo bhaviṣyati|
anye tu ye'tra parihanuprabhṛtayo'vyayībhāvāḥ, te
ṭhapaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā' (2.1.12) ityanenaiva bhavanti| atra yeṣvapi
varjanaṃ na gamyate, tatasteṣvayi ṭhavyayam' (2.1.6) iti
yogavibhāgenaiva| ye tūpasīrādaya upapūrvāḥ, te sāmīpye
ṭhavyayam' (2.1.6) ityādinā| ṭhanugaṅgam' iti| ṭhyasya cāyāmaḥ'
(2.1.16) ityavyayabhāvaḥ| anye tu ye'nusīrādayo'nupūrvāste
paścādarthe'vyayamityādinā||

60. antaḥ pūrvapadāṭṭhañ| (4.3.60)
ṭhantaḥśabdo vibhaktyarthe samasyate' iti| ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6)
ityādinā| vibhaktyarthastvadhikaraṇam,
antaḥśabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvāt|
samānaśabdāṭṭhañvaktavyaḥ' iti | vaktavyaśabdo vyākhyeye| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam-- ihāntaḥpūrvādityevaṃ siddhe yadadhikaṃ padagrahaṇaṃ
tadadhikamiha kāryaṃ bhavatītyevamarthaṃ kriyate, tena samānaśabdādapi
iñ bhavatīti| etena śabdāntarādeva|
adhyātmādibhya ūrdhvandamādūrdhvadehāllokotarapadācca ṭhañ bhavatīti
veditavyam| ṭhādhyātmikam' iti| ṭhādhyātmikam' iti| ātmanyadhi
adhyātmam, vibhaktyirthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| ṭhanuśatikādīnāñca' (7.3.20)
ityubhayapadavṛddhiḥ| ṭhadhyātmādirākṛtigaṇaścāyam' iti| yadyevam,
ṭhsamānaśabdāṭṭhañ vaktavyaḥ' (vā.454) ityadyanarthakam,
adhyātmādibhyaścetyanenaiva siddhatvāt ? nānarthak; asyaiva
prapañcārthatvāt| adhyātmādireva tat prapañcyate| nanu cākārānta
ūrdhvaśabdaḥ, tat kuta iha makārāntatvamāyātamit#aha--
ṭhūrdhvaśabdena' ityādi|
ṭhaihalaukikaḥ, pāralaukikaḥ' iti| pūrvavadubhayapadavṛddhiḥ|
ṭhmukhatīyam, pārśvatīyam' iti| ṭhapādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' (5.4.45)
iti tasiḥ| ṭhādyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.634) ityaupasaṃkhyāniko vā|
ṭhavyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' (vā.842) ityanena ṭilopaḥ| 
ṭhmaṇnīyau ca pratyayau vaktavyau' iti| madhyaśabdādityapekṣate|
ṭhmadhyo madhyaṃ dinaṇ cāsmāt' iti| madhyaśabdo madhyambhāvamāpadyate,
dinaṇ cāsmāt pratyayo bhavati| ṭhsthāmnaḥ' iti| sthāmaśabdāntāt
prātipadikāt| aśvasyeva sthāma balamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ,
pṛṣodaraditvāt sakārasya takāraḥ| aśvatthāmni bhava ityaṇ, tasya

84. vidūrāññyaḥ| (4.3.84)
ṭhtatra tu saṃskriyate' iti| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| saṃskriyate eva ca tatra
vidūre nagare, na tataḥ prabhavati|
ṭhvālavāyo vidūrañca' iti| vālavāyaśabda eva pratyayamutpādayati, na
vidūraśabdaḥ| prabhavatiśabdasya prathamata upalabhyata ityarthaḥ| prabhavati ca
vālavāye parvate| tasmādyataḥ prabhavati tadvācī vālavāyaśabdaḥ
prakṛtitvenākṣipyate| yathā viśravaṇaravaṇā ityādeśāveva śivādiṣu
paṭhaḷete| apatyādhikārātu yena tayorapatyāpatyavatsasambandhaḥ sa eva
prakṛtitvenākṣipyate viśravasśabdaḥ| viśravaso'patyaṃ vaiśravaṇaḥ,
rāvaṇaḥ|
atha vā prakṛtyantarameva vidūraśabdo vālavāye vartate| vidūrāt
bhavati vālavāyāt parvatāt prabhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ sthite yo
brūyāt-- naiva tatra vālavāye prasiddho vidūraśabda iti,taṃ pratyāha--
ṭhjitvarīvadūpācaret' iti| yathā vaṇija eva vāsāṇasī nagaraĀ
ṭhjitvarī' ityuccārayanti maṅgalārtham, na lokāḥ, evaṃ vaiyākaraṇā
eva vālavāyaṃ vidūramityuccārayanti| niyatadeśapuruṣaviṣayā api
rūḍhayo bhavantītyetajjitvarīvadityanena kathayati||

cchandastvaṃ vivakṣyate| nanuca ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni ca' (4.2.66) ityatra

pratipāditā, tatkimarthaṃ punaranena prakāreṇa pratipādyate| tatra vā
kalpādestadviṣayatāpratipādanārthaścakāraḥ kartavyaḥ, ayaṃ vā prakāra
āśrayitavya iti vikalpapradarśanārtham|
ṭhidānīntanena' ityādi| idānīntano yaḥ kāśyapaḥ sa
kāśyapagotraprabhavatvāt kāśyapa ityucyate, tathedānīntano yaḥ
kauśikaḥ sa kauśikagotraprabhavatvāt kauśika ityucyate; tatra yadi
ṛṣigrahaṇaṃ ṛṣiśabdādeva, tathā hi pravarādhyāye ye paṭhaḷnte ta ṛṣaya
iti, imāvapi tatra paṭhaḷete eva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādayamṛṣiśabdaḥ kriyāśabdo vijñāyate--
ṛṣirdarśanāditi| tena yāvananyapuruṣasādhāraṇenaupadeśikena
darśanena tadvnatau kāśyapakauśikaśabdau tata idaṃ pratyayavidhānam;
na cedānīntanau kāśyapakauśikaśabdāvevaṃvidhau, tābhyāṃ ccha eva
bhavati||

104.kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaśca| (4.3.104)
abhidhāne'bhiyopacārāt kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsyabhidhāyinaḥ
śabdā iha kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsiśabdena nirdiṣṭāḥ| ata evāha--
ṭhkalāpyantevāsinām' iti|
nanu ca ye vyavahitāḥ śiṣyaśiṣyāḥ, te
kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsina eva bhavanti, tadayuktamuktam--
kalāpyantevāsinaścatvāraḥ,vaiśampāyanāntevāsino nava ? ityāha--
ṭhpratyakṣakāriṇaḥra' ityādi| karotiratrādhyayane vartate| yaiḥ
sākṣādadhītaṃ te pratyakṣakāriṇaḥ| ihāntevāsino gṛhyante caitāvanta
eveti| kimatrāyuktam ? kuta iha sākṣātkāriṇo gṛhyante, na hi
vyavahitā ityatra hetuṃ pṛccchati| ṭhkalāpikhāṇḍāyanagrahaṇāt' iti|
hetunirdeaśaḥ| ṭhptathā hi--kāśikā}tathā ca' ityādi| asyaiva
vivaraṇam| vaiśampāyanasay kalāpyantevāsī, tasya ye'ntevāsinaste
vaiśampāyanāntevāsino bhavantyeva| yadi tatra ye
vyavahitāste'pyantevāsino gṛhyaeran kalāpigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt,
ṭhvaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt| tathā
vaiśampāyanāntevāsī khāṇḍāyanaḥ;tatra yadi vyavahitā apigṛhyaeran,
tato vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvādanenaiva sūtreṇa siddhe śaunakādiṣu
khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭho niṣphala eva syāt| tasmādihāpi
kalāpigrahaṇaṃ śaunakādiṣu khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭha etadubhayamapi
sākṣātkārigrahaṇasya liṅgaṃ jñāpakam| ṭhhāridraviṇaḥ' ityādi|
haridruprabhṛtibhyaḥ proktārthe ṇiniḥ,tadantāt ṭhtadadhīte tadveda'
(4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya ṭhproktālluk' 
ṭhulapena caturthena' iti| sahārthe tṛtīyā| ṭhkālāpakam' iti|
kalāpina idaṃ kālāpakam, ṭhgotracaraṇād vuñ' (4.3.126)| nanu ca
ṭhdharmāmnāyayorvuñ' (vā.476), na ceme śivyā dharmāmnāyāḥ,tatkathaṃ
vuñ ? evaṃ tarhyupamānādbhaviṣyatīti| kālāpakamiva dharmavaccchiṣyā
ucyante| yathā dharmaḥ kalāpisambandhī, tathā śiṣyā ityucyata
upamānārthaḥ| ṭhālambirnāma prācāṃ deśaḥ, tatrotpannaḥ ṭhcarakaḥ'| evaṃ
ṭhpalaṅgakamalāvubhau' | prācāmevatrayaḥ| ete prācyāḥ
vaiśampāyanaśiṣyāḥ ṭhṛcābhāruṇitāṇḍaḷaśca madhyamīyāstrayo'pera'
carakāḥ| madhyadeśe bhavā madhyamīyāḥ| gahādiṣu ṭhmadhyamadhyamañcāṇ
caraṇe' (ga.sū.99) iti paṭhaḷte. tasyāyamarthaḥ-- madhyaśabdo
madhyamabhāvamāpadyate, cchapratyayaśca tato bhavati, caraṇe tu pratyayārthe'ṇ
ca bhavatīti| tatra yadā ṛcābhādīnāṃ caraṇatvaṃ na vivakṣyate,tadā che
kṛte madhyamīyā iti bhavati| caraṇavivakṣāyāṃ tvaṇi kṛte mādhyamā
iti bhavati| udakṣu bhavā udīcyāḥ, ṭhdyauprāgapāg' (4.2.101) ityādinā
yat| udīcyeṣu madhye śyāmāyaniścarakaḥ|kaṭhakalāpināvapyudīcyeṣu

105. purāṇaprokteṣu brāhmaṇakalpeṣu| (4.3.105)

ṇiniḥ| tadantāt ṭhtadadhīte' (4.2.59) ityutpannasya ṭhpoktālluk'
(4.2.64) ṭhcchandobrāhamaṇāni' (4.2.66) ityādinā tadviṣayatā| ṭhpaiṅgī'
iti| ṭhāruṇaparājī' iti| piṅgāruṇaparājaśabdābhyāṃ ṇiniḥ|

purāṇaproktānyeva brāhmaṇāni, brāhmaṇāntaraiḥ purāṇaproktestulyatvāt

vastutvamanapekṣya vyavaharati sūtrakāra ityadoṣaḥ| ṭhtadviṣayatā kasmānna
bhavati' (iti)| ṭhcchandobrāhmaṇāni' (4.2.66) ityādineti bhāvaḥ|
ṭhpratipadam' ityādi| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) hi

kalpeṣu tarhi kasmānna bhavati; yathā-- kāśyapena proktaṃ kalpamadhīyate
kāśyapina ityatra ? ṭhna cāyam' ityādi| cchando'dhikāre ye
yogastadvihitasya pratyayasya tadviṣayatā bhavati, na cāyaṃ
yogaścchando'dhikāramanuvartate;tenaitadvihitasya
pratyayasyādhyetṛveditṛviṣayatā kalpeṣu na bhavati-- paiṅgī kalpaḥ,
āruṇaparājī kalda iti|
purāṇa iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yāvatā ṭhsāṃyaciram' (4.3.23) ityādinā
ṭaḷuṭaḷuloḥ sanniyogena tuṭi kṛte purātanamiti bhavitavyam ?
ityata āha-- ṭhpurāṇa iti nipātanāt tuḍabhāvaḥ (iti)| yadyevam, na
bhavati purātanam ? ityāha-- ṭhpna vā kāśikā}na ca' ityādi. nanu
ṭhbādhakānyapi nipātanāni' (vī.pa.vṛ.109) ityato bhavitavyameva

130. na daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu| (4.3.130)

darśayati| sa punarmayūkhyaṃsakāditvādvetivyaḥ|
mayūravyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvāt| ṭhvuñpratyayo na bhavati' iti|
etena vuño'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kathaṃ punarjñāyate vuño'yaṃ
pratiṣedha ? ityāha-- ṭhgotragrahaṇam' ityādi| iha hi
gotragrahaṇamanuvartate ṭhgotracaraṇādÂvuñ' (4.3.126) ityataḥ,
tenāyamartho bhavati-- ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityetasminnarthe yaḥ pratyayo
gotrāt prāpnoti sa daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu na bhavatīti, gotre
vuñeva prāpnotīti, atastasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedho vidhīyate|
gaukakṣyaśabdādgargādiyañantāt ṭhkaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111)

(4.2.112) ityaṇ ||

iti| 
atha tasyeti vacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tasyagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtameva ?
ityāha-- ṭhptasyaprakaraṇam-- prācīna mudrita vā} tasya prakaraṇam'
ityādi| taddhi prakṛtaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ śaiṣikairghādibhiḥ
psambaddha--mu.pāṭhaḥ} sambaddham| atastadanuvṛtau te'pyanuvarteran|
asmiṃstu tasyagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe pūrvakaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ nivartate|
tasmāt prakṛte'pi tasyeti vacane śaiṣika nivṛtyarthaṃ
punastasyetyucyata iti| nanu ca pradhānaṃ ghādayaḥ, vidhīyamānatvāt;
tasyeti tu vacanapradhānam, tadarthatvāt; tatrāyuktā guṇe
nivartamāne pradhānasya nivṛtiḥ prasajyeta, yathaiva hi prakṛtaṃ tasyeti
vacanaṃ ghādibhiḥ sambaddhaṃ tathā aṇādibhirapi ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ubhayeṣāṃ

ṭhkaṃsīyaḥ'iti| uṇādau kaṃsaśabdaḥ sapratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ|
paśuśabdo'pi ṭhpṛthivivyā pdhṛṣihṛṣabhyaḥ--da.u.} dhṛṣibhyaḥ kuḥraka'
(da.u.1.108) ityanuvartamāne ṭhāṅparayoḥ khaniśṛbhyāṃ pḍicca--da.u.,
ticca iti prā.mu.nyāsapāṭhaḥ} ṇicca' (da.u.1.118) iti kupratyayāntaḥ|
tadanayorapi dhātupratyayayorlukkasmānna bhavati ? ityāha--
ṭhprātipadikādhikārāt' ityādi| prātipadikāditi vartate, tena
prātipadikebhyo yo vihitastasya lugbhavati| ne cemau
prātipadikādvihitau, kiṃ tarhi ? dhātoḥ, ato'nayorlugna pravartate|
ṭhanudātatvādeva' iti| paraśavyaśabdo hi ṭhtitsvaritam' (6.1.185)
ityantasvaritaḥ| ṭhtenānudātādiḥ' iti| ṭhītīti tatra vartate' iti|
ṭhyasyate ca' (6.4.148) ityataḥ||
iti śrībodhisatvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ

atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
caturthaḥ pādaḥ
1. prāgvahateṣṭhak| (4.4.1)
atha prāggrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? arthaviśeṣe pratyayāntareṇāpavādena
nivartitasya ṭhaka utarasmin granthāntare punarupasthānaṃ yathā
syādityavemartham| tadyathā-- ṭhsaṃskṛtam' (4.4.3)
ityetasminnarthaviśeṣe ṭhkulatthakopadhāt' (4.4.4) ityaṇā
nivartitasyotaratrārthāntare ṭhtarati' (4.4.5) ityetasminnarthe
punarupasthānaṃ yathā syāditi|
ṭhṭhakprakaraṇe' ityādi| taditi karmābhidhāyibhya āhetyetasminnarthe
māśabdādibhyaṣṭhaka upasaṃkhyānan| ṭhvākyādetat pratyayavidhānam'
iti| sa eva hi vākyārtha iti nāvamṛṣṭaḥ karmabāvamupagataḥ| tadāheti
nirdiśyate--tadabhidāyina eva vākyāt pratyaya iti| padasamudāyo hi
vākyamiti| ṭhmā' ityetasya ca ṭhśabda' ityetasya ca padasya yaḥ padasya yaḥ
samudāyastadvākyam| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam|
kathaṃ punaḥ prātipadikādhikāre vākyātpratyayavidhiḥ ? ityata āha---
ṭhprabhūtādibhyaḥ' iti| punarvacanāt| yadi hyanenāpi prātipadikādeva
pratyayavidhiḥ syādevaṃ sati ṭhpāheti prabhūtādibhyaḥ---prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ}
āhau prabhūtādibhyaḥ' (vā.483) iti punarupasaṃkhyānamanarthakaṃ syāt;
anenaiva siddhatvāt| prabhūtādayo'pi hi māśabdādayo bhaviṣyanti,
te ca karmābhidhāyina eva pratyayamutpādayanti;
kriyāviśeṣaṇābhidhāyitvāt| kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ hi karmatvaṃ
ṭhtatpratyanupūrvamīpalomakūlam' (4.4.28) ityatra pratipādayiṣyate--
pratyayārtho'pyaheti| sa eva tasmādāheti prabhūtādibhya
itipunarvacanādvākyādeva pratyavidhānaṃ vijñāyate|
ṭhkriyāviseṣaṇāt' iti| prabhūtādiśabdaḥ
kriyāviśeṣaṇābhidhāyitvādabhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā
kriyāviśeṣamaśabdenoktaḥ||

2. tena dīvyati khanati jayati jitam| (4.4.2)
ṭhtena' iti pratyekamabhisambadhyate| ṭhsarvatra karaṇe tṛtīyā' iti|
dīvyatītyādau kartari lakāra iti tenaiva karturabhihitatvāt
kartari tṛtīyā nopapadyate| tasmāt karaṇa eva tṛtīyā| atha hetau
tṛtīyā kasmānna bhavati ? anabhidhānāt| jitamityatra karmaṇi
niṣṭhāvidhānādyadyapi kartaryapi tṛtīyā sambhavati, tathāpi
dīvyatītyādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt karaṇa eva tṛtīyā vijñāyate|
devadatena jitamityatra kartari tṛtīyā; tena vākyameva bhavati; na
pratyayaḥ|
iha sūtre dīvyatītyādinaikavacanāntenaikasaṃkhyasya pratyayārthasya
vartamānena ca kālena nirdeaśaḥ| tataścaikasminneva pratyayārthe pratyaya
syāt, na dvibahvoḥ| tathā vartamāna eva kāle, na
bhūtabhaviṣyatoriti yaścodayet, taṃ ityāha-- ṭhpratyayārthe
saṃkhyākālayoravivakṣā' iti| avivakṣātu tayornāntarīyakatvāt|
avaśyaṃ hi yayā kayācit saṃkhyayā yena kenacit kālena nirdeaśaḥ
kartavya iti| na tau pradhānam, na ca tayorvivakṣeti| yadi tarhi
saṃkhyākālayoravivakṣeti sādhanasyāpyavivakṣā prāpnoti,
ekaprakaraṇatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasya hi vivakṣāmantarema dvitīyasya
padasyoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ bhavati tanniyogato vivakṣitavyam|
dīvyatītyādiṣvanvarthamātre vivakṣyamāṇe dvitīyasya
padasyoccāraṇamanarthakamāpadyeteti na yuktā sādhanasyāpyavivakṣā|
iha dīvyatītyevamādau ṭhkriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti kriyaiva padena
prādhānyenākhyāyate, kartā tu guṇībhūtaḥ, taddhitastu--ākṣika iti
prādhānyena kartāramevātra vakti, kriyā tu guṇabhāvena, etaccāyuktam;
ākhyāteṣūtpannaiḥ pratyayairyathā'sau tiṅntenābhidhīyate, tathaiva
pratyayāntenāpi yukto'bhidhātumiti yaścodayet, ityāha--
ṭhkriyāpradhānatve'pi ca' ityādi| abhidhānasvabhāvaścāyam, yena
kriyāprādhānyasyāpyanuvidhīyamānastaddhitaḥ kartupradhāno bhavati|
tasmāt kartṛtvabhāvo'trāpekṣitavyaḥ| na hi svabhāvo'pi na hi
svābhāvo'pi paryanuyogamarhati||

7. naudvyacaṣṭhan| (4.4.7)

22. saṃsṛṣṭe| 4.4.22)
nanu ca ṭhsaṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityeva saṃsṛṣṭe pratyayayo bhaviṣyati,
yat punaryena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tatena saṃskṛtaṃ bhavati ? naitat; sato
hyutkarṣādhānaṃ saṃskāraḥ,ekabhāvaḥ saṃsargaḥ| na ca tatrotkarṣeṇa
bhavitavyam, svaśucidravyasaṃsarge svaprakarṣa eva bhavati, notkarṣaḥ|
saṃsargamātre pratyaya iṣyate; tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭa iti vaktavyameva; etadeva
kriyatām; kiṃ ṭhsaṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityanena ? asatyapi saṃsarge yatra
saṃskṛtamasti tatrāpi pratyaya iṣyate-- vaidyikaḥ, na vidyayā saṃsarga
upapadyate; saṃsargo dravyayoreva bhavati, yathā--daṇḍapuruṣayoḥ|
mūrtimatastaddharmatvāt, rana tu vidyā mūrtimatī| kulatthakoladhādaṇo
(4.4.4) vidhānārthaṃ saṃskṛtagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| na hi saṃsṛṣṭamātre
pratyaya iṣyate; kintu tatkṛtaguṇādhāne||

23. cūrṇādiniḥ| (4.4.23)
nanu ca cūrṇena ye saṃsṛṣṭāsteṣāṃ cūrṇamasti, tatra

24. lavaṇālluk| (4.4.24)

pāṭhaḥ} kṣauram, amlaṃ dadhīti; tathā lavaṇaśabdo'pi vartiṣyate, tataḥ

26. vyañjanairupasikte| (4.4.26)
ṭhvyañjanaiḥra' iti| bahuvacananirdeaśaḥ svarūpavidhinirāsārthaḥ|

29. parimukhañca| (4.4.29)

30. pyaccchati garhyam| (4.4.30)
ṭhdviguṇam' iti| tādarthyāt tāccchabdyaṃ darśayati| ādviguṇārthe
vastuni dviguṇaśabdaṃ vartayitvā tatra pratyayaṃ kurvataḥ ko'bhiprāyaḥ ?
evaṃ manyate-- dvaiguṇika iti utamarṇa ucyate, na cāsau dviguṇaṃ
prayaccchati, kiṃ tarhi ? skandayitvā dviguṇaṃ gṛhṇāti; anyathā hi
viparyaye sati prasasyameva syāt, na tu garhyam| yadaikasminnarthe
tādarthyādÂdviguṇaśabdo vartate tadaikameva dviguṇārthaṃ prayaccchato
dviguṇameva bhavatīti garhyamiti| garhā punariha pratiṣiddhasya śāstreṇa
dīyamānasya pratyavāyahetutvādvetitavyā| ṭhprakṛtyantaram'
ityāpinopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe'| tatrāpi tādarthyādvṛddhyarthaṃ
yaddīyate tadÂvṛdhudhiśabdenocyate| nanu ca tatpratyākhyāne
vṛddhiśabdāt pratyaye sati vārdhika ityapi syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
avyavikanyāyena hi vṛddhiśabdena vākyameva bhavati| vṛdhuṣiśabdena
vākyaṃ vṛtiśca|| 

31. kusīdadaśaikādaśāt ṣṭhanṣṭhacau| (4.4.31)
tatrāpi kusīdārthe vastuni daśaikādaśārtheṣu ca daśasu
daśaikādaśaśabdaṃ vartayitvā tataḥ pratyayaḥ| sarvataḥ pūrvavadabhiprāyo
veditavyaḥ| daśa caikādaśa ceti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ| nanu ca
bhinnaviṣayayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate ?
daśaikādaśaśabhdo'pyekādaśārtheṣu daśasvevopacarādvartata
ityadoṣaḥ| yo daśa prayaccchatyekādaśa eva syuriti sa daśaikādaśa
ityucyate| daśaikādaśāditi nirdeaśādakārāntatvaṃ nipātyate;
kimartham ? vākye'pyakārāntatvaśravaṇārtha daśaikādaśān
prayaccchatīti||

34. śabdadarduraṃ karoti| (4.4.34)
tadityanenaiva dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ śabdadarduramiti
dvitīyānirdeaśo laukikavākyapradarśanārthaḥ| śabdadarduraṃ
karotītyedvyāvahārikaṃ vākyam| asya pratigraho yatra loke
vyavahārastatra pratyayo bhavati nānyatretyartha sūcayate, tena śabdaṃ
karoti ravara ityatra na bhavati| loke sa śābdika ityucyate yaḥ śabdaṃ
veti; vaiyākaraṇa eva śabdaṃ veti, tena tatraiva pratyayo bhavati, na
khare| ca asau vaiyākaraṇaḥ pratyayaprakṛtyādinā sarvaṃ śabdaṃ jānāti||

35. pakṣimatsyamṛgānhanti| (4.4.35)
ṭhsvarūpasya paryāyāṇāñca tadviśeṣaṇānāñca grahamiṣyate' iti| kathaṃ
punariṣyamāṇamapi paryāyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ labhyate ?
arthapradhānatvānnirdeaśasya| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ
bhavati, nārthapradhāna iti pratipāditametat prāk| yadi tarhi
paryāyāṇāmapi grahaṇam, ajihmān hantyanimiṣān hantītyatrāpi
prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ iha dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ
punarditīyāsamarthavibhaktinirdeaśo laukikavākyapradarśanārthaḥ| asay
parigrahaḥ-- yatra laukikavākyavyavahārastatra pratyayo bhavati
nānyatretyasyārthasya sūcanārtham, tenājihmān hantītyādau pratyayo
na bhavati| ajihmān hantyanimiṣān hantītyasyārthasya
vivakṣāyāmājihmikaḥ, ānimiṣika iti loke na vyavahāro'sti| tatra
pakṣiṣu ṭhpākṣikaḥra' itaci svarūpasyodāharaṇam| ṭhśākunikaḥ' iti
paryāyasya| ṭhmāyūrikaḥ, taitirikaḥ' iti| viśeṣasya| matsyeṣu
ṭhmātsyikaḥra' iti svarūpasya | ṭhmainikaḥra' iti paryāyasya |
ṭhśāpharikaḥra, śākulikaḥ'iti viśeṣasya| mṛgeṣu ṭhmārgikaḥ' iti
svarūpasya| ṭhhāriṇikaḥra' iti paryāyasya| ṭhsaukarikaḥ, sāraṅgikaḥ'
iti viśeṣasya||

36. paripanthañca tiṣṭhati| (4.4.36)
yathā parimukhañceti parimukhaśabdasyāvyayībhāvatvaṃ tatpuruṣatvañca,
tathehāpi paripanthaśabdasya taddvayaṃ veditavyam| ṭhtaditi
dvitīyāsamarthāt' iti| nanu ca tiṣṭhatirayamakarmakaḥ tatkathaṃ
dvitīyayā saha sambandhaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; akarmaṇāmapi hi
pkālabhāvādhvanāṃ mudritapāṭhaḥ} kālabhāvādhnaḥ karmasaṃjñāṃ
pratipadyante| tathā coktam-- ṭhkālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā
hyakarmaṇām' (vā.1.3.51) iti| ṭhpāripanthikaścauraḥ' ityavyayībhāvaḥ|
cauro yaḥ panthānaṃ varṇayitvā tiṣṭhati sa
pāripanthikaśabdenocyate| tatpuruṣapakṣe tu yaścauraḥ patho vyāpya
tiṣṭhati sa paripanthika ucyate|
ṭhcakāraḥ' ityādi| tiṣṭhati cetyatra pratyayārthasamanantarameva cakāro
draṣṭavyaḥ, tena samānajātīyasyaiva pratyayārthasya samuccayaṃ karoti|
atha prakṛtereva samuccayaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ? karmatvānupapateḥ |
tatra hi dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiranuvartate, tiṣṭhateścākarmakatvāt
prakṛtāyā matsyādeḥ pkṛteḥ karmabhāvo nopapadyate|
kālabhāvādhvanāmeva hyakarmakāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñeṣyate, na matsyādīnām|
laukikavākyapradarśanārthaṃ tadetadÂdvitīyoccāraṇaṃ karotītyāha--
ṭhpparipathaśabdaparyāyaḥ---kāśikā}paripathaparyāyaḥ' iti| kimetasya
jñāpane prayojanamityāha-- ṭhsa viṣayāntare' ityādi| asati hyasmin
jñāpane ṭhakpratyayasanniyogena prakṛtirnirdiśyamānā pratyayābhāvena
prasajyate| jñāpane tu sati yatrāpi pratyayo na bhavati tatrāpi prayoga
upapadyate||

37. māthotarapadapadavyanupadaṃ dhāvati| (4.4.37)
daṇḍabhāvo mātho daṇḍamāthaḥ u ṛjuḥ panthā ucyate, taṃ dhāvati
ṭhdāṇḍamāthikaḥ'| śulkasya māthaḥ śulkamāthaḥ, ṭhśaulkamathikaḥ'| padasya
paścādanupadam, paścādarthe'vyībhāvaḥ, anupadaṃ dhāvati--
ṭhānupadikaḥ' | pratyāsatyā dhāvatītyarthaḥ| dvitīyāyāṃ samarthavibhaktau
labdhāyāṃ punardvitīyānirdeaśaḥ ṭhiṣṭādÂdvitīyāntādyathā syāt,
aniṣṭānmā bhūt' ityevamartham| tena yaḥ ṭhanuryatsamayā' (2.1.15)
ṭhyasya cāyāmaḥ' (2.1.16) ṭhkugatipradāyaḥ' (2.2.18)
ityādibhiryogairanuśabdasya samāsaḥ, tato na bhavati||

39. padotarapadaṃ gṛhṇāti| (4.4.39)
padagrahaṇena svarūpameva gṛhyate, na suptiṅntaṃ padam| ata evāha--
ṭhpadaśabda utarapadaṃ yasya' iti| etacca dvitīyāyāṃ
laukikaravākyapradarśanārthatvādÂdvitīyānirdeaśāllabhyate|
padotarapadaṃ gṛhṇātītyetallaukikaṃ vākyam| asya pradarśanenaitat
sūcitam-- laukikasya hi padasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti|
atha padāntādityeva kasmānnoktam ? ityāha-- ṭhpadāntāditi noktam'
ityādi| gatārtham| padamevotarapadaṃ yasya tasmādyathā syāt| iha tu
ślokapādapadaṃ gṛhṇātīti bhavatīti kecit||

40. pratikaṇṭhārthalalāmañca| (4.4.40)

lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' (2.1.14) iti| kaṇṭhasyābhimukhya iti|

gṛhṇāti, yo vā kaṇṭhamābhimukhyena gṛhṇāti| dvitīyāsamarthaprakaraṇe
punardvitīyānta prakṛtinirdeaśa iṣṭādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt|

43. samavāyān samavaiti| (4.4.43)
ṭhsamavāyaḥ samūha ucyate, na samprasāraṇā' iti| kuta etat ? tatra
samavaitītyasya pratyayārthasyāyogāt| āgatya tadekadeśībhavatīti
samavaitiśabdasyārthaḥ| sampradhāraṇā cāmūrtiḥ, caitasiko dharmaḥ, na ca
tadekadeśībhavituṃ śakyate| tasmāt samūha eva samavāyaśabdasyārthaḥ,
naitītyasyārthaḥ| etīti vartamāne samavaitīti
vacanamarthaviśeṣapratipatyartham| etīti prāptimātraṃ kurvannucyate|
samavaitītyāgatya tadekadeśībhavatīti||

46. saṃjñāyāṃ lalāṭakakkuṭyau paśyati| (4.4.46)

iti| lālāṭikakaukkuṭikaśabdayo rūḍhyamekatvāt|
ṭhtadanena' ityādi| yata eva sarvāvayavebyo lalāṭṃa dūre dṛśyate,
tasmādanena lalāṭadarśanena sevakasya svāminaṃ pratyanupaśleṣo

kukkuṭaḷrtho deśaśca vidyate||

55.śilpam| (4.4.55)
ṭhśilpaṃ kauśalam' iti| kriyābhyāsapūrvako jñānaviśeṣaḥ|
ṭhmṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpamasya' iti| mṛdaṅgo vādyate yena śilpena
tanmṛdaṅgavādanam| nanu ca mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpaṃ yasyeti vigṛhya
pratyaya utpadyamāno mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdādeva prāpnoti, na tu
mṛdaṅgaśabdāt, tato mārdaṅgavādanika iti bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ
mārdaṅgika iti bhavati ? ityāha-- ṭhmṛdaṅgavādanam' ityādi|
mṛdaṅgaśabda eva pratyayamutpadayati, sa tu mṛdaṅgavādane
vartamānaḥ, na mṛdaṅge| atraśabdaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| na cāyaṃ
niyamaḥ-- yena vigrahaḥ kriyate, tata eva pratyayena bhavitavyamiti| yathā
hyaveridaṃ māṃsamāvikam, māṃsamityaviśabdena vigrahaḥ
kriyate'vikaśabdādeva pratyayo bhavati, tathehāpi
mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate, pratyayastu
mṛdaṅśabdādbhavati| tena tatra gatārthatvāccchilpaśabdo na prayujyata
ityabhiprāyaḥ||

59. śaktiyaṣṭaḷerīkak| (4.4.59)
atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, ikageva nocyeta, ikakyapi
savarṇadīrghatve kṛte śāktīko yāṣṭīka iti sidhyatyeva ? na sidhyati;
ikārasya ṭhyasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopena bhavitavyam| tatkutaḥ
savarṇadīrghatvam ? ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādeva lopo na bhaviṣyati|
nanu cāvagrahanivṛtirikārasya prayojanaṃ syāt ? naitat; yadi
hyaetat prayojanaṃ syāt sūtrārambho'narthakhaḥ syāt; ṭhakāpyanavagrahasya
siddhatvāt ? nānarthakaḥ ; vākyanivṛtyarthatvāt| evamapi
pratyayagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, ṭhakpratyayo hi prakṛtaḥ , tatraitāvadena
vaktavyam-- śakkatiyaṣṭaḷeriti| evaṃ punarvidhānāṃ vākyanivṛtyarthaṃ
bhaviṣyati, kimīkagvidhānena ? tasmādikaggrahaṇasāmarthyāllopo na
bhaviṣyati| evamapi ṭhakaiva ṭhyasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti
lopābhāvenānavagrahe siddhe hīkaggrahaṇamadhikavidhānārthaṃ pratīyate|
tena ṭhyasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopo na bhavati| yathā tasmādakaḥ
savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrgho'pi na syāditi vigṛhītameva śrūyeta|
tasmādīkagvaktavyaḥ||

60. astināstidiṣṭaṃ matiḥ| (4.4.60)

62. cchatrādibhyo ṇaḥ| (4.4.62)
cchatraśīlatvaṃ śiṣyasya pratipādayitumāha--
ṭhchādanādapavāraṇāccchatram' ityādi| apavāriṇādityanena

taccchatramityucyate , tena śiṣyo'pi gurukāryatatparo gururyāni
ccchidrāṇi gopayati teṣāmāvaraṇāya pravṛtastatra yuktaḥ
saccchatrasahacaritāṃ kriyāmācarÄaścchatraśīlo bhavati|
ṭhsthāśabdo'tra paṭhaḷte, sa copasargapūrvo gṛhyate' iti| tataśca tasya
ṭhātaścopasarge' (3.3.106) ityaṅpratyayamutpādyāpyutpāditatvāt|

63. karmādhyayane vṛtam| (4.4.63)
kriyayā yadvyāpyamānamīpsitatamamanīpsitatamaṃ vā tat karma| iha
tvanīpsitatamaṃ gamyate| ata evāha-- ṭhyasyādhyayanaprayuktasya' ityādi| na
hi kasyacidadhyayane yuktasya parīkṣākāle paṭhataḥ
skhalitapāṭharūpamīpsitaṃ bhavati| adhyayanaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ,
karmasādhano vā| adhītam, adhīyate, vā'dhyayanam| vṛtaṃ u
bhūtam,utpannamityarthaḥ|
ṭhekamanyat'ityādi| samyak pāṭhāpekṣayānyo'rtho veditavyaḥ|
ṭhdvaiyanyikaḥ; traiyanyikaḥ' iti| ṭhna yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyām' (7.3.3)

64. bahvacpūrvapadāṭṭhac| (4.4.64)
ṭhdvādaśānyikaḥ' iti| dvādaśaśabdo bahvacpūrvapadam| dvau ca daśa
ceti dvandvaḥ| ṭhdvyaṣṭanaḥ saṃkhyāyāmabahuvrīhyaśītyoḥ' (6.3.47)
ityātvam, tato dvādaśānyānīti vigṛhya ṭhtaddhitārthe' 92.1.51) iti
samāsaḥ| nanu caikādeśe kṛte pūrvotarapadābhāvāt
bahvacpūrvapadaṃ na bhavati, na cāntādivadbhāvo'sti -- ṭhubhayata
āśraye nāntādivat' (vyā.pa.51) naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhnendrasya parasya'
(7.3.22) iti jñāpakādeśādeśāt pūrvaṃ pratyayaḥ| ṭhtatrodaśānyikaḥ'
iti| trayaśca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ, ṭhtrestrayaḥ' (6.3.48) iti traya ādeśaḥ|
anyaśabdo'tra samyak pāṭhāpekṣayāpapāṭhe vartata ityata āha--
ṭhcaturdaśāpapāṭhāḥra' ityādi| kathaṃ punarjñāyate'pāṭhe'nyaśabdo
vartate ? ityāha-- ṭhudāte' ityādi| udāte
kartavye'nudātakaraṇamapapāṭhaḥ| tatra ya udāte kartavye'nudātaṃ
karoti sa yasmādanyaṃ karoṣītyucyate tato
jñāyate'nyaśabdo'papāṭhe vartata iti||

65.hitaṃ bhakṣāḥ| (4.4.65)
nanu hitaśabdayoge caturthyā bhavitavyam, ṭhhitayoge caturthī

punastadevopasaṃkhyānam| liṅgañca----hitārthā kriyā

66. tadasmai dīyate niyuktam| (4.4.66)
nanu ca ṭhtadasay paṇyam' (4.4.51) ityatastaditi prathamā
samarthavibhaktiranuvartiṣyate, tadapārthakaṃ punaḥ
prathamāsamarthavibhaktyupādānām; ṭhasmai' iti pratyayārthopyapārthaka eva|
tathā hi ṭhasya' (4.4.51) ityanuvartate, tatra ṭhdīyatau' iti
ityabhisambandhāttu samÂparadānatvena bhavitavyam| tataśca
śeṣasambandhe nivṛte caturthyamatra vipariṇamyate, tasmāt ṭhdīyate
niyuktam' ityetāvadeva vaktavyam ? atrocyate--
samarthavibhaktyupādānaṃ tāvat pūrvasūtre samarthavibhaktiviśeṣaḥ
pratyayanutpādayatītyasay sūcanārtham. teneha na bhavati--
duḥkhamasyādhyane vṛtam, ajayo'syādhyayane vṛta iti| apapāṭha eva hi
vṛte pratyaya iṣyate| dīyamāne na sarvasmāt caturthī-- areḥ pṛṣṭhṃa
dadātīti| sa ca ṣaṣṭhaḷa eva viṣayo'rthaḥ| ṣaṣṭhaḷrthaṃ eva pratyayo
vijñāyate, caturthyantādyathā syāt| evaṃ ṭhasmai' iti pratyayārtho
nirdiśyate||

67. śrāṇāmāṃsaudanāṭÂṭiṭhan| (4.4.67)
ṭhatha ṭhañeva kasmānnoktaḥ' iti| eva hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
syādetat-- ṭhañṭiṭhanorviśeṣo'sti, ataṣṭinnukto na ṭhañ ? ityata
āha--- ṭhna hyatra' ityādi| dvyorapyanayorvṛddhatvānnāsti viśeṣaḥ|
yo'pi ṭhvṛddhinimitasya' (6.3.39) ityādinā ṭhañi
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, tasay ṭhna kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti
ṭiṭhÂannapyabhāvānnātra ṭhañṭiṭhanoḥ kaścidviśeṣo'sti| ṭhmāṃsaudana'
ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati|
ṭhkecit' iti vacanādvigṛhītagrahaṇaṃ kecinneccchanatītyetaduktaṃ
bhavati| tanmate ṭhañeva vaktavyaḥ| ṭiṭhatvacanaṃ vaicitryārtha
veditavyam||

68. bhaktādaṇanyatarasyām| (4.4.68)

69. tatra niyuktaḥ| (4.4.69)
atha ṭhniyuktaḥ' (4.4.66) iti vartamāne punarniyuktagrahaṇaṃ kasmāt
kriyate ? arthabhedāt| na tasya hyakavyabhicāralakṣaṇo nityabhāvo'rthaḥ|
asya tu tato'nya evārtho yadāha-- ṭhniyuto'dhikṛtaḥ' ityādi||

70. agārāntāṭhÂaṭhan| (4.4.70)

71. adhyāyinyadeśakālāt| (4.4.71)
adhyetuṃ śīlamasyetyadhyāyī, tācchīliko ṇiniḥ| ṭhadhyayanasya yau
deśakālau śāstreṇa pratiṣiddhau tāvadeśakālaśabdenocyete' iti|
apratiṣiddhābhyāṃ deśakālaśabdābhyāmanyatvāt
paryudāsavṛtyā'bhakṣyāsparśanīyavadadhyayanasyeti| ata āha---
tasyādhyāyinā pratyayārthena sannidhāpitatvāt| na hi
vinādhyayanenādhyāyyupapadyate||

72. kaṭhināntaprastārasaṃsthāneṣu vyavaharati| (4.4.72)
alpāctarasya prastāraśabdasya ca pūrvanipātamakurvannetat sūcayati--
anyadapi kāryaṃ lakṣaṇaprāptaṃ na bhavati| tena kaṭhināntaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ na
bhavatīti kaṭhinaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate| ṭhpharatirayam--
prā.mu. pāṭhaḥ} vyavaharatirayamasti paṇinā samānārthaḥ-- yasya
ṭhvyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ' (2.3.57) ityatra grahaṇam, asti vivāde--
vyavahāre parihṛtamiti, asti ca vikṣepe śalākāṃ vyavaharatīti,
asti ca laukike kriyātatve-- laukiko vyavahāra iti| iha tu
kriyātatve vartamānasya grahaṇamityetaddarśayitumāha--ṭhvyavahāraḥ
kriyātatvam' iti| kriyāyā aviparītasvabhāvatvādi kriyātatvam|
ṭhyathā' ityādi| laukiko vyavahāra ityatra yathā vyavahāraḥ kriyātatve
vartate, tathehāpi darśayati| kriyātatve vartamānasya grahaṇam| ṭhtatra'
(4.4.69) itisaptamyadhikāre saptamīnirdeaśāt prasiddhyupasaṃgrahaṇaṃ
labhyate| ṭhvāṃśakaṭhinikaścchakracaraḥra' iti| yaścakracaraḥ sannanuṣṭheyāṃ
kriyāṃ śāstroktamavigītā vaṃśakaṭhine'nutiṣṭhati sa evamucyate||

73. nikaṭe vasati| (4.4.73)
nikaṭe samīpa ityarthaḥ| yatra śāstrato nikaṭavāsastatrāyāyaṃ vidhiḥ|
etacca saptamyāṃ samarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ saptamīnirdeaśāt
prasiddhyupasaṃgrahaṇena labhyate| sa hyaevamarthaḥ kṛtaḥ--- iṣṭe saptamyante
yathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| sa punaḥ śāstrato nikaṭavāsa
āraṇyakasya bhikṣoriti darśayati-- ṭhāraṇyakena bhikṣuṇā' ityādi||

74. āvasthāt ṣṭhal| (4.4.74)

75. prāgghitādyat| (4.4.75)

76. tadvahita rathayugaprāsaṅgam| (4.4.76)
taditi dvitīyāmarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ rathādīnāṃ dvitīyānirdeaśa
iṣṭādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| tenehava bhavati-- gauryugya iti;
iha na bhavati-- yugaṃ vahati rājā kaliṃ dvāparaṃ veti| tathā prāsajyata
iti prāsaṅgaḥ, yat kāṣṭhṃa vahanakāle vatsānāṃ kaṇṭhaāsajyate
tatprāsaṅgaḥ, taṃ vahati prāsaṅgyaḥ| iha na bhavati-- prasaṅgādāgataṃ
prāsaṅgam| ṭhyugyañca pattre' (3.1.121) iti nipātanādyaugyaśabde
siddhe yugagrahaṇaṃ svarārtham| na yugyamayugyamityatra naño
guṇapratiṣedhe ṭhsampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ' (6.2.155) ityato naña
ityanuvartamāne ṭhyayatoścātadarthe' (6.2.156) iti naña
utarasyāntodātatvaṃ yathā syāt| tena na hyaekasvaro labhyate| tasya
kyabantatvāt||

77. dhuro yaḍḍhakau| (4.4.77)
atha ṭhdhuro ṭhak ca' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, cakāraḥ samuccayārthaḥ,
yathābhihite pratyaye vijñāyamāne yadeva bhaviṣyati ? naitadevam;
yo hi dhuraṃ vahati dhuso'sau voḍhā bhavati|tasya yathāvihite
pratyaye vijñāyamāne ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇapi syāt|
yadÂgarhaṇāt tasyedaṃvivakṣāyāmapi yadeva bhavati||

78.khaḥ sarvadhurāt| (4.4.78)
ṭhsarvadhuram' iti| sarvā cāsau dhūśceti ṭhpūrvakālaika' (2.1.49)
ityādinā samāsaḥ| ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinā samāsāntaḥ|
ṭhstrīliṅge nyāyye' iti| tatpuruṣasyotarapadārthapradhānatvāt
ṭhparavalihghaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ' (2.4.26) iti dhūḥśabdasya yalliṅgaṃ
tadeva nyāyyamiti| tatra ṭhsarvadhurāyāḥ' iti sūtre kartavye yataḥ
sarvadhurāditi napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeaśaḥ sa śabdarūpāpekṣaḥ,
arthāpekṣe hi nirdeaśe paravalliṅgatā bhavati| ayantu
śabdarūpāpekṣaḥ,śabdarūpañca napuṃsakamiti napuṃsakenaiva nirdeaśo
yuktaḥ| arthavivakṣāyāṃ tu strīliṅgameva bhavati-- sarvadhurāṃ
vahatīti||

79.ekadhurālluk ca| (4.4.79)
ṭhekadhurāt' ityayamapi śabdarūpāpekṣayā nirdeaśaḥ| arthāpekṣayā hi
paravalliṅgatā bhavati| atrāpi pūrvavat samāsasamāsāntau
veditavyau| vacanasāmarthyātpakṣe lugvidhīyate| yadi hi nityo
luk syāt, khasya vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, yata eva hi lukaṃ
vidadhyāt|nanu caikadhuraśabdāt kenacidvihito na syāt, tasya
kathaṃ luk śakyate vijñātum ? lugvacanādeva yato'pi
vidhiranugamyata ityadoṣaḥ||

80. śakaṭādaṇ| (4.4.80)
rathaśakaṭahalasīrebhyaḥ pratyayavidhānamanarthakam, ṭhtasyedam' (4.3.120)
ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| śabdabhedādvidhānamiti cedanyo hi śabdo

81. halasīrāṭṭhak| (4.4.81)

ṭhdvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) ityanena luk prāpnoti| anena punarna
prāpnoti, kasmāt ? ṭhprāgādīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) #tyidhikārāt|

82. saṃjñāyāṃ janyāḥ| (4.4.82)
astyatra yarbha iti ṭhpin ityeva sūtram-- da.u.} in sarvadhātubhyaḥ'
(da.u.1.46) janayatīti vā| ṭhatra kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' (ga.sū.50)
ṭhsarvato'ktinnarthāt' (ga.sū.51) iti ṅīp-- janī, tāṃ vahanti janyāḥ
u jāmāturvayasyāḥ| vivāhamānitābhidhīyate| kecitu kartari

83. vidhyatyadhanuṣā| (4.4.83)
ṭhpadyāḥ' iti| ṭhpadyatyatadarthe' (6.3.53) itipādaśabdasya padbhāvaḥ|
ṭhūravyāḥ' iti| ṭhvānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ|
ṭhnanu ca' ityādi| dhanuratra prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthena vāhyaṃ
karaṇamapekṣyate, tena sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatītyasāmarthyam ? nanu caṭa
vyadhanamevātra sāpekṣam, kriyayā karaṇaṃ sambadhyata iti kṛtvā, tacca
vyadhanaṃ kriyāpradhānatvādākhyātasya pradhānaṃ bavati, pradhānas sāpekṣasya
bhavatyeva vṛtiḥ, yathā-- rājupuraṣo'yamabhirūpa iti ? naitadasti;
yadyapi kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, tathāpīha pratyayārthaṃ eva pradhānam|
pratyayārthasya sādhanaṃ vyaddhā| tathā ca prāguktam---ṭhkriyāpradhānatve'pi
cākhyātasya taddhiteḥ svabhāvāt sādhanapradhānaḥ' iti| atha kriyādvāreṇa
vyaddhurapi karaṇaṃ pratyapekṣā bhavatīti kalpyate, tathā ca sati
prakṛtyarthasyāpi kriyādvāreṇaiva karaṇaṃ pratyapekṣā bhavatīti kena
vāryate ! na hi pādau vidhyati dhanuṣeti karaṇavivakṣāyāṃ
vyadhanamātrasya pādau karma dhanuṣkaraṇaviśiṣṭasya| tasmādvyadhanasyāpi
kriyākaraṇe pratyapekṣetyasāmrathyātpratyayo na bhaviṣyati|
ṭhanabhidhānācca' iti| atraivocapapatyanataram| kathaṃ
punarupapatyantaramityāha--- ṭhna hi' ityādi| dhanuṣā padya ityukte
dhanuṣa padyaṃ pratyupalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambhāvyate, yathā--śikhayā
parivrājakamadrākṣīditra śikhayā parivrājakaṃ prati| dhanuṣā saha
dṛṣṭaḥ padya ityeṣo'pyarthaścāśaṅkyate| na tu pādau vidhyati
dhanuṣetyayamartho vivakṣitaḥ pratīyate| ṭhevaṃ tarhi ' ityādinā
kriyāviśeṣaṇaparo dhanuṣeti nirdeaśaḥ; na dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ|
pratiṣedhe pradhānamiti darśayati--ṭhtena' ityādinā| kriyata eva dhanuṣaḥ
pratiṣedhaḥ, tena kriyā viśeṣyate| tena cauraṃ vidhyatītyādau na
bhaviṣyati| sambhāvyate hi caurādivyadhanakriyayā dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvam||

84. dhanagaṇaṃ labdhā| (4.4.84)
kathaṃ punaratra dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ, yāvatā ṭhkartṛkarmaṇoḥ
kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhaḷa bhavitavyam ? ityāha-- ṭhlabdheti tṛnnantam'

89. saṃjñāyāṃ dhenuṣyā| (4.4.89)

90.gṛhapitanā saṃyukte ñyaḥ| (4.4.90)

ṭhanyasyāpi' ityādi| yathaiva hi gṛhapatiryajanamāno gārhapatye

91.
nauvayodharmaviṣamūlamūlasītātulābhyastāryatulyaprāpyavaddhyānāmyasamasamitasammiteṣu| (4.4.91)
kathaṃ punarihāpi samarthavibhaktirlabhyate ? yāvatā nehopātā,
nāpyanuvartata ityāha--ṭhpratyayārthadvāreṇa' ityādi| dvāram u upāyaḥ,
kārakamityarthaḥ| iha tāryādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ| tatsambandhe kartari
karaṇe hetau tulyārthayoge ca yathāsambhavaṃ tṛtīyaiva bhavati| tataḥ
samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| ṭhnāvyam' iti| ṭhvānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79)
ityavādeśaḥ| atra nāvastaraṇakriyāyāṃ kartṛtvaṃ karaṇatvañca
vivakṣāvaśādbhavatīti karaṇe kartari vā tṛtīyā | evamanyatrāpi
yathāyogaṃ veditavyam|
ṭhdharmeṇa prāpyaṃ dharmyam' iti| tatpunardharmasya phalaṃ svargādyaucyate|
ṭhnanu ca' ityādi| nanu ca dharmeṇa yatprāpyaṃ taddharmādanapetaṃ bhavatīti
bhāvaḥ|
ṭhvidhyaḥ' iti| viṣeṇa vadhamarhatītyarthaḥ| vadhyaśabdasya ṭhdaṇḍādibhyo
yaḥ' (5.1.66) ityarhārthe vyutpāditatvāt|
ṭhānāmyamabhibhavanīyam' iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnāmatra namirabhibhave
vartate| ṭhpaṭādīnāmutpatikāraṇaṃ mūlam' iti| datena hiraṇyena
paṭādīnāmutpatirbhavati| ṭhtena' iti| mūlena| ṭhtat' iti| mūlyam'
| ṭhśeṣīkriyate' iti| anenābhibhūyata ityasyārthamācaṣṭe| śeṣīkriyate
u guṇabhāvamāpādyate, apradhānīkriyata ityarthaḥ| apradhānīkaraṇeva
abhibhavaḥ| kathaṃ punastena taccheṣīkriyate ? ityāha-- ṭhmūlyaṃ hi'
ityādi| hiśabdo hetau| mūlyamiha kartṛ, mūlaṃ karma| tatpraṇayena
hiraṇyena paṭādayo vikrīyante| tatra yanmūlātiriktaṃ hiraṇyaṃ lābhaḥ,
tanmūlyaṃ guṇo bhāvaḥ| saha tena vartata iti saguṇaḥ| guṇaḥ punariha
tadeva mūlyaṃ veditavyam| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--
yasmānmūlyabhāgenaiva bhāgabhūtena sabhāgaṃ mūlaṃ karoti na nyūnaṃ
tanmūlyamabhidhīyata iti| mūlye sati tat tatra dviguṇaṃ
karotītyucyate| kā punariyaṃ yuktaḥ, yadi nāma saguṇaṃ mūlaṃ
karotītyucyate tat kathaṃ mūlyamabhibhūyate ? yateyaṃ
yuktistadākhyāyate-- iha hi śāstre yatsiddhamupakāri
tadaṅgamapradhānam, yaccopakārasādhyamanupakārakaṃ tadaṅgi
pradhānamityeṣā vyavasthā| tathā coktam---
śāste dvyameveha syādaṅgamatha vā bhavedaṅgi tatra| 
upakāri siddamaṅgaṃ sādhyānupakārakamaṅgīti|| iti||
evañca mūlyena mūlaṃ saguṇaṃ kriyāmāṇamupakāryatvāt pradhānaṃ
sampadyate, mūlyaṃ tvanupakāryatvādapradhānaṃ sampadyate| tanmūlena
mūlyamabhibhūyate, tadapekṣayā tasyāḥ pradhānabhāvāpateḥ|
ṭhtulayā sammitaṃ tulyam' iti| atra tulyārthayoge tṛtīyā| yadyapi
tulyārthayoge ṣaṣṭhaḷpi vidhīyate,tathāpi
nauprabhṛtibhyastṛtīyāsamarthebhyaḥ pratyayavidhānāt tulāśabdādapi
tṛtīyāsamarthādeva pratyayo vijñāyate| ṭhyathā' ityādinā tulayā
sādṛśyaṃ darśayati| nanu ca ṭhtulyāsyaprayatnam' (1.1.9) iti

svarārthaṃ tu pratyayavidhānāt| ṭhyato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityādyaudātatvaṃ
yathā syāt| na hi nipātane satyādyaudātatvaṃ tulyaśabdasya śakyate
vijñātum||

2. ugavādibhyo yatÂ| (5.1.2)

3. kambalācca saṃjñāyāmÂ| (5.1.3)
nanu ṭhaparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyaḥ' (4.1.22) iti nipātanādeva
kambalya iti sidhyati kambalyaṃ hi pariṃmāṇaviśeṣaḥ, itarathā hi
kambalyaśabdasya tatra grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syātÂ, parimāṇaviśeṣasya
kambalyaśabdo nāmadeyamÂ; ayamapi pratyayaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ
vidhīyamānastatraiva bhavati, nānyatra; nahyatra kambalyaśabdaḥ saṃjñā,
tasmānnārtho'nena? naitadasti; nipātanena hi kambalyaśabdaḥ parimāṇe
sādhurityetāvatÂ pratīyate, na tu yadanto'yamiti|
tataścāntasvaritatvaṃ na syāt| tasmātÂ svaritatvaparijñānārthamidaṃ
kartavyamÂ| anantaraśrutasya yato'nukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ| nanu
svaritatvādeva yadbhaviṣyati? chāe'pi tarhi syātÂ| nanu ca ccchasya
sannidhāne prakṛtimātrācccha ukta iti niyamārthamidaṃ syātÂ,
taccāniṣṭamÂ, yatÂ punarniyataviṣaya iti tatsambandhe vidhyarthatā,
vidhiniyamayośca vidhereva jyāyānÂ? naitadasti; cchasyāpi sambandhe
vidhyarthatā sambhavati| kathaṃ saṃjñāyāmityucyate, saṃjñā
cānupātāvayavārthāpi bhati,
tatrānavayavārthānāmaprākkrītīyatvāddhitādyarthābhāve
cchapratyayārthametatÂ syātÂ, tasmāccakaro yatpratayayānukarṣaṇārthaḥ
kartavyaḥ? na kartavyaḥ; iṣṭato'pyadhikārāṇāṃ pravṛtinivṛtī bhavata
iti yata evānuvṛtirbhaviṣyati, na tu ccchasya| evaṃ tarhi cakāra
ugavādibhya ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| kimarthamidamÂ? sanaṅgvādibhyaḥ
paratvādañādayaḥ prāpnuvanti tadbādhanārthamiti| atha gavādiṣveva
ṭhkambalācca saṃjñāyāmÂ' iti kasmānna paṭhati? tatra pāṭhe na
kaścidgurulāghavakṛto viśeṣa iti yatkiñcidetaditi|| 

4. vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ| (5.1.4)
haviḥśabdo gavādiṣu paṭhaḷte, tena tasmānnityaṃ yatā bhavitavyamÂ|
atra haviṃrviśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇamÂ, nasvarūpasyeti; ugavādisūtre
svarūpaparibhāṣāyā upasthānātÂ| na hi tatra sopatiṣṭhamānā
kenacinniṃvāryate, tena svarūpasyaiva grahaṇamÂ| tatra svarūpagrahaṇe
satīha svarūpaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate; anyathā hi yadyatrāpi
svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syātÂ, tataḥ svatantra ekasmātÂ śabdātÂ nityaśca yato
vidhiḥ syādanityaścetyubhayamekatra nopapadyata iti na bhavati
viparyayaḥ| atha vā-haviḥśabdasyehi
pṛthagupādānādarthapradhānatvamavasīyate, anyathā hyapūpādiṣveva
paṭhediti| ṭhannavikārebhyaśca' iti| annavikāraḥuannaprakārāḥ, te ca
pratayayamutpādayanti vibhāṣā-udanyāḥ, udanīyā iti| yadyevamÂ,
apūpādīnāṃ kiṇvaparyantānāmatra vikāratvādeva siddhatvātÂ
pāṭho'narthako jāyate? yadā tarhi
kenacidākārasādṛśyenāpūpādayo'rthāntare upacaryante,
tadarthameṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ| kiṃñcānnavikāragrahaṇenāpūpādiṣu pratyamiccchata
ihāpi syātÂ--yavāpūpāḥ, vrīhitaṇḍulā iti| pratipadapāṭhe tu
grahaṇavatvātÂ tadandavidhiḥ paryudasto bhavati| nanu ca 'asamāse
niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) ityasamāsagrahaṇādbhavitavyamevātra
tadantavidhinā, etenāsamāsagrahaṇena pūrvatra
tadantavidhirastītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratipādyate? satyametatÂ; apūpādiṣu
pratipadapāṭhasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati||

6. śarīrāvayavādyatÂ| (5.1.6)
śīryata iti śarīramÂ, tena ghaṭāderapi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata
āha--ṭhśarīraṃ prāṇikāyaḥ' iti| etena rūḍhiriyamiti darśayati|
gavādāveti śarīrāvayavavācinaḥ| tatra tu yāḥ
prakṛtayastābhyo'nenāpi pūrveṇāpi vā yati viśe ṣo nāstyeva|
yatra viśeṣaḥ--ṭhnābhi nabhañca' (ga.sū.106) iti, sa viśeṣastatraiva
veditavya eva||

7. khalayavamāṣatilavṛṣabrahmaṇaśca| (5.1.7)
