iti| ṭhna saṃyogādvamantātÂ' (6.4.137) iti pratiṣedhātÂ
ṭhallopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopo na bhavati| ṭhnastaddhite'
(6.4.144) iti ṭilopo'pi na bhavita; ṭhye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168)
iti prakṛtibhāvātÂ| vṛṣaśabdo'yamatrākārānto gṛhyate, na tu
brāhmaṇaśabdo'kārānta iti| nanu cāśaṅkā vṛṣaśabde yuktā-nalope
sati kimayamakārāntaḥ? āhosvinnakārāntaḥ? iti, brahmanśabdācca yato
nivṛtiprasaṅgādÂ brahmañśabdādapi yacaca pratyayo nivartata iti
bhāvaḥ| ata evāha--ṭhcchapratyayo'pi' ityādi|
yatpratyayāpekṣayāpirayamÂ--na kevalaṃ yatpratyayo na bhavati, api tu
ccchapratyayo'pīti| brāhmaṇaśabdāccchapratyayābhāvo yojyaḥ| nanu
cābhyāmihānupādanādÂ yatpratyayo na bhavati, ṭhtasmai hitamÂ'
(5.1.5) iti ccchapratyayastu kasmānna bhavati? ityāha-ṭhanabhidhānātÂ' iti|
na hīha vṛṣīyamÂ, brāhmaṇīyamityukte vivakṣito'rthaḥ pratīyate;
yato'rthapratipādanaṃ prati niyatā eva śabdaśaktayo bhavantīti kvacitÂ
pratyayāntenārthasyābhidhānamÂṣa kvacidvākyeneti| ato
vākyamevāvatiṣṭhate-ṭhvṛṣṇe hitamÂ, brāhmaṇebhyo hitamÂ' iti|
vākyasamadhigamyasyārthasya taddhitenānabhidhānāditadi yāvatÂ|| 

8. ajāvibhyāṃ thyanÂ| (5.1.8)

pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| adantasya grahaṇe ṭhdvandve dhi' (2.2.32) ityetasya

ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.29)

9. ātmanviśvajanabogotarapadātÂ khaḥ| (5.1.9)
ayātmannityatra nalopaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yāvatā dvandvenāyaṃ nirdeaśaḥ
kriyate, tatra ṭhnalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopaḥ
prāpnoti? ityata āha-ṭhātmanÂ' ityādi| ātmannityeva bhavatyeṣā
prākṛtiriti jñāpanārthaṃ nalopo na kṛtaḥ| kaḥ punarevaṃ sati
viśeṣaḥ? ityāha-ṭhtena' ityādi| gatārthamÂ| yadyevamÂ,
viśvajanaśabdena hyutarapadasya sambandhaḥ prāpnoti? evaṃ
manyate-ātmanniti nalopābāvena pratyekaṃ
vākyaparisamāptervyabhicārasya darśitatvātÂ tataḥ
pratyāsaterbhogaśabdenaiva sambadhyate, na tu viśvajanaśabdeneti nāsati
doṣaḥ| ṭhkarmadhārayādeveṣyate' iti| vāryapāramparyopadeśātÂ|
vibhāvāgrahaṇānuvṛtervyavasthitavibāṣāvijñānādvedaṃ veditavyamÂ|
viśvasya jano viśvajanaḥ, viśvo jano'syeti viśvajana iti samāsena
bhavitavyamÂ| yathā kho na bhavati tathā cchāe'pi na
bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha-ṭhbahuvrīhistu' ityādi|
ṭhupasaṃkhyānamÂ' iti| pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanamÂ-iha hi
bhogasamāsāditi vāktavye utarapadagrahaṇamadhikavidhānārthamÂ| na
caivaṃ sati bahupūrvādīṣadasamāptau bhogo bahubhoga ityasmātÂ
khaḥ syādityāśaṅkanīyamÂ; bahucpracpratyayasya samāsābāvātÂ|
tato'tri chenaiva bhavitavyamÂ--bahubhogīya iti| tena pañcajanādapi
bhaviṣyati| saṃjñāśabdaścāyamÂ; ṭhdiksaṃkhye saṃjñāyāmÂ' (2.1.50) iti
samāsaḥ| tathā sarvajanādapi veditavyaḥ| ṭhtatpuruṣādeva' iti|
viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi mahājanāditi nirdeaśādeva
samānādhikaraṇādeva bhogaśabdo'yaṃ bhāvasādhanaḥ--bhuktirbhoga iti,
karmasādhano vā--bhujyata iti bhoga iti| ayamavyutpannaḥ śarīravācīsa,
tasyeha grahaṇamityāha--ṭhbhogaśabdaḥ' ityādi| bhogaśabdaḥ śarīrameva
pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| yatra vartamāno'yaṃ sākṣātÂ sambandhamāha, tatraiva
khapratyayamāsādayati| vartate ca kriyāyāṃ dravye ca| tathā hi--yadyapi
bhujikriyayā dravyeṇa ca sambandho'sti, tathāpi śarīreṇa mukhyaḥ
sambandha iti tato bhavati pratyayaḥ| yathā rājācāryābhyāṃ vākyameva
bhavati, tathehāpi bhavitarvyāmiti yaścodayetÂ, taṃ
pratyāha--ṭhācāryādaṇatvamÂ' iti| kṣubhnādipāṭhātÂ| ṭhkevalābhyāṃ
vākyameva bhavata#' iiti| cchapratyayo na bhavati, anarbhidhānādeva|| 

10. sarvapuruṣābhyāṃ ṇaḍhañañau| (5.1.10)

12. tadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ prakṛtau| (5.1.12)
tasmai idaṃ tadarthamÂ, ṭhcaturthī tadartha' (2.1.36) ityādinā samāsaḥ|
etadeva vacanaṃ jñāpakamÂ--arthotarapade samāse samudāyārthasya
liṅgaṃ bhavati, na ca paravalliṅgatetiṃ| etena yaduktaṃ--ṭharthena
nityasamāsaḥ sarvaliṅgatā ca vaktavyā' (vā.78) iti sā siddhā bhavati|
ṭhprakṛtirupādānakāraṇamÂ' iti| samānajātīyamabhinnasantānavṛti
kāraṇamupādanakāraṇamityucyate| upādīyata ityupādānamÂ,
bahulavacanātÂ karmaṇi lyuṭÂ, tasya kāraṇamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
ṭhtasyaiva va' ityādi| tasyaivopādānakāraṇasyotarabhāvyasthāviśeṣo
vikṛtiḥ| ṭhvikṛtivācinaḥ' ityādi| nanu ca ṭhsamarthānāṃ prathamādvā'
(4.1.82) iti vacanātadarthamiti prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭatvātÂ prakṛteśca
tadarthatvātÂ tadvācina eva pratyayaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prathamasya
cāprathamasya ca kāryaprāptau prathamādeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ
prathamagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ kṛtamÂ| iha tu prathamātÂ prāptireva nāsti|
ṭhprakṛtau' iti| saptamyā prakṛteḥ pratyayārthatvena sampāditatvātÂ|
ṭhvikṛteḥ' iti| pañcamyā vikṛteḥ prakṛtitvena tasmānnāyamasya viṣaya
iti vikṛtivācina eva pratyayo bhavati| ṭhvikṛtyarthāyāmÂ' iti|
anena tadarthamityatra subvyatyayena saptamyāḥ sthāne prathamā,
liṅgavyatyayena ca strīliṅgasya sthāne napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ kṛtamiti
darśayati| nanu ca cchandasi vyatyaya uktaḥ, nedaṃ cchandaḥ, tatkuto
vyatyayaḥ? ṭhcchandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.1.1.1) ityadoṣaḥ|
ṭhtadarthagrahaṇena' ityādi| iha prakṛtyantaranivṛtiḥ--yavānāṃ dhānāḥ,
dhānānāṃ saktava iti| kvacidvikārasya prakṛtisambandhaḥ--dhānānāṃ yavāḥ,
saktūnāṃ dhānā iti| kvacitÂ prakṛterananyārthatā,
yathā--kāṣṭhānāmaṅgārāḥ| prakṛterananyārthatākhyānārthena yadiṣṭaṃ
sampadyate, taddarśayati--ṭhpratyayārthasya ca' ityādi| iha vikṛtyarthāyāṃ
prakṛtau pratyaya ucyate| tasya tasmātÂ tādarthye caturthyeva
śakyate pratibodhayitumÂ| ataḥ pratyayārthasya tadarthatvena
sāmarthyāccaturthī samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| ṭhkecitu' ityādi| teṣāṃ
vacanalabhyaivu caturthī samarthavibhaktiḥ|
ṭhtadarthamÂ' iti| kimiti ṣaṣṭhī pratyudāhriyate? ṣaṣṭhaḷti tādarthyaṃ
brūte, yathā--guroridaṃ gurvarthamiti| tathā sati ṣaṣṭhaḷpi
samarthavibhaktirbhavati| aṅgārāṇāṃ kāṣṭhānīti pratyudāharaṇaṃ tu
prakṛtyantaranivṛtyā, tayā yavādeḥ samarthyete| aṅgārebhyaḥ
kāṣṭhāni, prākārebhya iṣṭakā iti| idamasati tadarthagrahaṇe na jñāyate
kimarthaṃ vivakṣitamiti| tasmādananyārthatā prakṛtervivakṣiteti| etatÂ
prayojanaṃ pratipādayituṃ tadarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca
prakṛtyantaranivṛtyā prakṛtireva sambadhyamānā vyatiricyata iti
yavādereva vyatirekavibhaktirbhavati| ye tu caturthīṃmanuvartayanti,
teṣāṃ tadarathagrahaṇaṃ catarthīviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate--tādarthye
caturthīti| tatra mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti pratyudāharaṇamÂ| teṣāṃ
caturthyanuvṛtirapārthikā; tadarthagrahaṇenaiva gatārthatvātÂ| tathā ca
yā tādarthyasamānārthā ṣaṣṭhī sā cāsatyāṃ viśeṣyate| ṭhyā kācitÂ'
itaci| na tūpādānakāraṇabhūtāpītyarthaḥ| syādetatÂ--kūpaḥ
prakṛtirudakasya na bhavatyeva; tatastannivṛtyarthaṃ vikṛtigrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyamityata āha--ṭhbhavati ca' ityādi| caśabdovadhāraṇe| nanu
cānyebhya eva svakāraṇebhya udakamutpādyate, tatkathaṃ kūpastasya
prakṛtiḥ? ityāha--ṭhtatrotpādanātÂ' iti| yathaiva hi prayājādīnāṃ
dharmāṇāmutpatyādhārabhūtau darśapaurṇamāsau prakṛtau bhavataḥ,
evamudakasyotpatyādhārabhūtatvātÂ kūpaḥ prakṛtirbhavati| yadyevamÂ,
udakamapi tasya vikṛtiḥ? ityāha--ṭhnanu' ityādi|
atraivopapatimāha--ṭhatyantabhedātÂ' iti| vikāro hi
prakṛterutaramavasthāntaramiti tato nātyantabhinno bhavati,
yathā--kāṣṭhānāmaṅgārāḥ| te hi pārthivenābhinnasantānavartitvena
kāṣṭhebhyo nātyantaṃ bhidyante| udakaṃ tu
bhinnasvabhāvatvādbhinnasantānavartitvācca kūpādatyantaṃ bhinnamÂ| ato
na tasyotaramavastāntaramiti na bhavati vikṛtiḥ| 
ṭhna tu kośī tasya prakṛtiḥ' iti| atatkāraṇatvātÂ,
anutpatyādhārabhūtatvācca| nanu ca prakṛtirvikṛtiriti
sambandhiśabdāvetau| sambandhiśabdaśca niyata eva pratiyogini
pratītimupajanayati, yathā hi--ṭhmātarivartitavyamÂ' ityukte na
cocyate ṭhsvasyāṃ mātari' iti, yā yasyā mātā tasyāmiti pratīyate|
evaṃ sati kūpalakṣaṇāyāṃ prakṛtau vikṛtyarthāyāṃ pratyayārthatvena
vivakṣitāyāmasatyapi vikṛtagrahaṇe tasyaiva kūpasya yā yā
vikṛtistata eva pratyayo vijñāyate| tathā ca
vikāravācino'siśabdātÂ pratyaye vidhitsite yasyāsau
prakṛtistasyāmeva tadarthāyāṃ prakṛtāvasatyapi prakṛtigrahaṇe pratyayo
vijñāyate| tasmādanyataropādāne'pi sarvamiṣṭaṃ sampadyate| na
kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata ityāha--ṭhtadarthaṃ dvayorapi' ityādi| anenaivaṃ
manyate--syādetadeva yadāsau prakṛtivikṛtiśabdau niyogataḥ
sambandhiśabdau, na cemau niyogataḥ sambandhiśabdau| tathā hiṃ,
vipūrvastāvadayaṃ karotiṃrastyevāpakāre--devadato'sthityai
vikarotīti; asti ceṣṭānānātve--vikurvate cchātrā iti;
astyanaucitye--vikṛtireṣā strīṇāṃ yatÂ svātantryamiti| asti
kārye--tantunāṃ paṭo vikāra iti| tatā prapūrvo'pyayamasti
kāraṇe--tantavaḥ prakṛtiḥ paṭasyeti; astiṃ caudāsīnye--satvānāṃ
prakṛtiriti| tānyucyante yānyanārambhakāṇi; asti
doṣāpagame--prakṛtisto'yamiti| asti svabhve-prakṛtyā'bhirūpa iti;
asti dharmāṇāmutpatyādhāre, yathā-darśapaurṇamāsau dharmāṇāṃ
prakṛtistho'yamiti| asati svabhāve-prakṛtyā'bhirūpa iti; asti
dharmāṇāmutpatyādhāre, yathā-darśapaurṇamāsau dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtiriti|
tadevamarthabahutvādanayoḥ sarmbāndhatvamanaikāntikamiti,
ato'nyataragrahaṇe na sidhyati| na cānyatareṇa śakyate vaktuaṃ vivakṣitaḥ
prakṛtivikārabhāvaḥ| ayamupādānakāraṇasya tadutarāvasthābhūtasya ca
yo vikāraḥ sa iha veditavyaḥ| yadi tu vipūrvaḥ karotiranekārthaḥ,
ṭhtasya vikāraḥ' (4.3.134) ityatrāpi sandehāpagamāya tarhi
prayatitavyamÂ? satyametatÂ; śailīyamācāryasya yasya
kvacidabhidhānamāśrayati, kvacannyāyamÂ, kvacidvacanamiti tatÂ
sarvamucyate| tena sarvaṃ pratyāyyate||

13. cchadirupadhibalerḍhañÂ| (5.1.13)
yadā cchadiścarmavikāro vivakṣyate tadāpi ḍhañeveṣyate--chādiṣeyaṃ
carmeti| nanu ca paratvātÂ ṭhcarmaṇo'ñÂ' (5.1.15) ityañÂ prāpnoti?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhcarmaṇo'ñÂ' ityatra cchadiṣo ḍhañanuvartiṣyate| 
yathā cchadiḥśabdādvaliśabdāccaturthīsamarthātÂ prakṛtivikārabhāve
pratyaya upajāyate, tathopadhiṃśabdādapi
bhavativyamityāśaṅkyāha--ṭhupadhiśabdātÂ' ityādi| atra
yuktimāha--ṭhupadhīyate' ityādi| tena ṭhkarmaṇyupasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' iti
darśayati| tena ca dravyasyānāsāditotarāvasthasyābhidhānamÂ|
yadyaupadhiṃśabdādvikṛtivācinaḥ syātÂ, evamarthāntare syātÂ| na
cāsau prakṛtiviśeṣe bhavati| na tūpadhiśabdādvācyasya pratyāntarasya
prakṛtivikārabhāvo'sti, abedātÂ| tathā hi--yadeva
rathāṅgamupadhiśabdenocyate
tadevānāsāditotarāvasthamaupadheyaśabdenāpi| syādetatÂ--yadā
bhāvasādhana upadhiṃśabda upadhānamupadhiriti tadā nāsti bhedaḥ,
kriyābhidhānātÂ; yadāpyupadhiśabdena kriyādravyasya vikāra ucyate
tadaupadheyaśabdena ca tatprakṛti dravyamÂ, ataḥ prakṛtiviśeṣe
parapratyayau bhaviṣyatīti? etaccāyuktamÂ; na hi kriyādravyasya
vikāro yujyate; atyantabhedātÂ| tasmātÂ sthārthaṃ
evopadhiṃśabdātÂ pratyayo vijñāyate||

15. carmaṇo'ñÂ| (5.1.15)
ṭhcarmaṇaḥ' iti pañcamī vā syātÂ? ṣaṣṭhī vā? yadi pañcamī, carmaṇa eva

16. tadasya tadasminÂ syāditi| (5.1.16)
dvitīyāśaṅkāmapaninīṣurāha--ṭhtatÂ' ityādi|
asterakarmakatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|
avayavārthapūrvatvādavayavyarthasyetyāha--ṭhasya' ityādi| karotīti
karaṇaḥ| kartari bahulavacanāllayuṭÂ| itiścāsau karaṇaśceti
karmadhārayaḥ| ṭhsambhāvane'lamiti cetsiddhāprayoge' (3.3.154)| 
nanu ca prākārīyā iṣṭakāḥ, prāsādīyaṃ dārviti ca pūrveṇaiva
siddhamÂ, tathā hi--yāsāmiṣṭakānāṃ yasya ca dāruṇo bahutvena
prākāraḥ prāsādaśca sambhāvyate, tāsāmiṣṭakānāṃ tasya ca dāruṇo
yathāsaṃkhyena prākāraprāsādau vikārau bhavataḥ, tādarthyācceṣṭakānāṃ
dārūṇāñcāstīvetyata āha--ṭhprakṛtivikāra' ityādi| gatārthamÂ| 
ṭhdvistadgrahaṇamÂ' ityādi| ityeṣa nyāyo'nena pradarśyate|
ṭhtadasyāstyasminniti matupÂ' (5.2.94) ityādau naikaḥ pratyayārthaḥ| tatra
tatsamudāyena samarthavibhakteḥ sambandho vijñāyate| tataśca yatra dvābhyāṃ
pratyayārthābhyāṃ samarthavibhakteḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati--śākhāvānÂ vṛkṣa
ityādau, tatraiva tatÂ syātÂ| yatra tvanyatareṇaiva sambandhaḥ--gomān
devadataḥ, vṛkṣavānÂ parvata ityādau, tatra na syātÂ| asmiṃstu nyāye

18. prāgvateṣṭhañÂ| (5.1.18)
prāgvacanaṃ ṭhśīrṣacchedādyacca' (5.1.65), ṭhdaṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' (5.1.66)

20. asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ| (5.1.20)

21. śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate|

draḍhayitumāha--ṭhtathā coktamÂ' ityādi| śatapratiṣedhe kartavye

cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena suvarṇaśatamānayorapi viṣyati|
ṭhadhyardhasuvarṇamÂ' iti| ṭhaño lukÂ, ṭhadyardhaśatamānamÂ' iti|
ṭhśatamāna' (5.1.27) ityādi-vihitasyāṇaḥ| ṭhadhyardhaśatamānamÂ' iti|
ṭhparimāṇāntasya' (7.3.17) ityādinotarapadavṛddhiḥ| nanu ca
suvarṇamunmānamÂ, na parimāṇamÂ, tatkutastasya buddhiḥ? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; utarapadavṛddhau hayunmānamapi parimāṇamiti gṛhyate| kaguto
jñāyate? ṭhasaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) iti śāṇaśabdasya pratiṣedhātÂ|
yadi tarhi tatronmānaṃ na gṛhyaeta, tadā śāṇasyonmānārthasya
prāptireva nāstīti pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryātÂ| adhyardhapūrvadvigubhyāṃ
kārṣāpaṇasahasrayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ kasmān bhavati? lakṣaṇavyabhicāreṇa
tadabhāvasya sūcitatvātÂ| 
iha tāvatÂ ṭhadhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ' (5.1.28) iti nirdeaśe'lpāctaratvādÂ
dhyantatvācca dviguśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti,
ṭhkārṣāpaṇasahasrābhyāmÂ' ityatrālpāctaratvātÂ sahasraśabdasya?
tāvetau nirdeaśau lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ bodhayantau
yatāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣāyā apyabhāvaṃ bodhayata iti na bhavati
yathāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣā||

30. dvitripūrvānniṣkātÂ| (5.1.30)
adhyardhapūrvagrahaṇamasvaritatvānnopatiṣṭhate| ṭhdviniṣkamÂ' iti|
dvābhyāṃ niṣkābhyāṃ krītamiti asamāne ṭhako vidhānādatra ṭhañÂ, tasya
lukÂ| ṭhdvinaiṣkikamÂ' iti| ṭhparimāṇāntasya' (7.3.17)
ityādinotarapadavṛddhiḥ| ṭhbahupūrvācca' iti|
bahupūrvadÂdvigorniṣkaśabdāntādārhīyasya pratyayasya vibhāṣā
lugbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānamÂ--ṭhdvitribhyāṃ niṣkātÂ' ityeva siddhe pūrvagrahaṇamadhikaṃ
kurvatai tatÂ sūcitamÂ--ṭhanyadapyadhikaṃ kiñcidasti' iti| tena
bahupūrvādapi bhavati|| 

31. vistācca| (5.1.31)
ṭhdvitripūrvāditi cakāreṇānukṛṣyate' iti| nanu ca svaritatvādeva
dvitrigrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, svaritatve satyadhikāraparimāṇaṃ na jñāyata
iti cetÂ? vārtametatÂ| vyākhyānato'dikāraparamāṇaṃ vijñāsyate?
evaṃ tarhi svaritatvādeva dvitripūrvagrahaṇasyānuvṛtau siddhāyāṃ
yatadanukarṣaṇārthaṃ cakaramadhikaṃ karoti, tenaitatÂ
sūcayati--anyadapyatra kiñcidadhikaṃ bhavatīti| tena bahupūrvādapi
vibhāṣā lukÂ siddho bhavati| ṭhbahibistamÂ' iti| ṭhdvibistamÂ' iti
dvau visto parimāṇamasyeti ṭhañÂ, tasya lukÂ| ṭhdvibaistikamÂ'
iti| utarapadavṛddhiḥ|| 

32. viṃśatikātkhaḥ| (5.1.32)
ṭhdvitripūrvagrahaṇaṃ nivṛtamÂ; pūrvatra cānukṛṣṭatvātÂ,
asvaritatvādvā| śatamānādisūtreṇa (5.1.27) aṇi prāpte tasya luki kho
vidhīyate| ṭhvidhānasāmarthyādasya lugna bhavati' iti| yadi lukÂ
syātÂ, khavidhānamanarthakaṃ syātÂ| na hyaṇaḥ khasya ca luki sati
kaścidviseṣo'sti|| 

33. khāryā īkan| (5.1.33)
khārīśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāṭṭhañi prāpte tasyekanÂ vidhīyate| 

ṭhkevalāyāśceti vaktavyamÂ' iti| kevalo yo'samastaḥ
khārīśabdastataścekanÂ bhavatītye tadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ|
tatredaṃ vyākhyānamÂ--ikanniti vaktavye yadikanomātrādhikasya vidhānaṃ
tadanyadapyatra kiñcadbhavatīti sūcayati, tena kevalādapi
khārīśabdādīkanÂ bhavatīti| kathaṃ punarikani rūpaṃ sidhyati?
savarṇadīrghatvena| nanu ca yasyeti lopaḥ (6.4.148) prāpnoti?
naitadasti; yadi hi yasyeti lopaḥ syātÂ, ṭanameva brūyātÂ| 
ṭhkākiṃṇyāścopasaṃkhyānamÂ' iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ|
pratipādanaṃ tu tasyaivādhikasūcanārthasyekano vidhānamāśritya
kartavyamÂ| 
ṭhkevalāyāścetyupasaṃkyānamÂ' [ṭhkevalāyāśca' ityeva-kāśikāṭ iti|
upasaṃkhayanaśabdasya pratapādanamarthaḥ| pūrvavatÂ prakṛtena sambandhaḥ|| 

34. paṇapādamāṣaśatādyatÂ| (5.1.34)
paṇapādamāṣebhyaḥ ṭhasamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) iti asamāse ṭhako
vidhānāṭṭhañi prāpte tasya luki śataśabdādapyasamāse ṭhśatācca
ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21) iti ṭhanyatorvidhānātÂ samāse saṃkhyālakṣaṇe
kani yadÂ vidhīyate| ṭhdvipādyamÂ' ityādi| nanu padbhāvaḥ kasmānna
bhavati ṭhpadyatyatadarthe' (6.3.53) iti? satyamÂ; ṭhpādasya padājyāti'
(6.3.52) ityatra prāṇyaṅgasyaiva padbhāvavidhānātÂ| kṛta etatÂ?
ṭhājyāti' ityādinā gativacanena sambandhastasyaivopapadyate; na
parimāṇaśabdasya| sa eva prāṇyaṅgavācyutarasūtre'pyanuvartiṣyata iti
tasyaiva padbhāva iṣyate| syādetatÂ--ayamapīha pādaśabdaḥ
prāṇyaṅgavācī, ato bhavitavyameveha padbhāvena? ityata
āha--ṭhpadbhāvo na bhavati' iti| ṭhpadyatyatadarthe' (6.3.53) iti padbhāvaḥ
prāpnoti, sa na bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha--ṭhprāṇyaṅgasya' ityādi|
ṭhpādasya padājyātigopahateṣu' (6.3.52) ityatra prāṇyaṅgasya pādasya
grahaṇamÂ| ṭhidaṃ tu parimāṇagrahaṇamÂ' [ṭhparimāṇamÂ-kāśikāṭ iti|
paṇādibhiḥ parimāṇaiḥ sāhacaryātÂ parimāṇaṃ pādo gṛhyate, na
prāṇyaṅgamiti padbhāvasyāprasaṅgaḥ|| 

35. śāṇādvā| (5.1.33)
ṭhṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| na ṭhakaḥ; śāṇasya parimāṇatvāt| 

ṭhśatācceti vaktavyamÂ' iti| śatāccādhyarthapūrvādÂdvigośca
yatpratyayo bhavatotyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyakhyānamÂ--pūrvasūtrādiha śataśabdo'nuvartate, tena tadantādapi
yadbhavatīti| yadyevamÂ, pūrvasūtre tasya pāṭho'narthaka iti, ihaiva
śataśāṇābyāñceti vaktavyamÂ? naivaṃ śakyamÂ; evaṃ hyucyamāne
ṭhdvitripūrvādaṇca' (5.1.36) ityanenāpi śatātÂ prasajyeta|
pūrvasūtre tu pāṭhasāmarthyādaṇvidhau nānuvartate| śataśabdaḥ
svaritatvāccehānuvartamāno vā yatamutpādayati||

36. dvitripūrvādaṇca| (5.1.36)
ṭhtena trairūpyaṃ sampadyate' iti| ekaṃ rūpaṃ sūtranirdiṣṭe'ṇi, dvitīyaṃ
cakārasamuccite yati, tṛtīyaṃ vāśabdaprāpitasya ṭhaño lukadi|
ṭhdviśāṇamÂ' iti| ṭhaño lukÂ||

37. tena krītamÂ| (5.1.37)
ṭhsāptatikamÂ, āśītikamÂ' iti| ṭhprāgvateṣṭhañÂ' (5.1.18)
ṭhnaiṣkikamÂ'; pāṇikamÂ' iti| ṭhasamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) iti
ṭhakÂ| ṭhśatyamÂ, śatikamÂ' ita| ṭhasamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) iti
ṭhakÂ| ṭhśatyamÂ, śatikamÂ' iti| ṭhśatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21)
iti| ṭhdvikamÂ, trikamÂ' iti| ṭhsaṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kanÂ'
(5.1.22)| 
sāmānyārthābhidhāne teneti tṛtīyopādanādiha kasmānna
bhavati--devadatena krītam, pāṇinā kritamÂ? ityata āha--ṭhtena'
ityādi| karaṇe tṛtīyā| parimūlyātÂ tataḥ pratyayena bhavitavyamÂ|
ṭhanyatra' iti| anyatara mūlyātÂ karaṇe tṛtīyā bhavati|
ṭhanabhidhānātÂ' iti| na hi yā kartari tṛtīyā yāpyamūlyātÂ
karaṇe tṛtīyotpadyate, tadantādutpannaḥ pratyāyo vivakṣitaṃ vastu
pratipādayitumalaṃ sambhavati| tathā ha--daivadatikaṃ pāṇikamiti
cokte, devadatena kartrā krītamÂ pāṇinā karaṇena
krītamityeṣo'rtho nāvasīyate| devadateneti kartari tṛtīyā,
pāṇineti karaṇe| tadetaduktaṃ
bhavati--pragatyāsannavinimayadravyasambandhānabhidhānāditi| 
ṭhanabhidhānādeva' iti| na hi prāsthikamityukte, prasthābhyāṃ krītaṃ
praśthairvā krītamityeṣo'vagamyate| tatra punarabhidhāne ko hetuḥ?
śabdaśaktirīdṛśī, kimatrānyena hetunā! api ca prasthādayaḥ śabdā
arthatastu parimāṇānāmarthānāṃ vācakā iti teṣāmabhidheyasya pracaye
pravṛtisambhave ko hetuḥ? nanvevaṃ vākye'pi pracayo nopapadyeta?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; vākye hi pracayasya vācikā vibhaktirastīti
pracayābhidhānaṃ na virudhyate| vṛtau tu na kaścitÂ pracayamācaṣṭa iti
nāsau vṛtiviṣaye yujyate| 
yadi tarhi dvivacanabahuvacanāntātÂ pratyayena na bhavitavyamÂ, evaṃ
sati dvābhyāṃ krītaṃ dvikamÂ, tribhiḥ krītaṃ trikamityevamādi na
sidhyatītyata āha--ṭhyatra tu' ityādi| anabhidhānaṃ dvivacanāntātÂ
pratyayānutpaterhetuḥ| taccābhidhānaṃ kva na bhavati? yatra prakṛtyarthasya
saṃkhyābhedāvagamo nāstīti; pramāṇābhāvātÂ| iha tu pramāṇamastyeva
kiñcitÂ| dvyādaya eva śabdāḥ prakṛtitvenopātāḥ| te hi
svapravṛtinimitabhūtayaiva saṃkhyayā'vaccchinnaṃ vastu pratipādayanti| ataḥ
svārthasya saṃkhyāviseṣāvagame pramāṇamÂ| tenātrānabhidhānādityeṣa
hetunastiti bhavati pratyayaḥ| ṭhtathā' ityādi| yathā trikamityādau
prakṛtyarthasaṃkhyānabhāvopagame pramāṇasambhavādbahuvacanāntādapi
pratyayo bhavati, tathā maudÂgikamityādāvapi
mudgādiśabdaprakṛtiratra svārthasya saṃkhyāvagame
pramāṇamityetaddarśayitumāha--ṭhna hyaekena' ityādi| mudgādinaikaya
vyaktyā krayo na bhavatīti vināpi vibhaktyā mudgādiśabdānuvṛtau
bahutvaṃ gamyate| tatra pramāṇaṃ bhavati| ekagrahaṇa
trayānupayoginordvayorapyupalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyamÂ|| 

38. tasya nimitaṃ saṃyogotpātau| (5.1.38) 
ṭhmahābhūtānāmÂ' [mahābhūtapariṇāmaḥuutpātaḥ--kāśikāṭ iti|

39. godvyaco'saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvāderyatÂ| (5.1.39) 
ṭhṭhañādīnāmapavādaḥ' iti| adiśabdena ṭhagādīnāṃ grahaṇÂ| nanu ca
saṃkhyāparimāṇayoḥ paryudāsātÂ kanaṣṭhako'pavāda iti vaktuaṃ
śakyate, tatkasmāṭṭhañādīnāmityucyate?
ṭhañādīnāmityayamatadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhirdraṣṭavyaḥ|
anayaivāpekṣayoktamÂ--aśvasya nimitamāśvikamiti| ṭhakÂ,
pratyudāhṛtaḥ| sarvapratyayasambhavaḥ, tadbādhanārthamidamuktamÂ|
ṭhpañcakam, aṣṭakamÂ' iti| saṃkhyālakṣaṇaḥ kanÂ (5.1.22)| ṭhprāsthikaḥ'

42. tasyeśvaraḥ| (5.1.42)
ṭhtasya nimitamÂ' (5.1.38) ityatastasyagrahaṇamanuvartate, tatkimarthaṃ
punastasyanirdeaśaḥ? ityāha--ṣaṣṭhīprakaraṇe punaḥ
ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktinirdeaśaḥ' ityādi| ṭhpratyayārthasya' iti| nimitasya|
ṭhanyathā' iti| yadi ṣaṣṭhīnirdeaśaḥ pratyayārthai nivṛtyartho na kriyate,
tato yathā saṃyoga utpātaśca pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamÂ, tatheśvaro'pi
tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta| tathā ceśvaraviśiṣṭe nimita eva

46. pātrātÂ ṣṭhanÂ| (5.1.46)
ṭhpātraśabdaḥ parimāṇavācī' iti| ṭhṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| atreyaṃ
yuktiḥ--yadi hyaparimāṇavācī syātÂ tadārhīyasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ, na

47. tadasminvṛddhyāyalābhaśulkopadā dīyate| (5.1.47)
nanu ca vṛddhyādīnāṃ bahutvākhyānenaiva bahuvacanaṃ tena
bhavitavyamitita kathaṃ dīyata ityekavacanāntena tasya nirdeaśaḥ?
ityāha--ṭhdīyata ityekavacanamÂ' ityādi| yadi
samuditairvṛddhyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ kriyate tarhi syādbahuvacanamÂ|
na ca taiḥ samuditaiḥsa kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? pratyekamÂ, ata
ekavacanameva| vṛddhiśabda iha laukiko dhanaviśeṣavācī gṛhyate, na ca
saṃjñāpadamÂ, āyādibhirdhanaviśeṣavācibhiḥ saha nirdeaśātÂ| ata
evāha--ṭhtatra' ityādi| utamarṇasya yaddhanaṃ tasmādatiriktamadhikaṃ
dhanamadhamarṇena yaddātavyaṃ tadÂvṛddhiḥ| ṭhgrāmādiṣu' iti| ādiśabdena
kṣetrādi| ṭhpaṭādīnāmÂ' ityādi| paṭādīnāṃ
vyavahriyamāṇānāmupādānaṃ sūtrādi| tasya yanmūlyaṃ tasmādatiriktaṃ
dravyaṃ paṭādivikrayeṇa yallabhyate sa lābha-| ṭhrakṣānirveśaḥ' iti|
vaṇijāṃ rakṣākārī rājño bhāgo rakṣānirveśa ityucyate| nanu
cāsāvapayāyaḥ, tadapārthakaṃ śulkasya pṛthagupādānamÂ? naitadasti;
pañcāsminÂ grāma āya ityāyaṃ prati grāmasyādhikaraṇabhāvaḥ;
utpadyamānasyāyasyādheyabāvātÂ| śulke tu na sambhavati| pañcāsminÂ
śate śulkā iti śataṃ na śulkasyādhikaraṇamÂ, kiṃ tarhi?
iyatāparicchedaḥ śatena śulkasya kriyate| tasmādasya bhinnatvātÂ
śulkaḥ pṛthaguktaḥ| 
ṭhsiddhaṃ tu' ityādi| vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavantīti sampradānākhye
cādhikaraṇatvena vivakṣetyāha--ṭhsamamÂ' ityādi| gatārthamÂ||

48. pūraṇārddhāṭṭhanÂ| (5.1.48)
ṭhpūraṇavācinaḥ' iti| pūryate yenārthena sa pūraṇaḥ, tadvācinaḥ
prātipadikātÂ| etena ṭhpūraṇa' ityarthasya grahaṇamÂ, na pratyayasyeti
darśayati| kathañca pratyayasya grahaṇaṃ syātÂ? yadi pūraṇagrahaṇaṃ svaryeta|
tasminÂ hi svaryamāṇe ṭhtasya pūraṇe ḍaṭÂ' (5.2.48) ityadhikṛtya ye
pratyayā vihitāste gṛhyaeranÂ| kiñca syātÂ? ṭhpūraṇādbhāge
tīyādanÂ' (5.3.48) ityannantāṭṭhanÂ na syātÂ;
apūraṇapratyayāntatvātÂ| tasyāgrahaṇe tu sati svārthikaḥ syādanÂ|
tasminnapyutpanne pūraṇa evārthe tadantamapi vartata iti tato'pi ṭhanÂ
siddho bhavati| ṭhṭhakṭhanorapavādaḥ' iti| pūraṇādārhīyasya
ṭhako'pavādaḥ. ardhādapi ṭharddhācceti vaktavyamÂ' (vā.502)
ityaupasaṃkhyānikasya ṭiṭhanaḥ| ṭhaki ṭiṭhani ca sati ṅīpÂ syātÂ;
ṭhani tu ṭābbhavati| ṭhdvitīyikaḥ' iti| dvayoḥ pūraṇa iti ṭhdvestīyaḥ'
(5.2.54) iti toyapratyayaḥ| ṭhtṛtīyikaḥ' iti| ṭhtreḥ samprasāraṇañca'
(5.2.55)| ṭhpañcamikaḥ, sarptāmakaḥ' iti| ṭhtasya pūraṇe ḍaṭÂ' (5.2.48)
iti ḍaṭpratyayaḥ, tasya ṭhnāntādasaṃkhayādermaṭÂ' (5.2.49) iti
maḍāgamaḥ||

49. bhāgādyacca| (5.1.49)
ṭhṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| na ṭhakaḥ; bhāgaśabdasya parimāṇatvātÂ| nanu
cāṅgamātravacano'pi bhāgaśabdo'sti? satyamasti; na tu tasyeha
grahaṇamÂ| tasya hi grahaṇe vṛddhyādibhiḥ sambando nopapadyate|
parimāṇavacanastu prasiddho rūpakāṃśe vartata iti vṛddhyādibhiḥ
sambandhaḥ upapadyate|| 

50. taddharapi vahatyāvahati bhārādvaṃśādibhyaḥ| (5.1.50)
ṭhprakṛtiviśeṣaṇamÂ' ityādi| prakṛteḥ prātipadikasya|
ṭhbhārādvaṃśādibhya ityarthaḥ' iti| atrārthe vaṃśādaya eva śuddhāḥ
pratyayamutpādayanti| 
nanu ca vaṃśādayaḥ śabdāḥ, bhāra ityapi śabda eva; na ca śabda
śabdāntarasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viseṣaṇamupapadyate, tatkathaṃ
bhārabhūtebhyo vaṃśādibhya ityeṣo'rtho bhavati?
ityāha--ṭhbhāraśabdo'rthadvāreṇa' ityādi| vaṃśādīnāṃmarthasya
bhāraśabdasyārtho mukhyaṃ viśeṣaṇamÂ, arthadvāreṇa tu vaṃśādīnāṃ
bhāraśapabdasya copacaritam| arthadharmeṇa śabdo'pi tathā vyapadiśyata
ityarthaḥ||

57. tadasya parimāṇamÂ| (5.1.57)

58. saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsahghasūtrādhyayaneṣu| (5.1.58)

ṭhparimāṇopādhikātÂ' iti| parimāṇamupādhirviśeṣaṇaṃ na sambhavati,
na hi śabdaḥ parimāṇaṃ śabdasya sambhavatīti? tadarthasya viseṣaṇaṃ
vijñāsyata ityadoṣaḥ| nanu cārthasyāpi na sambhavati, saṃkhyā hi naiva
parimāṇamÂ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nātra rūḍhaḥ parimāṇaśabdo gṛhyate, kiṃ
tarhi? kriyāśabdaḥ--parimāyate yena tatÂ parimāṇamiti| saṃkhyāyāpi
ca parimīyata iti sāpi parimāṇamÂ| nanvevamapi
viśeṣaṇamanarthakam; na hyaparicchedikā saṃkhyāsti, sañcakṣāṇā hi
saṃkhyocyate? satadyamÂ; paricchedikaiva saṃkhyā, sā tu svasyābhideyaṃ
pariccchinatīti ṣaṣṭhaḷrthamavaśyaṃ na pariccchinati| pañcāsya saṅghasya
putrā iti nātra sahghasyeyatā pratīyate| iha tu pañcasaṃkhyā
parimāṇamasya saṅghasyeti bhavatīyatāpratītiḥ saṅghasya|
tasmādupapannaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇaṃ viśeṣaṇamÂ| 
ṭhtatra' ityādi| pañcaśabdo'yaṃ saṃkhyeya eva vartate, na kadācidapi
saṃkhyānamātre| tataśca ya eva saṃkhyeyāḥ pañcatvasaṃkhyayāvaccchinnāḥ
pañcaśabdenocyante, pratyayāntenāpi ta eva na hi teṣāṃ bhinnānāmatra
saṃkhyeyāntaraṃ parimāṇaṃ pratyayavākyaṃ sambhavapati| tasmātÂ saṃjñāyāṃ
svārthaṃ eva pratyayo vācyaḥ| tathā cāha vārtikakāraḥ--ṭhsaṃjñāyāṃ svārthe
utpadyate' iti| 
ṭhpañcako'dhītaḥ' iti pāṭhāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgaḥ| ṭhadhītiradhyayanamÂ'
iti| anena bhāvasādhanamadhyayanaśabdaṃ darśayati| yadyadhīyata ityadhyayanaṃ
karmasādhano'dyayanaśabdaḥ syātÂ, sūtragrahaṇaṃ pṛthagvaktavyaṃ na syātÂ;
adhyayanagrahaṇenaiva siddhatvātÂ, sūtramapyadhīyata eva| ṭhpañcāvṛttyaḥ'
iti pāṭhe punaḥ kriyātmikāḥ pañca vārā ityādinā paryāyāntareṇa
pañcāvṛtya ityasyaivārthaṃ vyaktīkaroti| 
ṭhstome ḍavidhiḥ' iti| atrāpi ccchandasīti sambadhyate| mantrasamudāyaḥ
stomaḥ| ṭhekaviṃśaḥ' iti| ṭhato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ ca, ṭhti
viṃśaterḍiti (6.4.142) iti tiśabdalopaḥ|
ṭhśanśatoḥ' ityādi| śannityevamantāccchandasi ḍinirvaktavyaḥ|| 

59.
paṃktiviṃśatitriṃśaccatvāriṃśatpañcāśatṣaṣṭisaptatyaśītinavatiśatamÂ|
(5.1.59)
ṭhapadatvaṃ ca' iti| padanibandhanasya jaśatvādeḥ kāryasya
pratiṣedhārthamihaite viṃśatyādayaḥ parimāṇe nipātyante| ṭhtadasya
parimāṇamÂ' (5.1.57) ityadhikāre nipātanātÂ| evañca gavāṃ
viṃśatiriti ṣaṣṭhī vyatirekanibandhanā na prāpnoti|
viṃśatiśabdena hi tānyeva godravyāṇi gṛhyante, na tadadhikaṃ
kiñcidarthāntaramÂ| bahuvacanaṃ prasajati teṣāṃ bahutvāditi
yaścodayetÂ, taṃ pratyāha--ṭhviṃśatyādayaḥ' ityādi|
yathākathañcitprakāreṇa| vināpyavayavārtheneti yāvatÂ| rūpamātraṃ
pradhānamÂ, nāvayavārthaḥ| yastveṣāmarthaḥ sa lokata eva vyavatiṣṭhata
ityabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhnātrābhiniveṣṭavyamÂ' iti| saṃkhyāparimāṇopādhikaḥ
prakṛtyarthaḥ| ṭhparimāṇamātraṃ pratyayāḥ' iti nāyamatrābhiniveśaḥ kartavya
ityarthaḥ| anabhiniveśasya kāraṇamāha--ṭhtathā hi' ityādi|
syādetatÂ--ṭhatrāpyavayavārtho'sti' ityata āha--ṭhna ca' ityādi|
brāhmāṇānāṃ paṃktirityukte saṃkhyāparimāṇopādhikaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ,
parimāṇo vā kaṣṭa; pratyayārtho hi na gamyate, kiṃ tarhi?
sanniveśaviśeṣaḥ saṃsthānātmako guṇa eva pratīyate| tathā hi--tasya
sanniveśaviśeṣasyānavagame tāvatsyeva brāhmaṇeṣu paṃktiriti na
prayujyate| tadevaṃ guṇaśabdatvādviṃśatyādīnāṃ gavāṃ viṃśatiriti
sidhyati ṣaṣṭhī; viṃśatiśabdasya saṃkhyānavṛtitvātÂ| 
yadi tarhi guṇaśabdā ete, viṃśatigavi iti dravyaśabdena
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti? guṇinyatra vṛtiḥ, guṇamātre na
tato'yamadoṣa iti| vaktavyaḥ sa hetuḥ yata eteṣā kvacidguṇamātre
vṛtirbhavati, kvacidguṇini| bahuvacanaprasaṅgācca guṇini
vṛtirityetadeva duḥsthamÂ; bahutvādguṇināmÂ| iha ca viṃśatiḥ
kuṇḍānīti napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ prāpnoti, viṃśatirbrāhmaṇā iti
puṃlliṅgamÂ, guṇavacanānāṃ hi śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni
bhavanti, yathā--śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklaṃ vastramÂ, śuklā śāṭīti|
yadāsau dravyamāśritya bhavati guṇaḥ, tasya liṅgavacanaṃ yatÂ
tadguṇavacanasyāpi bhavati, yathā--guṇaśabdatve'pyeṣāmāśrīyamāṇe na
bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅgānmuktiḥ? ityata āha--ṭhyā caiṣāmÂ' itayādi|
na kevalamarthābhidānaṃ svābhāvikamÂ, kintvetadapītyapiśabdena
darśayati| yatra dravyeṇa guṇinaiṣāmabhidheyo guṇo viśeṣyate, tatra
svabhāvādeva guṇamātre vṛtiḥ| yatra tveta upasarjanībhūtasvārthāstena
svārthena dravyaṃ viśeṣayanti tatraiṣāṃ svabhāvata eva guṇini vṛtiḥ| 
ṭhsvaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānaṃ ca' iti| guṇinyaṇi vartamānānāṃ
yayorliṅgasaṃkhyayoryadanuvidhānamanuvartamānametadapi sarvaṃ
svābhāvikamÂ| anyeṣāmapi, guṇaśabdānāmapi kvacitÂ svabhāvata eva
guṇini vṛtirbhavati, tadyathā-śuklaḥ paṭa ityatra śuklaśabdasya|
kvacidguṇamātre, yathā--asyaiva śuklo guṇaḥ paṭasyetyatra|
anyeṣāmapi keṣāñcitÂ śabdānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ
svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānaṃ dṛśyata eva, tadyathā--vedāḥ pramāṇamÂ,
śrutayaḥ pramāṇamiti| tasmātÂ svābhāvikatvādguṇamātre guṇini ca
vṛteḥ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānasya ca na bhavati yathaktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ|
yadā hi svabhāvata iti saṃkhyānamātre guṇe guṇamātre vṛtiḥ tadā
vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| yadā tu guṇini, tadā tayorapi
ca dravyaśabdatvākatÂ sāmānādhikaraṇyamapi bhavati| dravye'pi
vartamānānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānamÂ| 
atha sahasrādayo'pi kasmānna vyutpādyante? ityāha--ṭhsahasrādayo'pi'
ityādi| evañjātīyakā evamprakārā viṃśatyādibhiḥ sadṛśā ityarthaḥ|
teṣāmapi guṇavatvātÂ tadvadeva viṃśātyādivadeva draṣṭavyāḥ|
viṃśātyādaya iva te'pi prakṛtyādivibhāgena vyutpādyanta ityarthaḥ|
yadyevamÂ, kimarthaṃ viṃśatyādaya eva sūtre upātāḥ?
ityāhṛ#ﬁṭhudāharaṇamātramÂ' ityādi| udāharaṇamātraṃ
viṃśatyādigrahaṇamÂ, anye'pyevañjātīyāḥ sahasrādayastathaiva
vyutpādyāḥ||

64. chedādibhyo nityamÂ| (5.1.64)

69. kaḍṅgaradakṣiṇācccha ca| (5.1.69)

76. pantho ṇa nityamÂ| (5.1.76)
ṭhnityagrahaṇamÂ' ityādi| atha vākyanivṛtyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati?
panthaśabdasya vākyāsamavāyitvātÂ| sa hi pratyayasanniyogena
vidhīyate, na vākyena samavaiti| nanu ca pathinśabdena vākyaṃ mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ syātÂ? naitadasti; yadi tadevamarthaṃ
syātÂ pūrvasūtra eva kṛtaṃ syātÂ--yatra pathinśabdaḥ śruyate| iha tu
karaṇe pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate|| 

77. utarapathenāhṛtañca| (5.1.77)
ṭhcakāraḥ pratyayārtha' iti| pratyayārthasamīpe śrūyamāṇatvātÂ|
gaccchatītyatra pūrvaṃ dvitīyāntātÂ pratyaya utpannaḥ| tadihāpi tata eva
pratyayena bhavitavyamiti bhrāntiḥ syātÂ| atastāṃ
nirākartumāha--ṭhatrāpi' ityādi| cakāro hyarthātÂ paraḥ
śrūyamāṇo'trārthamātrasyaiva gaccchatotyasyānukarṣakaḥ pratīyate, na tu
vibhakterapi; sambandhābhāvātÂ| tasmātÂ sa ihānuvṛtaḥ sannihitayā
samarthavibhaktyā sambadhyamānastṛtīyāsamarthādeva pratyayamutpādayatīti
bhāvaḥ| 
ṭhvārijaṅgala' ityādi| vāryādayaḥ pūrvapadaṃ yasya tatÂ tathoktamÂ|
etayorevārthayorupasaṃkyānamÂ| 
ṭhmadhukamaricayoḥ' ityādi| madhukamaricayorabhidheyayoḥ sthalātÂ
paro yaḥ pathinśabdaḥ, tadantādāhṛte vaktavyaḥ|| 

78. kālātÂ| (5.1.78)
kālāditi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ? pṛthagasya
yogasyārambhātÂ| kālaśabdasyāpi yadi svarūpagrahaṇama bhīṣṭaṃ
syādimaṃ pṛthagyogamakṛtvotarasūtre kālaśabdādeva
tṛtīyāmuccārayetÂ--kālena nirvṛtamiti| evaṃ hi nirdeaśādeva
tṛtīyāsamarthātÂ pratyayo vijñāyate| utarasūtre ca kālaśabdaḥ
svaritatvādanuvartiṣyata iti siddhamiṣṭamÂ| ato na kartavya evāyaṃ
pṛthagyogaḥ| sa eva kriyate'rthagrahaṇaṃ taditi darśayitumÂ|| 

79. tena nirvṛtamÂ| (5.1.79)

na bhavati|| 

80. tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvī| (5.1.80) 
ṭhkālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā| ṭhtamadhīṣṭaḥ'
ityādau karmaṇi dvitīyā nopapadyate; adhyeṣyamāṇādi hi
puruṣādikarmānayāniṣṭayābhihitamÂ, na cānyā kriyā'sti yasyāṃ
māsādi karma syātÂ|
ṭhnanu ca' ityādinā, yaduktamÂ--ṭhkālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5)
dvitīyeti tadvighaṭayati| tena kathaṃ māso vyāpyata iti? na
kathañcitÂ| vighaṭata ityarthaḥ| yaddhi muhūrtaṃ kriyate, tena
muhūrtena māsaikadeśo vyāpyate, na tu sakalo māsaḥ| ṭhkriyārthe'
iti| adhyayanādikriyārthe| tadarthaṃ hi te kriyete| ṭhphalabhūtayā kriyayā'
iti| adhyayanādikayā| ṭhtābyāmeva vyāpta ityucyate' iti|
tadanyavyāpārasya tatropacārātÂ| yathā ṭhcaureṇa grāmo dagdhaḥ'
ityukte na caureṇa grāmo dahyate, api tu tadāhṛtenāgninā|
upacāreṇa tu tathā vyapadeśaḥ|| 

81. māsādvayasaki yatkhañau| (5.1.81)
ṭhsāmarthyādbhūtÂ evātrābhisambadhyate' iti| vayasi bhūtārthasyaiva
sambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| bhāvyartho'pi tatra sambhavatīti cintyametatÂ| atha
tu neṣyate, punarabhidhānaṃ śaraṇamāśrayitavyamÂ| khaño ñitkaraṇaṃ
svarārthamÂ, vṛddhyarthañca| nanu ca vṛddha eva māsaśabdaḥ? satyaṃ
vṛddho'yamÂ, tathāpi vṛddhasyāpi vṛddhireṣitavyā| māsīnābhārya iti
ṭhvṛddhinimitasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedo yathā syātÂ|| 

82. dvigoryapÂ| (5.1.82)

89. citavati nityamÂ| (5.1.89)
yadi citavati pratyayārthe nityaṃ lugbhavati, ṭhvarṣasyābhaviṣyati'
(7.3.16) ityatra yadvakṣyati--ṭhdve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma
kariṣyatoti dvivārṣiko manuṣyaḥ' ita, tadvirudhyate; na hi nitye
lukyadhīṣṭabhṛtayorutpannasya pratyayasya citavatyabhidheya evaṃ
rūpamupapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhūta evāsyotpannasya pratyayasya citavati
nityaṃ lugiṣyate, na sarvatra| kuta etatÂ? nityagrahaṇātÂ| iha
nityagrahaṇamanarthakameva| ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityo lugbhaviṣyatīti
kiṃ niyamagrahaṇena? tatÂ kriyate viśiṣṭe'rthe nityo lugyathā
syādityevamarthamÂ| sa punarviśiṣṭo bhūta eva|| 

90. ṣaṣṭikāḥ ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante| (5.1.90)
ṭhbahuvacavāntasya nirdeaśādbahuvacana eva ṣaṣṭikaśabdasya sādhutvamÂ,
nānyatra' iti yaścodayetÂ, taṃ pratyāha--ṭhbahuvacanamatantramÂ' iti|
apradhānamityacarthaḥ| apradhānatvaṃ tu tasya nāntarīyakatvātÂ| avaśyaṃ hi
yena kenacidvacanena nirdeaśaḥ kartavyaḥ| yadyevamÂ, ekavacanena nirdeaśaḥ
kasmānna kṛtaḥ, evaṃ hi laghurbhavati? satyamÂ; vaicitryārthaṃ
bahuvacanena kṛtaḥ| yadi ṭhṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante' ityasminnayaṃ
etannipātanaṃ, mudgādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ, te'pi hi
ṣaṣṭirātreṇapacyante? ityata āha--ṭhsaṃjñaiṣā' ityātadi| dhānyaviśeṣa
eva hiṃ ṣaṣṭikaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena rūḍhaḥ|
tenābhidhānāmmudgādiṣvatiprasaṅgo na bhavati||

93. tena parijayyalabhyakāryyasukaramÂ| (5.1.93)
ṭhparijayyaḥ' iti| pariḥ sarvatobhāve| śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| sarvataḥ śakyo
jetuṃ ṭhparijayyaḥ' ṭhlabhyaḥ' iti, ṭhkāryyaḥ' iti| atrāpi śakyārtha eva
kṛtyau| māsena śakyo labyo māsikaḥ paṭaḥ| māsena śakyaṃ kartu
sukaraṃ vā māsikaṃ cāndrāyaṇamÂ| ṭhtena nirvṛtamÂ' (5.1.79)
ṭhtamadhīṣṭaḥ' (5.1.80) iti vibhaktitadvaye prakṛte punasteneti

94. tadasya brahmacaryamÂ| (5.1.94)
ṭhdvābhyāmapi sambadhyate' iti| samarthavibhaktyā, pratyayārthena ca| kathaṃ
sambadhyate? ityāha--ṭhkālasya' ityādi| iha hi
dvitīyā'tyantasaṃyoge|sā hiyaḥ kālasya vyāpakastamapekṣate,
nāntarayakatvātÂ| na hi tena vinā'tyantasaṃyoga upapadyate| brahmacaryaṃ
ca ṭhkālasya vyāpakamÂ' iti| ṭhvyāpakamÂ' iti| vyāpakamapekṣamāṇāyāṃ
vibhaktau brahmacaryasambandho bhavati| kathaṃ pratyayārthena sambadhyate? ityata
āha--ṭhpratyayārthasya ca svamÂ' iti| pratyayārthaḥ pratiyogi vasaktu
svamapekṣate|prakṛtatvācca brahmacaryasyaiva pratiyogitvaṃ vijñāyate, taddhi
tasya svaṃ bhavati| ataḥ pratiyogyapekṣāyāṃ pratyayārthasyāpi brahmacaryeṇa
sambandho bhavati| 
ṭhpūrvatra' ityādinā pūrvotarayorvṛtyorviśeṣaṃ darśayati| kiṃ
punaratra pramāṇamityāha--ṭhdvayamapi' ityādi| kathaṃ punarddhayamapi
pramāṇamityāha--ṭhubhayathā' ityādi| ubhayasminnapi hyatrārthe
sūtrametadācāryeṇa praṇītamÂ| dvayamapi pramāṇamÂ| 
ṭhmahānāmnyādibhya' iti| brahmacaryaṃ evārtha idamupasaṃkhyānāmÂ|
ṭhtaccarati' ityādi| taditi dvitīyāsamarthebhyo mahānāmnyādibhyaḥ
śabdebhyaḥ ṭhcarati' ityetasminnarthe idaṃ ṭhaña upasaṃkhyānamÂ|
ṭhtatsahacaritaṃ vrataṃ taccchabdenocyate' iti| bhavati hi sāhacaryātÂ
tāccchabdyamÂ, yathā--yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti| atha ṛca evocyanta ityevaṃ
kasmānna vijñāyete? caraṇārthasyāyogātÂ| brahmacarya hi caryate|
ṭhcaturmāsāṇṇyo yajñe' ityādi| catumasiśabdātÂ tatreti
saptamīsamarthādbhava ityetasminnarthe yajñe viṣaye ṇyo vaktavyaḥ| 
ṭhsaṃjñāyāmaṇvaktavyaḥ' iti| caturmāsādbhava ityetadapekṣate| idañca
yajñādanyatropasaṃkhyānam| nanu ca ṭhtatra bhavaḥ (4.3.53)
ityanenāṇaabhavatyeva, kimarthamupasaṃkhyāyate? satyamasti; tasya tu
dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti lukprapnoti| ato lugbādhanārthaṃ
tasyopasaṃkhyānamÂ|| 

95. tasya ca dakṣiṇā yajñākhyebhyaḥ| (5.1.95)
athākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamÂ? na yajñebya ityucyeta? ityata
āha--ṭhākhyāgrahaṇamÂ' ityādi| yajñānamadheyamātrādakālavācino'pi
pratyayo yathā syādityevamarthamākyāgrahaṇamiti| ṭhitarathā hi' ityādi|
yadyākhyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyotetyarthaḥ| nanu caikāhadvādaśāhādayo naiva
kālaśabdāḥ, tatkutasteṣāmevātragrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ?
athākālavācināmapyeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ sambhavati? evaṃ
satyagniṣṭomādīnāmapi bhaviṣyatītyapārthakamākhyāgrahaṇamÂ? ityata
āha--ṭhprāgvateḥ' ityādi| yadyapyete kālaśabdā na bhavanti, tathāpi
prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidhirabhyanujñātaḥ| tena satyapi
kālādhikāre'pyasti teṣu grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| tathā ca tatra vacanasya
caritārthatvādagniṣṭomādibhyo na syātÂ, tebhyo'pi yathā
syādityākhyāgrahaṇamÂ| 
nanu caivamapi sūtramanarthakamÂ, yā hyagniṣṭomasya dakṣiṇā
sāpyagniṣṭome bhavati| tatra ṭhbahvaco'ntodātāṭṭhañÂ' (4.3.67)
ṭhkratuyajñebhyaśca' (4.3.68) ityeva ṭhañÂ siddhaḥ| idamapi sūtraṃ
ṭhañarthamevārabhyate? satyametatÂ, kintu bhāvarthe ṭhtasyedamÂ'
(4.3.120) iti vivakṣite tadā paratvādaṇādayaḥ syuriti yuktaṃ
vidhānamÂ| api ca yajñākhyebhyastena ṭhañiṣyate| grahaṇavatā
prātipadikena tadantavidhyabhāvātÂ saṃkhyāpūrvapadebhyaṣṭhañÂ na
labhyeta--dvayorvājapeyayorbhavā dakṣiṇā dvaivājapeyikīti| anena ca
vidhānena ṭhprāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantagrahaṇamaluki'
(kāśikā. 5.1.20) iti ṭhañÂ siddho bhavati| athāpi kathañcitÂ
tadantavidhirbhavārthe labhyate, tathāpi ṭhdvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti
lukprasajyeta| tasmādyauktaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ|

96. tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavatÂ| (5.1.96)
ṭhyathā māse bhavaṃ māsikamÂ' ityādi| ṭhkālāṭṭhañÂ' (4.3.11) iti|
ṭhprāvṛṣeṇyamÂ' iti| ṭhprāvṛṣa eṇyaḥ' (4.3.17)| ṭhvāsantaṃ śāradamÂ'
iti| sandhivelādisūtre (4.3.16) ṇāṇÂ| ṭhhaimanamÂ' iti|
ṭhhemantācca' (4.3.21) iti, ṭhsarvatrāṇca talopaśca' (4.3.22) iti| vatiḥ
sādṛśyārthaḥ| ṭhkālebhyo bhavavatÂ' (4.2.34) ityatraitadvyākhyātamÂ|
tata evānugantavyamÂ| 
cakāraḥ kālādityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tena cānukṛṣṭatvādutaratra
nānuvartate, ata āha--ṭhkālādhikārasya pūrṇo'vadhiḥ' ityādi| nanu ca
yanmāse dīyate kāryaṃ ca tanmāse bhavati; māsādhāratvātÂ
tatsatāyāḥ| ataḥ ṭhtatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityanenāṇaiva siddhamiti
kimatideśena? evaṃ tena satyapi bhavatyarthe kāryadīyamānayoḥ
kāryatāṃ dīyamānatāñca kālāntātÂ taiḥ pratyayairapi
khyāyayitumatideśaḥ| kiñcānena ca tatra bhavānāmapi na | tena sati
tasminÂ tadantavidheriṣṭatvādÂdvayormāsayordīyate kāryaṃ
vā--dvaimāsikamiti| athāpi kathañcidbhavārthe'pi tadantavidhirgṛhyate,
evamapi ṭhdvigoḥ' (4.1.88) iti lukÂ syātÂ| nanu cātrāpi vidhāne
satyatideśādeva lukÂ prāpnoti? vacanasāmarthyānÂ
pratyayamātrasyātideśo vijñāsyate, na sarvakāryāṇāmityadoṣaḥ|| 



97. vyuṣṭādibhyo'ṇÂ| (5.1.97)
vyuṣṭaśabdo'yaṃ kālaśabdaḥ| tatsāhacaryānnityaśabdo'pi kālaśabda eva
gṛhyate| nākāśādivacanaḥ| tena tatra saptamyapavādaḥ
ṭhkāladhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā bhavati| tena
saptamyadhikāre'pi nityaśabdādÂdvitīyāsamarthādeva pratyayaḥ| nityaṃ
dīyate ṭhnaityamÂ'| sarvakāle dīyate ityarthaḥ| 
ṭhaṇprakaraṇe' ityādi| padetatÂ kātyāyanenoktamÂ ṭhaṇprakaraṇe
agnipadādibhya upasaṃkhyānamÂ' (vā.532) ityetanna vaktavyamÂ| kathaṃ
tarhyaṇÂ syātÂ? vyuṣṭādiṣvevāgnipadādayaḥ paṭhitavyā| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ
kimarthamÂ, yāvatā bhavavatÂ' (5.1.96) ityetadihānuvartate,
tenaivātrāṇapi bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyamÂ; evaṃ hi sati
vyuṣṭanityaśabdābhyāṃ ṭhkālāṭṭhañÂ' (4.3.11) iti ṭhañÂ syātÂ; naiṣa
doṣaḥ; tatra punarārambhasāmarthyādyaṣṭhañā bādhitaḥ sa eva bhaviṣyati| kaḥ
punarasau? aṇeva| evamapi tīrthaśabdātÂ
dvyajṛdbrāhmaṇādi(4.3.72)sūtreṇa ṭhagvihita iti tataṣṭhageva syātÂ|
ye cātra praveśanādayo'ntodātāḥ; tebhyaṣṭhañÂ syātÂ
ṭhbrahvaco'ntodātāṭṭhañÂ(4.3.97)iti; tebhyo bhavārthe ṭhaño
vihitatvātÂ| tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamÂ|| 

98. tena yathākathācahastābhyāṃ ṇayatau| (5.1.98)

115. tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ| (5.1.115)

118. upasargāccchandasi dhātvarthe| (5.1.118)
upasargāḥ prādayaḥ, te caivamātmakāḥ| yatra kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate,
tatra kriyāyā viśeṣakā bhavanti--āgaccchati, pragaccchatīti| yatra na

vartamānādupasargātÂ pratyayo vijñāyati ityāha--ṭhsamādhane
dhātvarthe' iti| yadi hyaevamātmakā upasargāḥ, dhātvarthagrahaṇaṃ na
kartavyamÂ? satyametatÂ; tatÂ kriyate vispaṣṭārthamÂ| ṭhudvataḥ,
nivataḥ' iti| uccchabdātÂ niśbadāt samādhane dhātvarthe vatiḥ| nanu ca
vateravyayasaṃjñakatvādvibhakterlukÂ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati?
avyayasaṃjñāyā anityatvātÂ| anityatvaṃ tu tasyāḥ ṭhsatyametatÂ;
tatÂ kriyate vispaṣṭārthamÂ| ṭhudvataḥ, nivataḥ' iti| uccchabdātÂ
niśabdātÂ samādhane dhātvarthe vatiḥ| nanu ca
vateravayayasaṃjñakatavādvibhakterlukÂ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati?

svarādāvapiṃ paṭhaḷte' ityādinā'vyayasaṃjñāprakaraṇa eva pratipāditam||

119. tasya bhāvastvatalau| (5.1.119)

ṣaṣṭīsamarthatā||

1. dhānyanāṃ bhavane kṣetre khañÂ| (5.2.1)
ṭhbhavanti jāyante'sminniti bhavanamÂ' iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭÂ| jāyanta

kṣetragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syātÂ| tatra mudgānāṃ bhavanaṃ kusūla ityatra mā

kusūle prasaṅgaḥ, na hyasau mudgādīnāmutpateradhikaraṇamÂ, kiṃ
tarhi? satāyāḥ; naitadasti; sati hi kṣetragrahaṇe
bhavatiratrotpativacano bhavati| katham? kṣetraśabdo

so'pi kṣetraśabdena nivartyata iti| atha kathaṃ ṣaṣaṭhī

5. sarvacarmaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ khakhañau| (5.2.5)
iha kṛtaḥ pratyayārthaḥ| tatra carmaṇaḥ karaṇatvaṃ syātÂ, kartṛtvaṃ vā|
tatra yadi karaṇatvaṃ tadā niyataṃ karaṇalakṣaṇayā tṛtīyayā
bhavitavyamÂ| atha kartṛtvameva ṭhna loka' (2.3.69) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ
pratiṣiddhāyāṃ kartṛlakṣaṇā tṛtīyaiva| tasmātÂ
pratyayārthasāmarthyālabhyā tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktiriti
matvā''ha--ṭhtṛtīyāsamarthātÂ' iti| sa ca sarvacarmaṇa iti nirdeaśaḥ
sarvaśabdasya carmaśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvā kṛtaḥ| tataḥ ṭhcarmaṇaivāsya
sambandho na hayanyatā samāsa upapadyate' iti yo manyate, taṃ
pratyāha--ṭhsarvaśabdaścātra' ityādi| yadyevamÂ, asāmarthyātÂ samāso na
prāpnoti? ityata āha--ṭhtatrāyamÂ' ityādi| asmādeva
nipātanādityabhiprāyaḥ| atha carmaṇaivabhisambandhaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate?
ityāha--ṭhsarvaścarmaṇā kṛtaḥ' iti| atra hi vākyārthe
taddhitavṛtiriṣyati| tathā hyayameva vākyārthastaddhitānugataḥ pratīyate|
asmiṃścārthe vākyārtha evaṃ taddhitavṛtirlabhyate, yadi sarvaśabdaḥ kṛtena
sambadhyate na carmaṇā| yadi sarvaśabdaścarmaṇā sambadhyate, sarvacarmaṇā
iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā syātÂ, karmadhārayo vā; tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāse
taddhitāntātÂ sarvasambandhinā carmaṇā kṛta ityeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate|
karmadhāraye tu sarvacarmaṇā kṛta ityeṣo'rthaḥ| na cāyaṃ dviṣprakāro
yastaddhitāntādavasīyate, api tu sarvacarmaṇā kṛta ityayameva|
tasmādaśakyaḥ sarvaśabdasya carmaṇā sambandho vijñātumiti kṛtenaiva
sambandho yuktaḥ|| 

6. yathāmukhasammukhasya darśanaḥ khaḥ| (5.2.6)
ṭhdṛśyate'sminniti darśanaḥ' iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭÂ| ṭhyathāmukhamÂ'
iti| ṭhyathā'sādṛśye' (2.1.7) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| mukhasya sadṛśaṃ
yathāmukhamÂ| kiṃ punastatÂ? ādarśāśrayaṃ pratibimbamÂ| nanu ca
ṭhasādṛśye' iti pratiṣedhānnātra samāsena bhavitavyamÂ? ityata
āha--ṭhnipātanātÂ' ityādi| samāsaścāyaṃ pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ|
pūrvapadaṃ cāsatvavacanamiti prathamāsamarthādeva pratyaya upapadyate| atha
vā--ṭhnāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) iti
jñāpakādavyayībhāvādÂdvitīyādayo bhavantītyato
dvitīyāsāmarthyātÂ pratya upapadyate| ṭhyathāmukhaṃ yatāmukhīnaḥ' iti|
mukhasadṛsya darśanaḥ' iti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| yatrā''darśādau sarva mukhaṃ
dṛśyate sa evamucyate|| 

7. tatsarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapatrapātraṃ vyāpnoti| (5.2.7)
atha sūtra dvitīyāntaprakṛtyuccāraṇaṃ kimarthamÂ? taditi
dvitīyāsāmarthyātÂ pratyayo yathā syātÂ| atha
vā--pathyaṅgakarmapatrapātramiti naiveyaṃ dvitīyā, na hi
vyāpnotikriyayā pathyādayaḥ sambadhyante, kiṃ tarhi? sarvādi| tasmātÂ
tasyaiva karmatvamÂ, na pathyādīnāṃ tadavayavānāmÂ| tatÂ kutaḥ? na
sā dvitīyā, subvyatyayena pañcamyāḥ sthāne prathamā tveṣā| tasmātÂ
samāhāradvandvasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvātÂ ṭhato'mÂ' (2.4.83) ityabhbhāvaḥ
kṛtaḥ| ṭhpariśiṣṭamÂ' iti| ṭhsarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapatrapātramÂ'
ityetacca| sarvādeḥ prātipadikasya pathyādayaścādau na bhavanti| tataḥ
sāmarthyātÂ tadantavidhirvijñāyata
ityāha--ṭhpathyaṅgakarmapatrapātrāntātÂ' iti| ṭhsarvapathīnaḥ' iti|
sarvaścāsau panthāśceti ṭhpūrvakāla' (2.1.49) ityādinā samāsaḥ,
ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntastadataḥ| nanu
ca samāsānte kṛte pathyantameva na bhavati? yadatra pathyantaṃ tadāśrayo
vidharirbhavatītyadoṣaḥ| nanu ca vyavadhānānna prāpnoti? antagrahaṇātÂ
samāsāntāḥ samāsagrahaṇena gṛhyanta iti nāsti vyavadhānamÂ|| 

8. āprapadaṃ prapnoti| (5.2.8)
ṭhtayoravyayībhāvaḥ' iti| ṭhāṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityanana|

prāpnotītyuktamÂ? sambandhamātraṃ prāptiḥ, sambandha eva sākalyena
vyāptirityeva viśeṣaḥ|| 

9. anupadasarvānnāyānayaṃ baddhābhakṣayatineyeṣu| (5.2.9)
ṭhanurāyāme' itayādi| yadāyāme tadā ṭhyasya cāyāmaḥ' (2.1.16) iti
samāsa-| yadā sādṛśye tadā ṭhyatārte yadavyayamÂ' tena ṭhavyayaṃ
vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā | yatā padamāyataṃ tathā ca
ṭhbaddhopānadanupadīnā'| sādṛśye yathānupadaṃ tatā baddhā'nupadīnā|
ṭhpadapramāṇetyarthaḥ' iti| yadāpyanu sādṛśye, tadāpyayamartha
veditavyaḥ, tulyapramāṇatayaiva sādṛśyamÂ| ṭhayaḥ pradakṣiṇamÂ' iti|
ayanamayaḥ, gamanamityarthaḥ| pradakṣiṇaṃ gamanamaya ityucyeta| ṭhanayaḥ
prasavyamÂ' iti| ayaviparītaṃ prasavyamanaya ityucyate| evamavayavārthaṃ
darśayitvā samudāyārthaṃ darśayitumāha--ṭhpradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmināmÂ'
ityādi| bahuvacanamayānayanimitapradarśanārthamÂ| yadi śārāḥ
pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca gaccchantyevamayānayau bhaktaḥ, nānyathā| tatrātmoyāḥ
śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ gaccchanti, parakīyāḥ prasavyamÂ| teṣāmevaṅgāmināṃ
yānisthānāni teṣāṃ yasminÂ pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanātmake
gativiśeṣe sati parairvipakṣabhūtaiḥ
śārairasamāveśaḥuanadhyāsanamanākramaṇaṃ so'yānaya ityucyate; na tu
pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanamātre sa evāyamÂ| evaṃrūpo'yānayo yadā
samahāyaiḥ śārauḥ padānyadhiṣṭhīyante tadā veditavyaḥ|
sasahāyānāmeva hi śārāṇāṃ padāni parairna śakyanta#e'dhyāsitum|
asahāyānāṃ tu śakyata eva| ṭhphalakaśirasi sthitaḥ' iti| yatra
phalake'ṅka'kṣairdīvyanti tasya śirobhūtaṃ yatra sthānaṃ kiṃtavānāṃ
prasiddhaṃ tatra sthitaḥ śāraḥ ṭhayānayīnaḥ' ityucyate;
tatraivāyānayīnaśabdasya rūḍhatvātÂ| 
apare tu, neyo netavyaḥ, na notastataḥ| tatra ṭhśirasi sthitaḥ'
ityarthānupapateḥ ṭhphalakaśirasi sthāpyate' ityartha iti granthena
bhavitavyamityāhuḥ| nīto vā neyaḥ; tadupalakṣaṇatvātÂ|
bhāvinyāvasthayoktaḥ| ayānayasambandhitve'pi sarveṣāṃ viśeṣyādeva
pratyayotpatiruktaiva| satyapi dvitīyādhikāre punardvitīyoccāraṇaṃ
dṛṣṭādÂddhitīyāntādyathā syādityevamarthamÂ| tena
viśiṣṭārthaneyavacanādayānayaśabdādÂddhitīyāntātadÂ pratyayo
bhavati, na neyavacanamātrātÂ| sa eva viśiṣṭo yo nayaḥ
pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmītyādinā granthena darśitaḥ| 
athāyānya iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yadi hyayaṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ, tasya
napuṃsakatvādayānayamiti bhavitavyamÂ? athetaretarayoge,
dvyarthatvādayānayāviti bhavitavyamÂ? nāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
mayūravyaṃsakāditvātÂ tatpuruṣaḥ--ayasahito'nayo'yānaya iti| atha
baddhābhakṣayatineyeṣviti kathaṃ tiṅntasya dvandvaḥ? kaḥ punarāhāyaṃ
dvandva iti? yadi na dvandvaḥ, kathaṃ neyeṣviti bahuvacanamÂ?
sautratvānnirdeaśasya| subvyatyayena vā ccchandasyekavacanasya sthāne
bahuvacanamupapannamÂ| nanu ccchandasi subvyatyaya uktaḥ, nedaṃ cchandaḥ?
ṭhcchandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā. 1-1-1) ityadoṣaḥ| atha vā; dvandva
evāyamÂ, na tu tiṅntasya| na hi bhakṣayatiśabdo'yaṃ tiṅntaḥ| kiṃ
tarhi? tiṅntapratirūpako nipātastiṅntena samānārthaḥ,
yathā--astikṣīrā brāhmaṇītyatrāstiśabdaḥ||

11. avārapārātyantānukāmaṃ gāmī| (5.2.11)

ṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ pūrvanipāto vaktavyaḥ| tena pakṣe pārāvāramityapi
bhavati| 
ṭhvigṛhītādapi' iti| [ṭhbhavati'-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥṭ ṭhviparītācca' iti|

dvitīyopādānaṃ kṛtamÂ? etena tadadhikasya vidhirbhavatīti

12. samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate| (5.2.12)

22. sāptapadīnaṃ sakhyamÂ| (5.2.22)

28. veḥ śālaccchaṅkaṭcau| (5.2.28)

paramārthato'narthakāḥ| veḥ śālaccchaṅkaṭacāvapyanarthakāveva vidhīyate

37. pramāṇe dvayasajdadhnañmātracaḥ| (5.2.37)

kimÂ' iti| na hi vikalpaḥ prakṛto yannivṛtyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ

ṭhsaṃśaye', ityādinā nityagrahaṇasya prayojanamāha| śravaṇaṃ prādaḥ,
ṭhkṛtvalyuṭo bahulamÂ' (3.3.113) iti bhāve ghañÂ' śrāvo'syāstīti

ṭhstome ḍaṭÂ' ityādi| pañcadaśāhāni parimāṇamasya yajñasya

śinaḥ' iti| ḍiniḥ, ṭhti viṃśaterḍiti' (6.4.142) iti tilopaḥ,

39. yatadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatupÂ| (5.2.39) 
ṭhyāvānÂ' iti| ṭhā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityakāraḥ| ugidacāmÂ'
(7.1.70) iti numÂ, ṭhatvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ,
halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| pramāṇaparimāṇaśabdau paryāyāviti
matyamāno paścodayetÂ--atra kasmātÂ parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ kriyate,
yāvatā pramāṇagrahaṇamanuvartata eveti? taṃ pratyāha--ṭhpramāṇe iti
vartamāne' ityādi| sa punaranayoḥ pramāṇaparimāṇayorbhedaḥ

vyākhyātaḥ|
ṭhḍāvatāvarthavaiśeṣyātÂ' iti| ṭhḍāvatau' iti
pūrvācāryasaṃjñāpratipāditāpekṣo'yaṃ nirdeaśaḥ, te hi yatadetebyo
ḍāvatumeva pratyayaṃ kṛtavantaḥ| viśiṣyata iti viśeṣaḥ, viśeṣasya
bhāvo vaiśeṣyamÂ| arthasya vaiśeṣyamarthasya viśiṣṭatvamityarthaḥ|
pramāṇaśapabdasyānyo'rthaḥ, parimāṇaśabdasya cānyo'rtha iti
bhinnārthatvamanayoḥ; tasmādarthavaiśeṣyāḍḍāvatau vidhātavye
parimāṇaśabdasya nirdeaśaḥ pṛthagucyate| ucyata iti kriyata ityarthaḥ|
kimarthaḥ pṛthignirdeaśaḥ kriyate? ityāha-ṭhmātrādyapratighātāya' iti|
pṛthignirdeaśenārthabede siddhe sati mātrajādīnāṃ bādhā mā
būdityevamarthaḥ pṛthagnirdeaśaḥ kriyata ityāha| athaikatve tu
prakṛtisāmānye mātrajādayo vidhīyamānā utsargā bhavanti,
prakṛtiviśeṣātÂ tu vatubÂ vidhīyamāno'pavādau bhavati,
ṭhapavādenotsargo bādhyate' iti yatadetebhyo mātra jādayo na syuḥ,
tataśca tatpramāṇamasya tanmātramityādi na sidhyetÂ,
arthabhedyautsargāpavādabhāvo nāstīti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ|
kiñca--ṭhbhāvaḥ siddhaśca ḍāvatoḥ' iti| ṭhḍāvatoḥ' iti pañcamī|
arthabhede sati vatuppratyayāntānmātrajādīnāmutpatiśca siddhā bhavati|
parimāṇe vatubÂ bhavati--yatÂ parimāṇamasya yāvāniti|
tadantātÂ parimāṇe mātrajādayo bhavanti--yāvatÂ parimāṇamasya
yāvanmātramÂ| athaikatve tu ṭhuktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' (vyā.pa.60) ti
matupā'bihitatvādasyārthasya tadantānmātrajādayo na syu-| 
ṭhtvāvataḥ, māvataḥ' iti| maparyantayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ

40. kimidambhyāṃ vo ghaḥ| (5.2.40)

41. kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca| (5.2.41)
ṭhsaṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇamÂ' iti| kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī|
parimitiḥ parimāṇamÂ| saṃkhyāpariccheda ityarthaḥ| pariccheda ti
bhāve ghañÂ| ṭhsaṃkhyāparicchede vartamānātÂ' iti|
paricchedopādhikāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ vartamānādityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ|
yathā hyayamevārtho'sya vacanasyotaratra tathā vyaktīkariṣyate| tasya
vakārasya ghatvamiti; ṭhvo ghaḥ' ityanuvṛteḥ| ṭhpṛcchÂayamānatvātÂ'
iti| yadā saṃkhyāyāḥ paricchede kiṃśabdo vartate| kadā ca vartate?
yadā saṃkhyā paripṛcchÂayamānā bhavati| na hyaparipṛcchÂayamānāyāḥ
pariccheda upapadyate| yadā ca paripṛṭacchÂayamānā bhavati, tadā ca
kiṃśabdaḥ paricchedaviśiṣṭāyāṃ vartata iti pṛcchÂayamānatvātÂ
ṭhparicchedopādikāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ vartamānātÂ kimaḥ pratyayo
bhavatīti vijñāyate| pariccheda upādhiviśeṣaṇabhūto yasyāḥ sā
paricchedopādhikā| paricachedaviśeṣaṇeti yāvatÂ| tadanena
saṃkyāparicchede vartamānātÂ kima ityasya yo'rtho'bhimataḥ sa
vyaktīkṛtaḥ| ṭhkati' iti| jasaḥ ṭhṣaḍbhyo lukÂ' (7.1.22) iti lukÂ| 
ṭhatha vā' ityādi| atra ca vyākhyāne ṭhsaṃkhyāparimāṇe' iti karmadhārayaḥ,
nipātanādupasarjanasyāyaṃ paranipātaḥ| parimāṇaśabdaśca
parimīyate'neneti karaṇasādhanaḥ| ṭhevamātmikaiva' iti| asyārthaṃ
paricchedasvabhāvetyanena vispaṣṭīkaroti| pariccchidyate'neneti
paricchedaḥ, sa svabhāvo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| ṭhyatra' ityādinā yadarthaṃ
parimāṇagrahaṇena saṃkhyā viśeṣyate taddarśayati|
syādetatÂ--nāstyeva sa viśeṣo yatra saṃkhyāyāḥ paricchedasvabhāvo
nāsti, tadapārthakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti? ata āha--ṭhkṣepe hi' ityādi|
ṭhkeyameṣāṃ saṃkhyā daśānāmÂ' iti| nātra saṃkhyā paricchedakatvena

42. saṃkhyāyā avayave tayapÂ| (5.2.42)

43. dvitribhyāṃ tayasyāyajvā| (5.2.43)
tayapratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamÂ, yāvatā prakṛta evāsāvanuvartiṣyate?

tatÂ? ṭhprathamacaramÂ' (1.1.32) ityādinā jasi vibhāṣā
sarvanāmasaṃjñā--dvaye, dvayāḥ; ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañÂ' (4.1.15) iti
ṅepÂ--dvayo| nanu ca pūrvasūtreṇaiva vihitasya tasya iha

ṭhdvitribhyāmÂ' iti| pañcamīnirdeaśaḥ ṭhtasmādityutarasya' (1.1.67) iti

tasya tvanuvṛtirutarārthipi bhavati| ṭhubhādudāto nityamÂ' (5.2.44)

44. ubhādudāto nityamÂ| (5.2.44)
ṭhvacanasāmarthyātÂ' ityādi| yadyantodātaḥ syādudātavacanamanarthakaṃ

saṃkhyā' iti| dvitrādivatÂ| pūrveṇa yogena tayayo vidhānamÂ,
tasyāpareṇa yogena nityamayajādeśo vidhīyate| ṭhubhaye
dedamanuṣyāḥ' iti| ubhāvavayavau yeṣāmityubhaye| kathaṃ bahutve
devamanuṣyāṇāṃ dvāvavayavau bhavataḥ? yadyapyatra bahutvamasti, dvitvamapi
tu prātipadikayorastyeva; atra hi dvau rāśī
samudāyasyāvayavau--eko devanāṃ rāśiḥ, aparo
manuṣyāṇāmityadoṣaḥ|| 

45. tadasminnadhikamiti daśāntāḍḍaḥ| (5.2.45)
ṭhpratyayārthena ca' ityādi| yathājātīyaḥ pratyayārthastathājātīya eva yadi
prakṛtyartho vati evaṃ pratyaya ityate, nānyathā| pratyayārthena
prakṛtyarthasya tulyajātīyatvaṃ
darśayitumudāharaṇamupanyasyati--ṭhekādaśa kārṣāpaṇāḥ' iti|
prakṛtyartho'pyekādaśa kārṣāpaṇā eveti prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārthena
samānajātīyaḥ| ṭhiha tu na' ityādi| atra hi kārṣāpaṇaśataṃ pratyayārthaḥ|
prakṛtyarthastvekādaśa māṣāḥ| te ca kārṣāpaṇebhyo vijātīyā iti na
bhavati pratyayaḥ| ṭhśatasahasrayoścaiveṣyate' iti| yatÂ ṭhtadasminÂ'
tasmiṃśca śate sahasre vā pratyaya iṣyate; nānyatara triṃśatyādau| 
kathaṃ punaranupātameva sūtre labhyate? ityāha--ṭhiti karaṇo
vivakṣārthaḥ' ityādi| ṭhkathamÂ' ityādi| yadi śate sahasre vādhikini
pratyayena bhavitavyamÂ, iha pratyayo na prāpnoti--ekādaśaṃ
śatasahasramiti| atra hi śatasahasraṃ saṃkhyāntarañcādhikamÂ, na śataṃ
nāpi sahasramityabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhśatānāmÂ' ityādi| anena śatasahasrasya
saṃkhyāntaraṃ nirasyāti| yadā śataśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷntaḥ sahasraśabdena
samasyate tadā śatānāṃ sahasraṃ śatasahasraśabdenocyate| yadā tu
sahasraśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷntaśabdena samasyate, tadā sahasrāṇaāṃ śataṃ
śatasahasraśabdenocyate| nanu ca sahasraśabdasya paṣṭhaḷntasya samāse
sahasraśatamiti bhavitavyamÂ? rājadantādiṣu darśanātÂ tasya
paranipāto bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| ṭhtatra śatasahasrayorityeva siddhamÂ'
iti| śatasahasravācyasyārthasya śatasahasrayorevāntarbhāvātÂ| 
ṭhadhike' ityādi| loke pratyayārthena samānajātāvadhike
śatasahasrayoreva pratyayākhyaṃ kāryamiṣṭamÂ| yadā tvasamānajātyadhikaṃ
bhavati, na ca śataṃ sahasraṃ vā pratyayārthena vivakṣitamÂ, tadā neṣyate|
athaikādaśaṃ śatasahasramityatra kasyādhikye sati ḍaḥ kartavyaḥ?
ityāha--ṭhyasya' ityādi| saṃkhyā saṃkhyānamÂ, gaṇanamityarthaḥ| yasya
saṃkhyā, tasyādhikye ḍaḥ kartavyaḥ| kasya ca saṃkhyā bhavati? adhikatvaṃ
saṃkhyāyate yasya| yadā śatāni saṃkyāyate tadā--śatānāṃ sahasramiti
śatasahasramÂ, tadā śatādhikye ḍaḥ kartavyaḥ| ekādaśādhikānsminÂ
sahasra ekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti| yadā tu sahasrāṇi
saṃkhyāyate--sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ sahasraśatmiti, tadā sahasrādhikye ḍaḥ
kartavyaḥ| ekādaśasahasrāṇyadhikānyasminnekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti| atha
kimarthaṃ taditi prathamāsamarthavibhaktirupādīyate? yāvatā ṭhtadasya
sañjātamÂ' (5.2.36) ityanuvartata eva, tatra pratyayārtha evāsminniti
nirdeaṣṭavyaḥ? naivaṃ śakyamÂ; tadanuvṛtau hi tatsambandhasyāsyeti
pratyārthasyāpyanuvṛtiḥ prasajyeta| na ca ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyarthayorvirodhaḥ;
tato'sminniti nirdeaśātÂ pūrvaḥ pratyayārtho na nivartate, tasyāṃ
tvanuvṛtau ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe'pi pratyayaḥ syātÂ| tasmādasyeti nivṛtyarthaṃ
punastaditi prathamāsamarthavibhaktirupādīyate| yadyevamÂ, asyeti
pratyayārthasya nivṛtatvātÂ ṭhsaṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭÂ'
(5.2.47) ityatra ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe pratyayo na prāpnoti| iha nivṛtasyāpi
maṇḍūakaplutinyāyenānuvṛtirbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| anye tu jñāpakaṃ
tadityasya varṇayanti| taditi prakṛte yatÂ tadityāha,
tajjñāpayati--ṭhtadasya sañjātamÂ' (5.2.36) ityādau sūtre yannirdiṣṭaṃ
tadihānuvartamānamapyaṅgabhāvaṃ na yātīti ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe pratyayo na
bhavati|| 

46. śadantarviśateśca| (5.2.46)
nanu ca ṭhpaṅÂkti' (5.1.59) ityādau sūtre triṃśadādayaḥ śabdāḥ
śatpratyayāntāḥ, tataśca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva tadantātÂ pratyayo
labhyate, tatÂ kimantagrahaṇena? ityāha--ṭhśadÂgrahaṇe'ntagrahaṇamÂ'
ityādi| yadyantagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
yasmātÂ sa vihitastadādereva syānÂ; nādhikātÂ| ato'dhikādapi
yathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇamÂ| yadi tarhi yasmātÂ pratyayo
vihitastadāderadhikārthamantagrahaṇaṃ kevalānna prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena kevalādapi
bhaviṣyati| ṭhsaṃkhyāgrahaṇañca kartavyamÂ' iti| saṃkhyā gṛhyate yena tatÂ
saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamÂ| kiṃ punaḥ kartavyamÂ? vyākhyānamÂ| tatraivaṃ
vyākhyānamÂ--ṭhsaṃkhyāyā avayave tayapÂ' (5.2.42) ityataḥ saṃkhyāyā
ityanuvartate, tena saṃkhyādhikādeva bhaviṣyati, nānyādhikātÂ| 
ṭhviṃśateśca' ityādi| viṃśatiśabdācca tadantācca
prātipadikāṅḍapratyayo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ|
tatraidaṃ vyākhyānamÂ--viṃśatiśabdātāvatÂ sākṣātÂ sūtropātāta
pratyayo bhavati, tadantādapi; cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāditi| 
ṭhsaṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ ca' ityādau pūrva evārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi pūrvakameva||

47. saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭÂ| (5.2.47)
ṭhguṇo yena nimīyate' iti| parivartyate, vikrīyata ityarthaḥ|
ṭhso'pi' ityādi| na hi tasya bhāgatvamantareṇa nimeyasya guṇa ityeva
nirdiṣṭasya bhāgatvamadhyavasātuṃ śakyamÂ| yadā hi mūlasya bhāgatvaṃ
nāsti, bhāgavyapadeśo na pravartata eva| tena yadyapi nimānasya bhāgatā
noktā, tathāpi sāmarthyātÂ sā pratīyate| ṭhyavānāṃ dvau bhāgau
nimānamasya' iti| nanu cobhayatrāpi parivartanamÂ, tathāpi mūlya eva
nimānaśabdo rūḍha iti yanmūlyatvena vivakṣitaṃ tadeva nimānaṃ
bhavati, netaratÂ| ṭhyavānāmÂ' iti| bhāgāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| yadyevamÂ,
parāpekṣa uvaściccchabde taddhitasya vṛtirvirudhyate| nanūdaśvidbhāge
pratyayaḥ, nodaśviti, tatkathaṃ dvimayamudaśviditi
pratyayāntasyodaśviccchabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyamÂ? ityata
āha--ṭhbhāge'pi tu' ityādi| atra punarabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ|
yathaivāṇādayo'patyāpatyavatsambandhe'pi vidhīyamānā
abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyātÂ prādhānyena sambandhinamācakṣate--āṬpagavo
dākṣiriti, tathāyamapi bhāge vidhīmāno
bhāgavantamudaśvidādikamācaṣṭe| ṭhguṇasyeti caikatvaṃ vivakṣitamÂ'
iti| guṇasyeti yaikasaṃkhyā sā vivakṣitā| nanu ca ṭhtaddhitāḥ (4.1.76)
iti nirdeaśe'pi bahuvacanamapramāṇamÂ, tasyāvivakṣitatvātÂ'
ityuktamÂ, tatkathamihaikatvavivakṣā yujyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ kṛtvā guṇanimāna eva kartavyamÂ, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ
bhavati| so'yamevaṃ vaktavye sati yadguṇasyetyekavacanamuccārayati,
tenaitatÂ sūcayati--vivakṣitamatraikatvamiti
tenetyādinaikatvavivakṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| ekatvavivakṣāyāṃ hyaetatÂ
prayojanamÂ--ekasya guṇasya nimāne vartamānādyathā syātÂ| ṭhdvau
bhāgau yavānāṃ traya udaśvitaḥ' iti| atra trayāṇāṃ bhāgānāṃ nimāne
dviśabdo vartata iti na bhavati pratyayaḥ| 
nanu ca satyāmapyekatvavivakṣāyāṃ naivānna pratyayena bhavitavyamÂ,
yataḥ ṭhbhūyasaśca vācikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyaya iṣyate' iti vacanamÂ|
na hyatra dviśabdo bhūyaso vācakaḥ? evaṃ tarhi yavānāṃ yau dvau bhāgau,
tāviha nimeyatvena vivakṣyete| ye traya udaśvito bhāgāste
nimānatvena| tatra yadyekatvavivakṣā na syātÂ tadā
triṣūdaśvidguṇeṣu vartamānātÂ pratyayaḥ syātÂ| bhūyasaścetyapi
pratyayārthātÂ prakṛtyarthasya bhūyaso vācikāyāḥ pratyaya iṣyate,
nānyataḥ| ṭhiha na bhavati' iti| anabhiṣānātÂ| ṭhtadasminnadhikamÂ'
(5.2.45) ityādeḥ sūtrāditikaraṇānuvṛtervā| yadi bhūyaso
vācikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā iṣyate yavānāṃ dvau bhāgau nimānamasyetyatra na
prāpnoti? ityata āha--ṭhbhūyasa iti ca' ityādi| 
evamapi hi prāpnoti--dvau yavānāmaṣyarddha udaśvita iti, asti hyatra
pratyarthātÂ prakṛtyarthasyādhikyamÂ? ityata āha--ṭhguṇaśabdaḥ' ityādi|
guṇaśabdo hyayaṃ bhāgavacano'pi samatāmapi tasya bhāgasya brūte, na
cāṣyarddhaśapabdena samabhāga ucyate| 
ṭhnimeye cāpi dṛśyate' iti| kena punarvihito dṛśyate? anenaiva|
kathamÂ? dve atra vākye; tatraikasminÂ vākye nimānaśabdaḥ
karaṇasādhanaḥ--nimīyate'neneti nimānamÂ; dvitīye tu
karmasādhano nimīyata iti nimānamÂ; ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulamÂ'
(3.3.113) iti karmaṇi lyuṭÂ| yadā karaṇasādhanastadā guṇasyeti
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭī, yadā tu karmasādhanastadā kartari| guṇo hi
nimānakriyākaraṇamiti kartṛtvena vivakṣyate| bhavati hi karaṇasya
kartṛtvena vivakṣā, yathā--sādhyasiścchinatīti| tatraikena vākyena
nimāne partamānāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā nimeye'bhidheye pratyayo vidhīyate|
apareṇa nimeye vartamānāyā nimāne'bhidheye'pi
pratyayo'bhidhīyate| vākyabhedasya ca saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ
nibandhanamÂ--ṭhsaṃkhyāyā avayave tayapÂ' (5.2.42) ityataḥ| evañca
saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvartate| idamiha dvitīyamÂ| tatra yadyatraikaṃ vākyaṃ
syādÂdvitīyaṃ saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syātÂ, sautrānumitābhyāṃ tu
dve vākye kriyamāṇe tadarthavadbhavati| tasmāddve atra vākye| 
ṭhdvau vrīhiyavau' ityādi| atra nodaśvidbhāgasya dvau vrīhiyavau
nimānatvena vivakṣitau, kiṃ tarhi? udaśvitaḥ| evaṃ ṭhdvauguṇau' ityādi|
atra prathamāsamartho guṇasya nimānena vartate| na hi kṣīrasya bhāgadvayena
tailasya bhāgo nimīyate| mayaṭaṣṭitkaraṇaṃ ṅībarthamÂ--dvau
guḍasyaiko drākṣāyā dvimayī drākṣeti|| 

48. tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭÂ| (5.2.48)
iha dve saṃkhyāgrahaṇe anuvartate, tatra caikena ṭhsaṃkhyāvācinaḥ
prātipadikātÂ' iti bruvatā prakṛtirviśeṣitā| dvitīyena tu
pratyayārtha viśeṣayitumāha--ṭhyena' ityādi| saṃkhyānaśabdaṃ
samuccārayanÂ saṃkhnāvacanaḥ saṃkhyānaśabdena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate
iti darśayati| dvividho hi saṃkhyāśabadaḥ--saṃkhyānavacanaḥ,
saṃkhyeyavacanaśca| tatra yadi saṃkhyeyavacanena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate,
tadāyamarthaḥ syātÂ--saṃkhyeyaṃ muṣṭaḷadikaṃ yena pūryate
dravyāntareṇātiriktaṃ kriyate sa ca pūraṇa iti, tataśca pañcānāṃ
muṣṭikāṇāṃ ghaṭa ityatrāpi syātÂ| tasmātsaṃkhyāvacanenaiva
pratyayārtho viśeṣayituṃ yuktaḥ| ṭhsampadyate' iti| pūryyata
ityasyārthamācaṣṭe| etenaitaddarśayati--saṃkhyāvacanena pratyayārtho
viśeṣyate| na muṣṭikāṇāmiva dravyāṇāṃ dravyāntareṇātiriktakaraṇaṃ
saṃkhyāyāḥ pūraṇamÂ, kiṃ tarhi? sampatireveti| ṭhiha na bhavati'
ityādi| na hi ghaṭa upajāte pañcatvasaṃkhyā muṣṭikāṇā sampadayate| kiṃ
tarhi? tatra pañcasaṃkhyakānāmeva dravyāntareṇātiriktatā||

49. nāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭÂ| (5.2.49)
ṭhḍaṭo maḍāgamo bhavati' iti| atha pratyaya eva nāntātÂ maṭÂ kasmānna
bhavati? narhati pratyayo bhavitumÂ| pratyaye hi tasminÂ sati
ḍaṭo'nuvṛtirapārthikā syātÂ, sa hi pūrvameva vihitaḥ, na ca
vihitasyānuvṛtirvidhānārthopapadyata iti| āgamārthe ca sā vijñāyate|
nanu ca pañcama ityādau na kaścidviśeṣaḥ--maṭa āgamatve, pratyayatve
vā; tadeva hi rūpamÂ, sa eva hi svaraḥ, kiñcānuvṛtena, maṭa eva
pratyayatvamastu? satyamÂ, iha nāsti viśeṣaḥ; viṃśatitama ityādau tu
vidyate| tathā hi ṭhviśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyāmÂ' (5.2.56) iti
maṭpratyayaḥ syātÂ| [ṭhmayaṭÂ' mudritapāṭhaḥṭ viṃśatitamaprabhṛtayaḥ
śabdāḥ pratyayasvareṇa madhyodātāḥ syuḥ| ḍaṭi tu pratyaye sati
tasyādyaudātatve kṛte tataścāgamānudātatve cāntodātā bhavanti|
tasmādutarārthe'nuvartamānasyehāpi ḍaṭa eva pratyayatvaṃ vijñāyate|
kathaṃ punarḍaṭo maḍāgamaḥ śakyo vidhātumÂ, yāvatā prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ
prakṛtaṃ ḍaḍgrahaṇamÂ, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ?
ityādi--ṭhnāntātÂ' ityādi| yadyapi prathamāntaṃ ḍaḍgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtamÂ,
tathāpi ḍaṭa āgamasambandhena ṭhtasmādityutarasya' (1.1.67) iti
nāntādityeṣā pañcamī ḍaḍiti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaĀ prakalapayatatyadoṣaḥ|
ṭhpañcamaḥ' iti| ṭilopo'tra na bhavati; maṭi kṛte
satyabhasaṃjñakatvātÂ| nanu ca paratvāṭṭilopenaiva
tāvadbhavitavyamÂ? naitadasti; antaraṅgo hyāgamaḥ, sa hi
pratyayasanniyogenocyate| ṭilopastūtpanne pratyaye bhasaṃjñāyā satyāṃ
prakṛtipratyayāvāśritya bhavatīti bahiraṅgo bhavati| 
ṭhekādaśānāṃ pūraṇā ekādaśaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punarasmātprāptiḥ, yāvatā
saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvartate, saṃkhyāsamÂdāyo'pi hi saṃkhyāgrahaṇena
gṛhyate--saṃkhyāyate'nayeti kṛtavā| avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyamÂ;
anyathā'daśatayā na syātÂ||

51. ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thukÂ| (5.2.51)
ṭhtadiha saptamyā' ityādi| pūraṇādhikāre hyayaṃ vidhīyamāno
ḍaṭsanniyogana vidhīyate| tatra yadyapi saptamau nāsti, tathāpi ḍaṭi
parato vijñāyate| tenārthādvibhaktivapariṇāmo bhavatīti ḍaḍiti
yadvateta tadiha saptamyā vipariṇamyate| ṭhkatipayaśabdo na saṃkhyā'
iti| laukikatvābhāvātÂ saṃkhyā na bhavati; loke'sya
saṃkhyātvenāprasiddhatvāt| śāstrīyo'pi na bhavati; śāstre
saṃkhyāsaṃjñā'vidhānātÂ| yadi na saṃkhyā, kaṃthamasya ḍaṭÂ, yatra
paratasthugvidhīyate? ityāha--ṭhtasya' ityādi| yadetaḍḍaṭi parataḥ
katipayaśabdasya thugvidhānaṃ tata eva jñāpakāḍḍaṭÂpratyayo'sya
bhavatītyavasīyate| ṭhṣaṣṭhaḥ' iti| ṣṭtvamÂ| ṭilopo'tra na bhavati|
thugvidhānasāmarthyātÂ| āgamasya pūrvāntakaraṇaṃ bhasaṃjñārthamÂ| yadi
parādiḥ kriyate tato bhasaṃjñā na syātÂ, tathā cāsatyāmÂ,
ṭhsvādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne' (1.4.17) iti padasaṃjñā syātÂ| tataśca ṣaṣṭha
ityatra jaśtvaṃ prasajyeta| ṭhcaturthaḥ' iti| atra rephasya ṭhvisarjanīyasya
saḥ' (8.3.34) iti satvamÂ| pūrvānte tu saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ na bhavati|| 

52. bahupūgagaṇasaṅkhasaya tithukÂ| (5.2.52)
ṭhpūgasaṅghayorasaṃkhyātvātÂ' iti| atra kathaṃ pratyaya iti,
pūgasaṅghaśabdau hi na laukikī saṃkhyā, nāpi śāstrīyā, tatkathaṃ
tābhyāṃ ḍaṭpratyayaḥ, yatra paratastayostithugvidhīyate, ḍaṭi ca
vidhānamÂ? athātrotaramāha--ṭhidameva' ityādi| yadetaḍḍaṭi
paratastayostithuko vidhānametadeva jñāpayati--bhavati tābhyāṃ
ḍaṭpratyaya iti| na hyasatastithugāgamaṃ prati nimitabhāva upapadyate|| 

53. vatorathukÂ| (5.2.53)
ṭhyāvatithaḥ' iti| ṭhyatadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatupÂ' (5.2.39), ṭhā
sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91)||

54. dvestīyaḥ| (5.2.54)
ṭhdviśabdātÂ tīyapratyayo bhavati' iti| atha dviśabdādutarasya
ḍaṭastīyādeśaḥ kasmādeva na bhavati? jñāpakatvātÂ| yadayamÂ ṭhkarmaṇi
dvitīyā' (2.3.2) iti ṭāpā nirdeaśaṃ karoti,
tajjñāpayati--nāyamādeśa iti| yadyevamanenaiva siddhatvātÂ
pratyayavidhānamanarthakamÂ? na; svarārthatvātÂ| nipātanāddhi
prātipadikasvareṇāntodātaḥ syātÂ| tīyapratyaye tu pratyayasvareṇa
madhyodāto bhavati| kiñca, yadi pratyayo na vidhīyate ṭhbādhakānyapi
nipātanāni bhavanti' (nī.pa.bṛ. 109) iti ḍaḍapi syātÂ| yadi
punarayaṃ ḍaḍādeśaḥ syātÂ, tarhi kiṃ syātÂ? ḍaṭsvareṇa
tīyaśabdo'ntodātaḥ syātÂ, striyāṃ ca ṭitvānḍīpÂ, tataśca
dvitīyeti nirdeaśo nopapadyate||

55. treḥ samprasāraṇañca| (5.2.55)
ṭhaṇa iti tatra vartate' iti| ṭhḍhūalope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111)
ityataḥ| nanu ca pareṇa ṇakāreṇāṇgrahaṇa ṛkāro'pyaṇÂ bhaviṣyati?
ityata āha--ṭhpūrveṇa ca' ityādi| 
atra ṭhtrestu ca' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktamÂ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktumÂ, evaṃ
hyucyamāne sandehaḥ syātÂ - kimayamādeśaḥ, uta pratyaya? iti|| 

56. viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyāmÂ| (5.2.56)

āha--ṭhpūraṇādhikārātÂ' iti| pūraṇārthe yo vihitasatasya
viṃśatyādibhyaḥ parasya tamaṅÂvidhīyate, sa nānyo ḍaṭaḥ sambhavatīti
ḍaḍeva vijñāyate| 
ṭhviṃśātyādayo laukikāḥ saṃkhyāśabdā guhyante' iti|
vyāpternyāyātÂ| te punarviśatyekaviṃśatiprabhṛtayaḥ saṃgṛhītā

57. nityaṃ śatādimāsārdhamāsasaṃvatsarācca| (5.2.57)

58. ṣaṣṭaḷadeścāsaṃkhyādeḥ| (5.2.58)

59. matau cchaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ| (5.2.59)
ṭhmatau' iti matvartha ucyate; sāhacaryātÂ| ṭhmatvarthena' ityādi|
samarthavibhaktiḥ prathamā, prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamÂ--astitvamÂ,
pratyayārthaḥ--asyāsminniti ca, sarvametanmatvarthagrahaṇena ṭhākṣipyate'
iti| sannidhāpyate, upasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| yuktaṃ yanmatubgrahaṇe
pratyayārtha ākṣipyate; tasya tadviṣayatvātÂ| samarthavibhaktyādi
kathamākṣipyate? arthasāhacaryātÂ||
atha vā pradhānānuvṛtitvāddguṇānāmÂ, prādhānyena pratyayārtha
upasthāpite pratyayasāmarthyātÂ tadapi guṇabhūtamupasthāpyata eva|
ihāsyavāmādiśabdo'nekapadāntatvādvākyamÂ| vākyasya
cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti prātipadikasaṃjñā
nāsti, atastebhyo na prāpnoti; aprātipadikatvāditi
yaścodayetÂ, taṃ pratyāha-ṭhanukaraṇaśabdāśca' ityādi|
anukaraṇagrahaṇena ca vākyatvamasyavāmaprabhṛtīnāṃ nirasyati| na
hyanukaraṇaśabdānāmavayavabhūtāni padāni santi, tatkutasteṣāṃ
vākyatvamÂ? yataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā na syātÂ| ṭhsvarūpamātrapradhānāḥ'
ityanenārthavatvaṃ teṣāṃ darśayati| anarthakatve hyarthavataḥ
prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhānātÂ prātipadikatvaṃ na syātÂ| tathā ca sa eva
pratyayābhāvaḥ prasajyeta| mātraśabdo'rthāntaravyavacchedāya| svarūpamātraṃ
pradhānamabhidheyaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| caśabdo yasmādarthe|
yasmādanukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpamātrapradhānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti,
tenānekadādapi pratyayākhyaṃ kāryaṃ siddhamÂ; tasya prātipadikatvātÂ|
aprātipadakatvañca vākyatvādanarthakatvādvā bhavetÂ| na
cāsyavāmaprabhṛtīnāṃ vākyatvamÂ; anukaraṇaśabdatvātÂ|
nāpyanarthakatvamÂ; svarūpamātreṇārthavatvāt| yadi
hyasyavāmetyādāvanukaraṇaśabdenānekāni padānyasyāvayavabhūtāni
santi tatkathaṃ tenānekapadādapi siddhamityuktamÂ? paraprasiddhyā
padasya| asyavāmādayo'pyevamÂ| eṣāmanekāvayavāḥ prasiddhāḥ;
tasmātÂ tatprasiddhyaivamuktamÂ; na tu vidyamānānekapadatvātÂ| 
atha kathamanukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpamātrapradānā bhavanti,
yāvatānukāryameva teṣāmabhidheyamÂ, atastadeva pradhānasvarūpamÂ?
naitadasti; iha hi prathamāsamarthādastinā samānādhikaraṇātÂ pratyayo
vidhīyate| anukaraṇaśabdāścānukriyamāṇenārthenārthavanto'pi
pratyavamṛṣṭā itikaraṇena śabdaśabdena vā
prathamāsamarthāstisamānādhikaraṇā bhavanti| arthe hi guṇībhūtānāṃ
prathamāsamarthatvamastyupādhikatvañca nopapadyate| tathā
hyasyavāmo'sminnastītyukte'nukaraṇapratyāyitasyānukāryasyaiva
śattdasya prathamāsamarthatvamastyupādhikatvañca gamyate, na
tvanukaraṇaśabdasya| tasmāditikaraṇena śabdaśabdena vā'vaśyambhāvo
pratyavamarśaḥ| asyavāma ityasminnastyavāmaśabdo vāsminnastīti
bhedānukriyamāṇapadārthatā nivartate, svarūpapadārthataivānujāyate|
nanvevaṃ sati matvartho nopapadyate, anukāryā hyāmnāyaśabdāḥ
sūktasāmnoḥ santi, na tu tadanukaraṇaśabdā laukikādayaḥ? naiṣa
deṣaḥ; vākya svātantryahetoritikaraṇādeḥ sannidhau tena
pratyavamṛśyamānā anukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpeṇārthavanto bhavanti, vṛtau
tvanukāryeṇaiva; tatra svātantryahetoritikaraṇāderabhāvātÂ|
vṛtāveva sūktasāmanī samatvarthavatayā vaktumiṣṭe, na vākya iti
kimatra nopapadyate! asyavāmaśabdo'sminnastyasyavāmīyamÂ|
kayāṣubhāśabdo'sminnasti ṭhkayāṣubhīyamÂ'| yogaścāyaṃ
matvarthīyānāmapavādaḥ||

72. śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi| (5.2.72)

ṣaṣṭhī pratiṣiddhā, tasmātÂ karmaṇi dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyamÂ|
kriyāviśeṣaṇācchītādiśabdādÂdvitīyāsamarthātpratyayo vijñāyate|

ṇiniḥ| na sa padārtho'sti yaḥ śītoṣṇasparśau niyogataḥ karoti|
tuṣārātapāvapi hi nāvaśyaṃ kurutaḥ; pratibandhasambhavātÂ|

73. adhikamÂ| (5.2.73)
ṭhadhyārūḍhaśabdasyotarapadalopaḥ' iti| utarapadamārūḍhaśabdastasya lopo
nipātyate| kathaṃ punaradhiko droṇaḥ khāryāmityasya prathamāntasya
droṇaśabdasya prayogaḥ, adhikā khārī droṇeneti tṛtīyāntasya ca?
ityata āha--ṭhkartari karmaṇi ca' ityādi| ṭhgatyarthakarmakaśliṣa' (3.4.72)
ityādinā sūtreṇa ruheḥ kartari karmaṇi ca kto vihitaḥ, tena kartari
kartari karmaṇi cādhyarūḍhaśabdo vartate, tataśca tasyārthe
vyutpādyamāno'dhikaśabdo'pi tatparyāyo
bhavaṃstayorevārthayorbhavati| tatra yadā kartari vartate tadā
droṇaśabdātÂ prathamā bhavati, na tṛtīyā| yadā karmaṇi vartate tadā
karturanabhihitatvādadhikaśabdena droṇaśabdātÂ tṛtīyā bhavati|
karmaṇastvabhihitatvātÂ khārīśabdātÂ prathamaiva bhavati, na dvitīyā|
ṭhadhikā khārī droṇena' iti| nanu cādhiko droṇaḥ khāryāmasyāmityatra
karmaṇo'nabhihitatvātÂ khārīśabdādÂdvitīyā prāpnoti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; yadayamÂ ṭhyasmādadhikamÂ (2.3.9) ṭhtadasminnadhikamÂ' (5.2.45)
iti ca nirdeaśaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati--adhikaśabdena yoge
pañcamīsaptamyāveva vibhaktī bhavata iti||

81. kālaprayojanādroge| (5.2.81)
ṭharthalabhyā' ityādi| artho'dhikaraṇādiḥ| tenātra
saptamīprabhṛtiranuktāpi samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| ṭhprayojanaṃ
kāraṇaśabdenovyate kālagrahaṇaṃ pṛthaṅna kartavyamÂ, kālo'pi
rogasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati? naitadasti; na hyavaśyaṃ kālo rogasya kāraṇaṃ
bhavati| tatra yadā hyasau rogasya kāraṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi tato yathā
syādityevamarthaṃ kālagrahaṇamÂ| ṭhdvitoye'hni bhavo dvitīyakaḥ' iti|
tatra kāraṇāntarādvātādeḥ kutaścidbhavato jvarasya kālaḥ
kevalamadhikaraṇabhāvena vivakṣitaḥ, na tu hetubhāvena| kathaṃ punaḥ
kālādanyataḥ pratyayo dvitīyādibhyaḥ śabdebhyo bhavati, na hyaete
kālaśabdāḥ prasiddhāḥ, sāmānyaśabdā hyaete, śabdāntarasannidhānātÂ tu
kāle vṛtireṣāṃ gamyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vākye hyaeṣāṃ
śabdāntarasannidhau kali vṛtiḥ, vṛtigataśca prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayānāṃ
viśeṣaṇamÂ; sannihitatvātÂ| na vākyagataḥ; viprakarṣātÂ|
ṭhviṣapuṣpairjanitaḥ' iti| tṛtīyā| ṭhuṣṇaṃ kāryamasya' iti| atra
kāryakāraṇasambandho vivakṣitaḥ| sa cedaṃśabdādevotpannayā
ṣaṣṭaḷabhihita ityuṣṇaśabdātÂ prathamaiva bhavati| iha
kālaprayojanaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo'bhihitaḥ, na
kālaprayojanaśabdābhyāmÂ; kālaviśeṣavācibhyo bhavanÂ kriyāyāḥ
kartari jvare prayojanaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ prayojanamiti;
kāryakāraṇavivakṣāyāñca kāryasambandhini| na cāyaṃ prakāraniyamaḥ
sūtre uktaḥ, tatkathaṃ labhyate? ityata āha--ṭhutarasūtrādiha
saṃjñāgrahaṇamapakṛṣyate' iti| tena tasminÂ satyayamartho
bhavati--pratyayāntaścetÂ saṃjñā bhavati, tasmiṃścārthe sati pratyayāntaṃ
yadi saṃjñā bhavatyevaṃ pratya utpadyate, nānyatheti|
saṃjñāgrahaṇasannidhānādiha sarvaprakāro'yaṃ niyamo labhyate| na hi
vinā tena prakārema pratyayāntaṃ saṃjñā bhavati| nanu cotarasūtre
saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva śeṣabhūtamÂ, tatkathaṃ tato'pakraṣṭa śakyate? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; ubhayorapi yogayostaccheṣabhūtamÂ| kathamÂ? yogavibhāgaḥ
kariṣyate-- ṭhtadasminnannaṃ prāye' tataḥ ṭhsaṃjñāyāmÂ' iti; tena
saṃjñāgrahaṇamubhayeṣāṃ śeṣo vijñāsyate||

82. tadasminnannaṃ prāye saṃjñāyāmÂ| (5.2.82) 
ṭhannaṃ cetprāyaviṣayam' iti| prāyo viṣayo yasya tatathoktam|
viṣayagrahaṇe ṭhprāye' iti saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayi| ṭhpratyayo
bhavati' iti| anyathā guḍāpūpāḥ prāyeṇānnamiti vavakṣāyāḥ kārakāṇi
bhavantītiprāyasya viṣayabhūtasya karaṇatvena vivakṣitatvāt tṛtīyā|
ṭhguḍāpūpikā' iti ṭhpratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasyātaḥ' (7.3.44)
itītvam|
ṭhvaṭakebhya inirvaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānam--iha saṃjñāgrahaṇasya pratyayāntopādhikatvādyatra pratyayāntaṃ
saṃjñā bhavati tatra pratyayena bhavitavyam| na ca vaṭakaśabdaḥ
kanpratyayāntaḥ kasyacit saṃjñā, tena tataḥ kan na bhaviṃṣyati
tarsmiścāsati matvarthīya inirbhaviṣyatīti| ṭhvaṭakino' iti|
ṭhṛmnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5)||

83. kulmāṣādañ| (5.2.83)
saṃjñāgrahaṇena pūrveṇa kanaḥ prāptāvasatyāṃ vākyenābhidhāne prāpte
matvarthīye matubādāvidamucyate| ṭhvkaulmāṇī' iti| ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇañ'
(4.1.15) iti ṅīp||

84. śrotriyaÄścchando'dhīte| (5.2.84)
ṭhnakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| nanu ca nakāra id yasya tarsminniti parataḥ
svara ucyate, na ca samudāyānubandhe nakāre nitparatvamasti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; na evet nit, tatpuruṣo'yam| tena nakāra itsaṃjñe parataḥ
pūrvasya svaro bhaviṣyati| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate?
ityāha--ṭhcchando'dhīte' iti| asya vākyasyārthe śrotriṃyanniti
nipātyate| ṭhcchandaso vā' ityādi| pūrvatra vākyārthe
padamavidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ nipātitam; idānīṃ tu
prakṛtipratyayau nipātyete tadavīta ityasminnarthe| atra yadyapi nidita
bahuvrīhiḥ, tathāpi svaraḥ sidhyatyeva; ghanpratyayasya nitaḥ parasya
vidyamānatvāt|
ṭhkathamÂ' ityādi| yadi ccchabdaḥśabdasya śrotraśabda ādeśo ghaṃśca
pratyayaḥ ṭhtadadhīte' ityasminnarthe nipātyate, nipātanena
bādhitatvādatrārthe cchāndasa iti na siṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ|| 

85. śrāddhamanena bhuktaminiṭhanau| (5.2.85)
ṭhśrāddhaśabda' ityādi| śāstroktena vidhinā niṣpādyasya kasyaciveva
kriyāviśeṣasya śrāddhaśabdaḥ saṃjñā| karmaśabdo'yaṃ kriyāvācī| śraddhā yatra
karmaṣyasti tacchrāddhamÂ, ṭhprajñāśraddhārcāvṛtibhyo ṇaḥ' (5.2.101) iti
ṇapratyayaḥ| ṭhtatsādhane' ityādi| bhūktatvaṃ karmaṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ na
sambhavatīti tatsādhane bhavatādau vartitvā śrāddhaṃ
pratayayamutyādayatīti vijñāyate| tatsādhāne tu tasya vṛtiḥ,
tādarthyātÂ; yathā--pradīpārthāyāṃ mallikāyāṃ pradīyapaśabdasya|
ṭhsamānakālagrahaṇamÂ' iti| samānaḥ kālo gṛhyate yena
tatsamānakālagrahaṇamÂ| vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamÂ?
ityāha--ṭhadya bhukte' ityādi| yasminnahani śrāddhamanena bhuktaṃ tasminneva
śrāddhika iti syātÂṣa adya bhakte śvo mā bhūdityevamarthamÂ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānamÂ--ihāpi vetyanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena
yasminnevāhani śrāddhaṃ bhuktaṃ tasminneveṣyate; nānyatreti||

86. pūrvādiniḥ| (5.2.86)
ṭhpūrva gataṃ pītaṃ bhūktamÂ' iti| pūrvaśabdo'tra kriyāviśeṣaṇatvātÂ
karma bhavatīti dvitīyāsamarthātÂ pratyayo vijñāyate| ṭhpūrvo' iti|
ṭhsau ca' (6.4.13) iti dīrghaḥ|| 

87. sapūrvācca| (5.2.87)
sahaśabdo vidyamānavacanaḥ| ata evāha--ṭhvidyamānaṃ pūrvamÂ' iti|
ṭhvopasarjanasya' (6.3.72) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| ṭhkṛtapūrvo kaṭamiti'
nanu ca niṣṭhaḷa karmaṇo'bhihitatvādÂdvitīyā'tara na prāpanoti?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; neyaṃ karmaṇi niṣṭhā, kiṃ tarhi? bhāve| yadāpi karmaṇi
tadāpi na doṣaḥ; niṣṭhayā hi sāmānyaṃ karmābhihitamÂ, na
viśeṣakarma| tasmādviśeṣakarmaṇo'nabhihitatvādÂdvitīyā bhaviṣyati|
nanu ca pūrvaṃ kṛtamityanekapadāvayavatvācca vākyamidamÂ| vākyasya
cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti prātipadikasaṃjñā
nāsti| tatkathamataḥ pratyayaḥ? ityāha--ṭhsupsupā' ityādi| 
ṭhyogadvayena ca' ityādi| yadi ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena'
(śāka. pa. 65) ityeṣā paribhāṣā na syātÂ tadā
ṭhsapūrvātpūrvādiniḥ' ityekayogaṃ kuryātÂ kiṃ yogavibhāgena!
ekayoge hi sati kevalādapi vyapadeśivadbhāvena pratyayo
bhaviṣyati| tadevamekayogena siddhe yatÂ ṭhpūrvādiniḥ' (5.2.86) iti
pṛthagyogaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--astīyaṃ paribhāṣā
ṭhvyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' (śāka. pa. 65) iti| yadi vā
ṭhgrahaṇavatā' (vyā. pa. 89) ityādikā paribhāṣā na syātÂ ṭhsapūrvācca'
itīmaṃ yogaṃ na kuryātÂ| ṭhpūrvādiniḥ' (5.2.86) ityanenaiva hi
kṛtapūrvītyādāvapi bhaviṣyati tadantavidhinā| tadeyaṃ
pūrvayogeṇaiva pūrvaśabdādapi siddhe pratyaye yatÂ ṭhsapūrvācca'
itīmaṃ yogaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati---astīyaṃ paribhāṣā ṭhgrahaṇavatā
prātipadikena tadantavidhirna bhavati' (vyā. pa. 89) iti|| 

88. iṣṭādibhyaśca| (5.2.88)
ṭhiṣṭo yajñe' iti| kathaṃ punaratra sapatamī; yāvatā yajñasya karmatāyāṃ

89. cchandasi paripanthiparipariṇau paryavasthātari| (5.2.89)

pariśabdaḥ, paścādinipratyayaḥ|| 

90. anupadyenveṣṭā| (5.2.90)
ṭhanupadī' iti| paścātÂ padasyānupadamÂ, paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ|
