91. sākṣāddraṣṭari saṃjñāyāmÂ| (5.2.91)
ṭhsaṃjñāgrahaṇamÂ' ityādi| viśiṣṭa evābhidhadheye pratyayāntasya
vṛtirabhidheyaniyamaḥ' (vā. 802) iti ṭilopaḥ| ṭhsaṃjñagrahaṇamÂ'
ityādi| asati hi saṃjñāgrahaṇe yathograhaṇe yathopadraṣṭā
sākṣiśabdenocyate, tathā dātā grahītā cocyeyātāmÂ, etāvapi hi
draṣṭārau bhavata eva| saṃjñāgrahaṇādupadraṣṭaivocyate| dātṛgrahītṛbhyāṃ
yo'nyo draṣṭā samīpe sa upadraṣṭā| nanu ca
ṭhsvāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣi' (2.3.39) iti nipātanādeva
sākṣiśabdaḥ sādhurbhāviṣyati, abhidheyaniyamo'pi laukikatvādasya
padasya lokokta eva vijñāsyate, tadapārthakamidamÂ? naitadasti; na hi
tasminÂ nipātane sākṣiśabdasya nakārāntatā śakyate vyavasātum,
pramāṇābhāvātÂ| loke na svābhidheye pratīyamāne pratipatigauravaṃ
syāt| tasmānnakārāntatāpratipatigauravaparihārārthaṃ cedamucyate|| 

92. kṣetriyacÂ parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ| (5.2.92)
cikitsya iti śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| ṭhvākyārthe' ityādi| ṭhparakṣetre
cikitsyaḥ' ityasya vākyasyārthe kṣetriya ityetatÂ
padavacanamavidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ nipātyate|
cakāro'ntodātārthaḥ| ṭhparakṣetrādvā' ityādi| vāśabdaḥ prakārāntaraṃ
dyotayati| atha vā--parakṣetraśabdātÂ tatreti saptamīsamarthātÂ
cikisya ityatrārthe pratyayo nipātyate, paraśabdasya ca lopaḥ|
ṭhparakṣetraṃ janmāntaraśarīramÂ' iti| ihatyācccharīrādanyatvādasādhya
ityanena paraśabdasyārthaṃ darśayati| 
sasyārthaṃ hi yatÂ kṣetraṃ saṃskṛtaṃ tadanutpādyatvātÂ tṛṇānāṃ
parakṣetraṃ bhavati| 
ṭhsarvaṃ caitatÂ pramāṇamÂ' iti| sarvasyācāryeṇa pratipāditatvatātÂ||

93. indriyamindraliṅgamindradṛṣṭamindrasṛṣṭamindrajuṣṭamindradatamiti
vā| (5.2.93)
ṭhrūḍhireṣā' ityanenanāvayavārthaṃ tyājayati| kathaṃ punarjāyate
rūḍhireṣā? ityāha--ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| yadyeṣā rūḍhirna syātÂ,
vyutpateraniyamo na syātÂ; arūḍhiśabdeṣu niyatatvādeva tadarthasya|
rūḍhiśabde tvasminÂ yujyate vyutpateraniyamaḥ| rūḍhiśabdānāṃ hi
yathākathañcidvyutpatiḥ kriyate parikalpitenāvayavārthena| kathaṃ
punarātmā cakṣurādinā karaṇena śakyo'numātumÂ?
ityāha--ṭhnākartṛkamÂ' ityādi| anenāvinābhāvaṃ darśayati|
itikaraṇao hetau| yasmātÂ karaṇādīnāṃ pravṛtirnivṛtirvā
kartradhīnā, tasmādyatra tāni tatrāvaśyaṃ kartrā bhavitavyamÂ| cakṣurādinā
karaṇenāvinā bhāvenāliṅgenātmā'numīyate| kathaṃ punastadātmanā
sevitamÂ? ityāha--ṭhtaddvāreṇa' ityādi| dvārema hi
viṣayeṣvātmano jñānamutpadyate| tasmādviṣayānÂ jñātumātmā
cakṣurādīnadriyaṃ sevate| ṭhyathāyathamÂ iti| yathāsvamÂ| yo
yasyendriyasya viṣayastatÂ tasmai datamÂ| 
ṭhitikaraṇaḥ prakārārthaḥ' iti| evaṃ prakārāntareṇāpi vyutpatiḥ
kartÂtavyetyetaditikaraṇaḥ prakārarthaṃ dyotayati ata evāha--ṭhsat
sambhave' ityādi| indreṇa viṣayā nīyante sambadhyanta
itīndriyamityevamādikā sati sambhave tathā vyutpatiḥ kartavyā|
ṭhvāśabdaḥ' ityādi| asati hi vāśabde ṭhindraliṅgam' ityevamādīnāṃ
vikalpaprakārāṇā pāratantryaṃ vijñāyeta| parasparāpekṣāyā
samuccitāyā eva vyutpateḥ kāraṇamiti|
vāśabdastavindraliṅgamitīndradṛṣṭamiti cetyevaṃ sambadhyamānasteṣāṃ
svātantryaṃ darśayati| tenaikaikaḥ prakāraḥ prakārāntaranirapekṣo
vyutpatādaṅgabhāvamupayāti|| 

94. tadasyāstyasminniti matupÂ| (5.2.94)
ṭhpratyayārtho' iti| nanu ca yadÂ yasya bhavati tata tasminnasti,
yadyasminnasti tatÂ tasya bhavati, yathā--vṛkṣe śākhā, vṛkṣasya śākheti;
tatrānyataranirdeaśenaiva siddhamÂ, tatkimarthaṃ dvau nirdiśyete?
naitadasti; na hi ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyarthayoravaśyambhāvo samāveśaḥ, tathā hi
gāvo gaṅgāyāṃ bhavanti, na ca te tasyāḥ; tathā deśāntaragato'pi
putro devadatasya ca bhavati, na cāsau tatra| tasmādubhāvapi
nirdeaṣṭavyau| ṭhastīti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamÂ' iti| nanu ca sambhave
vyabhicāre ca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo bhavati nīlotpalavatÂ, na
cāstitvasya vyabhicāro'sti, yathoktamÂ--ṭhna satāṃ padārÂtho
vyabhicarati' iti| tasyā vyavacchedyābhāvādapārthakamidaṃ viśeṣaṇamÂ?
naitadasti; viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādeva viśiṣṭaiva satā
viśeṣaṇatvenopātā, na satāmātramiti pratīyate| sā
punarviśiṣṭasatā sappratisataiva| asti ca tasyā vyabhicāra iti prasajyata
eva viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ sampratisatā
viśeṣaṇatvenopātā? tasyāmeva pratyayo yathā syātÂ
bhūtabhaviṣyatsatāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamÂ| tena gāvo'syāsanÂ,
gāvo'sya bhavitāra ityatar na bhavati| nanu ca gomānāsīta,
gomānÂ bhaviteti bhūtabhaviṣyatsatāya#a#ṃ matupaṃ vidhāya kathaṃ
prayujyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, dhātusambandhe'yathākāloktānāmapi
pratyayānāṃ sādhutvavidhānādevaṃ prayujyace; na bhūtabhaviṣyatsatāyāṃ
pratyayavidhānātÂ| ṭhastyarthopādhikaṃ cedbhavatītyarthaḥ' iti|
vartmānasatāviśiṣṭaṃ yadi tatra bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṭhgomānÂ' iti|
ṭhugidacāmÂ' (7.1.70) iti numÂ| halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau|
ṭhatvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrdhaḥ| ṭhvṛkṣa vānÂ' iti
ṭhmādupadhāyāśca' (8.2.9) ityādinā vatvamÂ|
ṭhviṣayaniyamaḥ' iti| viṣaye pratyayasya bhāvo viṣayaniyamaḥ| 
sa punarviśiṣṭaviṣayo bhūmādiriti darśayannāha--ṭhbhūmanindā'
ityādi| bahorbhāvo bhūmā| ṭhpṛthvādibhya imanicÂ' (5.1.222)
itīmanicÂ| ṭhbahorlopo bhū ca vahoḥ' (6.4.158) iti bhūbhāvaḥ,
ikāralopaśca| gāvo bahavo'sya santīti gomānÂ| ekasya dvayorvā
vidyamānatve'pi gomāniti na vyapadiśyate|
nindāyāṃ-kakudāvartīti| niṣphalatvānninditaḥ| praśaṃsāyāmÂ--praśastaṃ
rūpaṃ yasyāsti rahūpavānityucyate| nityayoge-kṣīrameṣāmastīti
kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ| nityaḥ kṣīrasambandho yeṣāṃ ta ucyante| ṭhatiśāyane
udariṇī kanyā' iti| yasyā atiśayenodaramasti saivamucyate|
ṭhsaṃsarge daṇḍī' iti| daṇḍasaṃsarga ucyate| teneha gṛhasthite
vidyamāne'pi daṇḍe daṇḍīti nābhidhīyate||

95. rasādibhyaśca| (5.2.95)
ṭhanyanivṛtyarthamÂ' iti| anyasyeniprabhṛtermatvarthīyasya nivṛtirarthaḥ
prayojanaṃ yasya tatathoktamÂ| ṭhkathamÂ' ityādi| rasādibhyaḥ
punarvacanamanyanivṛtyarthamÂ| tato rūpiṇī kanyetyādi na
sidhyatīti bhāvaṛḥ| ṭhprāyikamÂ' ityādi|
anyanivṛterbāhulyenārthaḥ--so'syāstīti prāyikameva yuktaṃ
bhavatīti| 
bāhulyenāsyānyanivṛtitvena rūpaṇītyādau kvacidanyo'pi
bhavatīti kathaṃ punarasya prāyikatvaṃ labhyate? ityāha--ṭhitikaraṇaḥ'
ityādi| itikaraṇaśceha vivakṣārtho'nuvarte| tena yatadra tu
matubantādeva lokasya vivakṣā bhavati, tatra tenānyanivṛtiḥ kriyate;
na sarvatra| 
ṭhatha vā' ityādi| parihārāntaramÂ| ādiśabdena
cakṣurādīndriyaparigrahaḥ| guṇāditi gaṇe paṭhaḷte| ca guṇagrahaṇaṃ
sarveṣāmeva rasādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇamÂ| tena ye rasanādīndriyagrāhyāḥ|
ṭhteṣāmevāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ' iti| guṇavacanāntebhyo
rasanādīndriyagrāhyaebhyo'nyanivṛtiranena kriyate, nānyebhya-|
syādetat--rūpiṇītyādāvapīndriyagrahyā ye guṇāstebhyo matvarthīya
utpannaḥ? ityāha--ṭhrūpiṇo, rūpikaḥṭh ityādi| rūpiṇī, rūpika ityatra
śobhāguṇo gamyate, na cakṣurgrāhyaeṇa rūpeṇa| ṭhrasiko naṭaḥ' ityatrāpi
bhāvaguṇo gamyate, na tu rasanendriyagrāhyaeṇa guṇena| bhāvāḥ
śṛṅgāravīrabībhatsādayo racanādharmāḥ|
ṭhekācaḥ' iti| ekākṣarāditi| eko'jÂ yasya tasmānmatubeva
bhavatīti--dhīmānÂ, svavāniti||

96. prāṇisthādato lajanyatarasyāmÂ| (5.2.96)
ṭhkaṇikālaḥ' iti| kaṇikādiśabdo'yaṃ prāṇyaṅgasya vācakaḥ,
nālaṅkāraviśeṣasya| 
prāṇyaṅgādeva hīṣyate, ata āha--ṭhprāṇyaṅgāditi vaktavyamÂ' iti|
prāṇyaṅgatvādevākārāntallajbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānamÂ--itikaraṇo
vivakṣārtho'nuvartate| tena prāṇyaṅgadeva bhaviṣyatīti,
nānyasmātÂ| anabhidhānādvā'prāṇyaṅgānna bhaviṣyatīti| 
nanu caikāco lacaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodātatvaṃ siddhamÂ, tatkimarthaṃ
cakāraḥ? ityāha--ṭhpratyayasvareṇaiva' ityādi| cūḍālaśabdātÂ
prathamaikavacanāntātÂ parato'siśabde vyavasthite tasya ṭhtiṅṅtiṅḥ'
(8.1.28) iti nighātaḥ, soḥ ṭhsasajuṣo ruḥ' 
(8.2.66) iti rutvamÂ, ṭhato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113)
ityutvamÂ,ṭhādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), tasya ca ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ'
(8.2.5) ityudātatvamÂ, ṭheṅḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) iti
pararūpamekādeśaḥ| asati tu vakāre ṭhsvarito vānudāte'padādau'
(8.2.6) iti svaritaḥ syātÂ| atastadbādhanārtha cakāraḥ kriyate|| 

97. sidhmādibhyaśca| (5.2.97)
yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena lajvikalpeta, tena pakṣe yathāprāptameva
syādityakārāntātÂ sidhmāderiniṭhanau syātāmÂ| ata imaṃ doṣaṃ
parihartumāha--ṭhanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena' ityādi|
anekārthatvānnipātānāmanyatarasyāmiha samuccate vartate| tathā ca
vārtikakāreṇoktamÂ--ṭhanyatarasyāmiti samuccayaḥ' iti| matubiha
svaritatvātÂ sannihita iti sa eva samuccīyate, na tu yathāprāptaṃ
pratyayāntaramityeke| anye tvāhuḥ---ṭhanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ
vikalpārthameva| na ceniṭhanāvubhau kriyete; tayormahāvibhāṣayaiva
siddhatvātÂ| tarhi pratyayāntaraṃ pakṣe vidhīyate? tadapi na;
yathāprāptamāpādayituṃ sannihitapratyāsateḥ matubeva|
tadevamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe sati matubeva vikalpyata
ityabhiprāyeṇānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena samuccīyata ityuktamÂ' iti| 
ṭhna tu pratyayo vikalpyate' iti| nanu ca laco bhāvābhāvau kriyete
ityarthaḥ| ṭhtasmātÂ' ityādi| yata evamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena matupÂ
samuccīyate, na tu pratyayo vikalpyate, tasmādye'trākārāntāḥ
paṭhaḷnte tebhya iniṭhanau na bhavataḥ| 
ṭhpārṣṇiśramanyordīrghaśca' iti| pārṣṇi, dhamani iti śabdābhyāṃ
lajbhavati, tayośca dīrghaḥ--pārṣṇīlaḥ, dhamanīlaḥ|
ṭhvātadantabalalalāṭānāmūṅ ca' iti| vātādīnāṃ, tasya ca laca
ūṅgagamaḥ| vātūlaḥ| dantūlaḥ| balūlaḥ| lalāṭūalaḥ| ṭhjaṭāghaṭākalāḥ
kṣepe' gamyamāne| jaṭālaḥ, ghaṭālaḥ, kalālaḥ| kṣepa iti kimÂ?
jaṭāvānÂ| ṭhkṣudrajantūpatāpācca' iti| kṣudrajantūpatāpācca' iti|
kṣudrajantuḥunakulādiḥ| upatāpaḥurogaḥ||

98. vatsāṃsābhyāṃ kāmabale| 
ṭhkāmavati balavati cārthe' iti| matvantayornirdeaśena
kāmabaśabdāvarśaādyakārāntāvupātāviti darśayati| 
nanu ca vatsāṃsaśabdau naiva kāmabalayorvartete, kiṃ tarhi?
vayoviśeṣe prāṇyaṅgaviśeṣe ca, tatkathaṃ tābhyāṃ kāmavānÂ
balavāṃścocyate? ityāha--ṭhvṛtiviṣaye' ityādi| kathametajjñāyate?
ityāha--ṭhna hyatra' ityādi| vatsaśabdasya vākye yo
vayoviśeṣalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ prasiddhaḥ, aṃsaśabdasya ca yaḥ
prāṇyaṅgalakṣaṇaviṣayaḥ sa yasmādatra vṛtau na vidyate na jñāyata ityarthaḥ|
atha vā--na vidyata iti nāstītyarthaḥ| anena vākye yau tayorathā
prasiddhau vayaḥprāṇyaṅgaviśeṣātmakau, tayorvṛtāvabhāvo darśitaḥ|
idānīṃ yau tayorabhimatāvartho tayorbhāvaṃ darśayitumāha--ṭhvatsalaḥ'
ityādi| ṭhsnehavānÂ' iti| kāmavānityarthaḥ| tadevaṃ
yasmādvatsāṃsaśabdayorvākye vayaḥprāṇyaṅgalakṣaṇo'rtho na vidyate,
tataścavatsalāṃsalaśabdābhyāṃ yathoktaḥ snehavānÂ balavāṃścocyate,
tato jñāyate--vatsāṃsaśabdau vṛtiviṣaye kāmabalayorvartamānau
tadvati pratyayamutpādayata iti| 
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ sarvatra cātra prakaraṇe matupsamuccayārthe vartate|
tato matupā bhavitavyamiti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha---ṭhna cāyamÂ'
ityādi| anenaiva ca hetunā vākyamapi na bhavatīti veditavyamÂ|
vkāye hi naivāyamarthaḥ sambhavati

100. lomādipāmādipicchādibhyaḥ śanelacaḥ| (5.2.100)
pāmādiṣu ṭhaṅgātÂ' iti paṭhaḷte, tatra
kalyāṇagrahaṇamaṅgaviśeṣaṇamÂ| kalyāṇāni śobhanānyaṅgānyasyāḥ
santītyaṅganā| kalyāma iti kimÂ? aṅgavatī| ṭhśīkīpalālīdadravāṃ
hrasvatvañca' iti| śākyādīnāñca pratyayo bhavati hrasvatvañca---śākinaḥ,
palālinaḥ dadruṇaḥ| mahacchākaṃ śākī, mahāpalālaṃ palālauti
kecitÂ| nānājātīyānāṃ śākānāṃ samāhāraḥ śākī, palālānāṃ
samāhāraḥ palālīti| ṭhviṣvakÂ' ityādi| viṣvakśabdānna pratyayo
bhavati, utarapadalopaśca| sa cākṛtasandheḥ akṛtayaṇādeśasya|
viṣvañcatīti viṣuśabda upapade'ñcate; ṭhṛtvikÂ' (3.2.59) ityādinā

yasya sanÂtīti na pratyayaḥ, akṛtayaṇādeśasyotarapadalopaḥ--viṣuṇa
iti bhavati| viṣuṇaśabdo'yaṃ nipātyate| nānārthe vartate| ṭhlakṣmyā
acca' iti| lakṣmāśabdānnapratyo bhavati, akāraścāntādeśaḥ
lakṣmīrasyāstīti lakṣmaṇaḥ| ṭhjaṭā ghaṭa' ityādi| jaṭādibhyaḥ kṣepe

102. tapaḥ sahasrābhyāṃ vinīnī| (5.2.102)

(2.2.33) iti pūrvanipāte balaśabdasyāpi ṭhladhvakṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ nipatati'
(vā. 108) ityasminÂ prāpte yo'yaṃ paranipātaḥ sa
lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayanniha matupprakāraṇe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ lakṣaṇasya
vyabhicārayati| tena pratyayarthayoḥ sarvatra matupprakaraṇe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na
bhavati| prakaraṇa ityetatÂ kutaḥ?
prakaraṇāpekṣatvāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnasya| etadapi kutaḥ?
vyākhyānātÂ| dvayorlakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnayorupādānādvā

iti| tapaḥśabdādasantatvātÂ ṭhasmāyāmeṣāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121)

vakṣyamāṇenāṇā bādhā mā bhūdityevamarthamÂ| ṭhsahasrātu' ityādi| ṭhata
iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) iti ṭhannapi prāpnoti, so'pi bādhyate| etana

110. gāṇḍaḷjagātsaṃjñāyāmÂ| (5.2.110)
ṭhhrasvādapi bhavati' iti| kathaṃ punardīrghasya grahaṇe hrasvādapi bhavatīti?
ṭhtatra tulyā hi' hatyādi| yādṛśī dīrghasyeha saṃhitā hrasvagrahaṇe'pi
tādṛśyeva dṛśyate| tasmātÂ hrasvasyāpi grahaṇamiha na virudhyata iti
bhāvaḥ| tatra caitatÂ syātÂ--yadyapi tulyā saṃhitā, tathāpi
kṛtayaṇādeśo'yameka eva śabdaḥ, tasya svarūpa ityanyatarasya
parigrahaṇena bhavitavyamÂ| tatra yadi dīrghatya grahaṇaṃ hrasvānna
prāpnoti, atha hrasvasya grahaṇaṃ dīrghanna prāpnotītyata āha--ṭhubhayathā'
iti| ubhayaprakāraṃ hyācāryeṇa praṇītaṃ sūtramÂ| tasmādubhayorapi
grahaṇamityadoṣaḥ| 
atha saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kimÂ, yāvatetikaraṇasya cānuvṛterasaṃjñāyāṃ na
bhaviṣyati, yathā dyaudrabhyāṃ mapratyayaḥ? evaṃ tarhi tasyaivetikaraṇasya
prapañcaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇamiti draṣṭavyamÂ||

115. ata iniṭhanau| (5.2.115)
ata ityakārastaparo gṛhyate| ata evāha--ṭhakārāntātÂ' ityādi|

hi rasādibhyo matupo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syātÂ| sa

116. vrīhyādibhyaśca| (5.2.116)
ṭhśikhādibhyaḥ' ityādi| ubhayatrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| śiṣṭaprayoge yebhya
inireva dṛśyate, te śikhādayo draṣṭavyāḥ, te hi tebhyaṣṭhanaṃ
vihitavantaḥ| eṣa tu viṣayavibhāga itikaraṇānuvṛtereva gṛhyate|
ṭhvācya' iti| asya tu vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| ṭhyavakhadādiṣu' iti
viṣayasaptamī| 
ṭhevaṃ tarhi' ityādi| tundādiṣu vrīhiśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇe satīha
tasya grahaṇamanarthakaṃ jñāyata iti sāmardhyātÂ tatra
vrīhigrahaṇenārthagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| arthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati
taddarśayitumāha--ṭhśālayo'sya santi śālikaḥ' ityādi| 
ṭhśīrṣānnañaḥ' iti| naña utaralasya śīrṣannityetasya pratyayo bhavati|
nipātanāccchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ---aśīrṣī, aśīrṣikaḥ| anye tu śīrṣanniti
śabdāntaraṃ paṭhanti| tasya tu pāṭho bhāṣāyāmapi yathā
syādityevamarthaḥ| anyathā ṭhśīrṣaṃścchandasi' (6.1.60) iti vidhānātÂ
bhāṣāyāmÂ aśīrṣikaḥ, aśīrṣavāniti na syātÂ||

118. ekagopūrvāṭṭhañÂ nityamÂ| (5.2.118)
matubādiṣu prāpteṣu ṭhañvidhīyate| sa ca
samānādhikaraṇatatpuruṣādekapūrvādbhavati, na tu sarvata
ekapūrvātÂ| etaccetikaraṇātuvṛterlabhyate| ekañca taccchataṃ
caikaśatamÂ, tadasyāstīti aikaśatikaḥ| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe--ekaśatavānÂ|
ṭhkathamÂ' ityādi| yadi ṭhataḥ' (5.2.115) ityetadanuvartate,
gośakaṭīśabdānna sidhyati, tasyānakārāntatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ṭhtato
bhaviṣyati' iti| tadantādbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ|
eṣo'rthaḥ--ekagopūrvādadantātÂ| prātipadikāṭṭhañÂ vidhīyata iti
sāmarthyāllabhyate| atha vā--tato hetorbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| ṭhavaśyaṃ
ca' ityādiḥ asatyāṃ hyata ityanuvṛtau dvandvopatāpagarhyādiṣu (5.2.128;
5.2.115) yogeṣu citrakalalāṭikādiśabdebhyo'pi pratyayaḥ syātÂ| 
ṭhnityagrahaṇamÂ' ityādi| asati hi nityagarahaṇe'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ
matupsamuccayārthaṃ sarvatrānuvartata iti matubati syātÂ|
tasmādabādhanārthaṃ nityagrahaṇamÂ| ṭhkathamekadravyavatvātÂ' iti| yadi
nityagrahaṇaṃ matubbādhanārthamÂ, evamÂ, na hyaeka
dravyavatvādityatraikapūrvāddravyaśabdānmatupÂ sidhyatīti manyate|
ṭhekena' ityādi| ekaśabdasya dravyavatvādityanena ṭhsupsupā' (2.1.4) iti
samāsaṃ kṛtvā sādhutvamasya pratipādanīyamityarthaḥ|| 

119. śatasahasrāntācca niṣkātÂ| (5.2.119)

120. rūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoryapÂ| (5.2.121)
ṭhtadāhatamucyate' iti| āhatamÂuāhananamÂ, tāḍanamityarthaḥ| ato
niṣpannaṃ puruṣādirūpamÂ, tadapi kāryai
kāraṇopacārādāhatamityucyate| 
ṭhyapprakāraṇe' iti| yapprakaraṇe'nyebhyo'pi dṛśyata iti vaktavyamiti|
anenāsya tu tulyatvātÂ tadvadeva vyākhyānaṃ kartavyamÂ|
cakārastviha ṭhśatasahasrāntācca niṣkātÂ' (5.2.119)
ityato'nuvartate|| 

121. asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ| (5.2.121)
ṭhyaśasvī'| ṭhtapasvī'| ṭhpayasvī'| ṭhtasau matvarthe' (1.4.19) iti bhatvamÂ,
ato bhatvājjaśatvaṃ na bhavati| jaśtvena sakārasya dakāraḥ prāpnoti,
sa na bhavati|| 

122. bahulaṃ cchandasi| (5.2.122)
ṭhdvayobhayahṛdayāni' ityādi| avadhāraṇamiha draṣṭavyamÂ| dvayādīnyeva
dīrghatvaṃ prayojayanti, netarāṇi; svata eva dīrghatvātÂ|
ṭhtadetatsarvaṃ bahulagrahaṇena sampadyate' iti| vaktavyaśapabdastu vyākhyāne
vartate ityabhiprāyaḥ|| 

123. ūrṇāyā yusa| (5.2.123)
ṭhūrṇāyuḥ' iti| padatvena bhasaṃjñābhāvādyasyeti lopo na bhavati|| 

124. vāco gminiḥ| (5.2.124)
atha minireva kasmānnocyate? jaśtve kṛte vāggmīti sidhyati;
nanu ca ṭhyaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) ityanunāsikaḥ
prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyavasthitavibhāṣāṃ vijñāsyate| evaṃ tarhi
gakāramadhikaṃ kurvannetatÂ sūcavati--gminirayamiti| 
yaḥ samyagbahu bhāvate tatrāpi vakṣyamāṇāvālajāṭacau bādhitvā
gminireva bhavati| evaṃ hyaṣikaṃ bhavati yadyapavādaviṣaye'pi
kvacidbhavati, nānyā| evañcā lajāṭacau kutsitaṃ yo bahu bhāvate
tatraiva pāriśeṣyādbhavata iti veditavyamÂ|| 

125. ālajāṭacau bahubhāṣiṇi| (5.2.125)
ṭhkutsite' iti| vaktavyaśabdastu vyākhyāne vartata ityabhiprāyaḥ|
ṭhvaktavyamÂ' iti| kutsitaṃ yo bahubhāṣate tatrālajāṭacau bhavata
ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ pūrvasūtra eva kṛtamÂ||

126. svāminnaiśvarye| (5.2.126)
ṭhekācaḥ' iti rasādiṣu (5.2.95) pāṭhānmatupi prāpta idamārabhyate|
ṭhaiśvaryavācinaḥ iti| dhanavacano'yaṃ svaśabda aiśvaryavācī| tathā
ca-dhanayogādaiśvaryaṃ taducyate|
ṭhsvavānÂ' iti| ātmādāvarthāntare svaśabdo vartate|| 

127. arśaādibhyo'cÂ| (5.2.127)
yathāsambhavaṃ matubādiṣvajvidhīyate| ṭhākṛtigaṇaścāyamÂ' iti|
avṛtkṛtatvātÂ| ādiśabdaścāyaṃ prakāre| ṭhsvāṅgāddhīnātÂ' iti|
hīnasvāṅgavṛteḥ prātipadikādajbhavati--khañjaḥ pādo'stīti
śuklamÂ| nanu ca śuklaśabdo guṇavacanaḥ,
tatrābhedopacāreṇāpyetatÂ sidhyati? evaṃ tarhi dravyavṛterapi
varṇavācinaḥ prātipadikādyathā syādityevamarthaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamÂ|
śuklaguṇayuktāḥ prāsādāḥ śuklāḥ, te'sminÂ santi śuklaṃ nagaramÂ|
pratyayasvareṇaivāntodātatve siddhe cakāro'rśo'syāstīti ṭhsvarito
vānudāte'padādau' (8.2.6) iti svaritabādhanārthaḥ||

128. dvandvopatāpagarhyātprāṇisthādiniḥ| (5.2.128)
ṭhtadviṣayebyaḥ' iti| taccchabdenopatāpagarhāveva parāmṛśyete| te
upatāpagarhe viṣayo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| prāṇisthavācināṃ
sarveṣāmeva dvandvādīnāmivaṃ viśeṣaṇamÂ| 
ṭhprāṇyaṅgānneṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi na bhavati?
cakārānuvṛteḥ| ṭhsiddhe pratyaye' iti| ṭhata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115)
ityanenaiva| ṭhṭhanādibādhanārthamÂ' iti| inireva yatā syātÂ,
ṭhanādirmā bhūdityevamarthaṃ punarvacanamÂ| ādiśabdena matubÂ
gṛhyate| ita utare yogā niyamārthā veditavyāḥ||

129. vātātisārābhyāṃ kukÂ ca| (5.2.129)
ṭhvātātisārābhyāmÂ' iti| yadyapi pañcamī,
tathāpyarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavati| āgamasambandhe ṣaṣṭhībhāvena
vipariṇamyate| ata evāha--ṭhtasyanniyogena ca tayoḥ kugāgamaḥ' iti|
atha pratyayasyaivāgamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? kugāgamavatā
pratyayenārthaṃsyānabhidhānātÂ| svarūpaṃ na sidhyatīti ca|
ṭhpiśācācceti vaktavyamÂ' iti| piśācaśabdādinipratyayo
bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ
vyākhyānamÂ--ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' (5.2.122) ityato
bahulagrahaṇamanuvartate, tena piśācaśabdādapi bhaviṣyati||

130. vayasi pūraṇātÂ| (5.2.130)
ṭhvayasi dyotye' iti| kathaṃ punarvayo dyotyate, yadi pañcamādayaḥ
śabdāḥ kāle vartamānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti| ata eva teṣāṃ kāle
vṛtiṃ darśayitumāha--ṭhpañcamo māso'syāsti' iti| ṭhsiddhe sati'
ityādi| pūraṇapratyayānāmakārantatvādiniḥ siddha eva, tasminÂ siddhe
punarivaṃ vacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ jñāyata iti| ṭhinireva bhavati' iti|
niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati|| 

131. sukhādibhyaśca| (5.2.131)
ṭhinipratyayo niyamyate' iti| pūrvavanniyamo veditavyaḥ| 
ṭhtadiha' ityādi| yato vrīhyadiṣu mālāśabdaḥ paṭhaḷte, tasmādyadiha
kṣepe mālāśabdasya punarvacanaṃ tanmatupo bādhanārthamÂ, na tu ṭhanaḥ|
sukhādibhya iti nocyata iti; anenaiva nivartitatvātÂ| mālāśabdo
hi śikhādiṣu, tatrāntarbhāvinaḥ kṣepādanyatrenirbhavatyeva|
śikhāditvānmatupÂ ca; matupastasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena
samuccitatvātÂ--mālī, mālāvāniti||

132. dharmaśīlavarṇāntācca| (5.2.132)

133. hastājjātau| (5.2.133)

134. varṇādrabrahmacāriṇi| (5.2.134)
ṭhsamudāyena cedbrahmacārī bhaṣyate' iti| etena samudāyopādhitvaṃ
brahmacāriṇo darśayati| vidyāgrahaṇārtha yadopanīyate tataḥ sevitavyo
yo niyamaviśeṣastadbrahmā, taccarati brahmacārī, āvaśyake ṇiniḥ| tatra
niyamaviśeṣacaraṇe brāhmaṇādīnāmeva trayāṇāṃ varṇānāmadhikāraḥ, na
śūdrasyetyāha--ṭhbrahmacārīti traivarṇiko'bhipretaḥ' iti| triṣu varṇeṣu
bhavaḥ, tatrāntarbhūtatvātÂ traivaṇikaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sa evābhipreta
ityāha--ṭhsa hi' ityādi||

135. puṣkarādibhyo deśe| (5.2.135)
iha kasmānna bhavati--puṣkarāṇi padmānyasminÂ deśe santīti?
itikaraṇānuvṛteḥ|
ṭharthāccāsannihite' iti| asannihitagrahaṇe tasya cāstitvena virodhaḥ|
yadi hyasannihito'rthaḥ, na nāma vidyate; yadi vidyate, kathamasannihitaḥ?
tasmādviśeṣaṇopādānādastotyetadviśeṣaṇamutsṛjyāsannidhānopādhikādarthātÂ pratyayo vidhīyate| abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyācca| ṭharthī' iti| abhilāṣavānevocyate| na sarvo'sannihito'rthaḥ pratyayāntena tadvimarśādasannihitavānÂ, ataḥ pratyayo vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ, kathaṃ punaranucyamāno labhyate? ṭhbahulaṃ cchandasi' (5.2.122) ityato bahulagrahaṇena yathā ṭhaṣṭrāmekhalādvayobhayarajāhṛdayādīnāṃ dīrghaśca' (bā. 586) ityevamādikaṃ kāryaṃ sampādyate, tathedamapi| 
ṭhtadantācca' ityādi| asannihitamityanuvartate,
asannihitopādhikādarthādinipratyayo bhavatītyetadarthaṃrūpaṃ
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtaprāyamÂ|

136. balapādibhyo matubanyatarasyāmÂ| (5.2.136)
ṭhyadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pratyayo vikalpyate--balādibhyo
matubvikalpo bhavatīti, tato matupā mukte yathāprāptaminiṭhanāvapi
syātāmÂ, inireva ceṣyate, sa kathaminireva labhyate,
yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇeneniḥ samuccīyate, na matubiti vikalpena?
ityevaṃ cetasi kṛtvāha--ṭhanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena' ityādi| nanu
yadīniṭanau dvāvapi syātāmÂ, sūtrārambho'narthakaḥ syātÂ,
vinā'pyanena pratyayasya siddhatvātÂ, tasmānmatupo'pi
vikalpasyānena doṣaḥ? naitadasta; ārambhasāmarthyādiniṭhanoranyataro
bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyate, na tvinireva|
tasmādinisamuccayārthamevānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamÂ|| 

137. saṃjñāyāṃ manmābhyāmÂ| (5.2.137)
ṭhprathiminī, dāminī' iti| prathiminÂ, dāminÂ--ityetābhyāminiḥ,
ṭhnastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ, ṭhṛnnebhyo ḍīpÂ' (4.1.5) iti
ṅīpÂ| atrāpi saṃjñāgrahaṇamitikaraṇasyaiva prapañcaḥ||

138. kaṃśaṃbhyāṃ babhayustitutayasaḥ| (5.2.138)
ṭhudakasukhayorvācako' iti| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kamityudayakasya vācakaḥ,
śamiti sukhasya| ṭhśaṃyuḥ' iti| ṭhmo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.33), tasya ṭhvā
padāntasya' (8.4.59) iti parasavarṇaḥ, masyānunāsiko yakāraḥ| 
tenānusvāraparasavarṇau siddhau bhavataḥ' iti| tayoḥ padādhikāre
vidhānātÂ| yadi punaḥ padasaṃjñā na syātÂ, tatastasyāmasatyāṃ
padanibandhanayoranusvāraparasavarṇayorabhāvātÂ--kamyuḥ,
śamyurityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sampadyate|| 

139. tundibalivaṭerbhaḥ| (5.2.139)
tundiśabdātÂ tundādiṣu ṭhsvāṅgādvivṛddhau' (5.2.117) iti
pāṭhādilacīniṭhanormatupi prāpte, baleḥ pāmādipāṭhānne matupi,
vaṭermatupyeva bo vidhīyate|| 

140. ahaṃśubhamoryusÂ| (5.2.140)
ṭhahamiti śabdāntaramÂ' iti| asmadaḥ ṭhtvāhau sau' (7.2.94) iti,
tyadādyatve ca kṛte yaccchabdarūpaṃ sampadyate, tasmādanya evāhamavyutpannaḥ
śabdaḥ, na tu tadityevaṃ śabdānyatvaṃ darśayitvā'rthāntaraṃ
darśayitumāha--ṭhahaṅkāre vartate' iti| ṭhahaṃyuḥ, śubhaṃyuḥ' iti|
pūrvavadanusvāraparasavarṇau||

1. prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ| (5.3.1)
ṭhvibhaktisaṃjñāste vedivyāḥ' iti| vibhaktirityeṣa śabdaḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ
te tathoktāḥ| nanu ca vibhaktiśabdaḥ suptiṅaṃ saṃjñā, saṃjñā ca
pradeśavākyeṣūccāritā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayatīti suptiṅaṃ
vibhaktisaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syātÂ| yathā vṛddhiśabdaḥ svābhidheye
laukike'rthe guṇībhūto'pyādaicÂ prati saṃjñātvamanubhavati, tathā
vibhaktiśabdo'pi tasilādīnÂ prati saṃjñātvena veditavyaḥ| atha
tatraiva kasmānnocyate--ṭhsupo vibhaktiśca prāgdiśaśca' iti, evaṃ sati
punarvibhaktigrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ na bhavati? naivaṃ śakyamÂ; evaṃ hi nyāse
sati ṭhkuta ārabya prāgdiśīyāḥ? iti na jñāyate| kiñca ṭhdigādibhyo
yatÂ' (4.3.54), ṭhtenaikadikÂ' (4.3.112) iti cānekaṃ śāstre
diggrahaṇamityavadhirapi sandihyaeta| ṭhkiṃsarvanāmabahubhyaḥ' (5.3.2)
ityevamādeśca kārahyasyāvadhidarśanārthaṃ punariha ṭhprāgdiśaḥ' iti
vācyameva syātÂ| tasmādyathānyāsameva sādha| ṭhtataḥ, yataḥ' iti| ṭhaṣṭana
ā vibhaktau' (7.2.84) ityanuvartamāne ṭhtyadādīnāmaḥ' (7.2.102)
ityatvamÂ, ṭhna vibhaktau tusmāḥ' (1.3.4) iti
sakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣeṣaḥ, ṭhtaddhita ścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38)
ityavyayatvādvibhakta#erlukÂ| ṭhkutaḥ' iti| ṭhki tihoḥ' (7.2.104) iti
kimaḥ kubhāvaḥ| 
ṭhtyadādividhayaḥ' iti| tyadādayo'tra dibhaktinibandhanāḥ| ṭhtataḥ' iti|
tyadādividheratvasyodāharaṇamÂ| ṭhiha iti| idamo vibhaktisvarasya|
idamaḥ saptamyantātÂ ṭhidamo haḥ' (5.3.11) iti hapratyayaḥ, ṭhidama iśÂ'
(5.3.3) itīśādeśaḥ| ṭhūḍidampadādyappumraidyaubhyaḥ' (6.1.171) iti idamaḥ
parasyodātatvaṃ vibhaktitve sati siddhaṃ bhavati| atra tu
pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhamādyaudātatvamÂ| tasmāccodāharaṇadigiyaṃ
pradarśita| idaṃ tvatrodāhāraṇaṃ yuktamÂ--ṭhitaḥ' iti| ivamastasilÂ,
pūrvavadiśÂ| ataTa hyasati vibhaktitve liti pratyayātÂ
pūrvapadādyaudātatvaṃ [ṭhpūrvamādyaudātatvaṃ'-mudritapāṭhaḥ
(vārāṇasī-1967)ṭ syātÂ| tasmistu ṭhūḍidamÂ' (6.1.171)
ityādinedamaḥ parasya tasa ādyaudātatvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu ca satyapi
vibhaktitve paratvāllitsvareṇa bhavitavyamÂ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhliti'
(6.1.193) ityatra hi ṭhūjidamÂ' (6.1.171) ityādikaṃ sūtramanuvartiṣyate
litsvarabādhanārthamÂ| nanvevamapi naiva vibhakterudātatvaṃ sidhyati?
tatra hi ṭhsāvekācastṛtīyādivibhaktiḥ' (6.1.168)
ityatastṛtīyādigrahaṇamanuvartate, na ca
tasilādayastṛtīyādigarahaṇena gṛhyante| tṛtīyaikavacanamāranya ā
pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteryāvānÂ pratyayo vibhaktisaṃjñaḥ sarvo'sau
tṛtīyādiḥ| 
ṭhataḥ paramÂ' ityādi| sāmarthyaṃ hi nāma sambandhārthatā; sā ca
pratiyoginamapekṣata eva yana sahaikārthībhāvo bhavati tasminÂ
pratiyogini sati, nānyathā| prāthamyamapi pratiyogyapekṣameva|
dvitīyaṃ hi pratiyoginamapebhya prathamamityucyate| ita utaraṃ pratyayāḥ
prakṛtyartha eva bhavantīti, na tadviṣau dvitīyasya pratiyoginaḥ sambhavaḥ;
tadabhāvātÂ sāmarthyaprāthamyayorapi nāstyeva sambhavaḥ; tayoḥ
pratiyogyapekṣatvātÂ| yataścaitadevamÂ, tataḥ ṭhsāmarthyādhikāraḥ
prathamagrahaṇañca nopayujyate' iti dvayamapi nivṛttmÂ| yadyevamÂ;
vāvacanasyāpi nivṛtiḥ prāpnoti, ekayoganirdiṣṭatvātÂ?
ityāha--ṭhvāvacanaṃ tu vartata eva' iti| tasya svaritatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
ṭhtena vikalpena' ityādi| tenotarasūtre vāgrahaṇānuvṛteḥ phalaṃ
darśayati|| 

2. kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyo'dvyādibhyaḥ| (5.3.2)
ṭhkutra' iti| ṭhsaptamyāstralÂ' (5.3.10), pūrvavatÂ kubhāvaḥ|
ṭhprakṛtiparisaṃkhyānamÂ' iti| prakṛtiparigaṇanamÂ|
ṭhvaiyākaraṇapāśaḥ' iti| ṭhyāpye pāśapÂ' (5.3.47)| ayaṃ cāvadheḥ paro
vya ityanyābhyo'pi prakṛtibhyo bhavati| ṭhsarvanāmatvādeva siddhe' iti|
sarvanāmatvaṃ kimaḥ sarvādiṣu pāṭhātÂ| ṭhkimo grahaṇamÂ' ityādi|
kiṃśabdo'yaṃ dvyādiṣu paṭhaḷta iti tasya ṭhdvyādibhyaḥ' iti
paryudāsaḥ kriyate| tasmātÂ sarvanāmno'pi svaśabdenopādānamÂ|
yadyevaṃ dviśabdātÂ pūrvaṃ kiṃśabdaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, evaṃ hi tasya
pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na kartavyameva bhavati? satyametatÂ; na sūtrakārasyeha
gaṇapāṭha iti nāsāvupālambhamarhati| api ca tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparaṃ
tataccchiṣyata iti kimaḥ sarvaireva tyadādibhiḥ saha vivakṣāyāṃ śeya
iṣyate--ṭhtvañca kaśca' kau, bhavāṃśca kaśca kau; sa caivaṃ pāṭhe na
sidhyatīti yathānyāsamevāstu| 
ṭhbahugrahaṇe saṃkhyāgrahaṇamÂ' iti| kathamiha sarvanāmasaṃjñayā sarvādayaḥ
saṃjñino nirdiśyante? tasmātÂ taiḥ saha nideśādbahuśabdasyāpi
bahugaṇādi (1.1.23) sūtreṇa yasya saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā tasyaiva
saṃjñitā tasyaiva saṃjñino grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| ṭhbahoḥ sūpātÂ' iti|
atra vaipulyavācī bahuśabdaḥ|| 

3. idama iśÂ| (5.3.3)
ṭhśakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ' iti| asakati hi tasminÂ ṭhalo'ntyasya'
(1.1.52) syātÂ| tataścedrūpasya hali lope (7.2.113) kṛte,
ṭhādguṇe' (6.1.87) caitaḥ, ehetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syātÂ| nanu
cedamastyadādyatve (7.2.102) kṛte'to guṇe (6.1.97) pararūpatve

tebhyo'pi bhavati| 
iha tisro vibhaktayaḥ, trayaścārthā digādayaḥ, tatra sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyena

evañcāyaṃ bahulavibhaktyantātÂ pratyayaḥ kṛto bhavati, yadi
digvṛterapi saptamīpañcamīprathamāntādeva bhavati--deśavṛterapi,

ṭhprāgaseḥ' iti| ṭhasi puradhavaścaiṣāmÂ' (5.3.39) iti vakṣyamāṇaḥ|
keciddikśabdamātrātÂ pratyayaṃ manyanta iti teṣāṃ matena pūrveṇa
vasatītyādyapi bhavati| yadi dikśabdamātrātÂ pratyo
bhavatītyañcātyantādapi syātÂ? bhavatu, ṭhañcerlukÂ' (5.3.30) iti
lumbhaviṣyati? naitadasti; ṭhmadhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānÂ vidhīnÂ
bādhante' (vyā. pa. 10) ityastāterevātrānena lukÂ, nānyasya| evaṃ
tarhyanyatarasyāmiti vyavasthitavibhāṣeyamÂ| tenāñcatyantānna
bhaviṣyati| 
pakāraḥ ṭhenapā dvitīyā' (2.3.31) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, svarārthaśca|| 

36. dakṣiṇādācÂ| (5.3.36)

svarārthastu cakāro nopapadyate; pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhatvātÂ|| 

37. āhi ca dūre| (5.3.37)

38. utarācca| (5.3.38)

nana; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa hi vyavahitamapyācaṃ samuccinoti|
tenā''japi bhaviṣyatīti|| 

39. pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣāmÂ| (5.3.39)

ṣaṣṭhaḷrthabhedaḥ? satyametatÂ; tathāpi

40. astāti ca| (5.3.40)

41. vibhāṣā'varasya| (5.3.41)

42. saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā| (5.3.42)
ṭhprakāravacane ca jātīyarÂ' (5.3.69) iti, tasyāyamapavādaḥ|
ṭhvidhāuprakāraḥ' ityaktaḥ ṭhprakāravacane thālÂ' (5.3.23) ityatra, sa ca
dravyaguṇaviśeṣo'pyasti; tatra yadi so'pi gṛhyaeta
dravyaguṇayorliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yīgādvā ptyayāntamaliṅgamasaṃkhyaṃ ca
na syātÂ| evañca tasyāvyayatvaṃ na syātÂ, tacceṣṭamÂ; tathā
hi--dhāpratyayo'vyayeṣu paṭhaḷte--tasilādistaddhita edhācparyanta iti|
kriyāviṣaye tu tasminÂ gṛhyamāṇe na doṣaḥ; kriyāyāḥ sarvadā
liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmayogādityetatÂ cetasi kṛtvā''ha--ṭhsa ca'
ityādi| kriyādhātuvācyo vikledanādirarthaḥ, sa ca viṣayo'sya sa
tathoktaḥ. kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyoktau viśeṣasya grahaṇaṃ labhyate?
arthagrahaṇasya hyaetadeva prayojanamÂ--prakāraviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syāditi,
anyathā hi ṭhvidhāyāmÂ' ityevaṃ hi brūyātÂ| yadi tarhi prakāraḥ
kriyāviṣayo gṛhyate, navadhā dravyamÂ nadadhā guṇa ityatra na prāpnoti?
naiṣa doṣaḥ? atrāpi kriyā'vyāhartatavyā| navadhā dravyamÂ, navadhā guṇa
upapādya vigṛhyate ceti|| 

43. adhikaraṇavicāle ca| (5.3.43)

44. ekāddho dhyamuñanyatarasyāmÂ| (5.3.44)
ṭhaikadhyaṃ kuru' iti| adhikaraṇavicāla udāharaṇamÂ| aikadhyaṃ bhuṅkte'
iti| vidhārthe| 
atra dhāgrahaṇamanuvartate, na ca tatra vidhyarthā vṛtiyuktā; pūrvameva
vihitatvātÂ| tasmādanuvṛtisāmarthyātÂ sthānitvaṃ dhāpratyayasya
vijñāyata itÂyāha--ṭhprakaraṇādeva labdhe' iti| dhāpratyayasya sthānitva
iti śeṣaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati dhāgrahaṇe vidhārthe vihitasya na
bhavati? ityāha--ṭhanantarasyaiva hi' ityādi| asati hi punardhāgrahaṇe
ṭhanantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā. pa. 19)
ityadhikaraṇavicālārthe yo vihitastasyaiva syātÂ, na tu vidhārthe
yo vihitastasya| punardhāgrahaṇe tu sati dhāmātrasyādeśaḥ siddho
bhavati|| 

45. dvitryośca dhamuñ| (5.3.45)
ṭhmatidvaidhāni' iti| nanu ca svārthikāḥ prakṛtidharahmānanuvartanta iti

46. edhācca| (5.3.46)

47. yāpye pāśapÂ| (5.3.47)
yāpyaśabdo'yaṃ gamayitavye vartate--grāmāntarātÂ yāpya iti;
astyaśakyapratīkāre--yāpyo roga iti, asti
kutsite--yāpyo'yamiti, kutsita iti gamyate| pāśappratyayāntātÂ
kutsita eva pratīyata iti tadabhidhāyina eva yāpyaśabdasyevaṃ grahaṇaṃ
yuktatamÂ| ata evāha--ṭhyāpyaḥ kutsita ityucyate' iti
yāpyanteuapanīyante tasmādguṇā iti yāpyaḥ, ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo
bahulamÂ' (3.3.113) ityapādāne kṛtyaḥ| 
ṭhtatra kasmānna bhavati' iti| yadyapyasau vyākaraṇe pravīṇaḥ tathāpi
duḥśīlatvādbhavitavyameva tatretyabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhyasya' ityādi| guṇo
viśeṣaṇamÂ dravyaṃ viśeṣyamÂ, tatra dravye yadyapi bahavo guṇāḥ
santi, tathāpi yasya guṇasya bhāve dravye śabdo niviśate vartate
pratyāsatestasyaiva kutsāyāṃ śabdena bhavitavyamÂ; na tu
vaiyākaraṇasya duḥśīlatvaṃ pravṛtinimitamÂ| kiṃ tarhi? vyākaraṇasya
parijñānamÂ, adhyayanaṃ vā| na ceha duḥśīlatvena bhavitavyaṃ
pratyayena|| 

48. pūraṇādbhāge tīyādanÂ| (5.3.48)
ṭhpūraṇapratyayo yastīyaḥ' iti| ṭhtasya pūraṇe ḍaṭÂ' (5.2.48) iti
pūraṇādhikāre vihitatvātÂ, pūraṇābhidheyatvādvā| upacārema
pratyo'pi tīyaḥ pūraṇa ityucye| ṭhbhāge' iti| aṃśa ityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ
punaridamÂ, yāvatā kṛte'pyani rūpaṃ tadeva? ityāha--ṭhsvarārthaṃ
vacanamÂ'iti| vibhāge nitsvareṇādyaudātaṃ yathā syātÂ| 
ṭhpūraṇagrahaṇamutarārthamÂ' iti| utaratra pūraṇapratyayāntātpratyayo
yathā syātÂ| tasya ca vyavacchedāya kriyamāṇaṃ pūraṇamihāpyarthavatÂ
syātÂ, sa ca nāstīti nehārthatā tasyopapadyate| nanu ca
ṭhmukhapārśvataserīyaḥ', (vā. 460) ṭhpārśvatīyaḥ' ityapūraṇo'pi
so'sti? ityata āha--ṭhmukhatīyādiranarthakaḥ' iti|
arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa. 1) arthavāniha tīyo gṛhyate, na ca
mukhatīyādiranarthavānÂ| ataḥ satyapi pūraṇagrahaṇe tasya grahaṇaṃna
bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ||

49. prāgekādaśabhyo'ccchandasi| (5.3.49)

50. ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamābhyāṃ ña ca| (5.3.50)

iti ṣaṣṭhagrahamanarthakaṃ syātÂ| tasmādubhayābhyāmubhayaṃ bhavati||

cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ceti|| 

52. ekādākiniccāsahāye| (5.3.52)
ṭhākinicaḥ kano vā lugvijñāyate' iti| pratyāsateḥ| na tu
prakāraṇāntaravihitasya; viprakarṣātÂ| ṭhsa ca' ityādi yadi nityaḥ
syātÂ tadvidhānamanarthakaṃ syātÂ| tasmādvidhānasāmarthyātÂ pakṣe
bhavati| 
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasahāyagrahaṇaṃ saṃkhyāśabdanirāsārthaṃ kriyate?
ityāha--ṭhtadupādāne hi' ityādi| asatyasahāyagrahaṇe
saṃkhyāvācino'pyekaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syātÂ| tasmistu sati
dvibahnorna syātÂ| na hi dvayorbahuṣu vā caikatvasaṃkhyā vidyate|
asahāyatā tu śatasyāpi bhavati;
tulyajātīyānyasyābhāvātÂ--śatamasahāyamiti| tenā sahāyārthasya
grahaṇe dvibahvorapi pratyayaḥ sidhyati| atha kasmādākinijvadhīyate, na
akanijityevocyeta, atrāpi savarṇadīrghatveneṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva? na
sidhyati; ṭhato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvamÂ, yasyeti (6.4.148)
lopaśca prāpnoti| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati? naitadasti;
asti hyakāroccāraṇasya prayojanamÂ| kimÂ? bhasaṃjñāyāmanyaḥ
padasaṃjñānibandhano'vagraho mā bhūditi| tasmādākinijeva viṣeyaḥ||

53. bhūtapūrve caraṭÂ| (5.3.53)
kimarthaṃ punaretau samānārtho śabdāvupadiśyete, nānyatara
evopadiśyeta? naivaṃ śakyamÂ; iha hyatikrāntakālaviśiṣṭe'rthe
vartamānātÂ pratyagrahamiṣyate, sa cātikrāntaḥ kālo'nyataroktau
naiva gṛhyate| tathā hi--bhūtaśabdo vartamāne'pyarthe vartate,
yathā--bhūtavāniti, pūrvaśabdastu digdeśayorapi|
tasmādanyataroktāvatikrāntakālo na pratīyate| ata
evā''ha--ṭhbhūtapūrvaśabdo'tikrāntakālavacanaḥ' iti| atha cakārasya
ṭhcuṭÂ' (1.3.7) itītsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati? anityatvātasya vidheḥ|
anityatvaṃ tu tatraiva pratipāditam|| 

54. ṣaṣṭhaḷa rūpya ca| (5.3.54)
iha ṣaṣṭhaḷntaṃ yattdviśeṣaṇaṃ parārthatvādapradhānamÂ, itaratÂ
punastenaivopakriyamāṇatvādviśeṣyaṃ pradhānamÂ| pradhānena ca
kāryasampratyaya itadi yatā ṣaṣṭhaḷntātÂ pratyavidhāne sampratati
ṣaṣṭhaḷntapratiyogini pradhāne pratyayo vijñāyato, ma prakṛtyarthe; tathā
bhūtapūrvagrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva jñāyate, na
prakṛtyarthasyetyetadālocyā''ha--ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷntātÂ' ityādi|
pratyayārthastu ṣaṣṭhaḷntasya yaḥ pratiyogī sa veditavyaḥ||

55. atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau| (5.3.55)
ṭhatiśāyanamÂ' iti| lyuṭÂ| yadyapi śetiḥ kevalaḥ svapne vartate,
tathāpyatipūrahvasya prakarṣe vṛtiḥ, ata evā''ha--ṭhprakarṣaḥ' iti| nanu
cātiśayanamiti bhavitavyamÂ? ityāha--ṭhnipātanāddīrghatvamÂ' iti|
nipātanaṃ tvatiśāyanaśabdasya kathamÂ? sādhutvaṃ vijñāyate
ityevamarthamÂ| ṭhprakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ caitat' iti| pratyayāśaṅkāṃ
nirākaroti| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ svāthikānāṃ dyotyaṃ bhavatīti na
vācyamÂ; tasya prakṛtivācyatvākatÂ| 
ṭhpaṭiṣṭhaḥ, laghiṣṭhaḥ' iti| ṭhturiṣṭhemeyassu' (6.4.154) iti ṭilopaḥ|
ṭhgariṣṭhaḥ' iti| ṭhpriyasthirasphirorubahulaguru' (6.4.157) ityādinā
guruśabdasya garādeśaḥ| 
ṭhprakarṣapratyayāntādapareṇa pratyayena na bhavitavyamÂ, ekenaiva
pratyayasya dyotitatvātÂ' iti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha--ṭhyadā ca' iti|
yatra prathame prakarṣe ātiśāyaniko vihitaḥ'; tatra tenaiva
dyotitatvādÂdvitīyo mā bhūta prakarṣapratyayaḥ| prakarṣāntaratve
ātiśāyanapratyayāntādyauktamevāpareṇātiśāyikena pratyayena
bhavitumÂ, tadadyotitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| iṣṭhani parataḥ ṭhpraśasyasya śraḥ'
(5.3.60), pūrveṇa saha ṭhādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| iṣṭhanpratyāntātÂ
tamapprakarṣapratyayaḥ| atra pratiyogyapekṣo yaḥ prakarṣaḥ pūrvasmātÂ
prakarṣātÂ sa prakarṣa iṣṭhanpratyayena dyotitaḥ| nanu ca
nāsyātiśāyikasya vidhāyakaṃ vākyamasti, yena tasminÂ vihite
tadantādaparaḥ prakarṣa ātiśāyāniko vidhīyeta, idameva hyaekaṃ
vākyamÂ, tatrānenaiva vidhīyamāne prakarṣapratyayo tadantāyāḥ
prakṛterasambhava ityayukta ātiśāyikādaparasyātiśāyikasya bhāvaḥ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha vidhīyamānapratatyayabhedāddve ete vākye,
tatraikeneṣṭhanÂ vidhīyate, apareṇa tu tadantātÂ tamapÂ|| 

56. tiṅśca| (5.3.56)
ṭhpacatitamāmÂ' iti| ṭhkimetiṅvyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' (5.4.11)
ityāmÂ| 
ṭhguṇavacane' ityādi| iṣṭhano'nudāharaṇe hetuḥ| ṭhajādī
guṇavacanādeva' (5.3.58) iti niyama iti, tata eva tena bhavitavyamÂ|
na ca tiṅnto guṇavacanaḥ, ato nāsāvudāhriyate|| 

57. dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau| (5.3.57) 
ṭhdvayorarthayorvacanaṃ dvivacanamÂ' iti| etenānvarthasya dvivacanasya
grahaṇamÂ, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati yadi hi pāribhāṣikaṃ
dvivacanaṃ, gṛhyaeta, ṭhasmākaṃ ca devadatasya devadato'bhirūpataraḥ ityatra
pratyayo na syātÂ; pāribhāṣikatasya dvivacanasyābhāvātÂ| anvarthasya
tu grahaṇe sati bhavati dvyarthatopapadasya| tathā
hi--asmākamityanenaiko'rtha ucyate, ekasminnevārthe ṭhasmado dvayośca'
(1.2.59) iti bahuvacanasya vidhīnātÂ| devadatasyetyanenāpi
dvitīyo'rtha ucyata iti bhavatyeva tadanvarthadvivacanamupapadamÂ|
tadevamanvarthasya grahaṇe sarvatra sidhyatīti tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti
manyate| ṭhvibhaktavyaḥ' iti| pṛthakÂ kartavya ityarthaḥ| yaḥ
punaratiśayyamānastasyopapadatvamÂ, nātiśayituḥ; tataḥ
pratyavidhānātÂ| nanu ca ṭhṛhalorṇyatÂ' (3.1.124) iti ṇyati kṛte
vibhāgya iti bhavitavyamÂ, kathaṃ vibhajya iti nirdeaśa upapadyate?
ityāha--ṭhnipātanādyadbhavati' iti| iha dve upapade, evaṃ prakṛtī ca
pratyayāvapi dvāveva, tataśca yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti
kasyacidbhāntiḥ syātÂ,
atastannirāsārthamāha--ṭhyathāsaṃkhyāmÂ'cāracihnātÂ| sa hi
lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayanÂ yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīha nāpekṣeteti
sūcayati| 
ṭhpaṭīyānÂ iti| pūrvavaṭṭilopaḥ, ṭhatvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14)
iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| (6.1.68; 8.2.23)| 
ṭhmāthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhaḷtarāḥ' iti ṭhpañcamī vibhakte' (2.3.42)
ityanena pañcamī| pāṭaliṃputrakebhya ityedatra vibhajyopapadamÂ,
pāṭaliputrakā hi māthurebhyo vibhajyanteupṛthakÂ kriyante| 
nanū caitadapi ṭhdvivacanopapade' ityeva siddhamÂ, asti hyatra
dvivacanamupapadamÂ, tathā hi--māthurāṇāmeko rāśiḥ, aparaḥ
pāṭaliputrakāṇāmÂ, tau ca dvivacanenocyete,
tasmādvibhajyagrahaṇamanarthakamÂ? naitadasti; yadyapyatra rāśyapekṣā
dvyarthatā'sti, tathāpi nāsau śabdenopādīyate| kiṃ tarhi?
avayavabhedaḥ| ata eva māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya iti bahuvacanamÂ| iha
rāśyapekṣāpi dvyarthatā nāstīti--sāṅkāśyakebhyaḥ
pāṭaliputrakebhyaśca māthurāḥ sukumāratarā iti|
tasmādvibhajyagrahaṇamapi kartavyamÂ|| 

58. ajādī guṇavacanādeva| (5.3.58)
ṭhpācakataraḥ' iti| kartṛśaktimato dravyasyābhidhānāddravyavacano'yaṃ
pācakaśabdaḥ| 
athaivakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvatā siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo vināpi tena
niyamārtho bhavati?ityāha-ṭhevakāraḥ' ityādi| asati hyaevakāre
viparītamavaṣāraṇaṃ vijñāyate--ajādī eva guṇavacanāditi, tataśca
yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti prakṛtiniyamaḥ syātÂ| evaṃ ca
guṇavacanasyājādyoniyatatvātÂ tatastarabādirnaṃ syātÂ| evakāre tu
prakṛtyanantaramuccāryamāṇe sati pratyayārthaniyamo'yaṃ bhavati na
prakṛtiniyama iti paṭuataraḥ, paṭuatama iti siddhaṃ bhavati| etayorapi
siddhyarthaṃ ṭhguṇavacanādiṣṭhannīyasunau' iti sūtraṃ na kṛtamÂ| tadā
vidhyarthatvādetau taraptamaporapavādatvādbādhakāviti tayorabhāve
paṭuataraḥ, paṭuatama iti na sidhyetÂ|| 

59. tuccchandasi| (5.3.59)
ṭhkaripṭhaḥ' iti| kartṛśabdātÂ tṛnnantādiṣṭhanÂ,
ṭhturiṣṭhemeyassu' (6.4.154) iti tṛśabdalopaḥ| ṭhdohīyasī' iti|

nimitābhāvādghatvādinivartate, ṭhugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīpÂ|| 

60. praśasyasya śraḥ| (5.3.60)
nanu cājīdī iti prathamāntamÂ, tatkathamajādyoḥ parata ādeśo
labhyate? ityāha--ṭhajādī' itaci| ṭhtadviṣayaḥ' iti| sa praśasyaśabdo
viṣayo yasya sa tadviṣayaḥ| ṭhajādī guṇavacanādeva' (5.3.58) itatyanena
yo niyamaḥ sa tadviṣaye na pravartata iti darśayati| 
ṭhevamutareṣvapi' iti| ṭhvṛddhasya ca' (5.3.62) ityevamādiṣu| ayamanayoḥ
ayamanayoḥ śreyāniti dvivacanopapada īyasunÂ ayamasmātÂ
śreyāniti vibhajyopapade| pūrvatra nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī (2.3.41), utaratra
ṭhpañcamī vibhakte' (2.3.42) iti pañcamī|| 

61. jya ca| (5.3.61)
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanivṛtyarthaḥ, utarārthaśca| utaratra vṛddhaśabdasya
jyādeśa eva yathā syātÂ, śrādeśo mā bhūviti|| 

62. vṛddhasya ca| (5.3.62)
ṭhvṛddhaśabdasya' iti| ṭhvṛddha' ityetasya śabdasyetyarthaḥ| etena ṭhvṛddhasya'
iti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ darśayati| nanu ca vṛddhaśabdaśca saṃjñā
kṛtā--ṭhvṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddhamÂ' (1.1.73) iti,
atastatpratyāyitasyaiva saṃjñino grahaṇaṃ na svarūpasya, ṭhsvaṃ rūpaṃ
śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā' (1.1.68) iti vacanātÂ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ṭhpraśasyasya'
ityetadihānuvartate, tena vṛddhaśabdo viśeṣyate--praśasyasya
vṛddhasyeti| svarūpagrahaṇe vayo'dhike ca śabdārthe praśasyatā yujyate,
na pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe| atha vā--sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā (1.1.50)
jyaśabdasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva sthāno vijñāyate, antaratamaśca tasya
vṛddhaśabda eva, tena tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamÂ| ṭhtayośca' ityādi| yathā
ṭhpraśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) ityatra niyamābhāvenājādyoḥ pratyayayoḥ
satvaṃ jñāpitamÂ, tathehāpi jñāpyate| niyamābhāvastvajādyoḥ
parataḥ pūrvavadādeśaviṣānādeva veditavyaḥ||

63. antikabāḍhayornedasādhau| (5.3.63)
ṭhnimittyoḥ' ityādi| nimitau pratyayau, tayoḥ parata
ādeśavidhānātÂ| kasmātÂ punariṣyamāṇo na bhavati? alpācyatasya
paranipātātÂ| sa hi lakṣaṇāntarānapekṣatāmācaṣṭe| tena
yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīha nāpekṣyate| yadyevamÂ, sthānyādeśayorapi
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti? mā bhūdyathāsaṃkhyamÂ, āntaratamyādvyavasthā
bhaviṣyati| nanu ca vyavasthākāri cellakṣaṇāntaraṃ nāpekṣyate,
sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣāpi (1.1.50) na prāpnoti? naitadasti;
nirveśānyathātvaṃ hi nirdeaśakṛtā vyāvasthā nāstītyetadeva
bodhayati, yā tvarthakṛtā vyavasthā tāṃ na nivartayati| api
cādeśapratipataye ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā' (1.1.49) ityeṣā paribhāṣā
niyogato'pekṣaṇauyā| taccheṣabhūtā ṭhsthāne'ntaratamaḥ (1.1.50) iti
paribhāṣā kathaṃ śakyā nāpekṣitumÂ|| 

64. yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyāmÂ| (5.3.64)
atrāpi nimitayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ neṣyate, tasya hyabhāvaḥ ṭhajādyadantamÂ'
(2.2.33) ityalpaśabdāsya pūrvanipāte
paranipātāllakṣaṇānapekṣāccihnillabhyate, yuveti
svarūpagarahaṇamiṣyate, na jīvatvaṃ vaṃśasya| kasmātÂ? ihāpi
ṭhpraśasyasya' (5.3.60) ityetadanuvartate, tena yuvaśabdo
viśeṣayitavyaḥ--praśasyasya yūna iti| svarūpagrahaṇe
sarvalokābhimatayauvanākhyavayaḥsambandhe śabdārthe praśaṃsopapadyate, na
pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe| atha vā--sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā (1.1.50)
kannityādeśasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva sthāniti vijñāyate, antaratamaśca
yuvaśabda eva| tasmāt svarūpasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamÂ| ṭhanyatarasyāṃ'
grahaṇamihālpaśabda eva prayojayati, na yuvaśabdaḥ, tasya vināpi tena
vikalpaḥ siddha eva; ṭhsthūlaṭūarayuvahrasvakṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ
pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ' (6.4.156) iti vacanātÂ| na hi nitya ādeśe
yaṇādeḥ parasya lopaḥ sambhavati, nāpi pūrvabhāgo guṇabhākÂ|
ṭhyaviṣṭhaḥ, yavīyānÂ' iti| sthūladūrādisūtreṇa (6.4.156) yaṇādeḥ
paraṃ lupyate, pūrvasya ca guṇo bhavati|| 

65. vinmatorlukÂ| (5.3.65)
matupā sāhacaryātÂ matvarthīya eva vinipratyayo gṛhyate--ṭhtapaḥ
sahasrābhyāṃ vinīnī' (5.2.102), ṭhasmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121)
iti; ābhyāṃ caitadeva lugvacanamajādyobhaviṃ jñāpayati| ṭhsragviṇau'|
iti| asmāyādisūtrema (5.2.121) viniḥ| ṭhsrajiṣṭhaḥ' iti|
ṭhprakṛtyaikācÂ' (6.4.163) iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ|| 

66. praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpapÂ| (5.3.66)
ṭhsvārthikāśca' ityādi| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ prasaṃsādi, tasya dyotakāḥ
svārthikā bhavanti, na tvathantirasya vācakāḥ| 
yadi praśaṃsāyāṃ varttmānādrūpabvidhīyate, nindāyāṃ vartamānānna
prāpnoti-vṛṣaṣalarūpo'yamÂ, caurarūpo'yamiti| vṛṣalādayo hi
śabdāḥ sadā nindāvacanāḥ; na kadācitpraśaṃsāyāṃ vartante, yathā
kākādayaḥ śabdāḥ? ityata āha--ṭhprakṛtyarthasya' ityādi| prakṛtyarthasya
vaiśiṣṭaḷṃ paripūrṇatvamÂ, tasminÂ sati praśaṃsā bhavati| evañca yadā
vṛṣalādiśabdānāmapi padārthasya paripūrṇatā bhavati, tadā te
praśaṃsāyāṃ vartante iti tebhyo'pi pratyayo bhavati| palāṇḍubhakṣaṇena
surāpāṇena ca prakṛtyarthasya paripūrṇatā bhavati, tadā te praśaṃsāyāṃ
vartante iti tebhyo'pi pratyayo bhavati| palāṇḍubhakṣaṇena
surāpāṇena ca prakṛtyarthasya paripūrraṇatāṃ darśayati| vṛṣalaśabdasya
hi śūdro vācyaḥ| sa yadā palāṇḍvādikamapi
sādhujanagahitamabhyavaharati tadā pa rapūrṇatvaṃ tasya śūdratvamÂ|
śūdraḥusarvāśī, sarvavikrayīti| cauraśabdārthasyāpi
suguptavastvapahāreṇa paripūrṇatā bhavati| 
nanu ca ṭhsvārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartante' (vyā.pa.74)
iti prakṛtyarthasya ye liṅgavacane te svārthikapratyayāntasyāpi bhavata
iti bhāvaḥ| tataśca pacatorūpamÂ, pacantirūpamityatra
dvivacanabahavacanābhyāṃ bhavitavyamÂ? ityata āha--ṭhkriyāpradhānamÂ'
ityādi| ākhyātasya yadyapi kriyā sādhanañcobhayaṃ vācyamÂ, tathāpi
tasya kriyaiva pradhānamarthaḥ| yaśca pradhānaṃ prakṛtyarthastasyaiva
liṅgavacanaṃ svārthikairanuvartayituṃ yuktamÂ| kriyāpradhānamekaiva ca
kriyā| tena rūpappratyayāntādākhyātādÂdvivacanabahavacane na bhavataḥ|
napuṃsakaliṅgamapi tarhi na syātÂ, kriyāyā aliṅgatvātÂ? ityata
āha--ṭhnapuṃsakaliṅgaṃ tu' ityādi| tatraiva
hetumāha--ṭhlokāśrayatvālliṅgasya' iti| yadi tarhi hyaekā kriyā,
pacataḥ, pacantīti dvivacanabahuvacane na sidhyataḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi
hyaekā kriyā, sādhanaṃ hyanekamÂ, atastadāśraye dvivacanabahuvacane
bhaviṣyataḥ| rūpappratyayāntātÂ tarhi syātāmÂ? tiṅntenoktatvānna
bhaviṣyataḥ| ekavacanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati; tasyautsargirakatvātÂ,
ṭhekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate' iti vacanātÂ|| 

67. īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ| (5.3.67)

68. vibhāṣā supo bahucÂ purastātu| (5.3.68)
vibhāṣāgrahaṇeneha bahucÂ sambadhyate, na purastādityetat; tena
bahucaḥ pūrvatvaṃ na viklpyata iti nityameva tadbhavati, ata
evāha--ṭhsa tu purastādeva' iti| evakārema tuśabdasyāvadhāraṇārthatāṃ
darśayati| yadi punastuśabdo' vadhāraṇārtho na kriyate, tato na
jñāyate--kiṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇena bahucÂ sambadhyate, atha
purastāditayetaditi! tu śabdena tvavadhāraṇārthena
purastāditatyetasminÂ niyamite pāriśeṣyādvibhāṣāvacane
bahujevābhisambadhyata iti vijñāyate| ṭhcitkaraṇamantodātārthamÂ'
iti| kasya punarantodātatvaṃ citkarādbhavati? saprakṛteḥ
samudāyasya;ṭhcitaḥ saprakṛterba hvakajarthamÂ' (vā.6.1.163) iti
vacanātÂ| yadyevamÂ, paṭava iti subantādutpatau jasa udātatvaṃ
prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bahucyutpanne sati ṭharthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ
prātipadikamÂ (1.2.45) iti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyāmÂ, ṭhsupo
dhātuprātipādikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti sublukÂ tāvatÂ kriyate,
tasminÂ kṛte paścādudātatvaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ paṭuaśabde ya ukārastasya
bhavati| yastu punaḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ subluki ca kṛte
anyo jasÂ utpadyate, tasyodātatvaṃ nāśahkanīyamÂ, na hyasau
prakṛtyekadeśaḥ| nanu cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ
niyamārthamiti bahucpūrvasya prātipadikasaṃjñayā na bhavitavÂyamÂ?
naiṣa doṣaḥ; tulyajātīyasya niyamaḥ| kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ?
yathājātīyakānāṃ samāsaḥ| kathañjātīyakānāṃ samāsaḥ?
bhadasaṃsargavatāmÂ| bhedasaṃsargau ca pṛthagarthānāmeva bhavataḥ|
dyotakānāñca pṛthagarthavatā na sambhavati| atha kasmātÂ sublukÂ
tāvatÂ kriyate, paścādantodātatvamÂ, yāvatā
paratvādantodātatve nai va pūrvaṃ yuktaṃ bhavitumÂ? naitadasti;
nityo hi lukÂ, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvātÂ| sa hi
kṛte'pyantodātatve prāpnoti, akṛte'pi; antodātatvaṃ tvanyasya
luki kṛte prāpnoti| anyasyākṛte śabdāntarasya prāpnuvanÂ
vidhiranityo bhavati, tasmāllugeva tāvatÂ kriyate| 
ṭhbahuguḍā drākṣā' iti| kathaṃ punaratreṣadasamāptiḥ, yāvatā
guḍaśabdena guḍajātirucyate, tadādhāro vā dravyamÂ| tatra
jātistāvadekā, niravayavā ceti sarvasminnāśraye samāptā, dravyamapi
yatÂ tayā sambaddhaṃ tatÂ sarvataḥ pūrṇatvātÂ samāptameva|
tasmādīṣadasamāptirayuktamiha viśeṇamÂ, asambhavātÂ?
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bahuguḍā drākṣeti drākṣāśabdena na prāpneti,
tasyārthāntaratvātÂ? strīliṅgamapi ṭhsvārthikāḥ prakṛtito
liṅgavacanānyanuvartante' (vyā. pa. 74) iti nopapadyate? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; iha śabdāduccāritāddvayaṃ pratīyate--śabdo'rthaḥ,
jātirdravyañca; abhidheyasambandhenāśabdārthabhūtā api guṇāḥ,
yatraitadubhayamasti tatra samāptiḥ| yatra tvanyatarannāsti tatreha
guḍaśabdo guḍajātihīne mādhuryādiguṇahīne vā dravye vartate
ityupapadyata īṣadasamāntiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamapyupadyata eva| kathamÂ?
yadā tāvajjātihīne kenacitÂ sādharmyeṇa drākṣādiśabdābhidheye
vartitvā guḍaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpadayata, tadā drākṣāśabdena
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati; ubhayorekārthavṛtitvātÂ| yadā tu
guṇahīne guḍajītīya eva, tadāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyamÂ, gaurvāhīka
iti yathā, tathā bhaviṣyati guṇahīno'pi guḍaśabdaḥ| guḍo
bahuguḍaśabdenotyate, tena ca tulyā drākṣeti sā'pi
bahuguḍaśabdenābhidāyiṣyate| strīliṅgamapi copapadyate; tasya
lokāśrayatvātÂ| api ca ṭhsvārthikāḥ
prakṛteliṃṅgavacanānyanuvartante (vyā. pa. 74) iti prāyikametata|
tena kadācidativartatante'pi, yathā kuṭīraḥ, śamīra iti|
ṭhkuṭīśamīśuṇḍābhyo raḥ' (5.3.88) iti svārthikaśca| 
ṭhvibhāṣāvacanātÂ' ityādinā vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭe|
asati hi vibhāṣāgrahaṇe tiḍanteṣu kṛtāvakāśāḥ kalpabādayo
bahucā subantādviśeṣavihitena bādhyeranÂ tasmistu satadi pakṣe
te'pi bhavanti| nanu ca bhinnadeśena bahucā nāsti teṣāṃ virodhaḥ,
tatkuto bādhā? asatyāṃ vā bādhāyāṃ kṛte'pi bahuci
tairbhavitavyameva, paradaśasyānavaṣṭabdhatvātÂ? naitadasti; na hyavaśyaṃ
deśakṛta eva sāmānyaviśeṣayorvirodho bhavati, kiṃ tarhi?
arthakṛto'pi| bahucaśca kalpabādibhiḥ samānortha iti bahucā
dyotitatvātÂ tasyārthasya kalpabādayo na bhavaviṣyanti| na hi
dyotite punardyotanamasti, yathābhihite nābhidhātavyamÂ| 
atha subgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamÂ, yāvatā prātipadikagrahaṇamanuvartate, na
ca prātipadikātÂ subantādvā bahuca utpatau kaścidviśeṣo'sti? ata
āha--ṭhsubgrahaṇamÂ' ityādi| asati hi subgrahaṇe ṭhtiṅśca' (5.3.56)
iti prakṛtatvātÂ tato hi pratyayaḥ syātÂ| atastannivṛtyarthaṃ
subagrahaṇamÂ|| 

69. prakāravacane jātīyarÂ| (5.3.69)
ṭhtasya vacane' iti| uktau, dyotana ityarthaḥ| ṭhprakāravati cāyamÂ'
ityādinā thāljātīyarorviṣayabhedaṃ darśayati| viṣayabhede sati
viśeṣavihitenāpi tālā jātīyaro bādhanaṃ na bhavati|
thālpratyāntātÂ jātīyarÂ siddho bhavati--kathañjātīya iti|| 

70. prāgivātkaḥ| (5.3.70)
tiṅntādayaṃ pratyayo neṣyate| ṭhakajiṣyate' iti| kathaṃ
punaretayorbhāvābhāvau labhyete? ityāha--ṭhtiṅścetyanuvṛtamÂ'
ityādi| utaratraivetyavadhāraṇena tvihānuvṛtamapi kapratyayena
sambandhanīyamiti darśayati| tacca
pūrvasūtrādvacanagrahaṇe'pyanuvartamāne yata utpadyamānena
pratyayenājñātāderarthasya vacanaṃ bhavati, tatraiva tena bhavitavyamÂ| na
ca tiṅntādutpadyamānenāpi kapratyayena so'rthaḥ śakyate dyotayituṃ,
akacā tu śakyate| tasmātÂ ṭhtiṅśca' (5.3.56)
ityetadanuvṛtamutarasūtreṇākacā sambandhanīyamÂ, neha kapratyayena|
prāggrahaṇamapidyotanārthamÂ, ivagrahaṇamavadhyarthamÂ;
anyathādhikāraparimāṇaṃ na jñāyate|| 

71. avyayasarvanāmnāmakacprākÂ ṭeḥ| (5.3.71)
ṭhkasyāpavādaḥ' iti| nanu ca bhinnadeśatvātÂ kākacorvirodho
nāsti, na cāsati virodhe bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, tataḥ kathaṃ
kasyāpavādaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; naivāvaśyaṃ deśakṛta eva virodho bhavati,
api tvarthakṛto'pītyuktamÂ---ṭhakacÂpratyayena samānorthaḥ' iti|
akacā dyotitatavātÂ tasyārthasya kapratyayo na bhaviṣyati| 
yadyatra prātipadikādityanuvṛteḥ prātipadikasya prākÂ
ṭerakajvidhīyate, tvayakā mayaketyādi na sidhyati? atha supa iti
prākÂ ṭervidhīyeta, evamapi yuṣmakābhiriti na siṣyati? ityata
āha--ṭhprātipadikātsupaḥ' iti| ṭhdvayamapi' ityādi| nanu ca
dvayānuvṛtāvapi kvacitÂ subantasyaiva prākṭerbhavati, kvacitÂ
prātipadikasya--ityeṣā vyavasthā na labhyate? ityāha--ṭhtatra' ityādi|
vacanagrahaṇaṃ vyavasthārthamihānuvartate| tena yatra prātipadikasya
prākṭerutpadyamānenārthadyotanaṃ śakyate kartumÂ, tatra prātipadikasya
prākÂ ṭerbhavati; yatra subantādutpannenārthadyotanaṃ śakyaṃ
sampādayituṃ, tatra subantasyaiva| 
akacaścitkaraṇamantodātārthamÂ| taddhi saprakṛteḥ samudāyasya| tathā ca
vakṣyati--ṭhcitaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajarthamÂ' (vā. 6.1.163)| 
ṭhtūṣṇīmaḥ kāmpratyayo vaktavyaḥ' iti| yathāsambhavaṃ kutsādiṣvartheṣu|
cakāro deśavidhyarthaḥ| 
ṭhśīle ko malopaśca' iti| śīlamiti na svabhāva evocyate, kiṃ tarhi?
niyamo'pi| tathā hi--śīlavānÂ bhikṣurityabhidhīyate, yaḥ
samyaṅniyamamanupālayatīti| tena yo'pi niyamaparatayā vācaṃ
niyamayati so'pi tūṣṇīka ucyate|| 

72. kasya ca daḥ| (5.3.72)
ṭhakacsanniyogena' ityādi| kathaṃ punarakacsanniyogenetyeṣa viśeṣo
labhyate, yāvatā na sūtre taduktamÂ? ityāha--ṭhcakāraḥ' ityādi|
cakārasyaitadeva prayojanamÂ--akacsanniyogena kakārasya dakāro
yathā syāditi bhāvaḥ||

73. ajñāte| (5.3.73)
ṭhajñātaviśeṣo'jñātaḥ' iti| yadi yasyātyantamajñānaṃ so'jñātaḥ
syātÂ, evaṃ sati sarvathā vastuvijñānā bhāve prakṛtireva na syātÂ,
na hi sarvathā'vijñāto'rthaḥ prayogamarhati; tasmātÂ svena rūpeṇa
jñātasya yasya dharmāntaratvamajñātaṃ sa ihājñāto'bhimata iti
jñāyate--avijñātaviśeṣo'jñāta iti| asyaivārthaṃ
vispaṣṭīkartumāha--ṭhsvena' ityādi| svarūpamaśvatvādi, viśeṣarūpaṃ
svasvāmisambandhādi||

76. anukampāyāmÂ| (5.3.76)
ṭhkāruṇṇena' ityādi| abhyupapatiranugraha eva| ṭhsvapitaki, śvasitaki'
iti| ṭhrudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) iṭÂ, adāditvāccchapo

77. nītau ca tadyauktātÂ| (5.3.77)
ṭhsāmadānādirūpāyo nītiḥ' iti| ādiśabdena
bhedadaṇḍayorgrahaṇamÂ; tautvanukampāyāṃ na sambhavata iti
sāmadānādirekaiva nītirguhyate, ṭhehaki' iti| iṇa
āṅpūrvālloṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanasya ṭhserhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti
hirādeśaḥ| nanu pūrveṇaivātrāpi pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ, atrāpayanukampā
gamyata eva, tata kimarthamÂ ityāha--ṭhpūrveṇaiva' ityādi|
pratyāsanno'nukampāsambandho yasyānukampayamānasya sa tathoktaḥ|
pratyāsannatvaṃ tu sambandhasaryānukampyānaṃprati;
tadāśrayatvādanukampāyāṃ vidhīyamānaḥ pratyāsateryasyānukampayā
pratyāsannaḥ sambandhastataḥ eva yukto vidhātumiti

83. ṭhājādāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ| (5.3.83)

uktaḥ, tadapavādaḥ|

11. kimetihvyayaghādābhvadravyaprakarṣe| (5.4.11)
ṭhadravyaprakarṣe' iti| nanu ca dravyasya na prakarṣo'sti; tathā ca bhāṣye
uktamÂ--ṭhna vai dravyasya prakarṣo'sti' iti, ataḥ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ?
ityata āha--ṭhyadyapi' ityādi| dṛśyate cādheyadharmasyādhāra upacāraḥ,
yathā--mañcāḥ ṛśantīti| tasmādādhārādheyayoḥ kriyāguṇayordharmaḥ
prakarṣaḥ| sa yadādhāradravya upacaryate tadāsau dravyadharmatvādupacāreṇa
dravyadharmo bhavati| ato'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| ṭhkriyāguṇayoreva'
ityādi| kriyāyā guṇasya prakarṣo yadā dravye nopacayaṃte
kriyāguṇayoreva prakarṣaḥ, tatraiva pratyayaḥ| yadi tu dravye upacaryate
tato dravyaprakarṣa iti vacanātÂ| ṭhkintarāmÂ' iti| vastuno bahavo
viśeṣāḥ, tatra praśnaḥ kiṃśabdārthaḥ| ṭhpūrvāhṇetarāmÂ' iti|
ṭhghakālataneṣu kālānāmnaḥ' (6.3.17) iti sampamyā alukÂ| nanu ca
pūrvāhṇaḥ kālaḥ, kālaśca dravyamÂ, dravyaprakarṣe pratyayena na
bhavitvyamÂ; adravyaprakarṣa iti pratiṣedhātÂ? naiva doṣaḥ; na hyatra
prātipadikārthaḥ prakarṣe vartate, kiṃ tarhi? vibhaktyarthaḥ, sa ca guma eva;
dravyaśaktisvarūpatvātÂ kārakāṇāmÂ| atha vā--vacanasāmarthyātÂ
kālaprakarṣe bhavati| na hi kālādanyasyasmādekārātÂ paro gha#e

ṭhuccaistarāmÂ' iti||

17. saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛtigaṇane kṛtvasucÂ| (5.4.17)
ṭhpaunaḥpunyamabhyāvṛtiḥ' iti| paunaḥ punyenātra

tasmādutarārthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamÂ|

vidhānātÂ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāpi siddhatā kriyāpradeśeṣu
kriyāgarahaṇena gṛhyata eva; dharmadharmiṇorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvātÂ|
anyathā kārakasya gatiḥ, kārakasya vrajyetyatra ṭhtumunṇvuṇau kriyāyāṃ

dvividhāḥ saṃkhyeyevartamānebhyaḥ saṃkhyeyavacanebhya eva pratyayaḥ syātÂ|
ṭhśataṃ vārānÂ bhuṅkte śatakṛtvo bhuṅkte' iti| atra
so'yamityabhisambandhena kriyābhyāvṛtau saṃkhyeye śataśabdo vartate|
ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyamÂ| śataṃ vārāniti saṃkhyāne partamānebhyo

31. vaṇa cānitye| (5.3.31)
lohitakaḥ kopena' iti| lohitaśabdavācyo varṇaḥ kope sati
bhavati| sthita eva ca devadate kopavigame gaccchatītyanityo bhavati|
atha varṇagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamÂ, yāvatā lohitaśabdo varṇa eva vartate?
naitadasti; maṇinimito'pyayaṃ dravye'pi vartata eva, tatrāsati
varṇagrahaṇe dravyasyāpyanityagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta, tataśca
lohitakāḥ pārthivāḥ paramāṇava iti pratyayo na syātÂ; teṣāṃ
nityatvātÂ| varṇagrahaṇe tu sati varṇasyaivānityagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ
bhavatīti nitye pratyayaḥ siddho bhavati| api ca--lohitaśabdo
varmanimita eva rudhirākhye vartate| tacca sarvatraivānitya iti
viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādanitye kāryaviśeṣa ucyate| sa punaḥ
satyevāśraye kadācidbhavati, kadācinneti| tena yadetatÂ
stroṇāmārtavaṃ lohitaṃ tatraiva syātÂ| tasmādvarṇagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamÂ|

ṭhlohito gauḥ, lohitaṃ rudhiramÂ' ityatra
yāvadāśrayastāvadavasthānādanityo varṇo na bhavati| nanu
cāyamapyāśrayavināśena vināśādanitya eva? satyametatÂ; sarva eva hi
varṇa īdṛśaḥ| ucyate cedamanitya iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyātÂ|
tena prakarṣeṇa yo'ntya iti vijñāyate, sa panaḥ satyevāśraye, abhūtvā
bhavatīti yo bhūtvā pratigaccchati sa eva bhavitumarhati| 
ṭhlohitālliṅgabādhanamÂ' ityādi| liṅgadhikāre yo vihitaḥ
pratyayaḥ sa upacārāliṅgaśabdenoktaḥ, tasya lohitaśabdādbādhanaṃ
bhavatīti vaktavyamÂ; anyathā strītvasya varṇānityasya yugapadvikṣāyāṃ
lohitaśabdātÂ ṭhvarṇādanudātātopadhāto naḥ' (4.1.39) iti yo
ṅīpÂ prāpnoti, sa kanā nityaṃ bādhyeta| tasya hi harita
varṇādiravakāśaḥ prāpnoti, tatra kani kṛte tadantāṭṭāpi
lohitaketyeva stātÂ lohiniketyevaṃ tu na prāpnoti| ṭhtasmāddhi
liṅgabādhanaṃ kartavyamÂ| evaṃ lohitaśabdātÂ ṭhvarṇādanudātātÂ'
(4.1.39) ityādinā ṅīpi takārasya nakāre tato'nena kanÂ| ṭhke'ṇaḥ'
(7.4.13) iti hrasvatve kṛte lohiniketi bhavati||

yadyevamÂ, bhāṣāyāmapi syātÂ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṭhvibhāṣā bahoḥ'

cchandasyeva bhaviṣyati, na bhāṣāyāmiti| 
ṭhsānnāya' [sānnayya-kāśikā, padamañjarī caṭ ityādi|

45. apādāne cāhīyarūhoḥ| (5.4.45)

50. abhūtatadbhāve kṛbhvastiyoge sampadyakartari cviḥ| (5.4.50)

53. abhividhau sampadā ca| (5.4.53)
ṭhsa tu kṛbhvastibhireva yoge bhavati' iti| kṛbhvastibhirityeva yoga
ityanena sambandhasyava tasyehānuvṛteḥ| abhividheḥ kārtsnyasya

syātÂ, ekenaiva siddhatvātÂ|
sa ca viśeṣo na jñāyate, ityatastatÂ pṛccchati--ṭhatābhividheḥ'
ityādi| ṭhyathāsyāṃ senāyāmÂ' ityādi| atha śeṣāṇāṃ
śastrāṇāmekadeśena hyātmanā sambandhamātraṃ vivakṣitamÂ, na sarvātmanā
vikārarūpāpatiḥ| ṭhvarṣāsu sarva lavaṇamudakasātsampadyate' iti| atrāpi
sarvāsāṃ lavaṇavyaktīnāmekadeśenodakātmatāvikāreṇa sambandhamātraṃ
vivakṣitamÂ| na tvekasya sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpatiḥ| ṭhkātsnyaṃ
tu' ityādi| yatra hyaekasyāpi dravyasya sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpatiḥ, na
tvekadeśena, tatra kārtsnya bhavati| tatra yadi pūrvo yogo
nārabyeta, yatraikadravyaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ kātsnyaṃ tatra pratyayogo na
syātÂ; abhividherabhāvātÂ| athāyaṃ nārabhyeta? yatra sarvāḥ prakṛtaya
ekadeśena vikāramāpadyante na syatÂ| tasmādubhayamārabdhadhyamÂ|| 

54. tadadhīnavacane| (5.4.54)
ṭhtadadhīnaṃ tadāyatamÂ' iti| tasyāyataṃ tadāyatamÂ| taccchabdena
svāmisāmānyamucyate| adhīnaśabdenāpīśitavyasāmānyamÂ|
anantaroktamevārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkartumāha---ṭhtatsvamikamityarthaḥ' iti|
sa svāmī yasya tatÂ tatsvāmikamÂ|
atrāpyanyapadārthapradhānatvādṛbahuvrīhiḥ| īśitavyasya
cānyapadārthatvātÂ tasya pradhānabhāvaḥ| svāminastu
tadupalakṣaṇatvādguṇabhāvaḥ| ṭhsvāmisāmānyamÂ' ityādi|
svāmisāmānyamÂuīśvarasāmānyamÂ,
īśitavyasāmānyamitatatatatyetadubhayaṃ tadadhīnaśabdenocyate| kathaṃ
kṛtvā? iha ṭhadhirīśvare' (1.4.97) ityadhiśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā,
tena yoge ṭhyasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvara' (2.3.9) iti ca saptamī| sa
ceśvara īśitavyāpekṣita iti sāmarthyādīśitavyābhidhānamadhiśabdena
yoge bhavati| adiśabdaścāyaṃ śauṇḍādiṣu paṭhaḷte, tatra ṭhsaptamī
śauṇḍṬaḥ' (2.1.40) iti samāse kṛte pūrvapadasya svābhisāmānyamartho
bhavati, utarapadasya ceśitavyasāmānyamÂ| avaḍakṣādisūtreṇa (5.4.7)
khapratyaye kṛte sa evāyamartho bhavati, tasya tatsvāmikatvādityevaṃ ca
kṛtvā| svāmisāmānyamīśitavyāsāmānyaṃ tadadhīnaśabdenocyate| tatra
svāmisāmānyaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, īśitavyasāmānyaṃ tu pratyāyartha ityata
āha--ṭhsvāmiviśeṣavācinaḥ' ityādi||

57. avyaktānukaraṇāddvyajavarārddhadanitau ḍācÂ| (5.4.57)
ṭhavyakatasyānukaraṇamavyaktānukaraṇamÂ' iti| yadyapyanukaraṇe
varṇaviśeṣo rūpeṇa na prakāśate, tathāpi dhvaneḥ samānatayā

nyūnataramekājbhavati| yadyakṛte dvivacane yasya dvyajavarārddhatā

dvyajavaramarddhaṃ bhavatītyetacchetasi kṛtvā''ha--ṭhyasya ca' ityādi|

ityāha---ṭhḍāci bahulamÂ' ityādi| yadyeṣā parasaptamī syātÂ,
syādeṣa doṣaḥ; na caiṣā parasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? viṣayasaptamī|
ṭhpaṭapaṭākaroti' iti| paṭaccchabdāḍḍāci vivakṣite viṣayabhūte

tasminÂ kṛte dvyajavarārddhatāyāmupajātāyāṃ ḍāci ṭilopaḥ,

pūrvavadÂddhirvacanamÂ, tato ḍācÂ| 
ṭhdṛṣatkaroti' iti| atrāpi dvirvacane kṛte dvyajavarārddhata
bhavatīti| nāvyaktasyedamanukaraṇamÂ| ṭhśratkaroti' iti|
bhavatyetadavyaktānukaraṇamÂ, na dvyajavarārddhamÂ| kṛte'pi hyatra
dvirvacane ekājavaramarddhaṃ sampadyate| ṭhkharaṭakharaṭākaroti' iti|
kharaṭavityetasyānukaraṇasyātra paṭadityetasyānukaraṇasyeva
pūrvavadÂddhirvacanamÂ, tato ḍācÂ| yadi ṭhdvyajarddhamÂ'
etāvaducyeta, iha pratyayo na syātÂ, na hyatra dvyajarddhatāsti|
avaragrahaṇe tu satīhāpi bhavati| tatra hi dvyaco'rddhādyasya

brayātÂ| ṭhpaṭiti karoti' iti| ṭhadhyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' (6.1.98)
ityaccchabdasya pararūpatvamÂ| yadyatra ḍācÂ syātÂ, tasya ḍājantasya
paramiti śabdamuccārya karotiranantaraḥ syāditi, na ca tatparamÂ;
taccāniṣṭamÂ| 
atha cakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvalatāntodātatvaṃ kṛtvādasya
pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhamÂ? ityata āha--ṭhcakāraḥ' ityādi| paṭapaṭā asi
iti sthite ṭhtiṅṅtiṅḥ' (8.1.28) ityasiśabdasya nighāte kṛte
ṭhsvarito vānudāte'padādau' (8.2.6) iti svarita ekādeśaḥ
prāpneti, na ca svarita iṣyate, tadartha cakāraḥ| 
ṭhsvārthiko vijñeyaḥ' iti| vyatiriktasyārthasyābhāvātÂ| kena punaḥ

59. saṃkhyāyāśca guṇāntāyāḥ|

ṭhtādṛśātÂ' ityādinā tathābhūtātÂ saṃkhyāśabdātÂ

68. samāsāntāḥ| (5.4.68)
"samāsāntāḥ" ityayamadhikāraḥ' iti| vakṣyamāṇena ṭhbahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye

samāsāntānÂ kṛtvā paścātÂ tadantena samāsaḥ kriyate| evañca taiḥ
saha samāsasaṃjñā bavatītyupapadyate ḍajādīnāṃ samāsāvayavatvamÂ|
ataścaitadevaṃ vijñeyamÂ| yo'bhimanyatesamāse kṛte

bhaktivyamÂ' iti, tadvirudhyate| nanu ca

pratipāditatvātÂ| ṭhtadgrahaṇena gṛhyante' iti taccchabdena samāsaḥ
pratyavamṛśyate| samāsāvayavatve sati teṣāmapi tadanupradeśo
bhavati| ataste| samāsagrahaṇena gṛhyanta iti| atha samāsāvayavatve
pratyayasya kiṃ prayojanamÂ? ityāha--ṭhprayojanamÂ' ityādi|
ṭhadhirājamÂ, uparājamÂ' iti| yatākramaṃ vibhaktyarthe
sāmīpye'vyayībhāvaḥ| ṭhavyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' (5.4.107), ṭhanaśca'
(5.4.108) iti ṭajantasyāvyayībhāvagrahaṇena grahaṇātÂ
ṭhnāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) iti vibhakteralukÂ,
amantabhāvaśca bhavati| 
dve purī samāhṛte iti ṭhtaddhitārthotarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti
samātaḥ| sa ca ṭhsaṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñaḥ,
ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmÂ' (5.4.74) ityakārapratyayāntasya dvigugrahaṇena
grahaṇāvakārāntātÂ ṭhdvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīpÂ siddho bhavati|

sraktvacinīti| pūrveṇa tulyamÂ|

samāsāntatve pratyayasvareṇāntodātatā syātÂ| ṭhuccairdhuraḥ,

73. bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇātÂ| (5.4.73)

tatÂprayojanamÂ--utamaśabdasyāpi saṃkhakyātasya
pratiṣedhapratipatiryathā syādityevaṃ kecidvarṇayanti| bhavati
tatsāmīpyātÂ tāccchabdyamÂ--gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādi| tasmāccchakta
utamaśabdaḥ sāmīpyādupotamaśabdamabhidhātumiti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ|
ṭhtena' ityādinā pratiṣedhasyopotamaśabdapratipateḥ palaṃ darśayati||

113. bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgatÂ ṣacÂ| (5.4.114)
ṭhadravaṃ mūrtimatÂ' (ma. bhā. 2.222 kā. 4.1.554) ityādinā prāribhāṣikaṃ
yatÂ svāṅgaṃ tadiha gṛhyate| ṭhduḥśliṣṭa vibhaktini' iti| duḥkhena
kaṣṭena śliṣṭāḥ sambaddhā vibhaktayo yeṣu tāni duḥśliṣṭavibhaktīni|
tathā ca--pratyayasambandhena ṣaṣṭhaḷa bhavitavyamÂ, yathā
ṭhtatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' (5.4.86) iti| sakthyakṣipragahaṇena ceha
tadantatayā bahuvrīherviśeṣayitumiṣṭatvātÂ| bahuvrīhau
yadvibhaktivacanaṃ tato'pi tenaiva bhavituṃ yuktamÂ| iha tu bahuvrīhau
saptamyekavacanamÂ| sakavyakṣiśabdābhyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanamÂ,
saptamīdvivacanaṃ vā| svāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sakthyakṣṇoriha samānādhikaraṇaṃ
viśeṣaṇamÂ, tataśca sakthyakṣiśabdābhyāṃ yā vibhaktistadvibhatikaṃ
samānādhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇamupapadyate| evaṃ vidhavibhaktibhiḥ padaiḥ
kaścidÂduḥkhena kṛcchreṇa yukto yāmāśritya vibhaktimevārthaṃ
pratipadyate| tasmātÂ tāni duḥśliṣṭavibhaktīni| kimartha punastāni
padāni kṛtāni? vaicitryārthamÂ| 
ṭhdīrghasakthi śakaṭamÂ, sthūlākṣirikṣuḥ' iti| atra sakthyakṣiśabdau
svāṅgaṃ na bhavataḥ| śakaṭasya kaścidavayavastathekṣośca tathā'bhidhīyate|
na tu tatra ṭhadravaṃ mūrtimatÂ (ma. bhā. 2.222) ityādikaṃ
svāṅgalakṣaṇamasti| 
nanu ca ṭacāpi prakṛtena sarvametatÂ sidhyati, tatÂ kimarthaṃ ṣajiti
pratyayāntaramupātamÂ? ityāha--ṭhṭaci prakṛte' ityādi| dīrghasakthī
strī--ṭaci ṅībanudātaḥ syātÂ, ṣaci tu sati ṭhṣidgaurādibhyaśca'
(4.1.41) iti ṅīṣudātaḥ siddho bhavati| nanu ca ṅīpyanudātÂta
udātanivṛtisvareṇodāta eva bhavati| ataḥ svarārthamapi naiva
pratyayāntaramupādeyamÂ? ityāha--ṭhsakathñcākrāntātÂ' iti|
ṭhvibhāṣotpucche' (6.2.106) ityato vibhāṣetyanuvartanamāne
ṭhsakthañcākrāntātÂ' (6.2.198) iti vikalpenotarapadasyāntodātatvaṃ
vidhīyate| yasminÂ pakṣa udātaṃ bhavati, tatra ṅīpi parataḥ, ṭhyasyeti
ca' (6.4.148) ityakārasyodātasya lope kṛte ṭhanudātasya ca
yatrodātalopaḥ' (6.1.161) iti ṅīpyudātatvena bhavitavyamÂ, ato
nāsti ṅīpi virodhaḥ| yasminÂ pakṣa udātaṃ na sambhavati tasminÂ

sarvatrodātaḥ siddho bhavati; ṅīṣpratyayasvareṇāntodātatvātÂ|| 

114. aṅgulerdāruṇi| (5.4.114)

115. dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūrdhnaḥ| (5.4.116)
atha kimartha ṣaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ vidhīyate, na prakṛtaḥ ṣajeva vidhīyate?
vikalpenāntodātatvaṃ yathā syātÂ| ṭhvibhāṣotpucche' (6.2.196)
ityato vibhāṣetyanuvartamāne ṭhdvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau'
(6.2.197) iti nakārāntasya mūrdhanśabdasya nirdeaśādÂdvitribhyāmutaro
yatra nakārānto mūrdhanśabdastatra bahuvrīherantodātatvaṃ pākṣikaṃ
vidhīyate; anyathā'kārāntamurdhaśabda utarapadodātatvaṃ vidhīyate,
kṛtasamāsāntameva nirdiśetÂ| tatra yadi ṣacpratyayo vidhīyate, tataḥ
pākṣikamantodātatvaṃ bādhitvā citkaraṇasāmarthyānnityamantodātatvaṃ
syātÂ| vibhāṣāntodātavacanasya tu yatra samāsānto nāsti
so'vakāśaḥ| asmiṃstu pratyayāntarasamāsānte kṛte
vikalpenāntodātatvaṃ sidhyati| nanu ca nakārāntanirdeaśānnakārānta
eva hi mūrghanśabdaḥ, utarapade vibhāṣāntodātena bhavitavyamÂ,
tatkathaṃ samāsāntādbhavetÂ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyati--ṭhyatrāpi
samāsāntaḥ kriyate tatrāpi bahuvrīhikāryatvātÂ tadekadeśatvācca
samāsāntodātatvaṃ bhavatyeva' iti| atha kimarthaṃ bahuvrīhau
dvitribhyāmutaro mūrdhanśabdo nakārāntaḥ sambhavati, yāvatā nityaṃ
samāsāntena bhavitavyamÂ, na hi sūtre vibhāṣāgrahaṇasti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; sa eva hi nakārāntanirdeaśo jñāpayati--vikalpena samāsānto
na bhavatīti|| 

116. appūraṇīpramāṇyoḥ| (5.4.116)

154. śeṣādvibhāṣā| (5.4.154)
śeṣaḥ kabapekṣo vā syātÂ---yasmādbahuvrīheḥ kabna vihitaḥ sa
śeṣa iti? samāsāntāpekṣo vā--yasmādÂbahuvrīheḥ samāsānto na
vihitaḥ sa śeṣa iti? tatra yadi kabapekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ syātÂ---anṛcaḥ,
vyāghrapātÂ, sugandhirityatrāpi syātÂ| na hyataḥ kenacitÂ kabvihita
iti kabapekṣe śeṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāsāntāpekṣayā śeṣa iti
darśayannāha--ṭhyasmādbahuvrīheḥ samāsānto na bhavati sa śeṣaḥ' iti|
kathaṃ jñāyate--samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣa iti? śeṣagrahaṇātÂ| tatra yadi
kabapekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ syātÂ, śeṣagrahaṇanarthakaṃ syātÂ|
ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi śeṣaviṣaya eva vikalpo bhaviṣyati; anyathā
yadi yato'pi pūrvevidhivākyaiḥ kabvihitastato'pyanena vibhāṣā
vidhīyate, vidhivākyānāmānarthakyamāpadyeta| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇātÂ
samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣo vijñāyate. ṭhbahūkhaṭvakaḥ' iti
ṭhāpo'nyatarasyāmÂ' (7.4.15) iti hrasvaḥ| ṭhbahukhaṭvaḥ' ityatrāpi
ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti| 
ṭhkathamÂ' ityādi| yadi samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ; anṛkkaṃ sāma, bahÂ
vṛkkaṃ sūktamityatra kabna sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhviśeṣe sa iṣyate' iti|
sa hyakāraḥ samāsānto viśeṣe māṇave caraṇākhyāyāṃ ceṣyata iti
tatrākāro vihitaḥ| na cāpi tatraiva viśeṣa kabvihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
viṣayāntare--sāmani, sūkte ca| tatra bahuvrīheḥ samāsāntāpekṣaḥ
śeṣaḥ| tena ca priyapathaḥ, priyamadhura iti ṭhṛkpūrabdhūḥ' (5.4.74)
ityādinā'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ śeṣagrahaṇamÂ, yāvatā yābhyaḥ
prakṛtibhyaḥ samāsāntā vihitāḥ, tābhyasta eva bādhakā bhaviṣyanti?
naitadasti; niravakāśā hi viṣayo bādhakā bhaviṣyanti, sāvakāśāśca
samāsāntāḥ| ko'vakāśaḥ? pratipadopātaprakṛtayaḥ; yābhyaḥ samāsāntā
arthaviśeṣe samāsaviśeṣaṃ prati pratipadamupādāya vihitāḥ
so'vukāśaḥ; viśeṣa prakṛtibhyaḥ prasaṅge satyubhayaprāptau
paratvātÂ kapratyayaḥ syātÂ| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamÂ||

156. īyasaśca| (5.4.156)

(5.3.60) iti śraḥ| ṭhhrasvatvamapi na bhavati' iti| ṭhgostriyorupasarjanasya'
(1.2.48) iti hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti, tadapi na bhavati| kasmānna bhavati?

tadabhāvaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati---yathā puṃvadbhāve satīkārasya

pratiṣedhasya siddhatvātÂ, panaḥ ṭhliṭi vayo yaḥ' (6.1.38) iti|
anantaroktamarthamabhyanujānāti| yadi satyametatÂ, tarhi kimarthaṃ
vayigrahaṇamÂ? ityāha--ṭheṣa eva' ityādi| tena spaṣṭīkaraṇārthaṃ
vayigrahaṇamityācaṣṭe| ṭhvidhyati' iti| divāditvācchÂayanÂ| ṭhuṣṭaḥ'
iti| tasantametatÂ, adāditvāccchapo lukÂ vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36)
ṣatvamÂ, ṣṭuatvamÂ| ṭhvicati' iti| tudāditvāccchaḥ|
vṛkṇa iti pūrvavannatvamÂ, ṭhskoḥ' (8.2.29) iti salopaḥ|
ṭhjhalādirniṣṭhā na bhavati' iti| tenātra ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
jhalācau hi tadvidhīyate; ṭhjhalo jhali' (8.2.26) ityato
jhalgrahaṇānuvṛteḥ| ṭhkṛtve tu kartavye tadasiddhameva' iti| na hi
yathā ṣatvādau niṣṭhādeśasya siddhatvamucyate, tathā kutve'pi, tena
tatÂ pravartata eva| ṭhvṛścati' iti| pūrvavaccchaḥ| ṭhvarīvṛścyate' iti|
ṭhrīgṛtvata iti vaktavyamÂ' (vā.880) iti rīgāgamaḥ| ṭhpṛṣṭaḥ' iti|
pūrvavatÂ ṣatvamÂ| ṭhyajayāca' (3.3.90) ityādinā naṅ ivihite praśna
ityatra samprasāraṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--ṭhnaṅ' ityāidi| ṭhbhṛṣṭaḥ'
iti| pūrvavatÂ ṣatvamÂ| ṭhbhṛjjati' iti| pūrvavaccchaḥ| ṭhbarībhṛjyate'
iti| pūrvavad rīkÂ| ṭhsakālasya' ityādi| nanu skhoḥ
saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti tasya lopena bhavitavyamÂÂ?
naitadasti; jhali padānte ca sa ucyata iti|| 

17. liṭaḷbhyāsasyobhayeṣāmÂ| (6.1.17)
ṭhuvayitha' iti| krādiniyamādiṭÂ prāptaḥ ṭhupadeśe'tvataḥ' (7.2.62) iti
pratiṣiddhaḥ ṭhṛto bhāradvājasya' (7.2.63) iti niyamātÂ punarbhavati| 
ṭhgraheraviśeṣaḥ' iti| yasmātÂ sati samprasāraṇe halādiśeṣeṇa
(7.4.60) rephanivṛtau jagrāheti graheryadrūpaṃ bhavati, satyapi
samprasāraṇa uratvaraparatvahalādiśeṣeṣvapi kṛteṣu tadeva bhavati|
ṭhjijyau' iti| ṭhāta āṬ ṇalaḥ' (7.1.34)| ṭhjijyatha' iti| ṭhāto lopa
iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ. ṭhvṛścateḥ satyasati vā yoge nāsti
viśeṣaḥ' iti| yadyanyārtho yoga ārabhyate na vṛścatyarthaḥ, tato
vṛścatyarthametadvacanaṃ na bhavatīti satyapyetasminnanyārthavacane
vṛścaterabhyāsasya naiva samprasāraṇena bhavitavyamÂ| na hyasati tadarthe
vacane kenacitÂ prakāreṇa samprasāraṇamupapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ
tataścāsatyasminÂ yoge vavraśceti yadrūpaṃ bhavati satyapi tadeveti
nāsti vṛścaterviśeṣaḥ| etacca vṛtikāramatenoktamÂ|
bhāṣyakāramatena tvāha--ṭhyogārambe' ityādi| tasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ--sati
vaca'nenyārtho kriyamāṇe tasya vṛścatyarthatāpi bhavati; vṛścaterahapi
grahyādiṣvantarbhāvātÂ| tataśca tadartho'pyayaṃ yogārambha iti
tadabhyāsasyāpi samprasāraṇena bhavitavyamiti tuśabdo
vṛtikāramatādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| ṭhyadi samprasāraṇamakṛtvā' ityādi|
nanu cobhayagrahamasya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati--halādiśeṣaṃ (7.4.60) paramapi
bādhitva#a samprasāraṇameva yathā syāditadi, tatÂ kuto'sya pakṣasya
sambhavaḥ? ubhayagrahaṇarahite yoge satītyabhiprāyaḥ| ṭhatha rephasya'
ityādi| ubhayagrahaṇasahite yoge satīti bhāvaḥ| ṭhuradatvasya
sthānivadbhāvātÂ' iti| kena punaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ? ṭhacaḥ
parasminÂ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti| kaḥ punarasau? pratyayo'caḥ
paraḥ, yannimitamoratvaṃ syātÂ| ahgasya yo'bhyāsa iti vijñāyamāne
sāmarthyātÂ pratyaya āśrito bhavati; vinā tenāhgavyapadeśābhāvātÂ
vṛtikāramataṃ ceṣitavyamÂ; anyathā tatrobhayagrahaṇābhāvātÂ
halādiśeṣeṇa (7.4.60) prāgeva samprasāraṇādrephe nivartite vakārasya
samprasāraṇaṃ syātÂ| tataśca uvraścetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syātÂ| 
ṭhpṛccchatibhṛjjatyīraviśeṣaḥ' iti| graheriva veditavyaḥ| ṭhakidarthamÂ'
ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamakidarthaṃ midaṃ vyākhyeyamÂ? ityata
āha--ṭhkiti' ityādi| yasmātÂ kiti paratvātÂ samprasāraṇa kṛte
kṛtasamprasāraṇasya punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādÂdvirvacane
kṛte'ntareṇāpyetadvacanamÂ, ūcaturityādi siddhyatyeva|
tasmānnedaṃ kidarthamÂ, api tvakidarthameveti| 
atha kimarthamubhayeṣāmityucyate, yāvatā
svaritaliṅgāsaṅgādevobhayeṣāmityasyānuvṛtirbhaviṣyati? na
cānuvṛtau satyāṃ ṅiti vacyādīnāmapi samprasāraṇaṃ
prāpnotītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyamÂ; yadi vacyādīnāmapi ṅiti
samprasāraṇaṃ syādyogavibhāgo'narthakaḥ syātÂ; maṇḍūakaplutinyāyena
vā vracyādīnāmanuvṛtirbhaviṣyati, tatkuto'sya doṣasyāvasaraḥ?
ityāha--ṭhadhikārādeva' ityādi| adhikārādevobhayagrahaṇe siddhe
punarubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇātÂ punaḥśrutirbhavati| tasyāścaitadeva
prayojanamÂ---yatra samprasāraṇaṃ cānyacca prāpnoti tatra
samprasāraṇameva yathā syātÂ, mā bhūdanyaditi| tena vivyādha,
vivyadhitha ityatra halādiśeṣaṃ (7.4.60) paramapi bādhitvā
samprasāraṇameva bhavati; anyathātra paratvātÂ prākÂ pravartamānena
halādiśeṣeṇa yakārasya nivṛtau kṛtāyāṃ vakārasya
samprasāraṇamāpadyeta, tataśca--uvyādha uvyadhithetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syātÂ||

23. styaḥ prapūrvasya| (6.1.23)
ṭhsāmānyena grahaṇamÂ' ti| dvayorapyātve kṛte pūrvasya ṭhdhātvādeḥ
ṣaḥ saḥ (6.1.64) iti satve samānatvādrūpasya|
lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.3) ca nehopatadiṣṭhate;
ubhayolakṣiṇikatvātÂ| athātra--ṭhsaṃyogāderāto dhātoryaṇvataḥ'
(8.2.43) iti niṣṭhānatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--ṭhsamprasāraṇe'
ityādi| na tvasya pūrvatrāsiddhatvātÂ pūrvaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ kriyata iti,
tatra kṛte ca yaṇvatā nāstīti natvaṃ na bhavati| 
ṭhprastya ityevaṃ siddhe' iti| nanu caivamucyamāne praśabdasyāpi
samprasāraṇaṃ syātÂ, tataśca prastīta iti rūpaṃ syātÂ, tatÂ
kimucyate--prastya ityevaṃ siddha iti? ṭhanantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya'
(vyā.pa.63) iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣa iti manyate| ṭhihāpi yathā syātÂ'
iti| kasmātÂ punarna prāpnoti? saṃśabdena vyavahitatvātÂ| 
kiṃ pūrvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe śabdārthaṃ eva tathāvido bhavati yenātrāpi
bhavati? atha granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ sūcayatītyābhiprāyeṇāha--ṭhtatÂ
kathamÂ' iti| prathamakalpaṃ darśannāha--ṭhprapūrvasya' iti| ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷrthe
bahuvrīhiḥ' iti| pūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacana iti ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe
bahuvrīhirbhavati| avayavavācini pūrvaśabde dhāturanyapadārtho
nopapadyate| na hi dhātoḥ praśabdo'yamavayavo bhavati, api tu
dhātūpasargasamudāyasya| tasmātÂ sa evānyapadārtho yukta ityāha--ṭhpraḥ
pūrvo yasya' ityādi| ṭhtadavayavasya' iti| tasyāvayavastadavayava iti
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| taccchabdena dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ parāmṛśyate|
ṭhvyadhikaraṇaṣaṣṭhÂayau' iti| ṭhprapūrvasya' iti| styāvayavāpekṣayā
yo'yamavayavāvayavisambandhastatra ṣaṣṭhī, ṭhstyaḥ' ityeṣā tu
yaṇavayavāpekṣayā yaḥ sambandhastatra| tena bhinnābhideyatvātÂ ṭhsatyaḥ',
ṭhpravūrvasya' iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhÂayau| syādevamÂ, prasaṃstīta
ityatra prapūrvasamudāyāvayavaḥ styāśabdo na sambhavati ityata
āha--ṭhtatra' ityādi|| 

24. dravamūrtisparśayoḥ śyaḥ| (6.1.24)
ṭhdravamūrtau dravakāṭhinye' iti| anena dravamūrtiśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe|
dravāvasthāyā utaro'vasthāviśeṣaḥ kāṭhinyākhyo'tra
dravamūrtiśabdenocyate| 
ṭhsparśe ca' iti| rūpādisahacarito guṇaḥ sparśa ityucyate|
ṭhśītamudakam' iti| kathaṃ punaratra sāmānādhikaraṇyamÂ, yāvatā
śītaśabdena guṇaviśeṣo'bhidhīyate| vāyvādiśabdena tu dravyaviśeṣa
ityata āha--ṭhguṇamātre' ityādi| yathā--śuklādiśabdā
kadācidguṇamātre vartante, yatā--paṭasya śukla iti; kadācitu
tadvati dravye
so'yamityabhedasambandhatadvānmatublopānmatvarthīyākārapratyayāntatvādvā śuklaḥ paṭa iti, tathā śītaśabdo'pi| tena yadā tadvati dravye vartate, tadobhayorekadravye niveśitatvādupapadyate sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti bhāvaḥ| ṭhsaṃśyānaḥ' iti| ṭhsaṃyogādeḥ' (8.2.43) ityādinā natvamÂ||

26. vibhāṣā'bhyavapūrvasya| (6.1.26)
ṭhseyamubhayatra vibhāṣā' iti| dravamūrtisparśaviṣaye pūrveṇa prāpte,
anyatrāprāpte| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamÂ, na ṭhvibhāṣā'bhyavābhyāmÂ'

dvividho'pi samudāyo nābhipūrvaḥ; nāpyavapūrvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi?
sampūrvaḥ| tena pūrvagrahaṇādatra na bhavati| kriyamāṇe'pi pūrvagrahaṇe
prāpnotyeveti manyamānaḥ kilaśabdamarucisūcanārthaṃ prayuktavānÂ|
tāmeva prāpti darśayannāha--ṭhyo'tra' ityādi| samūśabdātÂ paro yo
dhātūpasargasamudāyastadāśrayo vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati, bhavati
hyasāvabyavapūrva ityasti prāpti? ata āha--ṭhyatnāntaramāstheyamÂ' iti|
vibhāṣāgrahaṇamiha kriyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate,
teneha na bhavatīti yatanāntaramÂ| ṭhpūrvagrahaṇasya cānyatprayojanaṃ
vaktavyamÂ' iti| tatÂ punarabhisaṃśīnamÂ, abhisaṃśyānamÂ,
avasaṃśīnamÂ, avasaṃśyānamÂ--ityatrāpi vikalpo yathā syādityevaṃ
tadveditavyamÂ| etacca pūrvagrahaṇae kriyamāṇe yatopapadyate tathā ṭhstyaḥ
prapūrvasya' (6.1.23) ityatra ṭhprapūrvasyeti ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe bahuvrīhiḥ'

27. śrutaṃ pāke| (6.1.27)
ṭhṭhśrā pāke' ityasya dhātoḥ' iti| ṭhśrā pāke' (dhā.pā.1053) ityadādau
paṭhaḷte ghaṭādau (dhā.pā.810) ca mitsaṃjñārthamÂ| kaiściccurādāvapi,
ṭhśrai pāke' (dhā.pā.919) iti bhvādau, tatrehāviśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ
prāptamÂ| śrāyaterapi hi kṛtātvasyaitadrūpaṃ bhavatyeva| nipātanācca
lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.3) pratibandhaṃ na karoti|
ṭhṇantasyāṇyantasya ca' iti| viśeṣānupādānātÂ| tathā
coktamÂ--śrāśrapyoḥ śrṛtamiti|
yadi vibhāṣetyanuvartate kṣīrahaviṣorapi pakṣe śrāṇamÂ,
śrapitamiti syātÂ; tābhyāmanyatrāpi pakṣe śrṛtamiti prasajyeta? ityata
āha--ṭhvyavasthitavibhāṣeyamÂ' iti| 
ṭhyadāpi' ityādi| prayojakavyāpāraḥ preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādiḥ kārye
kāraṇopacāraṃ kṛtvā prayojakaśabdenoktaḥ| sa hi
prākṛtādarthādbāhyae bhavati, tatra tasyānantarbhāvātÂ| tatra yadā
ṭhhetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti dvitīyo ṇijutpadyate, tadāpi
kṣīrahaviṣorapi nipātanametanneṣyate;
vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādeva| tathā coktamÂ--śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra
hatoriti| hetumāṇṇico'nyatretyarthaḥ| dvitīyagrahaṇaṃ yadaikameva
bhavati, tadeṣṭatvācÂ śrapitaṃ kṣīraṃ devadatena yajñadateneti
tatprayojako hetuśca' (1.4.55) iti cakārāddevadatayajñadatayoḥ
kartṛ saṃjñāvidhānādubhayatrāpi kartari tṛtīyā| ṭhśrapitamÂ' iti|
śrāterṇica kṛte ṭhartihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā pukÂ, ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ'
(6.4.92) kṣīraṃ svayameva śrāti sma--tadyadā devadatadena prayujyate sma
tadā ṭhhetumati ca (3.1.26) iti prathamo ṇicÂ| so'pi śrapayanÂ yadā
yajñadatena prayujyate sma tadā dvitīyaḥ| ṭhṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti
pūrvasya ṇerlopaḥ, tataḥ kṣīre prayojye karmaṇi niṣṭhā--śrṛtamiti| 
ṭhṇyantasyāṇyāntasya ca nipātyete' iti pratijñāte sati yuktaṃ
ṇyantasyāpyetannipātanamÂ--yeṣāṃ śrātiścurādāvapi paṭhaḷte
ityabhyupagamaḥ| ye tu curādāvasya pāṭhṃa na pratijānate teṣāṃ kathaṃ
ṇyantasyetannipātanaṃ yujyate, na ca śakyate vaktumÂ--teṣāmapi
hetumaṇṇyantarayaitannipātanaṃ yujyate; ṭhśrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetauḥ'
iti bhāṣyakāravacanāditi yaścodayetÂ, taṃ pratyāha--ṭhśrātirayamÂ'
ityādi| karmabhāvāpanne'pi yo'rthaḥ saukaryyātÂ svātantryeṇa
vivakṣyate sa karmakartā, karma kartā bhavatīti kṛtvā| karma cāsau
kartā ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, sa yasya viṣayaḥ sa karmakartṛviṣayaḥ|
arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ paceḥ karmakartṛviṣayatvaṃ
veditavyamÂ| tasya yo'rthaḥ pacyamānakartṛkatvaṃ vikledanamātraṃ
tatrāyamakarmakaḥ--śrātirvartate| yadā tu sa ṇyanto bhavati tadā
prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha| prakṛtau bhavaḥ prākṛtaḥ, sa punaryaḥ prakṛtyantasya
pacerarthaḥ paktṛkartṛko vikledanopasaṃhārādiḥ sa iha veditavyaḥ|
devadatādipaktṛkartṛkaṃ prākṛtaṃ pākākhyaṃ pacyarthamāhetyarthaḥ| tatra
dvayorapi śṛtamiṣyata iti yo'ṇyantaḥ śrātiḥ karmakartṛviṣayeṇa
pacinā samānārthastratrāpīṣyate| yo'pi ṇyantaḥ prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha
tatrāpīṣyate| tatra śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ svayameveti prathamasyodāharaṇamÂ|
śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ devadateneti dvitīyasya| nanu ca ṭhśrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra
hetoḥ' iti bhāṣye uktamÂ, tatÂ kathaṃ dvayorapīṣyate? evaṃ
manyate--yadidaṃ bhāṣye uktamÂ--ṭhśrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetoḥ' iti, tatra
ṭhanyatra hetoḥ' ityanena sarvasya hetumaṇṇicaḥ paryudāso na
vidhitsitaḥ anyathā vipratiṣiddhamidaṃ syātÂ, asati hi
śrāteścurādau pāṭhe yadi śrapeḥ śṛtamiti nipātyate, kathamanyatra
hetoriti paryudāsaḥ! athānyatra hetoriti paryudāso na tarhi
śrapeḥ śṛtamiti nipātanamupapadyate| na hi śrāteścurādāvasata pāṭhe
śrāterhetumaṇṇicaṃ tyatkvā'nyastato ṇijasti| tasmādyasya
hetumaṇṇico na kenacitÂ prakāreṇa svārthikatvamupapadyate sa eva
bhāṣyakārasya paryudāsaviṣayatvenābhīṣṭaḥ| sa punaryo bāhyae prayojake
dvitīyo ṇijutpadyate sa vijñeyaḥ| yasya tu kenacitÂ prakāreṇa
svārthikatvamupapadyate, sa eva bhāṣyakārasya paryudāsaviṣayatvena na
prakalpyate, tasyaitannipātanamiṣṭameva| sa punaryasminnutpanne śrātiḥ
prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha sa vijñeyaḥ, śakyate hi tasya pacinā prakṛtyarthena
samānārthatvātÂ svārthikatvamupacāreṇābhidhātumiti| tadevamiha
pāṭhe'pi curādau śrāterṇyantasyāpyetannipātanaṃ yujyata eveti|| 
28. pyāyaḥ pī| (6.1.28)
ṭhpīnamÂ' iti| ṭhoditaśca' (8.2.45) iti niṣṭhānatvamÂ| 
ṭhityamapi' ityādi| apiśabdena na kevalaṃ pūrvasūtre yā vibhāṣā saiva
vyavasthitavibhāṣā, api tveṣāpīti darśayati| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati?
ityāha--ṭhtena' ityādi| sopasargasya tu naiva
bhavatītyasyāpavādamāha--ṭhāṅpūrvasya' ityādi|
nityaścāyamandhūdhasoḥ pībhāvaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣaiva|| 

29. liṅyaṅeśca| (6.1.29)
ṭhvibhāṣeti nivṛtamÂ' iti| utarasūtre punarvibhāṣāgrahaṇātÂ|
anyathāpīdameva tatrānuvartiṣyata iti tanna kuryātÂ| ata
evocyate--dvayordibhāṣayārmadhye ye vidhayaste nityā bhavantīti|
ṭhpyāyaḥ pītyetaccaśabdenānukṛṣyate' iti| itarathā hi samprasāraṇasya
prakṛtatvālliṅyaṅeḥ pyāyaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ vijñāyeta| caśabde tu
satyanantareṇaivapībhāvena sambandhaḥ sukhamavasīyate| nāprāpte
dvirvacane pībhāvo vidhīyate| tena tasya bādhakaṃ prāpnotīti
kasyacidāśaṅkā syātÂ| atastāṃ nirākartumāha--ṭhparatvātÂ'

ataḥ paratvātÂ pībhāve kṛte punaḥprasaṅgavajñānātÂ siddhamiti
dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti||

30. vibhāṣā śveḥ| (6.1.30)

ṭhśuśuvatuḥ, śiśviyatuḥ, iti| yadā samprasāraṇaṃ tadovaṅÂ,
anyadeyaṅ| ṭhaprāptamÂ' iti| kenacivavihitatvātÂ| 
ṭhliṭaḷbhyāsasyobhayeṣāmÂ' (6.1.17) ityubhayatrobhayagrahaṇādanyatÂ
