syādityetadubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanamuktamÂ| tataśceyamapi
vikalpaṃ bādhitvā nityaṃ samprasāraṇa meva syāditi kasyacidbhrāntiḥ
syātÂ atastāṃ nirākartumāha--ṭhyadā ca' ityādi| atra
śvayatervibhāṣā samprasāraṇamucyate, yadi kadāciddhātorna samprasāraṇaṃ
bhavati tadābyāsasya syātÂ tataśca śvayateḥ samprasāraṇaṃ pākṣikaṃ na
kṛtaṃ syātÂ| syādetatÂ--liṭparasya śakyateridaṃ vikalpena kāryaṃ

dvirvacane kriyāmātraṃ bhidyate, na dhāturūpamiti kutaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ

31. ṇau ca saṃścaṅeḥ| (6.1.31)
ṭhṇau ca saṃścaṅeḥ' iti bhinnādhikaraṇe saptamyau---saṃścaṅeḥ parato
yo ṇistasmiṃṇṇau parato yaḥ śvayatiriti| ṭhśuśāvayiṣati' iti|

codāhṛtamÂ? ityāha--ṭhsamprasāraṇamÂ' ityādi| ādiśabdenāyāveśaḥ

86. ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ| (6.1.86)

śasÂ utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? strībahutve; puṃso'pi yuktavadbhāvena
strītvātideśātÂ| tato'tra natvaṃ na bhavati| 
dīrghagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtamÂ, tasya cehārthavaśena pañcamyantasyopasathāne

107. ami pūrvaḥ| (6.1.107)

112. khyatyātparasya| (6.1.112)

115. prakṛtyā'ntaḥpādamavyapare| (6.1.115)

145. goṣpadaṃ sevitāsevitapramāṇeṣu| (6.1.145)
ṭhtasya ca ṣatvamÂ' iti| anādeśapratyayasakāratvātÂ suṭaḥ ṣatvaṃ na
prāpnotītyatastadapi nipātyate| ṭhgāvaḥ padyante' ityādinā deśasya

upātaḥ, tatÂ kasmādasevite'goṣpadādīnītyādyaudāhriyate?
ityāha--ṭhasevite' ityādi| nanu ca goṣpadaśabdaḥ sūtra upātaḥ, tatÂ
kasmādasevite'goṣpadādīnītyādyaudāhriyate? ityāha--ṭhasevite'

ṭhyadyevamÂ' iti| yadyasevite'goṣpadārthaṃ nipātanamityarthaḥ| ṭhnārtha
etena' iti| asevitagrahaṇena| kathaṃ tena vinā sidhyati?
ityāha--ṭhgoṣpadapratiṣedhātÂ'tyādi| ṭhsatyamevaitatÂ' iti|

etena' ityasyārthaḥ| yadi tarhi satyamevaitatÂ' tatÂ kimarthaṃ
sevitagrahaṇamiha kriyate? ityāha--ṭhyatra tu' ityādi|

svabhāvādutarapadarthasadṛśamarthamācaṣṭe' abrāhmaṇavatÂ| tataśca na
goṣpadamagoṣpadamiti tatpuruṣe kṛte yatra sevitasaya sevanasya
prasaṅgo'sti tatraivāgoṣpadamityetatÂ tathāpi bhavati' iti|
apiśabdo na kevalaṃ yatra sevataprasaṅgo'sti
tatraivāgoṣpadamityamumarthaṃ dyotayati| kasmātÂ?
punaratrāsevitagrahaṇātÂ| tatrā'pi bhavatītyata āha--ṭhyāni hi' iti|

bhāvasādhanenāsevitaśabdena vijñāsyate| avidyamānaṃ sevitamasminniti

gavāmatyantāsambhavastānyaraṇyānyāsevitaśabdenocyante| tataśca
tatrāpyagoṣpadamiti bhavati| 
ṭhgoṣpadapūramÂ' iti| ṭhvarṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyāmÂ'
(3.4.32) iti ṇamulÂ| nanu ca goṣpadamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yamÂ, tasya
ca gosambandhi padamarthaḥ, na tu pramāṇamÂ, tatÂ kathaṃ goṣpadamātraṃ
kṣetramityādi udāharaṇaṃ pramāṇe yujyatade? ityata āha--ṭhnātra'
ityādi| na hyatra svārthapratipādanārthameva goṣpadamityupādīyate| kiṃ
tarhi? kṣetrāderiyatāṃ paricchetumÂ| tasmātÂ kṣetrāderiyatā tena

nipātanasāmarthyātÂ| nipātanaṃ hi vastvaprasiddhamapyupādate||

bhavati, na tu parasyeta kimatra nopapadyate| ṭhiha ca' ityādi| pacāvaḥ
pacāmaḥ ityatra hi ṭhato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti dīrghatve kṛte na
syātÂ asatyupadeśagrahaṇe| tasmiṃstu sati śabakāro'pi mātrika
evopadiṣṭa iti yadyapyutarakāla dīrghatvaṃ bhavati tathāpi nighāto na
bhavatīti| ṭhiha ca mā bhūditi--hataḥ; hatha' iti| atra ṭhanudātopadeśa'
(6.4.37) ityādinā'nunāsikalope satyupadeśātparaṃ lasārvadhātukaṃ

iti| ṭhtācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaśÂ' (3.2.129) na ca sa lādeśaḥ,
api tu pratyayaḥ| lasarvadhātukatvaṃ tvasya na vidyate| ṭhśiśye' iti|
śīṅe hyātmanepade rūpamÂ, ṭheranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā
yaṇādeśaḥ| ṭhliṭÂ ca' (3.4.115) ityārdhadhātukametatÂ| ṭhśiśyāte'
iti| liṭaḷatāmi rūpamÂ| nānudātatvamÂ,
asārvadhātukasaṃjñāvidhānātÂ| ṭhhrau te, yadadhīte' iti| ṭhhrau ṅÂ
apanayane' (dhā.pā.1082) ṭhiṅÂ adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1046) yaccchabdasya

tasmādetajjñāpayati--pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ syātÂ, kartavyamevedaṃ vacanaṃ
syātÂ| pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhatvātÂ, kṛtañca|
tasmādetajjñāpayati--pratyayalakṣaṇamiha svaravidhau na bhavatīti|
kvacidgrahaṇaṃ kvacitu bhavatīti pradarśanārthamÂ, tathā hi ṭhsarvasya
supi' (6.1.191) ityatroktamÂ--pratyayalakṣaṇenāpyayaṃ svara iṣyata iti|

22. pūrvo bhūtapūrve| (6.2.22)
ṭhāḍhyo bhūtapūrvaḥ' iti| yaḥ pūrvamāḍhaḷ āsītÂ sa evamucyate|
samāse gamyamānārthatvādbhūtaśabdo na prayajyate, yathā--dadhyodana
ityatropasiktaśabdaḥ| 
ṭhparamapūrvaḥ' iti| atra ṭhsanmahatÂ' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsaḥ| ṭhatra
paramaścāsau pūrvaśceti samāsaḥ' iti| itikaraṇo'rthanirdeaśārthaḥ|
paramaścasau pūrvaśceti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ pūjyamānatālakṣaṇaḥ,
tasminniha pratyudāharaṇe samāsa ityarthaḥ| ṭhna tu paramo bhūtaḥ' iti|
tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| paramo bhūtapūrva iti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ
paramapūrvakālalakṣaṇaḥ, tasminnevātara samāsa ityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇamÂ?
ityāha--ṭhtathā ca' ityādi| caśabdo hi hītyarthe| ayaṃ samāso na
bhavati| evaṃ satyadāharaṇamevedaṃ bhavati, na pratyudāharaṇamÂ,
pūrvaśabdasya bhūtapūrvavācitvātÂ| yastu prāyeṇa pustakeṣu
pāṭho'tra ṭhparamaścāsau bhūtapūrvaśceti vigraho na tu paramo
bhūtapūrvaḥ' iti; sa pramādapāṭho veditavyaḥ; vākyadvaye'pi
bhūtapūrvayorgamyamānatvātÂ|| 

23. savidhasanīḍasamaryādasaveśasadeśeṣu sāmīpye| (6.2.23) 
saha viṣayā savidhaḥ, ṭhtena saheti tulyayoge' (2.2.28) iti

sanīḍādiṣvapi bahuvrīhiḥ sabhāvaśca veditavyaḥ| madrasavidhamityādayaḥ
ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ|

ityādi| ādiśabdena saha nīḍena saha maryādayetyevamādīnāṃ

ṭhprasthadhanamÂ' iti| ayamapi karmadhārayaḥ| bahuvrīhirvā| prasthaśabdo
bhavati parimāṇaṃ, na tu hiraṇyasaya, kiṃ tarhi? dhānyādeḥ|
ṭhkāñcanadhanamÂ' iti| yadi parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā
ṭhhiraṇyamÂ' ityetādaducyamāna ihāpi syātÂ; kāñcanaśabdasya
hiraṇyavācitvātÂ| hiraṇyavācyapi parimāṇavācī na bhavatīti na
bhavatyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| ayamapi samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ||

56. prathamo'ciropasampatau| (6.2.56)

abhinavavaiyākaraṇādinā'cirakālopasampatimudāharaṇe darśayati| 
ṭhādyo mukhyo yaḥ saḥ' iti| anenāpi pratyudāharaṇaviṣayasya

57. katarakatamau karmadhāraye| (6.2.57)

nityaśabda ābhīkṣṇye, na kūṭasthe| kuta etatÂ? kta ityucyate, ktaśca

bhavitavyamÂ| tasmātÂ ṭhsatatamiti yadā bhāve ktastadā thāthādi

hi satataśabdo'pi thāthādisvareṇāntodātaḥ (6.2.144)| bhāve hīyaṃ

65. saptamīhāriṇau dharmye'haraṇe| (6.2.65)

yogyāśanādikaṃ dātavyamiti| tena haraṇaśabdo dharmyavācī bhavati|
tathāpyaharaṇa iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| tataśca kṛtsvare prāpte ṭhano
bhāvakarmavacanaḥ' (6.2.150) ityutarapadaṃ lyuḍantamantodātaṃ bhavati|

pratiṣedhena? ityata āha--ṭhparo'pi' ityādi| tenetyādinā jñāpanasya

haraṇapratiṣedho na kriyeta, tadā paratvātÂ ṭhgatikārakopapadātÂ

asmiṃstu satyayameva hārisvaro bhavati| stūpeśāṇa ityādau yatra

pūrvavadādyaudātamidamucyate| 
pūrvapadāni ca prāyeṇāntodātāni, tathā hi--ṭhsṭūapa samucchrāye'
(dhā.pā.1672) ityasya caurādikasya pacādyaci stūpaśabdo vyutpādyate,

bhavati| ṭhekādeśa udātenodātaḥ' (8.2.5) iti| ṭhmaki maṇḍane'
(dhā.pā.89) ityetasmātÂ ṭhuṇādayo bahulamÂ', (3.3.1)

68. pāpaṃ ca śilpini| (6.2.68)

bahulamÂ' (2.1.32) iti bahulavacanādakṛtāpi samāsaḥ| ṭhtṛtīyā'

71. bhaktakhyāstadartheṣu| (6.2.71)
ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārthamÂ| nanu ca bahuvacanādeva

72. gobiḍālāsiṃhasaindhaveṣūpamāne| (6.2.72)
upamānaśabdo'yaṃ gavādibhiḥ pratyekamabhimasambadhyate;
anyathaikavacanāntasya bahuvacanāntaiḥ samānādhikaraṇena
viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo na syātÂ| tha vā subvyatyaye
bahuvacanasyaiva sthāna idamekavacanaṃ draṣṭavyamÂ| ṭhdhānyagavaḥ' iti|
ṭhgorataddhitaluki' (5.4.91) ṭaca samāsāntaḥ| atra citsvare prāpte
pūrvapadasyādyaudātatavaṃ vidhīyate| ṭhbhikṣābiḍālaḥ' ityevamādau
samāsasvare| upamānārtho'pi' ityādi| yo'yamatrodāharaṇe

yasyopamānasyārthasya ca loke prasiddhiḥ sa tathā yojayitavyaḥ| tatra
diṅmātramupamānārthayojanasya
darśayitumāha--gavākṛtiḥugosaṃsthānamÂ, tayā sanniveśitaṃ
goryatsaṃsthānaṃ tena sanniveśitaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ
dhānyagavaśabdenocyate; tulyākṛtitvātÂ| evamanyatrāpi yatÂ
kiñcitÂ sādṛśyaṃ yojyamÂ| yathā goracanāviśeṣāvayavānāmevaṃ
yasya hiraṇyasya taddhiraṇyaṃ hiraṇyagavaśabdenocyate| yathā biḍālā
alpapramāṇāstathā hi bhikṣā, yathā vā biḍālāḥ kvacidbhavanti na
sarvatra tathā bhikṣāpi| evaṃ śrāṇābiḍālayoḥ sādṛśyamevañjātīyakaṃ
yojayitavyamÂ| siṃhākṛtyā sanniviṣṭaṃ tṛṇaṃ tṛṇasiṃhaḥ| yathā
saindhavaṃ śuklamevaṃ saktuḥ saktusa#Ṭndhavaḥ| evaṃ pānasaindhavaḥ||

80. upamānaṃ śabdārthaprakṛtāveva| (6.2.80)
ṭhśabdārthaprakṛtau' iti| śabdārthaḥ prakṛtiryasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ|

[āhvāne rodane ca--dhā.pā.ṭ ityasmātÂ ṭhkartaryupamāne' (3.2.79)
iti ṇiniḥ| ṇininaiva sādṛśyasyoktatvādvṛtāvivaśabdo na prayujyate|
ṭhdhvāṅkṣarāvī' iti| ṭhru śabde' (dhā.pā.1034) pūrvalakṣaṇāṇṇiniḥ|
ṭhkharanādī' iti| ṭhṇada avyakte śabde' (dhā.pā.54)|
ṭhupamānagrahaṇamÂ' ityādi| yadyaupamānagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā pūrvasya
yogasyāsya ca viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyeta| yadi
yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyādviṣayāntaramya kalpyeta, tathāpīṣṭo
viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyeta| upamānagrahaṇe tu sati pūrvasya sāmānyaṃ
viṣayaḥ, asya tu viśeṣa upamānamiti viṣayavibhāgo niścīyeta|
tena viṣayavibhāgārthamupamānagrahaṇamÂ| 
ṭhvṛkavañcī' iti| ṭhvañcu pralambhane' (dhā.pā.1703)| ṭhvṛkaprekṣī' iti|
ṭhīkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610) prapūrvaḥ| atra kṛtsvara eva bhavati|
ṭhprakṛtireva' ityādi| yadi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā
śabdārthātÂ paro yo ṇinistadanta utarapada ityevaṃ vijñāyeta?
tataśca gardabhoccārī kokilābhivyāhārītyasyāpi syātÂ; bhavati
hyatrāpi dhātūpasargasamudāyāccchabdārthātÂ paro ṇiniḥ,
atastadantamutatarapadamÂ| tasmādiha mā bhūditi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ
kriyate, teneha na bhavati| prakṛtigrahaṇe sati yatropasarganirapekṣā
gatyarthatvātÂ, harateśca haraṇārthatvātÂ| yadvā--yo'tra śabdārtho
dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ, na tasmāṇṇinervidhānamÂ| 
yadi pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanamÂ, evaṃ siddhe
vidhirārabhyamāṇo niyamāya bhavatītyanarthakamevakārakaraṇamÂ?
ityāha--ṭhevakārakaraṇamÂ' ityādi| asati hyaevakāra upamāna eva
śabdārthaprakṛtāvityevamavadhāraṇaṃ syātÂ, tataśca śabdārthaprakṛtireva
niyamyeta--śabdārthaprakṛtau yadi bhavatyupamāna eva bhavati,
nānupamāna iti| tataścānupamāne na syātÂ|
tasmādupamānāvadhāraṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamevakāraḥ kriyate| kiṃ
kāraṇamÂ? ityāha--ṭhśabdārthaprakṛtau tu' ityādi| tuśabdo hetau|
tasmātÂ śabdārthaprakṛtāvupamānamanupamānaṃ cādyaudātaṃ bhavati|
tasmādupamānāvadhāraṇārthamevakārakaraṇamÂ| upamānaniyame hi sati
śabdārthaprakṛteraniyatatvātÂ tatrāviśeṣeṇa sarvasyādyaudātatvaṃ
labhyate| ṭhsiṃhavinardī' iti| upamānasyodāhaṇamÂ| ṭhpuṣkalajalpī'
iti| anupamānasya| puṣkalajalpītyatra ṭhvrate' (3.2.80)

81. yuktārohyādayaśca| (6.2.81)

93. saṃrva guṇakārtsnye| (6.2.93)
ṭhguṇakārtsnye' iti| guṇakārtsnya guṇasya sarvatrābhāvaḥ|
ṭhsarvaśvetaḥ' iti| ṭhpūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā

ṭhparamaśvetaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punaratra guṇakārtsnye paramaśabdo vartate,

ityata āha--ṭhāśrayavyāptyā' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau|

tasyotkarṣa upapadyate yadi sarvamāśrayaṃ vyāpnoti|
tasmādguṇakārtsnyaṃ iha paramaśabdo vartate| ṭhsarvasauvarṇaḥ,
sarvarājataḥ' iti| suvarṇasya vikāraḥ sauvarṇaḥ, rajatasya vikāro
rājataḥ--nātra guṇakārtsnyamÂ, kiṃ tarhi? jātiyuktasya vikāravaṣayaṃ
kārtsnyamÂ| sarva hi vikāradravyaṃ prakṛtibhāvena vyāpnotīti
dravyakārtsnyamiha, tatra ca sarvaśabdo vartate| ṭhsarveṣāṃ śvetataraḥ
sarvaśvetaḥ' iti| atra guṇakārtsnye| kathaṃ punaratra samāsaḥ, yāvatā
ṭhpūraṇagaṇasuhita' (2.2.11) ityādinā guṇavacanena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ
pratiṣiddhaḥ? athāpi kathañcitÂ samāsaḥ syātÂ, evamapi śvetataraśabdena
samāse kṛte sarvaśvetataramiti vaktavyamÂ? ityata āha--ṭhguṇātÂ
tareṇa samāsaḥ' ityādi| āṬpasaṃkhyānikāviha samāsataralopāviti
darśayati| samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamutare'pi yogāḥ| ṭhna

95. kumāryāṃ vayasi| (6.2.95)
ṭhvṛddhakumārī' iti| ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' (2.1.57) iti samāsaḥ|

(4.1.20) iti ṅībatra vihitaḥ, vṛddhājaratīśabdau carame vayasi vartate,

vayoviśeṣo'ntyaṃ vayaḥ| kathaṃ punarviśeṣavacanaṃ sāmānye vartate?
vayograhaṇasāmarthyātÂ| yadi vṛddhakumārīśabdaḥ prathame vayasi vartate
vayograhaṇamanarthakaṃ syātÂ| yatara kumārīśabdaḥ prayujyate
prathamavayovācī, tatra niyogato vayo gamyata eveti kiṃ
vayograhaṇena! tasmādvayograhaṇasāmarthyātÂ yathoktena prakāreṇa
vayaḥsāmānye pravartate| vayograhaṇena hi tasmādviśeṣādapanīyāsau
sāmānyavṛtirāśrīyate| ṭhtacca vaya iha gṛhyate' iti| yatra vartamāno
viśeṣavacanaiḥ saha samānādhikaraṇo bhavati, tacca vayo gṛhyate|
caśabdādanyacca yauvanādīnakumāratvameveti, na prathamavaya ityarthaḥ| 
ṭhparamakumārī' iti| atra samāsātÂ pūjyamānatā; pūjyamānatvaṃ tu
darśanīyatvātÂ| darśanīyā kanyetyarthaḥ| na hyatra samāso

kriyate? ityāha--ṭhsamāse kṛte' ityādi| samāse kṛte sati tasya

dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti supo luki prāpte
pratiṣedho'yamucyate| 
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamekavacanāntānāṃ stokādīnāmalugudāhriyate, na
dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmÂ? ityāha--ṭhdvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmÂ'
ityādi| vṛtau hi viśeṣaṇapadānyekatvādikāṃ saṃkhyāṃ
vihāyābhedaikatvasaṃkhyāṃ pratipadyante| sā punaḥ
sakhyānamātramanupātasaṃkhyāviśeṣaṃ sāmānyabhūtamÂ; yata evamato
vivakṣitārthānabhidhānādadvivacanabahuvacanāntanāṃ samāso na
bhavatyeva| abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛtaddhitasamāsā bhavantīti| ṭhtena'
ityādi| yata evaṃ dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ stokādīnāṃ samāso na
bhavati, tena stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ, stokebhyo mukta ityatra na
kadācidaikapadyamaikasvarya ca bhavati| stokābhyāmityasmāddhi padānmukta
ityetatÂ padamanyadevātyantabhinnamÂ, tathā stekebhya ityasmānÂ mukta
ityetatÂ| svaro'pyatrāneka eva| tathā hi--ṭhstokābhyāmÂ' ityetatÂ
prātipadikasvarema madhyodātamÂ, ṭhmuktaḥ' ityetatÂ
pratyayasvareṇāntodātamÂ| evamÂ ṭhstokebhyo muktaḥ' ityatrāpi
nānāsvaratā veditavyā| mūlodāharaṇe tu samāse satyekapadyaṃ
bhavati, svaro'pyeka eva| tathā
hi--thāthādi(6.2.144)sūtreṇātrāntodātatvamÂ| 
yadi dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ samāso na bhavatīha tarhi kathaṃ
bhavati--goṣucaraḥ varṣāsuja iti? vivakṣitārthābhidhānātÂ|
anabhidhānaṃ hyasamāse heturuktaḥ, iha tu vivakṣitārthasyārthasya
bahuvacanasyābhidhānamastyeva| yatra hyabhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate, tatra
saṃkhyāviśeṣasyābhidhānaṃ na bhavati, na
cātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| tataśca
vivakṣitārthābhidānādabhedaikatvasaṃkhyā nopapadyate| tathā
hi--goṣucara ityatra gośabdo'psu vartate, sa cāpo'bhidadhāno
bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭa evābhidadhāti, apśabdavatÂ| varṣāsuja
iti--varṣāśabdo'pi kālaviśeṣe bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭa eva vartate|
ataḥ prāpipadikenaiva bahutvasaṃkhyāyā
āśritatvānnātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| yadi tu jāyeta, tadā
bahutvasaṃkhyā nivarteta, tataśca gośabdasya varṣāśabdasya ca yaḥ
prātipadikārto'bhipretaḥ sa iha na gamyeta|
tasmānmābhūdgośabdavarṣāśabdayorabhipretasyārthasyānavagatiriti
nātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| tataśca vivakṣitārthābhidhānād
goṣucaraḥ, varṣāsuja ityatra bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| 
ṭhbrāhyaṇācchṃasina upasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyamÂ' iti| brāhmaṇācchṃasīti yo'yaṃ
śabdastasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaratra na
sidhyati? pañcamīti| brāhmaṇaśabdenātrādhyayanaviśeṣa ucyate, taṃ
śaṃsatiukathayati yaḥ saḥ brāhmaṇācchṃasīti tāccchiliko ṇiniḥ| atra
brāhmaṇaśabdātÂ ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) iti dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ
pañcamyupasaṃkhyeyā| alukpunaḥ ṭhtatpuruṣe kṛti bahulamÂ' (6.3.14)
ityeva siddhaḥ| yadā tu brāhmaṇādākṛṣyāvayavamarthaṃ vā śaṃsatīti
vivakṣyate, tadā pañcamyapi nopasaṃkhyeyā| ṭhapādāne pañcamī' (2.3.28)
ityevameva tasyāḥ siddhatvātÂ| kathaṃ punaratrāsatā pañcamyarthena
vyutpatiḥ kriyate? ityāha--ṭhkratvigviśeṣa' ityādi| rūḍhiḥuprasiddhiḥ,
saṃjñeti yāvatÂ| tasyā ityanena rūḍhimātraṃ pratyavamṛśyate, na tu
brāhmaṇācchṃasītyayaṃ rūḍhiśabdaḥ| rūḍhiśabdaḥ kasyācideva ṛtvigviśeṣasya
vācakaḥ, tatraiva tasya saṃjñātvena praṇītatvātÂ| tasmātÂ tasyāpyasatā
satā vāvayavārthena vyutpatiḥ kriyate| tatra yadi brāhmaṇaṃ
śaṃsatītyayamartho vivakṣyate, tadā
pañcamyarthasyāpādānasyābhāvādasatāvayavārthena vyutpatiḥ kriyate|
yada#a tu brāhmaṇādavayabārthaṃ vā gṛhītvā śaṃsatītyayamartho vivakṣyate,
tadā pañcamyarthasya bhāvātÂ satā||

6. ātmanaśca pūraṇe| (6.3.6) 
pūraṇagarahaṇiha svaryate, svaritena cādhikārāvagatirbhavati| tena
pūraṇagrahaṇadhikṛtya pūraṇagrahaṇamadhikṛtya pūraṇapratyayā vihitāsta
eva pūraṇagrahaṇena gṛhyante, na tu svarūpamÂ| ṭhutarapade' (6.3.1)

ityālocyāha--ṭhpūraṇapratyayānta utarapade' ityādi| ṭhpañcamaḥ' iti|

ṭhṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thukÂ' (5.2.51), ṣṭuatvamÂ|
ṭhātmanāpañcamaḥ' ityādau kena tṛtīyā, na hyatra
karaṇādistṛtīyārtho'sti, karaṇādi hi kārakamÂ, kriyāyāśca
kārakraṃ bhavati, na ceha kācitÂ kriyā vidyate?
ityāha--ṭhtṛtīyāvidhāne' ityādi| bhavatvevamÂ, tṛtīyāsamāsāstu
kathamÂ, na hyatra samāsalakṣaṇamasti? ityata āha--ṭhtṛtīyāvidhāne'
ityādi| bhavatvevamÂ, tṛtīyāsamāsastu kathamÂ, na hyatra
samāsalakṣaṇamasti? ityata āha--ṭhtṛtīyeti ca' ityādi| atha
vā--ṭhkartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' (2.3.18) ityanenaivātra tṛtīyā,
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulamÂ' (2.1.32) iti samāsa iti
darśayannāha--ṭhātmanā vā' ityādi| atra kartara karaṇe vaiṣā
tṛtīyā--kṛtaḥ pañcama iti| kṛte samāse kṛtaśabdo na prayajyate;
tadarthasya vṛtāvantarbhāvātÂ| 
ṭhkathamÂ' ityādi| atrāpyātmanā caturtha iti bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ|
ṭhbahuvrīhirayamÂ' ityādi parihāraḥ| tatpuruṣe hyātmanācaturtha iti
syātÂ, na cāyaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? bahuvrīhiḥ| sa ca
prathamāntayoreva padayoriti na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu

kaścidvyatirikto'nyapadārtho'sti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
avyatirakto'pyanyapadārtho bhavati vayapadeśivadbhāvena|
yathā--śobhanaśarīraḥ śilāputraka iti|| 

7. vaiyākaraṇākhyāyāṃ caturthyāḥ| (6.3.7)

10. kāranāmni ca prācāṃ halādau| (6.3.10)
vaṇigbhiḥ karṣakaiḥ paśupālaiśca rājñe deyo bhāgo
rakṣānibandhanaḥukāraḥ, tasya nāma kāranāma| ṭhkūpeśāṇamÂ' ityādau

alontyalopaśca, ṭhpādaḥ patÂ' (6.4.130) iti padādeśaḥ| 
ṭhkāraviśeṣasya' ityādināsya sūtrasya niyamārthatāṃ darśayati|
niyamavikalpāḥ--niyamaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ| ṭhkāranāmni ca' ityādinā
teṣāṃ niyamavikalapānāṃ svarūpaṃ darśayati| ete ca niyamavikalpāḥ

upādānālalabhyante| yadyādyo niyamo nābhipretaḥ syātÂ tadā
ṭhkāranāmni' iti na brūyātÂ| evaṃ yadi dvitīyo niyamamo

ityādi| kṛtamajantakāryaṃ yasya sa kṛtājantakāryaṃ āgamī,
tasyaivavidhasya pratipatiḥ pratītiryathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇamÂ|
antagrahaṇena hi kāryāntarasyānte'vasāne mumÂ kartavaya
ityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcyate| ato'jantakārye hrasavatve kṛte paścānmumÂ
bhavati| nanu ca mumā hrasvo na bādhyata ityanenaiva bhaviṣyatati
sopapatiko'yamarthaḥ pratipāditaḥ, tatÂ kimarthametadantagrahaṇamÂ?
naitadasti; tena hi niravakāśādÂ hrasvaśāsanasya mumā hrasvo na
bādhyata ityetāvanmātraṃ pratapāditamÂ, na tu kṛtājantakāryasya
mumÂ bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ, tataḥ paratvānmumi kṛta satyanajantasyāpi

nimitameva| evaṃ tarhyadugevāyamÂ| tulyā hi saṃhitā||

78. sahasya saḥ saṃjñāyāmÂ| (6.3.78)
ṭhsāśvatthamÂ' iti| sahāśvattheneti ṭhtena saheti tulyayoge' (2.2.28)
iti bahuvrīhiḥ| ṭhsahayudhvā, sahakṛtvā' iti| ṭhdṛśeḥ kvanipÂ'
(3.2.94) ityanuvartamāne ṭhrājani yudhi kṛñaḥ' (3.2.95), ṭhsahe ca'
(3.2.96) iti kvanipÂ, upapadasamāsaḥ, ṭhsarvanāmasthāne; (6.4.8) iti
dīrghaḥ| 
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sādeśa udāto nipātyate? ityata
āha--ṭhudātānudātavato hi' ityādi| nipātā ādyaudātā bhavanti'
(phi.sū.4.80) iti sahaśabda ādyaudāta eva, śeṣamanudātamÂ|
tenāsāvudātānudātavānÂ, tataścāntaryatastasya sthāne saśabdaḥ
svaritaḥ| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityudāto nipātyate| yadyevamÂ,
avyayībhāve'pi udāta eva svaraḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha--ṭhsa ca
nipātasvaraḥ' ityādi| ṭhyatra' ityādi| bahuvrīhau tatpuruṣe vā|
ṭhbahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadamÂ' (6.2.1) iti sahetyetasya
samāsāntodātatvāpavādaḥ prakṛtisvaratvaṃ bhavati| tatpuruṣe'pi
ṭhtatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā| tasmātÂ tatraiva sa
nipātasvaraḥ prasajyate| avyayībhāve tu samāsāntodātatvāpavādaḥ
prakṛtisvaro na kenacidvihita iti tatara samāsāntodātatvenaiva
bhavitavyamÂ| atastena bādhyata eva| ṭhseṣṭi, sapaśṛbandhamÂ' iti|
iṣṭiranto yasya paśubandho'nto yasyeti, ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6)
ityādinā samāsaḥ, antavacane| atra paratvātÂ prathamasatāvannapatasvaraḥ,
tataḥ samāsāntodātatvamÂ| tacca sati nipātasvare śiṣyata iti
satiśiṣṭamÂ, atastena nipātasvaro bādhyate; satiśiṣṭasvarasya
valayastvātÂ|| 

79. granthāntādhike ca| (6.3.79)
ṭhsakalamÂ' iti| kalāukālaviśeṣaḥ, tatsahacārito granthastathocyate|
saha kalayā vartata iti sakalamÂ| evaṃ ṭhsamuhūrtamÂ' ityetadapi
veditavyamÂ| ṭhsasaṃgrahamÂ' iti| etadudāharaṇaṃ
pramādādidānīntanaiḥ kulekhakairlikhitamÂ, tatra hi ṭhavyayībhāve
cākāle' (6.3.81) ityevaṃ sabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ? ityāha--tatra' ityādi| kathaṃ
punanaṃ prāpnoti, yāvatā kālamuhūrtaśabdau tāvatÂ sāhacaryādatra
granthe vartate? evaṃ manyate--prakaraṇādinā vākyena granthaviṣayatā
tayorgamyate| mukhyastu kāla evābhidheya iti| 
ṭhsadroṇā khārī' ityādi| ṭhtena saha' (2.2.28) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ||

80. dvitīye cānupāravye| (6.3.80)
ṭhdvayo sahaprayuktayorapradhāno yaḥ sa dvitīyaḥ' iti|
pradhānetarasannipāte satyapradhāna eva dvitīyaśabdasya prayogātÂ| tathā
hi--svāmibhṛtyayoḥ sahayuktayorbhṛtya eva svāminaṃ prati dvitīya
ucyate, na tu bhṛtyaṃ prati svāmī| ṭhupākhyāyate yaḥ sa upākhyaḥ' iti|
ṭhātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti kaḥ, sa ca bhavanÂ ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo
bahulamÂ' (3.3.113) iti karmaṇi bhavati| ṭhsāgniḥ kapotaḥ' iti|
pūrvavadbahuvrīhiḥ| atrāganisahayuktaḥ kapotaḥ, tayorhi sāhacarya
loke prasiddhamÂ| tatrāgnirapradhānaḥ| tathā hyagniḥ
kapotamanuvidhate--yatra hi kapotastatrāgninā'vaśyaṃ bhavitavyamÂ, na
tu yatrāgnistatra kapoteneti nāsāvagnimanuvidhate, tena kapotasya
prādhānyamÂ| agnyādayaḥ punarapradhānā eva| ṭhagnyādayaḥ' iti|
atrādiśabdena piśācadayo gṛhayante| tena hi kvacitÂ pratyakṣeṇa
upalabhyante, api tu kapotādibhiravinābhāvibhiranumīyanta
ityanupākhyā bhavanti|| 

81. avyayībhāve cākāle| (6.3.81)
ṭhakālavācini' iti| anena ṭhkāle' iti neha savarūpasya grahaṇamÂ, api
tu kālaviśeṣavācināṃ pūrvāhṇādiśabdānāmiti darśayati| kuta
etata punaravasitamÂ? ṭhgranthāntādhike ca' (6.3.79) ityatra
granthāntagrahaṇātÂ| anena hi kālavācinyutarapade pratiṣedhaḥ
parrāpnoti, sa mā bhūditi| tatra granthāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, yadi cātra
ṭhkāle' iti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syātÂ| tatastenaiva sakalamÂ,
samuhūrtamityatra sabhāvaḥ siddha iti tatra gnthāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ
syātÂ| ṭhsacakramÂ' iti| ṭhavyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādanā

(5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| 
ṭhsahapūrvāhṇamÂ' iti| tenaiva sūtreva sākalye'vyayībhāvaḥ||

82. vopasarjanasya| (6.3.82)
yadi ṭhupasarjanasya' ityetatÂ sahaśabdasaya viśeṣaṇaṃ syātÂ
tadā'tiprasaṅgaḥ syātÂ| viśeṣānupādānādihāpi
syātÂ--sahayudhvā, sahakṛtveti| atrāpi sahaśabda upasarjanamÂ;
ṭhupapadamatiṅÂ' (2.2.19) iti prathamā nirdeaśātÂ, aprādhānyācca|
anarthakañca viśeṣaṇaṃ syātÂ; sarvatraiva hi samāse
sahaśabdasyopasarjanatvātÂ| samāsaścehotarapadena sannidhāpitaḥ,
yasmātÂ samāse hyutarapadaṃ bhavati, atasatasyaivedaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti
manyamāna āha--ṭhupasarajanasarvāvayavaḥ' iti| upasarjanaṃ sarvo'vayavo
yasya sa tathoktaḥ; avayavadharmeṇa samudāyadharmasya tathā nirdeaśātÂ,
yathā--āḍhaḷmidaṃ nagaramiti| yadi kasyacitkaścidupasarajanamavayavaḥ
kaścidanupasarjanaṃ so'pyupasarjanamityucyate,
tadā'tiprasaṅgadoṣastadavasthaḥ syāditi sarvagrahaṇamÂ| kaḥ punarasau
sarvopasajenāvayavaḥ samāsaḥ? bahuvrīhiḥ| nanu
dvandvo'pyupasarjanasarvāvayava eva, tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa
doṣaḥ; na hi sahapadena tu guṇabhāvastatraiva prayujyate| atha
vā--ubhayagatiriha śāstre sambhavatati laukikamapyupasarjanamiha
gṛhyate| tena śāstrīyopasarjanena laukikena copasarjanībhūtāḥ
sarvo'vayava yasya sa evopasarjanaśabdena vivakṣita iti vijñāyate| na
caivaṃvidho dvandvaḥ| tasya hyavayavānāṃ
śāstrīyeṇaivopasarjanenopasarjatvamÂ, na tu laukikena|
bahuvrīhistu laukikenāpi| tasmātÂ tasyaivopasarjanagrahaṇena
grahaṇamÂ| ṭhtadavayavasya' iti| anenopasarjanasyetyeṣā'vayavaṣaṣṭhīti
dariśayati| ṭhsaputraḥ' iti| pūrvavadbahuvarīhiḥ| 
ṭhsahayuṣvā, sahakṛtvā' iti| tatpuruṣo'yamutarapadārthapradhānaḥ| 
atheha kasmānna bhavati--sahakṛtvapriyaḥ, priyasahakṛtve'ti, bhavati
hyatrāpi sahaśabdo bahuvrīhyavayavaḥ? ityāha--ṭhiha' ityādi| ṭhvā priyasya'
(vā.114) iti priyaśabdasya vikalpena pūrvanipataḥ|
utarapadādhikārādiha bahuvrīhyāśrayaṇācca bahuvrīhau yadutarapadaṃ
tatÂ paraṃ yasmātÂ sahaśabdātÂ tasaya sabhāvena bhavitavyamÂ| na
ceha bahuvrīhau yadutarapadaṃ tatÂ sahaśabdātÂ paramÂ,
śabdāntareṇa vyavadhānāditi na bhavati sabhāvaḥ||

86. caraṇe brahmacāriṇi| (6.3.86)
caraṇaśabdo'yamadhyayananimitamupādāya puruṣādiṣu vartate| brahmā
caratīti brahamacārī, ṭhvrate' (3.2.80) iti ṇiniḥ| ṭhsabrahmacārī' iti|
pūrvavatÂ karmadhārayaḥ| sabrahmacārītyasyāyamartho'bhimataḥ--samāne
brahmaṇi vrataṃ caratīti| eṣa cātrārtho yathopapadyate, tathā
darśayitumāha--ṭhbrahma vedaḥ' ityādi| tadadhyanārtha yadvrataṃ tadapi
brahyaeti| tādarthyātÂ tāccchabdyamÂ, yathā--indrārthā sthūṇā inda iti|
taccaratīti tatÂ sampādayati, paripālayatītyarthaḥ| kena punarasau
samānaḥ? ityāha--ṭhsamānastasyaiva' ityādi| tasyaiveti vedākhyasya
brahmaṇaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yata eva mupacāreṇa labdhabrahmavyapadeśaṃ vrataṃ
yaścarati brahmaṇaśca samānatvādayaḥ samānaḥ sa sabrahmacārī| tena
sabahmacārītyasyāyamartho bhavati--samāne brahmaṇi vratacārīti| yadi
hyasamāne brahmaṇi vrataṃ caretÂ tadā samānatvaṃ na syātÂ| tathāpi
brahmākhyaṃ vrataṃ na caredevamapi brahmacāritvaṃ na syātÂ| tasmādyaḥ samāne
brahmaṇi brahmacārī, so'vaśyaṃ samāne brahmaṇi vratacārīti bhavati|
sabrahmacārītyayamasyarthaḥ sampadayate--samāne brahmaṇi vratacārīti| atha
vā--tasyaivetyupacāreṇa labdhabrahmavyapadeśasya vratasyātra pakṣe paramarśaḥ|
samāne brahmaṇi ityatra brahmaśabdo vede vartate, prativedaṃ hi bhidyate,
tadadhyayanārthaṃ yadvrataṃ tatra yaḥ samāne vede'dhyetavye vrataṃ carati sa
eva sabrahmacārītyucyate||

139. samparasaraṇasya| (6.3.139)
ṭhkārīṣāgandhīputraḥ' iti| kārīṣagandherapatyamiti ṭhtasyāpatyamÂ'

ca; ubhayaṃ caitatÂ sāvakāśamÂ, iko hrasvatavasyāvakāśaḥ--grāmaṇiputra

yadyapi hrasvābhāvapakṣe kṛtārtha dīrghatvamÂ, tathāpi tena paratvādÂ

bhavati? ata āha--ṭhpunaḥprasaṅgavijñānañca' ityādi| gatārthamÂ||

pratyalakṣaṇena| nanu ca ṭhaṅgavṛte punaraṅgavṛtāvavidhi niṣṭhitasya'
(vyā.pa.38) iti samprasāraṇe kṛte guṇena na bhavitavyamÂ?
ṭhniṣṭhitasya' iti| ṭhvacanādadoṣaḥ| niṣṭhā hi śabdasya parisamāptiḥ,
sā ca tadā bhavati yadā śabdasaya prayogārhatā bhavati| na ca
yāvadguṇādisaṃskāro na kriyate tāvadasya prayogārhatā bhavati|
tasmātÂ kṛte'pi samprasāraṇe bhavatyeva guṇaḥ, tatretatÂ syātÂ|
yadyaūḍ na kriyate, tadā śārli vahati, ditiṃ vahati, śālyuhaḥ,
dityūha ityevamādyanakārante śāliditiśabda upapade vaherṇvi
pratyaye vihite sati na siddhyatītyata āha--ṭhanakārānte copapade'
ityādi| ṭhvahaśca' (3.2.64) ityanena ṭhcchandasi sahaḥ' (3.2.63) ityato'tra
cchandograhaṇānuvṛteścchandasyeva ṇvirvidhīyate, dṛṣṭārthavidhiścchandasi,
akārānta eva copapade praṣṭhādau vaheścchandasi ṇvirdṛśyate na
tvakārānte śālyādau| kathaṃ punaranena bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā
jñāpyate? ityāha--ṭhtasyāṃ hi' ityādi| bahiraṅgatvaṃ punaḥ
samprasāraṇasya bāhyājādipratyayanimitāṃ bhasaṃjñāmāśritya
pravṛtātvātÂ| guṇasya tvantaraṅgatvamÂ; abāhmapratyaye pravṛtatvātÂ|
kiṃ punarasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ jñāpanenaprayojanamÂ? pacāvedamÂ,
yajāvedamityatraḥ siddhatvaṃ bahiraṅgalakṣaṇasya|
ato'ntaraṅgalakṣaṇameta aitvaṃ na bhavati;
bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvādguṇasya| bahiraṅgatvantu padadvayāśritatvātÂ|
aitvasya tvantaraṅgatvaṃ viparyayātÂ||

149. sūryatiṣyāgastyamatasyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ| (6.4.149)

syātÂ---āpatyasyevānākārādau taddhite lopo bhavati īti ca

iṣṭirityatrāpi lopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇamÂ| nanu ca

taddhitagrahaṇamÂ|

36. videḥ śaturvasuḥ| (7.1.36)

ṭhprākÂ' ityādinā viṣayasaptamyāṃ satyāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate

tataśca ṭhadupadhātÂ' (3.1.98) iti yatÂ prasajyeta| viṣayasaptamyāṃ tu
prāgutpannena numā'dupadhatvasya vihatatvātÂ ṭhṛhalorṇyatÂ'
(3.1.124) ita ṇyadeva bhavati| kaḥ punarṇyati yata vā viśeṣaḥ;
yāvatobhayatrāpi tadeva rūpamiti, vyatpratyaye'pi vṛddhyā na
bhavitavyamÂ, tathā ca prāguktamÂ--ṭhparāpi satī vṛddhirnityatvābhumā
bādhyate' iti? ata āha--ṭhtatra' ityādi| tatra ṇyati sati
titsvaritatvātÂ ṭhgatikārakopapadātÂ kṛtÂ' (6.2.139) iti

68. na suṭuarbhyāṃ kevalābhyāmÂ| (7.1.68)|
ṭhupasṛṣṭasya' iti| upasargeṇa sambaddhasyetyarthaḥ, ṭhsulābhaḥ' iti|
suśabdo'yamādhikyārthaḥ, nākṛcchrārthaḥ, yathā--suṣiktaṃ nāma kiṃ
tavātreta| ṭhdurlābhaḥ' iti| ṭhduśabdo nindārthaḥ, na kṛcchrārthaḥ,
yathā--durbrahyaṇa iti| tena ghañeva bhavati, na khalÂ| 
ṭhsudurmyāmiti tṛtīyāṃ matvā kevalagrahaṇaṃ kriyate' iti|

pratiṣedhaḥ syātÂ| tasmātÂ tṛtayāyāmabhyupetāyāṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ
kriyate| atha pañcatryāṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kriyeteti praśnāvasarata
āha--ṭhpaccamyāṃ hi' ityādi| pañcamyāṃ hyasyāṃ
nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvādanantarasyaiva pratiṣedhena
bhavitavyamÂ, iha ca praśabdena vyavadhānamÂ, ataḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti,
tatÂ kiṃ kevalagrahaṇena? yadyevamÂ na kartavyameva kevalagrahaṇamÂ,
pañcamīmenāṃ pratijñāsyāma iti? naitadasti; supralambhaḥ duṣpralambha
iti--pratyudāhaṇadvayamabhipretyaitaduktamÂ| ṭhpañcamyāṃ hi
vyavahitatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ' iti| atisulambha ityatra
yadābhiśabdo'pyupasargastadā hyasati kevalagrahaṇe pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeta;
avyavadhānātÂ| tasmātÂ sarvadhā kevalagrahaṇasya kartavyatvātÂ,
kamavyatikrame ca prayojanābhāvātÂ tṛtīyaiveṣā yuktā
pratijñātumÂ| 
atisulabhamityatrātinopargena suśabdena labhirupasṛṣṭaḥ, tasmātÂ
pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syātÂ, atastāṃ
nirākartumāha--ṭhatisulabhamityatra' ityādi| karmapravacanīyatvaṃ
punaratiśabdasya ṭhatiratikramaṇe ca' (1.4.95) iti
karmapravacanīsaṃjñāvidhānātÂ| yasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā
tasyopasargasaṃjñā nāsti; ekasaṃjñādhikārātÂ,
karmapravavanāyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā bādhatatvātÂ| kathaṃ punaḥ
karmapracavanīyasya hi tasyāpi kevalatvamupapadyate? evaṃ
manyate--kevagrahaṇātÂ svaśabdopātādanyatÂ tulyajātīyameva
vyavacchedyamÂ, na tu vijātīyamÂ| tathā hi--ṭhkevalabhyāṃ vijhātīyena
karkaṭādinā sahitau praviśata eva| ata
evānyopasargarahitābhyāmityanena tulyajātīyanivṛtayarthatā
kevalagrahaṇasya darśitā| yadi tu sarvasya tulyajātīyasya
vijātīyasyāpi kevalagrahaṇena nivṛtiḥ kartu śakyate,
tadopasargagarahaṇamanarthakaṃ syātÂ, anyarahitābhyāmityevaṃ
brūyātÂ| tasmādvijātīyena kevalagrahaṇena nivṛtiḥ kartu śakyate,
tadopasargagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syātÂ, anyarahitābhyāmityevaṃ brūyātÂ|
tasmādvijātīyena sahitāvapi tau kevalāvevetyatisulabhamityatra
karmapravacanīyasahitenāpi suśabdenopasṛṣṭasya bhavatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ|
yatra tarhi pūjātikramaṇābhyāmanyatra vṛtiḥ, atiśabdasaya tatra
karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā na bhavati, tadā kathamÂ? ityāha--ṭhyadā tu'
ityādi| pañcamīnirdeaśe'pyevamarthaṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti; anyathā
hyatra vyavadhānābhāvātÂ pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyetetyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca
prasulambhaḥ--ityevamarthaṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamÂ? naitadasti; uktaṃ hi
bhāṣeya--ṭhnaiṣo'sti prayogaḥ' iti||

15. saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca| (7.3.15)

kālaparimāṇasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ saṃvatsaragrahaṇamÂ|

ṭhdvivarṣā' iti| dve varṣe bhṛto bhūto bhāvī vā, pūrvavaṭṭhak, tasya

16. varṣasyābhaviṣyati| (7.3.16)

27. nātaḥ parasya| (7.3.27)
pūrveṇa parimāṇasya vṛddhirucyamānā akārasyācamādeḥ prāpnotīti
pratiṣidhyate| pūrvapadasya tu vikalpo bhavatyeva; pūrvasya
tvityanuvṛteḥ| ṭhārdhaprasthikaḥ' iti| ṭhardhaṃ napuṃsakamÂ' (2.2.2) iti
samāsaḥ, pūrvavatÂ pratyayaḥ|
ṭhkiñca syātÂ' iti| evaṃ manyate--ākāro hi vṛddhimāneva, tatara
nāsti viśeṣaḥ satyasati vā vṛddhiparatiṣedhe, tadeva rūpamÂ,
ato'satyapi taparakaraṇe naiva kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata iti|
ṭhvṛddhinimitasya' ityādi| yasati taparakaraṇe tatkālārthe
yadaniṣṭamāpadyate taddarśayati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ
puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syātÂ? ityata āha--ṭhyatra hi' ityādi|
vṛddhiṃ kurvanneva hi taddhito vṛddhinimitaṃ bhavati| tasmādyatra taddhite
vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ kriyate sa vṛddhenimitaṃ na bhavati| tena
vṛddhinimitasya taddhitasya puṃvadbhāvo na pratiṣidhyata iti
puṃvadbhāvaḥ syātÂ| kva? ṭhyathā' ityādi| ṭhvaiyākaraṇī bhāryā'sya'
iti| vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ punaratra ṭhna yvābhyāmÂ' (7.3.3) ityādinā| atha
parasyeti kimarthaṃ, pūrvasya mā bhūditi? naitadasti; ata iti
viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyātÂ pūrvasya na bhaviṣyati| na hi
pūrvasyārdhaśabdasyāto'nyo vṛddhimākÂ sambhavati, ṭhpūrvasya tu vā'
(7.3.26) iti ca vikalpaśāsanamanarthakaṃ syātÂ, yadi tasya pratiṣedhaḥ
syātÂ| idaṃ tarhi prayojanamÂ--tadantavidhirmā bhūditi?
tadantadidhau satīhāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syātÂ--ardhadrauṇikamiti|
pūrvastu vidhiḥ--ardhena muṣṭinā krotamardhamauṣṭikamÂ,
ārdhamauṣṭikamityevamarthaḥ syātÂ, paragrahaṇe tu sati yadardhātÂ
paramanantaraṃ tadevāśritaṃ bhavatīti nāsti tadantavidhiprasaṅgaḥ||

28. pravāhaṇasya ḍhea| (7.3.28)
pravāhaṇaśabdasya ḍhea pratyaye parata utarapadasyeti vyadhikaraṇe
ṣaṣṭhÂayau| pravāhaṇaśabdasaya yadutarapadamavayavastasyetyarthaḥ|

ṇijantātÂ ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahulamÂ' (3.3.113) iti kartari lyuṭÂ,

vṛddhimavevaitatÂ? yadapyevamÂ, tathāpi vṛddhiravidhātavyā; taddhitasya
vṛddhinimitatvātÂ, ṭhvṛddhinimitasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre'
(6.3.39) iti puṃvadbhāvaprataṣedho yathā syātÂ| yadi

vidhīyate tasminÂ pakṣe pravāhaṇeyī bhāryā asyeti pravāhaṇeyībhāyaṃ

taddhitasya| yathā--vaiyākaraṇabhāyaṃ ityatra| nanu cāsatyapi

29. tatpratyayasya ca| (7.3.29)
ṭhprāvāhaṇeyiḥ' iti| ṭhata iñÂ' (4.1.95)| ṭhprāvāhaṇeyakamÂ' iti|
ṭhgotracaraṇādaṣuñÂ' (4.3.126)| 
atha kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā ḍhapratyayantasya
pravāhaṇeyaśabdasyotarapadaṃ nityaṃ vṛddhimadedeti,
tadarthastāvadārambho na yuktaḥ; pūrvapadasya vṛddhervikalpo yathā
syādityevamartho'pi naivāsyārambho yujyate; iñādāvapi taddhite
tannimitāṃ vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā pūrvasūtreṇa ca nimita eva vikalpo
bhaviṣyati, na hīñādāvutapanne taddhite ḍhasya paratvamapaiti?
ityāha--ṭhbāhyataddhita' ityādi| bāhyataddhino nimitaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā|
bāhmatvaṃ punaritradestaddhitasya prāvāhaṇeyaśabde'nantarbhāvātÂ| saivaṃ

brāhmataddhitotpaterḍhāśrayo vikalpo bhavannantaraṅgastāṃ bādhituṃ na

1. ṇau caḍaḷupadhāyā hvasvaḥ| (7.4.1)

hṛ--ityādikamavikṛtadhāturūpameva dvirucyate| atra kṛ,

idaṃ tarhyudāharaṇamÂ--kariṣyāmīti vrajatīti| atra ṭhlṛṭÂ śeṣe ca'
(3.3.13) iti cakārātÂ kriyāyāmupapade kriyārthāyāṃ lṛṭÂ, tasya
lṛṭaḥ sadvidhirna bhaviṣyatīti; vyavasthitavibhāṣayā|
aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇenetiyogādanyatra nityaṃ bhavati--kariṣyantaṃ
paśyeti, prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe tu vikalpaḥ--brāhmaṇaḥ kariṣyanÂ
brāhmaṇaḥ kariṣyatīti|
ṭhmithaḥ' ityādi| mitha iti sahabhāvena|
devatrātagalagrāhādayastrāṇagaragrahādibhiḥ sahaikasminÂ viṣaye

goḥ' (6.1.122) ityanuvartamāne ṭhavaṅÂ sphoṭāyanasya' (6.1.123) iti

kvacidvidhireva, kvacitÂ pratiṣedha eva, kvacidubhayamapītyevaṃvidhā

cābhinnatvātÂ paratvameva tāvanna dviśabdādeśe syātÂ, kutaḥ
punarāmreḍitasaṃjñā, anudātatvañca? yadi ca dviśabda ādeśaḥ syātÂ,
ṭhavyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' (6.1.98) ityanuvartamāne
ṭhnāmreḍitasyāntyasya tu yā' (6.1.99) ityāmreḍitāvayavasyāccchabdasya
pararūpatvapratiṣedho nopapadyate, na dviśabdasyāccchabdo'vayavo'sti|
etena sarvaśabdasyāpi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ pratikṣiptamÂ| yadi hi
sarvaśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syātÂ, tasyaiva hi dvirvacanaṃ syātÂ|
tataśca pūrvavadāmreḍitasambandhino'ccchabdasya pararūpatvapratiṣedho
nopapadyate, ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) ityatra nityagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ
syātÂ| tatra hi nitye'rthe vīpsāyāṃ ca vartamānasya dvirvacanaṃ
vidhāsyate| na ca sarvaśabdasya nitye'rthe vṛtirasti, tiṅkṣu
nityatā; ṭhavyayakṛtsucsupsu vīpsā' iti vacanātÂ| tasmātÂ
sarvasyetyatrārthagrahaṇamÂ| sarvaśabdo'yamiha sakale kalāvati vartate,
tena pacatītyādeḥ kṛtsnasya śabdasya dvirvacanaṃ
bhavatītyalamatiprasaṅgena| evaṃ tāvatÂ sthāne dvirvacanapakṣamāśritya
ṭhsarvasya sthāne dve bhavataḥ' ityuktamÂ| 
idānīmÂ ṭhdviṣprayogo dvirvacanamÂ' iti pakṣamāśrityāha--ṭhyadā tu'
ityādi| tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmātÂ pakṣādviśevasya pradarśakaḥ,
tatrāntaratamyena dve śabdarūpe ādiśyete| iha tu sa eva śabdo
dvirāvartyate, dvirucyata ityarthaḥ| ṭhdve āvṛtī bhavataḥ' iti| dve
uccāraṇākriye bhavata ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ ṭhdviṣprayogo dvirvacanamÂ'
iti pakṣa āśrayitavyaḥ? kathaṃ ca nāśrayitavyaḥ? sadoṣatvātÂ|
dviṣprayoge hi--ṭhāmÂ pacasi pacasi devadata' ityatra ṭhāma
ekāntaramāmantritamanantike' (8.1.55) iti nighātapratiṣedho na
prāpnoti; āmantritasya padadvayena vyavadhānādekāntaratāyā
abhāvātÂ| sthāne punardvirvacane hyaekapadasyāyamādeśa iti
satyapyādeśasya svagate bhede sthānivadbhāvādekatvavyapadeśe
satyekīvitaratī bhavatīti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ;
dharmabhedādupacarito hīha bhedaḥ, svagatastvabheda eva; anyathā
vṛtireva na syātÂ| ekasyaiva hi vastuna āvṛtadiḥ kriyate|
tasmādbhinnatvādvastuna ihaiva sunaramekāntaratā sidhyati| iha tarhi
paunaḥpunyamiti? atra ṭhguṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca' (5.1.124) iti
ṣyañÂ na prāpnoti, paunaḥpunika ityatra ca ṭhkālāṭṭhañÂ' (4.3.11)
iti ṭhañÂ na prāpnoti; aprātipadikatvātÂ| aprātipadikatvaṃ
tvarthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsasyaiveti samāsagrahaṇasya
niyamārthatvātÂ| sthāne dvirvacane punaryadyapi subantatayā svāśrayā
prātipadikasaṃjñā nāsti, tathāpi sthānivadbhāvātÂ
prātipadikagrahaṇe grahaṇātÂ prātipadikaṃ bhavati| yadyapi cāsya sthānī
pratyayalakṣaṇena subantaḥ; tathāpyapratyayaḥ (1.2.45) iti
prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedho na bhavati; prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ
pratyayalakṣaṇetāpratyaya (1.2.45) iti pratiṣedho na bhavatītyasyārthasya ṭhna
ṅsimbuddhyoḥ' (8.2.8) ityanena jñāpitatvātÂ| dviṣprayoge
dvirvavase'pi na doṣaḥ| atra samāsagrahaṇaṃ hi tulyajātoyasyaiva
prātipadikasaṃjñāṃ nivartayati| kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ? yasya
bhedasaṃsargadvāreṇa samudāyārtha upajāyate| kasya caivaṃ vidho'rthaṃ
upajāyate? vākyasya| nityādiścāyamarthaḥ padādasthāyāṃ na dṛṣṭa eva|
dviruktikāle dṛśyamānaḥ padāntareṇa na bhidyate, nāpi saṃsṛjyata iti
kuta evamprakārasya samāsagrahaṇānnivṛtiḥ| atha
vā''cāryapravṛtirjñāpayati--bhavatyevaṃjātoyebhyastadvitotpatiriti,
yadayaṃ kasyādiṣu kautaskutaśabdaṃ paṭhati| kutaḥ kuta āgata iti
ṭhavyayātyapÂ' (4.2.104) iti tyapi prāpte'smādeva nipātanādaṇÂ| 
sarvasyeti vacanamiha ṭhalo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) nivṛtyarthaṃ vā syātÂ?
ṣaṣṭhaḷrthapratipatyartha vā? tatra tvalo'ntyanivṛtyarthaṃ tāvannopapadyate|
tathā hi--śabdataścārthataścāntaratamābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ śabdarūpābhyāṃ
bhavitavyamÂ| ye caivamprakāre te niyogato'nekālsvarūpe
ityantareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇena ṭhanekālśitsarvasya' (1.1.55) iti|
sarvasyaiva bhaviṣyataḥ, nāntyasya| ṣaṣṭhaḷrthapratapatyarthamapi sarvagrahaṇaṃ
nopapadyate| tathā hi--yatra tāvatÂ ṣaṣṭhÂayuccāryate ṭhparervarjane'
(8.1.5) ityādau, tatra ṣaṣṭhÂayuccāraṇādeva ṣaṣṭhaḷrthasya
pratipatirbhaviṣyati| ṭhnityavīpsamoḥ' (8.1.4) ityatra yadyapi ṣaṣṭhī
noccāryate, tathāpi sarvasyeti vacanamantareṇāpi śakyate
ṣaṣṭhaḷrtho'vagantumÂ| kathamÂ? ṭhdve' iti hyādeśanirdeaśaḥ, ādeśaśca
sambandhinamapekṣate, ṭhnityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) iti cārthanirdeaśāḥ; na
cārthanirdeaśe sthānyādeśasambandha upapadyate| tasmānnityadīpsayoryaḥ
śabdo vartate tasya dve bhavataḥ--ityevaṃ vākyārthaḥ sthāne
dvirvacanapakṣe tāvadavagamyate| yadā ṭhdviṣprayogo dvirvacanamÂ'
tadāpi vinā sarvasyeti vacanena ṣaṣṭhaḷrtho'vagamyata eva| evaṃ
hyāvṛtirhi kriyā, tasyā avaśyaṃ sādhanena sambandhinā bhavitavyamÂ;
tadāyatatvādātmalābhasya kriyāyāḥ| tasmādyatasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ
tasya dve bhavata iti vilpaṣṭaiva
ṣaṣṭhaḷrthapratipatirbhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--ṭhsarvasyeti kimÂ' iti|
ṭhvispaṣṭārthamÂ' iti| ya evaṃ na śaknoti sarvādeśaṃ ṣaṣṭhaḷrthaṃ vā
pratipatumÂ, taṃ prati sukhapratipataye sarvasyetyucyata iti bhāvaḥ| 
ṭhatha' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--ṭhpadasya' ityucyamāne
samāsataddhitavākyānāṃ dvirvacananivṛtiḥ kṛtā bhavati; utaratra ca
ṭhpadasya' (8.1.16) iti vaktavyaṃ na bhavati| etadeva hi ṭhpadasya' iti
vacanaṃ tatrānuvartayiṣyate| anucyamāne ṭhpadasya' ityesminÂ,
samāsasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ syātÂ--parvaṇiparvaṇi saptasapta parṇānyasya
santīti saptaparṇa iti; taddhitasyāpi dvau dvau pādau dadāti
ṭhpādaśatasya saṃkhyādeḥ' (5.4.1) ityādinā vanÂ--dvipadikāṃ
dadātīti; vākyasyāpi--grāmegrāme pānīyamiti| padasya' (8.1.16) iti
cotaratra na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| ṭhnaivaṃ śakyamÂ' iti| atra kāraṇamāha--ṭhiha
hi' ityādi| ṭhprapacati' iti| vākyametatÂ, padasamudāyātmakatvātÂ|
atra ṭhpadasya' ityucyamāne'sya dvirvacanaṃ na syātÂ| tasmādaśakyaṃ
padasyeti vaktumÂ| saptaparṇaḥ, dvipadikāṃ dadātītyatra tu
padasyetyucyamāne dvirvacanaṃ na bhaviṣyati;
samāsataddhitābhyāmevoktatvātÂ| vīpsāyāṃ grāmegrāme
pānīyamityatrāpi na bhaviṣyati; avayavadvirvacanenaiva vīpsāyā
dyotitatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| 
ṭhiha' ityādi| ṭhdrūha jidhāṃsāyāmÂ' (dhā.pā.1197), tatastṛcÂ,
druhÂatṛ iti sthite ghatvaḍhatve prāpnutaḥ, dvirvacanaṃ ca, tatra

1. pūrvatrāsiddhamÂ| (8.2.1)
eṣa yogaḥ paribhāṣā vā syātÂ adhikāro veti pakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyate|
tatra yadyayaṃ paribhāṣā syātÂ
sarvasyāmaṣṭādhyāyyāmpūrvasminnutaramasiddhaṃ syātÂ, tataśca ṭhato
bhisa aisÂ' (7.1.9) ityatra tyadādyatvasyāsiddhatvātÂ taiḥ,
yaiḥ--ityatraisbhāvo na syāditīmaṃ paribhāṣāpakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā
svaritatvenādhikāratva (1.3.11) masyeti
niścityāha--ṭhpūrvatrāsiddhamityadhikāro'yamÂ' iti|
ṭhadhyāyaparisamāpteḥ' iti| avadhipradarśanārthametatÂ| ṭhtatra' iti
vākyopanyāse| ṭhsapādā' iti| saha pādenānantaraṃ prakrāntena vartata
iti sapādā| ṭhsaptādhyāyī' iti| saptānāmadhyāyānāṃ samāhāraḥ,
ṭhdvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīpÂ| kvacitÂ ṭhsapādasaptādhyāyī' iti
pāṭhaḥ, tatra sapādā cāsau saptādhyāyī ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ,
puṃvadbhāvaḥ| ṭhayamÂ' iti| vakṣyamāṇaḥ| ṭhpādono'dhyāyaḥ' iti|
anantaroktena pādenono'paripūrṇaḥ pādono'dhyāyaḥ| ṭhasiddho
bhavati' ityādi| pādonādhyāyagrahaṇenotarotarayogagrahaṇena ca
śāstrāsiddhatvamihāśrīyata iti darśayati| kāryāsiddhatvāśrayaṇe hi yathā
devadatasya hantari hate na punarvevadatasya prādurbhāvo bhavati, tathā
kāryasyāsiddhatve tipādite na pa#unaḥ prakṛteḥ pratyāpatirbhavati|
[ṭhprādurbhāvo'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥṭ tataścāmuddhatve tusmaibhāvaśāstrameva
pravartate, na tvaśāstramasiddhatavāmiti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| api
ca śāstrasya mukhyatvaṃ pūrvatvaṃ kāryasyaupacārikatvamÂ| yasya
kāryasya śāstraṃ pūrvaṃ tadapyupacāreṇa pūrvamityucyate, na svata eva
tasaya pūrvatvamÂ; sanniveśaviśeṣābhāvātÂ| kāryaṃ hi
lakṣÂyagatamÂ, tatra yathā lakṣyasya sanniveśo nāsti tathā
tadgatasyāpi kāryasya| na ca mukhye pūrvatve sati gauṇatvasya
parigrahaṇaṃ muktamÂ| tasmācchāstraṃ
[tasmācchāstrapūrvagrahaṇena--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥṭ pūrvagrahaṇena gṛhyate| tasya
ca pūrvatvaṃ paraśāstramevāpekṣya bhavati| ato yadapekṣaṃ tasya pūrvatvaṃ
tataḥ parasya śāstrasyaivāsiddhatvamanena kartuṃ yuktamÂ|
śāstrasyāsiddhau ca kṛtāyāmarthataḥ kāryāsiddhatvaṃ kṛtameva bhavati;
tasya tannibandhanatvātÂ| siddhaśabdo niṣpannavacanaḥ| siddhaṃ

iti| ādhāraparatanva udghanādāvasya vṛtiḥ, ato yatra kāṣṭhaśagādhāra

kākyarthamÂ' ityādi| 
atha skoriti kimarthamÂ? narnartītyatra mā bhūtÂ|

niyamaḥ--alpāctaraṃ dvandve pūrvameva prayoktavyamiti;
ṭhdravamūrtisparśayoḥ śyaḥ' (6.1.24) ityatra sparśaśabdasyālpāctarasya
paranipātaṃ kurvatā'sya niyamasya tvāgaḥ kṛtaḥ| sa kimarthaṃ kṛtaḥ?
sparśo'trāniyamena pradhānabhūta upasarjanabhūto vā samprasāraṇasya
kāraṇamityasyārthasya sūcanārthaḥ| tena guṇabhūto'pi sparśaḥ
samprasāraṇasya nimitaṃ bhavati| 
sparśaśabdo'yamasti guṇavacanaḥ, asti ca rogavacanaḥ; tadiha
viśeṣānupādānādubhayorapi grahaṇamÂ| tato roge'pi
prāpnotīti pratiśīna ityetanna sidhyediti codyamāśahkyāha--ṭhguṇe
ca' ityādi| guṇa evetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarguṇa eva pratiṣedho labhyate?
jñāpakātÂ| yadayaṃ ṭhdravamūrtisparśavoḥ śya-' (6.1.24) ityatra
samprasāraṇaṃ vidhāya punaḥ ṭhprateśca' (6.1.25) iti vidhate,
tajjñāpayati--śyāyateryatra grahaṇaṃ tatra sparśa upādīyamāno rogaṃ na
pratyāyayatīti| yadi hi pratyāyayetÂ, punarvidhānamanarthakaṃ syātÂ;
pūrveṇaiva siddhatvātÂ| pratipūrvo hi roga eva śyāyatirvatete,
nānyatra||

hi' ityādi| atra bhinnamityasya ca bhitaśakalaśabdābhyāṃ
pratyekamabhisambandhaḥ| tena ṭhbhinnaṃ bhitamityeva bhavati' iti| etatÂ
prayogadvayamapi bhidikriyādivakṣāyāṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| vidīrṇe hi
śakale tasya vidīrṇatāṃ pratipādayituṃ bhinnamÂ, bhitamityeṣa
prayogo bhidikriyāvivakṣāyāṃ kriyate| yadi ca bhitaśabda
kriyāpravṛtinimitaṃ syātÂ, tato bhitaśabdenaiva
bhidikriyānimitakena vidīrṇatā śakalasya pratipādyata ityeṣa prayogo
nopapadyate, na hi tadasti yasya bhitaśabdenāpratipāditasya
bhinnaśabdayogo bhavetÂ| bhinnaṃ śakalamityeṣa ca prayogo

81. eta īdrabahuvacane| (8.2.81)

2. atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā| (8.3.2) 
pūrvatvamidamāpekṣikam, ruścehānuvartate| na ca tadapekṣaṃ
pūrvatvamasya vijñātuṃ śakyate; ita utaraṃ hyanunāsiko ruśca
samanuvṛterekakālaṃ vidhauyata ityanunāsikavidhānakāle
roraniṣpannatvam| atastadapekṣayā pūrvatvamidamaśakyaṃ vijñātum|
tasmādyasya sthāne rutvaṃ vidhīyate tadapekṣayā pūrvatvaṃ vijñāyate,
ityāha--ṭhyasya sthāne rurvidhīyate tataḥ pūrvasya' iti| tuśabdaḥ
parasmāta kāryiṇaḥ pūrvasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati| parasya rutvakāryam,

darśayati| rutvaṃ nityam anunāsikastu vibhāṣeti| 
achāckadkagaṇaṃ kimartham? atra ruprakaraṇe yathā syāditi cenna;
adhikārādevaitat siddham| yathā hi ‘anunāsikaḥ pūrvasya'
ityadhikṛtamutaratrānuvartate, tathā rurityetadapi|
tatrāntareṇāpyatreti vacanaṃ ruprakaraṇe bhaviṣyatītyata āha--ṭhatra'
ityāgadi| sanniyogaḥ--yaugapadyam| yaugapadyam| ruṇā saha kathaṃ nāma
sa pratīyetetyevamarthamatragrahaṇam| avadhāraṇañcātra
draṣṭavyam--ruṇaiveti| sanniyogamātraṃ hi rutvānunāsikayoḥ;
utaratra dvayorapyanuvṛteḥ| sthāniūbhedena
virodhābhāvādvināpyatragrahaṇena labhyata eva| nanu

āha--ṭhadhikāraparimāṇāparigrahe hi' ityādi| adhikārasya

āśaṅkyeta|

ācāryapravṛtirjñāpayati--vikalpenāyaṃ vidhirbhavatīti,
yadayamutarasūtre yasyānunāsiko na kṛtastasmādroḥ pūrvasmāt

‘bhobhagoaghoapūrvasva' iti| bhobhagoaghopūrvasya
vakārasyāsambhavāt| avarṇapūrnastu vakāraḥ sambhavati| tasya tu
pūrvameva ‘hali sarveṣām' ityanena lopo na bhavatīti darśitam|
teneha yakārasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na vakārasya, tasya lopo na bhavatīti
darśitam--ṭhbhobhagoaghoapūrvasya' (8.3.17) ityādau sūtre|
tatrāśgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? hali sarveṣāmityayaṃ lopo'śi hali yathā
syāt, iha mā bhūt--vṛkṣa vṛścatīti vṛkṣavṛṭ, tamācaṣṭa iti
ṇic, vṛkṣavavati, vṛkṣavayaterapratyayaḥ vṛkṣav--ṭhvakṣav karoti'
iti| evamaśgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayatāmena sūtreṇāśi hali
vakārasyāvarṇapūrvasya lopo na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| nanu
cāvarṇapūrvasyetyasyānuvṛtirayuktā; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt,
tatkathamavarṇapūrvasya lopo bhavatīti? naitadasti;
‘cānukṛṣṭamutaratr nānuvartate' (vyā.pa.76) iti prāyikametat|
kathaṃ jñāyate? ‘ekājutarapade ṇaḥ' (8.4.12) ityatra ‘ṇaḥ' iti prakṛte
punarṇagrahaṇam, ‘vā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (8.4.10) ityatra ‘vā' iti
yadanuvṛtaṃ tannivṛrttytha kṛtam| yadi cedaṃ prāyikaṃ na
syāt, punarṇagrahaṇamanartham; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvādeva hi
vāgrahaṇasyānuvṛtirna bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ punarṇagrahaṇena? kṛtañca,
tato'vasīyate--cānukṛṣṭaparibhāṣā'nityeti| 
‘śākaṭāyanasyāpi lopo yathā syāt' iti| apiśabdācchākalyasyāpi|
asati tu sarvagrahaṇe pratyāsannasya gārgyasya matena lopa eva
vijñāyeta|| 

23. mo'nusvāraḥ| (8.3.23)
padasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, tacca padaṃ makāreṇa viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ta
tadantavidhirbhavatīti makārāntapadasyānusvāro
vidhīyamāno'lo'tyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52) makārasyaiva vijñāyate,
ityāha--ṭhmakārāntasya padasya'[‘makārasya padāntasya'--kāśikā,
padamañjarī caṭ padasya' iti||

24. naścāpadāntasya jhali| (8.3.24)
‘hali' iti nivṛtam, jhalgrahaṇāt| cakāro makārānukarṣaṇārthaḥ|
asati hi tasminnikārasyāpadāntasya kāryiṇa iha grahaṇānmakāro
nivṛta ityāśaṅkā syāt| ‘payāṃsi' iti| ‘jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20),
‘napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num, ‘sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya'
(6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ| ‘ākraṃsyate' iti| āṅpūrvāt kramerlṛṭ,
‘āṅ udyamane' (1.3.40) ityātmanepadam| ‘ācikraṃsate' iti|
‘pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam| evaṃ ‘athijigāṃsate'
ityatrāpi| iṅḥ sani ‘iṅśca' (2.4.48) iti gamirādeśaḥ; ‘ajjhanagamāṃ
sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ; dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam| 
‘rājan' iti| rājateḥ śatrāntāt sambuddhiḥ, tasyā halṅyādinā
(6.1.68) lopaḥ|| 

25. mo rāji samaḥ kvau| (8.3.25)
‘samrāṭ' iti| sampūrvādrājateḥ ‘satsūdviva' (3.2.61) ityādinā
kvip, vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam, ṣakārasya jaśatvam--ḍakāraḥ,
tasya cartvam--ṭakāraḥ| ‘sābhrājyam' iti| brāhyaṇāditvat vyañ| 

kimarthaṃ punarmakāra uccāryate? ityāha--ṭhmakārasya makāravacanam'
ityādi| ‘mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.2.23) ityanusvāraḥ prāpnoti, sa mā
bhūdityevamarthaṃ makārasya makāro vidhīyate| yadyevam, neti
pratiṣedhaḥ kartavyaḥ, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati;
vibhaktyanuccāraṇāt? evaṃ tarhi nirdeaśādhikyena tu
makāravidhānenaitat sūcayati--atra prakaraṇe'dhiko hi
vidhirbhavatīti| yavalapare yavalā vā bhavantītyupapannaṃ bhavati|
‘saṃyat' iti| yameḥ sampūrvāt kvip, ‘anudātopadeśa' (6.4.37)
ityādinā makāralopaḥ, akārasya ‘hrasvasya piti kṛti' (6.1.71) iti
tuk|| 

26. he mapare vā| (8.3.26)
maḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ| ‘kim hyalayati' iti| ‘hvala hyala
calane' (dhā.pā.805,806), ‘jvalahvalahyalanamāmanupasargādvā'
(ga.sū.dhā.pā.817 ityasyānantaram) iti vā mitsaṃjñā, ‘mitāṃ hrasvaḥ'
(6.4.92) iti hrasvaḥ| 
‘yavalapare' ityādi| yavalāḥ pare yataḥ sa yavalaparastasmin he
makārasya vā yavalā bhavantītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ|
vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvaṃ vihitameva| yavalāścaite bhavanta āntaratamyāt
sānunāsikā eva bhavanti| vāvacanāt pakṣe'nusvāro bhavatyeva| atha
‘he bhaḥ' ityeva kasmānnoktam; evaṃ hi paragrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati,
saptamyaiva hi tadarthaṃ pratipādayiṣyate--makāre parato yo'kāra iti?
naitadasti; ‘he maḥ' ityucyamāne viparyayo'pi
vijñāyeta--hakārapare makāra iti, tataśca kimahna ityādāveva
syāt| akāreṇa vyavadhānānna bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; ‘yena
nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt' (vyā.pa.46)
ityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate, na punaranekeneti| ādyapakṣe
kim hyalayatītyādiṣu kṛtārthaṃ vacanam, ato na śakyaṃ
vyavadhānamāśrayitumiti cet? na; yena hakārapade makāra ityeṣa
sūtrārtho gṛhītaḥ, taṃ prati pakṣāntarasyāsambhavāt| tasmāt
paragrahaṇameva kartvyaṃ viparyayapratītirmā bhūdityevamartham|| 

27. napare naḥ| (8.3.27)
naḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ| paragrahaṇaṃ nakārapare yathā
syādityevamartham, anyathā hi ‘ne naḥ' ityucya māne nakāra eva
kevale parato vijñāyeta, na iti nimitāntaropādanād he ityasya
nivṛtiḥ? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt| kṛte
hyanutvāre nakāre parataḥ ‘anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58)
ityanena nakāraḥ sidhyati? satyam; vikalpārthametat| atra hi
yadānena nakāro na kriyate, tadā vacanasāmarthyāt parasavarṇo na
bhavatīti vikalpaḥ sidhyati| tasmāt paragrahaṇa kartvyam--napare
hakāre yathā syāt, kevale mā bhūditi| ‘kin hnute' iti|
‘hnuṅ apanayane'; (dhā.pā.1082), adāditvāccchapo luk| 
iha keciccodayanti--na iti pratiṣedhaḥ kasmānna vijñāyata iti?
etaccāyuktam; savisargasya pāṭhāt pratiṣedhavācinaśca nakārasya
visargānupapateḥ| athāpyavisargaḥ paṭhaḷte? evamapyayuktā
pratiṣedhāśaṅkā; prāptyabhāvāt|| 

28. ṅṇoḥ kukṭuak śari| (8.3.28)
ṅśca ṇaśca tau ṅṇau, kaśca ṭaśca kaṭau, tayorukārakakārābhyāṃ
pratyekamabhisambandhaḥ--kukṭgiti| ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, kakāro
deśavidhyarthaḥ| ‘prāṅk chete' iti| prāṅiti ‘kvinpratyayasya kuḥ'
(8.2.62) ityatra vyutpāditam| vaṇṭ chete' iti| vaṇatervic| 
kimarthaṃ punaḥ pūrvāntādetau kriyete? ityāha--ṭhpūrvāntakaraṇam'
ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ pūrvāntatve ccchatvaṃ bhavati, na punaḥ
parāditve? ityata āha--ṭhśaśchāe'ṭi' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punaretaddhi
‘vijñāyate? [valijñāyeta'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥṭ ityata āha--ṭhiha' ityādi|
yadi padāntājjhaya (8.2.10) ityevaṃ tatra na kriyeta, tadā
virapśinnityatra ccchatvaṃ vijñāyeta, evañca vijñāyamāne na bhavati, na hyatra
padānte jhay| ‘viriṣśin' iti| vipūrvādrapeḥ ‘lṛṭaḥ sadvā'
[‘laṭaḥ'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥṭ (3.3.14) iti śatrādeśāḥ, ‘vyatyayo bahulam'
(3.1.85) iti syapratyayasya sakārasya śakāraḥ, yakārasya cekāraḥ|
‘prāṅk sāyaḥ' iti| atra parāditve sati ‘iṇkoḥ' (8.3.57),
‘ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti prāptasya ṣatvasya ‘sātpadādyoḥ'
(8.3.112) iti pratiṣedho na syāt; apadāditvāt| ‘vaṇṭ sāyaḥ'
iti| atrāpi ‘ṣṭuanā ṣṭuaḥ' (8.4.41) iti prāptasya ṣṭuatvasya ‘na
padāntāṭṭoranāma' (8.4.42) iti pratiṣedho na syāt;
apadāntatvāt| tasmāt prāṅkcheta ityādau cchatvādisidhyartha
pūrvāntakaraṇam|| 

29. ḍaḥ si dhud| (8.3.29)
‘ubhayanirdeaśe pañcamīnirdeaśo balīyām' (śāka.pa.97) iti ‘ṅḥ' iti
pañcamyā ‘si' ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ parikalpitāyāṃ śakārasyaiva
dhuḍavidhīyate, ityāha--ṭhḍakārāntāt' ityādi| yadyevam,
saptamīnirdeaśaḥ kimarśaḥ? lāghavārthaḥ| ‘ṅḥ so dhuṭ' ityucyamāne
mādhādhikyāṭ gauravaṃ syāt| atha ‘yasmin
vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) ityevamarthaḥ saptamīnirdeaśaḥ
kasmānna vijñāyate? kevalasya sakārasyābhāvādeva tatsiddheḥ, pada
ityadhikārācccha| śvaliṭatyāya ityatra dhuṭi kṛte dhakārasya
cartvam--takāraḥ|
prakriyālāghavārthaṃ tu tuṭi vaktavye dhuṅvacanamutarārtham--ṭhnaśca'
(8.3.30) ityatra dhuḍayathā syāt, tuṇmā bhūditi| yadi hi syāt,
tarhi kim? bhavāntsāya ityatra ‘naścchavyapraśāna' (8.3.7) iti ruḥ
prasajyeta? naitadasti; ampara ityatrānavartate, na
cehāmparastakāro'sti| athathehāpi bhūtapūrveṇokāreṇāmparaḥ
syāt? evamapyasiddhatvāt tuṭo rutvaṃ na bhaviṣyati| tasmātuḍeva
vaktavyaḥ| evaṃ tarhi vaicitryārtha dhuḍavacanam| 
atha kimarthaṃ dhuṭ parādhiḥ kriyate, na dyaugeva pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta, evaṃ
hi ‘śi tuk' (8.4.31) ityatra tuggrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, dhugeva
hi tatrānuvartiṣyate? ityata āha--ṭhparādikaraṇam' ityādi| yadi
pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta, śvaliṭtsāya ityatra dhukaḥ ṣṭuatvaṃ syāt|
parādikaraṇe tu ṭakārasya padāntatvaṃ na vihitamiti ‘na
padāntāṭṭoranam' (8.4.42) iti pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| tadarthaṃ
parādikaraṇam|| 

30. naśca| (8.3.30)
cakāro dhuḍityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| nanu ca svaritatvādevānuvartiṣyate,
na cotaratrānuvartiṣyate, āgamāntarasyopādānāt, asvaritatvādvā?
satyametat; pratipatigauravaṃ tu mandadhiyāṃ syāt| atha bhavāntsāya
ityatra dhuṭaścātve kṛte ‘naścchavyapraśān' (8.3.7) iti ruḥ kasmānna
bhavati? ityāha--ṭhdhuṭaścartvasya cāsiddhatvāt' ityādi| yadi kevalasya
catvesya dhuṭo vāsiddhatvaṃ syāt, tathāpi rutvaprāpterasambhava eva,
kiṃ punarubhayorasiddhatve satīti rutvaprāpteratyantāsabhbhavaṃ
darśayitumubhayorgrahaṇam| kvacit ‘ghuṭaścartvasyāsiddhatvāt'
iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpyayamartho veditavyaḥ--vināpi hi cakāreṇa tadartho
gamyate, yatāharaharnayamāno vaivasthato gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ
paśumityādau vākye| atha vā--asmi pāṭhe dhuṭo yaccārtvaṃ
tasyāsiddhatvādityarthaḥ| nanu dhuḍapyasiddha eva, tat
kutaścartvasyāsiddhāvamucyate? punardhuṭo'pi? naitat; satyapi
dhuṭi vinā cartvena rutvapraptireva nāsti| tato yasmin sati
rutvamādāṅkyate, tasyāsiddhatvaṃ yuktanuktamiti bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ
satyapi cartvasyāsiddhatve rutvamākṣaṅkitam, yāvatā'mpare cchavi
taducyate, na cehāmparatvamasti?
bhūtapūrveṇokāreṇāmparatvamastīti yugatamāśaṅkitam| nanu ca
sāmpratikābhāve bhūtapūrvagatirbhavati, asti
sāmpratikatvamanyatrāmparatvaṃ rutvasya? satyametat;
adhyāropyaivamuktam; evaṃ manyate--bhavatu nāma,
bhūtapūrveṇokāreṇāmparatvaṃ prasajyata
ityāha--ṭhdhuṭaśmartvasyāsiddhatvāt' iti||

31. śi tuk| (8.3.31)
‘śi' iti saptamyakṛtārthā ‘naḥ' iti pūrvasūtre kṛtārthāyāḥ pañcamyāḥ
ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayati; ‘tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti
vacanāt, tena nakara evāgamī vijñāyata ityāha--ṭhnakārāntasya'
ityādi| 
atha kimarthaṃ tuk pūrvāntaḥ kriyate, na prakṛto dhuḍeva parādiḥ
kriyeta; tathāpi cartvena sidhyati? ityata āha--ṭhpūrvāntakaraṇam'
ityādi| pūrvāntaḥupūrvasyāntaḥ, sa punaḥ prakaraṇāt tugvijñāyate,
talpa karaṇamuvidhānam, cchatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| yadi
prakṛto dhuḍeva vidhīyeta, ‘śaśchāe'ṭi' (8.4.63) iti ccchatvaṃ na
syāt| tatra ca kāraṇaṃ pūrvamevoktam| ‘yadyevam' ityādi| yadi
pūrvāntastuk kriyate, kurvañcete--ityatra tukā padāntatāyā
rahitatvāt nakārasya ‘aṭkuṣvāṅ' (8.4.2) ityanena ṇatvaṃ
prāpnoti, parāditve tveṣa doṣo na bhavati; ‘padāntasya' (8.4.37)
iti ṇatvaparatiṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ| ‘tatra' ityādinā ‘na
bhābhūpūkamigami' (8.4.34) ityādeḥ sūtrānneti vartamāne ‘stoḥ
ścunā ścaḥ' (8.4.40) iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena cavargayoge
kurvañcete--ityatra ṇatvaṃ na bhavatyeva| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi
yogadibhāge ṇatvaṃ prāpnotyeva, yasmādiha cavargayogo nāstyeva,
tukaḥ ścutvasyāsiddhatvāt? yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyāt
ścutvasyāsiddhatve'pi ṇatvapratiṣedho bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|| 

32. ṅmo hvasvādaci ṅmuṇnityam| (8.3.32)
‘imaḥ' iti, ‘ṅmuṭa' iti ubhayamapi pratyāhāragrahaṇam| uḍiti pratyekaṃ
ṅkārādibhiḥ sambadhyate| ‘hrasvāt' ityetanṅmo viśeṣaṇam,
hrasvaviśeṣito'pi ṅm padasya viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca
tadantavidhirbhavatīti tadantāt padāditi vijñāyate| yadyapi
padasyeti ṣaṣṭhaḷntaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpi tadihārthāt pañcamyantatayā
vipariṇamyate--ṭhubhayanirdeaśe pañcamonirdeaśo balīyān'
(śāka.pa.97) iti| ‘ṅmaḥ' iti pañcamyā ‘aci' iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ
parikalpitāyāmaca evāgamitvaṃ pratipadyate| saptamīnirdeaśastu
lāghavārthaḥ; utarārthaścetyetatsarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā'ha--ṭhhvasvāt
paro yo ṅm, tadantāt' iti| saṃkhyātānudeśo hīha
veditavyaḥ; āgamināmāgamānāñca samānatvāt| ‘pratyaṅṅaste' iti|
‘āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021), adāditvāccchapo luk| ‘kṛvannāste'
iti| ‘kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.990) laudādikaḥ, śat| 
atha paramadaṇḍinotamadaṇḍineti ‘sanmahat' (2.1.61) ityādinā
samāse kṛte ṅmantāt tṛtīyaikavacane tasya nuṭ kasmānna bhavati;
atra hi ‘yaci bham' (1.4.18) iti bhatve'pi samāsasya hrasvādikārāt
paro ṅm nakāraḥ, tadantāddaṇḍinetyasmādyā vibhaktistasyāṃ
luptāyāmapi pratyayalakṣaṇena (1.1.62) labdhapadasaṃjñatvāt
tṛtīyaikavacanamacparaṃ bhavatītyasti ṅmuṭprāptiḥ?
ityāha--ṭhparamadaṇḍinā' tyādi| utarapadatve utarapadavyapadeśe
kartavye satyapadādividhau padāvidhidheranyatra pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na
bhavatīti vākyārthaḥ| asati pratyayalakṣaṇe daṇḍinetyasya padasaṃjñā na
bhavati| tataśca padāntādutarasyocyamāno ṅmuḍāgamo na bhavati| 
evaṃ tāvat kātyāyanamatena parīhāra uktaḥ| yastu sūtrakāramatena,
taṃ darśayitumāha--ṭhatha vā' ityādi| pada ityanuvṛtī satyāmacā pade
viśeṣyamāṇe ‘yasmin vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vā.14)
ityanenājādau pade kāryeṇa bhavitavyam, na cātrājādi padamasti,
tatkuto nuṭprasaṅgaḥ|
atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatotarasūtre (8.3.33) vāgrahaṇādeva
nityo vidhirvijñāsyate? satyametat; pūrvasūtre'pi (8.3.31)
nityatvaṃ vijñāyeta| tasmāt pūrvasūtreṣu ‘he mapare vā' (8.3.26)
ityato ‘vā' itnuvartata iti jñāpanārthaṃ nityagrahaṇam|| 

33. maya uño vo vā| (8.3.33)
‘mayaḥ' iti pratyāhārasya grahaṇam, na tu aya vaya ‘maya' iti dhātoḥ|
kuta etat? vyāptinyāyāt| kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā ‘iko
yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityuño vakāraḥ siddha eva, vikalpārthamiti cet?
syādetat--yadi ‘iko yaṇaci' iti nityaṃ syāt, tasmādvikalpārthaṃ
vacanamiti? etacca na; ‘padāntādvā' (6.1.76) ityato vetyanuvartiṣyate,
sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenoño vikalpena
yanmavatītyāha--ṭhpragṛhyatvāt' ityādi| pragṛhyatvaṃ punaḥ ‘uñaḥ' (1.1.17)
iti pragṛhyasaṃjñāvidhānāt| tasmin sati ‘plutapragṛhya aci' (6.1.125)
iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, tasmin prāpte vakāro vidhīyate|
evamapi ‘iko yaṇaci' ityasyānantaramuño yaṇ vakāro vidheyaḥ?
evaṃ hi va iti na kartavyaṃ bhavati; yaṇaḥ prakṛtatvāt| veti vacanaṃ na
kartavyaṃ bhavati; ‘padāntādvā' (6.1.76) ityato vāgrahaṇaṃ
maṇḍūakaplutyā'nuvartate? ityāha--ṭhasiddhatvāt' ityādi| tatra

34. visarjanīyasya saḥ| (8.3.34)
‘kharotyanuvartate' iti| kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.15) ityataḥ

35. śarpare visarjanīyaḥ| (8.3.35)
śar paro yasmāditi vahuvrīhiḥ| atha paragrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na
śarītyevocyeta? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum, evaṃ hyucyamāne śara eva kevalaṃ
nimitabhāvo vijñāyeta, na kharītyanuvṛteḥ ‘vā śari' (8.3.36) iti
vidhānācca| viparyayastarhi vijñāryeta--śarīti, tathā ca nityaḥ
sphoṭaḥ, puruṣaḥ sthūla ityādādeva syāt, vāsaḥ kṣīmamityādau tu
na syāt? tasmādviparyayo mā vijñāyītyevamarthaṃ paragrahaṇam| 
atha kimarthaṃ visarjanīya ityucyate, netyevocyeta, sakārasa hi
pratiṣedhe kṛte visarjanīyaḥ svenaiva rūpeṇāvasthāsyate?
ityāha--ṭhvimarjanīyasya' ityādi| tasya visarjanīyasaya vikāro
jihvāmūlīyādiḥ, tannivṛtyartha visarjanīyagrahaṇam; anyathā yadi
netyevocyeta, tataḥ ‘anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedo vā'
(vyā.pa.29) iti sakārasyaiva vijñāyeta| tataśca
jihvāmūlīyādirvisarjanīyasya vikāraḥ syādeva| visarjanīyagrahaṇe
tu tatsāmarthyādeva na bhavati||

ca ḍhagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtaṃ vaicitryārtham| nanu ca kriyāmāṇena ḍhagrahaṇena

iti| ‘hrasvādaṅgāt' (8.2.27) iti sico lopa-|

‘rudavida' (1.2.8) ityādinā kitvād vacyādisatreṇa (6.1.15)
samprasāraṇam| 
‘kaḥ sānubandhake'nurodhaḥ' iti| nakāro'nubandhaḥ| nakārānubandhasya

(3.4.80), ‘asaṃyogālliṭ kit' (1.2.5) iti kitvam;
vaccādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam, krādiniyamādiṭ,

‘abhyāsasya yā prāptiḥ'[‘abhyāsāt'--kāśikā, padamañjarī caṭ ityādi|

tasmādabhyāsādyā ptistasyā niyamo yathā syādityabhyāsagrahaṇam|

aghipūrvādikaḥ san, ajāditvāddvitoyaikāc ‘sanyaṅeḥ (6.1.9)

62. sa svidisvadisahīnāṃ ca| (8.3.62)

63. prāksitādaṅvyavāye'pi| (8.3.63)

64. sthādiṣvabhyāsena cābhyāsasya| (8.3.64)

ityāha--ṭhabhyāsena vyavārye ityādi| aṣopadeśo yastasya sakāraḥ
pūrveṇa na sidhyatīti tadarthamabhyāsena vyavāye ṣatvamucyate|

ityādinā ṇic, iṣṭhavadbhāvāṭṭilopaḥ, san, pūrvavadiḍāgamaḥ|

‘avarṇāntābhyāsārthaṃ ca' iti| ṣopadeśamadhikṛtya taduktam| yadyapi

ṇalaḥ' (7.1.34) ityautvam, pūrvavat khayaḥ śeṣaḥ|

tadetaduktam--yaḥ ṣaṇi pratiṣedhaḥ stotiṇibhyāmanyasya dhātoḥ

yadyabhyāsena vyavāye nocyeta tadā ṣatvaṃ na syāt,
yathā--sisikṣatītyatra|

vyavāye'pīti, evamantareṇābyāsasyeti

79. vibhāṣeṭaḥ| (8.3.79)
kvacit pūrveṇa nitye prāpte, kvacidaprāpta eva vikalpārtha
vacanam| etaccodāharaṇe vyaktokariṣyāmaḥ| atreṇgrahaṇamiṭo

paratvaṃ na sambhavati, tasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt? yadyapi śāstrakṛtaṃ
na sambhavati, tathāpi śrutikṛtaṃ tu sambhavatyevetyadoṣaḥ|
‘laviṣīdhvam, laviṣīḍhavam' iti| atra ṣīdhvaṃśabdasyeṭi kṛte tasya

‘alavidhvam' ityatrāpi sica eveḍāgamaḥ kriyate, na luṅ iti tasya
tadgrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt pūrveṇa na prāpnoti| ‘luluviḍhave'
ityatrāpi liṭa eveḍāgama iti tasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇādasati
vyadadhāne pūrveṇa nityaṃ prāpnoti| 
‘āsiṣīdhvam' iti| ‘āsa upadaśane' (dhā.pā.1021), liṅ, sovuṭ,
dhātusakārasyeṇo'sanni veśādiṇaḥ paro'troḍāgamo na bhavati| 
‘atheha kathaṃ bhavitavyam' iti| kimatrānena vikalpena bhavitavyam?
uta nityena bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| ‘dīṅ kṣaye' (dhā.pā.1134),
liṭ, krādiniyamādiṭ (7.2.13)| ‘dīṅe yuḍaci kṅiti' (6.4.63)
iti guṭ, ṭeretavam| upadidīyidhva iti sthite kecidāhunaṃ
bhavitavyamevātra ḍhatvavikalpena; iṇantādaṅgādiṭo yadānantarya tasya
yuṭā vyavahitatvāta| samudāyabhakto hyasau yuṭ samudāyameva na
vyavadadhāti| avayavaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva| atha pūrveṇa nityaṃ kasmānna
bhavati? atreṇantādaṅgādutaro liṭ, satsambandhī ca dhakāra iti
bhavitavyam| tathā ca vṛtikṛtā sūtrārtho darśitaḥ| atha tu neṣyate,
tato vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ pūrveṇāsambandhanīyam| sā ca
vyavasthitavibhāṣaḥ, teneha na bhavati| evamanyatra tu nityameva
bhaviṣyati| ‘apareṣām' ityādi| yadāṅgagrahaṇamiha nivṛtam, iṇa
ityetadevānuvartate, tadeṇaiva kevaleneḍāgamo viśeṣyate--iṇaḥ

(pu.pa.vṛ.57) ityuktam—, tato'yamadoṣa iti cet—? na;
savarṇasaṃjñāsūtre (1.1.9) prayatnabhedasyāpyāśritatvāt—; anyathā tatra
prayatnagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt—| yadi tarhi vivṛtaḥ pratijñātastat—
kimarthaṃ tasyeha pratyatpatiḥ kriyate? ityāha--ṭhtasya” ityādi|
ṭhtathābhūtasya” iti| vivṛtaprayatnabhūtasyeteyarthaḥ| pratyāpatiḥ
punastasya saṃvṛtaguṇasyākārasya svarūpāt— pracyutasya punaḥ
svarūpasya pratilakṣaṇa, mṛtasya pratyujjīvanavat—| 
ihānena vivṛtenākākeṇa gṛhyamāṇenāṇatvāt—
sakalamavarṇakulamudātādibhedabhinnamaṣṭādakṣaprakāraṃ gṛhītam—,
tataśca yathā guṇāntarayuktasya hrasvasya saṃvṛto hrasva ādeśo bhavati,
evaṃ dīrghaplutayorapi syāt—| kiñcādeśo'yamakāraḥ saṃvṛta
upātaḥ, saṃvṛtasya cākārasyāṇtvaṃ nāsti, pratyāhāre'sanniveśāt—,
tataśca yathā'ctvābhāvāddīrghaplutau na gṛhṇāti, tathā saṃvṛtamapi
mātrikaṃ guṇāntarayuktaṃ na gṛhṇīyāta; evañca sati yadguṇa
uccāritastadguṇayuktasyaiva pratyāpatiḥ syāt—| na guṇāntarayuktasya?
ityāha--ṭhdīrghaplutayośca” ityādi| kathaṃ punardīrghaplutayoranena
vivṛtenākāreṇa grahaṇaniṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? kathaṃ ca saṃvṛtena
sarvaguṇayuktasya mātrikasya grahaṇamiṣyamāṇamapi labhyate? pūrvasūtra
udayagrahaṇāditi pūrvameva kāraṇamuktamatrāsmābhirudayagrahaṇasya
prayojña varṇayadbhiḥ| 
taparakaraṇanirddeśamanye tvāhuḥ| ad— a iti tapara nirdeaśaḥ
kartavyaḥ| tathā ca bhāvya utam—--ṭhsiddhaṃ tu taparanirdeaśāt”— iti| tatra
prathamo'kāraḥ taḥ paro yasmāditi taparaḥ, dvitīyastu tadapi
parastapara iti| tasya vivṛtasya taparatvaṃ dīrghaplutanivṛtyartham—,
saṃvṛtasya sarvaguṇayuktasya mātrikasya ca grahaṇāyaṃmiti|
iṣṭaḷupasaṃkhyānavatītyādiślokaḥ pūrvameva vyākhyātaḥ|| 

iti bodhisatvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ

kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāmaṣṭamādhyāyasya 

caturthaḥ pādaḥ
- - -
samāptaścāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ| 

iti bodhisatvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitā

kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikā|
- - -
samāptaśca nyāsagrantho jinendrabuddhikṛtaḥ||
